jobs.occupation: Software Engineer – build the future of heavy-lift cargo UAV
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced software engineer looking for something different? Imagine developing software in the morning, testing it on real hardware in the afternoon, and eventually watching it take flight.

At Acodyne, you will work alongside engineers developing next-generation unmanned aircraft, applying your software engineering experience to challenges that extend far beyond the screen.

You will have the opportunity to work across the software stack, from embedded systems and flight control integration to simulation, telemetry, and ground-based applications. You'll join a small, ambitious team where your contributions will have a direct impact on the aircraft we build.

**Your Role

**As part of our growing engineering team, you will develop and integrate software for our high-speed, heavy-lift cargo UAVs and their supporting systems.

You will work closely with electronics, mechanical, and aerospace engineers to turn ideas into working solutions, taking software from development through simulation, hardware integration, and real-world flight testing.

We believe that reliable software starts with good engineering practices. Code reviews, automated testing, continuous integration, and reproducible builds are important parts of how we want to develop our systems.

**You Will

**

• Develop and maintain software for our aircraft and supporting systems.

• Work with embedded Linux platforms, flight computers, sensors, actuators, and communication systems.

• Integrate and extend existing flight control technologies such as ArduPilot or PX4.

• Develop tools for telemetry collection, monitoring, data analysis, and ground control.

• Build and maintain simulation environments and automated tests to validate software before flight.

• Contribute to reliable development workflows, continuous integration, testing, and release processes.

• Collaborate across engineering disciplines to integrate and troubleshoot software and hardware.

• Participate in prototype development, system integration, and flight test activities.

• Document software designs, interfaces, and test results to support future certification and compliance.

**About You

**We're looking for an experienced software engineer who enjoys solving challenging technical problems and takes pride in building reliable, maintainable software.

You've worked in a professional software development environment and understand the value of good engineering practices. Version control, code reviews, automated testing, continuous integration, and reproducible builds are a natural part of how you work.

You're comfortable taking ownership, making pragmatic engineering decisions, and collaborating with people from different technical backgrounds. You enjoy learning new technologies and aren't afraid to venture beyond your existing expertise.

You don't need to be an aerospace expert. We value strong software engineering fundamentals, technical curiosity, and the ability to master new domains.

**You Likely Have

**

• Several years of professional software development experience.

• Strong programming skills in C/C++ and experience developing software for Linux.

• Experience working with modern development workflows, including Git, code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD.

• An understanding of software architecture, debugging, and maintaining complex software systems.

• Some experience with embedded systems, hardware interfaces, or resource-constrained environments.

• A pragmatic, hands-on approach to engineering and an interest in working with physical systems.

• The ability to work independently while contributing constructively to a multidisciplinary team.

**It Would Be a Plus If You Have

**

• Experience with robotics, UAVs, autonomous systems, or flight control software.

• Familiarity with ArduPilot, PX4, MAVLink, or similar technologies.

• Experience with simulation, hardware-in-the-loop testing, or real-time systems.

• Knowledge of networking, telemetry, data acquisition, or distributed systems.

• Experience using AI-assisted development tools or working with machine learning technologies.

We don't expect you to tick every box. We're more interested in your engineering mindset, technical curiosity, and ability to learn.

As an early-stage startup pushing the boundaries of innovation, we offer a salary typical for our phase of growth.

**About Acodyne

**Acodyne is on a mission to develop the world's fastest unmanned eVTOL aircraft for heavy payloads, initially to serve off-shore, remote areas and general logistics.

Beyond developing the aircraft, we're exploring how intelligent software, automation, and data-driven systems can shape the future of unmanned cargo operations.

We are a small, ambitious engineering team with plans to grow significantly. We're based at Avedøre Airfield, where your daily work will primarily take place.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and interviews will be conducted continuously.

Please note that we are currently unable to provide visa sponsorship or relocation assistance.

**Our Purpose

**Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and supports over 400,000 users across Europe, Australia and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

**How You’ll Make An Impact

**As our Lead Engineer- Data, you will set the architectural direction of the data platform that enables both the decisions we make internally and the data-driven features our customers rely on. Working with the Data, ML, Platform, and Product Engineering teams, you will keep ingestion, modelling, and orchestration dependable, and define the modelling, testing, and documentation standards the data function depends on. You will innovate on how people work with data, building the agentic tooling and semantic modelling that let teams across Planday work from trusted data with confidence.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Set the architectural direction of our data platform so it serves analytics, product engineering, and AI/ML from one coherent design, collaborating with Platform and ML engineering on shared infrastructure.

• Design the dbt models, semantic layer, and quality standards the data function depends on, with the validation and lineage to make them trustworthy downstream.

• Own orchestration and observability in Dagster, and onboarding new sources in a way that scales.

• Innovate on self-serve and AI-enabled analytics, from semantic models and agentic workflows to our BI layer.

• Build the historical and low-latency foundations that make predictive and real-time use cases possible.

• Introduce better modelling standards, tooling, and development environments.

• Keep the platform reliable, performant, cost-effective, and compliant.

**Success looks like

**

• Architecture that holds up as we scale and as new use cases emerge, and that other engineers follow as a pattern.

• Analysts ship faster and more efficiently because your tooling & standards remove friction.

• A drop in repeat requests to the data team, as stakeholders answer their own questions through agentic workflows.

• ML and product teams have the historical and real-time data they need, without bespoke workarounds.

• Strong working relationships with the Data, ML, and Platform teams.

**What You’ll Bring With You

**

• Deep, hands-on Snowflake and dbt experience: modelling, semantic layers, agents & skills, testing, performance and cost tuning.

• Production experience with a pipeline orchestrator, ideally Dagster (or similar Airflow, Prefect), including dependent workloads, partial failures, and observability.

• Modern cloud infrastructure (Azure/AWS/GCP) and Kubernetes experience deploying and operating containerised workloads, plus infrastructure as code (Terraform).

• Strong SQL & Python for pipelines, services, and automation.

• Software engineering discipline across CI/CD, testing, and code review.

• The ability to turn technical trade-offs into clear narratives that help stakeholders decide and trust the work.

• Experience operating data systems, including incident response, cost, and data privacy practices.

**At Planday, we offer you

**

• Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation

• On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan

• Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us

• Flexible remote work

• Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities

• Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe

• Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities

Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.

_At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process.

jobs.occupation: Business Consultant, Payments, Netcompany Banking Services
jobs.description:
Job Description

_Are you interested in the intersection of IT, business and finance? As a Business Consultant in Payments, you will work with IT solutions supporting banks' payment processes and open banking. You will analyse business needs, translate client requirements into solutions and build specialized knowledge within payments and open banking.

_

Netcompany Banking Services

We deliver various IT solutions and services to banks and savings institutions across Denmark and other Nordic countries. We provide a modern, cloud-based core banking platform serving more than 50 Nordic banks with over 2 million end customers. Our solutions encompass daily banking operations, mobile and internet banking, payments, investment management, risk management, compliance, and open banking.

Responsibilities

We are looking for a Business Consultant to join our team, working with IT solutions within payments and open banking. You will help translate business needs and regulatory requirements into solutions that support banks' payment services and enable secure access to customer accounts for regulated third-party providers. Your work will involve analysing business processes, understanding client needs and identifying opportunities to improve and develop our solutions.

You will join an experienced team that will support your development and help you build expertise within payments, open banking and financial services. Over time, you will have the opportunity to take on broader responsibilities within sales, strategy and leadership, contributing to client roadmaps, business cases and new initiatives.

**Your responsibilities will typically include:

**

• Analysing business needs and translating them into IT solutions within payments and open banking.

• Mapping business processes and facilitating workshops with clients and colleagues to identify needs, challenges and opportunities for improvement.

• Supporting the analysis of regulatory requirements and understanding their implications for our clients' solutions, including strong customer authentication and secure access for third-party providers.

• Collaborating closely with clients and colleagues on solution design, business cases, roadmaps and proposals, as well as implementation and change management where relevant.

• Building commercial and business understanding, with opportunities to contribute to sales, strategy and leadership initiatives over time.

About you

You are curious, analytical and motivated by understanding how business processes work and how IT can support and improve them. You enjoy asking questions, learning through dialogue and collaborating with different stakeholders to create value for clients. You are comfortable taking responsibility, building relationships and working towards deadlines, even when things get busy.

We imagine that you are either a recent graduate or have a few years of experience working at the intersection of business and IT. Most importantly, you are motivated to develop your commercial understanding and pursue a career within sales, strategy and leadership.

**We imagine that you have:

**

• A relevant master's degree, such as Cand.merc. IT, Cand.it. or a similar degree combining IT, business, finance or accounting.

• Some experience from IT consulting, business analysis or a similar field. Recent graduates with a strong interest in IT and financial services are also welcome.

• Good analytical skills and an interest in understanding business processes, identifying opportunities and translating business needs into solutions.

• A genuine interest in IT, digitalisation and business development, ideally combined with an interest in finance, banking or payments. An interest in sales, strategy or leadership is an advantage, but prior experience is not required.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English, spoken and written, is mandatory.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritize an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparing.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

**Help us bring AI from ambition to reality

**At AGC Biologics, we have reached an exciting point in our AI journey. The governance foundation is in place, several high-value use cases have been identified, and we are now ready to scale the development and deployment of AI solutions across the business.

To support this journey, we are looking for an AI & Data Solutions Engineer who can help turn business challenges into practical and scalable AI solutions.

This role sits within our Global Data, AI & Business Platforms organization and will work at the intersection of business, technology, and innovation. You will collaborate with stakeholders across AGC Biologics, partner with AGC Inc.'s Data Science teams, and contribute directly to the design, development, and deployment of AI-powered solutions that support manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and business operations.

**What You'll Be Doing

**In your first months, you will be involved in several AI initiatives already identified across the organization. Some solutions will be developed together with AGC Inc.'s Data Science teams, while others will be built and deployed directly within AGC Biologics.

Success in this role requires someone who enjoys moving between business discussions and technical implementation. One day you may be meeting with stakeholders to understand a new AI opportunity and define requirements. The next, you may be preparing datasets, working on solution architecture, developing machine learning capabilities, or supporting the deployment of an AI solution into production.

You will work closely with our Data Engineering, Analytics, Solution Architecture, and Digitalization teams and play an important role in ensuring that AI solutions are technically robust, business-relevant, and ready for real-world use.

**What We're Looking For

**We imagine you come from a background in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, or a related field, and have already worked hands-on with building, deploying, or supporting AI and data-driven solutions.

You are comfortable working with technologies such as Python, SQL, Azure, and ideally have exposure to platforms such as Microsoft Fabric and Snowflake. Experience working with machine learning models, AI applications, data pipelines, and data preparation is important, while familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, or other emerging AI technologies would be a significant advantage.

Equally important is your ability to work with people. This is a highly business-facing role, and we are looking for someone who can confidently engage stakeholders, translate business needs into technical solutions, and communicate complex concepts in a simple and understandable way.

You enjoy collaboration, challenge assumptions constructively, and thrive in environments where priorities evolve and new opportunities emerge.

**Experience That Will Help You Succeed

**Experience from the pharmaceutical, biotech, or other GxP-regulated industries will be considered a strong advantage. We also welcome candidates coming from manufacturing or production-focused environments where technology, data, and business operations come together to support critical processes.

Whether your background is in AI Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, or Data Engineering, what matters most is your ability to combine technical expertise with strong stakeholder engagement and a genuine passion for solving business problems through technology.

**Why AGC Biologics?

**This is an opportunity to join a growing global team where AI is becoming a strategic capability across the organization. You will have the chance to influence how AI is adopted, work with modern technologies, collaborate with colleagues across Europe, Asia, and North America, and contribute to solutions that support the development and manufacturing of therapies that improve patients' lives around the world.

If you are excited by the opportunity to help shape the future of AI at AGC Biologics, we would love to hear from you.

**Interested in Joining Us?

**If you are interested we would like to hear from you.

Applications are screened on an ongoing basis. You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application, but please include a few sentences in you CV about your motivation for applying to this position.

Please note that AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark, or the greater Malmø area.

If this sounds like the right challenge for you, we’d love to hear from you. Don’t hesitate to apply, even if you don’t meet every single requirement. The right mindset matters just as much.

Please submit your application through the AGC Biologics careers site. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

**Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

Join us as a frontrunner and change the way we build software, with AI at the centre.

Software engineering is being rewritten right now, and we want to be among the ones holding the pen. The best companies of the next few years will not simply be the biggest. They will be the ones that learned early how to work with AI as part of the team: people setting the direction, agents doing much of the work, and every step tested and traceable.

At Framm, the platform company of Inpay Group, we have already started. Our AI-driven development lifecycle (AI-DLC) is up and running, and agents write tests for us today. But we do not want to follow the pack. We want to be the frontrunner, and we really want to change the way we work, and not just in engineering. What we need now is an engineer who can take what works in development and carry it into the rest of the business.

**If you want to do more with AI than speed up a single team, and would rather help reinvent how a whole company works, keep reading.

****The role

**This is a rare chance to reshape a business from the inside. You will start in development, where our AI-DLC is already running, and build on it: strengthening how engineering works with agents and making it the way the whole team works. Then you follow the thread outwards.

Your job is to own capabilities, meaning end-to-end business activities such as how we reconcile funds at the end of the day or how an IT operations service is delivered. For each one, you understand the workflow, see where AI can make it work better or differently, and engineer the improvement all the way to practical use. Over time, the scope is the whole business: how we can run better, and differently, with AI. And because our platform moves money for customers every day, it has to be done safely. That is part of the fun: using AI where it counts, with the guardrails to match.

This is a hands-on role for someone who loves to build. There is no people management and no evangelist hat to wear, no second AI platform or center of excellence to run and no strategy slides to produce. Your time goes where the difference is made: in the code, the specifications and the work itself. You sit in development and report to the CTO, and you have the final say on the method: how agents are used, how work is specified, how output is reviewed and how tests are written. You will work side by side with colleagues across the business, bringing them along with working results and real influence.

**What You Will Own

**

• The way engineering works with AI: the agent harness, shared repository and compliance-gated pipeline, improved continuously from today’s baseline

• The method the team works by: how agents are used, how work is specified, how output is reviewed and how tests are written

• Business capabilities: following them across teams, systems and processes, starting with areas such as reconciliation, funds management and IT operations, and engineering AI-assisted improvements all the way into daily use

• Documentation and remediation: using agents to express what our platform does as specifications and tests, speed up security fixes and automate evidence for our control framework

• Guardrails that let engineers build their own AI-powered tooling safely, within the group’s shared permissions model

• Bringing colleagues with you: pairing with engineers and business colleagues, showing what works and following improvements through to adoption, so that people build confidence in working with agents

**Your first months

**You will start where we are strongest: in development. Our AI-DLC will be measurably faster and better and in daily use across the team, with the first capabilities documented as executable specifications and tests, and control evidence generated by the pipeline. From there, your first business capability will be in your hands: mapped end to end, with AI-supported improvements delivered into the way the work is actually done. You will spend more time building than presenting.

Success will be visible in concrete results: more efficient workflows, reliable outputs, stronger control evidence, more engineers working with agents daily on real work, and colleagues across the business who adopt what you build and ask for more.

**What You Will Bring

**You are a senior engineer who still writes code most days and has changed how you work because of coding agents, not just added them to the toolbar. Your career includes at least one long stretch inside a production platform that handled money or other regulated data.

• Eight or more years in software engineering, five or more of them in backend or platform engineering on production systems, with fluency in at least one of Python, Go, Java or TypeScript

• You have modernised something old while it stayed live, whether monolith to services, on-premise to cloud or a language or runtime migration, and you can tell us what you documented first, what you tested first and what went wrong

• Two or more years building LLM-based systems that reached production, with ownership of context and prompt design rather than just API calls, plus an evaluation framework with test sets, pass criteria and regression tracking that you used to decide whether something shipped

• Twelve or more months using coding agents such as Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor or Codex on real work, with a clear view of delegation boundaries, review discipline and failure cases

• Hands-on CI/CD, automated testing and release gating, including a pipeline you made enforce something rather than merely report it

• Experience from a regulated environment with enforced access control, audit logging, change evidence and segregation of duties, including producing or defending evidence for an audit or certification such as ISAE 3402, SOC 2, ISO 27001 or PCI DSS

• Specifications that other engineers built from and test suites that others relied on, plus the ability to understand business workflows, talk with non-technical colleagues and win cooperation across teams without line-management authority

**Lead from the code

**You are a builder who sets direction and brings people with you. You define the method, make the case for it and have the conviction to see it through, without waiting for permission or a title. You win people over with proof rather than slides: a working demo, a spec that holds up, a test suite that catches a real bug. When the team pushes back, you listen, adapt the how and hold the line on the why. You are confident without being loud, honest about what you do not know, and respectful of the people and platform that keep the money moving.

**Why you will love it here

**Inpay Group is growing, and this role puts you at the centre of that journey. Here is what you can look forward to:

• A role that is genuinely new: take AI-native engineering out of the development team and into the whole business, and define how it is done

• Real reach: from how engineering works with AI to how a whole payments business runs, with your work live on a platform that moves real money

• A flying start: our AI-DLC is already running and agents already write our tests, so you build on real momentum instead of starting from zero

• A direct line to the CTO, the final say on method and a genuine say in where technology goes next

• An open, informal culture where everyone is heard and good ideas win, with a fun office in the heart of Copenhagen, right next to Amalienborg, or remote within our working time zone

We are aiming for a start in January 2027, or earlier if your notice allows. You will be employed by Framm ApS, part of Inpay Group.

**Interested

**If you want to be the one who shows how a payments business can work differently with AI, we would like to hear from you. Click Apply below and upload your CV and application.

**You will be hired by Framm, which is part of the Inpay Group and delivers services to Inpay.

****Our core values drive our success. We seek individuals who embody these values:

****Customer First: You demonstrate professionalism, prioritize customer satisfaction, and deliver high-quality results.

****Raise the Bar: You maintain a positive attitude, foster resilience and adaptability, and strive for continuous improvement.

****Accountability: You take responsibility for tasks, show initiative in problem-solving, and meet commitments.

****Fearless Innovation: You embrace a growth mindset, seek learning opportunities, and drive innovation.

****Together We Can: You build positive relationships, collaborate effectively, and support team success.

****Action: You are proactive, action-oriented, and committed to delivering results.

****If these values resonate with you - and you’re based in Copenhagen or within commuting distance - we would love to hear from you.

**We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

_Hybrid, Copenhagen based - report to SVP Growth

_**About The Role

**OrderYOYO builds the ordering apps and websites that thousands of restaurants across seven European markets use to take orders directly from their own customers. Our Growth team has one number to move: average orders per day per restaurant partner.

We're looking for a Growth Data Analyst to find where those orders are being lost, design the experiments that win them back, and prove it with data — across the end-user apps (iOS and Android), the restaurant partner websites, and the marketing stack.

This is a hands-on role. You'll write the SQL, build the test, read the result, and present it to the people who decide what ships next — working alongside a developer, a marketing manager, a paid media manager, and a data engineer.

**Role Mission

**Grow average orders per day per restaurant partner by finding where orders are lost across apps, websites and marketing channels, running the experiments that win them back, and making the Growth numbers trustworthy enough to decide on.

**Core Responsibilities

**

• Own the end-user funnel view — from visit to order to repeat order — across apps and RP websites, by country and by restaurant partner.

• Run cohort, funnel, and retention analyses to find the biggest leaks in traffic, conversion, and repeat ordering, and size what fixing each one is worth in orders per day.

• Turn findings into a ranked backlog of hypotheses with expected impact and effort, and defend the ranking with the Growth team and Product.

• Design A/B tests end to end — hypothesis, success metric, guardrails, sample size and runtime, randomisation unit, and a pre-registered analysis plan — and set them up yourself on the apps and RP websites, working with the developer on feature flags or variant logic where code changes are needed.

• Check tests while they run (sample ratio, instrumentation, novelty effects) and read them out honestly, including when the result is flat or negative.

• Bring the same discipline to the marketing stack — paid media (Google Ads, Meta), email and push, SMS, landing pages, and restaurant partners' Google Business Profiles — using geo or restaurant-level splits and holdouts where a user-level test isn't possible, and judging traffic quality and incrementality on orders, not clicks.

• Own the definitions of the Growth metrics (AOD, conversion rate, new vs returning, retention), keep them consistent between GA4, the apps, and the warehouse, and chase tracking gaps with the data engineer and developer until fixes are verified with data.

• Partner with Algirdas on the Growth dashboards in Fabric and Power BI so reporting is automated rather than produced by hand.

• Build and own the experimentation playbook, and use AI as a daily tool — for SQL, analysis plans, and readouts — helping the team build small, repeatable AI workflows such as pre-test power calculations or weekly funnel checks. Experimentation is too important to be guesswork.

**Must-Have Requirements

**

• 3 to 5 years in product, growth, or marketing analytics, ideally in a consumer app, marketplace, e-commerce, or food ordering business.

• Strong SQL — able to write and debug multi-step queries over event and transaction data without help.

• A track record of designing, running, and reading A/B tests, with the statistics to do it properly: power and sample size, significance, guardrail metrics, and the common ways a test lies (peeking, sample ratio mismatch, novelty).

• Technical enough to set up a test yourself: comfortable with feature flags or an experimentation tool, basic JavaScript or app event instrumentation, and reading a tracking plan.

• Hands-on with a product or web analytics stack (GA4 or similar) and a BI tool (Power BI, Looker, Tableau, or similar).

• Comfortable testing in marketing channels as well as in product: campaign experiments in Google Ads or Meta, email or push tests, and geo or holdout designs for measuring incrementality.

• Uses AI tools daily for analysis work and can show how it changed the way you work.

• Clear, confident communication — able to take a messy result and explain to a non-technical audience what it means and what to do next, in writing and in person.

• Owns outcomes, not tasks, and is comfortable setting the plan in a small team rather than waiting for one.

• Fluent English. Danish is not required.

**Strong-to-Have Experience

**

• Python or R for statistical analysis and automating recurring checks.

• Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, or another lakehouse and BI setup.

• Mobile app experimentation (Firebase, Optimizely, GrowthBook, Statsig, or similar) and web experimentation on multi-tenant or white-label sites.

• Sequential or Bayesian test methods, or quasi-experiments where a true A/B test isn't possible (for example, market-level or restaurant-level rollouts).

• Paid media data (Google Ads, Meta) and attribution, to judge traffic quality as well as conversion.

• A customer data platform and B2C engagement tooling (Segment, Braze, Firebase messaging, or similar), including running lifecycle tests in them.

• Building AI-assisted workflows or agents for analysis, not only using chat tools.

**Who We Are

**At OrderYOYO, company culture comes first. We create a positive, inclusive environment where people are trusted to do their best work and take ownership of what they build. Personal development is central to how we work — engineers are encouraged to grow technically, take responsibility, and help shape how our products and platforms evolve.

We help restaurants succeed online by providing branded websites, mobile apps, and tailored marketing solutions, giving them full control of their business. By removing high commission fees charged by third-party platforms, we empower restaurants to grow sustainably.

Through our partnership with AppSmart, the market leader in POS and in-store systems, we've become the largest restaurant-focused platform in Europe.

**What We Offer

**

• A salary of DKK59,000/ month

• A hybrid role based in Copenhagen.

• High ownership and autonomy over the analysis and experiments you run.

• The opportunity to directly move a revenue-critical metric: orders per day.

• A strong focus on data quality, honest experimentation, and analytics best practices.

• A collaborative, international Growth team.

• Real emphasis on learning, mentoring, and personal development.

jobs.occupation: Junior Consultant - Europe Central Inhouse Consulting
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity: your next adventure awaits

Would you like to gain hands-on consulting experience while helping shape and transform a large international organization from within?

Our Europe Central Inhouse Consulting team is growing, and we are looking for a Junior Consultant to join us in January 2027. You will work on real projects with stakeholders across Europe Central and gain insight into the priorities and operations of one of the world’s leading professional services organization.

We act as an internal consulting partner to EY leadership, Functions and Service Lines across 33 countries. We help solve complex business challenges, translate strategic priorities into practical solutions and deliver change with lasting impact.

We are a small, collaborative team with a hands-on, pragmatic approach. We value constructive problem-solvers who take ownership, create momentum and turn ideas into results. You will receive coaching and mentoring and work closely with experienced consultants, leaders and colleagues across the organization.

The role averages 15-20 hours per week, with flexibility during exam periods.

What you will work on

• 
Support consulting projects from problem definition and planning through analysis, recommendations and implementation

• 
Conduct research and analyze data to identify patterns, gaps and insights

• 
Turn complex information into clear presentations, dashboards and decision material

• 
Maintain project plans and track milestones, actions, risks and dependencies

• 
Help prepare and facilitate meetings and workshops, including documenting decisions and follow-up actions

• 
Take ownership of selected analyses and deliverables, with increasing responsibility as you grow in the role

jobs.description:
This PhD project is part of a new Independent Research Fund project Smooth Tileable Surfaces. Joining the section for Mathematics at DTU Compute, you will help to develop the mathematical theory of a new class of surfaces in geometry, that are characterized as being decomposable into many copies of a small number of so-called prototiles. 

The subject has links to several areas of mathematics, including differential geometry and topology, graph theory and tiling theory, as well as applications in architecture and fabrication. 

Responsibilities and qualifications
Your focus is to help develop the new subject of smooth tileable surfaces by a) classifying generic subclasses of these surfaces b) establishing an understanding of their relations with graph theory and polyhedral theory, and c) developing methods for geometrically controlled generation of many examples of these surfaces. The overall project also involves collaboration with other team members, working towards the goal of developing not only the mathematical theory of these surfaces, but also algorithms for utilizing them in practical applications in architecture and fabrication.

You must have a background that includes a substantial amount of experience in mathematics, including:

• at least elementary differential geometry, 
• knowledge of, and interest in, some or all of the following subject areas: geometry of surfaces, topology, computational geometry, graph theory, group theory.
A genuine interest in the interplay between theoretical mathematics and applications is also essential.

During the 3 year programme you will:

• Investigate and prove theoretical properties of tileable surfaces
• Develop methods for controlled generation of these surfaces
• Collaborate with other team members on the scientific aspects of the project
• Publish articles in high quality scientific journals
• Present results at scientific conferences
• Contribute to teaching and co-supervision of BsC and MSc students
• Pass approximately 30 ECTS points of relevant coursework
You must have a two-year master's degree in mathematics (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

Assessment
The assessment of candidates will be ongoing until the position is filled, and applications received by 15 December are guaranteed full consideration. 

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

At DTU Compute, we have a large focus on creating a good working environment. Our work with diversity and inclusion is an essential part of that. We believe that having a good working environment is a necessary foundation to provide excellent research, teaching, supervision and innovation.

At DTU Compute, we have about 140 PhD students. We offer several events and activities for all our PhD students such as annual PhD Bazaar, onboarding course where you will meet other PhD students, and you can join our PhD Club that organizes BBQs, board games events, lunches etc. 

You can read more about DTU Compute at www.compute.dtu.dk. 

Salary and appointment terms 
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The period of employment is 3 years. The expected starting date is 1 March 2027 with some flexibility. The position is a full-time position. 

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information 
Further information may be obtained from Associate Professor David Brander by email: dbra@dtu.dk. 

You can read about the project here: https://people.compute.dtu.dk/dbra/TileableProject.html and about DTU Compute at www.compute.dtu.dk.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
For full consideration, your complete online application must be submitted no later than 15 December 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Compute – Department of Applied Mathematics and Computer Science – is an internationally recognised academic environment with over 400 employees and 10 research sections. We broadly cover digital technologies within mathematics, data science, computer science, and computer engineering, including artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, internet of things (IoT), chip design, cybersecurity, human-computer interaction, social networks, fairness, and data ethics. Our research is rooted in basic research and centres on mathematical models of the physical and virtual world, as a basis for the analysis, design, and implementation of complex systems. We focus on ensuring that our research results contribute to creating a better society by supporting areas such as health, green transition, energy supply, and life science. We collaborate with universities, public and private organisations, and companies in Denmark and abroad, and through DTU’s startup ecosystem, we encourage innovation and entrepreneurship. We have a strong ethical, human, and sustainable approach that ensures integrity in our work. Therefore, we strive for and take responsibility for driving the democratisation of digital technologies, so that everyone has the opportunity to actively participate in the development, and we ensure a continued open, democratic, and inclusive society for the benefit of all. At DTU Compute, we value diversity, inclusion, and a flexible work-life balance. 

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer – (Configuration and programming language design)

Join Us in Challenging the Life & Pension Sector.

Do you love programming language design, sophisticated verification logic and engineering solutions from start to finish? Festina Finance is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to evolve our configuration solutions, enabling business specialists to define and change the behaviour of the Festina Life and Pension platform.

Our Life & Pension solutions power the biggest pension funds in Denmark and the Netherlands and more than 30 banks across Scandinavia and the UK. As part of our fast‑growing and ambitious organization, you will help shape the core of systems used across Europe while working in a flat, informal culture with plenty of autonomy and room to influence.

What You Will Join

Festina Finance builds modern, high‑performance software platforms for the financial sector. You will join a team of highly skilled developers, actuaries, and domain specialists who work closely together to deliver solutions that are both technically strong and deeply rooted in business logic.

We value craftsmanship, curiosity, and collaboration. You will experience a workplace where people take responsibility, share knowledge, and enjoy solving hard problems together while having fun as a team.

Why this role is exciting

This role gives you the opportunity to work with a highly specialized and industry‑defining product that pushes the boundaries of what is possible in the pension sector. You will operate close to the core of our platform, where programming language design, verification and advanced business logic meet modern software engineering.

The products you will design are at the basis of all calculations and provide the definition of the business in the Festina Life and Pension platform. Scalability, performance, and proper design are key. Here you will get to work in the intersection between programing language design, systems architecture and direct contact with the people who depend on the result. You can expect your solutions to be in use for many years to come.

We produce solutions as a team and frequently have whiteboard sessions discussing upcoming designs and development changes. You can expect to learn through a mixture of individual work and team-based iteration.

What you will work on

Your work will span four main areas:

• Language, semantics and verification: Extend the syntax and semantics of F+, our own in-house functional programming language for financial domains. Design and strengthen the verification logic that ensures configuration is correct before it ever reaches production.

• Systems and architecture: Evolve our purpose-built version control system for F+. You will work with database design, API design, caching strategies, concurrency models, and performance.

• Tooling and operations: Build the configuration tools our business specialists rely on, including applications and integrations, and maintain the CI pipelines and production environment behind them — including monitoring and continuous cluster operations.

• Domain and customers: Analyze business domains, translate them into working solutions, and handle complex customer issues through direct contact with the people using what you build.

Needed skills

To thrive in this role, you should bring strong engineering fundamentals and a mindset suited for mission‑critical systems:

• Strong software engineering fundamentals

• A verification-driven mindset you enjoy building robust validation and verification

• Ability to take an idea from design to implementation while owning responsibility

• Experience designing large‑scale solutions for customers with active production systems

• A highly critical and detail‑oriented mindset our solutions sit at the core of all product calculations

• Strong collaboration skills we communicate intensively when exploring new design spaces

• A master’s degree in computer science or equivalent experience

AXON Networks delivers a robust AI-driven, analytics-based orchestration platform and a wide portfolio of next-gen high-speed routers that leverage the newest Wi-Fi technologies. Together, these technologies give ISPs the ability to manage and troubleshoot their networks in real time, and to deliver an outstanding customer experience.

AXON Networks is a trusted strategic partner for its customers, helping them evaluate their current technologies and business models, and creating and executing strategies that enable them to innovate faster, accelerate their digital transformations, and strengthen their relationships with consumers.

AXON Networks is headquartered in Irvine, CA USA with Asia HQ in Singapore and also operating in Denmark, Spain and Vietnam.

We are looking for a mid-level Python developer with strong software-engineering fundamentals and experience building production backend systems.

You should be comfortable designing, testing, and maintaining Python applications independently, while using LLM-assisted coding tools critically and responsibly.

**Responsibilities

**

• Build asynchronous Python services and FastAPI-based APIs

• Design modular, loosely coupled components with clear responsibilities

• Integrate databases, APIs, and external services

• Develop agentic applications using frameworks such as OpenAI Agents SDK or Pydantic AI

• Write type-safe, well-tested, maintainable code

**Requirement

**

• Strong Python and asyncio knowledge

• Experience with FastAPI and API design

• Modular design, separation of concerns, and loose coupling

• Database integration and connector experience

• Python type annotations and static type checking

• Unit testing with pytest

• Modern Python tooling such as uv, ruff, mypy, or pyright

• Docker and microservice fundamentals

• Git and collaborative development workflows

**Agentic AI Experience

**

• Understanding of tool calling, structured outputs, context management, guardrails, and evaluation

• Experience using AI-assisted coding tools

**Nice to Have

**

• Experience with PostgreSQL, Redis, or document databases

**Benefits

**

• Competitive remuneration package

• Health insurance

• Pension Scheme

• Flexi time, hybrid work

• Friendly office environment (pool table, darts board and gaming corner)

• Daily catered lunch, sodas, coffee, snacks, etc.

Join AXON Networks!

At AXON Networks, we promote equal opportunities in all our recruitment processes, ensuring non-discrimination on the basis of gender, age, origin, disability, or any other personal circumstances. We assess talent based on objective criteria and foster an inclusive and diverse working environment.

We are an experience innovation and digital transformation consultancy. We are responsible for the end-to-end product development for some of the biggest brands in the world. We build innovative AI-driven digital experiences used by millions of customers across retail, e-commerce, finance, automotive and other sectors. Operating across five continents with over 6,000 innovators in twenty-two countries, we help organizations reimagine the way they connect with their customers and transform their business operations.

**The opportunity

**At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

**We Are Proud Of

**

• The work we do and innovation we drive

• Our Values of share, care and dare

• A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy

• Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

**The Role

**Valtech Denmark is looking for new enterprise clients. You will be the person that will help win them.

As our Executive Business Developer, you will showcase to Danish enterprise leaders Valtech’s Intelligent Enterprise proposition which connects AI, data, technology, customer experience and operating models to deliver tangible business outcomes.

This is not a conventional sales role. You hunt like a seller, think like a management consultant, use AI and data in your own work and bring the right colleagues in early. You are relentless about results, and you never make the sale about yourself.

You report to the Managing Director, Valtech Nordics, and work day to day with colleagues in strategy, data and AI, experience design, technology and delivery, and with Valtech’s international network of expertise.

**Role Responsibilities

**

• Own new logo acquisition: identify, engage and win new enterprise clients across Denmark, running every stage from target selection and first contact to pitch, negotiation and close

• Build and execute a GTM plan focused on high-value target accounts and priority industries

• Build relationships with CEOs, COOs, CIOs, CMOs, CDOs and other senior decision-makers

• Open every conversation with a hypothesis about the client’s business, not our service catalogue, and link AI opportunities to the data, processes, technology and organizational capabilities needed to realize value

• Pull strategy, data and AI, design, technology and delivery colleagues in early, and lead pursuits and RFP responses through influence rather than ownership of every idea

• Co-sell with strategic partners (Adobe, Salesforce, Sitecore, Optimizely, Contentful, hyperscalers, etc.), including joint AI-led propositions

• Use AI and data across prospecting, meeting preparation, proposals and forecasting, and keep Salesforce disciplined so the pipeline and forecast can be trusted

• Deliver against your agreed new-business target and represent Valtech at industry events and partner activations

**What We Expect Of You

**

• Hunter: You open doors instead of waiting for leads, and can say exactly what you personally contributed to each win.

• Orchestrator: You compete on outcomes, not ego, and share credit with the specialists you involve.

• Consultant mindset: You ask sharp questions, challenge assumptions and frame problems that matter to the business.

• AI and data native: You use AI in your own work, know where it fails and tie it to real business problems, as a commercially credible bridge rather than a technical specialist.

• Energy builder: You bring pace, optimism and a bias for action, backed by a plan and real client conversations, not slogans.

**Must Have Qualifications

**

• Proven track record winning net-new enterprise logos in a digital agency or consulting environment, with a clear view of your personal contribution

• Experience selling complex, multi-million euro engagements across digital experience, data, technology and AI-enabled solutions

• A strong network in Denmark, ideally including senior decision-makers and C-suite relationships

• Exceptional consultative sales skills, with the ability to translate business challenges into impactful digital and AI-enabled strategies

• Practical understanding of how AI and data apply in commercial and customer experience contexts, including where they fall short

• Deep understanding of one or more key industries (e.g., Retail, Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences)

• Ability to influence senior stakeholders, navigate complex client organizations and mobilize internal specialists

• Strong communication and storytelling skills, with fluency in Danish and English

**Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

**We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

**The Benefits

**This is a permanent position based in Denmark.

**Beyond a Competitive Compensation Package, We Offer

**

• Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs

• Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts

**Your application process

**Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses ending in @valtech.com.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

**About Valtech

**Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen, Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

Ready to bridge innovation and operations in one of the Nordics' most recognized media brands?

Egmont IT is looking for a new Platform Engineer profile who thrives on improving and automating our cloud environments, while understanding the importance of stability, governance, and performance.

You’ll join Egmont’s Cloud Platform team, working primarily with Azure, AWS. Egmont’s cloud footprint is very large and requires that everyone thinks about automation and scalability first.

Your Role & Impact

We are looking for a colleague that is great at asking questions and challenging decisions. We already have a solid Kubernetes based platform used across the Enterprise. Now we need someone to come and help expand it, help our colleagues using and help in the other areas of Egmonts platform engineering

You will be doing hands-on work on our cloud platforms and solutions to ensure that we constantly improve on new solutions. As well as evaluating old implementations to determine when it is time to modernize.

Responsibilities

- Operate, develop and build on our Kubernetes platform

- Automating daily work around the cloud platforms we manage

- Develop and maintain tooling (GitHub Actions, Helm, Policies, etc)

- Strengthen observability and proactive monitoring – We use Datadog

- Use Infrastructure as Code to manage changes and enforce standards

- Collaborate with developers, security, and infrastructure teams and business stakeholders to ensure stability and compliance

What You’ll Bring (Qualifications)

We're looking for a blend of technical expertise and a collaborative, proactive mindset.

Desired Skills

- Experience from previous platform engineering or DevOps roles

- Strong hands-on experience with Azure or AWS (Either is fine)

- Scripting or programming skills in any popular language, we use Go

- Experience with IaC tools, any apply, but we use Terraform

Personal Qualities

You can build, automate, and optimize, but you also know that reliability, performance, and security are the foundation of success. You’re curious, pragmatic, and want to be part of a team that’s building a hosting platform, which is easy to use for our developers.

Why Egmont?

At Egmont IT, we enable creativity, not just for artist but also in tech. Behind every story, movie, game, or digital experience lies a foundation of stable and secure technology — and that’s where we come in.

Egmont is a foundation, meaning all our profits are reinvested into developing our media companies and donated to support vulnerable children and young people.

You’ll join an international IT organization with a strong purpose and culture. We believe in flexibility, trust, and development. You’ll have freedom to influence our cloud journey, collaborate with talented colleagues across the Nordics and Europe, and grow through certifications and learning opportunities. A key role in a cloud-driven operations team. A workplace that encourages innovation, collaboration, and autonomy. Flexible hybrid work setup (Copenhagen HQ + home office). Ready to join?

We look forward to hearing from you!

About Egmont

Egmont is a leading Nordic media group focused on strong content and platforms within film, tv, cinema, streaming, gaming, e-commerce, marketing services, educational platforms, magazines and books. jobs.occupation: Workplace Manager for Facility Management at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
Workplace Manager for Facility Management at Novo Nordisk Engineering

If you're energised by creating exceptional workplace experiences and thrive on building strong stakeholder relationships while driving operational excellence, we'd love to hear from you!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

We are looking for a proactive and people-oriented Workplace Manager to join our Facility Management team.

At NNE, we believe that great workplaces create great employee experiences. Our Facility Management team plays a key role in ensuring that our offices are safe, efficient, welcoming, and aligned with the needs of a growing organisation.

As Workplace Manager, you will take ownership of workplace and facility operations at our headquarters in Virum while helping shape the future workplace experience through continuous improvements, digital solutions, and close collaboration with stakeholders across the business.

You will act as the local face of Facility Management and become a trusted partner to employees, managers, landlords, and service providers. Through your visible presence, strong relationships, and proactive approach, you will help create a workplace where people can thrive and perform at their best.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys combining operational excellence with stakeholder engagement, workplace experience, and modern ways of working.

How you might spend your days

As a Workplace Manager you’ll be:

• Acting as the visible and approachable local FM representative, building strong relationships across the organisation.

• Coordinating day-to-day facility operations to ensure a safe, efficient and well-functioning workplace.

• Managing relationships with landlords, vendors, contractors and service providers to ensure high-quality services and agreed service levels.

• Driving maintenance activities, space planning, workplace services and facility related projects.

• Using workplace data, Power BI insights, digital tools, and emerging technologies to optimize workplace services, support decision-making and enhance the employee experience.

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Being outgoing and comfortable meeting stakeholders across the business, building relationships and ensuring a visible and approachable FM presence.

• A proactive and positive team player who takes ownership and drives tasks forward.

• Thriving in a service-oriented environment and motivated by creating value for colleagues and stakeholders.

• Building trust through great stakeholder management skills and communicate effectively across all organizational levels.

• Enjoying collaborating with others, fostering positive relationships, and achieving results as part of a team.

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• 
Experience within Workplace Management, Facility Management, Property Management, or a similar operational role.

• 
Relevant educational background within Facility Management, Building Construction, Architectural Technology, Construction Management or related discipline.

• 
Experience coordinating vendors, maintenance activities and facility-related projects.

• 
Experience working with budgets, invoice management and service contracts.

• 
Strong digital mindset with an interest in workplace technology, automation and data-driven decision-making.

• 
Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 6th December 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Please contact Associate Manager, Martin Dang at +45 3191 1695.

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

**Job Description:

****Performance Manager, Global Regulatory Affairs, 1-year contract

****Would you like to help shape how we understand and improve Regulatory performance across our global organisation?

**We are looking for a Global Regulatory Performance Manager to join us at the Ferring International PharmaScience Center in Kastrup, Copenhagen for a 12-month period. Here, you’ll become part of the Global Regulatory Affairs function and help establish a transparent, meaningful and sustainable approach to measuring regulatory performance.

**Ferring + you

**You will join the Global Regulatory Labelling and Performance team, where global labelling process ownership and regulatory operational support come together to strengthen performance across Global Regulatory Affairs. Working across functions and geographies, the team connects processes, embeds quality and compliance, and drives continuous improvement and more consistent ways of working.

In this newly created, project-oriented role, you will have the opportunity to shape how regulatory performance is measured and understood globally. Bringing together people, processes, and data, you will lead the development and implementation of a global Regulatory KPI framework and turn performance data into actionable insights that enable stronger decision-making, greater transparency, and continuous improvement.

**Your day at Ferring

**As Global Regulatory Performance Manager, you will work across Global Regulatory Affairs, collaborating with colleagues globally to define what good regulatory performance looks like and how it should be measured. You will play a key role in creating greater transparency around performance and turning data into insights that support informed decision-making and continuous improvement.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Lead the development and implementation of a global Regulatory Performance, Governance and KPI framework.

• Drive cross-functional alignment on meaningful KPIs, including definitions, data sources, ownership and reporting requirements.

• Lead the development and continuous improvement of Regulatory performance dashboards and reporting.

• Enable consistent and transparent monitoring of performance across geographies.

• Translate performance data into clear, actionable insights, identifying trends, opportunities and areas requiring attention.

• Partner with Regulatory process owners and key stakeholders to identify and drive performance and process improvements.

• Lead cross-functional performance initiatives from definition through implementation.

• Foster a culture of transparency, accountability, continuous improvement and data-driven decision-making.

Your work will help Global Regulatory Affairs move from individual performance measures towards a more connected and transparent view of Regulatory performance. By establishing meaningful KPIs and effective performance monitoring, you will enable the organization to identify trends, focus attention where it matters most, and make better -informed decisions that drive continuous improvement.

**Behind our innovation – there’s you

**In our team, we are committed to helping each other succeed. Thus we are looking for a structured and collaborative professional who enjoys bringing clarity to complexity and turning ideas, data and processes into tangible outcomes. You thrive in a cross-functional environment, are confident bringing different stakeholders together, and are curious enough to challenge whether we are measuring what truly matters.

We imagine that you bring:

• Strong experience in project management and/or performance management, ideally from the pharmaceutical industry or another regulated environment.

• Proven experience developing KPIs, performance frameworks, dashboards and management reporting.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex data into clear, meaningful and actionable business insights.

• Excellent facilitation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build alignment and drive progress across functions and organizational levels.

• Experience with data visualization and reporting tools, such as Power BI.

• An understanding of Regulatory Affairs or pharmaceutical business processes would be an advantage.

• A pragmatic and collaborative mindset, with a strong focus on implementation, continuous improvement and measurable outcomes.

• A master’s degree or equivalent experience in Life Sciences, Business, Engineering, Data/Business Analytics, or another relevant discipline.

Above all, you are someone who enjoys connecting people, processes and data, and who can move comfortably between strategic discussions and hands-on implementation.

We offer an inclusive and flexible working environment, with the opportunity to work remotely one day per week and on-site the remaining four days.

**Behind our purpose – there’s you

**If our mission and your vision are aligned, please apply. Kindly include a few lines regarding your motivation for applying in the CV or a cover letter. Please note that we review applications continuously and close the process when we find the right match.

We are unable to offer relocation assistance for this position. Candidates must be located in the Oresund region or willing to relocate at their own expense.

_**Note to agencies: This search is being managed by Ferring’s Talent Acquisition team. Kindly do not send us unsolicited profiles.

**__At Ferring Pharmaceuticals, we help people around the world build families and live better lives. We are entrepreneurial and innovative, with a global team focused on scientific advances in the areas of reproductive and women’s health, gastroenterology and urology. Ferring + You is all about working together and sharing ideas, so that we can bring science to life for patients around the world. Read more at ferring.com.

_Do you want to shape the future of analytics for the world's largest jewellery brand? Are you passionate about using data, insights, and technology to drive growth, influence strategy, and unlock commercial opportunities? Then you could be the Senior Manager, Global eCommerce Analytics & Insights we're looking for.

_As Senior Manager, Global eCommerce Analytics & Insights, you will play a pivotal role in defining and driving Pandora's global eCommerce analytics agenda. This is a highly visible leadership position at the intersection of analytics, commercial strategy, and digital growth.

You will act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders across Global eCommerce, helping shape business decisions through data-driven insights and strategic recommendations. Leveraging a deep understanding of digital performance, customer behaviour, and commercial drivers, you will identify opportunities to accelerate growth, optimise performance, and strengthen Pandora's global eCommerce business.

Leading a team of analytics professionals, you will combine strategic thinking, business acumen, and analytical expertise to ensure data remains at the heart of decision-making across the organisation.

**Key Responsibilities

**Commercial insights & business partnering

• Act as a trusted analytics partner to Global eCommerce leadership, shaping priorities and key business decisions.

• Identify growth opportunities across traffic, conversion, customer and product performance, and turn them into clear commercial recommendations.

• Lead deep dives into the key drivers of eCommerce performance and translate findings into actions that move the business.

Forecasting & performance management

• Own forecasting and performance measurement that support commercial planning and trading decisions.

• Define the KPIs and frameworks used to track and steer eCommerce growth.

• Continuously sharpen analytical approaches and decision-making tools.

Analytics strategy & Centre of Excellence

• Define the analytics strategy, priorities and roadmap for Global eCommerce.

• Lead Pandora's global eCommerce analytics community and set the standard for how analytics creates business value.

• Build analytical and commercial capability across the organisation through coaching and knowledge sharing.

eCommerce analytics platforms

• Act as business owner of Pandora's key eCommerce analytics platforms, ensuring they answer the questions that matter most to the business.

• Lead the Centre of Excellence around these platforms, connecting business needs with technology teams and vendor partners.
