**Job Description Summary

**The Production Engineer – Calibration & Maintenance is responsible for the calibration, maintenance, and lifecycle management of production, inspection, measurement, and test equipment used in a regulated medical device manufacturing environment.

The role works closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, equipment owners, and external service providers to ensure equipment remains calibrated, maintained, compliant, and available for production.

Responsibilities include day-to-day calibration and preventive maintenance coordination, HxGN EAM administration, calibration assessments, controlled procedures and work instructions, supplier coordination, and equipment compliance.

This is a hands-on Production Engineering role supporting manufacturing operations across scanner/system assembly, mechanical and electrical/electronic assembly, software configuration/loading, packaging and labeling, and testing/final acceptance.

**Job Description

****Roles & Responsibilities

**

• Coordinate the site calibration program, including calibration schedules, call-in activities, equipment status, due dates, and timely completion.

• Coordinate internal and external calibration activities, including equipment preparation, shipment, return, documentation review, and release back to production.

• Ensure new, returned, overdue, failed, or out-of-tolerance equipment is appropriately assessed and controlled before use.

• Act as SME for calibration and maintenance activities in HxGN EAM, maintaining asset records, calibration setups, preventive maintenance schedules, work orders, task plans, and supporting documentation.

• Perform and support calibration assessments, including equipment requirements, criticality, acceptance criteria, calibration methods, frequencies, and maintenance needs.

• Develop and maintain calibration and maintenance procedures, SOPs, and work instructions in collaboration with equipment owners, SMEs, and Quality.

• Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance activities for production and test equipment while minimizing disruption to manufacturing.

• Support investigations, risk assessments, and product-impact assessments related to overdue, failed, or out-of-tolerance equipment, and provide input to NC/INV/CAPA activities where applicable.

• Coordinate external calibration and maintenance suppliers, including quotations, service activities, documentation, and AGORA purchase orders.

• Support internal and external audits by ensuring calibration and maintenance records are complete, traceable, compliant, and audit-ready.

• Monitor calibration and maintenance performance and drive improvements in equipment compliance, availability, data quality, and execution efficiency.

**Required Qualifications

**

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, Metrology, Maintenance, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Experience with calibration, preventive maintenance, equipment management, or Production Engineering in a regulated manufacturing environment.

• Understanding of calibration principles, equipment control, documentation, traceability, and manufacturing process requirements.

• Experience with computerized maintenance or Enterprise Asset Management systems, preferably HxGN EAM or comparable systems.

• Experience working within controlled procedures, work instructions, and change management processes.

• Experience coordinating suppliers, service activities, quotations, and purchase orders.

• Knowledge of GMP and Quality Management System requirements within regulated manufacturing.

**Desired Characteristics

**

• Experience within medical device manufacturing or another highly regulated manufacturing environment.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.

• Hands-on and practical approach to supporting manufacturing equipment and production operations.

• Structured working style with strong ownership and ability to manage recurring deadlines.

• Strong collaboration skills across Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and external suppliers.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills.

• Comfortable balancing equipment compliance, production continuity, quality requirements, and operational priorities.

• Proactive and improvement-focused approach to equipment reliability and calibration/maintenance processes

******Additional Information

******Relocation Assistance Provided: No

**WHY SPEKTR

**At spektr, we are on a mission to automate the world’s most complex compliance workflows through AI. Founded by the team behind HelloFlow (acquired by Trulioo), spektr is building the infrastructure and AI agents to run compliance at scale.

_Compliance, built like product.

_Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

• $26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.

• Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.

• Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**We are looking for an AI Engineer who is, first and foremost, a product builder. In this role, you won't just be running experiments in a notebook; you will own the end-to-end AI strategy and its direct impact on our customers.

In this role, you will own everything related to AI, LLMs, and intelligent automation.

This is a high-impact role in a fast-growing company. We are looking for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, loves solving complex compliance puzzles, and is eager to shape the next generation of compliance technology.

**What You Will Be Doing

**

• AI Strategy & Ownership: Own the end-to-end AI roadmap—from selecting the right models (SOTA commercial vs. fine-tuned open source) to deciding how they are integrated into the product core.

• Agentic Feature Design: Design and deploy LLM-powered features including autonomous agents, advanced RAG pipelines, and intelligent document understanding.

• Product-Led AI: Collaborate directly with founders to translate complex compliance "puzzles" into scalable AI solutions. You own the "Why" behind every model choice.

• Continuous Innovation: Stay at the bleeding edge of AI/ML research, proactively identifying new papers or releases that can give spektr a competitive advantage.

• Engineering for Reliability: Turn non-deterministic AI outputs into deterministic product value. You ensure our agents are accurate, explainable, and hallucination-free.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• The Product Mindset: You are a product person at heart. You care about whether the AI actually solves the user's problem, not just if the loss curve is going down.

• High-Agency Builder: You prefer building systems over following manuals. You identify bottlenecks in our AI workflows and fix them before they become tickets.

• AI/ML Expertise: 2+ years of experience in ML, AI, or Data/Backend roles with a deep understanding of modern LLM stacks.

• Technical Mastery: Strong skills in TypeScript (our core) and/or Python, with hands-on experience in frameworks like LangChain or equivalent orchestration layers.

• RAG & Vector Mastery: You’ve built production-grade RAG pipelines and understand the nuances of embedding, retrieval strategy, and re-ranking.

• Evaluation Obsession: You understand that "it works on my machine" doesn't apply to LLMs. You have experience setting up evaluation frameworks to measure and improve model performance.

• Cloud & Scale: Experience deploying AI services in AWS or containerized environments, ensuring they are scalable and cost-effective.

• Communication: You can explain the trade-offs of a specific model architecture to a founder and a technical bottleneck to a peer with equal clarity.

**OUR TECH INTERESTS

**

• Models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and Open Source (LLaMA, Mistral).

• Stack: TypeScript, Python, LangChain, etc

• Infra: AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD for LLMs.

**OUR PROCESS

**

• Intro call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (60 minutes)

**How To Apply

**We hire the smartest, kindest, and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work. You’ll be joining a team with a proven track record and the "Product-Market Fit" to change an entire industry.

spektr is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation or any other characteristic, and we assess every candidate against the same role requirements.

Do you enjoy making complex equipment run reliably, turning data into better decisions, and finding smarter ways to work?

At AGC Biologics in Søborg, we are looking for an Equipment Engineer to join our Equipment Maintenance and Calibration team. This is an opportunity to take ownership of maintenance and calibration planning while driving digitalization and continuous improvement across our pharmaceutical manufacturing operations.

You will play an important role in ensuring our equipment is reliable, compliant, and ready to support production. **Your Role And Responsibilities

**

Pharmaceutical experience is an advantage, not a requirement. We are equally interested in candidates from other technical industries who bring relevant experience, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.

**Why join AGC Biologics?

**In This Role, You Will Get

**

Make sure to attach an updated CV

You don't need to tick every box to apply. If you have the right technical foundation, a proactive mindset, and an interest in improving how things work, we would like to hear from you.

From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Do you want to help develop novel instrumentation for groundwater investigations? At the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Aarhus University, we are seeking a motivated postdoctoral researcher in electrical engineering to contribute to the development of novel nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) instruments for groundwater characterization. You will join an interdisciplinary research environment spanning electrical engineering, geophysics, and environmental science working on technologies that can improve our understanding of vital groundwater resources. The 2-year position is based in Aarhus, Denmark and is available from 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Expected start date and duration of employment
This is a 2–year position from 1 March 2027 or as soon possible thereafter.

Job description
We are seeking a postdoctoral researcher in electrical engineering to help develop a new generation of surface NMR instruments for groundwater characterization. Through a recently funded research project, we are building a new instrument with capabilities beyond those of existing systems. As part of the project, you will play a central role in designing and integrating key electronic subsystems and in exploring how the resulting instrument can open new possibilities for groundwater investigations.

Your tasks will include

• Design, simulation, construction, and validation of electronic subsystems
• Interfacing of ADCs and DACs to analog frontends and a microcontroller
• Integration of subsystems into a complete instrument
• Experimental work, including testing of instruments and data collection in both laboratory and field environments
• Data analysis
• Co-supervision of bachelor and master thesis projects within the project
• Documentation of technical development and research results
• Leading and contributing to scientific publications
You will join a collaborative and interdisciplinary team where you will be working closely with other researchers, technicians, and students at the Department. The project also involves interaction with researchers and end-users working directly with groundwater characterization.

Your profile
Applicants should hold a PhD in electrical engineering or similar. 

Prior experience with surface NMR or groundwater measurements is not required, but we expect you to a have a curiosity for these areas.

We are looking for candidates with experience in several of the following areas:

• Electronic systems design
• Development of low-noise analog and digital electronics including power supplies
• Interfacing to/from ADCs and DACs
• PCB layout
• Solving EMC issues
• Practical electronic and laboratory skills
• Data analysis
Experience in one or more of the following areas is considered advantageous:

• Real-time data acquisition systems implemented on microcontrollers
• Embedded Linux
• Power electronics
• Signal processing and embedded signal processing
It is also advantageous if you have a driver’s license.

Personal skills
You have good English skills, both in speaking and in writing. You take responsibility for assigned tasks and communicate openly about progress, challenges, and ideas. You can work independently as well as in a team. You are open-minded, curious, and have a good sense of humour. We value the ability to work independently as well as in a team.

We encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds and experiences. If you believe you are a strong match for the position but do not meet every listed qualification, we would still like to hear from you.

Who we are
The Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE) at Aarhus University is a leading research institution committed to excellence in research, education, and innovation. The department hosts research spanning electronics, signal processing, embedded systems, sensing technologies, artificial intelligence, biomedical engineering, digital twins, power electronics, and many other areas, creating opportunities for interdisciplinary collaboration and knowledge exchange.

This position will be supervised by Associate Professor Jakob Juul Larsen, whose current research focuses on surface NMR instrumentation, methodology, and applications.

What we offer 
We offer a vibrant and inclusive research environment with a clear commitment to real-world impact. This position provides a rare opportunity to help shape the development of an entirely new scientific instrument, from subsystem design and implementation to system integration, testing, and scientific application. You will have substantial technical responsibility and the opportunity to influence both the engineering solutions and the future research capabilities of the instrument. Denmark is consistently ranked among the best countries in the world for work-life balance and quality of life. Family-friendly policies include generous parental leave, subsidised childcare, and access to excellent public healthcare and education. As a postdoc at Aarhus University, you will benefit from a supportive and flexible workplace culture that values diversity and offers excellent conditions for researchers and their families.

Specifically, we offer:

• A central role in the development of a new surface NMR instrument with unique capabilities for groundwater characterization;
• Opportunities to work across the full development chain, from electronics design and system integration to field deployment and scientific application;
• Access to state-of-the-art laboratory facilities and research infrastructure;
• Strong support for research career development, including mentoring and international networking opportunities;
• A workplace characterised by professionalism, equality and a healthy work-life balance.
Place of work and area of employment 

The place of work is Finlandsgade 22, 8200 Aarhus N, Denmark, and the area of employment is Aarhus University with related departments. 

Contact information
For further information, please contact: Associate Professor Jakob Juul Larsen, + 45 4189 3273, jjl@ece.au.dk.

Deadline
Applications must be received no later than 4 January 2027.

Formalities and salary range

Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

About Aarhus University

Aarhus University is an academically diverse and research-intensive university with a strong commitment to high-quality research and education and the development of society nationally and globally. The university offers an inspiring research and teaching environment for its 37,500 students, including PhD students, and has 9,000 employees (full-time equivalents) and an annual revenue of EUR 1.2 billion. Learn more at international.au.dk

Help shape the future of procurement at Royal Unibrew

Royal Unibrew is home to some of the Nordics' most recognized beverage brands, including Faxe Kondi, Booster, Egekilde, Royal, Ceres and Faxe.

We're looking for a Market Procurement Manager, Indirects to strengthen procurement capability, governance and value creation across Denmark, Norway and Sweden.

About Royal Unibrew

With a portfolio that includes well-known brands such as Faxe Kondi, Booster, Egekilde, Royal, Ceres, Albani and Faxe, we are committed to being the preferred local beverage partner while continuously driving growth, innovation and sustainability.

Today, Royal Unibrew employs thousands of colleagues across multiple countries and continues to invest in both people and capabilities that support long-term success.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced procurement professional who thrives on creating structure, driving improvements and influencing stakeholders in a dynamic business environment.

As Market Procurement Manager, Indirects, you will be responsible for developing and executing procurement strategies across a broad portfolio of indirect spend categories, including:

• Marketing Services

• Professional Services

• Maintenance, Repair & Operations (MRO)

• Other local indirect spend categories

This is not a role focused solely on managing established categories. A significant part of your success will come from identifying opportunities, building procurement maturity, implementing governance frameworks, improving spend visibility and helping stakeholders make commercially sound decisions.

You will work closely with stakeholders across Denmark, Norway and Sweden while collaborating with suppliers, internal business functions and Group Procurement colleagues to drive value creation and support Royal Unibrew's continued growth ambitions.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

• Develop and implement procurement and category plans across multiple indirect spend categories

• Lead sourcing initiatives, supplier tenders and commercial negotiations

• Build and strengthen procurement governance, sourcing frameworks and best practices

• Increase transparency, control and visibility across indirect spend

• Establish and drive supplier relationship and performance management activities

• Identify and deliver cost optimization and value creation opportunities

• Support demand management and compliance initiatives

• Influence stakeholders and challenge existing ways of working constructively

• Analyse spend data, supplier performance and market developments

• Contribute to procurement capability development across Denmark, Norway and Sweden

• Collaborate with Group Procurement and local business functions to support strategic priorities

You will be based in Faxe, Denmark, and report directly to the Procurement Director.

Profile

You bring a strong procurement foundation and a proven ability to create business value through sourcing, stakeholder management and commercial decision-making.

To succeed in the role, you likely have:

• 5+ years of experience within Procurement, Strategic Sourcing or Category Management

• Experience developing procurement strategies and category plans

• Proven success leading sourcing projects and commercial negotiations

• Experience managing supplier relationships and supplier performance

• Strong stakeholder management and business partnering capabilities

• Experience driving governance, compliance and process improvements

• Experience operating in a complex stakeholder environment with multiple priorities

• Experience from FMCG, consumer goods, retail, manufacturing or other stakeholder-intensive environments

• Fluent in English

Most importantly, you are:

• Commercially minded and business-oriented

• Comfortable operating in ambiguity and creating structure where needed

• Proactive, hands-on and self-driven

• Resilient and confident when challenging stakeholders constructively

• Curious, improvement-focused and eager to drive change

• Skilled at influencing without direct authority

• Motivated by ownership, accountability and visible business impact

Why Join Royal Unibrew?

Joining Royal Unibrew means becoming part of a company with strong local brands, ambitious growth plans and a culture built on entrepreneurship, ownership and collaboration.

You will have the opportunity to:

• Shape procurement maturity and ways of working across multiple markets

• Take ownership of a broad indirect spend portfolio spanning several business-critical categories

• Gain significant stakeholder exposure and business influence

• Enjoy a high degree of autonomy, ownership and visibility

**The opportunity

**We are looking for a Senior Manager to join Group Development & Strategy at our headquarters in Humlebæk. You will help develop Coloplast’s M&A agenda, build and maintain a strong pipeline of opportunities across our business segments, support the M&A Director on key priorities and independently lead selected projects.

The transaction scope spans acquisitions, divestments, minority equity investments and strategic partnerships, as well as integration planning. This is a hands-on role with significant exposure to senior leaders, business segments, global functions and external advisers.

**Welcome to Group Development & Strategy

**You will join a team of five high-performing specialists across strategy, business development and M&A. Together, we work across group strategy, strategic projects, transactions and post-merger integration, collaborating closely with Executive Leadership and teams across the organisation. You will become part of a distinctive performance culture focused on working together to achieve the best results.

Your key responsibilities includes

• Support the development of the enterprise M&A strategy and strategic priorities across our business units

• Source opportunities and maintain the pipeline across acquisitions, divestments, equity investments and partnerships

• Assess potential targets, including strategic fit, value and key risks, in collaboration with internal stakeholders

• Support the M&A Director on key transactions and independently lead selected processes

• Prepare financial models, valuations and business cases

• Coordinate due diligence across relevant functions

• Manage relationships with targets, owners and external advisers

• Support integration planning and the handover to the business

• Prepare proposals and recommendations for senior management and other internal stakeholders

• Monitor market, competitor and transaction trends relevant to Coloplast

• Support on selected enterprise strategy and integration projects

What we expect from you:

• A relevant commercial master’s degree or MBA

• 5–6 years of experience within M&A and ideally with strategic projects

• Experience from top-tier consulting, investment banking and/or private equity

• Strong financial and business modelling skills and hands-on M&A execution capabilities

• Experience across all phases of a transaction

• Experience managing multiple high-priority projects simultaneously

• Fluent written and spoken English

• Experience working in an international environment

• Experience from healthcare or medical devices industry is an advantage, but not a requirement

**You are intellectually curious and comfortable moving between the big picture and detailed analysis. You create momentum in ambiguous situations, challenge constructively and know when to involve others. You build trust across functions and geographies, remain composed under pressure and balance analytical thoroughness with the pace required in live transactions.

Team: Group Development & Strategy

Travel: Some international travel should be expected, particularly during active transactions.

jobs.occupation: Graduate Cloud Infrastructure Engineer – Medical Software
jobs.description:
MagVenture is an established medical device company specialized in the TMS technology (Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation), which is rapidly being adopted for treatment and investigation of a number of difficult mental and physical disorders such as depression and pain.

MagVenture is on a rapid international growth journey with many exciting new products to come and that is why we need a new colleague to strengthen our software and cloud operations.

Would you like to join this growth adventure? - then apply!

The job – working with Azure infrastructure and databases

You will become part of our growing software activities and play an important role in the deployment, operation, and maintenance of our cloud-based medical software solution.

Working closely with experienced software developers, engineers, Product Managers, and external technology partners, you will help manage our cloud infrastructure and databases, currently hosted on Microsoft Azure, and support the reliable operation of applications used by clinics worldwide.

The role offers an opportunity for a recently graduated engineer or IT professional with some practical experience in cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud to develop hands-on skills in cloud infrastructure, database management, automation, cybersecurity, and medical software.

You will gradually take on more responsibility as you become familiar with our systems, working alongside experienced colleagues and external specialists.

The role will be based out of our Headquarters in Farum, Denmark. Danish visa is required.

Tasks

You will support the deployment and ongoing operation of our cloud infrastructure and databases, primarily within Microsoft Azure. Your responsibilities will include:

• Setting up and configuring new customer environments, including domains, certificates, and regional deployments.

• Assisting with software releases, upgrades, and deployment activities.

• Monitoring cloud availability, database performance, capacity, and system health using cloud monitoring tools.

• Supporting incident investigation, troubleshooting, backup monitoring, and recovery activities.

• Helping maintain cloud and database security, access management, credentials, and environment configurations.

• Supporting Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, and integration with development pipelines.

• Monitoring cloud resource utilization and supporting cost optimization.

• Maintaining technical documentation and supporting cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, and audit requirements.

• Collaborating with internal development teams and external partners to continuously improve our cloud infrastructure.

Qualifications

We acknowledge a broad set of backgrounds, but typically look for:

• Recently completed or soon-to-be-completed degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, IT Engineering, Cloud Computing, or a related technical discipline.

• Practical experience with cloud platforms and databases (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, or similar) through student jobs, internships, university projects, or previous employment.

• Basic understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, databases, and application deployment.

jobs.occupation: Research Support and Laboratory Infrastructure Specialist - BRIGHT
jobs.description:
DTU BRIGHT is a vibrant and highly driven research environment dedicated to developing biotechnological solutions for a more sustainable future. With state-of-the-art infrastructure and a strong culture of collaboration, BRIGHT brings together motivated researchers working across disciplines to push the boundaries of microbial innovation, sustainable materials, and green food systems. The atmosphere is dynamic, ambitious, and supportive, offering an inspiring and engaging workplace where scientific curiosity and real-world impact go hand in hand. 

The position 
DTU BRIGHT is seeking a highly qualified and motivated specialist to take a leading role in the development, coordination, and continuous improvement of a shared research and laboratory environment supporting three research groups:

• Microbial Foods
• Sustainable Food Innovation
• Fermentation Cultures
The position is established as a specialist function with significant responsibility for ensuring that laboratory infrastructure, biological resources, documentation systems, research workflows, and compliance frameworks effectively support cutting-edge research activities.

You will serve as a key expert within laboratory operations and research support, working closely with researchers, students, technical staff, and group leaders to strengthen research quality, reproducibility, efficiency, and compliance across multiple scientific disciplines.

The role combines scientific expertise, operational leadership, infrastructure development, and project coordination. You are expected to independently identify, develop, and implement solutions that enable high-quality research and support the long-term development of shared research facilities.

Our expectations of you
In this role, you will contribute significantly to the development and support of a shared research environment across three research groups working within sustainable food innovation. You will use your scientific expertise and experience to strengthen the quality, reproducibility, and efficiency of research activities, while helping to ensure that researchers have access to the infrastructure, biological resources, methodologies, and support needed to conduct research at an international level.

The position combines scientific support, infrastructure development, coordination, and laboratory management. You will be expected to work independently and apply sound academic judgement in a broad range of situations, ranging from the development of research workflows and management of biological resources to advising researchers on laboratory practices, documentation standards, and implementation of new methodologies.

A central part of the position will be the continued development and stewardship of shared biological and laboratory resources. This includes responsibility for fungal and bacterial strain collections, laboratory workflows, documentation systems, and procedures that support reproducible and high-quality research. You will contribute to the development of standards and practices that can be applied across multiple research projects and research groups.

The role further includes close interaction with researchers, students, and technical staff throughout the research process. You will contribute to onboarding and training activities, support implementation of new methods and technologies, and facilitate the sharing of knowledge and best practices across laboratories and research groups. Through these activities, you will help strengthen scientific coherence and ensure efficient use of shared facilities and resources.

You will also play an important role in supporting research projects throughout their lifecycle. This may include contributing to project planning, coordinating project-related activities, advising on experimental workflows and data management practices, and helping ensure that laboratory activities are conducted in accordance with relevant quality, compliance, and safety requirements.

We are looking for a highly organized and proactive colleague who enjoys taking responsibility and who is motivated by enabling excellent research. You thrive in a collaborative environment and are able to establish productive working relationships across different academic disciplines and staff groups. At the same time, you are comfortable working independently and driving initiatives forward where improvements, new solutions, or changes are needed.

The successful candidate combines strong scientific insight with excellent coordination skills and a clear commitment to supporting high-quality research. Through your work, you will contribute to the continued development of a well-functioning and scientifically ambitious research environment that supports innovation and collaboration across the participating research groups.

What we offer in return
We offer a dynamic, versatile, and highly enthusiastic research environment at the forefront of food innovation, microbiology, sustainability science, and human health. You will gain unique insight into cutting-edge research taking place across multiple interdisciplinary groups, all working towards solutions for the green transition.

The role provides a central and highly trusted position within the research infrastructure, giving you significant responsibility and ownership over the daily functioning and long-term organization of shared laboratory facilities. You will work closely with researchers at all levels—from students to senior scientists—and become a key link across multiple projects and disciplines.

You will be part of a welcoming, collaborative, and international working environment with strong scientific ambition and a clear focus on real-world impact. The position offers extensive exposure to advanced laboratory workflows, state-of-the-art infrastructure, and best practices in laboratory management, quality control, and scientific data organization.

Beyond day-to-day operations, this role provides an excellent opportunity to develop professionally in areas such as academic research, laboratory coordination, research support strategy, compliance, and scientific infrastructure management, while contributing directly to high-impact research in sustainable food systems.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). You are employed as an Academic Officer or Senior Officer. In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): https://www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The position is a full-time position for at least 4 years. Starting date is in January 2027 or according to mutual agreement. 

Application and contact
Please submit your online application no later than Sunday 6 December 2026. Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates. 

Further information please contact group leader and senior researcher Leonie Johanna Jahn at lejj@dtu.dk

You can read more about BRIGHT below, and at www.bright.dtu.dk 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

BRIGHT – The Novo Nordisk Foundation Biotechnology Research Institute for the Green Transition
The Novo Nordisk Foundation Biotechnology Research Institute for the Green Transition (BRIGHT) is a major initiative based at DTU that aims to accelerate the development of biosolutions and strengthen the bio-based economy. BRIGHT serves as a hub for academic and industrial partners working together to unlock the potential of bioproduction. BRIGHT focuses on three main areas: Sustainable materials (Developing bio-based alternatives to fossil-derived materials), Microbial foods (Innovating food production through microbial technologies), and Microorganisms for net-zero agriculture (Creating solutions to reduce greenhouse gas emissions in agriculture). The goal is to develop and scale innovative biosolutions within these areas, ultimately creating sustainable and competitive alternatives to fossil-based products and processes that can make significant contributions to reducing global greenhouse gas emissions.

BRIGHT Mission 2 aims to build an AI-powered framework for the rational design of microbial foods that meet four targets: consumer acceptance, health, sustainability and scalability. The first phase focuses on two fungal chassis, Aspergillus and Yarrowia, characterizing more than 500 prototypes through multi-omics, sensory analysis, life-cycle assessment and safety testing. Predictive models for flavor, texture, nutrition and process scale-up are trained iteratively through active learning. The scientific scope spans strain engineering, adaptive laboratory evolution, solid- and liquid-state fermentation, sensory and consumer research, and pre-clinical and clinical evaluation of safety, bioavailability and cardiometabolic health, in collaboration with national and international partners.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

About ChemoMetec

ChemoMetec is a worldwide leading manufacturer of cell counting and analysis equipment. We specialize in developing and producing high-precision instrumentation, delivering consistent data for thousands of customers across biotech, pharma, and academic segments.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized and scientifically skilled Product Specialist - Technical Support & Documentation to lead technical support for ChemoMetec’s portfolio of analytical cell-counting instruments. In this support-centered role, you will handle technical inquiries from both customers and colleagues and act as the go-to reference for technically accurate and compliant solutions. The role combines life science, technical documentation, and QA collaboration, making it ideal for someone with a strong scientific background and a passion for structured problem-solving.

We are hiring two Product Specialists for our technical support team: one focused on documentation and one on data analysis. You will be part of the Product Management Department and work closely with QA, Field Application Scientists, and product teams to resolve customer complaints, complete technical documentation, and maintain our support infrastructure. A solid foundation in mathematics and validation methodologies, along with a strong understanding of GMP regulatory requirements, is essential to succeed in this role.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide technical support across all instrument platforms, with a focus on structured problem-solving and documentation.

• Collaborate with QA to complete technical questionnaires and support the resolution of customer complaints.

• Maintain and organize our support database platform, ensuring technical records are accurate and accessible.

• Proofread and write technical notes, user guides, and comparison studies.

• Develop and implement procedures to support both existing and new products.

• Ensure all support activities comply with GMP and relevant quality standards.

• Act as a subject matter expert on instrumentation and scientific applications, providing technical insight to internal teams.

Your Profile

• PhD in Biology, Physics, or a related scientific discipline.

• Solid foundation in mathematics and validation methodologies, and a strong understanding of GMP regulatory requirements.

• Strong understanding of microscopy, analytical instrumentation, and pharmaceutical workflows.

• Highly organized, structured, and detail-oriented.

• Excellent written communication skills, with experience producing technical documentation.

• Familiarity with support platforms or ticketing systems is a plus.

• Comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, technical environment.

Why join ChemoMetec?

At ChemoMetec, we believe that great people make a great workplace. We value both personal and professional development and offer an environment where you can grow, take responsibility, and make an impact. You will become part of a team of talented and supportive colleagues who enjoy working together in an informal and welcoming atmosphere. We also believe that strong relationships go beyond the workplace, which is why we regularly bring colleagues together through company-wide events to build connections and strengthen relationships across the organization.

Practical information

Both positions are on-site at our HQ in Allerød, Denmark. You will refer to Director, Ph.D. Product Management Bassam Tawfik.

Starting date is as soon as possible, and we conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. Deadline for applying is 20 November 2026.

If you have any further questions about this job opportunity, feel free to contact Frederikke Hvidberg, fhv@chemometec.com

Please attach a motivation letter and a resume.

jobs.occupation: Data Architect for Data Platform Tribe
jobs.description:
The Platform Tribe is undergoing a significant transformation, moving away from a centralized enterprise data warehouse to an approach that supports domain-oriented decentralized data ownership. Domains are empowered to own their data with a product mindset. They focus on delivering clear value and ensuring high quality. These domains publish data products supported by self-serve data infrastructure as a platform, underpinned by federated computational governance. This governance promotes collaboration, establishes shared standards, and enforces automated policies.

The Senior Data Architect role involves designing solutions that meet business and development requirements while aligning with strategic architecture direction and roadmaps. A core aspect of your responsibilities will be shaping and advancing standards and governance policies to guide data ingestion, technical design and development of data products, publishing in the data marketplace, and the implementation of robust data quality frameworks within a data mesh environment. Additionally, the role requires maintaining advanced knowledge across multiple technologies, domains, and disciplines, including event-driven data architectures, data management frameworks such as DMBOK, semantic web concepts, and linked data principles. You will play a key role in facilitating the adoption of industry best practices and driving innovation in these areas.

„We celebrate multiple approaches and points of view. We believe diversity drives innovation.”

You will:

jobs.occupation: Global Media Strategist, The Barn - Arla, Aarhus
jobs.description:
Are you the type who can't help dissecting brand campaigns when you come across them on your favourite digital platforms? Do you enjoy understanding why certain messages and creative ideas work better on some channels than others? And are you eager to turn that curiosity into effective media campaigns for brands like Lurpak, Castello and Arla?

Then come join us at Arla Foods' in-house agency, The Barn, as our new Global Media

Strategist.

So, what's The Barn?

Our in-house agency – The Barn – was established in 2019 to help our global and local brands win in a world of increasing media complexity. Today, we have strong teams specialising in campaign development and media strategy.

We work across disciplines and are curious, data-driven and results-oriented. You'll be working alongside specialists within strategy, planning and media buying, as well as other nice colleagues in creative production, data analysis, technology and creative development.

You can read more about The Barn here.

How will you make an impact?

As our Global Media Strategist, you'll join the global media team at The Barn, helping shape how our brands connect with people through effective media and communications planning. You'll work on campaigns from the initial brief through strategy, planning, activation and evaluation, translating brand ambitions and audience insights into clear media recommendations.

We believe great media planning goes beyond choosing the right channels. It's about connecting the different ways people experience brands – from building awareness and emotional connections to engaging with products and influencing purchase decisions. And understanding how media, messaging and creative ideas can work together to create a more connected consumer experience.

You will work closely with brand teams, creatives, strategists and media specialists across The Barn to bring these experiences to life.

Furthermore, you'll:

• Develop connected media strategies: Translate brand objectives and audience insights into data-driven plans, connecting channels and touchpoints across brand, product and shopper experiences.

• Connect media and creative: Bring a communication planning mindset to our campaigns, helping guide how messages, creative ideas and formats can work most effectively across platforms.

• Collaborate and challenge: Work with brand managers, creatives, media buyers and other specialists to develop integrated campaigns from brief to execution, presenting recommendations to global brand teams and challenging conventional approaches when needed.

• Explore and inspire: Stay curious about the evolving media landscape, emerging platforms and new opportunities, helping our brands make better use of media.

• Measure and improve: Work with our media and data specialists to evaluate campaign performance, understand what works and turn learnings into better future recommendations.

What will make you successful?

As a person, we expect you to be, well, first of all nice. Secondly, curious, collaborative and comfortable challenging the usual ways of doing things.

You're equally a strategic thinker and a doer. Someone who enjoys getting into the details of media planning but can also step back and see how channels, messages and creative ideas work together to build stronger campaigns. And you're the kind of person who loves exploring what media can do and isn't afraid to bring new ideas to the table.

• Minimum 5 years of experience with media strategy and/or comms planning, preferably from a media agency, in-house agency, international brand or similar role.

• Understanding of holistic media and communications planning across brand, product and shopper touchpoints, including digital platforms and advertising ecosystems such as Meta, YouTube and TikTok, and how to adapt messaging and creative formats to audience behaviour.

• Ability to translate business objectives and audience insights into clear media recommendations and actionable plans, using data, campaign performance and media measurement to inform decisions.

• Experience collaborating with different stakeholders and presenting recommendations in a clear and engaging way.

• Experience with international campaigns, connected TV, programmatic media or digital out-of-home is a plus.

What do we offer you?

This is your shot at joining an agency with an entrepreneurial mindset. The Barn was established in 2019 and today has full in-house capabilities covering everything from media strategy, planning and buying to technology, creative strategy and on-site production.

Our clients are our colleagues. This means we partner up across disciplines and focus our energy on building the best communications and digital solutions for our wonderful range of global brands, such as Lurpak, Castello, Starbucks, Cocio and, obviously, Arla.

We are fiercely ambitious, international and have hired from global hubs like London, New York and Singapore. But unlike most agencies, we also offer a healthy and sustainable work/life balance and real flexible working.

Some say The Barn is one of the best places they've ever worked (and even if they had 100 million dollars, they would still work here). Must be the informal atmosphere. Or the people. Or both.

How can you join?

If this sounds like the opportunity you've been waiting for, we'd love to hear from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis and close the job opening once we've found the right candidate.

For additional information, please reach out to Mathias Kjær at matkb@arlafoods.com. He’s nice too and very helpful.

If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

jobs.occupation: Postdoc Scientist focused on In Silico Predictive Methods for Antibody Purification
jobs.description:
Join Servier Symphogen as a Postdoc Scientist to pioneer in silico predictive methods for antibody purification and implementation in established purification workflows.

This 18-month Postdoctoral Scientist appointment, which includes the possibility of extension represents a unique opportunity to gain experience in an established pharmaceutical setting. The cross-functional nature of the role serves as excellent preparation for future professional advancement in industry.

You will evaluate and establish in silico methods to guide antibody purification strategies based on protein sequences, refining these in silico procedures for integration into existing purification workflows to increase efficiency.

You will join the Purification team within Drug Substance Development at Servier Symphogen and work closely with colleagues from Drug Substance Development, as well as from Research and Analytical teams.

**Objective

**This project aims to develop a digital framework for guiding purification strategies for complex antibody formats, including bispecifics and other high-complexity modalities. It addresses the challenge of product-related impurities, such as mispaired species and aggregates, by limiting the number of trial-and-error experiments. By integrating in silico tool evaluation with wet-lab chromatographic datasets, the project aims to identify correlations to enable sequence-based purification modeling. Ultimately, this approach standardizes and accelerates current purification workflows, ensuring complex antibody formats reach patients with efficiency and consistently high quality.

Identification of external collaboration opportunities may be necessary to establish the most appropriate digital framework going forward. Some travelling activity can be expected to attend conferences and visiting of external collaborators.

**Areas of responsibility

**This position focuses on developing a digital framework to guide purification strategies for complex antibody formats by correlating sequences with purification experimental data. The scope includes:

• Evaluation and implementation of in silico tools to guide purification of complex antibody formats, including:

• Integrating purification data into a digital framework to correlate experimental outcomes with antibody sequence information

• Building and implementing models to guide purification of complex antibody formats

• Continuously validating and refining established models using experimental data from relevant purifications

• Performing purifications to resolve product and product-related impurities to generate data for model development and refinement

• Evaluation and interpretation of analytical results in collaboration with the analytical team

• Presentation of findings internally and, where appropriate, through scientific presentations and peer-reviewed publications

**Qualifications

**You hold a PhD in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Biochemistry, Bioinformatics, Protein Chemistry, or a related field. To excel in this position, you must bridge lab and computational work by integrating experimental chromatography data into digital frameworks.

Preferred qualifications

• Demonstrated experience in evaluating and applying in silico tools, mechanistic modeling, or machine learning algorithms to predict protein behaviour or guide optimization of bioprocesses.

• Ability to design and implement digital frameworks that correlate protein sequences with experimental outcomes

• Skills in managing large experimental datasets and using bioinformatics tools to identify sequence-to-performance correlations

• A creative, innovative, and strategic team-player with a proactive mindset and a good sense of humor, excelling in cross-functional collaboration

It is of advantage if you have

• Practical experience in using ÄKTA chromatography systems and UNICORN software

• Theoretical and practical understanding of the purification challenges unique to bispecific antibodies and other high-complexity formats, specifically regarding the management of mispaired species and aggregates

• Knowledge within advanced analytical techniques for characterization purposes (e.g., Mass Spectrometry, CE-SDS, RPC and SEC)

• Experience presenting scientific findings internally and externally in written and spoken English (e.g. conferences and publications)

**Working at Servier Symphogen

**At Servier Symphogen, you will be part of the digital transformation of a highly engaged organization dedicated to advancing antibody-based therapeutics to improve the lives of patients. You will work in a collaborative environment with a strong focus on scientific quality, teamwork, commitment and professional development. You will be offered a relevant benefit package.

**Domicile

**Ballerup, Copenhagen Area

For further information about the scientific content of the position, please contact:

Jesper Buchhave Poulsen, Principal Scientist, Purification, Drug Substance Development, CMC  Biologics, email jesper.buchhavepoulsen@servier.com

For questions concerning employment terms, please contact Senior HR manager, Pia Holm Olesen, +45 4526 5050.

Please visit Serviersymphogen.com for more information about our company.

If you are interested in applying for the position, please mark your application, CV and relevant documentation “Postdoctoral Scientist for Predictive Antibody Purification” and mail to:

jobs-dk2@servier.com no later than January 18, 2027.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and relevant candidates may be invited for interview before the application deadline. All applications will be treated confidentially.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Symphogen is a subsidiary of Servier and antibody center of excellence primarily focused on oncology and immune oncology. We have a highly efficient antibody discovery and research platform supported by comprehensive early development capabilities.

Our antibody platform delivers antibodies with unique functionalities providing best or first in class potential as combination or mono therapy. Our approach and capabilities are well suited for combination therapies at the core of future cancer treatment.

Symphogen is located in Ballerup in the greater Copenhagen area. The company currently employs approximately 150 people

jobs.occupation: Clinical Professor of breast cancer therapy
jobs.description:
The Department of Clinical Medicine, Faculty of Health, Aarhus University, in collaboration with the Department of Oncology, Aarhus University Hospital, invites applications for a position as Clinical Professor of breast cancer therapy, commencing 1 September 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The position is a permanent, combined appointment at Aarhus University and Aarhus University Hospital. It includes 40% of working time for research and other university duties. The department guarantees that this share can be increased to at least 50% if the successful candidate secures external funding for the remaining 10%.

As a Clinical Professor at the Department of Clinical Medicine, you will be part of what is probably the largest health science research department in Denmark. Our clinical research covers all the medical specialties and takes place in close collaboration with the university hospital and the regional hospitals in the Central Denmark Region. We have approx. 30,000 square metres of modern research facilities for experimental surgery and medicine, animal facilities and also advanced scanners at our disposal. The department has overall responsibility for the Master's degree programs in medicine and in molecular medicine. At the department we are approx. 670 academic employees, 500 PhD students and 160 technical/administrative employees who are cooperating across disciplines. As a Clinical Professor, you will be working at Aarhus University Hospital or another hospital in the Central Denmark Region. You can read more about the department here and about the faculty here.

Your job responsibilities
As Clinical Professor of breast cancer therapy, you will have joint responsibility for the development of the department's research and teaching environment, and you will contribute to the implementation of the faculty's overall research strategy. You are expected to contribute – both independently and in collaboration with others – to the development of the department by leading research of high international quality and contributing to ensuring a high academic and didactic standard in teaching. Qua your excellent collaborative skills and a broad academic network, you contribute to the academic development at Aarhus University and to the university’s profile both nationally and internationally.

Your main tasks will consist of:

• Development pf high quality oncology research in the department
• Carry out the organization and implementation of local and national studies
• Establish national and local PhD projects
• Ensure a strong representation in relevant Danish Multidisciplinary Cancer Groups (DMCG’s) and Scientific Societies
• Contribute to maintaining and developing the department's international relations
• Research of high international quality, including publication in international journals
• Teaching, supervision and examination of Bachelor’s and Master's degree students
• Teaching and knowledge dissemination on an international level
• Contribute to the funding of your own research group with the help of external research funding
• Supervision of PhD students and contributing to assessment and committee work at Aarhus University.
• Dissemination of your research to the outside world
During your employment at Aarhus University, you will report to the Clinical Professor and Chair of Oncology.

Your competences 
You must be qualified to practice at consultant level, with documented specialist expertise and clinical experience equivalent to that of a senior hospital consultant.

You have an excellent track record on breast cancer therapy research, and you have established yourself as a prominent researcher. You possess solid research and teaching qualifications at a high international level. You have broad international cooperative partnerships and great experience of research partnerships with private and public-sector stakeholders. You have also a documented ability to attract significant competitive research funding from national and international funding bodies. You collaborate with a range of national and international breast cancer clinicians and physicists to ensure national and international accrual of patients into your clinical studies. 

As s person, you are a helpful and motivational leader who inspires other researchers and build trusting relationships with students, colleagues and partners. As a lecturer you communicate the newest and relevant knowledge in a committed, clear and comprehensible manner. As a supervisor you are competent, inspiring, supportive and responsible.

You are ready to take co-responsibility for the development of the department's research and education at the highest international level and for ensuring that we maintain a good work environment. You naturally involve yourself in interdisciplinary collaboration at departmental, faculty and university level as well as nationally and internationally.

As a Clinical Professor you are expected to inspire and raise the academic level in the clinic, and are expected to help elevate clinical tasks to a high level.

We expect you to be fluent in oral and written English. International applicants are expected to learn Danish, and Aarhus University arranges Danish teaching.

In order to be assessed as qualified for a Professor position, you must meet these academic criteria.

Questions about the position
If you have any questions about the position, please contact Clinical Professor and Chair of Oncology, Signe Borgquist tel.: (+45 2262 4525).

Your place of work will be the Department of Oncology, Palle Juul-Jensen Boulevard 99, 8200 Aarhus N, Denmark.

Terms of employment
• In making the appointment, emphasis will be placed on a high degree of original production at an internal level and experience from teaching at different levels as well as contributions to the development of teaching activities and teaching material, hereby documenting that the applicant has developed the academic discipline from a research and teaching perspective.
• Moreover, there will be an assessment of the applicant’s ability to perform research and teaching management tasks.
• Further information on the appointment procedure can be found in the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.
• The appointment is in accordance with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (Akademikerne).
• Remuneration is in accordance with the above, and the Salary agreement catalogue for staff at Health.
• Further information on qualification requirements and job description can be found in the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

Application
Your application must include the following:

• Motivated application
• Curriculum Vitae
• Diploma
• Template for applicant - professor
• A list of publications
• A teaching portfolio. We refer to Guideline on the use of teaching portfolios
• The ten publications stated as the most important in the 'Template for applicant - professor' must be submitted
• Research plan, which is part of the 'Template to applicant - professor' can be uploaded separately (optional)
• Coauthor statement(s) can be uploaded (optional)
• References/recommendations can be uploaded separately in the e-recruitment system (optional)
We refer to the faculty’s Guidelines for applicants.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

 

International applicant?
Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

About Aarhus University

Aarhus University is an academically diverse and research-intensive university with a strong commitment to high-quality research and education and the development of society nationally and globally. The university offers an inspiring research and teaching environment for its 37,500 students, including PhD students, and has 9,000 employees (full-time equivalents) and an annual revenue of EUR 1.2 billion. Learn more at international.au.dk

jobs.occupation: Removing micropollutants and oxidation products by biofilm reactors (Project Optimise)
jobs.description:
The project will focus on developing and testing innovative bioreactors for ozonation post treatment (especially for removal of ozonation products) for wastewater treatment. The system will be developed in labscale but its relevance will be tested by analysing ozonation products and organic micro pollutants in a small catchment receiving ozonated wastewater. Some samples will be analysed by partners by means of biosensing. Some sampling for micropollutants and ozonation products in recipients is part of optimize.

Expected start date and duration of employment

This is a 22 months position from 1st April 2027 or as soon possible.

Job description

•   Develop biofilm reactors for ozonation post treatment of wastewater

•   Analysing ozonation products and organic micro pollutants in wastewater

•   Analysing ozonation products and organic micro pollutants in recipient

•   Documentation, reporting and publishing

Applicants must hold a PhD in environmental engineering, environmental chemistry, environmental science or similar.

Experiences in i)biofilm engineering and ii)biofilm reactors, iii)quantitation of organic micropollutants by means of HPLC-MS/MS and/or HPLC-HR-MS/MS, iv)publishing results, v)collaboration in a multinational environment and vi) reporting are helpful, as well as vii)interactions with wastewater treatment plants. Some of these can be developed during the project.

Who we are

Most scientific information on the group is available under  https://projects.au.dk/waterpurification//

The group has own ozonation and biofilm reactors as well as two triple quad HPLC-MS/MS systems, two HPLC-MS/MS systems with high resolution and one imaging mass spectrometer.

Place of work and area of employment

Aarhus University, Department of Environmental Science, Frederiksborgvej 399, 4000 Roskilde

Contact information

Interested candidates are welcome to contact: Prof. Kai Bester (kb@envs.au.dk or +4593508089)

Deadline

Applications must be received no later than January 4, 2027.

Application procedure

Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self.
