Take full responsibility for warehouse operations, inventory management and stock accuracy in an international project organisation.

Copenhagen Global A/S is part of Copenhagen Group, a Danish project-driven organisation with a strong international profile. We tender for and manage complex projects for international organisations and national authorities, operating across different markets and in close cooperation with specialised partners.

Our activities place high demands on structured warehouse operations, accurate inventory management and reliable stock control. To support this, we are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Warehouse & Inventory Controller to take full responsibility for Copenhagen Global's warehouse, working closely with colleagues to ensure that all goods, equipment and materials are properly registered, stored and managed.

Your Responsibilities

You will have overall responsibility for the day-to-day operations of Copenhagen Global's warehouse, ensuring accurate stock records and effective inventory control.

Your responsibilities will include registering incoming and outgoing goods, maintaining accurate inventory records and ensuring that all materials and equipment are correctly identified, stored and accounted for. You will be responsible for maintaining and updating the warehouse management system, ensuring that physical stock levels match recorded inventory.

You will also plan and conduct regular stocktakes, identify and resolve discrepancies, and maintain clear procedures for stock handling, storage and inventory control, ensuring that all inventory records are continuously updated and accurately maintained in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.

In addition, you will coordinate the receipt and dispatch of goods, support logistical requirements across Copenhagen Global's projects and work closely with colleagues in procurement, project management and other relevant functions.

You will take ownership of maintaining a well-organised, safe and efficient warehouse, ensuring that materials and equipment are accessible, traceable and handled in accordance with established procedures.

The role requires a high degree of independence, accountability and attention to detail.

Your Background

We are looking for someone with previous experience in warehouse management, including direct responsibility for inventory control and goods registration.

You have practical experience with warehouse management or inventory systems and understand the importance of accurate registration, stock reconciliation and traceability. You are confident working with digital systems and maintaining structured, reliable inventory records.

You are highly detail-oriented, systematic and reliable, with a strong sense of responsibility and the ability to maintain an overview of a wide range of materials, equipment and ongoing activities.

You are proactive in identifying discrepancies and improving procedures, and you take pride in maintaining an organised warehouse where stock levels and the location of goods can be accounted for at all times.

You are comfortable working independently, prioritising tasks and coordinating with colleagues across different functions. You communicate effectively in Danish and English.

Relevant experience in logistics or project-driven warehouse operations, preferably involving the use of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, will be considered an advantage.

Practical Information

The position is based at our warehouse facilities in Copenhagen.

Salary will reflect qualifications and experience.

Employment is conditional upon obtaining the required security clearance.

Join Vattenfall as an Asset Integrity Engineer and take a leading technical role in safeguarding the long-term integrity, reliability and performance of Hollandse Kust Zuid (HKZ). You will translate asset condition, operational experience and technical risk into clear priorities and practical interventions, helping the organisation make well-founded decisions across maintenance, inspections, technical improvements and long-term asset planning.

Step into a vital role where your expertise in Asset Integrity Management ensures that our offshore wind farms operate reliably, safely, and sustainably. As an Asset Integrity Engineer within the Integrated Operations team at Vattenfall, you will help optimize the operational life and yield of our wind farms, with a clear operational interface to our offshore activities.

You will work with diverse stakeholders across Offshore Engineering, Asset Management, and Operations to strengthen our Asset Integrity Management framework, ensuring a continued focus on optimizing the operational life and yield of HKZ as well as contributing to our broader portfolio of operating assets.

Join us and power the journey toward a fossil-free future by shaping how we manage the integrity of complex, large-scale renewable energy assets. You will be part of a growing team within Business Area (BA) Wind, with a special focus on Offshore Generation—the organization fully accountable for operating and maintaining our offshore wind farms in a healthy, safe, and cost-efficient manner.

Your role / what will you do? As our new Asset Integrity Engineer in Asset Integrity, you will collaborate with various stakeholders in Technical Integrity Management to develop and maintain a robust framework for managing risk, condition monitoring, and maintenance activities for offshore wind assets.

You will act as a key focal point for integrity issues at HKZ, working closely with internal Technical Authorities to identify and mitigate risks related to WTG, cables, foundations, offshore structures, substations, and more.

You will help shape how Vattenfall leverages data and analytics to support Asset Integrity, ensuring that our condition monitoring, inspection, and maintenance programs drive continuous improvement. You will also engage in root cause analyses, contribute to project delivery and operational optimization programs, and lead change management initiatives to optimize asset performance over the long term.

The role supports asset integrity activities with a particular focus on HKZ, while contributing to Asset Integrity activities and knowledge sharing across our wider operating fleet as required.

Key Responsibilities:

As part of Integrated Operation and fully deployed to support our Asset Integrity Team:

• Being part of the continuous development of the Asset Integrity Management framework, delivering a systematic approach to Asset Integrity Management.

• Report accurately on the performance, status and health of HKZ and support consistent Asset Integrity reporting across our operating fleet.

• Ensure the integrity of HKZ is understood and appropriately managed, while supporting readiness within Asset Integrity for our future projects.

• Proactively support Integrity issues at HKZ and, where relevant, across our operating fleet and asset projects.

• In Collaboration with the different disciplines across Generation & Engineering ensure data availability to support Risk Based & Condition based maintenance Programs.

• Outline and support all condition monitoring, inspection and maintenance data collection activities, collate and integrate data to AIM-D and CMMS systems, so it supports the Asset Integrity Framework and quality in our Asset integrity reporting.

• Work with change management and root cause analysis to support HKZ, the operating fleet and projects.

• Work with our technical authorities/specialists to develop appropriate and cost-effective risk mitigation strategies and review external repair recommendations.

• Engage in assignments in product development, Classification of consequence, project delivery or operational assets as required for asset integrity management at HKZ and for future sites.

• Prepare and update key technology and process documents within Asset Integrity Management.

• Work with project management on operational optimisation programs.

Location

Kolding, Amsterdam, London or Hamburg.

Qualifications

Your profile / who are you?

As our Asset Integrity Engineer, you will bring an understanding of Asset Integrity Management across large-scale industrial or offshore environments. You excel at translating technical insights into practical maintenance strategies, thrive on interdisciplinary teamwork, and remain forward-thinking in a fast-evolving renewable energy landscape. Your ability to spot critical risks early, manage data effectively, and communicate clearly will be key to driving continuous improvement at HKZ and across our offshore wind portfolio.

Next to this, you bring:

• Preferably five years experience managing integrity for large-scale energy assets, ensuring proactive risk mitigation.

• Demonstrated proficiency in root cause analysis with a results-oriented, systematic approach.

• Knowledge of data analytics tools (e.g., Python, CMMS) and experience interpreting condition monitoring insights would be an advantage, but is not essential.

• Experience setting up risk-based and condition-based maintenance programs aligned with operational goals.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, collaborating seamlessly with Technical Authorities, Operations, and Engineering.

• Excellent communication in English, conveying complex technical issues to diverse audiences.

• A proactive, solution-focused mindset, consistently seeking innovative ways to meet our fossil-free mission.

Additional Information

Our offer

Good remuneration, a challenging and international work environment, and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field. You will be working in interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues. We offer attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development.

More Information

We welcome your application in English, no later than, December 3rd 2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website and that you refrain from submitting a cover letter with your application. You apply quickly and easily by answering screening questions and attaching your CV.

For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our recruiter Anne Vriesema via anne.vriesema@vattenfall.com

At Vattenfall we are convinced that diversity contributes to build a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation.

We look forward to receiving your application!

**Company Description

Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 21 000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission.

You will collaborate closely with other internal engineering teams and periodically communicate with external stakeholders to align on technical integrations and requirements.

What We're Looking For

Key qualifications and experience:

Why Connected Cars

jobs.occupation: Head of Translational Medicine and Early Development
jobs.description:
Turn scientific promise into clinical progress. Build the proof-of-concept engine that helps LEO Pharma make smarter development decisions and bring meaningful innovation closer to patients.

Shape What Comes Next

How would you connect emerging biology, quantitative insights, and clinical expertise to shape the next generation of development programs? At LEO Pharma, you will lead Translational Medicine & Early Development, bringing together people, partners, and evidence to answer critical questions early. This is an opportunity to build capabilities, influence portfolio decisions, and connect scientific ambition with a clear path to clinical proof of concept.

Your role

You will build and lead an integrated proof-of-concept engine, translating biological hypotheses into clinically testable, quantitatively informed, decision-ready programs. Working across internal teams and external partners, you will establish mechanism-based rationales, meaningful patient strategies, and robust development plans. Your focus will be on generating the evidence needed to select doses, assess benefit–risk, and guide progression toward registrational studies.

Your primary responsibilities will be to:

• Lead translational and early-development strategy across programs, developing people leaders and subject-matter experts.

• Partner with Science, Search & Innovation and clinical teams to design early-phase studies demonstrating target engagement, proof of mechanism, and patient relevance.

• Integrate biomarkers, patient stratification, quantitative pharmacology, and modelling and simulation to optimize doses, regimens, endpoints, and study designs.

• Support clinical due diligence and integration of externally sourced assets, building partnerships that strengthen translational capabilities.

• Shape regulatory and cross-functional evidence strategies, translating complex findings into clear recommendations for project teams and governance forums.

You will also establish progression criteria and performance indicators that strengthen decision quality, evidence maturity, execution, and resource efficiency. Throughout early development, you will ensure efficacy hypotheses are considered alongside safety, tolerability, and therapeutic index.

Your Qualifications

You bring scientific depth and leadership experience, with the ability to connect translational evidence to clinical and portfolio decisions.

We are looking for:

• An advanced degree in Medicine, Pharmacology, Translational Science, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related discipline; MD and PhD qualifications are preferred.

• Significant leadership experience in translational medicine, clinical pharmacology, and/or early clinical development within biotech or pharma.

• Demonstrated expertise in early-phase studies in patients and healthy participants, linking mechanisms of action and biomarkers to dose selection and development strategy.

• A track record of building high-performing global teams, developing people, and integrating external assets and partnerships.

• Experience contributing to regulatory submissions and evidence generation supporting registration and market access.

Experience with externally sourced innovation is strongly preferred; dermatology and/or rare-disease experience is beneficial. You combine strategic thinking with curiosity, sound judgment, and a collaborative approach, influencing effectively across a matrix organization.

Your new team

You will lead Translational Medicine & Early Development, with two line managers as direct reports, the group is in total 20 employees. You will report to the Vice President, Head of Global Clinical Development.

Your network will span clinical development, skin science, regulatory, safety, market access, and commercial colleagues. Together with external collaborators, you will connect expertise across disciplines to strengthen early development.

Contact and application

For additional information, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner, Sabina Ravn Lebech at saleb@leo-pharma.com

You do not need to upload a cover letter, but feel free to add a few sentences in your resume or CV on why this position has your interest.

Beyond the skin

Join LEO Pharma, a global leader in medical dermatology, as we go beyond the skin to make a lasting impact. Our innovative approach sets us apart. We are dedicated to leaving a legacy that positively impacts patients, colleagues, and our planet.

At LEO Pharma, we believe in the power of individuals to drive change. Our flat organizational structure empowers you to make a visible impact and offers versatile roles for professional growth. We value diversity and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, recognizing that our different perspectives, backgrounds, and attitudes enable us to make the best decisions. Join our passionate team at LEO Pharma and be yourself as we work together to make a difference.

For certain positions, LEO Pharma might complete a background check conducted by a third party.

jobs.occupation: Har du lyst til at arbejde som pædagogisk vikar i et dagtilbud, hvor mange vælger at blive lidt længere?
jobs.description:
Måske overvejer du at arbejde med børn i 0-6-årsområdet og vil gerne prøve det af først. Måske er du studerende, holder sabbatår – eller har brug for et fleksibelt job, hvor du selv kan byde ind på vagter, når det passer dig.

I Børnehuset Nørreskoven søger vi pædagogiske vikarer, som har lyst til at være en del af hverdagen, når der er brug for ekstra hænder – og som trives i et børnehus med nærhed, varme og tydelige rammer. 
Som vikar hos os

bliver du taget godt imod. Du skal ikke kunne det hele på forhånd – det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at være sammen med børnene og indgå i hverdagen på stuerne.

Dine opgaver kan blandt andet være:

• at indgå i hverdagen på vuggestue- eller børnehavestuer
• at lege, læse, være med i rutiner og på legepladsen
• at træde til dér, hvor der er brug for dig
• at bidrage til en tryg og god dag for børnene
Har du særlig interesse i at hjælpe til i køkkenet sammen med en erfaren medarbejder, er det en ekstra fordel. Skriv det endelig i din ansøgning.

Vi gør os umage for, at det skal være overskueligt og trygt at være vikar – også hvis du er ny i dagtilbud.
Hvem kan søge?

Vi forventer, at du:

• har lyst til at arbejde i et dagtilbud og være sammen med børn
• er fleksibel, mødestabil og god til at overholde aftaler
• møder børn og kolleger med godt humør
• ikke er bange for at tage fat og spørge, hvis du er i tvivl
• er nysgerrig og har lyst til at lære
• ikke er bange for at give en hånd med i hele huset
• At du kan starte hurtigst mulligt

 
Det er en klar fordel, hvis du har erfaring med børn eller dagtilbud – men det er ikke et krav. Vi tager imod både erfarne og uddannede profiler og dig, der gerne vil afprøve området og finde ud af, om arbejdet med børn er noget for dig. Vi har tidligere haft gode erfaringer med, at vikarer udvikler sig og senere går videre i uddannelse eller fast job – også hos os.
Derfor trives mange vikarer hos os

Vi oplever, at mange af vores vikarer er glade for at være i Nørreskoven og ofte vælger at blive hængende, mens de finder ud af, hvad næste skridt for dem skal være. Det ser vi som et tegn på, at hverdagen er rar at være i, og at man føler sig velkommen og taget alvorligt.

Hos os får du:

• et lille børnehus med masser af charme – hvor alle kender alle
• imødekommende og hjælpsomme kolleger i alle aldre
• en arbejdsdag med smil, grin og liv
• virkelig søde og engagerede forældre
• mulighed for at arbejde i både vuggestue og børnehave

Vi har 2 vuggestuegrupper med 12 børn på hver og 3 børnehavegrupper med ca. 20 børn i hver. Der er masser af muligheder for at lege, læse, cykle, spille bold, lave bål og være ude – alt sammen med fokus på at skabe det bedste børneliv.

Har du lyst til at prøve kræfter i køkkenet, har vi også et moderne køkken og en køkkendame, der gerne tager dig med.
Lidt om Børnehuset Nørreskoven

Vi er en integreret institution med vuggestue og børnehave. Huset er omgivet af en stor legeplads med mange legemuligheder, et lille “bjerg” og et bålhus. Når du træder ind i huset, møder du et sted, der oser af charme, nærhed og hverdagsliv – og hvor der er plads til nye ansigter.
Det praktiske

Børnehuset Nørreskoven ligger meget centralt i Værløse, tæt på bymidten og med særdeles nem adgang med tog, bus, cykel og bil. Det gør det let at komme til og fra – også når vagterne ligger forskelligt.

Stillingen er som vikar med varierende antal timer. Du er velkommen til at fortælle os om dine ønsker, og vi vil så vidt muligt forsøge at imødekomme dem.

Praktisk

Der indhentes referencer fra tidligere ansættelsesforhold, hvis du kommer i betragtning til stillingen.

I Furesø Kommune sker løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og ud fra principperne i Ny Løn.

Vi gør opmærksom på, at din private e-mail og/ eller telefonnummer bliver videregivet til faglig organisation i forbindelse med forhandling af løn.

jobs.occupation: Postdoc in Experimental Parasitology at Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly motivated and dynamic postdoc for a 1 year and 6 months position to commence 1 March 2027 or after agreement.

The postdoc will be part of the Parasites, Immunology and Gut Health (PIGH) group in the Section for Parasitology and Pathology.

A list of the group’s publications can be found at:

https://scholar.google.dk/citations?hl=en&user=70v-4RoAAAAJ&view_op=list_works&sortby=pubdate

Information on the department can be found at: https://ivh.ku.dk 

Our group and research
The PIGH group is interested in how dietary components and the gut microbiota interact to regulate type-2 immunity at mucosal surfaces, which is critical for protection against helminth parasites but can also cause pathologies such as allergies when dysregulated. We apply small (rodent) and large (swine) animal models and in vitro cell culture techniques to explore host-pathogen-microbiome interactions and nutritional immunology. The group is a multidisciplinary team embedded within the Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, with close links to other sections working on diseases, food chemistry, natural product chemistry, and the gut microbiome. Our aims are to develop novel therapies to prevent infection and disease in animals and humans. The group is international in nature, and the daily working language is English.

Your job 

In this position, you will work on a project exploring interactions between helminths and the host gut microbiome. We are particularly interested in how diet-driven changes in the host gut microbiome impact the parasite infectivity and host resistance. The main role of the postdoc will be to carry out research involving dietary manipulations and experimental parasite infections in laboratory animals. This will be coupled with extensive microbiome analyses including both amplicon-based sequencing approaches and shotgun (metagenomic) approaches and associated bioinformatic analyses. Furthermore, the duties of the Postdoc will include supporting the overall research goals of the group and contributing to a positive and supportive group environment that emphasizes teamwork, curiosity and positivity.

The postdoc’s responsibilities will primarily consist of: 

• 
research, including publication/academic dissemination duties

• 
research-based teaching

• 
sharing knowledge with society

 Furthermore, we are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic scientist with the following skills and experience:

Essential experience and skills:

• 
You have a PhD in parasitology, biology or related field

• 
You are experienced in laboratory animal models, including experimental parasite infections, with FELASA accreditation or equivalent.

• 
You have experience in gut microbiome analytical techniques

• 
Demonstrated record of peer-reviewed publications.

• 
Proficient communication skills and ability to work in teams.

• 
Excellent English skills written and spoken.

 Desirable experience and skills:

• 
Experience with transcriptomics and immunology techniques (e.g. flow cytometry).

• 
You have an active interest in nutrition and/or gut health.

Place of employment

The place of employment is at the Section for Parasitology and Pathology, Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and animal facilities.

Terms of employment 

The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 1 year and 6 months. The start date is 1 March 2027 or after agreement.

The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.

Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The application, in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW

Questions
For further information please contact Professor Andrew Williams arw@sund.ku.dk 

Foreign applicants may find this link useful: www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility).

Application procedure
Your application must be submitted in English by clicking ‘Apply now’. Furthermore, your application must include the following documents/attachments – all in PDF format:

• 
Motivated letter of application (Max. one page)

• 
CV incl. education, work/research experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position

• 
A certified/signed copy of a) PhD certificate and b) Master of Science certificate. If the PhD is not completed, a written statement from the supervisor will do

• 
List of publications

Deadline for applications: 6 December 2026, 23.59pm CET 

We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

The further process 
After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor. Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself.

You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/

Interviews are expected to be held in week 2, 2027

The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher in Electrical Engineering: Novel NMR Instrumentation for Groundwater Measurements
jobs.description:
Do you want to help develop novel instrumentation for groundwater investigations? At the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Aarhus University, we are seeking a motivated postdoctoral researcher in electrical engineering to contribute to the development of novel nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) instruments for groundwater characterization. You will join an interdisciplinary research environment spanning electrical engineering, geophysics, and environmental science working on technologies that can improve our understanding of vital groundwater resources. The 2-year position is based in Aarhus, Denmark and is available from 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Expected start date and duration of employment

This is a 2–year position from 1 March 2027 or as soon possible thereafter.

Job description

We are seeking a postdoctoral researcher in electrical engineering to help develop a new generation of surface NMR instruments for groundwater characterization. Through a recently funded research project, we are building a new instrument with capabilities beyond those of existing systems. As part of the project, you will play a central role in designing and integrating key electronic subsystems and in exploring how the resulting instrument can open new possibilities for groundwater investigations.

Your tasks will include

• Design, simulation, construction, and validation of electronic subsystems

• Interfacing of ADCs and DACs to analog frontends and a microcontroller

• Integration of subsystems into a complete instrument

• Experimental work, including testing of instruments and data collection in both laboratory and field environments

• Data analysis

• Co-supervision of bachelor and master thesis projects within the project

• Documentation of technical development and research results

• Leading and contributing to scientific publications

You will join a collaborative and interdisciplinary team where you will be working closely with other researchers, technicians, and students at the Department. The project also involves interaction with researchers and end-users working directly with groundwater characterization.

Your profile

Applicants should hold a PhD in electrical engineering or similar.

Prior experience with surface NMR or groundwater measurements is not required, but we expect you to a have a curiosity for these areas.

We are looking for candidates with experience in several of the following areas:

• Electronic systems design

• Development of low-noise analog and digital electronics including power supplies

• Interfacing to/from ADCs and DACs

• PCB layout

• Solving EMC issues

• Practical electronic and laboratory skills

• Data analysis

Experience in one or more of the following areas is considered advantageous:

• Real-time data acquisition systems implemented on microcontrollers

• Embedded Linux

• Power electronics

• Signal processing and embedded signal processing

It is also advantageous if you have a driver’s license.

Personal skills

You have good English skills, both in speaking and in writing. You take responsibility for assigned tasks and communicate openly about progress, challenges, and ideas. You can work independently as well as in a team. You are open-minded, curious, and have a good sense of humour. We value the ability to work independently as well as in a team.

We encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds and experiences. If you believe you are a strong match for the position but do not meet every listed qualification, we would still like to hear from you.

Who we are

The Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE) at Aarhus University is a leading research institution committed to excellence in research, education, and innovation. The department hosts research spanning electronics, signal processing, embedded systems, sensing technologies, artificial intelligence, biomedical engineering, digital twins, power electronics, and many other areas, creating opportunities for interdisciplinary collaboration and knowledge exchange.

This position will be supervised by Associate Professor Jakob Juul Larsen, whose current research focuses on surface NMR instrumentation, methodology, and applications.

What we offer

We offer a vibrant and inclusive research environment with a clear commitment to real-world impact. This position provides a rare opportunity to help shape the development of an entirely new scientific instrument, from subsystem design and implementation to system integration, testing, and scientific application. You will have substantial technical responsibility and the opportunity to influence both the engineering solutions and the future research capabilities of the instrument. Denmark is consistently ranked among the best countries in the world for work-life balance and quality of life. Family-friendly policies include generous parental leave, subsidised childcare, and access to excellent public healthcare and education. As a postdoc at Aarhus University, you will benefit from a supportive and flexible workplace culture that values diversity and offers excellent conditions for researchers and their families.

Specifically, we offer:

• A central role in the development of a new surface NMR instrument with unique capabilities for groundwater characterization;

• Opportunities to work across the full development chain, from electronics design and system integration to field deployment and scientific application;

• Access to state-of-the-art laboratory facilities and research infrastructure;

• Strong support for research career development, including mentoring and international networking opportunities;

• A workplace characterised by professionalism, equality and a healthy work-life balance.

Place of work and area of employment

The place of work is Finlandsgade 22, 8200 Aarhus N, Denmark, and the area of employment is Aarhus University with related departments.

Contact information

For further information, please contact: Associate Professor Jakob Juul Larsen, + 45 4189 3273, jjl@ece.au.dk_._

Deadline

Applications must be received no later than 4 January 2027.

Formalities and salary range

Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

_**Do you want to help shape the digital applications that support digital manufacturing at VELUX? As our new Technical Product Owner, you will connect manufacturing needs with solutions enabled by our top-tier Industrial IoT platform, turning business priorities into a clear roadmap and delivery-ready work—and helping drive our digitization journey.

**_**Meet your future team

**You will join our growing Industrial IoT Platform Team within the IT & Digital Enablement (IT&DE) department. We work closely with the Operations & Supply (O&S) organization to support the entire VELUX Group globally.

This role is a new addition to the team, and you will work alongside the Senior Technical Product Owner who is accountable for ensuring a common approach. You will connect IT and Supply and own an assigned area of manufacturing applications and capabilities within that framework. Your scope can evolve as portfolio priorities and the product model develop, contributing to VELUX’s continuous digitization journey.

**What We Offer

**As Technical Product Owner, you will have the opportunity to shape your part of an evolving digital manufacturing application landscape. You will own the technical product direction, roadmap, backlog and day-to-day decisions, in close collaboration with the business, translating their needs and priorities into a clear, scalable and sustainable product path.

You will connect manufacturing needs with delivery-ready work for technical teams, helping establish a consistent product mindset across your scope. To make that work clear and actionable, you will establish and maintain product requirements, processes and guardrails that support development and delivery.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

We look forward to hearing from you!

BEUMER Group
Conveying, loading, palletising, packing, sortation and distribution – BEUMER Group is a leader within the development and manufacture of high-technological intralogistics systems for global markets. Our employees stand out from others thanks to their ability to supply innovative solutions to our customers. They can do this because they know the industry and are passionate about continuously developing and expanding their knowledge. We support these high standards through teamwork, mutual respect and a working culture based on trust that fosters stability and security for all of our employees. Our common goal is to implement outstanding and innovative projects worldwide.

WHAT BENEFITS DO WE OFFER?

• 
We offer exciting opportunities in an internationally operating family-owned company with locations in more than 70 countries – including the opportunity to temporarily work from one of our international locations as part of our Flex Abroad Program.

Your health matters to us. Enjoy free access to our on-site fitness centre and join one of our many sports clubs for a healthier, more connected work-life. We also provide computer glasses subsidies, vegetarian lunch options, and free fresh fruit to help boost your well-being.

Do you want to shape how we manage the financial performance of complex portfolio of EPC and service projects? Are you a strong people leader and trusted business partner, who can challenge senior stakeholders and set direction while being close to the details to know what is really going on? 

In Semco Renewables we are delivering complex EPC and service projects within the wind energy sector. With a growing project portfolio, strong project controlling is essential to ensure transparency, sound decision-making, and strong financial performance. Thus, we are looking for you who can lead and develop our Project Controlling while acting as business partner to project leadership and senior management. You will have the opportunity to shape how we work with project financials, forecasting, risk management, governance, and performance across the organization. 

Your position

You will head up our Project Controlling function and lead a team of 10 colleagues divided into Project Controllers and Senior Project Controllers supporting our EPC and service projects. The Project Controllers are placed on locations in Denmark, Germany and Poland.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector. 

Your place of work will be at our Global HQ located in Esbjerg, the hub of the Danish energy industry, right on the waterfront – views do not get any better than this. The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel approximately 30 days per year.  

“We are looking for a Senior Manager who can bring direction and structure to our Project Controlling function while remaining close to the business. Someone who can challenge us strategically, but who is also willing to get into the details when the situation requires it. Strong project controlling is not only about reporting numbers – it is about understanding what drives the numbers and using that insight to improve our projects and business” Claus Erdmann, VP Finance

Your tasks & responsibilities

As Senior Manager, you will have overall responsibility for ensuring that the financial performance of our project portfolio is transparent, well understood, and proactively managed. You will work closely with Project Directors, Project Managers and the Finance organization, providing financial insight and challenging decisions where needed. Further, you will be a close sparring partner to the VP Finance on project portfolio performance, risks, opportunities, lessons learned and strategic decisions. Thus, you will need to be comfortable moving between the strategic perspective and the operational details – from discussing portfolio performance and governance to diving into the numbers of an individual project when required. 

Your tasks will include but are not limited to: 

• Leading and developing the Project Controlling function ensuring strong performance, clear standards, and continuous competence development.
• Ensuring transparent and reliable financial management of the project portfolio, including revenue, margin, cash flow, forecast, and risks.
• Driving robust forecasting and Estimate-to-Complete processes, ensuring early identification and follow-up on deviations, risks, and opportunities.
• Acting as a trusted financial sparring partner to VP and project leadership, supporting sound commercial and strategic decisions.
• Driving strong project governance and continuous improvement while remaining close to the operational details when needed.

Your profile & qualifications

To succeed in this role, you need to be a strong leader, a trusted business partner, and an experienced project finance professional. You are comfortable challenging senior stakeholders and setting direction, while staying close enough to the operation to understand the details when it matters. You bring structure to complexity, turn financial insight into action, and create clarity for both your team and the wider business.

You will be a part of a team that prioritizes time and details on point and a flexible working environment. We are sociable, helpful, and open to input, as well as dedicated, executory, and structured in our work, with respect for the agility that is a natural part of our core task. We want the same from you.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

• Strong leadership experience and a proven ability to lead, develop, and challenge experienced financial professionals.
• Extensive experience with project controlling/project finance and a strong understanding of project economics, including margin, cash flow, forecasting, and Estimate-to-Complete.
• Strong business partnering skills and the confidence to challenge and advise Project Directors, senior management, and other key stakeholders.
• The ability to move between strategy and operations – seeing the bigger picture while being willing and able to dive into the details when needed.
• Experience from a complex, project-oriented environment, preferably within EPC, service, offshore, wind, energy, infrastructure, or engineering.
• A structured and improvement-oriented mindset, with the ability to turn complexity into clear processes, standards, and actionable insights.
• Strong communication skills and fluency in English, with the ability to communicate financial matters clearly to both finance and non-finance stakeholders.

Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 

Change. With us. 

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

You will work closely with Project Managers, Site Managers, HSE, and engineering disciplines to ensure that all documentation — including RAMS, checklists, and execution plans — is complete, accurate, and aligned with project and client requirements. Senior Telecom Engineer – Offshore Wind

• Full-time

• Workplace type (LinkedIn): Hybrid

• Type of Employment (Career Site): Full-time only

Company Description

Vattenfall is a leading European energy company driving the transition to a sustainable energy system. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years. We employ around 21 000 people mostly in our core markets in Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK.

Job Description

Do you want to take technical ownership of the communication systems that help keep offshore wind farms safe, connected and operational? We’re looking for a Senior Telecom Engineer to develop, support and improve mission-critical telecommunications throughout the lifecycle of our operational and future offshore wind portfolio.

Telecommunications are critical to the safe and reliable operation of an offshore wind farm. In this senior engineering role, you will take technical responsibility for communication systems from early design and construction through commissioning, operations, maintenance and lifecycle replacement.

You will join our Digital Infrastructure & Connectivity organisation and work with a broad range of telecommunications technologies, with particular focus on mission-critical radio and offshore communication systems. These include TETRA, DMR, VHF/UHF radio, microwave and line-of-sight communications, AIS, ADS-B, Iridium and Starlink.

The role combines hands-on engineering, operational support, technical design, troubleshooting, stakeholder management and continuous improvement. Importantly, our involvement does not end when a project is commissioned. The Telecom team continues to support the systems it designs throughout their operational lifecycle.

Be in your element with BA Wind

As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets.

You won’t only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships.

Qualifications

Y****our role / what will you do?

You will take technical ownership of operational telecommunications infrastructure across the offshore wind portfolio and help ensure that communication systems remain secure, resilient, maintainable and available throughout the lifetime of our wind farms. You will support projects from tender and early engineering through construction, commissioning and transition into Operations & Maintenance, while also troubleshooting and improving systems already in operation. Working closely with operational stakeholders, project teams, suppliers and internal engineering disciplines, you will translate operational needs into robust technical solutions, guide complex engineering decisions and develop standardised concepts for future wind farms.

This is an operational engineering position as well as a project engineering role. You will develop a strong understanding of the workflows within the Marine Communications Center and Surveillance Center, including how telecommunications support normal wind-farm operations and emergency situations. You should therefore be comfortable working methodically under operational pressure, coordinating several technical contributors and following critical issues through to resolution. The position includes participation in a 24/7 on-call duty arrangement.

Your tasks and responsibilities:

• Take technical ownership of operational telecommunications infrastructure across the offshore wind portfolio.

• Design, implement, commission, operate and maintain mission-critical radio and telecommunications solutions.

• Support TETRA, DMR, VHF/UHF, microwave and line-of-sight, AIS, ADS-B, Iridium and satellite-based communication systems, including Starlink.

• Support wind-farm projects from tender and early engineering through construction, commissioning and transition into Operations & Maintenance.

• Perform and review site surveys, coverage calculations, technical designs, specifications, drawings, documentation, contractual requirements and engineering recommendations.

• Provide technical support for telecommunications used by wind-farm operations, marine coordination and surveillance functions, including emergency communication arrangements.

• Support marine coordination systems and integrate telecommunications equipment and services into infrastructure monitoring solutions.

• Monitor, troubleshoot and optimise existing telecommunications systems, including incidents and complex technical problems affecting operational services.

• Develop new telecommunications concepts and standardised technical solutions for future wind farms.

• Ensure systems are operated in accordance with applicable IT and OT security requirements.

• Produce and maintain engineering documentation, configurations and operational procedures.

• Support lifecycle planning, upgrades and replacement of ageing or obsolete telecommunications infrastructure.

• Work with suppliers, contractors, field teams, project organisations and internal engineering teams to ensure solutions meet technical and operational requirements.

• Ensure engineering activities are appropriately recorded and maintained through the Telecom support process and in JIRA.

• Identify opportunities to improve Telecom and Infrastructure processes and ways of working, and share technical knowledge with engineers and colleagues.

Your profile / who are you?

You are an experienced telecommunications engineer who combines strong technical judgement with a hands-on and structured approach to operational engineering. You are comfortable taking ownership of complex communication systems and following technical problems through to resolution, including when priorities change or operational pressure is high. You communicate clearly with engineers, operational teams, project organisations, management, suppliers and external partners, and you are confident challenging technical solutions while proposing practical alternatives. You value high-quality documentation and configuration management, work independently while contributing actively to the team, and willingly share knowledge to support the development of colleagues.

You do not need to be an expert in every technology from the first day. We value broad technical curiosity and expect our engineers to continue developing their knowledge as technologies and operational requirements evolve.

Next to this you bring:

• A degree or equivalent technical qualification in Telecommunications, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Network Engineering or a related discipline.

• Several years of professional experience in telecommunications, radio communications or critical infrastructure, with the ability to take technical responsibility for complex operational systems.

• Strong knowledge of radio communications and RF principles, including antennas, feeders, coverage, interference and radio-system troubleshooting.

• Experience with mission-critical radio systems, preferably TETRA and/or DMR.

• Knowledge of IPv4 networking, routing and multicast, together with experience integrating telecommunications systems into IP networks.

• An understanding of microwave or line-of-sight communication systems and basic knowledge of fibre-optic infrastructure.

• Experience supporting operational or business-critical telecommunications systems.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

Experience that would be valuable

• Experience from offshore wind, energy, utilities, maritime communications, OT/SCADA, emergency services, defence or another critical-infrastructure environment.

• Experience with AIS, ADS-B, Iridium, Starlink, VHF marine radio or other satellite communications.

• Experience supporting offshore operations, marine coordination or surveillance functions.

Travel and offshore work

The role involves engagement with Vattenfall sites and project locations. You should expect approximately 20 days of travel per year, although additional travel may be required during your initial onboarding period. During the first six months, travel may occasionally be required as frequently as every other week, depending on operational and training needs. Following onboarding, regular engagement with colleagues and stakeholders in Kolding and Esbjerg may also be required.

You must be able to obtain and maintain the appropriate offshore safety and medical qualifications required to access Vattenfall’s offshore assets, including relevant GWO and HUET training where applicable.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Location  Kolding Denmark, Amsterdam, Netherlands

Additional Information

Our offer

Looking for a career with growth?

Looking for a role where your superpowers can be leveraged to the maximum and with limitless opportunities for growth?

The scale and ambition of our wind, battery and solar business means you can really find your element with us. We’ll also provide you with all the learning and development you need to expand your horizons.

We strive to be the best place to work in the industry with highly competitive pay and conditions and an open, supportive culture. A commitment to a healthy work-life balance aims to ensure everyone plays to their strengths, whatever their background and experiences.

You will be part of a growing team of 1,700+ colleagues from 50+ nationalities where our positive approach to diversity is reflected in the fact that more than a quarter of staff are women.

More Information

For more information about the position you are welcome to contact hiring manager Alin George Raducu, alingeorge.raducu@vattenfall.com.  For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our recruiter Christian Pathuel, christian.pathuel@vattenfall.com.

We welcome your application in English no later than 06.12.2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website.

At Vattenfall we are convinced that diversity contributes to building a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be a good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation. Click here for further information.

The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfill within Vattenfall and will be performed by a third party, DISA Global Solutions AB.

Since Vattenfall is a part of the Swedish critical infrastructure, many of our services are security classed. If this position is security classified the final candidates might be subject to a security vetting process, according to Swedish legislation.

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.occupation: Removing micropollutants and oxidation products by biofilm reactors (Project Optimise)
jobs.description:
The project will focus on developing and testing innovative bioreactors for ozonation post treatment (especially for removal of ozonation products) for wastewater treatment. The system will be developed in labscale but its relevance will be tested by analysing ozonation products and organic micro pollutants in a small catchment receiving ozonated wastewater. Some samples will be analysed by partners by means of biosensing. Some sampling for micropollutants and ozonation products in recipients is part of optimize.

Expected start date and duration of employment

This is a 22 months position from 1st April 2027 or as soon possible. 

Job description

 * Develop biofilm reactors for ozonation post treatment of wastewater
 * Analysing ozonation products and organic micro pollutants in wastewater 
 * Analysing ozonation products and organic micro pollutants in recipient
 * Documentation, reporting and publishing

Applicants must hold a PhD in environmental engineering, environmental chemistry, environmental science or similar.

Experiences in i)biofilm engineering and ii)biofilm reactors, iii)quantitation of organic micropollutants by means of HPLC-MS/MS and/or HPLC-HR-MS/MS, iv)publishing results, v)collaboration in a multinational environment and vi) reporting are helpful, as well as vii)interactions with wastewater treatment plants. Some of these can be developed during the project.

Who we are

Most scientific information on the group is available under https://projects.au.dk/waterpurification//
The group has own ozonation and biofilm reactors as well as two triple quad HPLC-MS/MS systems, two HPLC-MS/MS systems with high resolution and one imaging mass spectrometer. 

Place of work and area of employment 

Aarhus University, Department of Environmental Science, Frederiksborgvej 399, 4000 Roskilde 

Contact information

Interested candidates are welcome to contact: Prof. Kai Bester (kb@envs.au.dk or +4593508089) 

Deadline

Applications must be received no later than January 4, 2027. 

Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self. 

Formalities and salary range
Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

About Aarhus University

Aarhus University is an academically diverse and research-intensive university with a strong commitment to high-quality research and education and the development of society nationally and globally. The university offers an inspiring research and teaching environment for its 37,500 students, including PhD students, and has 9,000 employees (full-time equivalents) and an annual revenue of EUR 1.2 billion. Learn more at international.au.dk

TEMPORARY ACCOMMODATION

Are you passionate about designing and improving global business processes?

Do you want to play a key role in enabling transformation by bringing deep domain expertise and driving process excellence?

Ambu is transforming – and this is your opportunity to drive that transformation at scale.

We are strengthening our global process organisation and are building a Global Process Lead (GPL) layer across a range of end-to-end business processes spanning the full value chain—from planning and operations to finance, compliance, and product lifecycle management.

As part of this transformation, we are maturing our global processes, governance structures, and ways of working to support a more scalable and standardised operating model.

A key element of this journey is the implementation and rollout of core enterprise systems such as ERP, QMS, and PLM, enabling improved process consistency and integration across the organisation.

The role

As a Global Process Lead, you support the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of Ambu’s product design process. This includes mechanical design, electrical design, manufacturing process design and managing engineering data across these subprocesses and across our IT systems, primarily our PLM. Specific subprocesses within the PLM include creation of EBOM, translation of EBOM to MBOM and product master data management.

You play a key role in translating business needs into robust, scalable processes aligned with global standards.

Working closely with the Global Process Owners, Subject Matter Experts, technical workstream leads, and stakeholders across functions and geographical sites, you will contribute to process design, support implementation, and help ensure adoption of new ways of working.

This is a high-impact role where functional expertise meets cross-functional collaboration, and where you actively contribute to driving process excellence across Ambu.

Key Responsibilities

****Process design and domain expertise (primary focus)

**

• Ensure the design process integrates into the global product development process

• Provide deep functional expertise and ensure high-quality process documentation and standards

• Contribute to defining future-state processes and capabilities that allow our engineers to design products effectively, efficiently and in compliance with regulatory requirements.

• Establish and maintain Standard Operating Procedures for the Design Processes that setup our engineers for success.

**Continuous improvement and execution support

**

• Identify and drive improvements that improve the product, reduce time to market and ensure regulatory compliance.

• Support implementation of process changes and ensure adoption across regions and sites

• Facilitate workshops and collaboration across functions to refine and improve processes

• Contribute to building a culture of continuous improvement

**Stakeholder collaboration

**

• Work closely with stakeholders across functions, regions, and sites to ensure alignment

• Support communication and anchoring of process changes in the organisation

• Act as a key contributor in transformation initiatives and projects

• Ensure effective collaboration between global and local teams

**Suggested candidate profile

**You are likely to succeed in this role if you:

• Relevant experience from industry or consulting, working within PLM-powered product design

• A strong combination of functional domain expertise and an interest in process design and improvement

• Experience from a similar or related role in an industrial or global organization is preferred, especially from within the medical device industry

• Solid experience working with cross-functional processes and stakeholders in a global context

• Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with attention to detail in process design and documentation

• A collaborative mindset with the ability to engage stakeholders and support alignment across functions and regions

• A proactive and solution-oriented approach, with a continuous improvement mindset

• Willingness to travel regularly as part of a global role, supporting collaboration and implementation across Ambu’s footprint (including the US, Malaysia, China, and Mexico)

• Comfortable working across time zones, with flexibility to occasionally engage outside standard working hours

• Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company experiencing rapid growth with ambitious targets. We achieve this through collaboration between highly skilled and motivated employees. Your contributions will be central to our success, and you will join an international environment with strong opportunities for professional and personal development.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Spirii has spent the past seven years building the infrastructure behind EV charging in Europe. Today, we operate across multiple markets and support CPOs, fleets, workplaces, and public charging networks with software and hardware solutions that make EV charging simpler to manage and scale. We are now at an important stage of growth. The market is moving fast, our product is maturing, and our organisation is scaling. That brings new opportunities, new complexity, and a need for even stronger alignment and execution across the company.

**As Director of Strategy & Execution, you will be the operational centre of gravity for the Spirii leadership team. This is a high-impact role for someone who can hold strategic context, drive cross-functional execution, and step into whatever the moment requires.

In practice, that means moving between the strategic and the operational with ease. One week you may be preparing a board presentation or supporting a key business decision. The next, you are driving alignment across product and commercial, or bringing structure to an initiative that spans multiple teams. The role requires both breadth and depth — and the judgement to know which is needed.

**What You Will Do

**

• Drive the quarterly planning cycle, OKRs, and cross-functional initiatives from kickoff through to follow-through

• Support leadership decision-making by structuring information, surfacing trade-offs, and ensuring the right inputs are in place

**Leadership alignment

**

• Identify where alignment is breaking down across commercial, product, engineering, and operations — and address it proactively

• Serve as a trusted connector across the organisation, helping teams stay coordinated and focused on shared priorities

**Special projects

**

• Lead high-impact projects that do not naturally sit within one department, and work with Edenred stakeholders on shared initiatives and reporting when needed

• Take complex, ambiguous problems, define them clearly, and drive them through to resolution

**Communication

**

• Support the CEO in communicating clearly across the organisation — all-hands updates, leadership messaging, and internal communications during periods of change

• Prepare board materials, investor presentations, and executive reviews

**What We’re Looking For

**

• 4–8 years of experience in a corporate development, management consulting, strategy, or general management role — ideally with exposure to B2B software

• Comfortable operating in ambiguity: you build the structure rather than waiting for it

• Strong written communication — you can turn a messy situation into a one-pager

• Commercially literate enough to sit in a room with customers or partners and follow the conversation

• Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

• Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

• Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.

• Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.

• Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.

• Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.

• Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.

Spirii was founded seven years ago as a company. Spirii strives to create an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of age, gender, race, sexual/religious orientation, or disability.

_Intro

Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you'll do well with us.

AI is not a nice-to-have at Monta. It's how we work. Engineers use Claude Code daily. We ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean because of it. We expect everyone to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI, not just use it passively.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people: sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You'll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Financial Services team, the team responsible for every euro that flows through Monta's platform. This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role where you'll own the architecture and delivery of complex financial systems, working across teams to ensure we can scale reliably as we expand across Europe.

Financial Services is at an inflection point. Our transaction volume is growing fast and already processes millions of euros each month. We're building the next generation of our financial infrastructure, including new billing models and compliance capabilities to support expansion into new EU markets. The problems are hard, the stakes are real, and the work matters.

We need someone who takes full ownership of what they build. Not someone who waits for direction, but someone who sees what needs to happen, drives it forward, and delivers. You will own projects end-to-end, from technical design through to production, and you'll be accountable for outcomes, not just output.

You should also be someone who has embraced AI as a core part of how you work. We use Claude Code extensively across the Financial Services team for everything from writing and reviewing code to designing systems and exploring financial domain problems. We expect you to be an advanced AI user who actively finds new ways to leverage these tools to move faster and think better.

This Is What You Will Achieve

• Redesign Monta's financial backbone. You'll architect and build the new invoicing system that every customer will use, replacing the current infrastructure with a foundation built for serious scale.

• Unblock EU expansion. You'll build the compliance infrastructure (e-invoicing, fiscalization, VAT) that enables Monta to enter new European markets.

• Strengthen the money flow. You'll improve the reliability and scalability of payment processing, reconciliation, and withdrawal systems across a rapidly growing transaction volume.

What You Will Do

• Own the new invoice system end-to-end. Design and deliver a new invoicing architecture that supports multiple billing models and financial flows as the business scales into new markets.

• Build and scale compliance infrastructure. E-invoicing across European markets. Fiscalization integrations. A VAT engine that handles the complexity of cross-border EV charging.

• Improve payment flows from card to payout. Card payments, automated reconciliation, withdrawal reliability, and working capital management.

• Collaborate across Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, and Product to deliver new billing and commercial models. You won't work in a silo.

• Drive architecture decisions for systems that must be right. Every euro must be traceable from summary down to line item. You'll design for auditability, correctness, and scale.

• Elevate the team around you. Contribute to the growth of the Financial Services engineering team through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing.

What We're Looking For

• Strong backend engineering experience. You've built and maintained production systems at scale. Java/Kotlin preferred, but strong engineers from other stacks are welcome.

• Experience with financial systems. Billing, invoicing, payment processing, or similar domains where correctness and reliability are non-negotiable.

• Proven ability to own architecture across teams. You don't just write code, you shape systems. You've led technical design for complex projects that span multiple teams.

• A strong sense of ownership. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks. When something needs to happen, you make it happen. You don't wait to be asked.

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity. Regulatory landscapes shift, business models evolve, and priorities change. You bring structure where there is none.

• Curiosity about financial infrastructure. Invoicing, VAT, compliance, payment flows. You don't need to be a domain expert on day one, but you're eager to go deep.

• Advanced AI adoption. You already use AI tools daily in your engineering workflow and you're always looking for new ways to apply them. You don't just accept suggestions, you prompt deliberately, iterate on output, and integrate AI into how you design, build, and debug.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, finance, legal, and product. You build alignment fast and communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders.

**Bonus

**

• Experience with EU financial regulations, e-invoicing standards, or fiscalization

• Experience with payment service providers or payment infrastructure

• Familiarity with event-driven architectures (Kafka) or high-throughput data processing

**If the mission excites you but your experience isn't a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway. We care about potential, not perfection.

**AI at Monta Engineering

• AI is central to how we build software at Monta. It's not a side experiment. It's embedded in our daily work and we expect every engineer to be a power user.

• Tools we use daily:

• Claude Code for writing, reviewing, and refactoring code, exploring domain problems, and building internal tooling

• Claude / Gemini for research, design thinking, and documentation

• Notion AI for docs, knowledge management, and meeting notes

• AI-enhanced testing and monitoring

We expect you to bring a strong opinion on how to use AI effectively in engineering. If you've built custom workflows, pushed the limits of agentic coding, or found creative ways to use LLMs in your development process, you'll fit right in.

Why Monta

• Impact, not easy mode. Your work matters, and you'll feel it every day.

• Ownership from day one. We don't micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• The people are extraordinary. Talented, driven, and fun to work with. You'll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure.

What We Offer

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life's big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you're at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

Please send us your application in English.

To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you'll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don't accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won't agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/
