jobs.occupation: Senior Data Scientists to join Project Systems department at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
If you’re energised by turning complex project data into AI-powered insights and you thrive on taking ideas from prototype to production, we’d love to hear from you!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

We are looking for two Senior Data Scientists with dedicated expertise in AI technologies to join our team in Project Systems supporting our Project Management area.

As a team, we are working on the data, systems and digital tools that support our customer pharma projects, all the way from design to handover of project documentation to the client. Your contribution will be important in turning that data into structure, insights and AI solutions that make our project execution smarter and more efficient.

You will work across the full AI lifecycle, from data preparation and machine learning to generative AI, large language models (LLMs) and AI agents, and help shape how NNE uses AI responsibly in a regulated pharma environment. This is your chance to become our go-to expert in AI and make a significant impact on the future of AI at NNE.

How you might spend your days

As a Senior Data Scientist, you’ll be:

• 
Designing and deploying problem-solving AI and machine-learning solutions, from predictive models to generative AI and agent-based applications

• 
Analyzing and structuring data across the project lifecycle, and helping design AI solutions together with business users

• 
Driving AI initiatives from proof of concept (PoC) to production-ready solutions in collaboration with colleagues from Project Management and Global IT

• 
Acting as the link between business needs and IT data engineers, speaking both the IT and the business “language”

• 
Presenting trends, patterns and predictions to management and non-technical stakeholders in a clear and actionable way

• 
Driving responsible AI adoption by mentoring colleagues, setting best practices for MLOps and AI governance, and keeping us up to date with the latest AI advancements.

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• 
Curious and innovative, with a genuine interest in technology and in putting new knowledge to use

• 
Pragmatic and solution-oriented, combining strong analytical skills with technical understanding

• 
Experienced in AI-assisted development with e.g Claude Code or Microsoft Copilot Studio.

• 
A clear communicator who can explain complex AI topics to colleagues, clients and management

• 
Comfortable working independently as well as collaborating with many stakeholders across disciplines and cultures

• 
Excited to share your knowledge, help others grow and build on the NNE culture of innovation

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• 
You have a master’s degree or PhD in data science, computer science, mathematics, statistics, engineering or a related field

• 
You have 5–8 years of hands-on experience in data science, including taking machine-learning models from prototype to production

• 
You have strong programming skills in Python and SQL, and experience with ML frameworks such as scikit-learn or PyTorch

• 
You have practical experience with generative AI, such as large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and Microsoft Copilot, Claude Code or Azure AI services

• 
You are fluent in written and spoken English, and Danish language skills are a plus.

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 1 December 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Martin Poulsen at +45 30 75 42 34.

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

**💰Salary Based On Your Experience And Seniority Level

**🇩🇰Up to 48,000 DKK (gross)

**About Monta

**Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you’ll do well with us.

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully — and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people — sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You’ll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

We’re looking for a Mid Level Backend Engineer who’s ready to roll up their sleeves, take ownership, and build with us.

**This Is What You Will Achieve

**

• Power the #1 CPMS & EV charging Platform: Build the robust, scalable infrastructure necessary to make Monta the undisputed global leader in Charge Point Management Systems.

• Scale the Roaming Network: Strengthen our existing roaming functionality. Your work will directly impact how seamlessly thousands of EV drivers connect to charging points across different networks.

• Innovate on Standards: Implement exciting new features including the latest OCPI versions and Plug & Charge capabilities.

• Turn vision into reality: Balance technical ambition with sleeves-rolled-up execution to ensure our fleet and roaming offerings remain best-in-class.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Own the full lifecycle: Scope out requirements and plan new features in collaboration with the team, taking code from ideation to production.

• Cross-team execution: Work closely with Roaming Ops, Product, Frontend and other Backend teams to navigate ambiguity and ensure features integrate seamlessly.

• Ensure quality at speed: Perform automated validation and verification testing while supporting your teammates with thoughtful code reviews.

• Monitor and Maintain: Utilize tools like Grafana and Loki to monitor system health, ensuring reliability for the drivers who depend on us.

• Own outcomes in a high-trust environment where we value execution over perfection.

• Navigate ambiguity and shifting priorities keeping momentum when it matters most.

• Celebrate wins and learn fast from misses alongside an ambitious, diverse team.

• Push boundaries with courage and resilience while staying true to our DNA.

**A Brief Overview Of Our Tech Stack

**

• PHP/Laravel monolith

• Kotlin services with Micronaut and Exposed

• Dart/Flutter (incl. Flutter Web) for apps

• Typescript/React (+Next.js) for web apps and rapid prototyping

• Observability via Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenSearch/Kibana

• AWS + Kubernetes with Helm and Argo CD for deployments

What We’re Looking For

• Junior ready for the next jump or mid-level backend experience: You have experience building scalable backend systems.

• Tech Stack: You have worked in Kotlin (Micronaut) and PHP (Laravel), or have experience in one with the ability to quickly master the other in a mixed environment.

• Clear & pragmatic communicator who builds alignment fast.

• Authentic team player with empathy, openness, and ownership.

• Comfortable with AI-powered tools to accelerate your work (Claude, Gemini, Codex, etc.), with the willingness to learn more.

_If the mission excites you but your experience isn’t a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway - we care about potential, not perfection.

_**AI Competency

**You’ll be expected to work with AI-powered tools. Some we use:

• GitHub Copilot / Claude Code

• ChatGPT / Gemini / Claude

• Notion AI (docs, knowledge, meeting notes)

• AI-enhanced testing & monitoring (e.g., generative QA, Grafana ML)

_We don’t expect mastery of all, but we expect comfort with learning, experimenting, and adopting AI responsibly.

_Why Monta

• Ownership from day one — we don’t micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• Becoming number one is not easy — priorities shift, and flexibility is sometimes needed to get things across the finish line. But so are the rewards: impact, growth, and a team that has your back.

• The people are extraordinary — talented, driven, and fun to work with. You’ll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure

**What We Offer

**

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life’s big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you’re at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

**Please send us your application in English.

**To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you’ll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don’t accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won’t agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

Monta is building the platform that powers the future of EV charging. We connect hardware, software, businesses, and drivers into one seamless ecosystem. Our mission is to make charging simple, reliable, and scalable for everyone.

Do you want to help ensure reliable documentation for electrical infrastructure projects? Can you bring structure to complex documentation flows and secure complete project records? And do you have at least five years of experience in document control? Then join COWI as our new Document Controller.

**Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

**We are looking for a Document Controller to join COWI and support our customer's electrical infrastructure projects. You will help ensure that both internal project documentation and supplier documentation are collected, organised and securely archived. Following an introduction to the relevant processes, methods and systems, you will work with minimal supervision to ensure complete project documentation through to final handover and project closure.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Set up archiving structures in the customer's electronic document and records management system and clarify which documentation must be collected and retained.

• Collect and secure internal project documentation from customer-managed SharePoint sites, as well as photographic documentation and other project records.

• Collect and secure supplier documentation, including collaborating with the customer's IT team on developing APIs or automation tools where needed.

• Ensure that final as-built documentation is complete, that projects comply with the customer's archiving guidelines, and that sites and platforms are closed down at project completion.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways, but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

On top of that, you will have:

• At least five years of experience in document control.

• Experience with electronic document management (EDM) systems, an aptitude for IT and a good working knowledge of Microsoft Office

• Experience managing electronic workflows and as-built documentation.

• Good written and verbal communication skills in both Danish and English.

• A structured and thorough approach, enjoyment of process-oriented tasks, and a service-minded, collaborative and practical attitude. You are motivated and engaged, with a focus on helping projects succeed

Your official COWI office location will be either Lyngby, Vejle or Aarhus. However, your primary workplace will be at Energinet in Erritsø, but Ballerup could also be an option, with some travel to Erritsø. You will report to Head of Discipline, Ioana Nicoleta Tuglui, who is based at COWI's headquarters in Lyngby.

**A place to work and so much more

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

**Before you apply

**All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

**We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

jobs.occupation: Senior Software Engineer - Revenue Enablement Group
jobs.description:
Veo is a global leader in AI-based sports camera technology. Our innovative, fully automatic camera solution enables sports teams to record matches and training sessions without a camera operator. We’re democratizing the world of sports by granting video analysis for teams on all levels—a privilege that used to be only for the few. More than 40,000 clubs in 90+ countries record their games every week.

But what truly sets us apart? Our people. We’re a diverse group of innovative thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who believe in delivering an incredible product—and having fun while doing it.

**The Opportunity

**Veo's Revenue Platform is the engine that drives the business. Each subscription, order, invoice, payment and shipment passes through the platform that our team built. We are looking for a senior engineer to help take it to the next level.

The team owns the core revenue engine that sits between Veo's products and the systems that run the business: billing, payments, CRM, ERP and fulfillment. Other teams use our APIs to sell, quote, bill and provision. Finance relies on us to get the numbers right.

The foundations are in place. The next chapter is about making the platform more robust, easier to build on, and ready for new markets, products and pricing models. You'll model subscription lifecycles, amendments, quotes, tax and payment flows. You'll make workflows stay correct when a third-party API fails halfway through an order. You'll also work closely with Finance, Sales and Product so the business logic in code matches how the business actually works.

**What You Will Do

**

• Evolve and scale backend services in Rust that process real revenue: orders, subscriptions, invoicing, payments and provisioning.

• Strengthen our Temporal workflows so they are reliable, idempotent and safe to change, through versioning and replay.

• Shape the Revenue Platform API into a clear, OpenAPI-first product that internal teams can adopt with confidence.

• Improve our integrations with billing, payment, CRM, ERP and logistics providers, and handle their failure modes properly.

• Turn ambiguous commercial requirements (pricing changes, new markets, new payment methods) into correct, well-documented business logic.

• Own what you ship in production: observability, alerting, incident response, and data migrations that touch thousands of customer accounts.

• Incorporate modern AI development tools into your workflow to iterate quickly and build thoughtful software solutions.

• Set technical direction for the platform's next phase, and raise the bar through design reviews, code reviews and testing.

**What You Could Bring

**

• 5+ years as a software engineer, with significant backend experience.

• Backend experience using Python, Rust, or another comparable language. Rust in production is ideal, but we'll also consider strong backend engineers who have built real things in Rust and want to go deeper.

• Experience in revenue-critical domains is a plus: billing, subscriptions, payments, e-commerce, or financial systems.

• Strong API design skills, and experience integrating with third-party APIs that don't always behave.

• Experience building distributed systems where correctness under failure matters.

• The judgement to make architectural calls and to improve a live system without stopping the business.

• Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams. You've worked closely with product managers, designers, finance, data and commercial stakeholders, and you're comfortable bringing them along on technical trade-offs.

• A product-oriented mindset. You care about the outcome, not just the code. You ask why before how, and you treat the platform's API and its internal users with the same care as an external product.

• Curiosity about modern AI development tools and how they can support everyday engineering workflows.

• Fluent English, written and spoken.

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to contribute meaningfully.

We are looking for a Frontend Engineer to build the customer-facing applications that allow our customers monitor the health of over one million connected devices and configure them on their own. Whether you have a couple of years of experience or a few more, we would like to see your application.

Make an impact at device scale. You will work on our device health and device configuration applications: helping customers avoid non-reporting units and the downtime that comes with them, and putting device configuration in their own hands, so the right data reaches our platform. You will work with one of the most advanced IoT frameworks out there, side by side with product managers and product designers, and with AI as part of how our team builds.

**What's in it for you?

**

• Own your part. You drive your work from idea to production, make decisions yourself and push changes, supported by sparring partners.

• Work with AI every day. Our team has a shared AI development workflow, and AI is a daily part of how we build.

• Work closely with Product and Design. Your day-to-day partners are a product manager and a product designer, so your ideas turn into shipped features together.

• Learn and share. A frontend community, training, conferences and agentic development workflows, with learning at the centre.

• Grow over time. Through impact conversations, the community and your colleagues, with you as the main driver, in an international tech company that uses continuous integration and deployment.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a frontend engineer who ships, and is just as comfortable asking questions as making decisions.

• Hands-on experience with React (our main framework), Node.js and TypeScript, ideally on complex product environments. An IoT background is a plus, but we value navigating a complex domain more than any specific industry.

• You are results-driven: you ship features fast, dare to try, and are not afraid of asking questions, failing, or reaching out to people online or face to face.

• You work independently and take ownership: you show initiative, make decisions and follow your work through to production.

• You are a mix of technical expert and good communicator, able to explain your choices to product managers, designers and senior colleagues.

• Nice to have: GraphQL, REST APIs and MCP servers, backend exposure (Java, Spring Boot, Databricks, Postgres, AWS).

AI is part of how our team builds software, including a shared AI development workflow. Hands-on experience is a plus, but curiosity and a genuine interest in working with it matter more.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Improve our device health tools so customers avoid non-reporting units and the downtime that follows.

• Build self-service device configuration for customers, such as profiles that make sure the right data reaches our platform.

• Ship features fast, in close collaboration with product managers and product designers, and keep quality high with tests and code reviews.

• Look beyond the existing tools: avoid dead ends in device health and help create a more seamless experience across our device landscape.

• Share what you learn with our engineering community and talk about what the future brings in frontend.

**Our hiring process

**Don't waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.

• Initial conversation with a colleague from our People & Talent team to get to know each other.

• Meet the hiring manager to talk through your experience and what drives you, in person where possible.

• Practical case that you prepare in advance and discuss with colleagues you will work closely with. The conversation matters more than the deliverable.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We're excited to welcome you to Trackunit!

****Coming Together To Connect Construction

****We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products – it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

Pandektes is building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world. Behind it is a backend that has to ingest, structure and search a huge database of legal information.

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help us making sure that the legislation and volume of data stays stable so we can scale our services so we can ingest larger volumes of data, more efficiently.

We have recently closed our Series A round and joining now means you will have a big impact how we grow in the future. This role is based in our Copenhagen HQ.

**About Pandektes

**Our mission is to rebuild legal research from the ground up. Lawyers still lose countless hours to fragmented sources, outdated systems, and databases that fight them at every turn. We're building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world to make that friction disappear.

We're a team of 45+ based in our Copenhagen HQ, Zurich, London, and Hamburg. We’re a small team with high trust and flat structure. We move fast, argue our positions, and ship. If your input is good, it gets implemented - often within hours, not sprints.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

**The Experience You’ll Bring

**You’ve built and operated backend systems that real customers depend on. You can work through questions about data, APIs, performance, and security, and explain the consequences of your decisions.

Experience integrating AI technologies like OpenAI and Pinecone into production systems to build innovative, data-driven solutions. Experience with vector databases, transformers, NLP and LLMs is a plus.

Our stack includes TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL, Postgres, and Prisma. We also work with OpenAI and Turbopuffer. Experience with these tools is useful; we’re especially interested in what you’ve built with them and the decisions you made along the way.

What we value

“How fast can we ship this?” comes up a lot at Pandektes. So does “we should take our time with this one.”

Knowing which question to ask is a big part of being an engineer here.

**Knowing when it’s good enough

**We like getting things into customers’ hands quickly. That means making trade-offs, questioning scope, and accepting when something is good enough for now. There’s usually another approach to explore or another prompt to try. At some point, you have to ship.

We use AI throughout our development process. AI code reviews, feature flags, and remote coding agents running end-to-end tests help us move quickly with confidence. Deciding what to build, what to check, and when it’s ready still takes judgment.

We value people who can find a smaller version worth shipping, explain the trade-offs, and follow through once customers start using it.

**Knowing when to slow down

**Some decisions deserve more time. Getting them right makes everything that follows easier. Getting them wrong means paying for the same mistake repeatedly.

Our default is to move quickly, so slowing down takes discipline. Sometimes it means pushing back when the rest of us want to get something out. We value someone who can explain why the extra work matters, challenge an approach, and help us decide where to spend our time.

You’ll have room to make those calls here, and teammates who will question them. We expect you to do the same for us.

**Make time to experiment

**We enjoy trying things before we know whether they’ll work. A new tool, a different way to use an agent, an idea that might turn out to be useless. Finding out is part of the work.

Once a month, we get together to demo our setups, show what we’re experimenting with, and share what we’ve learned. Sometimes we invite people from outside the team to show us how they work. Those sessions have changed how we build software.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We try to watch this video once a month to keep this value top of mind.

**What we offer

**You’ll join at a point where there’s still a lot to shape. We offer competitive pay and equity so you can share in the success you help create.

We are usually office based but we all work from home time to time. You’ll have your own Pleo card for the tools and work expenses you need, plus 25 vacation days a year, public holidays, and paid parental leave when your family grows.

We also make time to get together away from our usual work. Our last team trip was to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you along for the next one.

**Pandektes is an equal opportunity employer

**_We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

jobs.occupation: Head of Commercial Excellence & Go-to-Market Strategy Northern Europe
jobs.description:
LOCATION: Valby, Horsens, Aalborg, or Aarhus.

This is your chance to shape how we drive commercial performance and scalable growth across Northern Europe.

We offer you the opportunity to take a central role in how our commercial organization operates and develops. You will combine strategic transformation with operational leadership, improving how we work today while helping shape how we operate tomorrow.

Join a global organization where innovation, trust, collaboration, and sustainable thinking are central to the culture. And be part of a Nordic setup with a strong focus on continuous learning and professional development .

Your team and commercial landscape

As a member of the Northern Europe Sales Leadership Team, you will work closely with commercial and business leaders across Denmark, Sweden, Norway, and Finland.

You will lead and develop the Commercial Excellence & Strategy function and play a key role in creating the structures, capabilities, systems, and management practices that enable our commercial organization to perform effectively and grow sustainably.

Your role is not about personally executing every operational activity. It is about building an effective commercial organization through others. You will establish clear ownership, effective governance, and strong management practices, enabling teams and commercial leaders to deliver results.

Balance operational excellence with continuous transformation

In this role, your responsibility spans commercial operations, performance management, commercial capabilities, and strategy and transformation.

A central part of your work will be to balance operational excellence with continuous transformation, ensuring that we reliably manage commercial activities while creating the capacity to simplify, automate, and continuously improve the organization.

More Specifically, You Will

• Drive Commercial Operations, including the continuous development of processes and platforms such as CRM, Contract Lifecycle Management, analytics, reporting, and AI-enabled tools, while driving standardization, simplification, and automation.

• Strengthen performance management through effective reporting, forecasting, KPIs, management information, and mechanisms that increase transparency, accountability, and decision-making.

• Build commercial capabilities by enabling Sales Directors to take clear ownership of sales performance, forecasting, pipeline management, and execution, while developing training, enablement, tools, and best practices.

• Turn strategy into action by contributing to commercial and go-to-market strategy and translating strategic priorities into actionable plans.

• Lead transformation across the organization, driving cross-functional initiatives and ensuring that strategic initiatives deliver measurable business impact.

You combine strategic thinking with a pragmatic approach to commercial operations

We are looking for a colleague who can lead teams and drive change across functions and organizational boundaries, creating clear ownership and accountability. You combine strategic thinking with a pragmatic and hands-on understanding of commercial operations. And you possess strong stakeholder skills and the confidence to challenge existing ways of working constructively in a structured and results-oriented approach.

Finally, We Imagine That You Bring

• Experience within commercial excellence, sales operations, commercial strategy, business transformation, or a comparable role. Experience from an international technology, software, consulting, or professional services organization is an advantage.

• A strong understanding of B2B commercial organizations, including sales processes, pipeline management, forecasting, and go-to-market execution.

• Experience translating strategy into operational improvements and measurable business results, including developing operating models, governance structures, organizational capabilities, and management practices.

• Strong analytical capabilities and experience working with commercial systems, data, and performance management.

• Good capabilities within controlling.

• Fluency in English

Ready to shape commercial excellence across Northern Europe?

Then we look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you.

**About Electricity Maps

**Electricity Maps is a VC-backed climate and energy tech start-up building the world's most comprehensive electricity data platform. We provide real-time, historical, and forecasted data on electricity systems worldwide - covering generation mix, electricity prices, carbon intensity, and renewable share.

Our data powers decisions across sustainability and energy markets: from companies like Google and Cisco optimising compute workloads and reporting emissions, to energy market participants using our forecasts to inform trading strategies and asset optimisation. We're a small, technical team based in Copenhagen, working at the intersection of energy, AI, climate change, and data.

**About The Role

**You'll work in the product team responsible for exposing our data to the world and you will help people and companies consume our data: Via our API, our map or whatever makes sense next.

We believe in engineers owning product decisions. Engineers scope the problem, build it and evolve it based on feedback from customers, colleagues and users. Those decisions usually aren't mapped out before you start on them so you're figuring out the shape of the problem and the best solution as you unpack it.

You'll be part of a small engineering team with 3 other full-stack engineers. No two days look the same. Most of your energy goes into building and figuring out solutions, with bug fixes and other tasks mixed in.

****What you'll do

• Build and ship across the stack (we’re using TypeScript for 95% of the product surface).

• Own the systems that touch customers directly, from how we onboard, guide and support them to how we serve data in the API they integrate with.

• Decide what to build in collaboration with leadership, sales, marketing and data teams.

• Care about your solutions being actually used and understand what matters to our users: dig deeper in analytics, join commercial conversations, be curious.

• Push on new ways customers can interact with our data. Maybe new API capabilities, new functionality in the map or something else.

• Dig into bugs and edge cases.

****What you won't do

• Ship something and never find out if anyone uses it.

• Wait around for permission to fix something you can see is broken.

• Spend more time in alignment meetings than building.

****What we're looking for

• 6+ years of hands-on experience shipping full-stack features in production and scaling them.

• Early-stage tech company / product experience.

• Product mindset, meaning that you build with the user in mind and have strong, defensible opinions on what "good" looks like; in code, in product, in process.

• Comfortable with data-heavy products, where edge cases and correctness can play a big part.

• Founder mentality, meaning that you are excited about building new products and taking them from an early stage to something users rely on. You spend time across the organization to deepen your knowledge and learn how users interact with the product to build things that are used.

****Our stack

****Relevant to this role: TypeScript, Node.js, React, GCP. The ideal candidate has worked in or close to these systems.

****The details

****Location: Copenhagen (office first, with flexibility)

Type: Full-time

Compensation: Competitive salary + stock options

Benefits: 6 weeks vacation, health insurance, annual company offsite, lunch and snacks at the office

jobs.description:
**P-1450

**At Databricks, we are passionate about helping data teams solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers and dedicated to our customers, we leap at every opportunity to solve technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for working with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started.

As a software engineer, you will work with our engineering team to build infrastructure and products for the Databricks platform. We're hiring across all of our teams, including backend, full stack, infrastructure, databases, systems, tools, cloud, and customer-facing products. You will join a cohort of engineers who will build their careers through collaborative projects and learning opportunities. With a dedicated mentor and supportive team, you'll onboard quickly and start contributing to impactful projects soon after starting here at Databricks!

**The Impact You Will Have

**

• Work with a team to build features and improve architecture for the Databricks platform

• Develop and extend the Databricks product

• Own full software development lifecycle: design, development, testing, and operating in production

• Build solutions with a high level of reliability, scalability, and security

**What We Look For

**

• You will graduate between fall 2026 and summer 2027 with a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related subject

• You have implementation skills with a general purpose program language, such as Python, Java, or C++

• You have knowledge of algorithms, data structures, and OOP principles

• You have experience managing end-to-end projects

We are hiring Software Engineer - New Grads across multiple offices. Please apply for the single location that you're the most interested in, and we will discuss more with you as you move through the process. We can only consider one application in 30 days.

**About Databricks

**Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

**Benefits

**At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

**At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

**Compliance

**If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

ValueOne is recruiting a Procurement Category Manager Logistics & Transport for Haugen-Gruppen Nordic AS. In this newly established role, you will be responsible for driving and developing the Group's strategic procurement activities within the logistics and transportation category. The position is physically based at the Danish subsidiary's office south of Copenhagen and reports to Head of Supply Chain Operations & Development. We welcome applications from candidates residing in both Sweden and Denmark.

About Haugen-Gruppen Nordic AS

Haugen-Gruppen Nordic AS is one of the Nordic region's leading distributors and brand partners within food, beverages, snacks, and confectionery. With more than 100 years of experience, the Group helps both international and proprietary brands grow across the Nordic markets through strong capabilities in marketing, sales, logistics, and category development. Supply Chain is regarded as a key competitive advantage, with a strong focus on customer and brand value while ensuring the right balance between service and cost. The company currently generates annual revenues of MNOK 4500 and employs approximately 400 people across the Nordic countries. Following an acquisition in 2026, Haugen-Gruppen has also established a presence in Poland and intends to continue expanding beyond the Nordic region.

About the Role

The Procurement Category Manager Logistics & Transport is part of the Nordic Supply Chain team and responsible for strategic sourcing and category management at Group level within transportation, third-party logistics (3PL), warehouse equipment, packaging materials and load carriers, and, where relevant, selected third-party manufacturing. The role works closely with stakeholders across the various markets to develop competitive and sustainable supplier solutions that strengthen Haugen-Gruppen's supply chain while ensuring the right service levels and total cost position.

Key Responsibilities

• Own and develop the Group-wide Logistics & Transport category strategy.

• Lead strategic sourcing and procurement initiatives across transportation, 3PL, warehousing, and related logistics services.

• Drive the Source-to-Contract process, including sourcing strategy, tendering, negotiations, contracting, and implementation.

• Develop and optimize Route-to-Market solutions in collaboration with Supply Chain and Commercial stakeholders.

• Manage supplier relationships, commercial agreements, and performance to ensure competitiveness, service excellence, and sustainability.

• Identify cost optimization opportunities through spend analysis, market intelligence, and supplier development.

• Mitigate supplier risk and ensure compliance with Group policies, standards, and sustainability requirements.

• Support strategic sourcing initiatives across adjacent supply chain categories when required.

Experience and Qualifications

To succeed in this role, you should have:

• A Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business Administration, or a related field, alternatively equivalent relevant experience.

• Proven experience in strategic sourcing and category management managing suppliers and commercial agreements within indirect material and services.

• Strong commercial and analytical capabilities within spend analysis, tendering, negotiation, and total cost of ownership (TCO) assessment.

• Knowledge of sustainability requirements and compliance standards within logistics and procurement.

• Fluency in English and proficiency in at least one Scandinavian language, both written and spoken.

• Experience within logistics, transportation, supply chain, or FMCG environments is considered highly advantageous.

Personal Attributes

We are looking for a proactive, accountable, analytical, and solution-oriented professional who enjoys working in an international environment. You have excellent communication and organizational skills and thrive when collaborating across functions, countries, and cultures.

A service-minded, flexible approach combined with a continuous improvement mindset will be essential for success in this role.

Application

We welcome your application for the position of Procurement Category Manager Logistics & Transport. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. For further information, please contact Talent Acquisition Specialist James Li at James.Li@valueone.se.

About ValueOne

ValueOne specializes in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, and Logistics. We support our clients through three business areas:

• Interim Procurement and Supply Chain Consultants

• Recruitment of Procurement and Logistics Professionals

• Management Consulting

Through our consulting services, we help organizations develop and improve their procurement, logistics, and supply chain capabilities covering strategy, operating models, processes, organization, governance, and competence development.

**Why join us?

**Muuto is rooted in the Scandinavian design tradition characterized by enduring aesthetics, functionality, craftsmanship and an honest expression. By expanding this heritage with forward-looking materials, techniques and bold creative thinking, our ambition is to deliver new perspectives on Scandinavian design.

We are looking for a PR Intern to support Muuto’s global PR and brand activities and provide practical support to Channel Marketing. About the Job

We are looking for a Senior Security Architect to shape and strengthen security across Stibo DX products, platforms, and cloud services. You will join a small, senior architecture team at the center of Stibo DX's transformation from self-hosted and hybrid deployments to a standardized, cloud-native SaaS platform.

This is a hands-on, embedded role. You will work with engineering, product, platform, operations, customer-facing teams, and legal to ensure security is built into our solutions by design, not added afterwards. You will turn security strategy and risk into practical architecture, reusable patterns, and controls that teams can implement.

Your goal is to establish a consistent security architecture across Stibo DX and give teams clear standards, patterns, and guardrails to make secure architecture decisions. Early priorities will include establishing a security architecture baseline, identifying key security gaps across our SaaS platform, strengthening security architecture reviews and threat modelling, and defining reusable security patterns for engineering teams.

The role is primarily focused on security architecture, product and platform security, and secure engineering practices. You will also drive the technical aspects of security governance and support compliance activities when needed, including security certifications, customer security requirements, regulatory obligations, risk assessments, policies, and audit preparation.

You will work alongside peer architects covering Software, Platform/Infrastructure, and Data/Integration, reporting to the Director of Solution Architecture. Our governance model is based on minimum necessary control: decisions close to teams, with oversight proportional to risk and impact.

Security remains a shared responsibility. The Senior Security Architect owns the security architecture direction, standards, patterns, and cross-cutting guidance, while Software, Platform/Infrastructure, and Data/Integration architects continue to consider and address security within their respective domains. Engineering teams remain responsible for implementing and operating the required controls.

What You'll Do

• Define security architecture strategy across Stibo DX products, platforms, and cloud services, including principles, standards, target architectures, guardrails, and roadmaps.

• Embed secure-by-design practices into product discovery, solution design, delivery, and operation, working with teams early rather than reviewing security only at the end.

• Lead security architecture reviews and threat modelling for product, platform, customer, and technology initiatives; identify risks and align on practical mitigation with accountable teams.

• Shape identity and access management covering authentication, authorization, federation, privileged access, service identities, secrets, and Zero Trust principles.

• Strengthen cloud and platform security for AWS, Kubernetes, networks, workloads, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, data, and shared SaaS platform capabilities.

• Define reusable security patterns and controls for APIs, integrations, multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, encryption, key management, logging, monitoring, vulnerability management, and secure configuration.

• Embed security in the software development lifecycle by defining practices and guardrails and helping teams integrate security into engineering practices, automation, architecture decision records, and delivery pipelines.

• Lead security governance and compliance work when needed including security policies, control design, risk assessments, evidence coordination, audit preparation, and remediation planning.

• Translate external requirements into technical action including customer security expectations, contractual commitments, privacy requirements, and relevant frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, and CRA.

• Raise security maturity across Stibo DX through coaching, practical guidance, cross-team collaboration, and clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What we're looking for

Experience

• 10+ years of experience across software engineering, cloud/platform engineering, or cybersecurity, with 4+ years in a senior security architecture or technical security leadership role.

• Proven experience designing and securing cloud-native, distributed, and microservices-based systems in production.

• Practical experience with SaaS and multi-tenant architectures, including tenant isolation, identity, data protection, and shared platform controls.

• Experience leading threat modelling, security architecture reviews, risk assessments, and remediation planning across multiple teams or product areas.

• Experience defining security standards, patterns, reference architectures, and governance that teams can apply in practice.

• Experience working with security and compliance frameworks and translating them into proportionate technical and organizational controls.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to influence engineers, architects, product leaders, operations, customers, legal, and senior stakeholders.

Technical expertise

• Cloud security, preferably AWS, and Kubernetes/container security.

• Identity and Access Management, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, federation, privileged access, and service identities.

• Application, API, integration, and event-driven security.

• Network security, workload protection, secrets management, encryption, certificates, and key management.

• Secure software development lifecycle, DevSecOps, infrastructure as code, CI/CD security, and software supply-chain security.

• Security logging, monitoring, detection capabilities, vulnerability management, and incident preparedness.

• Threat modelling, security risk analysis, Zero Trust, and defense-in-depth principles.

Nice to have

• Experience leading or materially supporting ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR security controls, CRA, or similar initiatives.

• Experience with enterprise customer security assessments, contractual security requirements, and audit evidence coordination.

• Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience helping an organization establish or mature a security architecture and governance capability.

Personal qualities

• Hands-on and credible with engineers, while able to communicate security clearly with product, customers, legal, and leadership.

• Pragmatic and risk-based: able to balance security, usability, operational complexity, cost, and delivery speed without compromising critical controls.

• Collaborative and influential, using expertise, evidence, and trust rather than creating unnecessary gates.

• Structured and decisive, able to make risks, responsibilities, and architectural decisions explicit.

• Curious, adaptable, and motivated by building long-term security maturity while helping teams deliver now.

What We Offer

• Real influence on the security foundations of Stibo DX's cloud-native SaaS transformation.

• Ownership of security architecture and a central role in shaping security governance and compliance maturity.

• Hands-on work on real product, platform, customer, and operational challenges, not security from an ivory tower.

• A small, senior architecture team with trust, autonomy, and meaningful responsibility.

• High visibility across product, engineering, operations, customer-facing teams, legal, and leadership.

• The opportunity to create reusable security practices and patterns with lasting impact across Stibo DX.

Interested?

Apply at your earliest convenience. Short-listed candidates will be invited for an interview. Applications are processed as they are received until the right candidate is found.

For any questions, please reach out to hiring manager Safdar Aqeel Safdar on safs@stibodx.com.

Stibo DX is the global leader in digital transformation for media enterprises. Our platform and services help automate complex content production and enable omnichannel delivery for some of the world's most ambitious and successful media organizations.

We are a global and dynamic team of over 200 employees based in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Atlanta, Hamburg, Oslo, and Málaga, combining creativity and innovation with the stability of a long-standing organization.

jobs.occupation: Full Stack Software Engineer, Android Transactions
jobs.description:
About The Job

Flatpay is enabling merchants to simply and effectively accept payments in-store and online. We are one of the fastest-growing companies in Europe. 100,000+ merchants rely on us today, and we are just getting started.

Every day, merchants take card payments on Flatpay terminals, and the Android Transactions team is behind them. We own the software that runs on those terminals and the backend that connects them to the rest of Flatpay.

We are looking for a full stack engineer who is at home on both sides. On Android you will work on the apps that run on our terminals, including the app that lets a POS drive the terminal and the app that takes the payment itself. On the backend you will work on the Terminal API, the service that connects terminals, POS systems and the Flatpay platform.

You will take real ownership, with freedom to drive technical decisions and a direct impact on how payments are made at a company that has gone from startup to unicorn at record speed.

What you’ll do

• 
Build and maintain the Android apps that run on our payment terminals, including the payment and POS-connectivity apps, using Kotlin, Jetpack Compose and Hilt

• 
Develop and evolve the Terminal API backend in Java and Spring Boot

• 
Own features end to end across terminal, backend and infrastructure, from discovery through production

• 
Work with real payment hardware: integrate with the terminal vendor SDKs, debug on physical devices and make payment flows robust

Who you are

• 
3+ years of professional software engineering experience

• 
Experience building Android apps in Kotlin, ideally with Jetpack Compose, coroutines and dependency injection (Hilt or Dagger)

• 
Experience building backend services in Java and Spring Boot, including REST APIs, JPA and relational databases

• 
Understanding of what makes mobile and device software reliable: lifecycle, background work, retries and release management

• 
A habit of writing well-tested code and finding root causes in production issues

• 
Strong communication and collaboration skills

• 
Any experience with fintech, payments, POS or embedded and device-level Android would be a plus

We don’t expect experience with every technology listed below. We’re looking for engineers who can learn quickly and help us build great products.

Android (terminal apps)

• 
Kotlin, Coroutines, Jetpack Compose, Hilt, Room, WorkManager

• 
AWS IoT / MQTT, terminal vendor SDKs (PAX)

Backend (Terminal API)

• 
Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, MySQL, Redis

• 
REST APIs, OpenAPI, OpenFeign, webhooks

• 
AWS IoT, SQS, S3, KMS; MQTT-based device messaging

Platform & Delivery

• 
GitHub Actions, CI/CD, Docker, AWS ECS, Terraform

• 
Feature flags (LaunchDarkly), Esper device management, Sentry, New Relic

Why Flatpay?

As part of our team, you’ll join 2,600+ passionate Flatpayers dedicated to shaping the future of payments.

We offer an inclusive and diverse environment where engineers of all backgrounds are trusted with ownership, encouraged to make an impact, and supported in growing their craft.

Our engineering teams work together from our Herlev office in the greater Copenhagen area. We believe that close collaboration, quick feedback loops, and solving problems side-by-side help us build better products, move faster, and create a stronger engineering culture.

We also provide plenty of perks including free slush ice, an on-site gym, a fully equipped gamer room, and much more.

Perks and benefits

This job comes with several perks and benefits

Near public transit

Near public transit

Free office snacks

Free office snacks

Paid holiday

Paid holiday

Free coffee / tea

Free coffee / tea

Work life balance

Work life balance

Flexible working hours

Flexible working hours

See all 18 benefits

Working at

Flatpay

WHAT IS FLATPAY? At Flatpay, we believe that merchants deserve a payment solution that is easy to understand, affordable, and free from hidden fees. That's why we offer a straightforward pricing model with no setup fees for terminals, no subscription fees, and a flat rate for all card types. It's a breath of fresh air compared to the complicated and confusing pricing structures of our competitors.  What sets Flatpay apart is our dedication. We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our client's evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary? WHAT's THE CULTURE LIKE? Flatpay is a fast-moving, performance-driven environment where people are trusted to take ownership from day one. We value initiative, resilience, and a strong work ethic. Our teams are collaborative and supportive, but we also set clear expectations and hold ourselves accountable to results.  As a growing business, things move quickly. That means you’ll have the opportunity to take on real responsibility early, contribute ideas, and see the impact of your work directly. It also means being comfortable with change, solving problems as they arise, and continuously improving how we operate.  We’re best suited to people who are motivated by challenge, enjoy working towards clear goals, and want to develop in a commercial, high-energy environment. WHY CHOOSE FLATPAY? Flatpay offers the opportunity to take real ownership, develop valuable skills, and grow your career in a fast-moving, ambitious company where performance and initiative are recognised.

Build Intelligent Systems That Create Real Impact

Are you motivated by solving complex problems with data and AI?

Do you enjoy transforming business challenges into scalable, production-ready solutions?

At VENZO, we’re expanding our Data & AI team and are looking for experienced profiles across mid-to-senior level — from strong hands-on engineers to technical leaders who can shape architecture and guide others.

If you want your work to move beyond experimentation and into real-world implementation, this could be the right place for you.

About VENZO

At VENZO, we believe in the power of technology to create meaningful change – today, not tomorrow.

You’ll join a team of specialists who live and breathe digital transformation, helping some of Denmark’s largest and most influential organizations turn data into action. Here, innovation isn’t a buzzword – it’s how we think, collaborate, and deliver.

About the Role

You will contribute directly to the design, development, and deployment of advanced data and AI systems in cloud-based environments.

Your responsibilities may include:

• Architecting and implementing end-to-end AI and machine learning solutions

• Deploying, monitoring, and optimizing models on cloud platforms

• Translating business requirements into structured technical solutions

• Ensuring solutions are maintainable, scalable, and aligned with best practices

• Evaluating and applying emerging technologies within AI and GenAI

For more senior candidates, the role also includes:

• Acting as a primary technical contact for clients

• Leading workstreams and mentoring team members

We value profiles who can combine deep technical execution with sound judgment in real client environments.

Your Background

We are open to different experience levels, provided you bring strong fundamentals and practical experience.

Experience and Education

• 2+ years of experience in data engineering or AI/ML, delivering production-ready solutions

• Hands-on experience across the full ML lifecycle — from experimentation to deployment and monitoring

• Experience with generative AI

• For senior profiles: experience leading technical initiatives or mentoring others

Technical Capabilities

You have experience working within modern data and AI ecosystems, including:

• Programming: Python and SQL, Typescript is a plus

• Cloud: Microsoft Azure (e.g., Azure ML, Data Factory) or other cloud plattforms

• Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, MLflow)

• Machine Learning: Classical ML techniques and generative AI applications

• GenAI Tooling: LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, frameworks such as LangChain or Microsoft Agent Framework

• MLOps: CI/CD, model lifecycle management, orchestration tools, version control

• Data Engineering: ETL processes and large-scale data processing

How You Work

• Analytical and structured in your problem-solving approach

• Comfortable operating in client-facing environments

• Able to communicate complex technical topics in business-relevant terms

• Pragmatic, quality-driven, and accountable for outcomes

What You Can Expect From Us

• Meaningful, technically challenging projects with real business visibility

• A strong professional environment with high standards and high trust

• Autonomy in how you structure and deliver your work

• Access to modern tooling, platforms, and certifications (including Microsoft)

• Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits

• Continuous development — technically and professionally

Let’s Talk

Send your CV or a short introduction to hr@venzo.com.

We’re happy to meet for a coffee and explore whether there’s a mutual fit.

jobs.occupation: MCO is searching for a Project and Community Manager
jobs.description:
Help us shape the future of media and technology.

The media industry is changing faster than ever. AI, new technologies and changing audience habits are transforming how we create, distribute and consume content.

At Media City Odense (MCO), we’re bringing together the people and organisations who want to shape what comes next.

Now we’re looking for an ambitious, creative and hands-on Project & Community Manager to join our team in Odense and help take MCO to the next level.

A small team. Big ambitions.

Media City Odense is a growing innovation hub and community connecting some of Denmark’s leading media companies, technology businesses, startups, researchers and educational institutions.

Founded by TV 2 Denmark, JFM, TV 2 Fyn and the University of Southern Denmark, we’ve built a strong foundation for collaboration, innovation and knowledge sharing. And we’re just getting started.

Our ambition is to become Denmark’s leading national hub for media technology and innovation. A place where new ideas turn into real projects, where talent meets opportunity, and where the industry comes together to develop the solutions of tomorrow.

From our annual MediaTech Festival to industry events, innovation projects and new partnerships, we’re building a community that creates value all year round.

And that’s where you come in.

As our new Project & Community Manager, you’ll play a central role in turning ideas and ambitions into activities, experiences and tangible results.

You’ll work closely with our CEO, Event Manager and the wider MCO community, taking ownership of projects while helping develop and strengthen our organisation.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Project management: Plan, coordinate and execute projects and initiatives, from the first idea to the final delivery.

• Events & experiences: Help develop and deliver workshops, networking events, industry sessions and our annual MediaTech Festival.

• Community & relationships: Build and maintain strong relationships with our members, partners and stakeholders, ensuring they experience real value from being part of MCO.

• Marketing & communications: Create engaging content for our website, newsletters, social media and other communication channels, including basic visual and graphic content.

• Business development: Contribute ideas, identify opportunities and help develop new initiatives that support MCO’s growth and ambitions.

• Making things happen: Keep projects, partners and priorities moving forward, including the practical details that make the difference.

You’ll have plenty of opportunities to put your own ideas into action, take responsibility and make a visible impact on the organisation.

Who are you?

We’re looking for someone who combines structure with creativity, initiative with execution, and professionalism with a healthy dose of curiosity.

You enjoy working with people, you’re comfortable taking ownership, and you don’t need a detailed instruction manual to get started.

Ideally, you:

• Have experience with project management, events, communications, community building or a related field.

• Are highly organised, proactive and comfortable managing several projects at once.

• Have strong communication skills and can create engaging written and visual content.

• Have a good eye for design and are comfortable using digital tools to produce presentations, social media graphics and marketing materials.

• Enjoy building relationships and working with people across different organisations and industries.

• Are curious about technology, AI, innovation and the future of media.

• Communicate confidently in both Danish and English.

• Thrive in a small team where responsibilities are broad, decisions are made quickly and everyone contributes.

Experience from the media or tech industry is an advantage, but not a requirement. We’re just as interested in your mindset, initiative and ability to deliver as we are in your CV.

What do we offer?

At MCO, you’ll join a small, dedicated team with ambitious plans and the freedom to help shape how we achieve them. You’ll get:

• Real influence: An opportunity to shape projects, activities and the future development of MCO.

• An exciting network: Direct access to leading media companies, technology innovators, entrepreneurs and decision-makers.

• Variety and responsibility: A broad role where no two weeks look quite the same.

• Room to grow: Opportunities to develop professionally, take ownership and explore new ideas.

• A collaborative culture: An informal working environment built on trust, initiative, curiosity and a shared ambition to make a difference.

We’re based in central Odense, working at the intersection of media, technology and innovation, with a growing network across Denmark and beyond.

Ready to join us?

We’d love to hear from you.

Send your CV and a short application telling us who you are, what motivates you and why you’d be a great fit for Media City Odense.

Apply by email: thhah@mediacityodense.dk

We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, and expect to complete the recruitment process during November 2026.

The position is full-time, based in Odense, with a start date to be agreed upon.

Come help us build what’s next.

We are an experience innovation and digital transformation consultancy. We are responsible for the end-to-end product development for some of the biggest brands in the world. We build innovative AI-driven digital experiences used by millions of customers across retail, e-commerce, finance, automotive and other sectors. Operating across five continents with over 6,000 innovators in twenty-two countries, we help organizations reimagine the way they connect with their customers and transform their business operations.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

• The work we do and innovation we drive

• Our Values of share, care and dare

• A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy

• Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The Role:

Valtech Denmark is looking for new enterprise clients. You will be the person that will help win them.

As our Executive Business Developer, you will showcase to Danish enterprise leaders Valtech’s Intelligent Enterprise proposition which connects AI, data, technology, customer experience and operating models to deliver tangible business outcomes.

This is not a conventional sales role. You hunt like a seller, think like a management consultant, use AI and data in your own work and bring the right colleagues in early. You are relentless about results, and you never make the sale about yourself.

You report to the Managing Director, Valtech Nordics, and work day to day with colleagues in strategy, data and AI, experience design, technology and delivery, and with Valtech’s international network of expertise.

Role Responsibilities:

• Own new logo acquisition: identify, engage and win new enterprise clients across Denmark, running every stage from target selection and first contact to pitch, negotiation and close

• Build and execute a GTM plan focused on high-value target accounts and priority industries

• Build relationships with CEOs, COOs, CIOs, CMOs, CDOs and other senior decision-makers

• Open every conversation with a hypothesis about the client’s business, not our service catalogue, and link AI opportunities to the data, processes, technology and organizational capabilities needed to realize value

• Pull strategy, data and AI, design, technology and delivery colleagues in early, and lead pursuits and RFP responses through influence rather than ownership of every idea

• Co-sell with strategic partners (Adobe, Salesforce, Sitecore, Optimizely, Contentful, hyperscalers, etc.), including joint AI-led propositions

• Use AI and data across prospecting, meeting preparation, proposals and forecasting, and keep Salesforce disciplined so the pipeline and forecast can be trusted

• Deliver against your agreed new-business target and represent Valtech at industry events and partner activations

What we expect of you:

• Hunter: You open doors instead of waiting for leads, and can say exactly what you personally contributed to each win.

• Orchestrator: You compete on outcomes, not ego, and share credit with the specialists you involve.

• Consultant mindset: You ask sharp questions, challenge assumptions and frame problems that matter to the business.

• AI and data native: You use AI in your own work, know where it fails and tie it to real business problems, as a commercially credible bridge rather than a technical specialist.

• Energy builder: You bring pace, optimism and a bias for action, backed by a plan and real client conversations, not slogans.

Must have Qualifications:

• Proven track record winning net-new enterprise logos in a digital agency or consulting environment, with a clear view of your personal contribution

• Experience selling complex, multi-million euro engagements across digital experience, data, technology and AI-enabled solutions

• A strong network in Denmark, ideally including senior decision-makers and C-suite relationships

• Exceptional consultative sales skills, with the ability to translate business challenges into impactful digital and AI-enabled strategies

• Practical understanding of how AI and data apply in commercial and customer experience contexts, including where they fall short

• Deep understanding of one or more key industries (e.g., Retail, Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences)

• Ability to influence senior stakeholders, navigate complex client organizations and mobilize internal specialists

• Strong communication and storytelling skills, with fluency in Danish and English

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

The benefits

This is a permanent position based in Denmark.

Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer:

• Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs

• Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses ending in @valtech.com.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen, Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

How to apply

As a Consulting Solution Architect for the Data Management domain, you will serve as a trusted advisor throughout consulting engagements — helping clients shape feasible solution options, leading or supporting the design of custom, high‑value solutions, and ensuring strong domain integrity aligned with the broader SimCorp One solution design. You will play a central role in supporting scalable, high‑quality custom implementations and contribute to consistency and excellence across our Consulting organization.

You will also help advance our practices, strengthen our knowledge base, and mentor the next generation of solutioning talent within SimCorp.

• Relevant degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics or a relevant Business degree

• At least 7+ years of proven experience designing and implementing SimCorp Dimension solutions

• Deep business knowledge within the Data Management domain. Experience with the SimCorp Data Management Core solution and the SimCorp Data Management Service is a plus.

**Benefits

**NEXT STEPS
