**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT FOR US

**As a Lead Software Engineer, you are responsible for complex software features from design through delivery. You set the technical direction, raise the bar on quality, and make the people around you better. You work with modern AI tools and have the opportunity to participate in great AI Hackathons organized together with Microsoft (check recap from recent event here AI Hackathon 2026 ).

As an Engineer in Service Orchestration you will be part of international team builidng reliable, scalable services, orchestrating workflows and integrations, and automating operational processes. We work on developing self-service tools that allow our stakeholders to deploy and manage cloud environments.

We develop backend (API) and frontend (web application) using mainly:

• C# .NET

• Angular

• Azure

This is a devops role requiring not only development skills but also participating in bug fixing, testing, investigating and supporting users with additional focus on security. Requires being engaged and taking initiative.

Engineers at SimCorp are expected to shape how the work gets done, not just execute what's handed to them. If you want to own something end to end and work alongside people who take the craft seriously, this is the right environment.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Lead the design and architecture of software solutions that meet both business needs and engineering standards, and be accountable for the outcome.

• Mentor and support engineers across the team. The expectation is that your involvement makes the team better, not just the code.

• Work closely with product and design to ensure seamless delivery from concept to production.

• Own the resolution of complex technical issues. You are the person others escalate to, and you are expected to have an answer or find one.

• Drive continuous improvement in how the team builds software: tooling, processes, standards, and culture. If something is slowing the team down, you fix it or propose how to fix it.

• Set the standard for code quality. Code reviews are how you scale your judgment across the team.

**What We Value

**

• 5+ years of software engineering experience, with experience leading technically complex projects.

• Solid foundation in software design, distributed systems, and engineering best practices.

• The ability to communicate clearly across disciplines, with engineers, product managers, and stakeholders alike.

• A bias toward action and ownership, and low tolerance for unnecessary complexity.

**Benefits

**Competitive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, at SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide an excellent work & life balance: flexible work hours, a hybrid workplace model. On top of that, we have dedicated time you can spend on mastering your skills as well as contributing to the company development. There is never just only one route - we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

**WHO WE ARE?

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

jobs.occupation: Head of HR for Operations, Manufacturing & Quality
jobs.description:
**Would you like to shape the Human Resources agenda for a global Operations, Manufacturing and Quality organization within GN Hearing? Are you motivated by partnering closely with senior leaders, leading international teams and translating business priorities into HR strategies that strengthen performance, capability and transformation?

**Then this could be an exciting opportunity to join GN Hearing as Head of HR, Operations, Manufacturing and Quality.

In this role, you will provide strategic HR leadership and act as a trusted executive business partner to global leaders across Operations, Manufacturing and Quality. You will lead an international HR team and play a central role in building the organizational capabilities needed to support a high-performing, global and transforming business.

**The team you will be part of

**You will join the global HR organization for the Hearing Division and become a member of the HR Leadership Team for GN Hearing.

You will work closely with senior leaders across Hearing Operations, Manufacturing and Quality, as well as HR colleagues in the regions and HR Centres of Excellence.

You will lead three direct reports and an overall international HR team of approximately 15 colleagues across Denmark, China and Malaysia. Together, the team combines global alignment with local understanding to deliver trusted, data-informed and pragmatic HR support in a complex and multicultural organization.

**Your contribution is appreciated, and you will

**

• Set the HR strategy, priorities and people agenda for Global Operations, Manufacturing and Quality, aligned with business priorities and the overall HR strategy for GN Hearing.

• Act as a trusted advisor and constructive sparring partner to senior leaders on organizational performance, workforce planning, talent, succession, leadership and capability development.

• Lead, develop and support an international HR organization of approximately 15 colleagues, including three direct reports based in Denmark, China and Malaysia.

• Drive clear priorities, strong collaboration and high-quality HR delivery across the Global Operations, Manufacturing and Quality.

• Hold overall responsibility for GN Hearing’s global Health & Safety agenda and function, ensuring a strong and consistent approach across locations.

• Translate business priorities into clear and impactful HR plans, including organizational design, transformation, change management and capability building.

• Ensure effective and consistent deployment of global HR processes and policies, including performance management, reward, talent and succession.

• Lead people aspects of organizational changes and restructuring activities, balancing business needs with stakeholder alignment, local compliance and a people-centred approach.

• Use people and business insights to identify opportunities, anticipate risks and enable sound, forward-looking decisions.

• Contribute actively to the development and priorities of the HR Leadership Team for the Hearing Division.

**To perform well in the role, we imagine that you

**

• Bring extensive experience from a senior HR business partnering or HR leadership role, acting as a trusted executive business partner in a complex, international and matrix-based organization - ideally with 15+ years of relevant professional experience.

• Have a strong understanding of Manufacturing, Operations and Quality environments, including the people priorities associated with global, operational and potentially regulated settings.

• Have successfully led and developed HR teams across countries and cultures, creating clarity, trust, accountability and shared direction.

• Have experience working with or supporting organizations in APAC; this is a significant advantage given the role’s global scope and team presence in China and Malaysia.

• Combine strategic perspective with a pragmatic, hands-on approach and the ability to turn priorities into sustainable HR initiatives and measurable outcomes.

• Are an engaging and credible leader who builds strong relationships across the organization and takes a genuine interest in understanding the business and how value is created.

• Bring a transformation mindset, sound judgement and the confidence to challenge constructively when needed.

• Use data and insights to guide decisions.

• Communicate clearly and effectively in English.

The role is based in Ballerup, Denmark, and involves approximately 10–30 travel days per year.

At GN, we encourage flexible work whenever possible. We trust our people to fulfil their responsibilities, know when in-person collaboration creates the greatest value and are present when it matters most.

**We encourage you to apply

**Even if you don’t match all the above-mentioned skills, we welcome your application if you think you have transferable skills. We highly value a mindset and motivation that align with our core values, to not only ensure growth for you, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

**We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

**All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting the invitation to the interview.

**How to apply?

**Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than 30 November 2026. Applications are assessed continuously, so don’t wait to send yours.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV, including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.

**Join us in bringing people closer

**GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhances the senses of hearing and sight. We enable people with hearing loss to overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses, and provide great experiences for audio and gaming users.

GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

High-Tech Defence | Brand Building | Creative Execution | AI-Driven Marketing

Our Ambition is to not look like just another traditional defence company. We want a brand that reflects the future of defence technology: bold, innovative, technically credible, visually outstanding, and internationally recognized.

UMag Solutions is a fast-growing defence technology company developing advanced Quantum Magnetic Sensing payloads for autonomous systems for land- and naval mine detection and anti-submarine warfare. Our end-customers are typically within defence and governments around the world – both via B2B and B2G sales.

Today, we are a team of approximately 45 highly skilled professionals. Over the next three years, we expect to triple our organization and establish subsidiaries in key international markets. This growth requires a senior, creative, commercially minded, and hands-on Head of Marketing to build a distinctive international brand and strengthen how we communicate our technology, products, capabilities, and partnerships.

Our ambition is to create a modern, innovative, and visually outstanding defence technology brand that combines technical credibility with compelling storytelling and strong commercial impact.

Together with the existing marketing team, you will be responsible for developing our marketing strategy, brand identity, and creative execution across our website, social media, international exhibitions, product brochures, videos, presentations, and other marketing channels.

You will work closely with our Sales, Operations, Support & Logistics, and Technical Solutions & Partnerships teams, transforming their commercial insights, product demonstrations, and technical expertise into high-quality marketing material that supports business growth.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You know the craft and stay hands-on in the daily work. You bring in the right specialists to help, and you own the result. You are supported by the wider team and the existing marketing team.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Marketing Leadership & Execution

• Together with the CCO and marketing team, develop the company's marketing strategy, priorities, and activity plans.

• Lead and develop the existing junior marketing/business development colleague.

• Manage external designers, agencies, photographers, and other specialists when needed.

• Establish brand guidelines, marketing processes, and a structured content production pipeline.

• Manage the marketing budget and monitor the effectiveness of key activities.

• Remain actively involved in creative production and day-to-day execution.

2. Brand Development & Creative Direction

• Develop and continuously strengthen a distinctive, modern, and premium brand identity.

• Establish a consistent and recognizable visual expression across all marketing channels.

• Position the company as an innovative and credible player in the international defence technology industry.

• Develop creative campaigns, visual concepts, and storytelling that differentiate us from traditional defence companies.

• Ensure high-quality design, messaging, and communication across all external materials.

3. Content Creation & Technical Storytelling

• Translate sophisticated defence technologies into clear, compelling, and commercially relevant communication.

• Produce professional brochures, product sheets, presentations, technical illustrations, and marketing materials.

• Develop high-quality written content for websites, social media, press releases, and corporate communication.

• Create and edit videos, animations, and visual presentations of our products and capabilities.

• Work with technical specialists to ensure that all marketing content is accurate, credible, and appropriate for external release.

4. Website, Digital Marketing & Social Media

• Own and continuously improve the corporate website, including design, content, user experience, and product presentation.

• Develop engaging content for LinkedIn and other relevant digital channels.

• Create graphics, animations, videos, and digital campaigns that communicate our capabilities.

• Support search engine visibility, digital marketing activities, and performance tracking.

• Ensure our digital presence reflects our technology, ambition, and international positioning.

5. Trade Shows, Exhibitions & Events

• Take responsibility for the company's visual identity and marketing presence at international defence exhibitions.

• Develop innovative booth concepts, exhibition graphics, product videos, presentations, and promotional materials.

• Coordinate with Sales, Operations, and Technical Solutions & Partnerships to present a coherent and compelling company story.

• Support customer demonstrations, product showcases, and partner activities at exhibitions.

• Ensure that exhibitions strengthen brand recognition and support commercial objectives.

6. Commercial Marketing & Sales Support

• Work closely with the Sales team to understand customer needs, market opportunities, and commercial priorities.

• Develop compelling sales presentations, customer-specific materials, product brochures, and other sales-enablement tools.

• Support sales campaigns, product launches, customer visits, and strategic business development initiatives.

• Ensure that marketing activities support the sales pipeline and international growth objectives.

• Maintain consistency between external marketing messages and the company's commercial positioning.

7. Product Demonstrations & Operations Collaboration

• Collaborate closely with the Operations team, which is responsible for conducting product demonstrations and operational activities.

• Plan and coordinate the marketing aspects of demonstrations, including photography, video recording, visual content, and communication.

• Transform product demonstrations, field activities, and operational capabilities into engaging marketing stories.

• Develop demonstration videos, product showcases, and other materials that highlight the company's technology in real-world applications.

8. Technical Solutions & Strategic Partnerships

• Work closely with the Technical Solutions & Partnerships team as well as Product Managers to understand product capabilities, technical solutions, integrations, and new developments.

• Translate technical input into clear product messaging, illustrations, presentations, and marketing content.

• Develop marketing material highlighting collaborations and integrations with drone manufacturers, defence companies, and other technology partners.

• Support joint marketing initiatives, partner announcements, co-branded materials, and technology showcases.

• Ensure that technical claims, product specifications, and integration descriptions are validated by the relevant technical specialists.

• Help communicate the value of the company's broader technology ecosystem and strategic partnerships.

9. AI-Driven Marketing & Creative Production

• Actively use modern AI tools to accelerate and improve marketing production.

• Apply AI to graphic concepts, content creation, video production, presentations, and marketing workflows.

• Identify and implement tools that improve marketing quality, efficiency, and scalability.

• Combine AI-generated material with professional creative judgment and strong quality control.

• Ensure that all AI usage complies with company confidentiality, security, intellectual property, and information-handling requirements.

Your Profile

We are looking for a senior marketing leader with sound judgment, a sharp eye for quality, exceptional English, and a commercial mindset.

Essential Qualifications

• Exceptional English, written and spoken, at native or near-native level. All our external communication is in English, and you set the standard for it.

• Proven senior experience in marketing, branding, digital communication, or creative marketing leadership.

• Excellent graphic design skills and a strong eye for visual identity, layout, typography, and aesthetics.

• Hands-on experience producing websites, brochures, presentations, digital campaigns, and social media content.

• Experience with video production, editing, and visual storytelling.

• Strong practical proficiency with modern AI tools for marketing and creative production.

• Experience with creative tools such as Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma, Affinity, or equivalent software.

• Ability to understand complex technical products and communicate their value clearly.

• Strong collaboration skills and experience working across commercial and technical functions.

• Ability to combine strategic thinking with independent, hands-on execution.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in defence, aerospace, drones, robotics, advanced manufacturing, or other high-tech product industries.

• Experience with international B2B and B2G marketing and technical product marketing.

• Familiarity with motion graphics, 3D visualization, and technical animations.

• Experience developing marketing content from product demonstrations and real-world operational activities.

• Experience with partner marketing, technology ecosystems, and joint product announcements.

• Experience with international exhibitions and trade shows.

Personal Characteristics

• Creative: You know how to make sophisticated technology visually exciting.

• Hands-on: You enjoy producing high-quality material yourself.

• Commercially minded: You understand how marketing supports sales and business growth.

• Technically curious: You enjoy working with engineers, technical specialists, and operational teams.

• Collaborative: You can bring together people from different functions and turn their input into compelling communication.

• AI-driven: You actively explore and apply new technologies to improve marketing.

• Structured and proactive: You take ownership and deliver results.

• Ambitious: You want to help build an internationally recognized defence technology brand.

What We Offer

• The chance to help grow one of Denmark's leading defence companies.

• Significant creative freedom and responsibility.

• Close collaboration with Sales, Operations, engineering, and strategic partners.

• A steep but exciting learning curve in advanced technology and international defence.

• Real opportunities to develop, professionally and personally.

• Great colleagues across marketing, sales, engineering, and operations.

• A good working environment with short decision paths.

• An office in a creative environment, surrounded by nature, 20 minutes from central Copenhagen.

Why Join Us?

You will join a fast-moving and highly innovative tech company at a defining moment in its journey—from an innovative scale-up to an internationally recognized defence technology company backed by the Bridgepoint Group.

Apply

Please send your CV and application via the link "Apply" on this page as soon as possible.

Apply with QuickApply.

“You will build and lead the teams that give Danske Commodities data it can rely on, so our colleagues can stop second-guessing the numbers and spend their time on the work they love to do.”

Here’s what the job entails

As our Head of Enterprise Data & Insights, you will build, lead and grow Enterprise Business Intelligence and Master Data Management – two teams, one purpose: dependable figures and core data across Danske Commodities.

Working closely with Product Managers, architects, data owners and business colleagues, you will contribute to making our data consistent, reducing manual reconciliation and creating the foundation for scalable operations, analytics and AI.

More concretely, your areas of responsibility will include:

• building, leading and continuously developing the teams with full people responsibility

• fostering psychological safety and high team performance

• growing our master and reference data service, keeping core data matched, validated and consistent across our systems

• delivering trusted company figures to Finance, Risk and Controlling, grounded in definitions and quality standards agreed with the data’s business owners

• leading both teams to develop mature ways of working within our product operating model, applying agile principles to improve flow, and ensuring clear communication and transparent roadmaps so the internal product teams and back-office teams that depend on their services can plan and coordinate effectively

Meet your team

You will lead the Enterprise Business Intelligence and Master Data Management teams, part of our ETRM (Energy Trading and Risk Management) & Enterprise Solutions unit in Technology. They are newly established teams whose role is to make sure that the figures and core data used across Danske Commodities are consistent, certified and reusable – from the numbers Finance and Risk rely on to the shared data that connects our systems.

We are currently a team of two specialists in master data management, and your first step will be to fill the open positions in master data management and BI across the two teams.

But enough about us… over to you!

As you will be leading specialists across both business intelligence and master data in a business-critical area, we imagine that you are motivated by developing people and building autonomous, accountable teams where it is natural to speak up about ideas, concerns and mistakes. We also expect that you have strong stakeholder skills, as you will work with many colleagues who each own a piece of the puzzle – and you will need to influence, facilitate decisions and lead adoption across the organisation rather than decide alone.

Furthermore, we imagine that you:

• have leadership experience and thrive in a product-oriented organisation where technology and business work closely together

• have solid experience in business intelligence or master data management, with a working knowledge of the other

• bring depth in either semantic modelling and governed measures within business intelligence, or identifiers, authoritative sources and matching within master data management

• are experienced in partnering closely with data governance and management functions, putting agreed ownership, quality monitoring and traceability into daily practice

Please note that it is not a requirement to have prior knowledge of the energy industry to enter this role.

We’ll take good care of you

At Danske Commodities, we take great care of our people. Joining us means you’ll get a lot of great perks – including social events, cultural experiences, tasty food and benefits to better your health, your life and your future.

Here are some of the benefits we offer our employees:

Shape your development tailored growth plans, 100+ DC University courses & Harvard Learning access

100+ yearly events from office parties to DC Sports events, CS:GO team, student network & more

Global career paths as part of our parent company, Equinor’s 20,000-strong international network

Flexible work life adjustable hours, part-time options & up to 2 work from home days/week

Fuel Fridays one paid Friday off every month (July and December excluded)

Top-tier parental leave up to 26 weeks paid, pension during leave & post-leave support

Unlimited paid child's sick days because family comes first

Extra time off 5 additional days on top of your 5 weeks

Senior days extra time off if you’re 55+

Attractive package 10% pension, health insurance, bonus scheme & more

Share savings the option to join Equinor’s attractive share programme

Home setup covered paid internet, phone & IT gear

Free tickets & discounts culture, family fun, hotels, restaurants & more

Organic meals light breakfast, lunch, snacks, dinner & take-away

Barista café high-quality coffee, always on us

On-site wellness state-of-the-art gym, physio, chiro and massage therapy

HQ in the heart of Aarhus with stunning views, inspiring architecture and close to public transport

…. and much more

We're an energy trading and optimisation company that works at the intersection of technology and energy economics. Our disciplined and scalable trading strategies are designed to be competitive in volatile markets and create value for our partners.

Are you a strong leadership profile who can translate strategy into action plans, then you have the chance to become the Managing Director of Form & Frys.

Drive strategy, performance, and operational excellence across the organization

As Managing Director of Form & Frys, you will have full P&L responsibility and overall accountability for the strategic, commercial, operational, and organizational development of the company. Reporting to the Board of Directors of Rademaker, you will lead the business into its next phase of development, with a clear mandate to drive profitable growth, strengthen performance, and build a more scalable organization.

You will own the financial performance of the business, including revenue, profitability, budgeting, forecasting, and delivery against agreed targets and KPIs. Working closely with the leadership team, you will translate strategy into clear priorities and strengthen structures, processes, and leadership capabilities across sales, engineering, sourcing, manufacturing, finance, and people.

Commercially, you will strengthen relationships with key customers and strategic accounts while identifying new opportunities for growth. At the same time, you will work closely with Rademaker to leverage the capabilities and international reach of the wider organization, balancing Form & Frys’ entrepreneurial mindset, technical expertise, and customer proximity with the structure and strategic direction required for continued profitable growth.

Adept leader with technical abilities and a strong commercial mindset

The ideal candidate brings solid senior leadership experience from an international industrial or manufacturing environment, ideally within machinery, automation, food processing equipment, or another engineering-driven business. You have held full P&L responsibility and combine strong commercial acumen with a sound understanding of operations, technology, and financial management that enables you to make informed decisions that drive the company’s performance. Likewise, you have extensive experience in managing high-level, global stakeholders, paired with strong technical expertise.

You have a proven track record of developing and professionalizing organizations, translating strategy into execution, and driving profitable growth. Experience working with a parent company or professional Board is an advantage, as is exposure to international B2B markets.

You are a commercially minded and engaging leader who combines strategic perspective with a pragmatic, hands-on approach. You create direction, structure, and accountability while empowering the organization and leadership team to take ownership and deliver results. Entrepreneurial and decisive by nature, you are comfortable operating close to customers, employees, and the business while maintaining a broader strategic perspective. You build strong relationships across the organization and balance the need for greater structure and professionalization with the agility and entrepreneurial mindset that characterize Form & Frys. Furthermore, you are required to possess strong interpersonal and communication skills, as you will be collaborating across various functions and levels within the organization. Finally, fluency in both Danish and English is required, and you should be prepared to travel as necessary to meet the demands of this role.

Set and execute the strategic direction at Form & Frys

This is a unique opportunity to become part of a global organization, where management and professionalism are of the highest standards within the food processing industry. The recruitment process is carried out by Venaris Executive Search (www.venaris.dk). For more information regarding the position, please reach out to Sr. Executive Search Consultant Lars Nordlund on +45 3123 3018. All requests will be handled confidentially. If this position is for you, do not hesitate to apply by uploading your CV - it is not necessary to include a cover letter.

Form & Frys Maskinteknik

Form & Frys is a Danish engineering company specializing in the development and manufacture of advanced machinery for the international bakery industry. Based in Hobro, Denmark, the company provides specialized solutions for forming, folding, and filling dough-based products, including Danish and puff pastry, pizza, pies, and savoury products. Combining strong technical expertise, application know-how, and close customer collaboration, Form & Frys delivers both standardized machinery and customized solutions tailored to specific production requirements. Since 2025, Form & Frys has been part of Rademaker, strengthening the company’s international reach and creating a strong platform for continued development and growth. Learn more about this here: https://www.formfrys.dk/

**Hands-on Game Director for WHAT THE CAR?

**Do you love working in small, creative teams turning wild ideas into a reality? Do you thrive on community feedback? Could you ensure an already loved comedy game remains goofy in all the right ways? Awesome. We need to talk!

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

WHAT THE CAR? is our absurdly silly racing adventure game which addresses fundamental questions such as… What if a car had legs? Or a jetpack? Or secretly identified as a sailboat? First launched in 2023 on Apple Arcade and now also on Steam, it has gained a steady following of dedicated fans who have contributed hundreds of thousands of community-built levels.

We’re looking for a Game Director to grab the creative wheel (sorry) on a small but mighty team to help steer CAR into the future. You’ll guide decisions on which jokes are worth pursuing, how we maintain and push quality and which turns to take along the road. You'll work closely with studio creative leadership and external partners to help define the future of CAR and to explore opportunities to reach even bigger audiences.

If you’re already rethinking what a car is, keep reading!

**Here’s What You'll Do Day To Day

**

• Take product responsibility for WHAT THE CAR? and ensure that it remains true to and evolves upon the existing WHAT THE? universe

• Along with studio leadership, define the game’s ongoing vision, strategy and goals

• Effectively communicate the vision within the team to enable team and individual autonomy

• Work closely with the Producer and team to create achievable product roadmaps built upon a humanistic approach to production

• Contribute directly to project development, such as creating prototypes, implementing gameplay or building levels in-engine

• Facilitate team-wide creative processes which ensure all ideas have been heard and the best solutions are agreed and understood

• Ensure we maintain a high quality bar across the game, and help catch what’s not working before it ships

• Be part of nurturing a creative, inclusive, high performing, high trust team culture

• Immerse yourself in user feedback, turning what players tell us into decisions about where the game goes next

**You’re a great match if

**

• You bring 8+ years working in creative product lead roles

• You’ve worked on at least 3 commercial and shipped game projects

• You are extremely familiar with one or more commercial game engines, including Unity

• You're a born communicator and collaborator who enjoys working closely with every member of a team

• You understand and appreciate the WHAT THE? universe and are excited to be an integral part of its future

• You use AI to boost workflows and productivity, giving you more time to focus on the important creative decisions

• You prefer to “show don’t tell” by demonstrating ideas through prototypes over endless design discussions

• You have experience working on family-friendly titles for a casual audience

**Nice to have

**

• Experience coding in C#

• Experience with game design for a live game

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Product Marketing Manager

__

What we believe in:

At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges head-on. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are important drivers in our goal to enable everyone to create sustainable solutions. This is our story. Make it your story.

Role and tasks

As Associate Project Manager, you will take responsibility for smaller projects from planning through delivery and close-out. You will coordinate customers, colleagues, suppliers and other stakeholders to keep projects moving according to scope, schedule, quality and financial targets.

The role gives you direct responsibility for the full project process while working closely with experienced colleagues across sales, engineering, procurement and operations. It is a good opportunity to develop your project management experience while gradually handling increasingly complex activities.

Your responsibilities will include

• Plan, coordinate and follow up on projects, ensuring activities and milestones progress according to the agreed scope and schedule.

• Act as a key contact for customers and coordinate across internal teams, suppliers and other project stakeholders.

• Monitor project financials, including costs, invoicing, cash flow and resource utilization.

• Identify and follow up on project risks, opportunities and changes, escalating when needed and taking corrective action together with the relevant stakeholders.

• Coordinate procurement of services, materials and equipment and support dialogue with suppliers throughout project execution.

• Maintain project schedules, track progress and promptly address potential delays that could affect on-time delivery.

• Ensure required project documentation, contractual obligations, quality requirements and HSE standards are followed.

• Support project acceptance and close-out and capture relevant lessons learned for future projects.

Qualifications for the role

• 
A relevant technical or commercial education combined with an interest in project management and project execution.

• 
Some experience with project management, project coordination or similar work. We also welcome candidates who are still building their project management experience.

• 
Ability to plan and coordinate activities and follow them through together with colleagues, customers and suppliers.

• 
An understanding of basic project economics, schedules and risk management, or an interest in developing these skills.

• 
Comfortable communicating with different stakeholders and keeping relevant people informed when priorities, deadlines or project conditions change.

• 
Comfortable working in English.

More information

At ABB, we have a clear goal of promoting diversity and inclusion in terms of gender, LGBTQ+, disability, ethnicity, and age. Together, we have embarked on a journey where we all individually and collectively celebrate and welcome individual differences. You can look forward to joining an organization that emphasizes employee well-being. Collaboration and team spirit are key words for us and a crucial foundation for reaching our shared goals. We prioritize a good working environment highly and continuously invest in the education and development of you and your colleagues. If you want to read more about our continuous work with the working environment and sustainability, you can find more information at: https://global.abb/group/en/sustainability

You will be based at our office in Middelfart, alongside your closest colleagues. In addition, we offer the possibility of working from home a few days a week.

The position reports to Product Marketing Director Morten Hellesøe.

Apply for the job online via our simple and easily accessible system, where you can also sign up to receive notifications on other opportunities within ABB. If you have questions about the position before then, you are welcome to contact Morten Hellesøe at +4540278387.

The application deadline is 10.12.2026. We look forward to receiving your application.

Run What Runs the World.

Ready to make an impact?

Are you passionate about helping Commercial organizations get more value from their digital solutions? Do you enjoy combining hands-on technical work with CRM platforms, integrations, automation, and continuously exploring better ways of working?

You thrive in an entrepreneurial, informal, and open environment where innovation and change are key. You handle ambiguity well and employ a solution-oriented approach to generate new ways forward together with your team.

Join our Accounting team in Sweden as a dedicated and highly motivated Financial Controller. We pride ourselves on our inclusive and supporting culture, where diversity is celebrated, and every employee is empowered to contribute to our mission. Based in Vejle, Denmark, you’ll gain valuable insights into the value chain and organizational structure of Siemens Gamesa. Your expertise in financial processes will be crucial in supporting our mission to lead the change in renewable energy.

Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community. At Siemens Gamesa, we are constantly seeking talented individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Gamesa: https://www.siemens-energy.com/global/en/home/careers/working-with-us.html

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by multiple nationalities. • 
Opportunities to work with a global team

• 
Medical benefits

• 
Paid holidays and parental leave

• 
Employer-funded pension

• 
Subsidised lunch and more

**What Makes Us, Us

Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

To further support and drive this journey, we recently established a new Strategy & Execution team within the Product Development organization, which we are now expanding.

**

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible; we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. **Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer.
