**Job Description

**Capital is fundamental to a bank's resilience, profitability and ability to grow. In Capital Exposure Management, you will turn complex regulation, data and risk into clear insights that inform decisions at the heart of Danske Bank. This is a role where your analytical skills and regulatory knowledge translate directly into outcomes that matter.

**What You Will Be Doing

**You will join a skilled, international team of 16 colleagues across Denmark, Lithuania and Sweden. The team combines deep expertise with a supportive culture built on learning and continuous improvement. You will work closely with business, risk, finance and technology teams, providing analysis and recommendations to both business units and senior management on capital regulation and risk exposures.

More specifically, you will:

• Produce strategic insights on capital regulation, capital consumption and risk exposures

• Run, improve and control monthly capital and REA reporting processes

• Interpret regulatory requirements and support their practical implementation

• Perform ad hoc analyses and deliver clear recommendations to stakeholders and senior management

• Improve and automate processes using tools such as Python and SQL

**About You

**

• Strong knowledge in regulatory capital, credit risk models or process automation

• Ability to translate complex requirements into practical, workable solutions

• Self-directed and analytical approach, taking work from analysis through to implementation

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

• Experience with process optimisation and automation; Python and SQL are an advantage

• Master's degree in finance, mathematics, science, programming or a related field

• Professional proficiency in English

**What We Offer You

**You will be part of a dedicated team where collaboration and continuous learning are part of daily work. We operate in a hybrid model, with three to four days per week in the office to support knowledge sharing and team cohesion. You will have room to develop your analytical skills, deepen your understanding of capital management, and take on increasing responsibility over time. We welcome colleagues from all backgrounds and cultures.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**If this role sounds like the right fit for you, we would be glad to hear from you. For more information or an informal conversation, please reach out to Karin Vedel Acasio, Head of Capital Exposure Management, at aca@danskebank.dk.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible or by 23 November 2026 at the latest.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Do you want to build the operational backbone behind a new way of monetizing software - where pricing, product usage, data, and billing all need to connect seamlessly?

Trackunit is changing how we charge customers as we move from a traditional SaaS model towards more flexible, usage-based offerings. That means we need to connect a lot of moving parts: what customers use, how that usage is measured, what they have agreed to pay for, and what ultimately appears on their invoice.

As our Senior Monetization Operations Manager, you’ll help us make that entire flow work. You’ll build the processes and checks that help us catch errors early, keep our systems aligned, and give both customers and colleagues confidence that our billing is accurate.

This is a senior individual contributor role with a lot of ownership, but no formal people-management responsibility. You’ll work closely with colleagues across Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, Revenue & Billing and RevOps. Some of the foundations are still being built, so you won’t simply inherit a finished setup. You’ll have an important role in shaping how we work—and we hope that’s the kind of challenge you find energizing.

Trackunit is a fast-growing company and a leading supplier of IoT solutions, operating out of many offices worldwide. We create digital solutions that connect machines, people, and systems in the global construction industry, helping one of the world’s least digitalized industries become more connected, efficient, and productive.

With locations in Denmark, Germany and the Netherlands, we offer a flexible setup giving you the option to work from our hubs or remotely in these countries.

**What’s in it for you?

**

• A place in an agile growth SaaS business, with possibilities to grow internally in the company. We are moving quickly, so fasten your seat belt and prepare to adjust. Back in 2020 we were 150 employees at Trackunit and we have just passed 450 employees.

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and support them through training, coaching and mindfulness, alongside an open feedback culture that helps you identify your strengths and opportunities. We do this by focusing on your impact on yourself, your team, and the organization.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us. We believe you know how you work best. Once you've decided what works for you, we'll make sure you have the IT equipment and support you need.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. This priority starts with our hiring - we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We assess candidates solely on their qualifications and merit.

**Who are you ideally?

**We’re looking for a hands-on monetization operations expert who combines strong systems and data fluency with the ability to create structure across a complex, cross-functional environment.

**Ideally, You Bring

**

• Experience running or improving usage-based monetization operations, consumption platforms, metering, rating, or another environment where customer usage needs to be captured and processed accurately.

• The ability to follow data through several systems, spot when something doesn’t add up, and work out where the problem started - not just fix the final output.

• Experience setting up and testing products, price plans, usage rules, or similar configurations before they are released.

• A practical approach to processes and controls. You know how to make an operation reliable without creating unnecessary complexity or slowing everyone down.

• The confidence to bring Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, and commercial teams together when an issue crosses several areas - and to keep the work moving until the underlying cause has been resolved.

• Comfort working closely with both technical and commercial colleagues. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should be curious about how data and systems work and willing to get into the details.

• The judgment to spot risks, challenge unclear ownership, and set clear standards, even when you don’t formally manage the people involved.

• Experience with usage-metering or monetization platforms such as m3ter, Metronome, Amberflo, or similar would be a strong advantage. Familiarity with Salesforce, NetSuite, Databricks, or related systems would also be valuable, but we don’t expect you to know our exact technology stack from day one.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries - this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're excited about this opportunity and your experience doesn't perfectly match every qualification, we'd still love to hear from you.

**Primary Responsibilities

****In this role, you will:

**

• Build and improve the way we run monetization operations, including clear processes, responsibilities, checks, and ways to escalate issues.

• Make sure new products and pricing plans are set up, tested, approved, and released correctly in m3ter and our connected systems.

• Keep track of whether the full flow from customer usage to invoice is working as expected and make risks or gaps visible early.

• Put the right checks in place to identify missing, incorrect, or unusual data before it affects customer billing.

• Work with Finance and Revenue & Billing to make sure the data and documentation needed for invoicing, reconciliation, and audits are ready and reliable.

• Help turn agreed business and pricing rules into system configurations and practical ways of working.

• Lead investigations when usage, system configuration, or billing numbers don’t look right, bringing the relevant teams together to find and fix the underlying cause.

• Work with Product, Engineering, and Data to improve how usage is captured, moved between systems, and monitored.

• Create and maintain useful dashboards, instructions, control records, and documentation so people know what is happening and what to do when something goes wrong.

• Look for recurring problems and manual work that can be simplified or automated as the business grows.

• Help the Monetization Operations Specialist prioritize the right work and provide guidance on more complex issues, while working together as peers in the Monetization team.

**Our hiring process

**Don't waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that's not in the cover letter.

• Initial Interview conversation through zoom with a colleague from our People & Talent team to get to know each other better.

• Virtual meet and greet with the hiring manager and someone from the team.

• Assignment-specific interview. You'll receive a case study to prepare in advance and present to colleagues you'll work closely with in the role.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We're excited to welcome you to Trackunit!

**The question is: Are you in?

**

**Build full-stack AI agents for science, with freedom, room to be creative, and real ownership, in a lively startup in Copenhagen.

**An AI agent is only as useful to a scientist as the data it can see and trust. Dalea gives research labs structured data with full provenance, and we want AI co-scientists that do real scientific work on top of it. You'll own the AI side of that.

What you'll own

• The agent harness and the framework for AI co-scientist agents, from architecture to the workflows they run.

• Our MCP integrations, which give agents access to lab data with a traceable record of what they do.

• Model choices: following the field, testing new models against what labs actually need, and adopting what works.

• How we evaluate AI quality.

• The infrastructure the AI runs on: inference, model serving and agent execution.

• Full-stack work wherever the AI needs deeper integration with the platform, and help elsewhere when the team needs it.

What you bring

**Must-haves

**

• You've designed and built an LLM agent system used in production, and made the architecture decisions yourself.

• Strong full-stack TypeScript (React, Next.js or close equivalents), and you're comfortable in Python.

• You've owned the direction of a technical area, including a significant rework.

• You've shipped quickly in a small team or an early-stage product.

**Nice To Have (none Of Them Required)

**

• MCP servers or clients, agent frameworks or harness tooling (open source counts)

• Tools for scientists, or a background in bioinformatics, computational biology or AI for science

• Mastra or another TypeScript agent framework

• Open-weight models, through inference APIs or self-hosting

• Kubernetes

• Systems where provenance or audit trails matter

You don't need lab or biology knowledge, a PhD or Danish. Hands-on, shipped work counts more than research or publications. If you match the must-haves, apply, even if you have none of the nice-to-haves.

Our stack

TypeScript, Next.js and React. Python for our MCP service. An agent harness built on Mastra. Docker Compose and Kubernetes, hosted on Scaleway.

How we work

Our dev team is the two founders plus up to three new developers, led by our CTO. We discuss progress and priorities closely and continuously, and we expect you to take part: share ideas early, argue for what you think is right, and change course when the evidence says so.

You won't need permission to fix what's broken, and what you build reaches production quickly. We work together at BioInnovation Institute 3–5 days a week. We're building the team and the way we work, and that happens best in person.

**About Dalea

**Dalea is a data management platform for biology and lab workflows. Experiments, structured data, samples and inventory sit in one place, with full data provenance. Everything a lab builds in Dalea can be packaged and shared, so we're building a GitHub for life science: labs publish and reuse each other's workflows instead of rebuilding them from scratch. We work with biotech startups, academic labs, pharma R&D and CROs.

Timing and our funding round

This position depends on our current funding round closing, which we expect in February/March 2027. We can make a conditional offer before then, and we'll be open with you about the timing throughout the process.

What we offer

• Salary: DKK 725,000–900,000 per year, depending on experience

• Warrants: under the Danish

• 7P scheme

• Pension: through ASE

• Location: BioInnovation Institute, Copenhagen, on-site 3–5 days a week. You'll need to live in the Copenhagen area or be willing to move here. We're happy to hear from people relocating within the EU.

• Language: English

• Start: when the round closes

How to apply

Apply here with your LinkedIn profile, your CV and short answers to a few questions. No cover letter needed.

We're also hiring a Senior AI Engineer. You're welcome to apply for more than one.

jobs.occupation: Student Assistant – Range Golf Product & Business Development
jobs.description:
Are you a curious and analytical student looking to gain hands-on experience in product and business development? Would you like to contribute to innovative golf technology used by millions of players worldwide?

At Trackman, we are looking for a motivated Student Assistant to join our Range Golf Product & Business Development team. This is a great opportunity to gain practical experience in an international environment, work alongside experienced professionals, and contribute to the continued development of our golf technology solutions.

As a Student Assistant, you will support our Range Golf Product & Business Development team with a variety of analytical, commercial, and operational tasks. You will gain valuable insights into how product development, market research, and business strategy come together in a global technology company.

Your key responsibilities will include_:_

• 
Managing and maintaining Business Intelligence (BI) and CRM data to support market insights and competitor analysis.

• 
Conducting market research and gathering relevant insights to support product development and strategic decision-making.

• 
Developing and maintaining sales presentations and supporting materials for the Trackman Range Golf product portfolio.

• 
Supporting the Business Development and Sales teams in preparing and coordinating tender submissions.

• 
Assisting the Product team with various activities, ranging from team coordination to hands-on product testing.

• 
Collaborating with colleagues across Product and Business Development on ad hoc projects and tasks.

• 
Currently enrolled in a Master’s program in business administration, business management or similar

• 
Passionate about golf or sports innovation

• 
Analytical, curious, and eager to learn

• 
Comfortable working with data and structured problem solving

• 
Great at creating presentations decks

• 
A strong communicator who thrives in a collaborative environment

• 
Experience in a similar position is considered a plus but not mandatory

• 
Fluent in English

What We Offer

At Trackman, you will become part of an innovative and international company where technology, sports, and business come together.

We offer:

• 
The opportunity to gain hands-on experience in product and business development while studying.

• 
A collaborative working environment with highly skilled and passionate colleagues.

• 
The chance to contribute to products that make a real impact in the global golf industry.

• 
Exposure to some of the world's most advanced sports tracking technologies.

• 
An international workplace with more than 35 nationalities represented at our headquarters.

• 
A welcoming and social work environment with opportunities to learn, develop, and build your professional network.

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.

_Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant, or outsourcing company.

_Join a team of fintech heroes! 🚀

Performativ is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions operate. We are building a modern platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement, replacing fragmented systems, manual workflows, and technology built for another era.

Our customers include wealth managers, asset managers, family offices, and financial institutions across Europe and beyond. We are on an ambitious scaling journey, supported by leading global venture capital investors, and are working to become the platform on which modern wealth management runs.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com.

As our new Software Engineer, Reporting & Fee Management 📈

You will help build the products our customers use to communicate investment results and charge their clients.

Reporting and fee management look simple from the outside, but every wealth manager has its own data, calculations, presentation requirements, commercial agreements, and operating processes. Joining Performativ should not require customers to abandon what makes their business work.

Our direction is to turn these differences into flexible, reusable platform capabilities. This includes a new reporting workbench and AI-assisted experiences that allow users to configure, generate, and publish reports and fee arrangements safely themselves.

• You will build reporting and fee-management capabilities that turn complex portfolio data and customer requirements into accurate, understandable outputs.

• You will work closely with users and customer-facing colleagues to understand real workflows, challenge assumptions, and distinguish reusable product needs from one-off requests.

• You will help develop self-service configuration and AI-assisted workflows, with clear validation, permissions, review steps, and safeguards for untrusted input.

• You will investigate issues across data, calculations, configuration, and presentation, then deliver permanent solutions that are observable, testable, and safe to deploy.

• You will direct AI agents to produce much of the implementation, review their decisions and output critically, and leave systems in a state that teammates can understand and extend.

You should bring solid software-engineering judgment and an interest in developing product and financial-domain understanding. Experience with investment reporting, fee calculations, portfolio data, document generation, configurable workflows, or financial software would be valuable, but deep experience with our exact technology stack is not required.

We value your passion 🔥

At Performativ, we are builders first. We have ambitious goals and value the time, judgment, and effort people put into their work. You will be trusted to make your mark and help shape how we solve difficult problems.

We do not divide the platform into personal territories. People develop deeper context in different areas, but we solve problems as a team. We expect people to lead when appropriate, follow through on what they take on, contribute to the work of others, and help teammates succeed.

AI increases our delivery speed, but it does not reduce our engineering standard or our accountability for the result. You must be able to recognise incorrect assumptions, missing edge cases, weak product decisions, and unsafe production behaviour.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together primarily from our city-centre office, with flexibility to work from home when it makes sense. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

What we can offer you 🌱

• The opportunity to build products used directly by wealth managers and their clients.

• Difficult product and engineering problems involving financial data, calculations, configuration, document generation, and AI-assisted workflows.

• A central role in making complex reporting and fee management genuinely self-service.

• An ambitious, collaborative team with experience from leading technology companies, consultancies, and financial institutions.

• Strong opportunities for professional development as Performativ grows.

💰Salary based on your experience and seniority level: 🇩🇰Up to 48,000 DKK (gross)

**About Monta

**Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you’ll do well with us.

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully — and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people — sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You’ll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

We’re looking for a Mid Level Backend Engineer who’s ready to roll up their sleeves, take ownership, and build with us.

**This Is What You Will Achieve

**

• Power the #1 CPMS & EV charging Platform: Build the robust, scalable infrastructure necessary to make Monta the undisputed global leader in Charge Point Management Systems.

• Scale the Roaming Network: Strengthen our existing roaming functionality. Your work will directly impact how seamlessly thousands of EV drivers connect to charging points across different networks.

• Innovate on Standards: Implement exciting new features including the latest OCPI versions and Plug & Charge capabilities.

• Turn vision into reality: Balance technical ambition with sleeves-rolled-up execution to ensure our fleet and roaming offerings remain best-in-class.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Own the full lifecycle: Scope out requirements and plan new features in collaboration with the team, taking code from ideation to production.

• Cross-team execution: Work closely with Roaming Ops, Product, Frontend and other Backend teams to navigate ambiguity and ensure features integrate seamlessly.

• Ensure quality at speed: Perform automated validation and verification testing while supporting your teammates with thoughtful code reviews.

• Monitor and Maintain: Utilize tools like Grafana and Loki to monitor system health, ensuring reliability for the drivers who depend on us.

• Own outcomes in a high-trust environment where we value execution over perfection.

• Navigate ambiguity and shifting priorities keeping momentum when it matters most.

• Celebrate wins and learn fast from misses alongside an ambitious, diverse team.

• Push boundaries with courage and resilience while staying true to our DNA.

**A Brief Overview Of Our Tech Stack

**

• PHP/Laravel monolith

• Kotlin services with Micronaut and Exposed

• Dart/Flutter (incl. Flutter Web) for apps

• Typescript/React (+Next.js) for web apps and rapid prototyping

• Observability via Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenSearch/Kibana

• AWS + Kubernetes with Helm and Argo CD for deployments

What We’re Looking For

• Junior ready for the next jump or mid-level backend experience: You have experience building scalable backend systems.

• Tech Stack: You have worked in Kotlin (Micronaut) and PHP (Laravel), or have experience in one with the ability to quickly master the other in a mixed environment.

• Clear & pragmatic communicator who builds alignment fast.

• Authentic team player with empathy, openness, and ownership.

• Comfortable with AI-powered tools to accelerate your work (Claude, Gemini, Codex, etc.), with the willingness to learn more.

_If the mission excites you but your experience isn’t a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway - we care about potential, not perfection.

_**AI Competency

**You’ll be expected to work with AI-powered tools. Some we use:

• GitHub Copilot / Claude Code

• ChatGPT / Gemini / Claude

• Notion AI (docs, knowledge, meeting notes)

• AI-enhanced testing & monitoring (e.g., generative QA, Grafana ML)

_We don’t expect mastery of all, but we expect comfort with learning, experimenting, and adopting AI responsibly.

_Why Monta

• Ownership from day one — we don’t micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• Becoming number one is not easy — priorities shift, and flexibility is sometimes needed to get things across the finish line. But so are the rewards: impact, growth, and a team that has your back.

• The people are extraordinary — talented, driven, and fun to work with. You’ll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure

**What We Offer

**

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life’s big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you’re at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

**Please send us your application in English.

**To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you’ll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don’t accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won’t agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

**In this Senior Partner Manager role, you’ll be…

**

• Accountable for driving regional growth across the Danish market by facilitating end-to-end sales cycles (from lead to closed-won) in close collaboration with an enterprise-grade partner ecosystem and an internal team of experienced Account Executives.

• A strategic partner builder and commercial lighthouse, establishing executive-level relationships with directors at top audit firms, consultancies, and legal specialists, alongside leading solution-oriented direct selling.

• Driving revenue impact through dual channels, taking ownership of direct pipeline while co-designing structured partner motions (onboarding, enablement, deal support) to hit both direct and partner-sourced targets.

• Manage large partner-related projects, in close collaboration with internal product experts, Marketing, Sales Enablement and Revenue Operations.

• A trusted domain advisor and cross-functional collaborator, enabling partners and prospects on complex frameworks (NIS2, DORA, ISO 27001, GDPR) while staying closely aligned with the regional strategies in coordination with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Leadership.

**Who is the Partner Management Team?

**The Partner Management Team is instrumental in strengthening Formalize’s partner-led go-to-market strategy as we build the leading European platform for Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC). Focused on the Nordic region, we build, structure, and scale enterprise-grade ecosystems across audit firms, advisory consultancies, legal specialists, and boutique partners.

We don't do transactional channel management - we drive strategic, revenue-relevant alignment. By connecting partner- and director-level stakeholders externally with our internal Sales, Product, and Leadership teams, we build pipeline, deep credibility, and long-term value in an increasingly complex market of regulations, standards and resilience best practices.

**What you’ll bring:

**

• Proven expertise in strategic partnerships, alliances, or enterprise business development, ideally within B2B SaaS, advisory, compliance, cybersecurity or regulated industries.

• Proven experience collaborating with enterprise consulting, legal advisory or audit partners (experience with Big-4 or equivalent strongly preferred).

• Deep understanding of compliance, risk, audit, and regulatory buying centers, or a proven ability to quickly adapt on knowledge gaps.

• Commercial mindset with proven experience owning or materially influencing revenue outcomes (previous direct sales experience, e.g., as an AE, is a big plus).

• Professional fluency in Danish, and the ability to work in an English-first team, to communicate value and negotiate seamlessly with customers and colleagues.

• Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to act as a trusted advisor when engaging with senior partner- and director-level decision-makers.

• Experience using a SaaS-typical tech stack of Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, HubSpot, along with various AI tools, is a strong plus, but not a requirement.

**We offer you:

**

• The On-Target-Earnings (OTE) for this role will be between DKK 52,353 and DKK 68,334, with the base salary portion being between DKK 44,500 to DKK 51,250, with the exact placement in the range based on experience level.

• Uncapped commission scheme - there is no ceiling on what you can earn if you outperform.

• Continuous development through a clear and transparent career framework, so you always know what the next step looks like through biannual growth talks and regular check-ins.

• Thorough pre-boarding and onboarding to set you up for success.

• An office-first culture in central Copenhagen (Kødbyen), with benefits including lunch, health insurance, and social events.

• A culture of ownership, trust, and independence with the support you need.

• A strong team spirit where we celebrate wins and enjoy time together across offices.

• Our annual Global Summit, where the whole company connects over strategic achievements and projects.

**Our recruitment process:

**

• Send your application and upload relevant information.

• 30-minute online interview with our Talent Acquisition team.

• 60-minute online interview with our Hiring Manager.

• Complete a personality assessment and prepare a case presentation.

• 60 minutes in-person case presentation interview with our Hiring Manager & other relevant stakeholders.

**About Formalize:

**Formalize is a tech company founded in 2021 with offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Milan, Munich, Madrid and Paris. Currently, we are a team of 200+ people from 30+ nationalities operating in multiple European markets and are one of the fastest growing SaaS scale-ups. We thrive on ambition, deliver impact through pragmatism, and embrace passion and honesty. We are celebrating our wins, learning from our mistakes, and growing together as a team.

Our journey began within the whistleblowing compliance sector, highlighted by the award-winning Whistleblower Software by Formalize, laying the foundation of our success story. Now, we have extended our expertise to a larger compliance universe, including data compliance, risk, and privacy. Our Formalize product helps companies to effortlessly navigate and stay ahead in the ever-changing landscape of compliance. Our platform adapts to regulatory changes, continuously adapting to meet and foresee the evolving needs of our users, ensuring businesses remain compliant and confident in their operations.

Still curious? Read more about us here: About Formalize.

**Ready to apply?

**We will hold interviews and hire on an ongoing basis. For more information or questions, please contact the responsible recruiter in the Talent Acquisition team. Apply now with your resume and other relevant information in English through our Career Page. We look forward to seeing your application!

Why this role exists

Tech-first. Ego-free. User-obsessed. Over a million Danes use Skatteguiden to understand and optimise their taxes: automating tax tracking, surfacing deductions people didn't know they had, and connecting directly to the Danish tax authority to do it. We're an independent, profitable, 50-person company in central Copenhagen with a 4.7-star rating and one mission: make financial insight accessible to everyone, not just those who can afford an accountant.

None of that works without data people can trust. Our platform runs on Snowflake, Dagster and dbt, and we're investing further in it. We're looking for a data engineer who wants to own it: build it, run it and keep improving it, from infrastructure and ingestion down to the SQL.

If you're ready for the step up to senior and want a platform that's yours to own, not one you build and hand over, this is it.

The team works in English, so Danish isn't required. We're together in our Copenhagen office five days a week, with flexibility for the odd day at home when life calls for it.

What you'll be working on

• Ingestion, end to end. Get data from our source systems into Snowflake, and work with our product and platform teams on data contracts so pipelines hold up as those systems change.

• Orchestration in Dagster. Scheduling, dependencies, monitoring and recovering when things fail.

• Infrastructure as code. Snowflake environments, access and cost, managed in Terraform.

• dbt models and dbt Cloud. Turn raw data into well-tested data products, and run the environments, jobs and deployments behind them.

• How we use AI in the data stack. Help decide where it earns its place, and build it.

• Better practices. Testing, CI/CD, semantic modelling and performance on Snowflake.

• Over time, exposure to Java and our event-driven architecture.

What you bring

• 3+ years building data pipelines or data platforms.

• Hands-on experience with Snowflake and dbt, ideally in your current role.

• You've owned ingestion end to end, including the messy parts: source quirks, backfills, schema drift. You're more at home on the ingestion and platform side than in analytics and dashboards.

• Java or another OOP language, and event-driven architecture.

• Independent and profitable. No investor KPIs or heavy hierarchy; we answer to our users.

• A great spot in Copenhagen. Five minutes from Rådhuspladsen, lunch from Claus Meyer, and dinner covered when the day runs long.

Practical

• Location: Central Copenhagen, on-site five days a week

• Language: English (Danish not required)

• Salary: DKK 45,000–55,000 per month

• Pension: No employer-paid pension

• Start: As soon as possible

• Reports to: Head of Data & Operations Planning

Hiring process

• 1-hour on-site case session with the hiring manager and a team member.

• 30-minute on-site meet-and-greet with our CEO.

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professors in Electronic Systems (with the possibility of tenure-track)
jobs.description:
At the Technical Faculty of IT and Design, Department of Electronic Systems, one or more positions as Assistant Professor in Electronic Systems are open for appointments from June 1, 2027, or soon after. The positions are available for a period of 4 years (with the possibility of tenure-track). The positions are with the department's research groups located at the university campus in Copenhagen.

Your profile and work tasks

We seek to appoint one or more Assistant Professors (with the possibility of Tenure-Track) to conduct research, teaching, and knowledge exchange, and to grow and develop the department's research activities within our subject fields.

The positions require internationally recognized research experience within one or more of the following areas:

• Cyber security

• Privacy engineering

• Computer Systems

• Edge/cloud computing

• High-Performance Computing (HPC)

• Data Engineering

• Big Data Infrastructure

• Machine Learning Systems

The main tasks and responsibilities include:

• developing a research profile and providing valuable contributions to science.

• providing research-based teaching and supervision within at least one subject area.

• participating in grant application activities

• coordinating own projects and contributing to an active academic environment

Your competencies

You have an interest in collaborating with external partners and experience from participating in grant applications. You have also contributed to workplace well-being, collaboration, equal treatment, diversity, and a good working environment.

Selected candidates should demonstrate development potential in science and have peer-reviewed publications in recognized journals and books or anthologies. Under the leadership of others, you can plan and carry out individual teaching and supervision activities with a focus on the students' learning.

Who we are

In electronic engineering, Aalborg University is known worldwide for its high academic quality and societal impact. The Department of Electronic Systems employs more than 200 people, of which about 90 are PhD students, and about 40 % of all employees are internationals. In total, it has more than 700 students in its BSc and MSc programs, which are based on AAU's problem-based learning model.

The department leverages its unique research infrastructure and lab facilities to conduct world-leading fundamental and applied research within communication, networks, control systems, AI, sound, cyber security, and robotics. The department plays an active role in transferring inventions and results into applications in close collaboration with industrial partners worldwide.

The department places significant emphasis on supporting early career researchers and provides comprehensive career and personal development programmes, specifically designed to assist individual academics in achieving their professional objectives.

You can read more about the department at www.es.aau.dk.

Qualification requirements

Appointment as Assistant Professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

**Tenure-track

**When appointing tenure track assistant professors, Aalborg University also place particular emphasis on:

• The candidate can demonstrate a high degree of autonomy in their previous education and employment path

• The candidate shows considerable potential and is among the best in their field

• The candidate has academic experience from several universities and/or research institutions and preferably international experience

• The candidate is a skilled communicator

• The candidate writes and speaks English at the academic level

• The candidate is expected to meet the criteria for permanent employment as an associate professor at Aalborg University at the end of the tenure track process

Evaluation and promotion proces:

• Annual internal follow-ups to review progress on the promotion plan and ensure the assistant professor remains on track.

• A mid-term evaluation, based on external review, conducted by an internal assessment committee after three years.

• A final review by an external committee after 5.5 years. A positive outcome leads to a tenured appointment as Associate Professor.

• Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorship

**Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorship

**The assessment in connection with transition to tenure as an associate professor normally takes place in the final six months of the tenure track assistant professors’ employment. However, the employee may request that an assessment take place at an earlier time in the first four years. If this assessment finds that the employee is not academically qualified, they may request another assessment within the final six months of their period of employment. A maximum of two assessments may take place.

The assessment, on transition to the associate professorship, will as a minimum, emphasize the following qualifications in relation to the scientific subject area of the tenure track assistant professorship:

• Research qualifications equivalent to the level that can be achieved on the basis of satisfactorily completed employment as tenure track assistant professor.

• Documented scientific production at international level. Assessment will be based on up to ten selected publications selected by the employee.

• Documentation of pedagogical supervision and upgrading of qualifications, including a positive written assessment of teaching qualifications. The assessment will also be based on the employee's teaching portfolio.

• The level of contribution to an active academic environment as well as the ability to collaborate and build relationships.

• The level of experience with grant proposals and experience of communicating research to relevant stakeholders.

If the tenure track assistant professor fails to request that their qualifications be assessed in the last year of their period of employment or if they are assessed as not academically qualified, the university must immediately initiate dismissal proceedings in accordance with the collective agreement rules.

How to apply

Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position

• Curriculum Vitae (CV)

• Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma)

• List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications.

• Documentation of teaching qualifications. Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design. If this is not enclosed, the applicant must enclose the reasons for this .

• Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc.

• Additional qualifications in relation to the position

• References/recommendations

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

 Further information

Read more about our recruitment process here

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Salary and terms of employment  The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Tenure track assistant professor/Tenure track researcher”.

jobs.occupation: Research Assistant in Explainable and Causality Informed Reinforcement Learning (DEIS)
jobs.description:
We invite applications for a full-time, one-year position as Research Assistant in the Section of Distributed, Embedded and Intelligent Systems (DEIS), Department of Computer Science, Aalborg University. The position focuses on developing reinforcement learning methods that produce understandable control strategies and provide insight into the underlying system dynamics and causal relationships. The research will address safe and effective control of cyber-physical systems, with particular emphasis on UPPAAL Stratego and collaboration with domain experts and external partners.

Expected starting date: 01.12.2026.

Your work tasks

You will develop and evaluate methods for explainable and causality informed reinforcement learning. The aim is to make learned strategies transparent to human domain experts, support well-founded trust in their decisions, and improve understanding of hidden dynamics and causal relationships in the systems being controlled. Your tasks will include:

• Developing compact, interpretable representations of learned control strategies, including strategy minimisation with guaranteed preservation of safety properties.

• Investigating how causal information can inform reinforcement learning and help explain the behaviour and decisions of learned strategies.

• Working with reinforcement learning and recurrent neural networks in UPPAAL Stratego, including implementation and experimental evaluation.

• Applying and evaluating the methods on safety-critical cyber-physical systems, with relevant case studies in water and wastewater infrastructure.

• Collaborating with DEIS researchers, the UPPAAL development team and external partners, and contributing to scientific publications and dissemination.

The work builds on DEIS research in safe reinforcement learning and practical experience with UPPAAL Stratego for modelling and optimal control of wastewater infrastructure, including collaboration with HOFOR continuing the DIREC Bridge project Verifiable and Safe AI.

Your competencies

You should have a strong background in reinforcement learning and machine learning, solid programming skills, and experience implementing and evaluating research methods. Knowledge of explainable AI, causal reasoning, recurrent neural networks, or interpretable policy representations is particularly relevant. Experience with UPPAAL or UPPAAL Stratego, formal verification, and modelling and control of cyber-physical systems is an advantage. You should be able to work independently, collaborate with researchers and domain experts, and communicate research clearly in English.

Qualification requirements

Appointment as a research assistant requires academic qualifications at master’s degree level. A relevant degree in computer science or a closely related discipline is expected.

Who we are

You will join Section DEIS at the Department of Computer Science, Aalborg University. The position brings together research in formal methods, machine learning and cyber-physical systems, with opportunities to contribute to the UPPAAL tool suite and its applications.

You will collaborate closely with development teams to ensure reliable software functionality in our hearing solutions. You will specify and verify embedded software tests, with a particular focus on test automation and the development of tools and test systems for firmware testing.

**Welcome to GN Hearing!

****The Team You Will Be Part Of

**At GN Hearing, we combine scientific research with deep expertise in advanced hearing aids and accessories.

You will join Test Development, a team of 11 developers working closely with our Agile teams. Together, we develop, specify and verify features and integrated product platforms to ensure robust software functionality in new devices and products.

We promote a collaborative environment where colleagues share knowledge, take ownership and continuously improve how we work.

**Your Contribution Is Appreciated, And You Will

**

• Specify, plan, execute and evaluate embedded software tests, and communicate findings clearly to development teams

• Verify the behaviour of signal processing algorithms, wireless protocols and operating systems

• Review software requirements and design documentation to support testable, reliable solutions

• Follow up on test results and provide clear reporting and input to developers

• Contribute to compliance with internal requirements, relevant standards and regulations

• Develop and improve test automation, tools and test environments for firmware testing

• Collaborate with Agile teams to improve testing processes and support effective software delivery

**To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:

**

• Bring an educational background in computer science, engineering or a related field

• Have experience with software testing, verification and test automation using C#, or another object-oriented programming language

• Bring a structured and proactive approach to planning work, following through on activities and improving ways of working

We pride ourselves on encouraging flexible work whenever possible. We trust our people to fulfill their responsibilities, to know when in-person collaboration is better than hybrid, and to be present when it's needed most.

Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV, including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying.

**Join us in bringing people closer

Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhances the senses of hearing and sight. We enable people with hearing loss to overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses, and provide great experiences for audio and gaming users.

GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Photonic Integrated Circuits for Next-Generation LiDAR - DTU Electro
jobs.description:
Help turn advanced photonic chip designs into advanced 3D sensing technology.

Are you interested in integrated photonics, optical sensing, and chip design? Join NiteLiDAR, an EU-funded Doctoral Network, and develop integrated LiDAR technology through a PhD spanning simulation, chip design, nanofabrication and experimental demonstration.

You will be working at DTU Electro, in the Photonic Integrated Circuit based Systems (PICSys) group. The setting will be the cutting-edge laboratory for photonic integrated devices and advanced optical systems, and the access to one of the largest cleanroom facilities in European Universities. You will be working with a group of professionals in photonic integrated devices, optical phased array, LiDAR, optical communications, optical computing, and FPGA hardware programming. 

You will join an international team of 10 PhD researchers working on photonic and electronic integrated circuits for next-generation LiDAR. The network brings together three universities, an international R&D organization, and a company, with partners across four EU countries. Your project includes one year of research at IMEC, giving you the opportunity to work across academic and industrial research environments.

Responsibilities and qualifications
Your goal will be to design and experimentally investigate a photonic integrated chip for LiDAR, with a focus on frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) ranging and optical phased array (OPA) beam steering.

You will follow the development process from defining system requirements to measuring chip performance and reconstructing 3D scenes. Your work will include:

• Exploring system architectures: Define specifications, review state-of-the-art approaches, and identify promising on-chip implementations.
• Assessing system performance: Calculate optical link budgets in collaboration with another doctoral researcher.
• Modelling photonic components: Simulate key building blocks, including OPAs and grating couplers, on silicon nitride (SiN) and silicon-on-insulator (SOI) platforms.
• Designing a LiDAR chip: Develop the chip design and layout in close collaboration with researchers across the network.
• Nanofabrication of LiDAR chips using DTU Nanolab cleanroom. 
• Demonstrating sensing capabilities: Characterize the OPA’s far-field performance, conduct ranging experiments, and reconstruct 3D point clouds from measured data.
• Supervise BSc and MSc student projects.
• Data analysis, writing of scientific articles and presentations at conferences and meetings.
• Participate in outreach activities including, but not limited to, social media updates, participation in public events and campaigns, as well as dissemination to popular press.
We welcome applicants with a background in photonics, electrical engineering, applied physics, or a closely related discipline, and a strong interest in connecting theoretical concepts with practical experiments.

Experience in optical modelling, numerical simulation, cleanroom fabrication, photonic integrated circuits, or experimental optics would be valuable. Curiosity, self-motivation, analytical thinking, and enthusiasm for collaborating in an international research team are central to this project. Excellent English communication skills both spoken and written. Candidates with a strong background in integrated photonics, silicon photonics, or nanophotonics are preferred. 

Due to the mobility rules of the Marie Skłodowska-Curie program, you must not have resided or carried out your main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Denmark for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before the recruitment date.

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

Assessment
The assessment of the applicants will be made by Senior Researcher Hao Hu at DTU Electro and Marcus Dahlem at IMEC.

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures. 

The period of employment is 3 years. Starting date is 1 February 2027 (or according to mutual agreement). The position is a full-time position.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information
Further information may be obtained from Dr. Hao Hu, huhao@dtu.dk. 

You can read more about DTU Electro at www.electro.dtu.dk.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 20 December 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
• A mandatory research statement discussing your comprehension or achievements in photonic integrated circuits for LiDAR, including an analysis of the opportunities, challenges, obstacles, etc. You are more than welcome to include your research results and justify how the results could contribute to this research field, if any. Maximum 2 pages.
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

The recruitment is taking place following the European Code of Conduct for Recruitment of Researchers, which all candidates are encouraged to study.

Selection process
To ensure a gender balance in the project and work towards the Commission’s own policies on narrowing the gap between the genders in research, should two applicants be found to be equally qualified the preference will be given to the one that will balance the gender distribution in the entire Network. After the deadline, all submitted applications will be checked against the defined admissibility and eligibility criteria (e.g. submitted electronically, readable, complete, in English, including grades and references), and applicants will be informed by email within two work weeks on the outcome. The following interviews and selection process will be carried out by a temporary Selection Committee constituted by the Coordinator (when possible) and the supervisors. Evaluation criteria include: Scientific background, capacity for creativity and independent thinking and leadership, mentoring and presentation abilities.

Protection of personal data: The personal data of the applicants will be handled in compliance with applicable EU and national law on data protection (GDPR). 

DTU Electro 
DTU Electro employs more than 300 skilled researchers with competencies in electrical and photonics engineering. As a department, we strive towards creating sustainable energy and a greener internet, as well as strengthening cyber security and health technology. Working with industry and public organizations is one of our top priorities to find and implement new solutions to our society. We aim to offer education, research, and innovation of the highest standard, and our focus on application-oriented research enables us to work across many engineering disciplines and research areas, such as IT and the medical and health sciences. We have a close collaboration with researchers from all over the world, just as we collaborate with industry and public authorities about the dissemination of solutions based on electrical and photonics engineering as their key enabling technologies. 

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

**What You Will Do. A Glimpse Into Your Role

**

**Governance & Compliance

**

**Every action has an impact. You will make a difference here if:

**Stillingsbeskrivelse

**_We are looking for a driven Business Controller with a strong motivation for FP&A to join Netcompany DK. You are either a recent graduate or have 1–3 years of experience, and you will play a central role in ensuring timely and accurate management reporting, as well as in-depth analyses of our business and financial KPIs. You will become part of a dynamic team where collaboration across departments and with different stakeholders is a natural part of everyday life.

_**Your Responsibilities

**You will become part of a well-functioning and collaborative team where you will have plenty of opportunities to share ideas, learn from colleagues, and grow professionally. Working closely with the Head of Finance NBS and DK, you will take ownership of key aspects of the monthly financial reporting to management. This includes following up on our business areas and preparing presentations.

In addition to being responsible for your own areas, you will have a broad range of stakeholders, where collaboration with the other Shared Services departments in the business is an important part of the role. The position will give you unique insight into the financial value drivers of the company and an understanding of the financial parameters that drive a business.

**Your Responsibilites Will Typically Include

**

• Conducting business analyses

• Comment on monthly reports for your areas of responsibility

• Contributing to the continuous improvement of the monthly reporting process

• Participating with your own areas of responsibility in the development of our system structure

• Actively participating in the budgeting and forecasting processes

**About You

**As a person, you are motivated by working with both complex and operational tasks, and you possess the ability to communicate across the organization. You have a proactive mindset and strong business acumen, combined with excellent analytical skills. You take initiative, identify opportunities for improvement, and are motivated by contributing to the development of the organization. With a keen eye for detail and a strong focus on quality, you take pride in delivering accurate results and meeting deadlines in a structured and reliable manner.

**

• Have experience working in Excel and processing large volumes of data.

**At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

**Send us your application

**Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

_All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!

Our growing sales organisation is compensated through commission, and our Global Sales Planning & Compensation team structures those plans, sets sales targets, and ensures every salesperson worldwide is paid accurately and on time. Acting as the company’s behavioural economists, we partner with commercial leadership to analyse how incentives drive revenue growth, which gives us an inside view across the entire sales journey, from revenue planning to performance and pay.

We are looking for a Student Assistant to join our Global Sales Planning & Compensation team in Copenhagen, reporting to the Sales Compensation Manager. This is a hands-on, part-time role with hours planned flexibly around your studies and exam periods. From day one, you will take ownership of real processes that directly impact how colleagues are paid and how leadership tracks performance, working across Sales, Finance, and HR in Denmark, the UK, and the US.

To thrive in this role, you bring strong analytical instincts, a sharp eye for detail, and genuine curiosity about how incentives shape commercial behaviour. Experience with Salesforce, Forma, or similar business tools is a plus, but not required.

What you’ll be doing:

• Support the monthly and quarterly commission cycle to ensure accurate, on-time global payouts.

• Investigate and resolve commission questions from sales colleagues, explaining data outcomes clearly.

• Upload and reconcile sales targets across our systems and help prepare and launch commission plans.

• Run recurring reports and build leadership presentation packs that turn numbers into actionable insights.

• Coordinate administration for our sales recognition programmes.

• Help develop our commission system (Forma), build controls, and document repeatable standard operating procedures while working across Forma, Salesforce, and Sage.

• Collaborate with colleagues in the UK and US across Commercial, Revenue Operations, FP&A, Payroll, Accounting, and HR.

Who you are:

• In the final year of a Bachelor's degree, or early in a Master's, in finance, economics, or a related field.

• Skilled in Excel or Google Sheets (lookups, pivot tables, and clean, structured models) with a strong interest in numbers and data.

• Analytical, detail-oriented and proactive, you catch anomalies in data and spot ways to improve processes.

• Commercially curious and eager to learn how sales compensation and incentives drive revenue in a global tech company.

• A clear, concise communicator who handles confidential pay and performance data with care.

• Collaborative, fluent in English, and able to work regularly from our Copenhagen office.

What’s in it for you:

• 
Learn how sales compensation works in a global technology company, from plan design to payout, and how commercial leaders use incentives to influence behaviour and reach revenue goals.

• 
Hands-on experience in a function that connects Sales, Finance and HR.

• 
Ownership of real processes that directly affect how our sales colleagues are paid.

• 
Flexible hours that fit around your studies and exam periods.

• 
A strong foundation for a career in finance, commercial operations or reward.

• 
Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist

• 
Central office with  a laid-back vibe and constant buzz of different languages being spoken everywhere you go It’s complete with a coffee bar, canteen, and table tennis and has a wide variety of refreshments available - you can opt-in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price

Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, Trustie Community activities, and team socials

jobs.description:
Transformational Change Manager | Financial Services | Copenhagen, Denmark

Are you ready to lead teams and drive impactful change at scale for financial services clients? Are you passionate about helping organizations successfully navigate transformation, and do you bring both strategic vision and hands-on delivery experience? Then the role of Transformational Change Manager in Copenhagen is your next career move. Let’s build the future of work—together.

About the Team and the Role

As a Manager within our Talent team, based in Copenhagen, Denmark, you will take ownership of end-to-end project delivery, client relationships, and account management, with financial services as your primary industry focus. You will guide teams in co-creating and implementing human-centered transformation strategies, develop change approaches that are agile and ready for the digital world, and ensure the realization of measurable business outcomes.

You will work primarily with leading financial services clients, including banks, insurance providers, and capital markets firms, partnering with them on digital, technology-driven, and organizational transformations. You will be part of multidisciplinary teams delivering large, complex programs, working closely with client teams and international colleagues to solve challenging organizational problems, lead key workstreams, guide junior colleagues, and deliver specific project outcomes. Explore our point of view and Talent offering here.

The Work

• Lead Transformation Journeys – Help financial services clients navigate complex transformations, building organizations that are more capable, resilient, and adaptable to redirection and ambiguity.

• Human-Centered Change Strategies – Translate strategic direction and business objectives into holistic, agile change strategies that address culture, ways of working, and readiness for the future.

• Deep Change Management Expertise – Drive leadership alignment to the change vision, activate change using insight-driven approaches leveraging AI, engage large-scale change networks, and prepare organizations for business readiness, technology adoption, and new ways of working.

• Workforce Reinvention – Shape organization design, reskilling, and upskilling strategies for new operating models (e.g., S/4HANA, GBS, human-agentic workforce) and prepare the workforce for emerging roles.

• Technology Enablement – Unlock the human potential of new technologies through enterprise-wide system implementations, digital learning platforms, and AI-enabled change activation.

• Data-Driven Insights – Use analytics and predictive tools to measure adoption, sentiment, and transformation impact.

• Stakeholder Engagement & Account Management – Build trusted relationships with C-level executives and client teams in financial services, oversee account health, and proactively identify opportunities to expand our footprint.

• Business Development – Build trusted client relationships, identifying new growth opportunities, supporting business development activities, and shaping go-to-market strategies.

You will also:

• Lead workstreams and coach junior colleagues, bringing together cross-functional teams and specialists.

• Collaborate with Financial Services clients, the Netherlands & Nordics Talent practice and Accenture’s international network of experts.

• Balance changing priorities and timelines while keeping delivery focused on practical, measurable outcomes.

• Contribute to an inclusive, supportive team culture and continue developing your expertise in Change & Transformation Management.

About You

You bring a background in management consulting, organizational change or business transformation, with experience delivering people-centered change in complex, technology-enabled programs. You understand the opportunities and challenges facing banks, insurers and capital markets firms as they modernize systems, redesign operating models and introduce new ways of working. Your project experience may include roles such as Change Manager, Transformation Lead, Organizational Change Lead, Change and Communications Lead or Business Project Manager.

You are passionate about the people side of transformation and about turning strategic ambitions into meaningful, measurable change. You can align leaders around a shared vision, engage stakeholders and change networks, and shape communication, training and adoption activities that help people embrace new technologies, processes and behaviors. You use data and feedback to assess readiness, measure adoption and improve your approach iteratively.

You are comfortable leading workstreams and multidisciplinary teams in fast-paced, complex environments, combining strategic thinking with hands-on delivery. You build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, coach junior colleagues and solve problems in a people-oriented, insight-driven way. Most importantly, you are a collaborative colleague who helps teams navigate uncertainty and achieve outcomes together.

Requirements

• 
5+ years of relevant experience in organizational change, future workforce and/ or Human Resources; for example, guiding organizations in their transformation journey, designing and implementing large-scale communication and training programs, or upskill leaders to carry out desired behaviors.

• 
Management consulting experience or experience working within Financial Services, is a plus, not a prerequisite

• 
Strong consulting skills and the ability to engage senior business and HR stakeholders

• 
Strong self-leadership, with experience leading workstreams, collaborating in teams and coaching junior colleagues

• 
Understanding of organizational change and transformation components and complexicty, preferably within financial services and knowledge of banking, insurance, or capital markets transformation challenges

• 
A commercial mindset, the ability to build trusted client networks and a focus on measurable business and workforce outcomes

• 
Experience collaborating with cross-functional project teams in a global environment

• 
Professional proficiency in English; Danish language skills is an advantage for local client engagement, but not a requirement

• 
Track record as people-oriented, insight driven and iterative problem solver

• 
A master’s degree in a relevant field, such as business, engineering, or behavioral and social sciences

What We Offer

• Membership in our growing Netherlands & Nordics Talent team, with access to a global network of experts at the forefront of talent reinvention

• The opportunity to shape your career around your aspirations, with regular support from your People Lead

• A competitive salary, bonus schemes, health insurance, an employee share purchase program, and other benefits

• A strong commitment to employee well-being and work-life balance, including flexible arrangements that support family life, mental health, and well-being

• A supportive, encouraging and fun team who always roots for one another

• Market-leading expertise, a steep learning curve and great opportunities for development

• Opportunities to participate in corporate citizenship initiatives, including volunteering, charity work, and Inclusion & Diversity networks

Ready to Apply?

We would be delighted to hear from you. Please apply online and attach your CV and cover letter.

We are looking for exceptional people to help Accenture create lasting, positive change for our clients, our people, and our communities.

We believe that delivering value requires innovation, and innovation thrives in an inclusive and diverse environment. We actively foster a workplace free from bias, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and is respected and empowered to do their best work.

About the job

Marine International Service Engineer

• 
Kolding

• 
Søborg
