At Continia, we value diversity and encourage authenticity. We are team players who respect each other’s thoughts and ideas, and we expect everyone to take ownership of their work. We focus on personal and professional development to grow internally within our organization.

In our day-to-day work, we are pragmatic and result-oriented, and we aim to stay entrepreneurial by keeping things simple and focusing on our employees. We celebrate our wins and releases and aim to have one major event each year where all employees meet up in one place.

We recognize that time is what matters most. Continia solutions give customers more time every day to work and live. That’s why “It’s About Time” is our motto. Our success is built on partnering with more than 1,800 reselling partners, serving more than 20,000 customers worldwide.

jobs.occupation: Director, Team Lead Late-Stage CMC Project Management
jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

At Genmab, we’re committed to building extra[not]ordinary futures together, by developing antibody products and pioneering, knock-your-socks-off therapies that change the lives of patients and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. From our people who are caring, candid, and impact-driven to our business, which is innovative and rooted in science, we believe that being proudly unique, determined to be our best, and authentic is essential to fulfilling our purpose.

**The Role and Department

**The Late Stage CMC Project organization is growing and we are looking for 2 Directors to lead and develop a team of Project Managers in Genmab’s late-stage CMC project organization.

The roles have similar responsibility and you will combine people leadership with strategic oversight and hands-on responsibility for complex CMC programs, including contribution to governance of outsourced activities with contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs).

Both postions report to the Senior Director, Head of the Late-Stage Project Management Office, within Genmab Tech Ops in Denmark. Working closely with CMC, Regulatory Affairs, Quality and Supply Chain, you will align CMC delivery with development priorities and drive progress towards regulatory submission and commercial readiness.

You will help shape the late-stage project organization, develop experienced Project Managers and translate portfolio priorities into clear decisions and reliable delivery.

**Responsibilities

**Team leadership and development

• Lead and develop your team through resource planning, recruitment, performance management and succession planning, building capabilities for current and future portfolio needs

• Coach Project Managers in strategic thinking, cross-functional leadership and resolving complex CMC challenges. Set clear expectations, delegate effectively and build accountability for results

• Work closely with the Senior Director to prioritize resources and budgets across the team’s programs, resolve capacity constraints and align delivery with portfolio objectives

CMC strategy and project responsibilities

• Shape CMC strategies with technical and functional leads, aligned with overall Drug Development Plans. Lead assigned programs through integrated planning, budget analysis and management of cross-program dependencies.

• Drive cross-functional delivery of technology transfer, process validation, manufacturing readiness and submission documentation, with clear ownership and adherence to Genmab’s quality system and applicable regulatory requirements

• Ensure reliable plans, risk and decision logs, and executive reporting. Anticipate portfolio impacts, resolve high-impact issues and facilitate data-driven options and recommendations to senior governance forums

• Lead improvements to the Project Manual, governance and ways of working, including digital and AI-enabled tools that strengthen planning, risk management and delivery

**CDMO collaboration and project governance

**

• Representing Late Stage CMC Project Management in CDMO joint project and steering committees, facilitating strategic discussions and decisions within delegated authority. Ensure decisions translate into clear commitments and follow-through

• Shape outsourcing and partnership strategies with relevant functions, aligning proposals, contracts and quality agreements with program objectives, business needs and intellectual property considerations

• Hold partners accountable for agreed scope, quality, timelines and budgets. Build transparent relationships, resolve vendor conflicts and escalate strategic trade-offs and risks with clear recommendations

**Requirements

**

• Master’s degree or higher in natural sciences, pharmacy, engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience

• Extensive biopharmaceutical CMC experience, including late-stage biologics development and progression towards commercial supply. Experience with antibody-drug conjugates is an advantage

• Proven experience shaping strategies and leading complex global CMC programs, including portfolio prioritization, strategic budget management and cross-functional risk resolution

• Established people-leadership experience, with a track record of developing Project Managers, building team capabilities and supporting talent and succession planning

• Strong understanding of technology transfer, process validation, submission strategies and the interdependencies between development, manufacturing and supply

• Experience shaping outsourcing strategies, leading CDMO governance and resolving complex partner issues with sound business judgment

• Advanced knowledge of GMP and global CMC regulatory expectations, including those relevant to FDA, EMA and NMPA submissions

• Excellent English communication skills, with a track record of influencing senior stakeholders and translating complex issues into clear business recommendations.

**About You

**You combine strategic perspective with the judgment to know when to engage directly and when to empower others. You develop people, set clear priorities and make well-founded decisions under uncertainty, balancing quality, timelines and cost.

You build trust across functions and cultures, challenge assumptions constructively and create an inclusive environment where colleagues take ownership. You champion a ONE-Team approach, welcome feedback and turn lessons learned into improvements across the project organization.

**Location and Travel

**The role is based in Denmark. Travel is expected to be approximately 10–15 days per year.

Genmab leverages the effectiveness of an agile working environment, when possible, for the betterment of employee work-life balance. Our offices are designed as open, community-based spaces that work to connect our employees. Whether you’re in one of our collaboratively designed office spaces or working remotely, we thrive on connecting with each other to innovate.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK883.200,00---1.324.800,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Do you have experience developing medical devices? Would you like to be part of developing innovative products that make a meaningful difference to patients, while applying your skills in a global MedTech company that is helping shape the future of endoscopy?

Then your next career move could be as a Systems Engineer with Ambu.

**Be a Key Player in Engineering & Imaging

**In this exciting role, you will be a key contributor within our R&D organization and a leading technical member of a product development project. You will play a central role in shaping and delivering innovative endoscopy solutions, directly contributing to Ambu’s future success and to improved outcomes for patients and healthcare professionals.

As part of this position, you will join a team responsible for developing a go-to-market solution that introduces new product features AI capabilities to our existing portfolio of display units. This will enable us to gain valuable experience with AI-enabled solutions while preparing for the development of our next-generation display unit. The solution will support our current portfolio of endoscopy products while also laying the foundation for future platforms, capabilities, and product offerings.

You will be part of our Global Systems Engineering department and report to the Systems Engineering Team Manager. The position is based at our headquarter in Ballerup, Denmark, where you will join a collaborative, professional, and globally connected team.

We foster a strong culture of innovation, with a clear focus on fast time-to-market while remaining deeply committed to developing the right products to meet customer and user needs, ultimately improving patient care. This requires the ability to navigate complex medical device development and bring different technologies, disciplines, and perspectives together into coherent product solutions.

You will join a truly global Systems Engineering team of 22 highly skilled and motivated colleagues based across different locations. The team is part of Engineering & Imaging within our R&D organization and brings together a diverse mix of backgrounds, perspectives, and expertise. What really stands out is the team’s strong collaborative spirit and proven track record of successfully bringing Ambu’s innovative products to market, making it a great environment in which to learn, grow, and contribute.

**Global, User-Driven Innovation: From Idea to Launch

**As a Systems Engineer, you will hold the overall technical view of the product and help subject matter experts, project team members, and other stakeholders understand each other and work effectively together.

You will be leading technical alignment and discussions in the project team to find the right solution , helping drive and maintain the overall technical solution and ensuring coherence across the different technologies and disciplines involved. You will navigate technical trade-offs, facilitate decisions, and ensure that the product solution remains aligned with user needs, business objectives, regulatory requirements, and the overall system architecture.

You will create, facilitate, and review key product development documentation, including requirements, design inputs, design outputs, and technical reviews. You enjoy working in cross-functional project teams, finding pragmatic solutions to complex technical challenges, and ensuring an appropriate level of documentation and technical rigor.

You will be involved throughout the product development lifecycle, from early scope investigation and concept development through design, integration, verification and validation, and ultimately market launch.

We work in a hybrid setup, typically with minimum three days on-site in Ballerup, providing flexibility while maintaining strong team connections.

**Your Responsibilities

**

• Define, plan, document, and technically manage product development activities within the project to ensure the product is delivered in accordance with the defined design objectives and development plan.

• Identify and understand stakeholder and user needs through engagement with key stakeholders and users.

• Analyze and decompose user needs, business needs, and system requirements into clear and actionable product and development requirements.

• Leading technical alignment and discussions with the Project Manager and relevant Line Managers.

• Ensure alignment with product and technology architectures and promote the appropriate reuse of existing design solutions across the R&D organization.

• Investigate and scope new product concepts and solutions within existing or new clinical areas, building on Ambu’s technologies and capabilities.

• Establish and maintain the overall technical overview of the product, including system interfaces, dependencies, and trade-offs between technologies and design solutions.

• Ensure development, documentation, verification, and testing activities are performed in accordance with applicable FDA, ISO, IEC, and internal quality requirements.

Your stakeholder base will be broad, and you will collaborate across Ambu’s global organization, with functions involved throughout product development, as well as externally with users, knowledge centers, technical partners, and suppliers.

Our production sites are located in Malaysia, China, the USA, and Mexico, and we collaborate with KOLs and development centers across Europe, Asia, and the US. Some travel should therefore be expected, approximately 20 days per year.

**Suggested Candidate Profile

**Setting you up for success is one of our cornerstones. We imagine that you are proactive, driven, committed, and comfortable taking responsibility and ownership. You are thorough and quality-minded, with strong interpersonal skills and good situational awareness, enabling you to work effectively in cross-functional and global teams.

**Skills

**Skills and experience can be gained in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for a role cannot always be defined on paper. That said, you are likely to thrive in this role if you bring:

• A degree or professional background in electrical engineering, mechatronics, mechanical engineering, biomedical engineering, or a similar technical field, together with relevant hands-on product development experience.

• Experience developing medical devices, including working with design control and requirements in a regulated environment, or comparable experience from another highly regulated industry.

• Experience in cross-functional product development involving hardware, electronics, mechanics, and software, ideally within medical devices or a related engineering or consultancy environment.

• A strong systems engineering mindset combined with a practical approach to developing robust and reliable product solutions.

• The ability to work independently, take ownership, and remain pragmatic and solution-oriented while actively sharing knowledge and collaborating within a global team.

• Experience working with an OEM, contract manufacturer, or external development partner would be an advantage.

• A solid understanding of relevant standards for medical electrical equipment, such as IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-2-18, and ISO 80601-2-18, and experience translating regulatory and standards requirements into practical product development activities would also be an advantage

As Ambu is a global company, it is important that you communicate fluently in English. Only applications submitted in English will be considered.

**How To Apply

**We invite candidates for interviews on a continuous basis, so please do not hesitate to apply via our career site at ambu.com.

Your application will be treated confidentially.

_Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant, or outsourcing company.

_Join a team of fintech heroes! 🚀

Performativ is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions operate. We are building a modern platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement, replacing fragmented systems, manual workflows, and technology built for another era.

Our platform depends on accurate and timely data from custodians, banks, brokers, and other financial institutions. These connections provide the positions, transactions, cash movements, instruments, and corporate actions used throughout the investment-management lifecycle.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com.

As our new Software Engineer, Investment Data Integrations 📈

You will help build and operate the systems that connect Performativ with custodians and other providers of investment data.

The immediate challenge is practical: we need to deliver a growing number of integrations while maintaining the existing portfolio and resolving real production issues. The longer-term challenge is to avoid a scaling trap where every new institution requires another collection of manual processes and bespoke code.

We are building a more automated integration platform with reusable pipelines, mappings, reconciliation, quality controls, and AI-assisted development. Your work will contribute both to integrations customers need now and to the foundations that let the team deliver future integrations faster and more safely.

• You will develop and maintain integrations covering positions, transactions, cash, instruments, prices, corporate actions, and other investment data across files, APIs, SFTP, and message-based interfaces.

• You will build reusable ingestion, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and monitoring capabilities instead of treating each provider as an isolated implementation.

• You will investigate complex data and production issues across internal systems, external providers, and customer environments, then deliver permanent fixes that prevent known classes of problems from recurring.

• You will work closely with users, operations specialists, and other engineers to understand the complete workflow and ensure that integrated data is correct and useful throughout the platform.

• You will direct AI agents to produce much of the implementation, review their assumptions and output critically, and establish the tests, controls, and evidence required for safe deployment.

You should bring strong backend or data-engineering judgment and experience with production systems where correctness and reliability matter. Experience with financial integrations, investment data, reconciliation, ETL pipelines, APIs, structured files, or regulated systems would be valuable. Familiarity with technologies such as Python, Golang, PHP, TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, AWS, and CI/CD tooling is useful, but experience with our exact stack is not essential.

We value your passion 🔥

At Performativ, we are builders first. We have ambitious goals and value the time, judgment, and effort people put into their work. You will be trusted to make your mark and help shape how we solve difficult problems.

We do not divide the platform into personal territories. People develop deeper context in different areas, but we solve problems as a team. We expect people to lead when appropriate, follow through on what they take on, contribute to the work of others, and help teammates succeed.

AI can help us understand formats, generate mappings, develop implementations, and test integrations faster. It does not replace financial-domain understanding, careful validation, or accountability for the resulting data.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together primarily from our city-centre office, with flexibility to work from home when it makes sense. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

What we can offer you 🌱

• Work on integrations at the centre of a production wealth-management platform.

• Solve difficult problems involving financial data, external systems, reconciliation, reliability, and operational workflows.

• Help create an AI-assisted approach to developing and maintaining integrations safely at scale.

• An ambitious, collaborative team with experience from leading technology companies, consultancies, and financial institutions.

• Strong opportunities to deepen both your engineering capabilities and your understanding of investment management.

As Accounting Manager at Netcompany Denmark and Netcompany Banking Services, you are responsible for accounting topics such as annual reports, IFRS, tax, VAT and the audit process. You report to the Head of Finance for Denmark and Banking Services and support in leading and developing the team.

Netcompany DK and NBS are part of the wider Netcompany Group. While Group Finance defines the finance framework, standards, and processes, you are responsible for translating these into the local context and supporting the Danish business in making informed financial and strategic decisions.

You will work closely with the local Finance leadership team, Group Finance and your fellow Accounting managers across the Netcompany Group. We are ambitious in how we develop our Finance organisation and actively embrace new technology and ways of working.

Your Responsibilities Will Typically Include

• Take end-to-end responsibility for financial reporting, annual accounts, IFRS, tax and VAT, management reporting, commercial finance and KPI forecasting.

• Act as a trusted team member in Denmark and Banking Services Finance leadership team, supporting both day-to-day decision making and the achievement of long-term ambitions.

• Translate Group Finance frameworks, standards and ambitions into the local Danish context, and make sure they are implemented well across the organisation.

• Help continue the process of creating a culture focused on quality, ownership, collaboration and continuous development.

• Support the continued development and adoption of AI-enabled tools and ways of working across Finance, actively contributing to our ambition to build a more digital, automated and insight-driven finance function.

About You

• You hold a relevant master's degree in finance, accounting, economics or a comparable field.

• 3–6 years of experience in accounting, audit or a similar field.

• Proven experience working with IFRS standards and financial compliance and reporting requirements.

• Strong analytical and business-related problem-solving skills, with the ability to solve complicated financial tasks.

• Structured and reliable approach to delivering high-quality results with attention to detail and within deadlines.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, and a real interest in developing people as well as delivering results yourself.

To Succeed In This Role, You

• Provide the Danish and Banking Services with clear and reliable insights that support both short- and long-term decision making.

• Ensure accurate, timely and compliant financial reporting across the Danish and Banking Services organization.

• Successfully translate Group Finance Accounting standards and ambitions into effective local processes and ways of working.

• Identify opportunities to improve financial performance, processes and reporting, and turn these into tangible results.

• Successfully contribute to the transition towards our new Finance system landscape, including our bespoke AI-driven Finance application.

Join an inclusive community At Netcompany, we highly prioritize an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

Send us an application Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

About MicroTech Software

MicroTech is a small software company with more than 35 years of experience building custom solutions in close dialogue with our customers, mainly in banking and insurance. Since 2025, applying AI has been a major focus for us.

We value quality over quantity, and we keep the customer experience at the centre. Expect great colleagues and a busy but relaxed workday in an informal atmosphere. We also care about ESG and like to give back, for example through sponsorships and by being an inclusive workplace that welcomes employees who need special accommodations.

About the role

You’ll help shape the architecture of a live AI product running on our own on-prem LLM stack.

Two big projects are coming up, and you’ll play a key part in both:

• Voice-to-workflow: making speech a first-class input channel in our agentic workflows

• Moving to a graph architecture: going from RAG to GraphRAG by building a knowledge graph and integrating it into our existing pipeline

Responsibilities

Shape the architecture of a live AI product

• Evaluate and challenge design decisions across the stack, including retrieval strategies, LLM backend selection, service boundaries and data flow, and propose improvements with clear reasoning

• Take part in technical planning with the team and with insurance-domain stakeholders, turning vague requirements into concrete engineering tasks

• Identify technical debt, assess its cost and make the case for addressing it

Develop and optimize our on-prem AI stack

• Further develop and optimize our self-hosted LLM stack: local models, local embedding and on-prem vector stores

• Evaluate open-weight LLMs for Danish-language RAG quality, weighing latency, accuracy and hardware requirements

Move to a graph architecture (RAG → GraphRAG)

• Help design and build a knowledge graph for our domain, including ontology and knowledge extraction

• Integrate the knowledge graph into our existing RAG pipeline and measure the effect on retrieval quality

Design and build agentic workflows

• Design multi-step agent architectures using LangGraph or equivalent frameworks that can route, plan, use tools and synthesize across document corpora

• Define tool-use interfaces, memory patterns and failure-handling strategies for agent loops running in production

• Work with domain experts to identify automation opportunities worth building

Enable voice-to-workflow capabilities

• Help design a pipeline that integrates local speech-to-text models into agentic workflows

• Evaluate Danish-language ASR quality, identify gaps and assess whether fine-tuning or model selection is the better approach

• Design the integration points carefully, with attention to latency, error handling and data privacy, so voice becomes a first-class input channel

Requirements

• 2–4 years of production Python engineering experience, including async code, clean architecture patterns and testable codebases

• Direct experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain or similar) in a shipped product or serious project

• Solid understanding of RAG systems: chunking strategies, embedding models, vector search and retrieval quality evaluation

• Familiarity with vector databases such as pgvector, Chroma, Weaviate or Pinecone

• Comfortable owning a FastAPI service end-to-end: schema design, error handling, auth,

• containerization and deployment

• Ability to reason about architectural trade-offs and communicate them clearly

• Hands-on experience designing or running local LLM inference (Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp) in a real rather than toy context

Nice to have

• Familiarity with knowledge graphs, including ontology building, knowledge extraction and RAG integration (especially relevant)

• Speech-to-text pipeline work (Whisper, Deepgram, Speechmatics or comparable local STT), especially on non-English languages (especially relevant)

• Experience with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI) or custom tool-use and planning loops in production

• Hybrid retrieval systems (dense + sparse, BM25 + vector) and re-ranking with cross-encoders

• LLM observability and tracing tools (Arize Phoenix, LangSmith or similar)

• Multilingual NLP, particularly Danish or other Nordic languages

• Knowledge of regulated-industry data handling, GDPR or EU AI Act compliance

• Cloud platforms (e.g. Azure), container registries and CI/CD

What we offer

• Beautiful offices: art on the walls, plenty of green plants and high ceilings

• Great location: bus, train and light rail right outside the door, easy to reach by car, and free parking

• Flexible work: a hybrid setup with the option to work from home up to around 2 days a week after the initial onboarding

• Small organisation: very short decision-making processes and great opportunities for co-responsibility

• Personal development: varied tasks, direct client contact and support for further education

• All phases: you’ll work on everything from definition and solution design to programming and production

• Competitive salary: an attractive compensation package that matches your skills

Please note

• Start date: as soon as possible. We’ll still take the time to find the right person, so we review applications on an ongoing basis and will keep the position open until it’s filled.

• This is a hybrid role based at our office in Viby J., Aarhus. It is not a remote position.

• We cannot offer work permit sponsorship or relocation support. Applicants must already have the right to work in Denmark.

jobs.occupation: Production Workers Wanted for Food Production in Nordhavn

Washing dishes and cleaning production equipment.

• 
Preparing ingredients and raw materials for cooking.

• 
Packing and wrapping finished food products.

General duties within the production area.

• 
Is willing to work hands-on and take responsibility.

• 
Is flexible and comfortable with different tasks.

• 
Can work independently as well as part of a team.

Working hours and salary

Shape the future of customer engagement at LEO Pharma — from global design to local impact.

Join us in creating a future legacy in medical dermatology. At LEO Pharma, we are global leaders in medical dermatology, with 115 years of experience bringing innovation to healthcare.

In Global Customer Engagement Platforms & Excellence, we partner across the business to drive customer engagement excellence – empowering global and local teams to execute with impact. We are guided by simplification, collaboration, and accountability. Now, as we embark on a global Customer Engagement Platform implementation affecting around 1500 users across 30+ markets. We are preparing to launch a transformation project and are expanding the team with 2 permanent and 3 temporary Senior Global Business Process Owner roles, who will help define how customer engagement works across LEO — and make it simpler, smarter, and more scalable.

Your role

You will be the business authority for customer engagement processes within your portfolio. You will be the business voice that connects commercial needs with technical delivery - translating needs into process design, requirements, governance, and adoption. You will work closely with global and local stakeholders – bringing deep respect for the knowledge of people living the day-to-day reality – while driving towards global standards that create value for LEO, our customers, and ultimately patients. When decisions are needed for the greater good of LEO and the patients we serve – you drive them through. Global IT and external partners build to your specifications.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Designing and governing scalable customer engagement processes across global and local markets.

• Facilitating cross-functional workshops and driving alignment across Business Units, Commercial Excellence, Medical Affairs, Digital Engagement, and regional teams – and representing your portfolio credibly to senior stakeholders.

• Translating business needs into process flows, user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria with Global IT and external partners.

• Making process design decisions within your portfolio – proceeding when alignment is reached, escalating when it’s not.

• Setting global standards, enabling train-the-trainer models, and ensuring platforms and processes are adopted successfully.

• Owning and prioritising the improvement pipeline, including business cases, benefits, adoption metrics, and continuous optimisation.

You may work across areas such as segmentation, targeting, territory planning, field execution, omnichannel journey enablement (process design, platform configuration and data flow – engagement model and channel strategy are owned by Digital Engagement), Key Account Management, event management, field coaching, analytics, and AI-enabled customer engagement insights.

When you apply, indicate which areas are your primary strength and where you have secondary experience.

Your qualifications

We imagine that you bring solid business process ownership experience from pharmaceutical or life sciences commercial operations. You understand how global platforms support local execution, and you know how to turn ambiguity into clear, practical decisions that move the business forward.

We are especially looking for:

• Extensive experience in business process design and optimisation within pharma or life sciences commercial operations.

• Experience with CRM platforms such as Veeva CRM, Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud, or equivalent.

• Proven ability to apply Lean, value stream mapping , Gemba, or similar improvement methods.

• Experience translating business needs into requirements, acceptance criteria, and delivery input for IT or external partners.

• Solid facilitation experience in global, multi-market, and cross-functional environments.

• Strong communication and presentation skills – able to articulate process rationale and build confidence with senior stakeholders.

Experience with CRM transformations, Agile delivery, business case development, pharma compliance processes, data governance, change management, or train-the-trainer models will be an advantage.

As a person, you are collaborative and curious – you genuinely want to understand how people work and what markets need. But you are not consensus-dependent: when the time comes, you decide. You have backbone, think in systems, and create clarity for others rather than accumulating decisions. You communicate in ways that enable others to self-serve, and you default to progress over perfection. You bring a structured approach to solving problems - untangling complexity rather than adding to it.

What success looks like

• Business teams experience you as a trusted partner — someone who makes their work easier through well-designed processes.

• Your processes are adopted and continuously improving — delivering measurable value, not gathering dust.

• Global standards are self-sustaining — through train-the-trainer and local enablement rather than central enforcement.

• You make decisions confidently within your portfolio — creating clarity rather than accumulating decisions.

• The customer experience improves because the processes you govern make it easier for LEO to engage healthcare professionals consistently and at scale.

Your new team

You will join Global Customer Engagement Platforms & Excellence in Ballerup, Denmark. We are a global team working at the intersection of business process, customer engagement, commercial excellence, and platform governance. Together, we partner with markets, functions, Global IT, and external implementation partners to create processes that are adopted, valuable, and built to scale.

A note from the hiring manager

I'm building a team that partners with the business and owns the outcome — not one that waits to be told what to do. A global Customer Engagement Platform implementation is kicking off imminently — and this role will be central to shaping it from the start.

I believe in partnership as the work, real ownership within clear guardrails, and progress over perfection. You are not a requirements scribe passing notes to IT — you shape how processes should work, and IT builds to that specification. If you can walk me through how you've used structured methods to align people and improve something real, I'd like to hear from you.

The opportunity comes with visibility to executive level.

Contact and application

For additional information, please contact Lisa Munkvold, Head of Global Customer Engagement Platforms, LIMUN@LEO-Pharma.com

You do not need to upload a cover letter, but feel free to add a few sentences in your resume or CV on why this position has your interest and which of the process areas above are your primary strength.

Beyond the skin

Join LEO Pharma, a global leader in medical dermatology, as we go beyond the skin to make a lasting impact. Our innovative approach sets us apart. We are dedicated to leaving a legacy that positively impacts patients, colleagues, and our planet.

At LEO Pharma, we believe in the power of individuals to drive change. Our flat organizational structure empowers you to make a visible impact and offers versatile roles for professional growth. We value diversity and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, recognizing that our different perspectives, backgrounds, and attitudes enable us to make the best decisions. Join our passionate team at LEO Pharma and be yourself as we work together to make a difference.

For certain positions, LEO Pharma might complete a background check conducted by a third party.

**In this Head of Employee Experience role, you'll be…

**

• Setting the vision and one roadmap for our Employee Experience across the employee journey, so colleagues experience one Formalize in every office and every new country.

• Building a scalable, intuitive model where people, systems, processes, IT and offices simply work, so day-to-day operations run smoothly on their own, freeing up your team to give personal, high-touch support when it matters most

• Setting up one front door for every question on people, workplace and IT, with one ticketing system and a shared knowledge base, solving most questions through self-serve and the rest first time.

• Leading a team of around ten across People Operations, Workplace and Internal IT with clear ownership, and making your team's time here a real springboard for their HR careers.

• Owning workplace standards, vendors and budgets, and opening new offices on time and on budget from one playbook.

• Working with our People Business Partners and Talent Acquisition on journeys that cross teams, such as onboarding and country launches.

****Who is the Employee Experience team?

****Employee Experience is the team that treats our colleagues like our best customers. We bring People Operations, Workplace, and Internal IT together under one roof because a great workday relies on all three: a contract and conversations that make sense, an office where we celebrate wins together, and a laptop that works from hour one.

Within People Operations, a back office sets standards, systems and automation, while People Operations Partners in the front office are the daily face for colleagues. Our People Business Partners, focused on managers and leaders, work closely with us.

Our principle is high touch where it matters, effortless everywhere else, with one front door for every question and the ambition that colleagues hardly need us.

**What you bring

**

• Proven leadership experience across the broader employee experience spectrum, combining People Operations with workplace and internal IT, ideally in a scaling international tech company.

• A builder's instinct. Your energy comes from systems, standards and support models that work every day. Events and celebrations matter but aren't the core, so if confetti is what drives you, this probably isn't your role.

• You think in models, linking the structural basis to the human interaction it enables, and you know where high personal-touch adds value and where good design does the job better.

• Strong on digital: people systems, automation and AI are how the team scales, and you're comfortable owning tooling decisions and the budget behind them.

• A strong sense of fairness and consistency, with standards explicit enough to guide people rather than slow them down.

• A hands-on leader who builds teams across disciplines and grows people into bigger roles.

• Clear communication in English, the credibility to partner effectively with our leadership team, and the ability to work from our Copenhagen office (or Aarhus).

**What do we offer you?

**

• A monthly salary ranging from 65,000 to 70,000 DKK.

• Continuous development through a clear and transparent career framework, so you always know what the next step looks like, with biannual growth talks and regular check-ins.

• Thorough pre- and onboarding to set you up for success.

• A culture of ownership, trust and independence, with the support you need.

• An office-first culture in a central location in Copenhagen or Aarhus, with benefits including pension, lunch, health insurance and social events.

• A strong team spirit where we celebrate wins and enjoy time together across offices.

• Our annual Global Summit, where the whole company meets and connects.

**Our recruitment process

**

• Send your application and upload relevant information

• 15–30-minute online interview with our Talent Acquisition team

• 30-minute interview with our Hiring Manager

• 30-minute interview with our interim Head of Talent Acquisition

• Completion of Personality Assessment

• In-person team workshop in Aarhus with representatives of People Operations, Workplace and Internal IT, where you work on a real case such as our future onboarding

About Formalize

Formalize is a tech company founded in 2021 with offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Milan, Munich and Madrid. Currently, we are a team of +200 people from +30 nationalities operating in multiple European markets and are one of the fastest growing SaaS scale-ups. We thrive on ambition, deliver impact through pragmatism, and embrace passion and honesty. We are celebrating our wins, learning from our mistakes, and growing together as a team.

Our journey began within the whistleblowing compliance sector, highlighted by the award-winning Whistleblower Software by Formalize, laying the foundation of our success story. Now, we have extended our expertise to a larger compliance universe, including data compliance, risk, and privacy. Our Formalize product helps companies to effortlessly navigate and stay ahead in the ever-changing landscape of compliance. Our platform adapts to regulatory changes, continuously adapting to meet and foresee the evolving needs of our users, ensuring businesses remain compliant and confident in their operations.

Still curious? Read more about us here: About Formalize.

**Ready to apply?

jobs.occupation: Associate Partner and Competence Team Lead, Operational Transformation, Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by the opportunity to deepen your leadership, commercial and advisory impact while contributing to sustainable growth in the operational transformation area? As Associate Partner and Competence Team Lead for Valcon’s Operational Transformation team, you will play a key role in developing our people, strengthening client partnerships and evolving our capabilities. And you will be instrumental in growing the area considerably in the future matching Valcon’s growth ambitions.

**Role and profile

**The job is located at the intersection between client delivery, team leadership, commercial work and service offering development.

You will lead a team of approximately 12 consultants and help shape the continued development of our Operational Transformation offerings, focused on Process Redesign and Process Automation, including agentic automation. You are expected to support the further integration of AI, data and technological capabilities into the services based on a clear understanding of our clients’ business needs and strategic ambitions. The ideal candidate brings deep experience and insight from both operations’ excellence and business process redesign as well as technology-driven business change and automation.

You will also act as a trusted advisor to clients, and contribute to Valcon’s growth by being commercial active, building trusted client relationships and lead projects that deliver sustainable results.

To thrive in this role, you have demonstrated experience in these four competence areas:

• Team leadership: Guide, inspire and develop a talented team of consultants, fostering an inclusive environment where people can thrive, collaborate effectively and deliver meaningful results together

• Commercial growth: Strengthen Valcon’s position as a trusted advisor by building long-term client partnerships and creating sustainable growth opportunities together with clients

• Client engagement: Manage and deliver complex projects with high-quality standards from initial mobilization to final delivery and further expansions

• Service development leadership: Develop internal capabilities and strengthen methodologies with AI, data, and technology as key enablers of business transformation

The role offers a high degree of autonomy and responsibility. The ability to balance time between all four areas is key, as they are equally important for success in this role.

**In Addition, You Should Embody These Skills

**

• People skills: Build and nurture existing relationships and teams through empathy, engagement and effective communication with clear direction

• Business and digital acumen: Think analytically and strategically with a pragmatic approach to execution. View AI, data and digital technology as integral elements of modern business development

• Subject-matter-expertise: Business process redesign, improvement and automation

• Education: Speak and write English fluently and professionally, with Danish being a plus. Completed relevant higher education or equivalent professional experience. Further education is a plus

**Organisation and reporting

**You will be the direct people manager of the Operational Transformation team of consultants (excluding Associate Partners and Partners) or managing their people managers. The role reports to a Partner from either one of our Commercial Sectors or our Head of Consulting.

**Location and travel

**The role is based at Valcon’s offices in central Copenhagen or Århus, Denmark. You can expect travel in connection with client meetings and project work, primarily within the Nordic region.

**About Valcon

**We are a European powerhouse in AI and data-driven business transformation, bringing this to life by integrating management consulting with data and digital technology capabilities.

We ensure companies are in their best possible shape – fit for the future. We spot opportunities and help bring them to life. We are thorough, fast and collaborative in everything we do. From the boardroom to the shop floor. From strategy to operations.

We are a no-nonsense consultancy with curious individuals who are driven by creating value together with clients. We have an informal culture and a flat hierarchy with offices in Denmark, Sweden, the Netherlands, the UK, Germany, Croatia and Serbia.

**Career opportunities

This supports our ambitious expansion plans – both geographically and in terms of capabilities – with a particular focus on the Nordics and the DACH (German-speaking) region. Therefore, you will have a unique opportunity to help shape the company’s development and gain strategic influence over its future direction.

**Role

**The role provides internal career development opportunities toward broader leadership roles within the capability or across the broader organisation. With Valcon’s international footprint and focus on complex transformation projects in the business and technological space, you will gain access to:

• A broad network of colleagues and clients across Europe

• Strategically significant and high-complexity projects

• Opportunities to work with cutting-edge technology, including AI, data and digital technologies

**Application

**If this role sounds like a good match, we warmly encourage you to apply and share how your experience, strengths and perspective could contribute to the team. Deadline for applications is Monday December 7, but we do review applications on an ongoing basis.

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager for CMC API Cultivation Pilot Plant

Senior Manager for CMC API Cultivation Pilot Plant

Category:  Manufacturing

Location:

Bagsværd, Capital Region of Denmark, DK

Sr Manager

CMC Development

CMC API Pilots, Mammalian Pilot Plant

Location: Bagsværd

Your impact begins here**. Lead with purpose. Empower people.

**

Are you an authentic, resilient, and empathetic people leader who thrives on developing people, building trust, and ensuring operational excellence in a complex API production environment?

As our new Team Leader (Sr Manager) for the Mammalian Pilot Plants (MPP) Cultivation team, you will lead 15 dedicated scientists and technicians producing Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API) for clinical studies. You will play a key role in ensuring strong operations, fostering collaboration, and managing stakeholders across our API pilot production activities, from cultivation to recovery and purification. You will be a visible and approachable leader on the shopfloor, creating an environment built on psychological safety, trust, and teamwork. You will also join a close-knit leadership team where colleagues support, challenge, and inspire each other to succeed.

Ready to lead and make a difference? Apply today!

**

What you’ll do**

As Sr Manager of the mammalian cultivation team, you will lead a team responsible for daily operations in our cultivation facility. A key part of your success will be your ability to coordinate and engage in prioritization with your manager colleagues across the department to ensure high quality, production activities and team engagement.

Furthermore, you have a preference to set and meet ambitious goals on the premise that success is achieved through collaboration and sharing key observations early to accelerate delivery. You are motivated by being on shopfloor daily, visible to your employees and engaging in problem solving.

You will primarily be responsible for the cultivation of API for phase 1, 2 and 3 studies ensuring high quality and compliance. Your team consists of 15 employees (Scientists and Technicians) who are preparing, conducting, and reporting API production campaigns in close collaboration with the development and production areas of Novo.

You will join a growing area preparing for taking in more exciting development projects and expanding capacity for the supply of our portfolio. Your main tasks will be to:

• Ensure delivery according to ambitious production plans with a high level of quality

• Coordinate and engage in prioritization with your manager colleagues across the department to ensure high-quality level, production activities and team engagement.

• Continuously ensure high level of psychological safety, motivation and engagement in your team

• Day-to-day visible on shopfloor, engaging with your employees, in problem solving and identifying opportunities to optimize our workflow and processes through a structured approach.

As Sr Manager you will be part of the leadership team in CMC MPP, which is composed of 1 Director, 4 Sr Managers and an administrative coordinator that meets frequently, help and support each other, and routinely use each other as sparring partners.

What you’ll bring

To succeed in this role, you will need a technical background, master’s degree or PhD in science/technology, biochemical/chemical engineering, pharmacy, or other relevant fields. Furthermore, you will need:

• Experience in the pharma industry and knowledge of GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) is preferred.

• Leadership experience and a natural desire to engage, develop and empower people.

• Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with both internal and external collaboration partners.

• The ability to challenge status quo and see LEAN as a natural part of your daily work.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

You are a strong relationship builder who creates trust and followership within your team. You empower and involve your employees, lead with authenticity, and motivate others to deliver high-quality results. You thrive in a dynamic development environment with competing priorities and complex problem-solving. You balance leadership and operational management effectively and bring an innovative, flexible mindset.

**Who you’ll work with

**CMC Development's role in Novo's value chain is to turn molecules into approved products in close cooperation with our colleagues in R&ED, Development and Global Manufacturing and Supply.  As part of CMC Development, CMC API Pilots is the preferred partner for API production supporting clinical trials and ensuring process transfer to commercial production.

The CMC MPP department is organised within CMC API Pilots and we are 65 employees divided into four teams, three facilities, and two locations. Our primary task is to produce API for clinical studies supporting Novo’s important strategic projects within our mammalian platform.

What you can expect hereYou will work in an international environment where your expertise is valued, and your contribution can shape decisions across areas. You will be supported to perform at your best and trusted to take ownership. You will be encouraged to make your voice heard, learn from leadership colleagues and contribute to work that helps create progress for people living with serious chronic diseases. We foster a collaborative culture where we care for one another, value initiative, and empower you to drive projects forward while growing professionally.

**What we offer

**Salary: The annual base salary for this role ranges from DKK 742.600 to DKK 1.091.600, depending on the level of the position. Placement within the range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives and other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

jobs.occupation: (Senior) Process Scientist - New Tablet Drug Products
jobs.description:
Your impact begins here

As (Senior) Process Scientist, you will help move new tablet products from development into reliable, large-scale production. You will characterise, test, and validate tablet production processes so they work at manufacturing sites around the world, and prepare the documentation that supports market approval. Oral treatments are a strategic focus area at Novo and your work will help our patients and customers towards lasting health.

What you’ll bring

• An M.Sc. degree in Chemistry, Pharmacy, Engineering or another relevant academic area.

• Minimum 2 years of experience in oral product production, late-stage product development, drug product analysis, or clinical manufacturing

• General experience working within a GMP environment, knowledge of validation activities, and familiarity with regulatory documentation.

• Fluency in spoken and written English.

• Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with team success ahead of personal achievement.

• A self-driven, quality-minded approach, with good planning and time-management skills to meet ambitious deadlines.

• Comfort working with some unknowns and many stakeholders, and the ability to adapt, learn and stay in control when situations are challenging.

Useful, but not essential:

• Experience from cross-organisational projects.

We welcome applications from both experienced and more junior candidates. The scope of the role can be adjusted to your level of experience, providing an opportunity to grow into the position. If you meet the core requirements, we encourage you to apply.

What you’ll do

You will work on late-phase manufacturing science for new tablet products, preparing processes for large-scale market production.

You will have the opportunity to:

• Drive scientific progress to reach project milestones, delivering on characterisation studies, test runs, and process validation activities.

• Work with production sites to solve technical challenges with blenders, granulators, tablet machines, in-process control systems, and process analytical technologies (PAT).

• Update and maintain critical process documentation, quality statements, scientific rationales and health authority submission files.

• Apply and uphold the relevant standards. Where a standard does not fully fit the situation, use your own scientific judgement to find the best way forward.

• Learn from how new ways of working meet reality at the sites, adapt your approach, and help update the standard so others can benefit.

The role is based in Taastrup, with some workdays in Måløv, and includes up to 25 international travel days a year, depending on your project.

Who you’ll work with

You will join New Product Introduction (NPI) within Tablet Manufacturing Science and Technology (TMSAT) in Global Manufacturing & Supply (GMS). Tablet MSAT supports the global network of tablet manufacturing sites by introducing new products, managing the processes and quality of marketed products, and developing new technology to improve performance.

NPI is a rapidly growing department of around 20 colleagues, working with an expanding pipeline of tablet products. Together, we develop, scale up and validate blending, granulation and compression processes, and make sure the product’s stability, specifications and quality hold up. We work in cross-functional project groups, united by shared team goals, and we share experience and knowledge as we go.

You will collaborate closely with development departments, production sites, quality assurance, quality control, regulatory affairs and the scientists who support marketed products. The stakeholders you work with will change as projects move forward, so you will keep building your network.

What you can expect here

Oral treatments are a strategic focus area for Novo, and the landscape is dynamic. That means varied projects, new ways to broaden your skills and a chance to see your work make a difference at sites around the world. You will have a highly engaged, supportive team around you, and room to develop your professional and personal competences as the department grows.

Salary

For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 638,200.00 to 938,100.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

“When the learner is ready, the teacher appears.”

What if learning was not something you had to wait for?

As Director – Global Medical Learning, you will lead the shift from scheduled, content-led training to personalised, on-demand and AI-enabled learning that supports colleagues in the flow of their work. What you’ll do

• Set a clear global strategy for Global Medical Learning and lead the move towards personalised, on-demand learning available at the moment of need.

• Explore and scale responsible uses of AI, including AI coaching, simulation, role-play and LLM-powered knowledge and learning.

• Transform medical and scientific onboarding and continuous development for colleagues entering Medical Affairs, taking on new roles or moving into new disease areas.

• Strengthen critical Medical Affairs capabilities, from bold, impactful scientific dialogue and behavioural skills to digital fluency and AI learning.

• Show that learning makes a difference, moving beyond completion statistics towards proficiency, application, behaviour change and organisational readiness.

• Build learning communities across Global, regional and affiliate teams so that great ideas and practices travel instead of being reinvented.

• Lead and develop the Global Medical Learning team, creating clarity and direction while giving talented people a safe and caring working environment to experiment, grow and make an impact.

Who you’ll work with

Your closest partners will be the Therapeutic Area (TA) experts in Global Medical Affairs, Affiliates, Regions and IO-SO, alongside Learning partners, People & Organisation, Data/AI, IT and other relevant teams. As Advanced IT Security Architect, you will take the lead on Application and DevSecOps Security and on AI Security within Defence Engineering. You will design and build the security capabilities that protect how Novo develops software and AI, from delivery pipelines to AI models, agents, workloads and data flows. Your work helps teams build and deploy with confidence, so technology can keep supporting people living with serious chronic diseases.

What you’ll bring

You are hands-on, curious and ready to take ownership of a new area. We value technical depth and the right security mindset, and we are open on seniority depending on your expertise, potential and overall fit.

• A strong technical foundation in application development, the software development lifecycle, AppSec, DevSecOps or IT architecture.

• Proven experience in cybersecurity, ideally from several years in IT architecture, technical strategy or security roles. Candidates from application development or IT architecture backgrounds are welcome if they show the right security mindset.

• Experience designing and configuring IT systems, cloud infrastructure or integrations, and working with compliance and IT-risk assessment processes.

• Experience or a strong interest in AI security, including AI models, agents, workloads and data flows.

• Familiarity with security frameworks and standards such as CIS, NIS2 and ISO 27001.

• The ability to make decisions, turn ideas into practical implementation, and influence and communicate with colleagues at different technical levels.

• Fluency in English, written and spoken, and a global mindset.

• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field. Significant professional experience can be considered equivalent.

Useful, but not essential :

• Experience in the pharma industry or another large organisation.

• Knowledge of ITIL or broader IT processes, and familiarity with Agile ways of working.

• Experience from large-scale deployments across infrastructure.

What you’ll do

You will design, engineer and implement security capabilities, working directly with security tools rather than focusing mainly on governance or documentation.

• Lead and develop Application Security, DevSecOps and AI Security capabilities within the team, and act as the go-to expert and point of contact for these areas.

• Assess risks across applications, AI models, agents, workloads and data flows, using threat modelling and security design reviews of AI solutions, development platforms and CI/CD pipelines.

• Design and implement security architectures, policies and controls, including automated checks for code, dependencies, secrets, containers and infrastructure as code, and protections for AI-specific risks such as prompt injection and sensitive data exposure.

• Strengthen monitoring, alerting, detection and response for AI services, developer platforms and software supply chains.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the Defence Engineering team and work with specialists across Cloud, Identity, Endpoint and Data Protection. Together, you will align defensive controls and close gaps across security domains.

Day to day, you will partner with AI, software engineering and DevOps teams to build security into development workflows. You will also work with Cyber Defence Centre, Security Operations and Incident Response colleagues to agree telemetry and detections, and with Offensive Security and Vulnerability Management teams to validate attack scenarios and verify fixes. Security Architecture, Governance, Risk and Compliance colleagues help ensure your work aligns with standards.

What you can expect here

You will join a large enterprise environment with broad exposure to major IT security technologies and highly skilled specialists across multiple security domains. You will have significant ownership and visibility, and the chance to establish yourself as the go-to expert in Application and AI Security, an area that is still taking shape.

You will be trusted to explore, decide and deliver, with colleagues who support you to perform at your best and grow your skills on the job.

Help build how AI is done right in a medical device company

Imagine joining a team at the very beginning. Not to maintain something others designed, but to shape what it becomes: the code, the platform, the way of working and the people around you. That is the opportunity in our Quality AI Enabler team.

We are a small team working where AI, cloud technology, software engineering, data and Quality meet. Together with our AI Business Analyst and Quality Engineering Graduate, you will turn promising AI ideas and prototypes into secure, maintainable solutions that help our Quality colleagues work smarter, and ultimately support the quality of the hearing aids that improve people's lives every day. You will be the team's engineering anchor, and with that comes real influence on what we build and how we build it.

Your days will be hands-on. You will design, build and deploy AI-assisted workflows and applications in Microsoft Azure, using large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, and enterprise data. You will write backend services, APIs and integrations, and you know what it takes to move a prototype into production. You probably have around 4-6 years of software development behind you, and you have already shipped something real with generative AI.

But this role is about more than code. You will set the engineering practices the team grows on, create reusable patterns for future AI initiatives, and help less experienced colleagues grow through pairing, reviews and sharing what you know. You do not need a manager title to lead: you lead by example, explain technical choices in plain language, and challenge assumptions when something looks fragile.

And then there are the guardrails. Hearing aids are regulated medical devices, so in our company responsible AI is not a slide in a presentation; it is part of the design. You will help define how we handle security, data access, evaluation and AI lifecycle controls, and you will learn how the EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001, ISO 13485 and IEC 62304 shape what good looks like. Experience from a regulated industry is an advantage, but curiosity matters more. Few places let you build this knowledge from the ground up. We are one such place.

What you bring

• Strong development skills in Python or another language

• Hands-on experience deploying solutions in Microsoft Azure

• Practical experience with generative AI and LLM-based applications

• Working knowledge of REST APIs, MCP servers or similar integrations

• Git, automated testing and CI/CD as daily habits

• A solid grasp of authentication, secrets and application security

• Clear communication in English

It is a plus if you have worked with Azure OpenAI or AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Graph, Semantic Kernel, Docker or SQL, or with AI evaluation and monitoring.

You are a pragmatic builder who knows the difference between an impressive demo and a solution people can rely on. You enjoy experimenting, but you respect disciplined engineering. If you want to develop your own skills while building a team, its processes and its infrastructure from the start, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.occupation: PhD Position : Clinical and Multi-Omics Biomarker Discovery and Risk Prediction in Diabetes Compli-cations
jobs.description:
We invite applications for an exciting PhD position within the Bioinformatics and Data Science Team, Complications Research Group, Clinical and Translational Research Department at Steno Diabetes Center Copenhagen (SDCC).

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of clinical research, multi-omics, computational biology and precision medicine, contributing to the discovery of novel biomarkers and improved risk prediction of diabetes-related complications.

About the Complications Research Group

The Complications Research Group is led by a research manager and currently comprises five senior scientists, together with several PhD students and postdoctoral researchers. Our overall aim is to identify novel biomarkers, mechanisms and risk-stratification approaches to improve the prevention and treatment of microvascular and macrovascular complications of diabetes.

The group includes two clinical research teams and a Bioinformatics and Data Science Team. The latter leads and collaborates on national and international research projects focusing on risk stratification and precision medicine in individuals with type 1 and type 2 diabetes. Our research spans several diabetes complications, including neuropathy, brain and cognitive dysfunction, cardiovascular disease, kidney disease, diabetic foot disease and retinopathy.

Our research integrates clinical cohort data with multi-omics technologies and advanced bioinformatics, statistical and artificial intelligence approaches. We specialize in human genomics, metabolomics, lipidomics, and proteomics to identify novel disease mechanisms, biomarkers and therapeutic targets, ultimately supporting improved clinical decision-making and personalized medicine.

About the Project

This PhD project will focus on translational biomarker discovery and risk prediction of neurological complications and neurodegeneration in individuals with type 2 diabetes.

The project will involve the acquisition and analysis of metabolomics and lipidomics data from well-characterised clinical cohorts, alongside integration with other molecular and clinical data. You will receive training in omics data processing, multi-modal data integration, computational biology and advanced data science approaches, including machine learning.

Joining our team, you will become an integral part of a multi-omics research initiative within the Complications Research Group, working closely with clinicians and researchers across SDCC. The project will be conducted within the Bioinformatics and Data Science Team, in collaboration with the Type 2 Diabetes and Neuro Unit at SDCC and other research partners.

The Position and Your Responsibilities: As a PhD student, you will take an active role in the planning, execution and dissemination of research findings. Your responsibilities will include:

• Contributing to the acquisition, processing and quality control of metabolomics and lipidomics data.

• Managing and analysing complex clinical and multi-omics datasets.

• Developing and applying computational pipelines for multi-modal data integration, including clinical, imaging and omics data.

• Conducting biomarker discovery, mechanistic investigations and risk-prediction analyses.

• Applying statistical modelling, machine learning and other advanced data science approaches.

• Preparing scientific manuscripts, presenting research findings and contributing to collaborative research activities.

We are looking for a motivated candidate with the following qualifications:

• A Master's degree in Bioinformatics, Biomedical Engineering, Computational Biology, Data Science or a related discipline.

• A strong interest in biomedical research, omics technologies and precision medicine.

• Knowledge of metabolomics and/or lipidomics/proteomics, preferably with experience in omics data analysis and AI/ML implementation within a clinical setting.

• Good programming and analytical skills, preferably in R and/or Python.

• An interest in multi-omics data integration, statistical modelling and machine learning/AI approaches.

Previous research experience, scientific publications and experience with clinical or omics datasets will be considered an advantage.

We particularly welcome candidates who are enthusiastic about combining computational and analytical approaches with clinically relevant research.

What We Offer

We offer an exciting opportunity to develop a research career at the interface of bioinformatics, multi-omics and clinical translational research.

You will benefit from:

• Working in an interdisciplinary research environment with close interaction between bioinformaticians, clinicians and experimental researchers.

• Access to well-characterised clinical cohorts and advanced omics technologies.

• Training in multi-omics data integration, computational biology, machine learning and precision medicine.

• Opportunities to participate in national and international research collaborations involving academia and industry.

• Opportunities to develop independent research ideas, contribute to grant applications and establish your own research profile.

• Formal training and opportunities to develop scientific, project-management and leadership skills.

Recruitment and Employment

Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement for Academics employed by the Danish Regions (Danske Regioner) and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (Akademikerne).

Contact and Application: Applications must be submitted online by 15 December 2026.

Interviews are expected to take place during the following week, with an anticipated starting date of 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

For further information about the position, kindly contact: Associate Professor Tarunveer Singh Ahluwalia, the Bioinformatics and Data Science group lead or Professor Tine W. Hansen, Head of Department, Complications Research, SDCC.

We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds who possess the relevant academic qualifications and motivation.

About Steno Diabetes Center Copenhagen

Steno Diabetes Center Copenhagen (SDCC) is a leading centre for diabetes care, research, prevention and education of healthcare professionals. SDCC is the largest diabetes clinic in Scandinavia, providing specialised care to more than 11,000 children and adults with diabetes annually. Through close integration of clinical practice and research, SDCC aims to advance diabetes prevention, treatment and personalised medicine.
