jobs.occupation: Associate Professorship at the Centre for Alcohol and Drug Research
jobs.description:
The Centre for Alcohol and Drug Research, Department of Psychology and Behavioural Sciences, Aarhus University, invites applications for Associate Professorship in social science alcohol and drug research, commencing 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The Centre for Alcohol and Drug Research is an independent, interdisciplinary social science research centre. As an Associate Professor, you are expected to conduct high-quality research that strengthens the Centre’s research environment and contributes to the development of alcohol and drug research in Denmark. You will be expected to help strengthen the Centre’s international, including Nordic, research profile and collaborative activities within the field.

Candidates are expected to attract external research funding, publish in recognised academic journals and book series, teach at undergraduate and graduate levels, supervise PhD students, and have experience in, or shortly after appointment take responsibility for, leading research projects. There is also an expectation that you actively disseminate alcohol and drug research in a Danish context to practitioners, policymakers, and the general public. Furthermore, it is a requirement that you are based at the Centre on a daily basis and contribute actively and enthusiastically to its interdisciplinary research environment. Administrative duties will also be associated with the position.

Qualifications

Applicants with a social science research background in alcohol and drug studies and related areas will be preferred. Appointment as Associate Professor furthermore requires research and teaching qualifications equivalent to those typically achieved through a successful period of employment as an Assistant Professor although equivalent qualifications may also have been acquired through other means. To obtain permanent employment as an Associate Professor at Aarhus BSS, candidates must, prior to appointment, have completed the faculty’s supervision course and the faculty’s course in Online and Blended Learning offered by the Centre for Educational Development at Aarhus University. If these courses have not been completed prior to employment, appointment will be conditional upon their completion within five years.

About Us

At the Centre for Alcohol and Drug Research, we conduct social science research within the field of alcohol and drug studies. Our research projects focus on areas including treatment, prevention and harm reduction, policy, law enforcement, and recreational substance use. We study both legal and illegal substances. The Centre is interdisciplinary, and staff members have backgrounds in fields such as anthropology, psychology, sociology, criminology, and public health. Our aim is to establish and conduct research projects, provide teaching, disseminate knowledge about alcohol and drug problems, develop interventions, and collaborate with national stakeholders and international research institutions. For more information about the Centre for Alcohol and Drug Research, please visit www.crf.au.dk.

The Centre for Alcohol and Drug Research is part of the Department of Psychology, Aarhus BSS, Aarhus University. The Department of Psychology is one of six departments within Aarhus BSS, one of the University’s five faculties. Aarhus BSS brings together the core business and social science disciplines to reflect the close relationship between society and business. Aarhus University is ranked among the world’s top 100 universities, and Aarhus BSS and the Department of Psychology have obtained the prestigious AACSB and AMBA accreditations.

Further Information

For further information regarding the position, please contact: Bagga Bjerge, Director, Centre for Alcohol and Drug Research, Tel.: +45 22 35 19 89. Email: bb.crf@psy.au.dk

If you require assistance with uploading your application or have questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact: Charlotte Thomsen, HR-Coordinator. Tel.: +45 87 16 53 62. Email: Charlotte@au.dk.

The place of employment is: Centre for Alcohol and Drug Research, Bartholins Allé 9, 8000 Aarhus C, Denmark

Application deadline
12 January 2027

International applicant? 
Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Please find more information here:
https://internationalstaff.au.dk/relocationservice/

Please find more information about research opportunities at Aarhus University here: http://international.au.dk/research/

Terms of employment
Salary and terms of employment are governed by the Cirkulære om overenskomst for akademikere i staten  (in Danish). You will be employed as associate professor at base pay level 4–8 with additional supplements in accordance with the Cirkulære om protokollat om visse ansættelsesvilkår for videnskabeligt personale ved universiteter (in Danish).

The job content and qualification requirements are described in further detail in the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

Application procedure
When you apply for this position it is mandatory to attach the following:

• Application
• Curriculum Vitae. You are encouraged to declare any periods of leave without research activity, including, for example, maternity leave, since your research activities are assessed in relation to your actual research time
• Education (diploma for master's, PhD and possibly higher doctoral degree)
• List of publications (the enclosed publications must be clearly marked on the list of publications)
• Publications. Up to five publications can be included in the application. In the event of several authors the publications must be accompanied by a co-author statement concerning the applicant's share of the collaborative work with the consent of the co-authors. This template may be used for the purpose
• Teaching portfolio. The specific requirements regarding the documentation can be found here
 Materials which cannot be uploaded together with the application may be submitted in five copies to Aarhus BSS HR & PhD, Aarhus University, Bartholins Allé 16, DK-8000 Aarhus C.

Read more about how to apply for an academic post at Aarhus BSS here

The evaluation process
After the application deadline, an assessment committee is appointed. Please note that the assessment of applicants is based solely on the material received prior to the application deadline. For further information, see Guidelines for Assessment Committee, Aarhus BSS.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

About Aarhus University

Aarhus University is an academically diverse and research-intensive university with a strong commitment to high-quality research and education and the development of society nationally and globally. The university offers an inspiring research and teaching environment for its 37,500 students, including PhD students, and has 9,000 employees (full-time equivalents) and an annual revenue of EUR 1.2 billion. Learn more at international.au.dk

The group designs almost all electronic elements of the radar antennas including antenna elements, mixers, LNAs, HPAs, PSUs and digital circuits. We play a key role in our certification activities and support the production team with module testing, system verification, and debugging.

In this role, you will work with system-level debugging and testing—both internally and as part of our certification processes—while also contributing to design tasks in our ongoing roadmap projects.

Your main responsibility includes the following tasks:

• Drive the design of various microwave PCBs and modules

• Test and verify performance of the developed solutions – both on board level and module level.

• Work closely with system engineering and subsystem architects to align module requirements

• Drive needed documentation like requirements, design specifications, test specifications and production documentation.

• Work closely with NPI team in developing efficient test solutions.

• Collaborate with your engineering colleagues to find the best cross-functional solution

Other responsibilities and tasks will be:

• Take part in the development of our next generation radar platform architecture

• Support system-level debugging, troubleshooting and integration.

• Include compliance requirements in designs and support compliance team

About you

We are looking for an experienced colleague and ideally +10 years of experience from a similar role. You can quickly get up to speed with ongoing design, debugging, and compliance tasks while building an understanding of the design trade-offs relevant to radar systems. Hands-on experience with debugging in a live environment is a strong advantage. The role requires a detail-oriented and structured approach, combined with the ability to maintain an overall view of the system and meet project deadlines.

The essential requirements of the job include:

• A university degree in electrical engineering with focus on RF

• +10 years’ experience in advanced RF designs.

• Experience with design of microwave circuits and debugging

• Experience with microwave measuring instruments such as VNAs, spectrum analyzers, and signal generators

• Experience with HPA and LNA design

• System-level understanding of radar architecture

• Knowledge of electromagnetic theory and free space waves

Your new team

The Antenna group consists of more than 50 engineers ranging from few years to 30+ years of experience - of these 18 engineers make the Microwave team. The Antenna group is cross functional engineering team with analogue and digital electronics, RF or microwave electronics and mechanical engineering – all skills to deliver a full functional Antenna.

Contact and application

Please note that we review applications on an on-going basis. Please apply at our website using the ”Apply” button. Applications can be in Danish or English. If you have any questions, you are very welcome to contact Engineering Manager Microwave, Thomas Madsen, thm@weibel.dk.

The deadline is November 25th, 2026.

Please be aware that it is a requirement for this position that you can provide a criminal record with no remarks and obtain a security clearance.

We are looking forward to hearing from you.

jobs.description:

At Siteimprove, we are the leader in agentic content intelligence. Siteimprove.ai is a unified platform that brings together accessibility, analytics, SEO/AEO, and content strategy into a single, continuous flow. Our AI agents work alongside marketing and digital teams — not instead of them — helping to create high-performing, accessible content that's easy to discover by both humans and AI.

As Senior Engineering Manager for Content Platform, you own the systems that acquire and ingest the content our entire product line reasons about. Our enterprise customers bring thousands of sites each, re-crawled continuously. Every accessibility finding, analytics number, and SEO recommendation begins as content one of your systems fetched, parsed, and stored.

You will lead two Copenhagen engineering teams, each with its own Technical Leader role held by a Principal Engineer. The two carry different hard problems. One sustains crawl throughput so that cost tracks value rather than volume. The other builds the shared foundations the rest of Siteimprove works through, so product lines reach content through common contracts rather than each solving it their own way. You represent this group's engineering in a trio with Product and UX. Pillar strategy is set with Seattle, nine hours behind you, and you are the leader on the ground who turns it into local decisions rather than waiting on it.

Your teams set the ceiling on what the rest of Siteimprove can build. Your goals follow from that — ingestion reliable enough that customers trust it, efficient enough that cost tracks value rather than volume, capable enough to feed our agentic products, and ready for the compliance bar our public sector customers require. You will use AI to build the platform that powers our AI products and stay close enough to the code to argue a design on its merits.

What we will be doing

• Decision Authority in Copenhagen: You are the decision-maker on the ground. Resolve in Copenhagen hours what would otherwise wait overnight. As engineering's voice in the group's trio, bring the constraints Product and UX have no way to see into scope conversations early enough to change them. Your director sets goals with you and discusses how you and the group are tracking against them.

• Platform Ownership: Own Content Platform's ingestion surface as a running business — availability, throughput, cost, and delivery predictability. Modernization is how you improve those numbers, not a separate program you report on. Our move to EKS is part of it. You decide which debt gets paid down and when and keep that trade-off in front of the trio.

• Architectural Direction: Own the constraints and the cross-team contracts your Technical Leaders design within: scheduling the crawl workload so cost tracks value rather than volume, moving ingestion onto event-driven services, and defining how the rest of Siteimprove consumes what we ingest. You will hold that direction with your senior engineers, because authority here is earned in design review.

• Delivery Under Pressure: Hold the delivery line when priorities move. Work arrives from outside the team continuously, and you will sequence so committed work reaches completion rather than stalling half-built. Align directly with peer engineering leaders and close the gaps at functions you depend on but don't manage.

• Measurable Impact: Define the KPIs these systems are judged by and hold your teams to them. You will prove the impact of what you prioritize in throughput, cost, and reliability rather than asserting it, and you will stop work that moves none of them.

• Growing Your Engineers: Own performance, career development, and compensation decisions for the group. Hand the Tech Vision and System Design for major initiatives to the engineers closest to the systems, and review rather than drive them.

• AI-Native Delivery: Use AI for engineering throughput, not just for product features. You will model the practice yourself: interpreting legacy code paths nobody documented, generating test coverage around behavior before you change it, and shortening the distance between a design decision and a working replacement

• Travel may be required; a valid passport is required

• Perform other duties as assigned

What we will require of you

• Ownership at Distance: A group whose outcomes you owned while the people setting direction sat elsewhere. We want evidence of decisions you made rather than escalated, because waiting would have cost more than being wrong. This role also asks for a standing weekly overlap in your late afternoon, when the Seattle day begins, so that the conversation with your director is a working one.

• Systems Depth: 7+ years in backend engineering, with real depth in distributed systems, high-throughput data ingestion, or crawling at scale. Comfort establishing how an undocumented system behaves before changing it, and the instinct to reach for AI to do that quickly.

• Leadership Through Leaders: 10+ years managing engineers, including senior technical leaders whose designs you reviewed rather than produced, and whose scope you expanded rather than absorbed.

• Architectural Judgment: A track record of moving established services onto cloud-native infrastructure and of designing interfaces other teams build on. What matters is having lived with both long enough to know which decisions held and which leaked.

Work Environment

• This is a hybrid role based in our Copenhagen office, with the opportunity to work from both the office and home. Our working language is English.

• Travel may be required up to 5% of the time.

• You will work across a nine-hour spread with product and engineering leadership in Seattle, and with peer teams in other Siteimprove locations. Your late afternoon overlaps the start of the Seattle day, and the role expects you to keep a weekly window there for goal-setting and progress discussions with leadership.

What we will love about you

These systems quietly carry the entire product. If you're ready to make them faster and cheaper to run without stopping the business that depends on them, we'd love to hear from you. Join us in helping enterprise marketing teams turn their vast content into clear, actionable insights that drive measurable business results.

What you'll love about us

We’re building the next generation of AI-powered content intelligence, helping organizations unify accessibility, SEO/AEO, analytics, and content performance into one platform. If you’re energized by solving complex problems, working cross-functionally, and contributing to a product with real-world impact, we’d love to connect.

In addition, we hope you will appreciate:

At Siteimprove, we're committed to supporting your wellbeing both at work and beyond. Our Denmark benefits are designed to help you thrive personally and professionally.

Rest and relaxation: Generous time off including Danish holiday entitlements, five additional FF Days, child sick leave, and bereavement leave.

Comprehensive benefits: Health insurance, company-paid mobile phone support, and internet allowance to support your day-to-day needs.

Prepare for the future: Danica pension with employer contributions to help support your retirement goals.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, or other legally protected status.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. You will join our Corporate Actions team. The team works with requirements and customer-facing activities related to corporate actions. Your direct manager will be Ali Razvi.

Location: Greater Copenhagen, Denmark (minimum 4 days on-site per week)

Board Intelligence is a technology and advisory firm on a mission to make boards more effective, and through them, build better businesses and benefit society.

Over twenty years we have established ourselves as the market leader in governance and board effectiveness, trusted by more than 80,000 directors, executives, and governance professionals globally, including across the Fortune 500, FTSE 100, and OMX 30. That trust has been earned through depth of insight, rigorous advisory work, and a track record that newer entrants simply cannot replicate.

We have invested in applied AI since 2020, well ahead of the market, and that early conviction has paid off. Our AI-powered platform and smart board advisor give us a competitive advantage that is widening, not narrowing. In 2024, K1 Investment Management, the leading B2B Enterprise SaaS investor, backed us to accelerate that position further. We are now growing fast, with a proven commercial model spanning both mid-market and enterprise, and a product suite that has become a necessary addition in high-stakes board environments.

The people joining us now will shape how we scale. We are deliberate about how we do that. Our founders and leadership team are deeply invested in keeping the culture that got us here: thoughtful, high calibre, and genuinely human. Ambition and balance are not in competition at Board Intelligence.

If you want to work at the intersection of AI and governance, on problems that matter at the highest level, this is a strong place to be.

Our Mission

We unleash the potential of organisations through the science of board effectiveness, building better businesses and benefitting society.

**The Role

**Juristic is a Danish legal tech company, founded in 2021 and headquartered in Copenhagen. Our platform brings four tools together on the same case data: Structure, Timeline, Flow and JuristIQ, our legal AI in chat and tabular formats.

Clients include PwC, Bird & Bird and Bech-Bruun. Juristic is now part of Board Intelligence, and we are bringing a new product to market. The work is led by our CTO, and we are looking for an AI Engineer to build it with them from the first line of code.

This is a zero-to-one role in a small team of four full-stack developers, a machine learning engineer and the CTO. You will write the code, sit in front of customers, and help decide what we build next.

**Main Responsibilities

**

• Design, build and ship the AI capabilities at the core of a new product, from first prototype to production

• Own LLM-powered workflows end to end, such as document understanding, data extraction and agentic assistants

• Choose and integrate models and providers, and own the prompting, retrieval, evaluation and guardrails that make AI output reliable enough for legal and governance work

• Work directly with customers and the CTO to turn real problems into product decisions, and help own the product roadmap

• Lay the engineering foundations for the new product, including architecture, testing, observability and deployment, so it can scale

• Work with the wider Juristic and Board Intelligence engineering teams, and contribute to AI tooling shared across the suite

**Person Specification

**We are looking for a builder: an experienced AI engineer who has been a technical founder or an early employee at a startup, and who is ready to do it again.

Required Skills and Experience:

• At least four years of professional software engineering experience

• Experience as a technical founder or early employee at a startup, having built a product from the first line of code

• A track record of building and shipping AI or LLM-powered products to real users

• Practical experience with LLM APIs, prompt design, retrieval and evaluating model output in production

• Strong engineering fundamentals across backend and frontend, with the judgement to move fast without leaving a mess behind

• A strong product mindset: you have worked directly with customers and owned a product roadmap

• Hungry, motivated and ready for another zero-to-one journey

• Fluent written and spoken English

Nice to haves:

Experience with our stack: TypeScript (Node.js and React) and Python

Experience with document processing, such as PDF parsing and extraction from unstructured text

Experience building agentic systems, tool use or MCP integrations

Experience with search and retrieval infrastructure, such as Elasticsearch or vector databases

A background in legal tech, governance or B2B SaaS for professional users

What good looks like in this role:

• After three months: you know our customers, the product vision and the codebase, and you have shipped AI features that real users rely on

• After six months: the core AI capabilities of the new product are in production, backed by evaluations that show they are reliable, and you are acting on customer feedback

• After twelve months: the product is in market with paying customers, you are a trusted voice on the roadmap, and the AI foundations you built are reused across the Juristic and Board Intelligence suite

**How We Work

**We hire people who are expert at what they do. Once you join, you have the autonomy to shape how you work and the space to do it well. That doesn’t mean working in isolation. You’ll have colleagues who know their craft, regular collaboration across functions, and easy access to senior leadership when you need it.

We keep our structure flat. We work at pace in an agile, nimble environment where good ideas don’t wait for permission. If you spot something that could work better, we encourage you to say so. If you want to run with an idea, we’ll back you to do it.

We work with people who take pride in their output, back their team through the hard parts, and leave things better than they found them.

**What Happens Next

**Once you apply, our Talent team will review your application. If there’s a fit, they’ll be in touch to discuss the role and next steps.

**How We Use AI In Our Hiring

**We use AI responsibly, both in the software we build for governance teams and in how we hire. Our Talent team may use AI to support application review, CV analysis, or identifying areas that need further verification.

But hiring decisions are made by people. AI surfaces signals; people make the call on whether to progress a candidate or extend an offer.

If you’d like details on how your data is handled during recruitment, contact our Talent team.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

**We’re an equal opportunities employer. We’re building a team that works because it reflects a breadth of experience, background, and perspective.

Apply even if you don’t tick every box on the job specification. If the role excites you and you think you could make an impact, we want to hear from you.

We don’t discriminate on the basis of age, disability, ethnicity, gender, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of recruitment, or if there’s anything else we can do to make the process more accessible, tell our Talent team. We’ll sort it.

**Your Safety Matters

**Be cautious of unexpected messages claiming to be from Board Intelligence. We will never ask you for fees as part of recruitment. If you’re unsure whether a communication is genuine, contact our Talent team through our official channels before sharing information or clicking links.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**Job Description

**Capital is fundamental to a bank's resilience, profitability and ability to grow. In Capital Exposure Management, you will turn complex regulation, data and risk into clear insights that inform decisions at the heart of Danske Bank. This is a role where your analytical skills and regulatory knowledge translate directly into outcomes that matter.

**What You Will Be Doing

**You will join a skilled, international team of 16 colleagues across Denmark, Lithuania and Sweden. The team combines deep expertise with a supportive culture built on learning and continuous improvement. You will work closely with business, risk, finance and technology teams, providing analysis and recommendations to both business units and senior management on capital regulation and risk exposures.

More specifically, you will:

• Produce strategic insights on capital regulation, capital consumption and risk exposures

• Run, improve and control monthly capital and REA reporting processes

• Interpret regulatory requirements and support their practical implementation

• Perform ad hoc analyses and deliver clear recommendations to stakeholders and senior management

• Improve and automate processes using tools such as Python and SQL

**About You

**

• Strong knowledge in regulatory capital, credit risk models or process automation

• Ability to translate complex requirements into practical, workable solutions

• Self-directed and analytical approach, taking work from analysis through to implementation

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

• Experience with process optimisation and automation; Python and SQL are an advantage

• Master's degree in finance, mathematics, science, programming or a related field

• Professional proficiency in English

**What We Offer You

**You will be part of a dedicated team where collaboration and continuous learning are part of daily work. We operate in a hybrid model, with three to four days per week in the office to support knowledge sharing and team cohesion. You will have room to develop your analytical skills, deepen your understanding of capital management, and take on increasing responsibility over time. We welcome colleagues from all backgrounds and cultures.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**If this role sounds like the right fit for you, we would be glad to hear from you. For more information or an informal conversation, please reach out to Karin Vedel Acasio, Head of Capital Exposure Management, at aca@danskebank.dk.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible or by 23 November 2026 at the latest.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Management Consultants in Supply Chain Planning – Graduates 2027
jobs.description:
Job description

We're looking for talented and curious graduates who want to start a career in management consulting at the intersection of deep functional expertise and digital planning solutions.

What you’ll do

In this role, you’ll be joining a nerdy team that designs and delivers optimal supply chains by combining best-in-class processes with leading digital solutions. Every day, we help clients transform their planning processes in demand, supply, and inventory optimisation across the value chain and planning horizons.

You’ll be working on a wide range of projects. Depending on your personal journey and development goals, your role in a project could include:

• Design and implement planning excellence: Apply advanced concepts in forecasting, demand and supply planning, S&OP/IBP, inventory optimisation, and operational planning to build robust, end‑to‑end planning processes.

• Enable adoption and capability building: Train stakeholders and facilitate client workshops to co-create designs, refine processes, and embed continuous improvement.

• Translate requirements into actionable processes: Convert business needs into well-defined process designs and implementation plans – with clear governance, data, and decision flows.

• Guide digital planning transformations: Advise clients on solution architecture and roadmaps for SAP IBP and other leading platforms from concept to configuration and adoption.

• Deliver measurable impact: Execute projects that optimise planning tools and processes, strengthen performance management, and build organisational capabilities that sustain excellence.

• You’re excited to live a year in Copenhagen to immerse yourself in our strong Implement culture while working in an international team and to build a broad network at Implement.

If this sounds like the kind of nerdery you would like to dive deep into, you’ll feel right at home in our team.

Please note that for the first year, you’ll be employed in our Copenhagen office, Implement’s HQ, before joining the Aarhus office.

What you’ll bring

As our new team member, you’ll be working at the forefront of supply chain transformation – integrating digital enablers with core business functions to create end-to-end impact, from strategy and design to implementation and adoption.

To be a great fit, you hold – or are about to complete – a master's degree in a relevant field such as engineering, supply chain, operations research, or business analytics, with strong academic results to show for it.

On top of that, we’re looking for someone who meets most of the following criteria:

• Relevant experience: Ideally, you’ve applied supply chain concepts through an internship, student role, or thesis project.

• Project-driven and adaptable: You enjoy working in a project-based setting, managing timelines, stakeholders, and changing priorities.

• Interest in digital tools: Ideally, you have exposure to SAP (e.g., SAP IBP) or other digital planning platforms or you are interested in building expertise in digital planning solutions.

• Analytical problem-solver: You love turning complex problems into clear insights and actionable solutions.

• Structured communicator: You can structure and deliver compelling presentations and workshops in English (proficiency in another European language is considered a plus, but not a requirement).

Supply chains are becoming one of the most strategically important – and technically complex – areas in business. If you want to be at the sharp end of that, join our team where curiosity is rewarded, diverse perspectives are valued, and where you will make an impact from day one.

What we offer

At Implement, a healthy, dynamic, and collaborative environment always comes first. You'll become part of a fast-growing, entrepreneurial Scandinavian consultancy that gives you the space to grow, lead, and innovate while creating real results for our clients.

• Build deep functional expertise: develop mastery across demand planning, supply planning, inventory optimisation, S&OP/IBP, and digital planning tools with ownership of end-to-end planning transformations.

• Hands-on from day one: work on client projects immediately, side by side with experienced consultants who elevate your strategic thinking and methodological rigour.

• Continuous development: get access to an ambitious internal training programme with keynotes, workshops, certifications, and mentoring to accelerate your professional and personal growth.

• High-trust culture: enjoy autonomy, support, and a flat hierarchy in a team that shares knowledge freely and continuously raises its standards.

• An exciting start to your career: Feel the energy and atmosphere at our Copenhagen HQ for one year, joining a cohort of international graduates. Build a community and engage in a steep learning programme into the world of supply chain planning before you move on to the Aarhus office.

Make your next move matter.

How to apply

Please include your CV, a cover letter, and your GPA for both your BSc and MSc.

Start date for this position flexible, either winter 2026/2027 or September/October 2027 in Copenhagen.

About Implement

Implement Consulting Group (founded 1996) is an international management consulting firm with 1,900+ employees. Headquartered in Copenhagen, we have 12 offices across the Nordics, the DACH region, and the United States, making us one of the largest European consultancies. We support organisations in delivering sustainable strategic, commercial, and operational transformations. To help our clients succeed with their most critical change initiatives, we aim to attract, develop, and promote the best talent by creating a unique, collaborative learning environment where people can follow their passion, shape their own careers, and choose their own leaders.

**About Sedna:

**Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising global trade, serving as the North Star for businesses navigating the complexities of international commerce. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. As we continue to grow and innovate, we are looking for exceptional talent to join our journey and contribute to our mission of transforming global trade.

You can find out more about us on our website: https://sedna.com/

**Role Snapshot

****Scope

**Owns a named portfolio of Premier and Strategic accounts globally. Co-owns renewals and expansion commercially with the AE. Owns the customer relationship, account health, success plan execution, and ensuring the customer is in the right place before the renewal conversation happens; Sales owns the close.

**Autonomy

**Operates independently with minimal management oversight. Escalates to Head of Customer Success on strategic or genuinely unusual situations only.

**Influence

**Directly shapes retention and growth outcomes on Sedna's highest-value accounts. Executive-level relationships and QBR ownership mean this role has material impact on revenue.

**Team

**Sets the standard for account management practice across the CS function. Acts as a reference point for regional CSMs on complex account situations.

**Role Overview

**The Enterprise Customer Success Manager owns Sedna's most commercially significant customer relationships. This is a senior, largely autonomous role for someone who is equally comfortable running an executive-level conversation and building the account infrastructure, success plans, health monitoring, renewal strategy, that makes that conversation credible.

The portfolio spans Premier and Strategic accounts globally. These are customers with high ARR, high complexity, and in many cases, long relationships that carry both genuine opportunity and genuine risk. The job is to hold those relationships well, act on signals before they become problems, and surface and progress commercial outcomes in partnership with Sales.

This is not a role that fits someone who needs clear direction on what to do next. The expectation is that you read the account, form a view, and act on it. The Head of Customer Success is there for strategic decisions and unusual situations, not routine account management.

**Key Responsibilities

****Account Ownership

**

• Own a named portfolio of Premier and Strategic accounts. Know them well enough that no renewal, no escalation, and no expansion conversation comes as a surprise.

• Build and maintain executive-level relationships. The relationship should not depend on the product working perfectly; it should be strong enough to hold when it does not.

• Produce and execute success plans tied to customer outcomes, not just product usage metrics. Plans should reflect what the customer is trying to achieve and how Sedna is contributing to it.

• Run QBRs with commercial framing. A QBR should advance the relationship and the commercial position, not just report on the quarter.

• Maintain deep product knowledge across Sedna Email, Prefix, and VMS. You are not delivering training, but your commercial conversations need to be grounded in a genuine understanding of how customers are using the product and where they are not.

**Retention and Renewal

**

• Monitor account health continuously and act on risk signals before they become churn conversations. If a customer is at risk, the Head of Customer Success should hear about it from you, not from the customer.

• Co-own the renewal conversation with the AE. Own the preparation, the relationship context, and the customer's readiness to renew; Sales owns the close.

• Escalate renewal risk early, with a clear view of what is driving it and what the options are.

**Growth and Expansion

**

• Identify and progress expansion opportunities in collaboration with the AE. This means having enough commercial awareness to spot the signal and enough credibility with the customer to explore it.

• Bring the Head of Customer Success into complex or large deals at the right moment, not after the conversation has already been shaped.

**Cross-functional Coordination

**

• Coordinate training delivery through Education. You are not responsible for delivering training; Education owns that. Your job is to ensure the right training reaches the right accounts at the right time.

• Work with the Programme Manager to ensure smooth onboarding for new accounts entering the portfolio.

• Provide context to Education Specialists before training sessions on Premier and Strategic accounts, so delivery is appropriately calibrated.

• Partner with Support and Product to close feedback loops and ensure customer insights are informing the right internal conversations.

**About You

**

• Significant experience managing complex, high-value B2B accounts at a senior level, with a track record of holding executive relationships and co-owning commercial outcomes alongside Sales.

• Strong executive presence and the ability to hold a relationship through difficult conversations, not just good ones.

• A background in shipping, maritime operations, or global trade is strongly preferred. Sedna serves some of the world's largest maritime businesses, and candidates who understand how those organisations operate will be better placed to build credible, lasting relationships with them.

• Commercially fluent: able to read a renewal situation, understand what is driving it, and act with appropriate urgency without waiting to be asked.

• Clear, structured communicator in writing and in person, comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders and leading commercial conversations.

• Familiarity with Salesforce or equivalent CRM. Experience with tools such as Mixpanel or Snowflake is an advantage.

**What Success Looks Like

**

• A portfolio where no renewal, escalation, or expansion conversation comes as a surprise, because you have been managing the signals well in advance.

• Executive relationships on Premier accounts that are strong enough that customers would describe you as genuinely useful, not just present.

• Net Revenue Retention at or above target, with a clear understanding of what drove the result in both directions.

• Expansion pipeline contribution in partnership with Sales, with opportunities identified and progressed rather than waited for.

• Customer insights flowing consistently into QBRs, product feedback, and internal planning.

**Directional KPIs

**

• Net Revenue Retention on portfolio

• Logo retention rate on portfolio

• Expansion ARR generated

• Renewal on-time rate

• QBR completion rate against plan

• Time to escalation on at-risk accounts (faster is better)

• Executive relationship health, qualitative, assessed quarterly by Head of Customer Success

• Training coordination rate: proportion of accounts receiving at least one Education touchpoint per quarter

**Our Values:

**Finally, culture is important to us, so we also look for candidates who share our values:

**Stay Ahead, Stay Agile

**

• We don’t just adapt-we anticipate change and act with confidence.

• Curiosity, data, and customer insights help us stay ahead of the curve.

• We embrace challenges as opportunities and remain resilient under pressure.

• By staying open to new ideas and ways of working, we lead the future.

**Execute With Focus

**

• We turn strategy into action, delivering measurable results that matter.

• Every initiative counts-discipline and ownership drive business impact.

• We make smart decisions with speed, balancing pace and precision.

• Clear priorities keep us focused on what moves the needle.

**Work Together, Win Together

**

• Collaboration is our superpower-we succeed as one team, internally and with customers.

• We co-create solutions, seek feedback, and build the future of the OS together.

• Strong relationships are built on trust, respect, and shared goals.

• By aligning across teams and with customers, we unlock greater impact.

jobs.occupation: Field Service Engineer - Instrumentation radar systems
jobs.description:
Do you want to become a specialist in advanced radar systems and use your engineering skills to troubleshoot, analyze and solve complex technical challenges for customers around the world?

At Weibel, you will join a truly international and technology-driven company that develops advanced radar systems for both defense and civil applications across the world. Our strong technology and close customer partnerships have secured us success in the market and continuous growth.

As part of this growth, we are looking for a skilled Field Service Engineer with a strong engineering mindset to join our Aftermarket Service Team within Instrumentation. This is an opportunity to take your engineering skills into real-world applications, working hands-on with advanced radar technology and solving complex system-level challenges directly with our customers.

Your role

As Field Service Engineer in the Instrumentation team, you will work hands-on with advanced Weibel radar systems used by customers worldwide for high-precision test, measurement and tracking applications.

You will play a key role throughout the technical lifecycle of the systems, from final system testing and verification to installation, integration, operation, troubleshooting, maintenance and upgrades. The position combines system-level engineering, technical problem-solving and direct customer interaction, requiring you to understand how complex hardware and software systems work together in real-world applications.

Your primary tasks include:

• Pre-FAT / SAT system testing and Customer FAT / SAT testing

• Installation, system integration, configuration and acceptance testing of Weibel radar systems

• Technical troubleshooting and diagnostics of complex system issues, both on site and remotely

• On-site mission support, including system setup, verification and performance assessment

• Preventive maintenance, technical upgrades and system modifications

• Analysis and documentation of system performance, technical findings and maintenance activities

• Root cause analysis of technical issues and development of recommendations for corrective actions

• Training of customer personnel in system operation and maintenance

We offer continuous training, and your responsibilities will increase as your expertise grows. Over time, you will develop deep technical knowledge of radar technology and the interaction between hardware, software and system performance, becoming a specialist within our systems and an important technical point of contact for both customers and colleagues.

The role includes international travel of up to 100 days per year, sometimes on short notice, and you must be able to travel freely within the EU and enter the United States under an ESTA permit or equivalent.

Your profile

We are looking for a technically curious engineer who enjoys understanding how complex systems work and solving problems that do not always have an obvious answer. You are motivated by combining analytical problem-solving with hands-on technical work and want to develop deep specialist knowledge within advanced radar systems.

You enjoy taking ownership of technical challenges, working systematically from problem to root cause, and applying your engineering knowledge in real-world environments. At the same time, you are comfortable working directly with customers and communicating technical topics in a clear and professional way.

We imagine that you bring:

• A relevant engineering or technical degree at minimum bachelor level, for example within electronics, electrical engineering, RF, mechatronics, automation, physics or similar

• Ability to read and interpret electrical, mechanical and RF schematics

• A good understanding of electronics, IT systems and the interaction between hardware and software

• A practical mindset and an interest in working hands-on with electronics, tools and test equipment

• An analytical and structured approach to troubleshooting and problem-solving

• Strong communication skills in written and spoken English

• As a person, you are curious, analytical and structured. You enjoy getting to the bottom of complex technical problems, remain calm when conditions change and communicate confidently with both colleagues and customers.

Please be aware that it is a requirement that you can provide a criminal record with no remarks and obtain security clearance.

Contact and application

Please apply at our website using the ‘Apply’ button.

If you have questions, you are very welcome to contact our Field Service Team Lead for Instrumentation, Nikolaj Skov Lillevang, at NISL@weibel.dk.

The deadline for your application is December 7th 2026.

We are looking forward to hearing from you.

Bliv en del af en dansk virksomhed

Weibel Scientific A/S er en danskejet ingeniørvirksomhed i kraftig vækst. Vi udvikler og producerer højteknologiske radarer til brug i bl.a. rumforskning, flyindustri, forsvar samt beskyttelse af kritisk infrastruktur. Vi er verdensførende inden for udvikling af Doppler-radarer og har siden vores etablering i 1977 leveret flere end 4.500 state-of-the art radarer til mere end 40 lande.

Vores hovedkvarter ligger i Allerød og beskæftiger knap 600 medarbejdere.

I Weibel kan du se frem til et spændende og udfordrende job i en dynamisk og fremtidsorienteret virksomhed med in-house produktion og højteknologisk udvikling.

Læs også meget mere om os på vores hjemmeside.

Do you want to build a new repair and service capability for Weibel's radar systems

At Weibel, we develop and produce advanced radar systems for customers across the world. As our installed base continues to grow, so does the need for a dedicated capability that can provide our customers with efficient and consistent support when their radar systems require spare part replacement, repair or system updates.

We are therefore establishing a new Repair & Service function within Aftermarket, covering both our Instrumentation and Surveillance radar systems. The ambition is to build a strong, independent capability that brings the competencies, team and processes together in one dedicated workshop.

Today, these activities draw on resources from Production and Field Service. By bringing the responsibility together we establish a specialized function within Aftermarket to improve turnaround time for our customers and enable Production and Field Service to focus on their core responsibilities. You will play a key role in turning that ambition into a strong, self-sufficient function.

Build the function from the ground up

You will report to our Aftermarket Director and take the lead in establishing and developing the new Repair & Service function.

You will shape the workshop, build the team and competencies and establish the processes needed to handle spare part replacements, repairs and system updates efficiently across our radar portfolio. You will have the opportunity to build your own area of responsibility and set the direction for how the function develops as it grows.

A strong customer perspective will be central to the role. You will take responsibility for the complete repair journey, from the moment a need is reported until the radar or component is repaired, updated and ready to return to operation. Short turnaround times, high quality and clear communication will be key measures of success.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Establishing the new Repair & Service workshop, including the physical setup, equipment and workflows

• Building and developing the team and the technical competencies needed to support our radar systems

• Establishing efficient processes for spare part replacement, repair, system updates and testing

• Leading and developing the team and setting clear direction and priorities as the function grows

• Developing the spare parts setup needed to support an efficient Repair & Service operation together with Production and Warehouse

• Building strong collaboration with Production, Field Service and relevant technical functions across Weibel

**How you will make a difference

**About The Role

**You will join a growing AI team of 19 talented colleagues with a shared mission: transforming data and AI into measurable business value for Flatpay and our merchants.

We are hiring Data Scientists across two areas: improving our KYC and Image AI products, and developing AI-powered customer service automations.

As a Data Scientist, you will design, build, and productionize GenAI and/or Machine Learning powered products and pipelines that support business-critical processes across the organization.

You will own the implementation of solutions together with colleagues from the AI team and the wider business. This includes understanding the underlying business problem, shaping the solution, building it, deploying it to production, and continuously improving it based on real-world performance.

The role is ideal for someone who combines strong GenAI and software engineering skills with the ability to communicate effectively with business stakeholders. You should enjoy turning ambiguous operational challenges into practical AI products that create measurable value.

We are looking for someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, takes ownership, and is comfortable engaging directly with stakeholders to pursue opportunities, align solutions with business needs, and continuously drive improvement.

What You'll Do

• Design, build, and maintain production-grade AI products and pipelines using Python, Databricks, and MLflow.

• Apply traditional machine learning and GenAI techniques, choosing the right approach based on the business problem, available data, and operational requirements.

• Work within one of our key focus areas:

• Customer service: Build GenAI and classical ML powered automations, including ticket classification, information retrieval, response assistance, and workflow automation.

• KYC & Image AI: Build document and image processing workflows that extract and validate information, populate application fields, and integrate with acquiring partners.

• Integrate models and AI applications with internal systems, APIs, and external platforms.

• Write clean, maintainable, and tested Python code, with monitoring, validation, guardrails, and fallback mechanisms appropriate to the use case.

• Evaluate solutions against relevant technical and business measures, including accuracy, reliability, latency, cost, and operational impact.

• Collaborate with data engineers and other technical teams to build on reliable, scalable, and well-governed data foundations.

• Work directly with stakeholders to understand processes, define requirements, and take solutions from proof of concept through production and ongoing improvement.

Who You Are

We are hiring across several focus areas and do not expect you to have experience in all of them. We are looking for a strong technical foundation, a practical approach to problem-solving, and relevant experience in the area you would join.

**Required

**

• You have 2–4 +years of industry experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, AI Engineering, or a similar technical role.

• You have strong Python skills and write clean, maintainable, and tested code.

• You understand core machine learning concepts, including data preparation, model evaluation, and validation.

• You have hands-on experience building solutions with traditional machine learning, GenAI, or a combination of both.

• You are comfortable working with SQL and data processing libraries such as Pandas.

• You understand what it takes to move a solution from prototype to production, including testing, monitoring, and reliability.

• You communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders and can translate business needs into practical technical solutions.

• You take ownership, enjoy learning, and care about building solutions that create measurable business value.

**Nice to Have - Depending on Your Focus Area

**Relevant experience in one or more of the areas below is a plus. You do not need to cover every area.

• Customer service and GenAI automation: Experience building LLM-powered applications using structured outputs, tool calling, RAG, or agents, particularly for ticket classification, response assistance, and workflow automation. Familiarity with Freshdesk or similar platforms is a plus.

Why Flatpay

You’ll be joining an ambitious, metric-driven, and fast-growing fintech company that believes in the power of personal connections, both with our customers and in the way we work with each other Working on early-stage products where you’ll have a sizeable impact on what gets built A modern office with an international and vibrant work environment with free slush ice, an in-office gym, a fully equipped gamer room and plenty of other fun things at the office! **SIEM Lead in the Cyber Defense team

**As SIEM Lead, you will be the owner of our SIEM application (Splunk Enterprise Security) used by TDC NET’s Cyber Defense team. Your work will help analysts detect and investigate threats across our IT systems and Denmark’s critical telecommunications infrastructure.

**About The Job

**Your focus will be the SIEM application, its detections and the workflows analysts use every day. A dedicated engineering team in another department operates the underlying platform. You will work with that team on security data requirements and with the Head of Analysts to prioritize improvements.

Our work is guided by threat intelligence. The wider Cyber Defense team covers detection and response, threat hunting, detection engineering, incident response and forensics, penetration testing and red teaming, vulnerability management, anti-abuse and security postmaster services.

Your responsibilities

• Own the SIEM application for the Cyber Defense team, defining its roadmap and priorities with the Head of Analysts and coordinating delivery with the engineering team.

• Assess gaps in SIEM capabilities, data coverage and investigation workflows, and turn findings into a prioritized improvement plan. Track progress through measures of coverage and alert quality.

• Maintain investigation dashboards, reusable searches and security context, including threat intelligence and asset and identity information used to enrich alerts.

• Define logging and data requirements for the engineering team. Validate that delivered data contains the fields, timestamps and context needed for detection and investigation.

• Act as the technical lead for SIEM analysis during major incidents, coordinating with incident response colleagues.

• Mentor analysts in SIEM use, alert analysis and investigation techniques, and review detection content and tuning decisions with the team.

• Validate detections with the Security Testing team through attack simulations and purple team exercises and follow up on missed or incomplete alerts.

Our Cyber Defense team is Trusted Introducer certified, and our Security Testing team is CREST certified.

You will join approximately 45 colleagues in TDC NET Security, with an open, informal working culture where people share knowledge and challenge ideas.

The Cyber Defense team operates a 24/7 on-call rotation. As Senior Security Analyst, you will participate in this rotation, investigating and responding to security incidents outside normal working hours.

**About You

**You are an experienced (3-5+ years of experience) security analyst with solid practical SIEM knowledge and the ability to turn operational needs into clear priorities. You can make sound decisions with incomplete information, coordinate technical analysis under pressure and communicate findings and uncertainty clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

**We Are Looking For Experience In The Following Areas

**

• Working with SIEM capabilities, data flows, integrations and application configuration in a production SOC or Cyber Defense environment.

• Taking ownership of a SIEM application, assessing gaps and defining a practical, prioritized roadmap in collaboration with analysts and platform engineers.

• Investigating incidents and hunting for threats using endpoint, identity, network and application logs, with an understanding of data quality and normalization.

• Using threat intelligence and MITRE ATT&CK to define detection requirements and identify gaps in coverage.

• Translating security needs into clear requirements for engineers and providing practical guidance to less experienced analysts.

• Understanding offensive techniques such as exploitation, privilege escalation and lateral movement, and the evidence they leave in logs.

• Using penetration tests, red team findings or purple team exercises to validate detections and close monitoring gaps.

• You must be able to maintain security clearance at HEMMELIGT (SECRET) level throughout your employment.

Experience with scripting, automation and version control is welcome.

Relevant higher education and security certifications are also welcome.

**Contact

**If you have questions about the position or want to know more about what it means to work at TDC NET, feel free to reach out to Cyber Defense Director Cristiano Iria at crii+cdc@tdcnet.dk

We look forward to reviewing your application and potentially welcoming you to our team at TDC NET.

Are you ready to help shape the future of hearing care? In this role, you will identify emerging technologies and turn promising opportunities into mature concepts that can inform GN Hearing’s future solutions.

In the role of Incubation & Technology Scouting Lead in the GN Hearing R&D organization, you will connect external technology intelligence with GN Hearing’s internal capabilities to mature early opportunities into validated concepts, prototypes and well-framed development initiatives.

The Team You Will Be Part Of

You will join GN Hearing’s R&D organization, where we develop advanced hearing solutions that support people with hearing loss in everyday life. Our work brings together expertise across audiology, acoustics, electronics, mechanics, embedded software, algorithms, fitting solutions and digital services.

You will work across a broad network of technical specialists, product teams and external partners. We are curious, collaborative and practical in our approach, combining exploration with a clear focus on bringing meaningful innovations closer to product development.

Your Contribution Is Appreciated, And You Will

• Scout and assess technology opportunities by monitoring emerging technologies, companies, suppliers, research and ecosystem developments relevant to GN Hearing’s technology and product strategy.

• Build actionable technology intelligence by maintaining the opportunity roadmap, knowledge base and internal expert network, and translating internal and external signals into recommendations for R&D leadership, product management and innovation teams.

• Evaluate and mature external opportunities through early technical dialogue, partner assessments and due diligence, with appropriate consideration for confidentiality, intellectual property, data and regulatory requirements.

• Turn opportunities into development-ready concepts by leading feasibility work, proof of concepts and early prototypes, and aligning cross-functional experts around system vision, interfaces, performance targets, risks and key assumptions.

To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:

• You bring an advanced degree in a related technical field.

• You may have experience in advanced R&D, hearing technology, medical-device development, systems engineering, innovation or technical product incubation.

• You bring deep technical knowledge into one or more relevant domains, such as acoustics, audiological algorithms, low-power electronics, embedded systems, connectivity, sensors, mechanical design, fitting systems, mobile software or AI and machine learning.

• You have experience moving early technology or product ideas from exploration through concept definition and proof of concept towards product development, including complex systems spanning devices, software and digital services.

About Zuuvi

Zuuvi is the Creative Infrastructure Platform: the governance, intelligence and production layer between brand strategy and market execution. Powered by The Brain, a private AI trained on each customer's own brand and performance data, we help enterprise brands and global agency networks – scale ads and go to market faster, without drifting their brand.

Purpose of the role

As Solution Architect, you own the solution architecture in Zuuvi's enterprise and partner opportunities: how Zuuvi fits into each customer's campaign supply chain, proving it works, and making sure what was sold is what goes live. Enterprise Sales owns the customer and the deal, Partnerships owns the partner relationships – you are their solution lead, before and after signature.

Just as important: you are an AI and vibe-coding ninja. You use AI agents, LLMs and AI coding tools to turn architecture into working prototypes, integrations and automations – and to operationalise customer solutions in days, not months.

Reports to: Head of Product

Location: Flexible - we hire the best candidate. Copenhagen HQ, US or remote in Europe, with regular travel.

Language: fluent English required.

What you'll do

1. Enterprise solutions – with the Enterprise Sales team

• Run technical discovery and design the target architecture: where Zuuvi sits in the customer's stack and how it connects upstream and downstream

• Vibe-code working prototypes on the customer's own data, deliver demos and security/IT reviews, and own the technical side of RFPs

• Scope and run POCs with clear success criteria, and translate the architecture into the scope and plan the proposal is built on

2. Partner solutions – with the Partnership team

• Design joint and white-label solutions on Zuuvi, integrated into partners' platforms and AI agents via API and MCP

• Enable partners' technical teams with reference architectures, integration guides and solution blueprints, and feed field insight back to Product

3. Post-sales – with Customer Success, Product and Engineering

• Hand over a solution design with integration specifications and acceptance criteria

• Lead complex implementations technically – templates, brand guardrails, data feeds, integrations and distribution – using AI to operationalise them fast

• Validate that the solution delivers the agreed outcomes, and design extensions as accounts grow

• Participate in strategic status meetings with clients and partners

What you bring

• 
10+ years in solution architecture, solutions consulting or sales engineering – ideally in adtech, martech or creative tech – as the solution lead in complex enterprise deals

• 
An AI and vibe-coding ninja: fluent with tools such as Claude Code or Cursor, AI agents, LLM APIs and MCP – and able to take prototypes to enterprise-ready solutions

• 
Integration expertise: REST APIs, webhooks, data feeds, SSO, cloud security and GDPR

• 
Deep knowledge of the campaign supply chain Zuuvi connects to, for example:

• 
Workflow and data: Workfront, Wrike, Salesforce, Adobe, Segment, Tealium

• 
Assets, content and commerce: Bynder, WoodWing, Akeneo, Informatica, Contentful, Shopify, Figma

• 
Channels: Meta, TikTok, Google Ads, DV360, The Trade Desk, Adform, DOOH, retail and owned media

• 
Measurement and formats: CM360, GA4, BI and MMM; HTML5, VAST, DCO and feed-based ads

• 
Commercial acumen: you build the technical case behind an ROI story and present confidently to CMOs, CTOs and IT security

• 
A true team player who makes account executives and partner managers more successful

What success looks like

3 months: You know the platform and its integration landscape, have joined live opportunities with Enterprise Sales and Partnerships, and delivered your first solution design and POC.

6 months: Solution lead on all strategic enterprise and partner opportunities, with a standard for solution design, POCs and handover in place.

12 months: Higher win rates and faster time-to-value on the deals you architect, and reference architectures for our key integrations.

What we offer

A central role alongside Enterprise Sales, Partnerships and Product, leading brands and agency networks, and a front-row seat in building Creative Infrastructure for the AI era. Competitive salary and benefits, with flexibility in where and how you work.

jobs.description:
**Job Description

Do you want to develop cutting-edge software applications for our world-leading products? Looking to use and grow your development skills in a fast-paced and creative environment? If this sounds like an exciting challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

About The Job Trackman products generate extremely accurate measurements using a patented combination of camera and radar, which provide valuable insights for athletes ranging from top worldclass professionals to enthusiastic amateurs, as well as coaches, scouts, and clubs of all levels.

As part of our company's continued expansion, we are looking for a .NET C# backend developer. You will join a department of 45+ skilled developers, responsible for applications used in golf, baseball, softball and football. You will be part of refinement, planning, implementation, testing and deployment to our customers.

We build applications hosted on distributed Linux servers running Docker, on Microsoft Azure technologies, on mobile devices and customer laptops. You will get to interact with skilled developers working across a range of platforms and apps. We always work with the latest LTS .NET version using C# with web frontends in React.

As part of our development toolkit, our teams actively use AI-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude to speed up coding, testing, and documentation — letting our developers spend more time on solving interesting problems and less on repetitive tasks.

You will join a team of skilled developers who love what they do and, in a role, where you can have a big impact both on what is being built and how it is built. We value having our developers being part of refinement and you will be deeply involved in finding great solutions from a technical as well as a user perspective together with our Head of Products and UI/UX designers.

**Job Requirements

**Required skills:

• 3+ years of working with .NET and excellent C# programming skills

• Professional usage of an IDE like Visual Studio or Rider

• Work in an agile environment with a strong focus on collaboration, knowledge sharing, and clear communication

• Good understanding of architectural patterns and software design principles

• Good communication skills and a positive and proactive mindset

• Experience with Git

Additional skills (not required, but nice to have):

• Experience with using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude)

• Experience with Docker and Azure Pipelines

All we ask is that you bring passion, curiosity and structure to our workplace. We are a company of many nationalities. Whether you are from abroad or already living in Denmark, we welcome talented people of any gender, nationality and belief. We think the right mix of people makes for the best culture and product.

At Trackman, we see AI not as a replacement for great developers, but as a tool that makes great developers even more effective — accelerating code reviews, catching bugs earlier, and freeing up time for the creative problem-solving that moves our products forward.

The IT landscape is evolving faster than ever and staying up to date with AI-assisted development is quickly becoming a fundamental part of the software development process.

**The Office

**We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

**Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

**Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

**Where innovation happens

**At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

**Share our Passion!

**Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.
