**Our infrastructure relies heavily on external partners, managed service providers, and vendors. We're looking for someone engaged, who will ensure that our suppliers deliver as agreed in terms of scope, budget and schedule.

In this role, you will be the person who holds suppliers accountable, runs the operational reviews, and steps in before a delayed delivery or an unresolved ticket turns into a business problem.

You will work closely with the HO IT Infrastructure to ensure that services are performing as expected.

**What The Job Is

**

• Run operational vendor management: Act as the primary operational contact for our infrastructure and network suppliers.

• Enforce SLAs and deliverables: Track performance metrics closely. When a supplier misses an SLA or slips on a deadline, you address it early and drive the remediation plan.

• Lead structured reviews: Chair regular service reviews (monthly/quarterly), track action items, and ensure unresolved operational issues are followed through to completion.

• Partner with IT Procurement: Provide the operational data needed for contract renewals, dispute discussions, and vendor scorecards.

• Handle escalations: Intervene when standard operational channels stall.

**How Will You Contribute To The Team

**

• Proven background: Solid experience in a Service Delivery, Vendor Management, or IT Operations role within an enterprise environment.

• Infrastructure knowledge: A practical understanding of enterprise IT (cloud hosting, networks, on-prem hardware, data centers, security platforms). You must be able to follow technical discussions, challenge timelines and spot when a vendor is giving vague answers.

• Commercial and contract awareness: Hands-on experience working against contracts, Statements of Work (SOWs), and strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

• Communication style: Firm, diplomatic, and articulate. You need to be able to say "no" or "this isn't acceptable" clearly and professionally.On the other hand, you would also be able to build good relations to continue the good corporation with our suppliers

• Languages: Professional fluency in English (written and spoken). Danish language skills are a plus. Structured as a person (especially in written form).

**Pluses (not Hard Requirements)

**

• Practical knowledge about ITIL frameworks

• Daily experience working on platforms like ServiceNow, and Jira.

• Experience operating within multi-vendor setups and international organizations.

• Financial understanding

**What does your next challenge look like?

**At SATAIR, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.

We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan.

In Satair, you can challenge the status quo, pioneer new ways of working, and generate real value for airlines and suppliers worldwide.

Being part of the Airbus family gives us the opportunity to live a global mindset, working in international and diverse teams and collaborating across functions, sites and cultures.

If you want to work as one team embracing a can-do attitude in a demanding environment, then we offer a great place to explore, learn, and grow, making an impact on aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

_Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company!

_**About SATAIR

**Satair is an Airbus Services company offering first-class material management solutions in the aviation aftermarket industry. We take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience around the clock, driving innovation, and contributing to aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

With our global functional organisation spanning 12 sites and locations worldwide, and a team of over 2,000 people supporting a $3.9 billion turnover, you will be part of a truly global company that continues to grow year after year.

Welcome to the Satair family!

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

**What do we offer at SATAIR?

**At SATAIR, you will find much more than a job - we offer you the possibility of growing both your personal and professional capacities in a fun, supportive and informal working environment, where you will be encouraged to engage, share knowledge and ideas.

SATAIR is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We love to bring in people with different backgrounds and experiences as we believe it enhances our performance immensely!

Here is a selection of some of the benefits we offer our employees in Copenhagen:

Financial Benefits: Competitive salary, Employee Stock Ownership Program, Success sharing, Health insurance, Group accident insurance, Employee discounts to local businesses

Employee Health and Wellbeing: On-site gym, App-based health & wellbeing platform, Amazing canteen at a subsided price, Massage scheme

Learning and Development: Airbus Leadership University, Large number of e-learning and training offers for personal and professional development, Promotion of professional development (e.g. postgraduate studies, technician training), Possibility of mentoring, Gain international experience

Work-life blend and life phase support: Possibility to work remotely, 4 care days, Senior days, Working from home policy (2 days remote per week)

Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company

Please send us your application as soon as possible to get the opportunity to become part of an exceptional global team!

We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

When applying for the position, you accept our data privacy statement: _http://www.SATAIR.com/privacy

_This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

**ORDERYOYO – Senior Data & AI Platform Engineer

**Remote

• Quarterly team gatherings in one of our global offices

Join OrderYOYO’s Data team to build the data pipelines and lakehouse that power executive reporting and merchant insights across our platform, and automate how we deliver finance data and AI-driven data products to the rest of the business.

You’ll own complex changes from technical design through release and production operation, working closely with the leadership team, Finance, Product and fellow engineers. Your work will improve the accuracy and reliability of our reporting, merchant insights and finance data, while reducing routine manual Finance work.

Our data platform runs in a Microsoft Azure cloud environment, and we’re moving it to Microsoft Fabric. We value transferable experience: strong Azure Databricks or Synapse engineers who can quickly develop deep Fabric expertise are encouraged to apply. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a pure architecture, BI or people-management position, and you’ll regularly design, code, troubleshoot and operate production data solutions.

**Role Mission

**Build and evolve OrderYOYO’s data platform into a single source of truth for executive reporting, merchant insights, finance automation and AI, leading the move to a modern Microsoft Fabric lakehouse. You’ll help strengthen the reliability and quality of our data in production while building AI into how we deliver data products and supporting our growing international restaurant platform.

**Core Responsibilities

**

• Design, build and operate production-grade data solutions in Microsoft Fabric across Lakehouse, Warehouse, notebooks, pipelines and related platform capabilities.

• Build and run production pipelines in Fabric, Python and PySpark that are tested and maintainable, not just notebooks.

• Design ingestion and transformation patterns that scale across multiple source systems, databases and business domains while controlling source impact, concurrency and platform cost.

• Manage Fabric capacity and cost, and retire redundant legacy layers.

• Lead migrations from legacy to modern platforms with metric parity, stakeholder sign-off, change control and safe decommissioning.

• Run the platform in production: monitoring, alerting, incident triage, root-cause analysis, data-quality checks, lineage and runbooks.

• Diagnose and resolve production issues across SQL, Spark, pipelines and semantic models, including performance degradation, data failures and capacity/resource constraints.

• Support and evolve governed semantic models and reusable metric definitions, working closely with analytics and business stakeholders to ensure performance, consistency and reliability.

• Build AI into the platform and our delivery: RAG, Azure OpenAI and agents, with prompt and version management.

• Deliver applied data science such as churn, recommendations, personalisation, fraud or risk models, and show the results.

• Work with executives, Finance, Product and engineering, and judge when to move fast, standardise, automate or hold.

**Must-have Requirements

**

• 8+ years of relevant data experience, including substantial recent hands-on data engineering or data-platform engineering responsibility in production environments.

• Demonstrated ability to independently take a data-engineering problem from requirements and technical design through implementation, production deployment, monitoring and ongoing operation.

• Deep hands-on Microsoft Fabric, or strong Synapse, Databricks or Delta experience with a clear path to Fabric.

• Strong understanding of lakehouse architecture and Delta-based data engineering, including partitioning, schema evolution, file optimisation and performance considerations.

• Expert SQL and T-SQL, including complex modelling and tuning.

• Production-grade Python or PySpark.

• Strong experience designing and implementing incremental data ingestion patterns, including approaches such as CDC, change tracking or watermarks, with reliable merge/upsert, replay and idempotent processing.

• Experience with analytical and semantic data modelling, ideally with Power BI/Fabric semantic models, including performance optimisation, governance and reusable business metrics.

• Working knowledge of Azure platform fundamentals including Azure SQL, ADLS/OneLake, Entra ID, managed identities, RBAC and Key Vault.

• A track record of leading a legacy-to-modern migration.

• Real, hands-on AI engineering beyond out-of-the-box Copilot.

• Concrete data science or ML models you delivered, with results.

**Strong-to-have Experience

**

• Strong Power BI/Fabric experience, including Direct Lake, DAX, semantic model performance tuning, incremental refresh and capacity considerations.

• Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Terraform, Bicep or equivalent tooling.

• Data platform experience in SaaS, marketplace, fintech, payments, e-commerce or multi-region businesses.

**Who We Are

**At OrderYOYO, company culture comes first. We create a positive, inclusive environment where people are trusted to do their best work and take ownership of what they build. We look for engineers who take ownership, raise risks early, explain decisions clearly, collaborate respectfully and follow through on commitments.

Our values describe what that looks like day to day:

• Passion: Adaptable and positive in a fast-moving environment, proactive about improving how things work.

• Action: Leads by example and takes the initiative rather than waiting to be asked.

• Compassion: Supports colleagues and considers the impact of decisions on merchants and teammates.

• One Team: Communicates clearly in writing and in person, stays calm under pressure and shares information openly.

We help restaurants succeed online by providing branded websites, mobile apps and tailored marketing solutions, giving them full control of their business. By removing high commission fees charged by third-party platforms, we empower restaurants to grow sustainably.

**What We Offer

**

• A salary of up to £75,000 per year (or local equivalent).

• A remote role, with quarterly in-person gatherings at one of our global offices.

• Ownership of a business-critical data and AI platform.

• A collaborative, international engineering team.

Join Copenhagen Energy Trading as our next Quantitative Researcher - Algorithmic Trading (Short-term Power Markets)

Copenhagen Energy Trading (CET) shapes the future of the energy transition by combining deep market expertise with technical excellence in data, quantitative research and engineering to drive, automate and optimise our trading operations.

We’re a small, elite team based in central Copenhagen specializing in power trading and asset management across Europe and North America. Technology is core to how we operate, powered by exceptional talent and one of Europe’s most advanced automated and analytical trading environments for power markets. But we're not done. We want to push automation and advanced analytics even further, and to do that we need more exceptional people.

The Opportunity

That’s where you come in. We’re looking for an outstanding Quantitative Researcher with a proven track record of building real-time algorithmic trading strategies that operate with high reliability in regulated industries. You'll play a key role in developing strategies for the European short-term power markets.

This isn't a narrow coding or analyst role. You'll have an end-to-end mandate, from prototyping and data engineering to strategy implementation, backtesting and low-latency execution in our algorithmic trading framework. You'll own your projects from idea to P&L, working autonomously alongside a close-knit group of software engineers, quantitative researchers and expert traders.

So, if you feel energized by the intersection of markets, advanced analytics and trading technology and you want to help build something that moves power to where it’s needed the most, then we must talk.

Responsibilities

• Research and model the markets: Analyse energy market dynamics and turn your insights into predictive models that drive profitable trading strategies.

• Own the data: Build and maintain high-quality datasets that combine fundamental and real-time market data.

• Take strategies to production and keep them running: Own the path from research to live trading, shaping the systems, forecasting tools and data pipelines that run our strategies in real time. Once they're live, you'll monitor their performance, handle issues as they come up and make sure they trade reliably day to day.

• Shape the team's direction: Work closely with engineers, quantitative researchers and traders to challenge ideas, share expertise and influence where we take our algorithmic trading next.

• Master the domain: Become a domain expert and understand algorithmic trading architectures and order execution logic in the short-term power markets.

Who are you?

You have:

• Quantitative expertise: A track record of building accurate forecasting models and trading strategies for financial or energy markets, with a rigorous approach to research and validation.

• Software and data skills: Advanced Python skills, and the ability to write clean, efficient, reliable code, backed by solid computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, system design). Strong data skills, from sourcing and cleaning to structuring complex datasets. Some experience with C++ would be a plus.

• Ownership: The ability to work independently and deliver in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong communication: Excellent problem-solving and communication skills with full professional proficiency in English.

• Domain knowledge: A genuine interest in learning about power markets and systems. If you already have that domain knowledge, then that is a big plus.

• Education: An advanced degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science or Engineering.

What We Offer

• Growth environment: Be part of a young, ambitious, and expanding tech-driven trading company where talented people are given responsibility and room to grow.

• Exceptional team: Work closely with experienced quantitative researchers, software engineers and power traders.

• Competitive compensation and flexibility: Receive a competitive salary package with benefits and enjoy flexible work arrangements that support your work-life balance.

• Strong culture: Participate in both social and professional events, including team sports, company parties, teambuilding and informal gatherings that strengthen our team spirit.

• Central Copenhagen location: Work from our office in Carlsberg Byen, located in beautifully renovated historic Carlsberg buildings.

About Copenhagen Energy Trading

Copenhagen Energy Trading A/S was founded in 2021 and is part of Copenhagen Energy Group.

We specialize in short-term power trading across Europe and North America. Through technology, data, and market expertise, we develop discretionary and algorithmic trading strategies that help move power to where it is needed most.

Based in Copenhagen, we are building a collaborative, high-performance environment where talented people are trusted with responsibility and given the freedom to make an impact.

How to apply

If this opportunity feels like the right fit for you, we would love to hear from you.

Please apply via LinkedIn and submit your cover letter, CV, and university transcripts as a single PDF. Please note that applications that do not meet these requirements may not be considered.

If you have any questions, please contact Jens Christian Johannsen at jc@copenhagen-energy.com or Anna Schumann at as@copenhagen-energy.com.

jobs.occupation: Mid Level Backend Engineer - Financial Services
jobs.description:
💰🇩🇰 up to 48,000 DKK/month gross _(varies by seniority)

_**About Monta

**Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you’ll do well with us.

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully — and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people — sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You’ll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

The Role

We're looking for an Engineer to join our Financial Services team, the team responsible for every euro that flows through Monta's platform. This is a hands-on individual contributor role where you'll own delivery of meaningful pieces of our financial systems and grow your expertise in the domain, helping us scale reliably as we expand across Europe.

Financial Services is at an inflection point. Our transaction volume is growing fast and already processes millions of euros each month. We're building the next generation of our financial infrastructure, including new billing models and compliance capabilities to support expansion into new EU markets. The problems are hard, the stakes are real, and the work matters.

We need someone who takes ownership of what they build. You'll own medium-sized projects from design through to production, working independently within your team and delivering quality outcomes.

You should also be someone who has embraced AI as a core part of how you work. We use Claude Code extensively across the Financial Services team for everything from writing and reviewing code to designing systems and exploring financial domain problems. We expect you to be an advanced AI user who actively finds new ways to leverage these tools to move faster and think better.

**This Is What You Will Achieve

**

• Help rebuild Monta's financial backbone. You'll contribute to the new invoicing system that every customer will use, owning meaningful slices of the new infrastructure.

• Power EU expansion. You'll build features within our compliance infrastructure (e-invoicing, fiscalization, VAT) that enables Monta to enter new European markets.

• Strengthen the money flow. You'll improve the reliability and scalability of payment processing, reconciliation, and withdrawal systems across a rapidly growing transaction volume.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Deliver core parts of the new invoice system. Build features within the new invoicing architecture that supports multiple billing models and financial flows, owning your slice end-to-end and contributing to design discussions.

• Build and scale compliance infrastructure. E-invoicing across European markets. Fiscalization integrations. A VAT engine that handles the complexity of cross-border EV charging.

• Improve payment flows from card to payout. Card payments, automated reconciliation, withdrawal reliability, and working capital management.

• Collaborate across Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, and Product to deliver new billing and commercial models. You won't work in a silo.

• Build for systems that must be right. Every euro must be traceable from summary down to line item. You'll write code with auditability, correctness, and scale in mind, and contribute to design discussions for new components.

• Grow with the team. Contribute through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing, and help onboard new joiners as you grow into the domain.

What We’re Looking For

• Solid backend engineering experience. You've built and shipped production systems and you write clean, maintainable code. Java/Kotlin preferred, but strong engineers from other stacks are welcome.

• Some exposure to financial systems is a plus. Billing, invoicing, payment processing, or similar domains where correctness matters — but we'll help you grow the depth.

• A sense of ownership. You take responsibility for what you ship, follow it through to production, and flag issues early rather than waiting to be asked.

• Comfortable asking questions and learning fast. Regulatory and financial domains have a lot of nuance — you bring curiosity and a willingness to dig in.

• Curiosity about financial infrastructure. Invoicing, VAT, compliance, payment flows. You don't need to be a domain expert on day one, but you're eager to go deep.

• Advanced AI adoption. You already use AI tools daily in your engineering workflow and you're always looking for new ways to apply them. You don't just accept suggestions, you prompt deliberately, iterate on output, and integrate AI into how you design, build, and debug.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, finance, legal, and product. You build alignment fast and communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders.

**Bonus

**

• Experience with EU financial regulations, e-invoicing standards, or fiscalization

• Experience with payment service providers or payment infrastructure

• Familiarity with event-driven architectures (Kafka) or high-throughput data processing

**If the mission excites you but your experience isn't a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway. We care about potential, not perfection.

**AI at Monta Engineering

AI is central to how we build software at Monta. It's not a side experiment. It's embedded in our daily work and we expect every engineer to be a power user.

**Tools We Use Daily

**

• Claude Code for writing, reviewing, and refactoring code, exploring domain problems, and building internal tooling

• Claude / Gemini for research, design thinking, and documentation

• Notion AI for docs, knowledge management, and meeting notes

• AI-enhanced testing and monitoring

We expect you to bring a strong opinion on how to use AI effectively in engineering. If you've built custom workflows, pushed the limits of agentic coding, or found creative ways to use LLMs in your development process, you'll fit right in.

Why Monta

• Impact, not easy mode — your work matters, and you’ll feel it every day.

• Ownership from day one — we don’t micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• The people are extraordinary — talented, driven, and fun to work with. You’ll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure

**What We Offer

**

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life’s big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you’re at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

**Please send us your application in English.

**To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you’ll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don’t accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won’t agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

Monta is building the platform that powers the future of EV charging. We connect hardware, software, businesses, and drivers into one seamless ecosystem. Our mission is to make charging simple, reliable, and scalable for everyone.

**Your role and opportunity

**As a Project Management Intern, you’ll support the coordination of our Project Management student assistant team and contribute to day-to-day project activities. You’ll work with experienced colleagues and gain insight into how project teams operate in a CDMO environment.

The role combines team coordination, administrative and operational support, and a defined project or workstream. You’ll receive structured onboarding, guidance from a designated manager and opportunities to learn from Project Managers. Your responsibilities will develop as you gain experience and understand the team’s processes.

**What You’ll Do

****Student team coordination

**

• Help coordinate the work of the Project Management student assistant team, which includes approximately eight students.

• Support task visibility and follow up on agreed updates, availability and actions.

• Help facilitate student team meetings and maintain the team’s task overview.

• Flag blockers or missed updates to the appropriate manager or Project Assistant.

**Project and operational support

**

• Support Project Managers with administrative and coordination activities.

• Help report Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and support the uploading and tracking of Project Change Orders, working with relevant stakeholders.

• Support the coordination of shipments, including associated deviation documentation for products in quarantine, in line with applicable procedures and under appropriate guidance.

• Follow up on stability protocols and help ensure reports are delivered to customers.

• Upload and update key project milestones.

• Contribute to other departmental activities, such as meeting minutes, records management or Project Improvement Plans, as appropriate.

**Customer And Project Experience

**

• When trained and authorised, support customer visits, including accompanying customers during approved tours of the production facility.

• Take ownership of a defined departmental project or workstream, with an agreed scope, milestones and a designated contact for guidance.

**What You’ll Learn

**During the internship, you’ll have the opportunity to develop practical skills in:

• Team coordination and professional communication.

• Meeting preparation, facilitation and action tracking.

• Project documentation, prioritisation and follow-up.

• Relevant department tools and processes.

• Cross-functional collaboration and customer-focused work.

• Project delivery through a defined piece of work.

Regular check-ins will provide an opportunity to discuss your progress, workload, feedback and learning goals.

**Who We’re Looking For

**You’re currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Design, Bio-entrepreneurship or a related field. You’re interested in project management and motivated to contribute in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

**We’re Looking For Someone Who Is

**

• Service-oriented: You care about providing a positive experience for customers and colleagues.

• Adaptable and proactive: You respond constructively to changing priorities, ask questions and take initiative.

• Organised and reliable: You can keep track of actions, follow through and raise issues when something is unclear.

• A clear communicator: You communicate professionally in English and work well with people in different roles and teams.

• Professional and collaborative: You bring a positive attitude, respect internal procedures and are comfortable learning with support.

**Practical details

**

• Type: Paid internship

• Duration: Six months

• Working hours: Full-time, 37 hours per week, with some flexibility

If you’re ready to challenge yourself, learn from experienced colleagues and contribute to work that supports a meaningful mission, we’d love to hear from you.

**How To Apply

**Please submit your application and CV through the AGC Biologics career site. We do not accept applications by email.

**Deadline: 29 November 2026.

**Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the vacancy before the application deadline if a suitable candidate is identified.

_**Please note that AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark.

**_**We look forward to receiving your application!

****Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

Svitzer offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to how we strengthen our commercial capabilities across a global organisation. We have ambitious growth plans, which you will support as the Commercial Excellence Partner.

Further, you will drive the development and implementation of commercial processes, tools and insights that help our commercial teams perform at their best. Working with colleagues across regions, you will help turn commercial priorities into practical ways of working that strengthen customer focus and support profitable growth.

You will be part of the Global Commercial Team and work closely with commercial colleagues across our four regions, as well as colleagues across Operations, Finance, Strategy and other Global Functions. The role is based in our Headquarters in Nordhavn, Copenhagen, and you will report to the Head of Commercial Excellence & Commercial Operations.

**About Us

**Svitzer is a leading global towage operator with 4,500 colleagues and a fleet of 510 vessels operating across more than 35 countries. Every day, we help keep ports open, terminals operating and global trade moving through safe, reliable and increasingly sustainable marine services. If you would like to see our tugboats in action and learn more, visit our website and watch this short video: Svitzer Introduces TRAnsverse Tug.

**What We Offer

**At Svitzer, we are a truly people-centric company with safety at our core, driven to innovate and succeed together, with our customers’ interests in focus.

You will become part of an ambitious global organisation where commercial drive and accountability go hand in hand with collaboration across cultures. You will be encouraged to take ownership and have the opportunity to help shape the role in our fairly new team. We offer flexible ways of working and room to develop.

**Responsibilities

**In this role, you will:

• Drive the implementation of Svitzer’s Commercial Excellence agenda, helping translate commercial priorities into practical frameworks, tools and ways of working.

• Support the development and continuous improvement of commercial processes, tools and methodologies that enable consistent and effective commercial execution.

• Run Svitzer’s annual NPS process, including gathering and analysing input and helping translate customer feedback into relevant actions.

• Drive the Key Customer Programme for Svitzer, which entails establishing best practices for our main key accounts.

• Support commercial planning, customer segmentation and performance management across regions.

• Help strengthen commercial capabilities through training, knowledge-sharing and practical support to regional and local commercial teams.

• Analyse commercial data, insights and performance measures and use these to support commercial decision-making.

• Contribute to the development of customer value propositions and commercial approaches that reflect customer needs and Svitzer’s strategic priorities.

• Work with regional and local commercial teams to support the adoption of common tools and processes, while recognising different market needs.

• Facilitate knowledge-sharing and exchange of commercial best practices across regions.

• Identify and suggest improvements to how we collaborate with a focus on simplicity, customer value and effective execution.

**Who We Are Looking For

**We are looking for a commercially minded professional with strong analytical skills and an interest in developing how commercial teams work and perform. You probably have 5–7 years of experience in a commercial role.

You enjoy collaborating with colleagues across functions, regions and cultures and are comfortable working on several initiatives and stakeholder relationships at the same time. You combine analytical thinking with a practical mindset and enjoy turning ideas and insights into solutions that can be used in the business.

**In Particular, We Are Looking For Someone Who Brings

**

• A valid work and residence permit for Denmark (this is a must).

• Good business and commercial understanding, including an understanding of how customer needs can turn into commercial outcomes.

• Relevant experience from Commercial Excellence, business development, commercial operations, pricing, sales effectiveness or a related area.

• Experience working with or improving commercial processes, tools and frameworks.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn data and insights into clear conclusions and recommendations.

• Good project-management and coordination skills.

• The ability to build effective working relationships with diverse stakeholders.

• A pragmatic and collaborative approach and an ability to make complex topics practical and understandable.

• Good communication and presentation skills.

• Experience from an international organisation is an advantage.

• Fluency in English.

You do not need to meet every requirement to apply. We value diverse experiences and are interested in your motivation, potential and ability to grow in the role.

**How To Apply

**To ensure a consistent and fair recruitment process, please submit your CV and a motivational letter via the “Apply” button on our Svitzer Careers page. Applications submitted outside the system cannot be considered. Please leave out information about age, gender, religion or other factors not related to the role. A photo is not required.

**Deadline

**The deadline for your application is 30 November 2026. However, we review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the job advertisement earlier if we receive a strong field of qualified candidates.

**Questions

**To ensure a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we will not respond to questions in advance of interviews. Relevant questions can be addressed during the interview process.

**Building a Diverse Workplace

**In Svitzer we value the diversity of our talent and will always strive to recruit the best person for the job – we value diversity in all its forms, including but not limited to gender, age, nationality, race, sexual orientation, disability, or religious beliefs. We are proud of our diversity and see it as a genuine source of strength for building high performing teams.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that members from some under-represented groups are less likely to apply for jobs if they don’t meet every single qualification. At Svitzer we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles, and we are excited about hearing from you!

**How To Apply

**To apply for this role, please click on the 'Apply Now' button and create a Candidate Home to manage your applications.

jobs.description:
**The Impact You'll Make

jobs.occupation: PhD Scholarship in Nonlinear Nanophotonics: Trapping Light for Extreme Light–Matter Interactions - DTU Electro
jobs.description:
Are you an experimental physicist eager to push light–matter interaction to its extremes? 

We offer a PhD scholarship at DTU Electro, where you will trap light in nanoscale optical cavities coupled to highly nonlinear 2D materials, and control them to let light interact with light far more strongly than conventional devices allow.

To trap and release light on demand, we use photonic crystal cavities in thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN), whose strong electro-optic effect allows fast electrical control. Our team has recently demonstrated ultracompact TFLN cavities used as modulators [1], with electrically controllable coupling to waveguides [2], and as multiport switches [3]. The project builds on these results and shares fabrication efforts with our collaborators at Harvard University, who pioneered the TFLN platform [4].

Photons interact only through a material nonlinearity, and in conventional static cavities the interaction time is fundamentally bounded, which dynamically coupled cavities can overcome [5]. You will combine such cavities with atomically thin 2D semiconductors with exceptionally strong nonlinearities to explore a largely uncharted dynamic regime of nonlinear optics, aiming to generate quantum states of light, such as squeezed light, at ultralow energies. The project is part of the Center for Nanophotonics (NanoPhoton), a Center of Excellence funded by the Danish National Research Foundation.

Responsibilities and qualifications
You will drive the experimental work in the project from device design to demonstration, working closely with PhD students, postdocs, and senior researchers at DTU and our collaborators at Harvard University. Depending on your interests, you will have the opportunity to:

• Design photonic crystal cavities and circuits using electromagnetic and multiphysics simulations.
• Fabricate devices in DTU Nanolab’s state-of-the-art cleanroom.
• Integrate 2D materials with photonic chips.
• Characterize devices using high-speed electro-optic, pulsed-laser, and quantum-optical measurements.
• Compare your experiments with theoretical models of cavity dynamics.
• Present your results at international conferences and in leading journals.
You are curious and driven, enjoy hands-on laboratory work, and take ownership of the progress and quality of your work.

Required qualifications:

• A strong background in optics or photonics.
• Experimental experience in optics or photonics, e.g., from your master’s project.
• Programming experience in Python.
You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Desired qualifications:

• Nanofabrication or integrated photonics.
• Nonlinear or quantum optics, or 2D materials.
Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

Assessment
Assessment of the candidates will be carried out by Associate Professor Mikkel Heuck and Professor Jesper Mørk.

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The period of employment is 3 years.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information 
Further information may be obtained from Associate Professor Mikkel Heuck (mheu@dtu.dk).

You can read more about our department at www.electro.dtu.dk.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 8 December 2026 (23:59 Danish time).

Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

You will join a research team at DTU Electro that is part of NanoPhoton, an interdisciplinary center that brings together several DTU departments. NanoPhoton is a highly collaborative and international community of PhD students, postdocs, senior researchers and professors, where theorists and experimentalists work side by side. We value curiosity, openness and helping each other. Questions are always welcome, and experienced colleagues will help you get started in the laboratory and cleanroom.

DTU Electro 
DTU Electro employs more than 300 skilled researchers with competencies in electrical and photonics engineering. As a department, we strive towards creating sustainable energy and a greener internet, as well as strengthening cyber security and health technology. Working with industry and public organizations is one of our top priorities to find and implement new solutions to our society. We aim to offer education, research, and innovation of the highest standard, and our focus on application-oriented research enables us to work across many engineering disciplines and research areas, such as IT and the medical and health sciences. We have a close collaboration with researchers from all over the world, just as we collaborate with industry and public authorities about the dissemination of solutions based on electrical and photonics engineering as their key enabling technologies. 

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Macroscopic Quantum States for Sensing and Fundamental Physics - DTU Physics
jobs.description:
Are you intrigued by quantum physics and excited about the novel opportunities emerging from quantum technologies? Do you want to explore how quantum optomechanics and quantum information science can shed light on open questions in fundamental physics by probing the limits of quantum mechanics?

At the Section for Quantum Physics and Information Technology (QPIT), we are seeking an excellent and highly motivated PhD candidate to work on the study of quantum states of macroscopic systems of light and matter. In particular, on the development of novel protocols for generating and controlling macroscopic states in optomechanical systems, quantifying their macroscopicity, and exploiting them for precision sensing and for exploring the limits of quantum theory and potentially probing quantum gravity. The work will be theoretical, in close collaboration with our local experimental team and international collaborators.

At QPIT you will be part of bigQ - Center for Macroscopic Quantum States - a Danish national Center of Excellence in quantum information science and technology. The purpose of the center is to explore quantum physics in new macroscopic regimes, deepening our understanding of quantum physics, and speeding up the development of emerging quantum technologies. While our main focus is curiosity-driven research, we also support innovation, interdisciplinary collaborations and industry partnerships. The center offers a stimulating and diverse working environment, comprising more than 60 people (with about 23 nationalities) including faculty members, PhD students, postdocs, engineers and administrators.

Responsibilities and qualifications
We are looking for outstanding physicists who are driven and curious. We expect you to have a strong ability to conceive new ideas, take initiative, and take ownership of your projects. Documented experience, e.g. from studies, projects, or thesis work, with several of the following topics is an advantage:

• Theoretical quantum information science
• Quantum optics
• Quantum optomechanics
• Quantum metrology/sensing
• Open quantum systems
In addition, we expect you to:

• be motivated and dedicated to do research of the highest standards.
• enjoy working in a team, be excited about sharing your expertise with other group members, and be open to new ideas,
• share our values of scientific curiosity and creativity.
• be open and honest and conduct research responsibly.
• be excited about large challenges and enjoy solving them.
• have an extraordinary drive towards achieving groundbreaking results.
• love physics discussions and participating in thoughtful conversations.
You should hold (or complete before starting) a master’s degree in physics, applied mathematics or related fields and have excellent analytical skills.

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms 
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The period of employment is 3 years. The starting date is 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information
Further information may be obtained from Associate Professor Jonatan Bohr Brask, jobb@dtu.dk. 

You can read more about the Department of Physics at https://physics.dtu.dk/. 

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 8 December 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

At DTU Physics, we carry out cutting-edge research in modern physics, with particular focus on four main areas: quantum technology, sustainable energy, materials, and biophysics. Our focus is both to acquire greater knowledge about basic scientific problems and to conduct research oriented towards use in societies and companies.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

You will have the opportunity to grow your expertise in a domain that sits at the centre of Danske Bank's strategic direction, working alongside colleagues from a wide range of disciplines.

This position can be located both in Denmark and Lithuania (no relocation package included). If the position is located in Lithuania, the salary range will be from 3920 EUR to 5880 EUR gross (based on your competencies relevant for the job) and your job function (position) in the job contract will be Technology Business Solutions.

**Have we caught your attention?

**Apply now! We process applications continuously, so we encourage you to apply sooner rather than later.

For more information, please contact Hiring Manager Michael Friis Bak on mras@danskebank.dk or Cluster Lead Mikkel Winther mikkelw@danskebank.dk.

**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the teams by creating or helping create great guest experiences, and use every day as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer or staff member; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of people who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You'll learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path—our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**We are looking for an FP&A Specialist to strengthen our Corporate FP&A team and take ownership of cash flow forecasting, balance sheet planning, working capital management, and other key planning activities below Adjusted EBITDA across the Group.

Reporting directly to the Head of FP&A, you will play a key role in advancing our financial planning capabilities and driving transparency across cash flow, liquidity, and balance sheet performance. You will work closely with Accounting, Tax, Controlling, regional Finance teams, and key business stakeholders to ensure robust planning processes and high-quality management reporting.

This is a unique opportunity to:

• Take ownership of the Group's cash flow, balance sheet, and working capital planning agenda, helping to improve cash generation and support management decision-making.

• Shape and develop our Workday Adaptive Planning capabilities, leading key initiatives to establish scalable planning models and reporting structures.

• Work across markets and functions, partnering with regional Finance teams and senior stakeholders to strengthen forecasting, reporting, and business insight throughout the organization.

The successful candidate will help establish best-in-class planning processes that connect P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow forecasting, providing management with greater visibility into liquidity, working capital performance, and long-term value creation. The role is a full-time role and reports to the Head of Group Financial Planning & Analysis.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Own the Group's cash flow planning across forecast, budget, and long-range planning cycles.

• Drive the development of balance sheet forecasting capabilities and ensure alignment between P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow planning.

• Lead the implementation and continuous development of cash flow and balance sheet planning models in Workday Adaptive Planning.

• Define business requirements and partner closely with the BI Team to improve planning processes, reporting capabilities, and system functionality.

• Partner with Accounting, Controlling, Tax, and regional Finance teams to strengthen cash flow and balance sheet reporting, improve forecast accuracy, and establish clear ownership across planning activities.

• Develop and maintain monthly cash flow, balance sheet, and working capital reporting, including variance analysis, key risks and opportunities, and actionable management insights.

• Establish and maintain a clear RACI framework across Finance for balance sheet and cash flow planning, forecasting, and follow-up activities.

• Develop driver-based forecasting methodologies for key working capital metrics, including inventory, receivables, payables, and other material balance sheet accounts.

• Monitor working capital performance and identify opportunities to improve cash conversion and optimize working capital.

• Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, Accounting, and Controlling to strengthen understanding of working capital drivers and improve forecast accuracy.

• Support Executive Management and Board reporting by providing insights on cash generation, liquidity, working capital performance, and financial risks and opportunities.

• Drive continuous improvement of forecasting methodologies, planning processes, and financial transparency across the organization.

• Support the ongoing development of FP&A capabilities by integrating balance sheet and cash flow considerations into strategic and long-range planning processes.

**WHO YOU ARE

**You are a curious and analytical finance professional with a passion for turning data into insights and helping the business make better decisions. You enjoy working across functions, building strong stakeholder relationships, and taking ownership of complex planning processes.

You thrive in a dynamic and growing environment and are comfortable navigating between operational details and the bigger picture. You enjoy driving improvements, challenging assumptions, and creating structure where it is needed.

You are comfortable working across Finance functions and partnering with regional Finance teams to improve forecasting, strengthen financial transparency, and drive continuous improvement. Most importantly, you are proactive, structured, and motivated by creating impact through high-quality financial planning and analysis.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• 5+ years of experience within FP&A, Financial Controlling, Corporate Finance, or a similar role.

• Strong understanding of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning.

• Experience working with cash flow forecasting, working capital, balance sheet analysis, or investment planning.

• Solid financial modelling and analytical skills, including advanced Excel capabilities.

• Experience with Workday Adaptive Planning or other EPM/planning tools is an advantage.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• A proactive mindset and a passion for improving processes, systems, and ways of working.

• Experience from retail, hospitality, food & beverage, consumer goods, or other multi-site businesses is considered a plus.

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

**Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

****ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

jobs.occupation: Talent Product Consultant Learning and Development - Assistant Director
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

**The opportunity

We’re looking for a Learning & Development Product Consultant to lead key aspects of the firmwide deployment of Microsoft Viva Learning and help drive the end-to-end success of the platform. **In this role, you will:

**

• Partner with the Global L&D Product Owner and functional leads to set direction, align priorities and advance Microsoft Viva Learning as a global learning platform

• Translate strategy into a clear roadmap, practical governance and measurable success outcomes

• Drive adoption, engagement and measurable business impact across a complex global stakeholder landscape

**What will help you succeed:

**

• Proven experience in product ownership, platform leadership or digital product delivery

• Strong background in Talent, Learning & Development or HR transformation

• Hands-on experience with Learning Experience Platforms, Microsoft Viva Learning or the Microsoft 365 ecosystem

• Ability to influence senior stakeholders, navigate ambiguity and lead change in a complex global environment

This is a standout opportunity to help build a skills-led, experience-driven Talent ecosystem, powered by Microsoft Viva Learning — at global scale.

If you’re passionate about learning, product thinking and digital employee experience, we’d love to hear from you.

What we offer you

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

**EY | Building a better working world

**EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

_Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant, or outsourcing company.

**Join a team of fintech heroes! 🚀

**Performativ is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions operate. We are building a modern platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement, replacing fragmented systems, manual workflows, and technology built for another era.

Our platform depends on accurate and timely data from custodians, banks, brokers, and other financial institutions. These connections provide the positions, transactions, cash movements, instruments, and corporate actions used throughout the investment-management lifecycle.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com.

**As our new Software Engineer, Investment Data Integrations 📈

**You will help build and operate the systems that connect Performativ with custodians and other providers of investment data.

The immediate challenge is practical: we need to deliver a growing number of integrations while maintaining the existing portfolio and resolving real production issues. The longer-term challenge is to avoid a scaling trap where every new institution requires another collection of manual processes and bespoke code.

We are building a more automated integration platform with reusable pipelines, mappings, reconciliation, quality controls, and AI-assisted development. Your work will contribute both to integrations customers need now and to the foundations that let the team deliver future integrations faster and more safely.

• You will develop and maintain integrations covering positions, transactions, cash, instruments, prices, corporate actions, and other investment data across files, APIs, SFTP, and message-based interfaces.

• You will build reusable ingestion, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and monitoring capabilities instead of treating each provider as an isolated implementation.

• You will investigate complex data and production issues across internal systems, external providers, and customer environments, then deliver permanent fixes that prevent known classes of problems from recurring.

• You will work closely with users, operations specialists, and other engineers to understand the complete workflow and ensure that integrated data is correct and useful throughout the platform.

• You will direct AI agents to produce much of the implementation, review their assumptions and output critically, and establish the tests, controls, and evidence required for safe deployment.

You should bring strong backend or data-engineering judgment and experience with production systems where correctness and reliability matter. Experience with financial integrations, investment data, reconciliation, ETL pipelines, APIs, structured files, or regulated systems would be valuable. Familiarity with technologies such as Python, Golang, PHP, TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, AWS, and CI/CD tooling is useful, but experience with our exact stack is not essential.

**We value your passion 🔥

**At Performativ, we are builders first. We have ambitious goals and value the time, judgment, and effort people put into their work. You will be trusted to make your mark and help shape how we solve difficult problems.

We do not divide the platform into personal territories. People develop deeper context in different areas, but we solve problems as a team. We expect people to lead when appropriate, follow through on what they take on, contribute to the work of others, and help teammates succeed.

AI can help us understand formats, generate mappings, develop implementations, and test integrations faster. It does not replace financial-domain understanding, careful validation, or accountability for the resulting data.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together primarily from our city-centre office, with flexibility to work from home when it makes sense. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

**What We Can Offer You 🌱

**

• Work on integrations at the centre of a production wealth-management platform.

• Solve difficult problems involving financial data, external systems, reconciliation, reliability, and operational workflows.

• Help create an AI-assisted approach to developing and maintaining integrations safely at scale.

• An ambitious, collaborative team with experience from leading technology companies, consultancies, and financial institutions.

• Strong opportunities to deepen both your engineering capabilities and your understanding of investment management.

jobs.occupation: Laboratory Technician / Laboratory Manager – New Neuroscience Research Group at BRIC
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced, motivated and independent laboratory technician/laboratory manager to join a newly established research group at the Biotech Research and Innovation Centre (BRIC), University of Copenhagen, investigating the molecular mechanisms of synaptic plasticity.

  We particularly welcome applications from experienced laboratory technicians seeking a long-term role in a research group.

  As the first member of the new research group, you will work closely with the group leader to establish the laboratory from the ground up. The position combines hands-on experimental work with responsibility for laboratory organization and offers the opportunity to play a central role in shaping how the laboratory develops as the group grows. We hope to build a lasting working relationship with a colleague who enjoys taking ownership of laboratory operations and experimental methods.

  Information on the department can be found at: https://www.bric.ku.dk/

   

  Our research

  Our research aims to understand how neuronal connections respond and adapt to activity, with a particular focus on the local molecular mechanisms regulating synaptic function and plasticity. We are particularly interested in how RNA localization and local protein synthesis are spatially organized at synapses, and how these processes contribute to activity-dependent changes in neuronal connectivity.

  We combine molecular and cellular neuroscience with advanced imaging, transcriptomic and proteomic approaches to investigate these questions across different types of synapses, including conventional neuronal synapses and specialized synapses of the retina.

  We are establishing a new research group at BRIC and aim to build an ambitious, collaborative and supportive team with open communication, high scientific standards and shared responsibility. As the first member of the laboratory, you will have a unique opportunity to contribute to its development from the beginning.

   

  Your job

  You will work closely with the group leader during the initial establishment of the laboratory and, as the team expands, become a central technical and organizational point of contact for the group.

  Your tasks will include:

   	
• Helping establish the laboratory, including ordering systems, stocks, equipment, documentation and shared laboratory resources. 	
• Establishing, documenting and maintaining laboratory protocols, procedures and experimental workflows. 	
• Contributing to hands-on experimental work and supporting ongoing research projects. 	
• Implementing, optimizing and troubleshooting new experimental methods. 	
• Onboarding and training new students, postdoctoral researchers and other group members in laboratory procedures and experimental techniques. 	
• Helping ensure continuity in laboratory procedures, experimental workflows and technical knowledge as the group grows. 	
• Coordinating shared laboratory activities and contributing to an efficient, safe and well-organized research environment.   The position is expected to develop together with the research group. Initially, there will be a strong focus on establishing the laboratory and experimental workflows. As the team grows, the role is expected to increasingly combine hands-on research with laboratory coordination, training and technical support.

   

  Profile

  We are looking for a motivated, independent and collaborative colleague who enjoys taking responsibility and contributing to the development of a new research environment. Substantial hands-on laboratory experience, reliability and an interest in long-term technical stewardship are particularly valued; a PhD is not required.

  Essential experience and skills

   	
• Relevant training as a laboratory technician, biomedical laboratory scientist or equivalent, or comparable professional experience in a biomedical research environment. 	
• Demonstrated experience working independently in a biomedical research laboratory and taking responsibility for experimental workflows, laboratory procedures or shared laboratory activities. 	
• Broad practical laboratory experience and the ability to implement and troubleshoot experimental procedures. 	
• Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and follow tasks through to completion. 	
• Good communication and collaboration skills. 	
• A proactive and solution-oriented approach to laboratory work. 	
• An interest in sharing knowledge and training students and other researchers. 	
• Good written and spoken English.   Desirable experience and skills:

  Experience in one or more of the following areas would be an advantage:

   	
• Laboratory organization or management, including ordering, stocks, equipment or shared laboratory resources. 	
• Establishing, documenting and troubleshooting experimental protocols. 	
• Molecular biology and RNA or protein biochemistry. 	
• Cell culture, including neuronal cell culture. 	
• Microscopy and imaging. 	
• Tissue processing and histological techniques. 	
• Experimental animal models. 	
• Experience working with neural tissue, particularly retinal tissue, would be an advantage   We do not expect you to have experience with all techniques used in the group. Training can be provided for the right person. We particularly value applicants who are interested in taking ownership of their role, developing new skills and growing with the research group while contributing to its long-term development. Applicants with extensive practical laboratory experience are encouraged to apply regardless of publication record.

   

  Place of employment

  The place of employment is at the Biotech Research and Innovation Centre (BRIC), Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. BRIC provides a dynamic and international

  We aim to create a supportive and highly collaborative research environment with open communication, high scientific standards and a strong sense of shared responsibility. The position offers considerable independence and the opportunity to develop a broad and central role as the research group grows.

   

  Terms of employment

  The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

  The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 3 years. The starting date is 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  Employment as laboratory technician will be in accordance with the agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and OAO/HK STAT. The position is placed in salary group 4.

  Employment will be in accordance with the provisions of the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations). The monthly salary will be based on the number of years of work experience (seniority) with the possibility to negotiate a salary supplement based on prior experiences and qualifications. The employer will pay an additional 18.07 % to your pension fund.

  Foreign and Danish applicants may be eligible for tax reductions, if they hold a PhD degree and have not lived in Denmark the last 10 years.

  The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2020.

   

  Questions

  For further information regarding the position, please contact Eva Kaulich, Associate Professor and Group Leader, BRIC, University of Copenhagen: eva.kaulich@bric.ku.dk

   

  Application

  Your application should be submitted in English and include:

   	
• Motivated letter of application (max. one page). 	
• CV incl. education, work/research experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position. 	
• Copies of relevant educational or professional qualifications (for example, laboratory technician or biomedical laboratory scientist training certificates); a PhD is not required. 	
• Optional: a brief description of relevant laboratory methods, technical responsibilities or laboratory management experience. Publications are not required.   Please submit your application by clicking on “Apply Now” below. Only online applications will be accepted.

   

  Deadline for applications: 2 December 2026, 23.59pm CET 

  We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

   

  The further process 

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor. Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself.

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/

  The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

   

  Interviews are expected to be held in week 49-50

  The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

Vi tilbyder
