**About Apylon And The Opportunity

**Apylon is building agents for the most complex workflow out there - financial admin in healthcare.

Hospitals and payers move billions of euros through fragmented, manual workflows shaped by clinical data, payer rules, contracts, and local coding systems. We believe this is a data, machine-learning, and automation problem disguised as financial operations.

We are live with leading private hospitals and expanding quickly. Every hospital presents a different challenge: EHR systems are configured differently, national coding rules vary, and contracts describe the same clinical event in different terms. Your job is to help us turn that complexity into a system that learns: each new integration should make the next one faster, safer, and less expensive.

Apylon is backed by experienced operators and top-tier investors in healthcare and fintech. Our team draws on experience from Zendesk, Pleo, Wawa Fertility, Sibill, and some of the largest multi-country hospital groups in Europe. You’ll join the first small engineering team, with massive ownership over both what we build and how we build it.

Delivering healthcare is hard. Getting paid for it shouldn’t be.

You’ll be responsible for

• Own EHR integrations end to end: APIs, schemas, undocumented behaviour, operational failure modes, and vendor changes.

• Build reusable integration-platform primitives for extraction, normalisation, versioning, replay, monitoring, and observability.

• Design the canonical data model that connects heterogeneous EHR data, reimbursement systems, national coding standards, and hospital-specific conventions.

• Build reliable inputs for our billing agents, including the constraints, validation, and evaluation systems that make model-assisted decisions safe to use in production.

• Work directly with hospital IT teams and EHR vendors: technical discovery, implementation, joint debugging, and onboarding.

• Take responsibility for the full lifecycle of your work: design, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and iteration from real-world data.

Who you are

• 3+ years building and operating production systems in complex, messy domains. We care more about demonstrated judgment and ownership than an exact number of years.

• Experience using LLMs as production components—not just developer tools. You understand when to use models, when deterministic systems are better, how to constrain outputs, and how to evaluate reliability.

• Strong data-modelling instincts. You know when abstraction creates leverage and when it hides important real-world variation.

• Comfort working from incomplete information. You form hypotheses, test them against data, and distinguish unknowns that can wait from assumptions that could invalidate the system.

• Confidence in customer-facing technical work: discovery calls, debugging sessions, and direct conversations with vendors and hospital IT teams.

• Experience with cloud infrastructure and distributed systems.

• A practical, hands-on approach: equally comfortable designing an integration architecture and writing a quick script to answer an urgent question.

This role may be a strong fit if

You enjoy reverse-engineering systems you do not control, finding structure in messy real-world data, and turning one-off discoveries into reusable software. You are comfortable being the engineer in the room with customers and partners.

What this role is not

• Consulting or bespoke delivery work. Each integration must improve the product and reduce the marginal cost of the next.

• A role insulated from customers or operational reality.

• Pure platform engineering or pure integration work: the value comes from doing both.

• A role where incorrect mappings are merely technical defects. In this domain, they can produce incorrect invoices.

Bonus points

• Experience with healthcare interoperability or coding standards, including HL7v2, FHIR, or national messaging and reimbursement standards.

• Experience building and operating third-party integrations at scale.

• Experience in healthcare, fintech, or another regulated environment.

• Experience in an early-stage or fast-growing company.

• Working proficiency in Danish, or German.

Our tech stack

• Python

• Django

• React

• PostgreSQL

• AWS

• K8s

• Terraform

• Bedrock

• We’re pragmatic. You’ll have a big say in how it evolves.

What Apylon offers

• The chance to solve one of Europe’s biggest healthcare inefficiencies.

• Competitive salary + stock options (you’ll own part of what you build).

• 25 days of annual leave + local public holidays.

• Lunch on us during workdays at the office.

• Regular off-sites and social events. We like building together, not just working together.

• Travel within the EU roughly monthly. Onboarding a hospital, working through an integration with a vendor’s engineers, or spending time on-site to understand how the data is actually produced. If travelling to a hospital basement to figure out why an export is malformed sounds like a bad week, this isn’t your role.

Working at Apylon means embarking on a highly ambitious mission to rebuild the financial infrastructure of European healthcare. We’re already live with leading private hospitals, processing thousands of invoices, proving that complex payer rules can be turned into code, powering transparent, automated, and intelligent revenue systems.

How to apply. If you're excited by the challenge of building intelligent, high-impact systems at the core of European healthcare and enjoy shipping fast, we'd love to hear from you.

**Contact The Hiring Manager

**Nicolò Calcavecchia

CTO & Co-founder

nicolo@apylon.co

jobs.occupation: PhD Project in Muscular signaling and metabolism
jobs.description:
PhD Project in Muscular signaling and metabolism

  Nutrition Exercise and Sports (NEXS), Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen

  The August Krogh Section for Human and Molecular Physiology at Department of Nutrition, Exercise and Sports invites applicants for a PhD fellowship in “Elucidating the role of AMPK in Skeletal Muscular signaling and metabolism”. The project is part of the research project “Illuminating the signaling architecture of skeletal muscle insulin resistance”, which is financed by the Novo Nordisk Foundation

  Start date is (expected to be) 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  The project

  By the use of phophosproteomics in human skeletal muscle, we recently discovered a novel phosphorylation site on AMPK alpha2 subunit regulated by mTORC1. This phosphorylation is associate with glucose uptake. We now wish to explore the relationship between the catabolic signal from AMPK and the anabolic signal from mTORC1 and the potential causal link to metabolic regulation. The project will primarily be conducted in mice by the use of transgenic KI models.

  Who are we looking for?

  We welcome applications from candidates with a strong academic background in physiology, biology, biomedical sciences, exercise science or a related field, and an interest in skeletal muscle physiology and metabolic regulation.

  The project combines animal studies with molecular and metabolic analyses. Experience in one or more relevant areas is an advantage, but applicants are not expected to have all of the skills already. Relevant experience could include in vivo or ex vivo research, metabolic phenotyping, muscle physiology, tissue processing, immunoblotting, immunoprecipitation or tracer-based assays.

  An interest in molecular signalling pathways involved in metabolism, including AMPK and nutrient sensing, would be valuable. Above all, we are looking for a curious and motivated researcher who is keen to learn and develop within a collaborative research environment.

  Our group and research- and what do we offer?

  The group is a part of Department of Nutrition, Exercise and Sports at the Faculty of Scince, University of Copenhagen. We are located in Copenhagen.

  We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and animal facilities.

  Our group work focuses on the molecular mechanisms through which physical activity promotes metabolic health.

  We are particularly interested in the intracellular interactions between exercise-induced signaling events and those triggered by insulin, aiming to unravel how a single bout of exercise can enhance muscle insulin sensitivity. Central to these studies is the role of AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) and its interacting partners, including mTOR and TBC1D4.

  We are studying this in humans using various cell/animal models for validation and mechanistic analyses.

  Principal supervisor is Professor Jørgen Wojtaszewski (NEXS, JW@nexs.ku.dk, 45 28751625) and Associate professor Rasmus Kjøbsted (NEXS, Rasmus.Kjobsted@nexs.ku.dk, 45 28344370)

   

  The PhD programme
 
 Qualifications needed for the regular programme
 
 To be eligible for the regular PhD programme, you must have cand. med. (180 ECTS/3 FTE BSc + 180 ECTS/3 FTE MSc). For information of eligibility of completed programmes, see General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database.

  Terms of employment in the regular programme 
 
 Employment as PhD fellow is full time and for maximum 3 years.

  Employment is conditional upon your successful enrolment as a PhD student at the PhD School at the Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen. This requires submission and acceptance of an application for the specific project formulated by the applicant.

  The terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State (AC). The position is covered by the Protocol on Job Structure.

  Responsibilities and tasks in the PhD programmes

   	
• Complete and pass the MSc education in accordance with the curriculum of the MSc programme (ONLY when you are attending the integrated MSc and PhD programme)    	
• Carry through an independent research project under supervision    	
• Complete PhD courses corresponding to approx. 30 ECTS / ½ FTE 	
• Participate in active research environments, including a stay at another research institution, preferably abroad 	
• Teaching and knowledge dissemination activities 	
• Write scientific papers aimed at high-impact journals 	
• Write and defend a PhD thesis on the basis of your project   We are looking for the following qualifications:

   	
• Professional qualifications relevant to the PhD project 	
• Diploma allowing independent work with experimental animals 	
• Experiences with experimental animal work 	
• Experiences with experimental animal work related to metabolism and cellular signaling 	
• Experiences with experimental animal work related to skeletal muscle 	
• Curious mind-set with a strong interest in muscle metabolism and cellular signaling 	
• Good English language skills   ***************************************************************************

  Application and Assessment Procedure

   Your application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

  Please include: 

   	
• Motivated letter of application (max. one page) 	
• Curriculum vitae including information about your education, experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position 	
• Original diplomas for Bachelor or Master and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorized English translation if issued in another language than English or Danish. If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted. 	
• Publication list (if possible) 	
• Reference letters (if available)   Application deadline: 

  The deadline for applications is 6 December 2026, 23:59 GMT +1. 

  We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

  The further process 
 After deadline, a number of applicants will be selected for academic assessment by an unbiased expert assessor. You are notified whether you will be passed for assessment.

  The assessor will assess the qualifications and experience of the shortlisted applicants with respect to the above-mentioned research area, techniques, skills and other requirements. The assessor will conclude whether each applicant is qualified and, if so, for which of the two models. The assessed applicants will have the opportunity to comment on their assessment. You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  Interviews with selected candidates are expected to be held in January 2027

  Questions
 For specific information about the PhD fellowship, please contact the principal supervisor.

  General information about PhD study at the Faculty of SCIENCE is available at the PhD School’s website: https://www.science.ku.dk/phd/.

  The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the surrounding community and invites all regardless of personal background to apply for the position.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher in Human Skin Biology and Wound Healing
jobs.description:
Postdoctoral Researcher in Human Skin Biology and Wound Healing

  Department of Biology, Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen

  The Department of Biology at the University of Copenhagen invites applications for a postdoctoral researcher in human skin biology and wound healing. The position is part of a newly established research group investigating how cells coordinate their behaviour to maintain and repair tissues.

  The position is fully funded for at least 2 years, with the possibility of extension, through generous funding from the LEO Foundation. The earliest possible start date is 1 April 2027. Please clearly state your availability and preferred start date in your cover letter.

  Information about the Department of Biology is available at https://www1.bio.ku.dk/english/. Information about the specific research section you will be affiliated with is available at https://www1.bio.ku.dk/english/research/cbp/.

  Project overview

  The overarching aim is to develop strategies to help people with slow- or non-healing wounds.

  This project investigates how planar cell polarity (PCP)—the coordinated orientation of cells within a tissue—contributes to human skin organization and wound repair. Although PCP signaling is essential for tissue organization across many organisms, its role in human epidermis remains poorly understood.

  You will establish reconstructed human epidermis (RHE) as an experimental model to investigate PCP signaling in human skin, then use advanced fluorescence microscopy to characterize PCP clusters, their polarization, and how they change during wound repair and in response to other stressors.

  The project bridges fundamental questions in cell and developmental biology with potential long-term applications in regenerative medicine and skin repair. It is supported by collaborators with expertise in RHE development and by access to confocal and advanced microscopy, including SIM, TIRF, and STED.

  The project provides a clear starting point and room to shape the research questions as findings emerge. In your cover letter, please clearly describe what interests you about the project and what related research questions you would be excited to explore.

  Your role

  We are seeking a motivated, technically skilled, and scientifically independent postdoctoral researcher to play a central role in establishing this research programme. As one of the first members of a newly established research group, you will have an exceptional opportunity to shape its experimental approaches, contribute to its scientific direction, and help build a collaborative, ambitious research environment.

  Your primary responsibility will be to establish and optimize experimental systems to investigate PCP signaling in reconstructed human epidermis. You will work closely with the PI while taking substantial ownership of day-to-day experimental development and execution of the project.

  Your responsibilities will include:

   	
• Establish and optimize robust, reproducible assays with mature, stratified RHE cultures. 	
• Develop and optimize immunostaining, advanced microscopy, and quantitative imaging workflows. 	
• Analyze and interpret experimental data, contributing scientific ideas, and identifying promising new research directions. 	
• Prepare manuscripts for publication in peer-reviewed journals and presenting findings at local and international conferences. 	
• Contribute to the development of a supportive, collaborative, and scientifically rigorous lab environment. 	
• Help train and supervise students or other researchers as the group expands.   Profile 

  We are seeking a curious and proactive researcher who can take ownership of their experiments while collaborating constructively with the project team. You do not need experience with every method listed below; training and collaboration will help you develop the techniques needed for the project.

  Essential experience and skills:

   	
• PhD in cell biology, developmental biology, skin biology, molecular biology, tissue engineering, biophysics, or a closely related field by the time of appointment. 	
• Extensive hands-on experience in mammalian cell culture, with demonstrated ability to independently establish, optimize, and troubleshoot experimental protocols. 	
• Demonstrated experience in fluorescence microscopy and immunofluorescence staining. 	
• Evidence of scientific independence, initiative, and the ability to advance an experimental research project, including strong organizational skills. 	
• A solid publication record appropriate for your career stage. 	
• Excellent written and spoken English skills.   In the cover letter, you are encouraged to highlight an example of experimental independence, including situations in which you have established or substantially improved an experimental method, solved a challenging technical problem, or independently advanced a research project.

  Desirable experience and skills:

   	
• Experience with human keratinocyte culture, reconstructed human epidermis, organotypic skin cultures, or other 3D epithelial models. 	
• Experience establishing new experimental model systems or developing and optimizing complex cell-culture protocols. 	
• Experience with quantitative image analysis using Fiji/ImageJ, Python, or other comparable computational tools. 	
• Experience with molecular perturbation techniques, including CRISPR/Cas9, RNA interference, and genetic manipulation of mammalian cells. 	
• Experience with confocal microscopy or an advanced imaging technique such as SIM, TIRF, or STED. 	
• Experience mentoring or supervising students or junior researchers.   Research shows that women and other underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. If you are excited about this position and believe you can contribute, we strongly encourage you to apply, even if your experience does not perfectly match every point. We value curiosity, motivation, and the potential and willingness to learn.

  What we offer

   	
• An opportunity to join a newly established research group and meaningfully contribute to its scientific development. 	
• A central role in an ambitious, externally funded research project that addresses fundamental and medically relevant questions. 	
• Substantial scientific independence and opportunities to develop novel experimental approaches. 	
• Close scientific interaction with the PI and opportunities to shape future research directions. 	
• Access to the research infrastructure and collaborative environment at the University of Copenhagen. 	
• Opportunities for international collaboration, conference participation, publication, and professional development.   The position offers an excellent opportunity for a researcher seeking to develop greater scientific independence and strengthen their qualifications for a future academic or research leadership career.

  Terms of employment

  The average weekly working hours are 37 hours.

  The place of employment is at the Department of Biology, Section for Cell Biology and Physiology, University of Copenhagen.

  Salary, pension and other conditions of employment are set in accordance with the Agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant organisation. Currently, the monthly salary starts at 35,000 DKK/approx. 4,700 EUR (October 2021 level). Depending on qualifications, a supplement may be negotiated. The employer will pay an additional 17.1 % to your pension fund.

  Foreign and Danish applicants may be eligible for tax reductions, if they hold a PhD degree and have not lived in Denmark the last 10 years.

  The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2020. 

  Questions
 For further information, please contact PI: Silas Boye Nissen; boye.nissen@bio.ku.dk.

  Foreign applicants may find this link useful: www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility).

  Application procedure
 Your online application must be submitted in English by clicking ‘Apply now’ below. Furthermore, your application must include the following documents/attachments – all in PDF format:

   	
• Motivated letter of application (max. one page). 	
• CV incl. education, work/research experience, and other skills/experience relevant for the position (see above). 	
• A certified/signed copy of a) PhD certificate and b) Master of Science certificate. If the PhD is not completed, a written statement from the supervisor will do. 	
• List of peer-reviewed publications.   Deadline for applications: December 31, 2026, 23:59 CET 

  We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

  The further process 
 After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor. Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself.

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/

  The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

   

  The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

Postdoc at the Department of Biomedical Sciences, Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, NNF Center of Stem Cell Medicine (reNEW), University of Copenhagen

  The Friesen group is looking for a motivated researcher with experience in stem cell biology and metabolism for a postdoctoral position, to commence on January 15, 2027 (or after agreement).

  About us

  The newly established Friesen lab aims to understand, treat and prevent metabolic disease. We want to explore how a cell transitions from a healthy state to insulin resistance to type 2 diabetes and to reverse this process. Our group leverages human pluripotent stem cell (hPSC)-derived in vitro disease models that accurately represent the in vivo cell state. We study the molecular underpinnings of metabolism and insulin signaling in a variety of cell types, improving in vitro hPSC-derived metabolic disease models, and applying these for translational research.

  Your role

  Your tasks will include designing experimental strategies, executing wet lab biology experiments, data analysis, and scientific writing and presentation. Additional tasks could include contributing to grant applications, and research-based supervision of MSc or PhD students.

  As a postdoctoral researcher in our lab, you will play a key role in leading a research project to completion. As a founding team member in a new lab, you will have a hand in shaping the lab’s culture and research direction, and you will have early ownership of projects. You will contribute to metabolic-disease focused translational research, implementing hPSC-derived disease models to deepen our understanding and potentially impact translational strategies.

Your ability to lead technically credible conversations, guide customers through implementation decisions, and proactively manage risks will be critical to achieving strong adoption, smooth go-lives, and long-term customer success.

jobs.occupation: Senior Quantitative Developer - European Gas Fundamentals
jobs.description:
Join us in this role where you’ll help design and develop our new European gas supply–demand modelling capability, supporting short- and medium-term trading and portfolio decisions. You’ll combine strong Python development skills with quantitative modelling and market analysis, working closely with experienced energy market specialists and traders. This is an opportunity to shape the technical foundations of an important new modelling capability and see your work directly influence commercial decisions.

Welcome to Forecasting & Market Analysis You’ll join a collaborative team of quantitative developers and market analysts developing fundamental models, forecasts, and analytical tools across European gas and power markets.

You’ll play a central role in building our European gas modelling capabilities, working alongside colleagues with complementary expertise in energy fundamentals, quantitative modelling, and software development.

As a team, we collaborate across disciplines, share knowledge, and continuously improve how we model and understand energy markets.

You’ll play an important role in:

• co-developing and enhancing our new European gas supply–demand model, supporting gas trading, market analysis, and portfolio management.

• designing scalable, reliable Python-based models and contributing to their architecture, implementation, and continuous improvement.

• modelling fundamental gas market drivers, including pipeline supplies, LNG imports, storage dynamics, consumption, infrastructure constraints, and cross-border flows.

• developing quantitative methodologies to analyse market balances, assess scenarios, and understand short- and medium-term market developments.

• integrating and processing diverse market datasets, ensuring data quality, transparency, and reliable model outputs.

• improving model performance, automation, testing, documentation, and deployment through modern software engineering practices.

• collaborating closely with gas analysts, traders, and other developers to turn complex market questions into practical modelling solutions.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have strong experience in Python development, quantitative modelling, software engineering, or a related field.

• can design and build scalable, maintainable, well-tested quantitative applications and data processing pipelines.

• have a solid understanding of numerical methods, data analysis, time series, or statistical modelling.

• are comfortable working with SQL, version control, automated testing, and collaborative development practices.

• enjoy translating complex real-world problems into robust, practical models.

• are intellectually curious about energy markets and motivated to understand the fundamental drivers behind market behaviour.

• communicate effectively and enjoy collaborating with people from different technical and commercial backgrounds.

It would be an advantage if you also bring:

• experience with European natural gas, LNG, power, or other commodity markets.

• previous experience developing supply–demand, fundamental, forecasting, or scenario models.

• familiarity with European gas market datasets, infrastructure, and price formation.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.

**Pre-employment background checks:

**For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

jobs.occupation: Product Manager – AI | Shape the Future of Construction Tech with Dalux
jobs.description:
Dalux continues to grow rapidly, and AI is creating entirely new possibilities for how construction professionals find information, understand complex project data, automate repetitive work, and make decisions.

We're looking for an AI Product Manager to help turn those possibilities into products that create real value for our users.

As an AI Product Manager at Dalux, you'll operate at the intersection of customer needs, rapidly evolving AI technology, and business strategy. You'll work closely with Product Design, AI engineers, developers, and other Product Managers to identify where AI can meaningfully improve construction workflows – and equally importantly, where it cannot.

Building AI products is different from traditional software development. Outputs are probabilistic, quality needs continuous evaluation, and product decisions involve trade-offs between accuracy, latency, cost, scalability, and user trust.

You'll help us navigate those trade-offs and establish how we build great AI products at Dalux.

**Your responsibilities will include:

**

• AI Product Discovery: Identify and validate problems where AI can create meaningful value rather than applying AI for its own sake.

• Customer Insights: Work closely with users and internal domain experts to understand construction workflows and identify opportunities for AI-powered improvements.

• Evaluation & Quality: Define what "good" looks like for AI features and establish evals, quality metrics, test cases, and feedback loops.

• AI Safety & Trust: Consider hallucinations, uncertainty, guardrails, failure modes, explainability, and user trust throughout product development.

• Feature Ownership: Lead AI-powered features from early experimentation and prototyping through delivery, evaluation, and continuous improvement.

• Technical Collaboration: Work closely with AI engineers and developers on model capabilities, context, architecture, latency, scalability, and cost.

• AI Product Strategy: Follow developments in models and AI technology and help determine which technological advances create meaningful opportunities for Dalux.

**About You

**We are looking for someone who combines strong product thinking with a solid understanding of modern AI.

You don't need to be an AI engineer, but you need enough technical understanding to make informed product decisions and have meaningful discussions with the engineers building these systems.

We believe you:

• Have experience building or managing customer-facing AI/ML products.

• Understand concepts such as LLMs, RAG, embeddings, context, agents, evals, and guardrails.

• Understand the fundamental difference between building deterministic software and probabilistic AI experiences.

• Can translate rapidly evolving technical capabilities into valuable user experiences.

• Are comfortable defining and measuring quality where traditional acceptance criteria are insufficient.

• Think critically about when AI is – and isn't – the right solution.

• Can balance user value, model quality, latency, scalability, and cost.

• Communicate fluently in English, written and spoken.

Experience with B2B SaaS is an advantage.

Experience with construction technology is welcome but not required. We have deep construction expertise within Dalux – for this role, we are particularly interested in adding strong AI product expertise to our organization.

**What To Expect At Dalux

**At Dalux, you'll join a product-driven company where ideas quickly become reality and where you'll have a direct impact on the products we build.

We offer:

• A collaborative and informal work environment with flat hierarchies

• High ownership, trust, and the freedom to drive initiatives

• Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international team

• A central Copenhagen office, flexible work hours, and no dress code

• Monthly social events and an active community

• Attractive benefits including health insurance, lunch, fitness facilities, and free parking

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

**Ready for the next step?

**We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your resume and application as soon as possible.

**About Dalux

**Founded in 2005, Dalux is a Danish Contech company revolutionizing the construction industry with innovative software built on geometric processing and 3D computer graphics.

Over the past years, we’ve grown by 40% annually and now have over 900 employees across 50+ offices in more than 25 countries. All product development takes place in our Østerbro, Copenhagen office, where we focus on building the future of construction technology. We place great value on our strong social community and close collaboration with colleagues, which is why we primarily work from our Copenhagen location.

**Application deadline:

**As soon as possible

The XcytoMatic instruments are advanced lab equipment for automated cell counting. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role where you’ll combine your technical expertise with a proactive mindset to keep instrument uptime and customer satisfaction high.

Key Responsibilities

• Perform annual preventive maintenance, troubleshooting and repairs on XcytoMatic instruments at customer sites across Europe, primarily biotech and pharma labs.

• Support customers on site in the Asia-Pacific region when needed.

• Service electromechanical systems, including firmware updates and module and component replacement.

• Inspect instruments and setups to identify and reduce risks that could lead to downtime, and read and troubleshoot system-generated log files.

• Work closely with R&D, Product Management and the service organization at our headquarters to share field insights and contribute to continuous product improvement.

• Act as a ChemoMetec ambassador, providing a high level of customer service and technical professionalism.

• Document all interventions in our service system (CRM).

What We’re Looking For

We’re searching for someone who thrives on solving complex problems and enjoys travelling to meet customers in their own environments. To succeed in this role, you have:

• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering or a closely related field.

• 2+ years of field service experience, ideally with electromechanical laboratory equipment or automation systems.

• Strong knowledge of sensors, actuators, firmware interaction and basic networking.

• A curious mind and a real passion for technology.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

**

What We Offer**

At ChemoMetec, you’ll be part of a growing life science company driven by innovation and a strong sense of purpose. We offer:

• A key role in the launch of our new XcytoMatic product line, shaping the future of automated cell counting.

• Thorough training and onboarding at our headquarters in Allerød.

• A supportive and highly skilled team of engineers and scientists.

• Opportunities to grow professionally in an international company with a strong focus on quality and technology.

Why join ChemoMetec?

At ChemoMetec, we believe that great people make a great workplace. We value both personal and professional development and offer an environment where you can grow, take responsibility, and make an impact. You will become part of a team of talented and supportive colleagues who enjoy working together in an informal and welcoming atmosphere. We also believe that strong relationships go beyond the workplace, which is why we regularly bring colleagues together through company-wide events to build connections and strengthen relationships across the organization.

**

Practical information**

When you’re not travelling, you’ll be based at our headquarters in Allerød, Denmark, and will report to Tobias Schaldemose, Head of Operations US. The starting date is as soon as possible.

Please submit your CV and a short cover letter via our website. We’ll review applications on an ongoing basis and look forward to hearing from you.

If you have any further questions about this job opportunity, feel free to reach out to tsc@chemometec.com.

Work location:

Gydevang 43

3450 Allerød

Danmark

Application deadline:

13. January 2027

Join us in this role where you’ll be responsible for onshore and offshore pipeline operation, inspection, engineering and integrity tasks as well as asset management of the Danish onshore and offshore pipelines and terminals bringing most of the Danish oil and gas into Denmark.

**Welcome to Asset Integrity

**You’ll be part of Asset Integrity where you, together with your engineering colleague will support the organisation with your mechanical engineering skills in the operation, inspection, engineering, integrity and asset management. As a team we foster collaboration and innovation. We are a group of ambitious professionals within different engineering disciplines, who are passionate and motivated and who value teamwork as an essential part of safeguarding our assets.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• executing various engineering studies and tasks for onshore oil&gas terminals and offshore and onshore pipelines both internally and by defining scope of work and liaison with external engineering consultants

• performing inspection data analysis and integrity assessment of our approx 800km of pipelines

• supporting the offshore inspection and maintenance campaigns.

• liaison with Authorities, Contractors, Oil&Gas companies and other third parties.

• act as offshore company representative/supervisor onboard contractors’ vessels

• ensure and perform engineering and quality check and final delivery of inspection results to our Integrity engineers

• providing input to budgets and reporting to management.

Once familiar with our systems, you will be included in a 24/7 duty roster to respond to emergency situations.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have key focus on safety, which shall be embedded in all the work you do;

• hold an engineering degree, preferably in mechanical engineering

• have experience working with oil&gas plant and pipeline integrity and engineering both onshore and offshore

• have experience working with engineering companies, contractors and/or suppliers;

• have experience working with practical onshore and offshore pipeline operation and maintenance as well as experience in marine and subsea operations and inspection methods

• have a proactive and systematic approach to your work tasks

• possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills and can work independently in your area of responsibility and participate in a culture of knowledge sharing in an open, honest and trustful culture

• are a team player who thrives on solving complex problems together with your colleagues.

• speak and write English fluently and knowledge with a Scandinavian language is an advantage.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. You’ll receive the training needed to maintain and further develop your competencies.

The role involves some travel, including two to three day trips per month to onshore sites, a two-week offshore campaign in summer, and a few conferences or courses each year.

**Working at Ørsted

**In the Asset Integrity department we have the responsibility for looking after some of Denmark’s most important infrastructure assets. We have highly skilled employees dedicated to safeguard and care for our assets.

We offer a collaborative, dynamic, and diverse workplace with constructive feedback and continuous learning, enabling our people to develop their expertise in asset integrity and engineering.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is kr54,480.00- kr68,100.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11 % contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3 % holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and well-being programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, and internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**This position requires a background check as part of the hiring process and the offer is dependent on the outcome of this check. You will receive more information during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

About the role

Are you an experienced Project Manager with a solid understanding of IT integrations and a talent for creating structure, progress and strong working relationships?

Scan Global Logistics is looking for a hands-on Technical Project Manager to support a major global transformation programme involving the implementation of new systems, global processes and data migration.

The programme implements a new Transportation Management System (TMFF), Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, and a Vendor Invoice Management solution (Basware and AP Essentials.

As Technical Project Manager, you will play a key role in driving and coordinating integration projects across teams, integration specialists and business stakeholders.

Your primary responsibility will be to create structure, draft plans, ensure progress and make sure that tasks, responsibilities, dependencies and deadlines are clearly defined and followed up.

You will act as the link between diverse teams and the business, helping translate technical challenges into clear business requirements – and vice versa.

This is not a developer role. However, you should have a good technical understanding of integrations, data flows and system dependencies, enabling you to engage confidently in technical discussions and challenge proposed solutions when needed.

You should also enjoy getting involved in the practical aspects of project management, including communication, documentation, process descriptions and mapping integration flows. It is a must that you know when to support and when to drive tasks, content, colleagues to ensure progress.

Key responsibilities

• Drive and coordinate integration projects across implementation and integration teams and vendor teams, i.e., integration to e-invoicing governmental portals

• Act as the link between technical teams, system owners, implementation teams and business stakeholders.

• Create structure, clear priorities, realistic timelines and well-defined project plans.

• Ensure proper task management and follow-up in Jira.

• Make sure tasks are clearly described, assigned to the right people and followed through to completion. You support the integration team with describing their tasks, flow descriptions, etc.

• Coordinate resources, dependencies and delivery schedules across teams.

• Support the documentation of integration flows, system dependencies and processes.

• Translate technical issues into business requirements and ensure alignment between business and IT.

• Follow up on progress, identify bottlenecks and help resolve issues before they impact delivery.

• Coordinate testing, deployment and operational handover where relevant.

Your background

We are looking for someone with solid experience in technical project management and, in particular, system integration projects.

You do not need to be a technical specialist or developer, but you must understand how systems communicate and how integrations work.

Ideally, you have:

• Experience managing IT integration projects.

• A good understanding of APIs, CSV, data flows and integration patterns.

• An understanding of system dependencies and how different applications interact.

• Experience coordinating technical teams, developers or integration specialists.

• Experience with project planning, resource coordination, and delivery follow-up.

• Experience using Jira or similar project management tools.

• The ability to create clear documentation, process descriptions and integration flow diagrams.

Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, ERP or TMS solutions is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Experience from logistics and transportation is also an advantage, but we are equally interested in candidates from finance, operations or other industries who have moved into IT and integration projects.

Who are you?

Your personality will be just as important as your technical and project management experience.

You are someone who can create momentum and gain the respect of others without relying on formal management authority.

You are structured, detail-oriented and persistent when it comes to following up and ensuring that things get done.

At the same time, you are approachable and understand the importance of building good relationships.

You are comfortable working with different personalities, handling disagreements and challenging existing ways of working in a constructive manner.

You know when to push and when to listen. You can stand your ground without being overly dominant, and you understand that successful project delivery depends on bringing people along.

You are pragmatic, have a good sense of humour and can navigate different situations with confidence and good judgement.

The team

You will report to the Programme Lead and work closely with integration specialists, system owners, workstream leads, implementation project managers and solution architects to mention just a few.

What we offer

• An important role in a major global transformation programme.

• An international working environment with colleagues across different countries.

• A role combining technical insight, project management and relationship building.

• The opportunity to make a visible difference to project delivery and collaboration.

Location: Hvidovre is preferred, but Viby is also an option for the right candidate.

**Travel:**Approximately once a month between locations.

Contact

The recruitment process is handled by EPICO Group. If you have any questions about the position, please contact: Mia Mûller, Senior Delivery Manager, Email: mbm@epico.dk, Prone: +45 2866 3943.

Why Scan Global Logistics?

At Scan Global Logistics, you will join a global growth company with an entrepreneurial spirit and a fast-paced environment. You will play a central role in a strategic transformation with high visibility and the opportunity to make a real impact.

Scan Global Logistics is a leading Danish logistics and transportation company headquartered in Hvidovre, Denmark. We provide global solutions within sea, air and road freight as well as supply chain management, helping businesses move their goods safely and efficiently around the world.

Are you interested in gaining hands-on experience within Global Procurement at one of the world's leading jewellery brands? Do you enjoy working with data, analysis, and stakeholder collaboration in a dynamic international environment?

Pandora is looking for a Student Assistant to join our Global Procurement team. In this role, you will support sourcing activities, procurement projects, and business analysis across different spend categories while working closely with category managers and stakeholders across the organisation.

This is a unique opportunity to gain valuable insight into procurement within a global organisation operating across the full value chain. Working alongside experienced colleagues, you will contribute to sourcing activities, supplier management, data analysis, and process improvements while building both professional skills and practical business experience.

Key Responsibilities

You will be exposed to a variety of tasks within Procurement and collaborate with stakeholders across all levels of the organisation. We expect you to take ownership of your responsibilities and contribute proactively to ongoing projects and initiatives.

Your responsibilities will typically include:

• Support Procurement colleagues with various procurement activities

• Contribute to sourcing projects and tenders across spend categories

• Project manage smaller projects and tasks independently

• Conduct data analyses and create business insights

• Create and deliver presentations for internal stakeholders

• Assist with the implementation of new processes across the global organisation

• Engage in dialogue with suppliers on various topics, including compliance-related activities

• Support data quality initiatives and ad hoc administrative tasks related to contract management

Your Team

Working in Global Procurement, you will join a team that partners with stakeholders across Pandora to drive value through strategic sourcing, supplier collaboration, and continuous improvement initiatives across a broad range of indirect spend categories.

The Global Procurement team is part of the Group Commercial organisation. You will work alongside more than 20 skilled colleagues in an international and collaborative environment and report to the Director of one of our Indirect Procurement categories.

You will be part of an exciting business area and work in an international hub of passionate, performance-driven, and can-do spirited colleagues.

Qualifications

You might be the person we are looking for if you are currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree and ideally have at least two years remaining before graduation.

We hope you can demonstrate:

• Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree or similar in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Economics, or Data Management

• Excellent communication skills in English

• Strong Excel skills and an analytical mindset

• A genuine interest in Procurement and related disciplines

• Great interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships across different functions

• A flair for creating professional and impactful presentations in PowerPoint

Personal Competencies

We are looking for someone who is:

• Proactive, curious, and eager to learn

• A humble and enthusiastic team player

• Comfortable working independently and taking ownership

• Structured and detail-oriented in their approach

• Not afraid to take initiative and responsibility

• Ambitious and motivated to develop professionally

You Will Get

A position as Student Assistant in Global Procurement offers an opportunity for both personal and professional development in a global organisation.

You will get:

• Valuable work experience from a globally recognised brand within Procurement across different spend categories

• Exposure to a fast-moving and dynamic environment where our people and values are at the centre of what we do

• A chance to challenge yourself and apply what you have learned in a global business environment

• Support and coaching from your manager as well as a diverse and experienced team

• Flexible working hours, especially around exam periods

Additional Information

This role is based at Pandora's Global Office in Copenhagen, Denmark.

You are expected to work approximately 15-20 hours per week on average (less during exam periods and more when possible and required).

Did We Get Your Attention?

We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you would like to become part of Pandora's future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you.

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site at Pandora Group.

Icing on the Cake

You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable, and inspirational, delivering a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting, and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery.

Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores. Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery using 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030.

Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

New Power Partners is looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead the delivery of complex construction and building projects across Europe.

The role is responsible for managing projects from planning and procurement through construction and handover, ensuring delivery on time, within budget, and to the highest quality and safety standards. The Senior Project Manager will work closely with clients, consultants, contractors, and authorities, acting as a trusted advisor throughout the project lifecycle.

In addition to project delivery, the role includes supporting business growth through client development, tender support, and identifying new opportunities. As the business expands, the successful candidate will play a key role in mentoring colleagues and, over time, helping establish and develop a team of project managers and specialists.

About Site Solutions

Site Solutions develops and delivers turnkey solutions for the onshore and offshore wind industry – covering everything from facilities and workforce logistics to operational planning and site coordination. We work closely with global project teams to ensure efficient site setups that keep projects running smoothly and safely.

Site Solutions is a great team of nine employees, and the Senior Project Manager will work closely with all team members while contributing both strategically and operationally to the development and delivery of our services.

While our heritage is rooted in the wind industry, we increasingly support customers across construction, infrastructure and industrial sectors where temporary site facilities are critical for successful project execution.

What the role offers

Key Responsibilities

Project Delivery

• Lead construction and building projects from initiation to completion.

• Manage scope, schedule, budget, quality, and project risks.

• Coordinate clients, consultants, contractors, suppliers, and authorities.

• Ensure projects comply with applicable regulations, HSE requirements, and quality standards.

• Provide clear project governance, reporting, and stakeholder communication.

Commercial & Client Management

• Build and maintain strong client relationships.

• Support tendering, procurement, and contract management activities.

• Manage project commercial performance, including budgets, forecasts, variations, and claims.

• Identify opportunities for additional services and long-term client collaboration.

Business Development

• Support business growth through networking, client engagement, and market development.

• Contribute to proposals, commercial discussions, and new project opportunities.

• Help strengthen New Power Partners' position within the Danish construction sector.

Team Development

• Mentor and support junior project managers and consultants.

• Share knowledge and best practices across projects.

• Support recruitment and onboarding as the team grows.

• Contribute to building a collaborative and high-performing project organization.

Qualifications & Experience

• Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Building Technology, or a related discipline.

• 8+ years of project management experience within the Danish building and construction industry.

• Proven track record delivering commercial, industrial, residential, infrastructure, or mixed-use projects.

• Strong understanding of Danish construction processes and regulations.

• Experience with contract management, procurement, and stakeholder management.

• Familiarity with AB18, ABT18, and ABR18 is an advantage.

• Fluent in Danish and English.

Key Competencies

• Strong project and stakeholder management skills.

• Commercially minded with sound contractual understanding.

• Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.

• Structured, proactive, and solution-oriented.

• Ability to balance hands-on project execution with business development.

• Leadership potential with an interest in developing people and teams.

Success in the Role

Success will be measured by:

• Safe and successful project delivery.

• High client satisfaction and repeat business.

• Strong financial and commercial project performance.

• Development of new business opportunities.

• Contribution to the growth of the project management team and the wider business.

Why join New Power Partners?

You will work in an international project environment, collaborate with experienced colleagues and customers, and play a role in shaping the future of Site Solutions.

This role is ideal for an experienced Senior Project Manager who enjoys delivering complex projects, building strong client relationships, and contributing to the growth of both the business and future project teams**.

jobs.occupation: Interest Rate Option Trader – Graduate / Early Career
jobs.description:
**Job Description

**Interest rate markets move constantly, and the people who understand them shape how risk is managed for clients across the region. Joining our Derivatives Trading team you will be working directly with experienced traders and building practical expertise in interest-rate options from day one.

**What You Will Be Doing

**You will be part of a close-knit trading team where analysis, precision, and curiosity matter every day. Working within Derivatives Trading, you will support the pricing and execution of interest rate option transactions, monitor market developments, and collaborate with colleagues across sales, quant, risk, and operations.

More specifically, you will:

• Support pricing and execution of interest rate option transactions under experienced traders

• Monitor interest rate markets, volatility, and economic developments with the team

• Analyse portfolio exposures and help manage risk within agreed limits

• Build and improve tools for pricing and risk monitoring using Python or similar languages

• Collaborate with sales, quant, risk, and operations colleagues to support accurate trade processing

**About You

**You are a recent graduate or have up to two years of relevant experience in trading, quantitative analysis, asset management or a related field. Previous trading experience is not required. We are interested in your analytical ability, curiosity and willingness to learn.

• Degree in economics with a technical focus, alternatively in mathematics, physics, engineering, or a related quantitative field

• Strong numerical and analytical skills with a structured approach to problem solving

• Genuine interest in fixed income markets and a desire to build a career in trading

• Programming ability in Python or a comparable language, applied to practical problems

• Fluency in English and a Scandinavian language

• Sound judgement, attention to detail, and willingness to ask questions and raise concerns

Familiarity with derivatives, probability, statistics, or numerical methods is an advantage, though no prior trading experience is required. Academic projects, relevant coursework, or internships are all useful ways to demonstrate your analytical interest.

**What We Offer You

**This role offers structured learning through direct collaboration with experienced traders, with responsibility growing as your knowledge deepens. This is a full-time, in-office role with daily access to colleagues who are invested in your progress and development.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, apply by submitting your CV, cover letter and grade transcripts. If you have any questions before applying you can reach out to hiring manager Frederik Dimo-Ungermann at fdi@danskebank.dk.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Finding new routes beyond roads. That’s us.

Mercedes-Benz is on an exciting journey of transformation. Our purpose is defined as “First Move the World.” We aim to be at the forefront of innovation, not only in automotive technology and luxury, but also in shaping a more sustainable and connected future. By combining pioneering products and services with a strong customer focus, we continue to set new standards in safety, digitalization and design.

Mercedes-Benz Danmark A/S is the general distributor for passenger cars, vans and aftersales products in Denmark. Working as part of the Sweden and Denmark cluster, we support our authorized retailers and workshops with sales, marketing and business development.

To strengthen our Danish used-car business, we are now looking for an analytical and commercially minded Used Car Specialist. The position is based at our office at Digevej, Copenhagen. You will be a part of a team across border and expect to travel to our Swedish office, based in Hyllie Malmö, on a regular basis.

**About The Position

**As Used Car Specialist, you will play an important role in driving our used car and remarketing activities in Denmark together with the team. You will combine commercial insight, data analysis and operational coordination to help ensure competitive pricing and efficient vehicle sales. Working closely with dealers, auction and remarketing partners, as well as Sales and other internal stakeholders, you will turn market data into clear recommendations and help create a professional, efficient vehicle journey from return to sale.

**Your main responsibilities within the team will include:

**

• Drive remarketing performance by analyzing sales, stock, pricing and market data and translating insights into commercial action.

• Own the remarketing journey from returned to sale.

• Enable high-quality vehicle sales by securing accurate documentation, equipment descriptions and vehicle data.

• Build strong partnerships with Danish dealers, auction platforms, logistics providers and other remarketing partners.

• Support the team in improving processes, reporting and data quality across the remarketing journey.

**Who Are You

**You are analytical, structured and curious about understanding what drives business performance. You enjoy working with data and figures, but also appreciate collaborating with colleagues, dealers and external partners.

You are proactive, detail-oriented and motivated to learn new skills in a dynamic commercial environment.

**We believe you bring:

**We believe you are at the beginning of your career with approximately 1-3 years of experience from a similar position. Your educational background could be within business, finance, economics, sales, automotive management or a related field, but we will also look at candidates with a different educational background with curiosity so don’t hesitate to apply.

Experience from the automotive or used car industry, vehicle appraisal, trade-in activities or auction and remarketing platforms will be considered an advantage.

You will have the chance to influence remarketing performance, pricing decisions and residual-value development while working closely with dealers, partners and colleagues across the Mercedes-Benz organization.

You will join an international and collaborative environment where data, customer focus and continuous improvement are central to how we work. The role offers broad stakeholder exposure and a genuine opportunity to strengthen how we manage and develop the vehicle lifecycle in Denmark.

**Application

**For position specific information please contact Thomas Larsson thomas.larsson@mercedes-benz.com . For general information about the recruitment process, please contact Evelina Hofstedt, HR Partner at evelina.hofstedt@mercedes-benz.com .

We are keen to get the right candidate onboard as soon as possible; therefore, we practice continuous selection. So don't wait with your application, send it as soon as possible, however no later than 25th November. Please apply using the link below; we do not consider applications received via email.

jobs.occupation: Senior Management Consultant within Supply Chain Planning
jobs.description:
**Help shape the future of supply chain planning

**We’re looking to expand our Copenhagen team with a **Senior Consultant / Solution Architect

**with a management consulting background and the expertise to design and implement SAP IBP solutions.

**What you’ll do

**As a senior member of our team, you’ll be working in the sweet spot **where consulting meets deep solution expertise.

**Specifically, you will:

• 
**Design end-to-end supply chain planning processes

**and facilitate key decisions with senior stakeholders

• 
**Step into the subject-matter expertise role,

**knowing how SAP IBP can improve demand, response & supply, inventory and/or S&OP

• 
**Bridge the gap between business and IT

**by translating client needs into robust, value-adding solutions while being able to challenge the client on the status quo

• 
**Drive project delivery from blueprint to go-live

**, ensuring meaningful client impact

• 
**Support business development

**through your consulting experience and client network in the Nordics

In addition to facilitating change management initiatives, you’ll be working with a team of younger consultants, providing guidance and support to ensure high-quality project delivery.

**What you’ll bring

**We’re looking for a seasoned consultant who combines structured thinking, technical depth, and a collaborative mindset. In the best-case scenario, you bring:

• **At least 4 years

**of **client-facing

**experience at a **management consulting firm

**, demonstrating strong team collaboration and interpersonal skills.

• Proven expertise **designing and delivering

**in one or more **SAP IBP solutions

**(demand, response & supply, inventory, S&OP)

• Strong capabilities and interpersonal skills to **facilitate workshops

**, align stakeholders, and articulate complex solutions through **clear PowerPoint storytelling

**

• Deep understanding of **supply chain planning processes and operating models

**

• A relevant master's degree (e.g., in Supply Chain, Engineering, or Business)

• Fluency in English; other languages are a plus

• A collaborative, entrepreneurial spirit – and a desire to reshape how consulting is done in the Nordics

**What we offer

**Our Planning Excellence team across EMEA has seen substantial growth over the past few years, thanks to our strong subject-matter expertise and our ability to drive effective change management in organisations seeking to transform their planning operating model.

Joining us means entering a world of:

• A unique culture of **freedom, trust, and responsibility

**

• Opportunities to work on **transformational projects

**with leading organisations

• A **flat organisation

**where your ideas and initiatives matter from day one

• A strong, performance-based compensation model

• A **growing, entrepreneurial international team

**backed by a strong Scandinavian brand

**About Implement Consulting Group

**Implement Consulting Group (founded 1996) is an international management consultancy with over 1,800 employees, making it one of the largest European consultancies. Headquartered in Copenhagen, the company has 12 offices across the Nordics, the DACH region, and the United States. Implement supports organisations in delivering sustainable strategic, commercial, and operational transformations. The company combines analytical rigour, functional expertise, and industry insight with a unique collaborative model and an ability to engage and mobilise client organisations.

**Ready to drive change with SAP IBP and shape the future of supply chain planning?

**Make your next move matter.

Apply now.

Do you enjoy outbound sales, building relationships, and creating new business opportunities? Are you a native or near-native German speaker with experience in B2B sales? Then you might be the next addition to our Outreach Team at PriceShape.

At PriceShape, you'll join an international SaaS company on a strong growth journey, where you'll play an important role in expanding our presence across German-speaking markets.

Your Role at PriceShape

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), your main responsibility will be to identify and engage potential customers through outbound outreach, generate interest in PriceShape, and book qualified meetings for our Business Development Managers (BDMs).

You'll work closely with fellow BDRs and BDMs, contributing to our sales efforts across the DACH region. While German will be your primary language when engaging with prospects, strong business-level English is essential for internal collaboration and communication with international prospects and customers.

What You'll Be Doing

• Identify and engage potential customers through outbound calls, emails, and LinkedIn.

• Build relationships with relevant decision-makers and understand their business needs.

• Communicate PriceShape's value proposition and generate interest in our solutions.

• Book qualified meetings and collaborate closely with BDMs to create new sales opportunities.

• Share market insights and contribute to improving our outreach efforts.

What We're Looking For

• Strong business-level English, both written and spoken.

• Experience in outbound B2B sales, lead generation, or business development.

• A proactive and goal-oriented mindset with a strong commercial drive.

• Confident communication and relationship-building skills.

• The ability to thrive in a collaborative and international environment.

Depending on your experience and proven results, the scope of the role and compensation will be tailored accordingly.

What We Offer
