jobs.occupation: Academic Coordinator for the EUROfusion Project
jobs.description:
SDU Center for Large Structure Production (LSP), part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI) at University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for one funded Academic Staff position, to be project administrator for the EUROfusion project. The temporary position will be vacant from 1 January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter, until 31 December 2027. Main work location is Odense/Denmark at SDU and Odense Havn (Odense Port).

Work environment

The candidate will be part of SDU Center for Large Structure Production (LSP). LSP’s central ambition is to provide a physical “go-to” lab for companies in the sectors maritime, construction and energy to carry out research, development, and testing of novel solutions in the production of large structures, such as buildings, ships and offshore platforms. In this context, the candidate is expected to work closely with our industrial partners on application-oriented use cases, while helping to commission and operate the unique set of equipment of the center. 

LSP is closely working together the companies at Odense Havn and similar partners making large structures across Denmark and Europe. LSP is integrated with the Odense Robotics Cluster involving startups and established companies in robotics. We are a team of currently about 24 researchers, engineers and PhD students, specialized in robot solutions involving modelling, simulation, and control of advanced robot technologies (systems and services) for application-oriented industrial applications. 

Our group is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners. We solve challenging research problems derived from real-life challenges by implementing novel robot solutions. We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team, with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

Job description

The candidate will be project administrator for the EUROfusion project. Jointly, and together with the rest of the team around this project, this goes for other institutes and departments of SDU TEK together with partners from ITER and EUROfusion. 

Profile and requirements

The candidate is expected to have the following qualifications:

• 
Good communication and collaborative skills

• 
Good English and Danish skills, both written and spoken

• 
Can work independently and have a good overview

• 
IT skills and being good at developing and maintaining procedures

• 
Background in engineering will be useful, e.g. involving handling of 3D models

Contact information

For further information, please contact Professor Christian Schlette via email (chsch@mmmi.sdu.dk) or on LinkedIn (www.linkedin.com/in/christian-schlette/).

Application deadline: November 30, 2026 at 23:59 o'clock. 

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

"Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.”

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out. 

You can only apply for the position at – https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu. 

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

At PriceShape, you’ll join an international SaaS company on a strong growth journey, where you’ll play a key role in making sure our existing customers succeed with our platform every day.

Your Role at PriceShape

As a Product Success Manager, you’ll support our existing customers and Customer Success Managers (CSMs) with product, data and technical questions. You’ll own every request from the moment it comes in until it is resolved or handed over with clear information and ownership.

Half of your time goes to product support: investigating issues, giving clear guidance and making sure each request reaches the right solution. The other half goes to commercial account handling: renewals, expansions, Business Reviews and spotting risks and opportunities in your accounts.

You’ll work closely with CSMs, Product Success colleagues, Solutions Engineers, Data Controllers, and our Product and Engineering teams.

What You’ll Be Doing

Product Success (approx. 50%)

• 
Handle product, data and technical questions from customers and CSMs with clarity, ownership and the right level of urgency.

• 
Investigate product configuration, product behaviour and data issues to find the cause and the right solution.

• 
Resolve requests on your own where you can, and work out whether a case is a product question, a data task or a product defect.

• 
Escalate complex data tasks to Data Controllers and product defects to Product or Engineering, with full context, examples and expected outcomes.

• 
Keep CSMs and customers updated on status, ownership and next steps.

• 
Turn recurring questions into better documentation, guidance and ways of working, and share insights with Product, Data and GTM.

Commercial Operations & Account Handling (approx. 50%)

• 
Proactively manage contract renewals, expansion plans and account upgrades in line with the account strategy.

• 
Prepare and run Business Reviews that show product value, ROI and fit with the customer’s strategic goals.

• 
Handle payment reminders and related account administration professionally.

• 
Document and escalate commercial risks and opportunities, such as churn threats or upsell potential seen in product usage.

What We’re Looking For

Experience in a customer-facing role within B2B SaaS, such as product support, customer success, technical account management or similar.

A strong analytical and technical mindset, and comfort working with data and complex product setups.

Fluent English, both written and spoken.

A fast-growing SaaS company with opportunities for personal and professional development.

• 
A collaborative and international team with a strong team spirit.

• 
A competitive salary package.

• 
Flexible working hours and a strong focus on work-life balance.

A modern, centrally located office in Aarhus C with great facilities, an in-house canteen, and social activities.

Pension and health insurance.

We’re a diverse team of 80 employees from 24 nationalities, working from a modern, centrally located office in Aarhus C. We prioritise work-life balance, trust, community and personal and professional growth.

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, please send us your CV and application as soon as possible. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Scientist for formulation and high throughput assay development
jobs.description:
Do you want to apply your skills within drug discovery and help turn new molecules into new drug products? We are looking for a motivated Scientist to support our drug discovery pipeline within Pharmaceutical Development in our Biotech unit at Gubra.

As our new Scientist, you will take ownership for physicochemical characterization of peptides including development and maintenance of our high throughput plate-based assays. You will be part of both our Pharmaceutical Development department and our cross-departmental drug discovery project teams contributing to study planning and data interpretation to progress our molecules through the discovery and development pipeline. You will work closely with scientists and laboratory technicians across Gubra.

Your new department

The Pharmaceutical Development department supports Gubra’s drug discovery & development projects by delivering physicochemical characterization, formulation development and analytical development and support for novel peptide drug candidates. Our department is involved all the way from early drug discovery, through to supporting Gubra’s CMC department when our projects go into clinical development. We are currently 5 scientists and 5 laboratory technicians in the department.

Key responsibilities

• Act as the Pharmaceutical Development lead scientist in drug discovery projects setting the scientific direction for designing, interpreting, and reporting studies from early drug discovery all the way to supporting clinical development.

• Responsible for setting up and developing new high-throughput plate-based assays to support discovery and development of new drug candidates.

• Evaluate physicochemical stability of peptides using high-throughput plate-based assays (fluorescence, UV, turbidity, DLS) and/or HPLC and MS.

• Drive early-stage formulation development for new drug candidates.

• Identify opportunities for automatization and optimization of our laboratory workflows and develop improvements in close collaboration with laboratory technicians and scientists.

Core competencies and qualifications

We imagine you have solid experience with and a strong interest in assay development for physicochemical characterization of peptides. You have knowledge and experience within early formulation development for peptides. You enjoy collaborating with laboratory technicians and scientists with different backgrounds and you thrive in a fast-paced environment.

• A PhD or master’s degree within biochemistry, chemistry, pharmaceutics, engineering, or similar.

• 3+ years relevant experience within drug discovery or development projects.

• Experience with different assay methods for peptides (fluorescence, UV, turbidity, DLS or others).

• Experience with coordination of laboratory tasks and close collaboration with laboratory technicians.

• Propose new scientific ideas, take initiative to move agreed work forward, and involve colleagues in developing and implementing improvements.

• Great execution and collaboration skills.

• Experience with communicating study plans, scientific findings and uncertainties clearly to scientists and laboratory technicians, adapting explanations to the audience and checking shared understanding.

As a person you are

• Keen to take on responsibility and take the lead.

• Proactive and good at initiating and delivering on new projects and following up on new ideas.

• Keen on collaborating across departmental workflows, sharing relevant knowledge and contributing to agreed priorities within your role and expertise.

• Able to adapt plans when priorities change, clarify expectations with colleagues and communicate the implications for ongoing work.

We offer

Gubra Biotech is a project-centric organization, and you will work in cross-functional teams on our drug discovery projects. As a Scientist representing Pharmaceutical Development, you will provide scientific recommendations within your discipline and agreed project priorities, working together with scientists from other study disciplines including Chemistry, Molecular Pharmacology, Translational Pharmacology, DMPK, and Computational Drug Discovery.

We are expanding our capabilities, and you will have the opportunity to impact what new methods and workflows that Pharmaceutical Development needs.

You will be supported to perform at your best, trusted to take ownership and encouraged to share your ideas, learn from colleagues and drive projects forward while growing professionally.

Contact and application

Please apply no later than November 29th, 2026, by uploading your motivated cover letter, resume and relevant diplomas on our website. Applications will be evaluated on a rolling basis.

If you have questions about the position, you are very welcome to contact Senior Department Manager Natashia Mai Yde Jacobsen at nyj@gubra.dk.

We are looking forward to receiving your application.

About Gubra

Gubra is a disease-agnostic techbio company specialized in peptide-based drug discovery and development as well as preclinical contract research services striving for excellence at all levels. We insist on doing things efficiently – and often differently - to reach the results we aim for. Our vision is to become leaders in the path towards a more sustainable and healthier world. We do that by facilitating the discovery of new medicine, and by acting and inspiring others to fight the ongoing climate and biodiversity crises.

Gubra’s activities are focused on the early stages of drug development and are organised in two main highly synergistic business areas: Biotech and CRO Services. We generate our revenue by performing research for life science companies as well as by partnering projects from our discovery and development pipeline.

Our therapeutic focus is within metabolic and fibrotic diseases, and we specialize in in vivo pharmacology, ex vivo assays, drug profiling, histology, stereology and whole brain and organ imaging. In addition, we offer a full palette of advanced transcriptomics. Our ML/AI-driven peptide drug discovery platform streaMLine enables us to rapidly develop a peptide hit into a non-clinical candidate ready for development. Through a constant focus on high quality, scientific excellence, speed, and solid teamwork we have established ourselves as a highly professional and competent partner in the market.

People are our greatest asset, and our team consists of around 300 employees of which many are located in Hørsholm, Denmark. The mix of people from different cultures and educational backgrounds combined with our entrepreneurial mindset have greatly impacted our working environment, which is characterized by entrepreneurial drive, scientific curiosity, and teamwork – we join forces!

Job title: Senior Research Scientist – Discovery Pharmacology

Department: Global Research

Location: Måløv, Denmark

**Your impact begins here

**As Senior Research Scientist – Discovery Pharmacology, you will help build a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research that generates and validates therapeutic concepts in cardiometabolic disease and healthspan. You will combine hands-on rodent pharmacology with original scientific thinking, shaping research questions and turning emerging biology into opportunities for drug discovery. Your work will bring new projects into the early discovery pipeline, because lasting health starts with the science we build today.

**What You Will Bring

**You hold a PhD in pharmacology, physiology, neuroscience or a related discipline, or bring equivalent relevant research experience. You also bring:

• At least two years of relevant post-PhD experience with scientific innovation, or equivalent scientific contributions.

• Hands-on experience in rodent pharmacology.

• Strong skills in experimental design, quantitative analysis and interpretation of complex biological data.

• Scientific depth in metabolic physiology, neuroscience, in vitro pharmacology, or a related area.

• Original scientific thinking, intellectual curiosity and the ability to turn ideas into testable hypotheses.

• A collaborative approach and the ability to work independently while contributing to shared research goals.

• Clear scientific communication in written and spoken English.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**Experience in metabolic phenotyping, advanced behavioural assays, rodent surgery, modern neuroscience methods, in vitro or ex vivo approaches, or developing novel experimental technologies. We welcome complementary profiles – you are not expected to bring expertise in every method or scientific area.

**What You Will Do

**You will contribute to both the scientific direction and hands-on experimental work of the team. Your responsibilities will include:

• Generate hypotheses and propose new therapeutic concepts grounded in biological understanding.

• Design, conduct, analyse and interpret mouse and rat pharmacology studies to investigate efficacy, mechanism of action and physiological responses.

• Develop experimental models and introduce methodologies that enable us to address challenging scientific questions.

• Connect in vivo findings with relevant in vitro and ex vivo experiments.

• Integrate evidence into recommendations on how emerging concepts should advance, change direction or be discontinued.

• Document and communicate findings, sharing scientific insights across disciplines and project teams.

• Contribute to rigorous, reproducible experimental practice and high standards of animal welfare.

All scientists are expected to contribute directly to experimental work alongside laboratory technicians and fellow scientists.

**Who You Will Work With

**You will join a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research within Research & Development, combining expertise in physiology, pharmacology, neuroscience and molecular innovation. Day to day, you will work closely with scientists and laboratory technicians. The team, headed by Christoffer Clemmensen, is currently recruiting at multiple levels, so you contribute to shape the new team from the onset.

You are expected to establish close collaborations across the organisation with colleagues in chemistry, biology, DMPK and relevant technology functions to develop and test new therapeutic concepts. Bringing these perspectives together early helps the team make clear, evidence-based decisions at pace.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will have the opportunity to shape the research of a new team and contribute your own ideas, in an environment that values thoughtful scientific challenge, collaboration and learning from unexpected findings.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000.00 to 956,900.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn emerging biology into new therapeutic concepts, apply for the Senior Research Scientist – Discovery Pharmacology role by 22 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.occupation: Head of P&O for Louis Nielsen
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about creating an exceptional employee experience and enabling business performance? Then this could be your next opportunity at Louis Nielsen and Specsavers.

Join us as our new Head of P&O for Louis Nielsen and take responsibility for a people agenda spanning two distinct parts of our business: our Support Office and our nationwide retail organisation. As a trusted business partner to the Country Leadership Team, you'll help shape organisational success by translating people priorities into meaningful business outcomes while leading a skilled, supportive and caring P&O team.

Your role

As Head of P&O, you will lead the local P&O team and people agenda for Louis Nielsen in Denmark. The role has two important dimensions.

For our Support Office, you will work closely with the Country Director and management team as a strategic P&O partner. You will help shape the organisation, leadership and employee experience needed to deliver the business plan, including organisational change, talent and performance, recruitment and onboarding, leadership development and engagement.

For our Retail organisation, you will ensure that the P&O team provides relevant and effective support to our stores and retail leaders. This includes strengthening the P&O services, processes and guidance available to stores, particularly within employee relations, employee experience and core people processes.

Across both areas, you will lead and develop the local P&O team, including payroll and connect Louis Nielsen with the wider Northern Europe P&O organisation, translating regional and global priorities into locally relevant delivery.

Your key responsibilities

Partnering with our Support Office:

• Partner with the Country Director and management team to shape and deliver the people agenda and local business plan.

• Advise and coach leaders on organisation, leadership, talent, performance and people-related matters.

• Lead organisational change and support leaders and colleagues through change.

• Ensure strong recruitment and onboarding, talent and performance processes, and development planning across the Support Office.

• Drive employee engagement, including Great Place to Work, action planning and follow-up.

Enabling our Retail organisation:

• Ensure that retail leaders and stores have access to relevant and effective P&O services and support.

• Support the continued development and delivery of HR services to stores, including employee relations and employee experience guidance.

• Ensure that core people processes and policies are practical, consistent and effective within our retail environment.

• Work closely with retail leadership to identify emerging people needs and translate them into appropriate P&O solutions.

Leading P&O and connecting with Northern Europe:

• Lead and develop the local P&O team, including payroll, creating clarity, capability and strong delivery.

• Represent Denmark within the Northern Europe P&O team and contribute to the Northern Europe People Plan.

• Translate relevant regional and global people priorities into strong local delivery.

• Partner with regional P&O colleagues across business partnering, learning and development, and operational excellence.

• Lead and contribute to cross-functional projects in Denmark and across Northern Europe.

Your new team

You'll lead the Danish People & Organisation team of six people while being part of the wider Northern Europe P&O function.

The team supports two distinct parts of Louis Nielsen: our Support Office and our nationwide retail organisation. The nature of that support differs, and an important part of your role will be ensuring that our P&O model meets the needs of both.

Within the Support Office, the team works closely with leaders and colleagues across the full employee lifecycle. For Retail, the focus is on providing scalable, effective P&O services, processes and guidance that enable our retail leaders and stores to succeed. You will also collaborate closely with colleagues across the Northern Europe P&O function.

What are we looking for?

“We are looking for someone who genuinely cares about our people, builds trust, and understands everyday life in our stores and Support Office. Someone who offers practical support and keeps things simple and efficient, freeing up time for meaningful conversations, development and looking ahead. You’ll help shape the people agenda in Denmark—and I look forward to working alongside you and our colleagues across Northern Europe, sharing ideas and supporting one another.”_

- Malene Green Brostrøm, People Director Northern Europe

Preferably our candidates will have some of the following competencies:

• Significant HR leadership experience within a complex, matrix organisation.

• Experience acting as a strategic People partner to senior business leaders.

• Experience balancing strategic business partnering with the delivery of scalable and effective HR services across different employee populations.

• A strong track record of leading organisational change and transformation initiatives.

• Experience linking business strategy, people priorities, and employee engagement outcomes.

• Experience working within an international environment.

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, coaching, and influencing skills.

• Strong leadership experience with a proven ability to develop high-performing teams.

• The ability to move comfortably between strategic business partnering and ensuring strong, pragmatic P&O delivery.

It would be an advantage if you have:

• Experience within retail, consumer goods, or other customer-facing multi-site environments.

• Experience working across multiple countries or markets.

• Knowledge of employment relations and organisational change programmes.

• Experience leading cross-functional projects in an international organisation.

As a person, we believe that you are:

• An inspiring leader who develops and motivates others.

• A trusted advisor who builds credibility and strong relationships at all levels.

• Commercially minded and able to connect people priorities with business performance.

• Structured and resilient, with the ability to navigate complexity and change.

• A collaborative communicator who engages stakeholders across functions and geographies.

What awaits you upon joining Louis Nielsen

At Louis Nielsen and Specsavers, you'll get more than just a job. You'll join an organisation with a clear purpose: changing lives through better sight and hearing.

We offer an exciting and influential leadership role where you'll play a key part in shaping the future of our people agenda in Denmark.

Joining us, you’ll get:

• Competitive compensation and benefits.

• Significant exposure to senior business leaders and strategic decision-making.

• An international and collaborative work environment.

• The chance to make a meaningful impact on both people and business performance.

• A culture built on trust, inclusion, and continuous development.

Your base will be at Louis Nielsen’s Support Office in Aalborg, but we take a very flexible approach to where you work. Finding the right person matters more to us than where in Denmark you live. You should, however, expect to spend a couple of days in Aalborg each week.

Is this your next step? Then apply today

To apply, please send us your CV using the button below. We want to respect your time, so including an application letter is optional. Feel free to apply as soon as possible. Please avoid including any photos or references to your age in your CV. It contributes to a fairer and more unbiased assessment.

We review CVs and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis. Our recruitment process typically consists of an initial screening, two rounds of interviews, and a personality assessment feedback session.

Diversity & Inclusion at Specsavers

Specsavers will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected factor.

In line with our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, we integrate these principles into all aspects of our work, from product development to team building.

jobs.occupation: HSO International - Dynamics 365 F&O Finance Lead Consultant
jobs.description:
Position: Dynamics 365 F&O Finance Lead Consultant

Department: Dynamics 365 F&O UO

Visa Sponsorship: You must have legal working rights in the country of your residence within the European region. Sponsorship is only available within the Netherlands.

**About HSO

**HSO is a global business transformation partner where innovation, AI, and Microsoft technology come together. With 30+ years of Microsoft expertise, 3,000 employees worldwide, 2,000+ clients, and 7,500+ projects delivered, we help organizations unlock the full potential of the Microsoft Cloud.

Recognized as a Microsoft AI Business Solutions Inner Circle Partner for 22 consecutive years and a Microsoft Frontier Partner, HSO is among the top Microsoft partners driving AI-powered transformation worldwide.

**About HSO International

**At HSO International, you'll join a diverse team of 300+ professionals representing more than 50 nationalities. We deliver cross-border transformation programs for international customers, combining local expertise with global reach in a culture built on collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.

Learn more about Life at HSO International: Life at HSO International

**The Opportunity

**As a D365 Finance Lead Consultant, you work with Microsoft Dynamics 365, the Azure cloud platform, and our unique, industry-specific solutions to develop the best strategy for a digital transformation and design, implement, and manage innovative cloud solutions for our customers. You will lead the Finance workstream of a complex multinational Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations transformation.

**What You’ll Do

****Lead Finance Transformation

**

• Lead the Finance workstream across international Dynamics 365 programs.

• Advise Finance leaders and key stakeholders on processes, operating models, and technology decisions.

• Lead discovery and design workshops, challenge existing processes, and identify opportunities for standardization, automation, and efficiency.

**Own Finance Solution Design

**

• Own functional design across Dynamics 365 Finance, including General Ledger, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Asset lease, PMA, Revenue recognition, Cost management, Electronic reporting, E-invoicing, Cash & Bank, Budgeting, Credit & Collections, financial reporting and multi-country localizations.

• Ensure Finance solutions work across countries, legal entities, and business units.

• Partner with Solution Architects and other workstreams across integrations, data, testing, and deployment.

**Lead the Workstream

**

• Guide Finance consultants on priorities, dependencies, risks, and key decisions.

• Act as a senior point of contact for the customer Finance team.

• Mentor consultants and maintain quality across Finance deliverables.

**Create Impact Beyond Delivery

**

• Support presales engagements, workshops, and demonstrations.

• Contribute to HSO Finance methodologies, accelerators, and best practices.

• Identify opportunities to apply Copilot, AI, automation, Power Platform, and analytics to Finance transformation.

**What We’re Looking For

**

• At least 10 years of ERP consulting experience with significant Finance expertise.

• Several years of experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations and multi-industry project experience.

• Experience leading a Finance workstream or taking senior functional ownership on complex implementations.

• Strong Finance process, workshop facilitation, solution design, and stakeholder management skills.

• Experience with international or enterprise-scale transformations and mentoring consultants.

• Familiarity with Power Platform, Azure, analytics, automation, AI, Copilot, and the wider Microsoft ecosystem.

• Strong English communication skills and a collaborative, commercially minded approach.

**What You’ll Gain

**

• Global impact: lead Finance transformation across countries, regions, legal entities, and business units.

• Leadership: take greater ownership while remaining close to Finance, technology, and delivery.

• Freedom: influence solution direction and shape your role around your strengths.

• Innovation: help define how AI, automation, and Copilot change Finance and consulting delivery.

• Growth and flexibility: learn from experienced Dynamics 365 professionals and work from anywhere in Europe.

**Location

**This role can be based anywhere within Europe for candidates with existing European or UK working rights. Travel to customer locations and HSO offices will be required as part of international transformation programs.

About Celvivo

Celvivo is a Danish life science company developing innovative solutions for growing and studying cells in 3D while mimicking in vivo conditions. Our platform brings together advanced laboratory equipment and cloud-based software, helping researchers explore new possibilities in cell culture and achieve new results in their scientific research and their work towards better patient outcomes.

Celvivo has a team of 35 employees across Denmark, the United States, Sweden, the Netherlands, the UAE, and Singapore.

As we expand our presence within the pharmaceutical industry, we are looking for an experienced and entrepreneurial Director of Quality Assurance & Regulatory Affairs to establish and lead our quality and regulatory journey.

The Opportunity

You will play a central role in preparing Celvivo for increased engagement with pharmaceutical customers, ensuring that our quality systems, certifications, product compliance practices, and regulatory approach support both current and future business objectives.

You will report directly to our CEO and serve as a key member of the management team, defining and implementing Celvivo’s quality and regulatory strategy. Initially, you will be a hands-on leader working closely with external consultants to establish the foundations of the QA/RA function. As the company grows, you will build and develop the QA/RA agenda and capabilities required to support our future ambitions.

This is a unique opportunity to work with a premium product and shape the quality and regulatory strategy at an ambitious growth company, where your decisions will directly influence our future direction, customer relationships, and market opportunities.

What You Will Do

Quality & Regulatory Strategy

• Define Celvivo’s quality and regulatory roadmap, including recommendations regarding certifications, regulatory positioning, and quality investments.

• Advise executive management on strategic quality and regulatory decisions.

• Develop budgets and implementation plans for QA/RA initiatives.

Quality Management System & Certification

• Lead the implementation of a scalable Quality Management System.

• Establish SOP frameworks and key quality processes.

• Drive certification activities and ensure ongoing compliance.

Regulatory Affairs & Product Compliance

• Determine product classifications across key markets, including the EU and US.

• Ensure compliance of product claims, labeling, marketing materials, and CE marking activities.

• Monitor regulatory developments relevant to Celvivo and our customers.

Customer & Supplier Quality

• Serve as the primary quality contact for customers.

• Lead customer and supplier audits.

• Establish and maintain quality agreements with distributors, suppliers, and customers.

• Ensure audit readiness across the organization.

Leadership & Business Partnership

• Collaborate closely with colleagues across the organization to create a pragmatic and effective quality culture.

• Maintain external and internal key stakeholders.

• Contribute actively to the management team and overall company strategy.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you will:

• 

• Complete a comprehensive gap analysis and recommend Celvivo’s future quality and regulatory path.

• Deliver an approved QA/RA roadmap and budget.

• Establish the SOP framework and document product classifications.

• Implement core QMS processes and prepare the company for certification.

• Develop a scalable resource plan for the future QA/RA organization

What You Bring

We imagine that you bring:

• 

• An MSc or equivalent degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related discipline.

• More than 10 years of QA/RA experience within life science tools, medical devices, diagnostics, or pharmaceutical environments.

• A proven ability to influence senior stakeholders.

• Experience implementing ISO 9001 and/or ISO 13485 compliant quality management systems, ideally from the ground up.

• Experience driving certification activities and interacting with auditors.

• Strong knowledge of product classification, labeling, and compliance requirements for laboratory equipment and related technologies.

• Experience working with pharmaceutical customers and quality audits is highly advantageous.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Danish is considered a plus

Why Join Celvivo?

At Celvivo you have the right to be nerdy, the obligation to be friendly, the chance to be pioneering and the privilege of working with premium products. We combine scientific curiosity with entrepreneurial ambition, and we are united by our mission to help researchers achieve better outcomes through smarter ways of working.

As Director of QA/RA, you will have a rare opportunity to create a function from the ground up and make a tangible impact on Celvivo’s future growth and success together with a team of passionate colleagues.

Interested? Send us your CV and a cover letter with a few words about yourself, your experience, and what motivates you to join Celvivo.

Would you like to be part of a finance department where you contribute both to the daily operations and to shaping and developing processes and workflows? Do you thrive in a role where you collaborate with colleagues and managers across the company? Then you might be our new controller.

Controller for a Growing Company in the Metal Industry

At Danpres A/S, we are a team of about 100 skilled and dedicated employees who develop and manufacture customized metal components for, among others, the renewable energy and food industries in Denmark and Germany.

We have many exciting projects in the pipeline and are continuing to grow. That’s why we are now looking for a new colleague to join our finance team, which currently consists of three employees.

Daily Operations and Development

As a controller in our finance team, your workday will be varied – including recurring key figures you track and follow up on to ensure correct registration. You support the accounting function and communicate with the sales and production leadership on how we can improve processes and work smarter.

Most importantly, our daily operations must run smoothly. We all need to be able to step in for each other and get the job done. That’s why we need you to bring structure and help create a collaborative environment where we understand each other’s tasks and coordinate continuously to stay aligned.

You will also play a key role in supporting the entire company with sparring, support, and suggestions for improvements to help us continuously evolve and work more efficiently. This requires a flexible mindset, patience, and the ability to adapt your communication to the many different colleagues and leaders you will work with.

What We Offer:

• A versatile role in a finance team covering accounting and controlling – including hands-on bookkeeping, reporting and support, budgeting, annual reports, KPI views, etc.

• A high degree of freedom and influence to shape your role, the direction, and how we do things.

• A broad collaboration with colleagues across the office and production floor.

• Close cooperation with your immediate manager to set clear goals that support your development.

• A company culture where we work daily on building job satisfaction and team spirit.

• An active staff association, lunch arrangement, and shared breakfast every Friday.

What We Expect from You:

• You have a relevant education and a solid professional skill set.

• You have strong analytical skills and are proficient in Excel.

• You take initiative and responsibility for moving tasks forward.

• You are patient and communicate constructively with colleagues.

• You are interested in or open to automation and can help identify smarter ways of working.

• You are comfortable communicating in both English and German.

• Experience from a manufacturing company and familiarity with Monitor ERP is a plus.

Further Information

Feel free to contact Finance Manager Lars Noe at +45 86 95 23 00 if you have any questions. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. Start date: as soon as possible.

Send your CV and application to hr@danpres.dk – write “Controller” in the subject line. Let us know why you’d like to work with us and what you can contribute.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About Danpres A/S

We provide customized component solutions for a wide range of industries and currently employ around 100 people at our site in Låsby, Denmark. Our customers are large manufacturing companies in Denmark and Germany, and we handle projects from initial idea to final assembly. Our modern 10,000 m² production facility houses 18 robots, and we continuously invest in new technology. At Danpres, our employees are our most valuable asset, and we actively invest in culture, collaboration, and workplace satisfaction.

Corti builds AI for critical industries. We started in healthcare, where messy inputs, specialized knowledge, and consequential errors make demanding engineering problems unavoidable. Today we train and post-train models, build agents, and turn research into APIs that developers use to build their products. Our platform supports more than one million production interactions every week.

We are building Europe’s alternative to closed AI: ambitious model development, published research, and AI infrastructure that gives developers control over the systems they depend on.

Our platform and APIs provide the building blocks for specialized intelligence that organizations own:

• 
Models: frontier and open-weight models with reasoning, tool calling, structured output, and embeddings through an OpenAI-compatible interface, plus custom models trained and post-trained on an organization’s own data.

• 
Sovereign compute: GPU capacity on Corti-operated European infrastructure for teams that need their data and workloads to stay in Europe.

• 
Agents: a harness to build, evaluate, and optimize agents that connect to real systems, with planning, tool use, external knowledge, persistent context, human approval, and observable execution.

• 
Speech: live dictation, conversational transcription, and batch audio processing.

• 
Clinical documentation: fact extraction as conversations unfold, and document generation with explicit schemas and controllable synthesis.

• 
Medical coding: code predictions from clinical narratives, linked to supporting passages.

Explore the platform at docs.corti.ai.

The Role

You want to train models at the frontier, and you want the science in the open, where other engineers can inspect it. At Corti, you don't have to choose.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer in our Applied AI team, you drive large-scale training and post-training alongside researchers and engineers. Your decisions span the training recipe, the evaluation, and the system that serves the result. The calls are consequential, and you stay close enough to the implementation to understand why they succeed or fail.

What You Will Do

• 
Designing and running distributed training, including architecture, data pipelines, parallelism, checkpointing, evaluation, and recovery.

• 
Improving model capabilities through supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and distillation.

• 
Finding the causes of unstable training, inefficient communication, poor utilization, and unexpected regressions.

• 
Developing models for agentic work: choosing tools, using evidence, maintaining context, and completing complex tasks reliably.

• 
Building evaluations that expose failure modes and establish whether an improvement holds outside the training distribution, including LLM-as-judge systems you build and calibrate

• 
Creating and curating training data, including synthetic data pipelines that feed real training runs.

• 
Turning stronger models into practical APIs by improving latency, throughput, memory use, and serving cost.

Which capabilities belong in the weights, and which need tools or retrieval? You help decide, and you build the experiments that establish the answer.

Put the science where engineers can inspect it

We believe engineers should be able to examine the methods and evidence behind the systems they build on. We publish research, release benchmark resources, and document how our platform works. Read the work behind our clinical APIs: corti.ai/research

Who you are

You have depth and an urge to experiment

• 
You have trained large language models and owned technically complex ML work. You can explain a difficult run in detail: the architecture, the bottleneck, the failed hypothesis, and the evidence that changed your mind.

• 
You bring strong practical distributed-training experience, and depth in areas such as mixture-of-experts models, reinforcement learning, or distillation. Experience serving open-weight models is a plus. You write code other engineers can build on and make technical trade offs clear.

• 
You know post-training methods from the inside.Preference optimisation and reinforcement learning have quirks, reward hacking, runs that look stable until they collapse, and signals that turns out to be noise. You have hit these problems and learned to spot them before they cost you a week.

• 
You have hands-on experience with the data the models learn from. You have built training-data pipelines, ideally synthetic ones, and stayed close to the training that consumed your data.

• 
You have evaluated LLMs in production. You have built and calibrated LLM-as-judge systems to automate that evaluation, and you know when a judge's score means something and when it just flatters the model it is scoring.

• 
You also have the itch to investigate. A new model, paper, or agent framework appears, and you want to understand what actually changed. You build experiments, compare approaches, and test the claims. Perhaps your latest side project involves agents building tools, coordinating with other agents, or failing in a surprisingly instructive way. We want to hear about it.

• 
A relevant advanced degree is welcome; equivalent experience matters just as much.

Build with us in Copenhagen

This is a full-time role reporting to the CTO. We provide equipment and relocation support.

We welcome different backgrounds and paths into machine learning. If the work fits your ambition and you bring substantial relevant experience, apply even if you do not match every item.

Send us something you built, a hard problem you solved, or a result you think deserves to be challenged. A link is enough. Help us shape the models, agents, and infrastructure developers build on next.

________________________________________________________________

We treat all candidates equally, are committed to bringing in top talent from all sectors and countries, and will not discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

Additionally, we want to remind you that experience comes in many forms, and we're passionate about creating teams with a multitude of perspectives! If you believe your experience is close to what we're looking for but not an exact match, we still hope you consider applying!

**Why we are hiring

**Spirii is growing. We work with charge point operators, businesses and fleets in several European markets, we take part in more and more tenders, and our commercial team has grown along the way. With growth comes friction. Deals and tenders are tracked in different places, the numbers in the CRM do not always match what we bill, and it takes too much effort to answer simple questions like “what will we close this quarter?”

We want one person to own the engine behind our revenue: the CRM, the data, and the path a customer takes from first contact to signed deal, onboarding and correct billing. That is this role. You will make work easier for our sales, marketing, onboarding and customer success teams, and you will give leadership numbers they can trust.

**The team

**You will report to our CSO. You will own Revenue Operations from end to end, and you will work every day with sales development, account executives, marketing, onboarding and customer success, and closely with Finance on billing data.

**What You Will Do

****CRM and tools

**

• Own and improve HubSpot, our CRM, so everyone works from the same clean data

• Make sure every deal and tender is tracked in one place, from first contact to result

• Set up and improve lead routing

• Bring in the other tools the commercial team needs, such as order management, bid management and lead development

• Make sure master data is correct, so billing runs smoothly

**Metrics and forecasting

**

• Define and track our core SaaS metrics: ARR, ACV, TCV, NRR and pipeline stages

• Run the weekly forecast and track how accurate it is

• Connect marketing, sales development, account executives and customer success, so the forecast reflects what is really happening

**Data and reporting

**

• Build dashboards that leadership trusts and uses to make decisions

• Keep the CRM clean and reconcile it with billing data

**Planning and sales process

**

• Build one clear sales process, with the same stages and rules from lead to handover across teams and markets

• Support territory design and regional planning reviews

• Run capacity modelling and lead quota planning

• Improve the path from lead to opportunity

**What Success Looks Like After Your First Year

**

• Leadership opens one dashboard and trusts what it sees

• Every deal and tender lives in HubSpot, and CRM data matches billing data

• The weekly forecast is a habit, and it gets more accurate over time

• Every market follows the same sales process

• Our sales team spends less time on admin and more time with customers

**What You Bring

**

• 5+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations or commercial analytics in a B2B SaaS company

• Strong CRM administration skills, ideally in HubSpot

• A track record of building tools and processes that help a sales organisation work better

• Comfort with data: Excel, SQL, or BI tools such as Tableau

• A good understanding of SaaS business models and unit economics

• Hands-on experience bringing AI tools into a sales or marketing team

• Fluent English. Another European language, such as German, French, Dutch, Swedish, Danish or Italian, is a big plus

• A degree in business, engineering or a similar field, or equivalent experience

**Who You Are

**

• You enjoy building things from the ground up, and you are comfortable when not everything is defined yet

• You take ownership and follow through

• You can think big picture and still roll up your sleeves to fix a workflow yourself

• You explain data clearly, whether you are talking to a sales rep or to the leadership team

• You like working with people from many countries and cultures

**Benefits

**It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work life balance.

• Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

• Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

• Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.

• Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.

• Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.

• Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.

• Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but Fluent English language skills are required.

**About Spirii – Who We Are

**Spirii is a full-service e-mobility provider which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii was founded seven years ago as a company. Nevertheless, the people in Spirii have extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, as well as the development of future transport- and energy systems.

Spirii is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Spirii strives to create an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of age, gender, race, sexual/religious orientation, or disability.

OJ drives, controllers and thermostats are subject to tough performance demands and stringent regulatory requirements. Making sure they excel consistently takes thorough testing, expert validation, and solid documentation. If you have experience with PRODUCT COMPLIANCE, EMC AND LVD, CERTIFICATION AND APPROVALS, and SYSTEMATIC TESTING, consider joining our team as a QA and Product Compliance Engineer.

OJ Electronics is looking for a QA and Product Compliance Engineer to help make sure our products live up to our customers’ expectations – also in terms of compliance with all applicable regulations.

We are looking for a Senior Security Engineer who views security as an engineering challenge, not a checkbox exercise. You will join our Infrastructure Team to own security across our entire stack (from the low-level GKE configurations to the high-level application logic).

In a startup of our size, "chaos" is just another word for "opportunity." You aren’t here to just manage compliance spreadsheets or interface with IT; you are here to build the tooling, automation, and architecture that makes it impossible for our developers to make a critical mistake as we continually increase velocity.

What You’ll Do

• Own the Stack: Secure everything from our Kubernetes clusters on the cloud to our SaaS integrations and developer workflows.

• Usher in the Future: articulate and execute on a vision for what security should be in the age of LLMs giving both us and attackers increasing leverage.

• Engineer for Security: Build internal tooling and CI/CD automations that catch vulnerabilities before they ever hit production.

• Architect & Model: Lead threat modeling sessions and secure code reviews, ensuring we design "secure-by-default" APIs and deployments.

• Harden the Perimeter: Take a first-principles approach to hardening authentication and access control across all internal and external surfaces.

• Red Team: proactively probe for vulnerabilities and lead the remediation.

• Lead the Bug Bounty: You will be the primary owner for standing up, launching, and managing our Bug Bounty Program , triaging reports, and driving remediation.

• Respond & Remediate: Investigate vulnerabilities, lead incident response, orchestrate pen testing, and run blameless postmortems that actually result in systemic change.

• Evangelize: Be the partner, not the blocker. Translate complex security risks into actionable engineering tasks that your peers can get excited about.

Who You Are

• Startup Native: You thrive in a fast paced 100–300 person environments. You know how to prioritize when everything feels urgent and are comfortable "failing forward" to find the right solution.

• Security-First Engineer: You have 6+ years of experience in software/infrastructure engineering with a deep obsession with security. You don't just find holes; you write the code to plug them.

• Cloud Savvy: You are deeply familiar with Google Cloud (GCP) , Kubernetes , and containerized environments.

• Systems Thinker: You can analyze a system for weaknesses whether they are buried in business logic, IAM configurations, or the codebase.

• Action-Oriented: You have a track record of responding to real-world incidents and leading remediation efforts without being the "no" person.

Our Technical Stack

• Cloud: Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

• Orchestration: Kubernetes (GKE)

• Infrastructure: Terraform / Infrastructure-as-Code

• Pipeline: Modern CI/CD workflows and various SaaS integrations

Where You'll Work

Roboflow is distributed across the US and Europe. We currently have Hubs in New York City and San Francisco (and plan to open more as we grow density in new cities). We provide opportunities (like team onsites in different cities) and resources (like a $4000/yr travel stipend) to work in person with other team members as much as you'd like, while also supporting remote team members. You can work from one of our Hubs (we offer a relocation bonus), work from home, work at co-working spaces, etc. We want you to work where you work best!

What You’ll Receive

To determine your salary, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources. We review all salaries every six months to ensure we stay in line with the market.

The target salary for this position ranges from $165,000-$200,000

In addition to our cash compensation, we offer generous perks and benefits. Below are some of the highlights:

• $4000/yr Travel Stipend to travel anywhere anytime to work alongside other Roboflowers

• $350/mo Productivity stipend to spend on things that make your work environment more productive, like high-speed internet at home or a co-working space

• $350/mo AI Tools stipend

• $150/mo team lunch stipend

• $500/one time home office stipend

• Cover up to 100% of your health insurance costs for you and your partner or family

• Equity in the company so we are all invested in the future of computer vision

Interview Process (6+ hours)

Below is the interview process you can expect for this role. We are all motivated to work with an exceptional team and you will be speaking directly with our team about what it's like to work and thrive at Roboflow. We like to be decisive and work fast, so don't be surprised if all the below conversations happen over a day or two.

Before the Interview

• We’ll review your application, LinkedIn, Github, etc.

• The best way to stand out is to write about something you’ve built with Roboflow or contribute to one of our open source projects .

• We may send you a technical screen if applicable.

Introduction Phase

• [30m] Meet with People Ops

• [30m] Meet with hiring manager to assess for overall mindset and skillset

• [45m] Technical Assessment

Team Interview Phase

• [30m] Meet with another member of the team

• [60m] Meet with hiring manager or CTO Use this time to review specifics about the job description

• Begin working through your 30/60/90 projects

• Ask questions!

Final Interview Stage

• [45m] Meet with Head of Operations for a culture discussion

• [60m / Optional] Meet with Joseph Nelson, CEO

Note: you are welcome to request additional conversations with anyone you would like to meet and we will accommodate as best we can.

Learn More About Us

Roboflow is a diverse, distributed team and an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, plus opportunities to learn from and contribute to our world-class team.

Equal Employment Opportunity

We’re committed to building an inclusive team where great ideas come from everywhere. We consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**Role

**With a clear strategy of becoming an integrated end-to-end biotech innovation powerhouse, Genmab is directly involved in the commercialization of our products. To further strengthen the Quality Assurance Commercial & Lifecycle team located in Denmark and the United States, we are looking for a Senior Manager, Quality Assurance (QA) to join our Good Distribution Practice (GDP) team in Denmark.

As Senior Manager, QA - GDP, you will play an important role in ensuring quality and compliance across Genmab’s global commercial distribution network. You will have a broad and hands-on role covering storage and distribution activities, vendor oversight and cross-functional projects, working closely with international vendors and partners as well as stakeholders across QA, Supply Chain and Commercial Operations. Auditing is a significant part of the role, and you will conduct GxP audits of external vendors and partners across our global network. The role requires approximately 50% international travel to vendors and partners, primarily in connection with GxP audits. We are looking for an experienced QA professional who is comfortable taking ownership and navigating new or unfamiliar areas. As a Senior Manager, you will also act as a subject matter resource within your areas of responsibility, providing quality guidance and advice to stakeholders and contributing to compliant and risk-based decision-making.

This is an individual contributor role at Senior Manager level. The position is based in Denmark and reports to the Director of QA GMP, Commercial & Lifecycle - Storage and Distribution.

**Responsibilities

**

• Plan and conduct GxP audits of external vendors and partners and contribute to audit planning, follow-up and continuous improvement based on audit observations and trends.

• Take ownership of vendor oversight activities, including vendor risk evaluations, quality agreements and follow-up on the performance and compliance of GDP vendors.

• Independently manage operational GDP quality activities, including external notifications, change controls, deviations and other quality issues involving external partners.

• Participate in and support recall operations for the EU market in collaboration with the global QA GMP team and external partners.

• Contribute to shipping lane validation/qualification and perform GDP risk assessments related to storage, transportation and supply chain operations.

• Contribute to the implementation and continuous improvement of quality systems, SOPs and work instructions.

• Represent QA GDP in cross-functional and global projects, taking ownership of QA deliverables within assigned areas.

• Perform shipment release and support EU serialization activities.

• Support implementation and maintenance of GDP training.

• Participate in regulatory inspections and internal audits.

• Maintain knowledge of new and updated GDP regulations and guidelines and translate relevant requirements into practice.

• Collaborate closely with Supply Chain, Commercial Operations and other stakeholders to ensure compliant distribution practices.

• Handle and contribute to continuous improvement of Product Complaint intake and investigations.

• Take on new quality topics and assignments as business needs evolve, independently building the knowledge and stakeholder network needed to bring activities forward.

**Requirements

**

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in science or related field.

• You have 8+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry, with significant experience within Quality Assurance and GxP. Experience within GDP and commercial distribution is preferred but not required.

• You have solid experience conducting GxP audits and are comfortable acting as an auditor. Audit experience is a requirement for this position.

• You are proactive, curious and comfortable taking ownership of assignments, independently navigating new or unfamiliar areas and finding solutions where the way forward is not predefined.

• You have strong interpersonal and problem-solving skills and can establish effective relationships across functions, geographies and with external partners.

• You communicate confidently in English and are comfortable asking questions, challenging constructively and making quality decisions within your area of responsibility.

• You must already be based in Denmark at the time of application, and you are willing to travel approximately 50% of the time across Europe, the United States, and the rest of the world on a long-term basis.

**About You

**

• You are genuinely passionate about our purpose.

• You bring precision and excellence to all that you do.

• You believe in our rooted-in-science approach to problem-solving.

• You take pride in enabling the best work of others on the team.

• You can grapple with the unknown and be innovative.

• You have experience working in a fast-growing, dynamic company (or a strong desire to).

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK607.920,00---911.880,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

atNorth is a leading Nordic data center company providing cost-effective, scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit services to industry-leading organizations across Iceland, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark.

With sustainability at our core, our data centers run on renewable energy and are designed according to circular economy principles. Through innovative design, power efficiency, and intelligent operations, we deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance infrastructure.

Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across the Nordics, with additional sites under development in Finland, Denmark, Sweden and Norway.

We combine world-class technology with a people-first culture built on collaboration, ownership, and trust, empowering our teams to grow, take responsibility, and make a real impact.

By joining our international team, you will help shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure.

**Senior Technical Lead - Electrical at atNorth

**Are you a seasoned electrical engineering expert with a passion for delivering and operating world-class data centre infrastructure? At atNorth, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the next generation of sustainable, high-performance data centres across the Nordics.

As the technical authority for electrical systems and critical power infrastructure, you will provide expert guidance across both project delivery and operations, ensuring technical excellence, engineering integrity, and operational reliability throughout the asset lifecycle.

This is a unique opportunity to combine deep technical expertise with strategic influence, working closely with Operations, Design, Development, and industry-leading specialists to drive innovation in one of the fastest-growing sectors in Europe.

**Key responsibilities:

**

• Act as the technical lead and authority and signatory for electrical engineering designs, calculations, specifications, standards, and operational procedures.

• Provide expert leadership across critical electrical infrastructure, including LV and MV distribution systems, UPS systems, generators, batteries, protection systems, and associated controls.

• Drive design reviews, engineering assurance, commissioning activities, and technical handovers to ensure operational readiness and long-term reliability.

• Develop and maintain engineering standards, technical specifications, operational procedures, and best-practice frameworks across atNorth's Nordic data centre portfolio.

• Collaborate closely with Design, Development, and Operations teams to ensure seamless integration of new infrastructure and effective transition into operations.

• Lead technical investigations, troubleshooting efforts, and root-cause analyses for complex electrical incidents and performance issues.

• Serve as the primary electrical engineering advisor for internal stakeholders, clients, consultants, and vendors.

• Evaluate emerging technologies and industry developments, supporting innovation within critical power systems and data centre infrastructure.

• Drive training, technical mentoring, and knowledge sharing across operational and engineering teams to strengthen capability and consistency.

• Support asset lifecycle planning, maintenance strategies, resilience improvements, and continuous improvement initiatives across the portfolio.

**Your profile:

**

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.

• Minimum 10 years of experience in electrical engineering, critical infrastructure, or mission-critical environments, including progression into senior technical leadership roles.

• Extensive experience delivering data centre engineering projects, with deep expertise in critical electrical infrastructure, including LV and MV distribution, UPS systems, generators, batteries, protection systems, and power quality management.

• Strong understanding of commissioning, system integration, operational readiness, maintenance strategies, and asset lifecycle management.

• Proven experience acting as a technical authority, reviewing and approving engineering designs, technical documentation, specifications, and operational standards.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Fluent English and willingness to travel across the Nordic region as required.

**About the atNorth Culture

**We believe that sustainable success starts with the wellbeing of our people. For us, an open, transparent, and inclusive culture is more than a priority, it is the core of how we lead and innovate.

We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced.

We recognize that innovation and collaboration thrive where people feel truly connected, which is why we come together each week to share ideas, strengthen relationships, and nurture a sense of belonging, sometimes over a simple breakfast and good conversation.

At atNorth, we are building a community where you can do your best work and shape a sustainable future together. #99

Are you passionate or curious about cutting-edge optics and photonics? Do you want to help manufacture the world’s best spectrometers – and make a real difference in industries ranging from green energy to healthcare?

Join Ibsen Photonics – a global leader in optical innovation.

We’re looking for talented production engineers to join our Engineering team, where we support, validate and continuously improve the production of our transmission grating based spectrometers in collaboration with international customers.

Why join us?

At Ibsen Photonics, we combine world-class technology with a strong sense of purpose. Our products help advance green energy, improve healthcare diagnostics, and enable innovation across a wide range of industries.

Since 2014, we have 5-folded our revenue, reaching annual sales of more than 200 MDKK. We are 100 dedicated colleagues working from our R&D and manufacturing facility in Farum, just outside Copenhagen.

We offer:

• An important role in a fast-growing, financially strong company

• A culture built on trust, collaboration, freedom with responsibility, and swift decision-making

• An innovation-driven workplace where your ideas matter – and where you will see them come to life

Your role: Production Engineer in the Spectrometer production

You will join our 7-person Spectrometer Engineering team. We are a cross-disciplinary team taking pride in combining our individual expertise to achieve the best. Your tasks will primarily be related to supporting and improving our spectrometer production. Every spectrometer leaving our facility is thoroughly tested, and you will play an important role in improving and maintaining our optical test setups and automated test software.

Your tasks will include:

• Contributing to New Product Introductions

• Innovating established processes in order to increase our capabilities while improving robustness.

• Troubleshoot, correct and prevent production issues

• Validation and statistical analysis

• Quality Assurance support and documentation

What you bring

We are looking for someone who is both technically strong and possess the curiosity and drive to immerse yourself in the wonderful world of photonics. Whether you have many years of industry experience or are starting your career, we look forward to integrate your skills in our department.

You are required to have

• An M.Sc. degree in Engineering, Physics or similar

• Hands-on experience with opto-mechanical assemblies or experimental optics work

• Coding proficiency in eg. Python, MatLab or LabVIEW for test automation and data analysis.

• A structured, analytical approach to problem-solving and quality assurance

• A proactive mindset and a desire to reach goals in collaboration

• Oral and written proficiency in Danish.

Ideally you also have

• Experience from a volume manufacturing environment

• Routine in carrying out validation activities

• Insight into detectors and electronics

What we offer

• Flexible working hours

• A culture where everyone contributes to a shared goal – and takes pride in the result

• A friendly, respectful work environment with regular social events

• Competitive salary and benefits (details can be discussed during the interview)

Ready to make a difference?

If you believe you are the right candidate for the position, click the application link to apply on our website. We are looking to recruit as soon as possible but will keep the position open until we have found the right candidate. If you want more information about the position, please call Morten Mechlenborg on +45 4290 1466 or email morten.mechlenborg@ibsen.com.

About Ibsen Photonics

Ibsen’s core technology is optical transmission gratings and grating based spectrometers, which we design, manufacture and supply to customers worldwide. Our spectrometers find their way into medical devices and scientific instruments used in sustainable energy, industrial, pharmaceutical, life sciences, security, and many other applications.

We work closely with our customers to create value adding solutions, sharing our extensive technical knowledge in an open and honest work environment with a flat “Scandinavian” hierarchical structure.

You will join a rapidly growing company employing 85 people at our facility just north of Copenhagen, and realising a turnover of more than 150 MDKK in 2023. We work actively with the UN’s Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and strive to make our business fully sustainable.

Ibsen Photonics is majority owned N. Foss & Co. A/S, a world leader in analytical solutions for the agricultural industry, with an annual turnover of 2.5 Billion DKK and more than 1.800 employees.
