jobs.description:
**Security and Fire Specialist, Denmark

****Lyngby, Odense, Vejle, Esbjerg, Aarhus, Aalborg

**Full-time Permanent

Hybrid

Are you a fire protection and security systems specialist looking to develop robust technical solutions within one of Denmark’s largest electrical engineering teams in Buildings and Industry? Do you thrive on thoughtful building design, reliable systems and multidisciplinary collaboration across a diverse project portfolio? If so, we would like to hear from you.

**Create the solutions that enable a better tomorrow

**We are seeking a Senior Security and Fire Specialist to strengthen our expertise in security and fire protection systems for complex projects that support essential societal functions. You will join COWI’s Buildings and Industry division, where approximately 500 specialists work with clients on some of the most significant projects in Denmark and internationally.

You will be part of an international network of specialists, collaborating closely with colleagues across disciplines and countries. With a primary focus on fire protection and security systems, you will play a key technical role in both your own assignments and larger multidisciplinary projects. Sustainability and digital development are priorities at COWI, and an interest in integrating these perspectives into your work would be an advantage.

We welcome candidates from a range of professional backgrounds. As a large electrical engineering discipline within Buildings and Industry, we bring together diverse skills and experience, united by a commitment to collaboration, integrity and a positive working environment. You may have a qualification in electrical installation, electrical engineering, marine and technical engineering, or a related field.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Working with fire protection and security systems, including ABA, ABDL, AVA, ABV, ADK, AIA and TVO

• Preparing project documentation throughout all phases of major construction projects

• Providing technical consultancy, design, specifications and tender documentation for security and fire protection systems

• Undertaking project follow-up, site supervision and commissioning of security and fire protection systems

• Developing and sharing best practice, exchanging knowledge and maintaining up-to-date technical expertise within the discipline

**Your skills. Our team. Together, we design the future.

**The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

You will also bring

• In-depth knowledge of security and fire protection systems, gained through practical experience, formal education or a combination of both; your specific educational background is not a determining factor

• The ability to communicate clearly, precisely and unambiguously in both written and spoken English and Danish

• Recent, relevant experience with security and fire protection systems

• Ideally, more than 10 years of experience providing consultancy on security and fire protection systems

• Knowledge of CER and NIS2 would be an advantage

• The ability to obtain security clearance to at least HEM (SECRET) level

**A place to work – and so much more

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

**Do you have more questions?

**For more information about the position and what we offer, please contact Priyanka, our Global Talent Acquisition Specialist, at prki@cowi.com.

Learn more about our projects, strategy, ambitions and life at COWI at www.cowi.com.

We are committed to a fair and unbiased recruitment process. To support this, please do not include a photograph in your CV.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, and inclusion is integral to the way we work.

**We are committed to a respectful and equitable workplace where every colleague feels a sense of belonging and has equal opportunities to thrive and develop. We expect our leaders to model inclusive leadership and foster a culture that values different perspectives and ideas. Diversity and inclusion inform our relevant decisions and processes, as well as the way we bring teams and forums together. This reflects our values and our belief that it is the right thing to do.

**About Flatpay

**Flatpay is not just another payment solution; we're dedicated to innovating the market for payment solutions and financial services in the SME segment with our customer-centric and transparent services.

We've grown into one of the fastest-growing fintech companies out of the Nordics and Denmark's fastest unicorn company. Today, we're more than 2,000 colleagues across Europe, building products that make a real difference for our customers.

We're ambitious, move fast, and like to challenge the status quo - but we also believe work should be fun. We celebrate wins, help each other out, and create an environment where people can do great work while genuinely enjoying the journey.

**About The Job

**Flatpay has become one of Europe's fastest-growing payment companies by helping merchants accept card payments in-store.

Our Point of Sale system serves as the central engine of the business. It streamlines the merchant's entire workflow — from order taking, product and inventory management, to payment processing, reporting, and compliance.

**Some Of The Core Capabilities Include

**

• Product catalogue: Organizes how they manage their products, categories, modifiers and inventory

• Order management: Basket, pricing, discounts, payments and managing tables and long-running orders among groups of customers.

• Hardware integrations to barcode scanners, receipt and kitchen/bar printers and our different Mobile-, Premium- and Basic POS devices. No least manage synchronicity across multiple POS systems at shared locations in realtime.

• Our reporting suite ensures cash management, end-of-day reports, various sales, turnover, staff, tax and compliance reports that enables merchants to optimize their business and comply with local tax regulations.

As our merchants grow, so does the platform. Every new market introduces new payment methods, fiscal requirements and merchant needs. Every new feature increases the depth and complexity of the product. And with our customer base doubling approximately every six months, the demands on scalability, reliability and performance continue to grow.

This is a hands-on engineering role with significant ownership. You'll influence technical direction, contribute to architectural decisions and solve the engineering challenges that come with building one of Europe's fastest-growing commerce platforms.

What you'll do

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll contribute far beyond implementation. You'll help shape technical direction while remaining deeply involved in building products. You'll work closely with Product, Design and fellow engineers to build software that scales across all dimensions: more merchants, more markets, more capabilities and increasingly sophisticated workflows.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Designing, building and evolving features across our Point of Sale platform platform.

• Lead feature and platform initiatives involving multiple engineers, driving delivery from discovery through production

• Build APIs, services, and integrations that enable stock, order lifecycle, sales reporting & compliance reporting towards governmental standards of our markets.

• Take ownership of features from design and implementation through deployment and maintenance

• Drive architectural decisions and long-term technical improvements

• Improve reliability, observability, performance, and security across the platform

• Mentor engineers through coaching, code reviews, and knowledge sharing

• Continuously improving our engineering practices, tooling and development experience

• Contribute to testing, operational excellence and contribute to a collaborative team culture

Who you are

We're looking for experienced engineers who enjoy solving difficult problems and helping others succeed.

**You Likely Bring

**

• 7+ years of professional software engineering experience

• Strong experience designing and operating distributed systems

• Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects involving multiple engineers and influence architectural decisions

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity and helping shape new products and systems

• The ability to break down complex problems into pragmatic, maintainable solutions.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills

• Experience building scalable backend platforms and APIs

• Continuously improve CI/CD pipelines

• A collaborative mindset and a willingness to challenge ideas constructively

• Contribute to testing, operational excellence and contribute to a collaborative team culture

• Experience within payments, fintech, e-commerce, SaaS, or high-scale transaction systems is a plus

You'll be working with the following technologies; we don't expect experience with every technology listed; we're looking for engineers who can learn quickly and help us build great products.

• Java, Spring Boot, JUnit

• MySQL, Flyway, SQS

• REST APIs

• Domain Driven Design

• Docker, Terraform, AWS ECS

• Ports and adapters architecture

**Why Flatpay

**Joining Flatpay means stepping into a dynamic environment where innovation is encouraged, and teamwork is celebrated. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, contributing to our mission of empowering merchants to succeed.

With us, you’ll experience an ambitious drive to constantly push boundaries and redefine what's possible. While we don’t take ourselves too seriously, we take our responsibility towards our people very seriously. We welcome driven, low-ego individuals who live our values and want to grow with us.

jobs.occupation: PhD in modelling and experiments on PEM electrolysis
jobs.description:
At the Faculty of Engineering and Science, AAU Energy, a position as PhD stipend is available within the general study program. The stipend is open for appointment from January 1st or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

Your work tasks

The position is offered in relation to the research group "Hydrogen and Electro Fuels" and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Thermal Engineering”.

Your competencies As a PhD student in modelling and experiments on PEM water electrolysis, you will work at the intersection of chemical and electrochemical reactor engineering, with a particular emphasis on electrolysis. The project focuses on testing proton exchange membrane electrolysis cells, characterising their electrochemical performance and developing detailed electrochemical cell models. You will design and carry out experiments on single cells, analyse electrochemical behaviour under different operating conditions and use the resulting data to build, calibrate and validate mechanistic models that describe transport, kinetics and degradation phenomena.

An important part of your work will be to investigate how PEM electrolysers perform when conventional materials are partially replaced by recycled ionomers and iridium. You will compare performance, stability and degradation patterns with and without recycled components and translate your findings into a deeper understanding of the underlying electrochemical mechanisms. In parallel, you will conduct techno‑economic assessments of PEM electrolysis systems, including related life cycle assessment studies, to evaluate how material choices, operating strategies and system design affect costs and environmental impacts over the full life cycle.

The PhD project is carried out in the context of the CYCLOPEM, EDSOES and CAPEX projects, which provide access to state‑of‑the‑art experimental facilities and collaboration with academic and industrial partners. You are expected to participate in project meetings and to present your results at international conferences and workshops. In addition, you will contribute to teaching activities within courses on chemical and electrochemical reactors and take part in the daily activities of the Hydrogen and Electro Fuels research group at AAU Energy, including group meetings, seminars and joint publications.

The applicant must have a relevant professional and/or educational background within thermal, chemical and electrochemical engineering. Modelling of chemical and electrochemical reactor and LCA.

**Qualification requirements

**PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

**Who we are

**AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean

and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real‑world energy challenges.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg/Esbjerg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday life. New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters.

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk

**How to apply

**Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position

• Curriculum Vitae (CV)

• Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades)

• Project description (4-5 pages), that: describes the applicant’s initial thoughts and ideas related to the specific project applied for. This includes a brief state-of-the-art (including short list of references), a time schedule and how the applicant intends to shed light on the project objectives

• Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.

Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

**Salary and terms of employment

**The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement).

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world

Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Join Copenhagen Energy Trading as our new Machine Learning Engineer

Machine learning is becoming an increasingly important part of how we understand energy markets, improve forecasts, and make trading decisions. We are therefore looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to move our models from research to production, building robust, scalable pipelines that continuously improve our strategies.

At Copenhagen Energy Trading (CET), we combine deep market expertise with machine learning, quantitative research, data, and engineering to automate and optimise how we trade power. We’re a small, highly ambitious team based in central Copenhagen, specialising in power trading and asset management across Europe and North America. Technology is at the core of how we operate, supported by one of Europe’s most advanced automated and analytical trading environments for power markets.

The Opportunity

Energy markets produce vast amounts of data and are continuously shaped by weather, power production, transmission constraints, and market behaviour. Using that data meaningfully requires accurate models and reliable software and infrastructure that allow those models to run in production.

As our Machine Learning Engineer, you’ll work across machine learning and software development. Alongside quantitative researchers, software engineers and traders, you’ll build the production systems behind our ML pipelines, making our trading more performant, more reliable and more automated.

You’ll own the full lifecycle around the model: from data management to the pipelines and frameworks that deploy and monitor our models, keeping them reliable and adaptive as markets evolve. The opportunity for impact is large, and so is what it asks of you: dedication, real talent and the willingness to grind through hard problems. This is a hands-on engineering role at the centre of how CET uses machine learning to trade.

What You Will Do

• Strengthen our ML framework: Build and improve the framework our researchers use to build models and quantitative strategies.

• Build production-ready software: Design and develop reliable, scalable, and well-tested Python software that integrates machine learning into our internal trading platforms.

• Develop data infrastructure: Build and maintain data pipelines and storage solutions for ingesting, transforming, and serving diverse market and fundamental data.

• Ship and operate models: Take models from experiment to production, including deployment, serving, monitoring and experiment tracking

• Improve our ML and engineering practices: Help strengthen our approach to MLOps, testing, CI/CD, code reviews, and the wider model development lifecycle.

• Shape our technical solutions: Evaluate and introduce tools and technologies that improve how we develop, deploy, and operate machine learning solutions.

• Collaborate across disciplines: Work closely with quantitative researchers, traders, and software engineers to turn business and market needs into practical technical solutions.

• Build energy-market expertise: Develop a deep understanding of power markets and how machine learning, data, and software can improve trading decisions.

What We're Looking For

We value strong technical ability, sound judgement, curiosity, and motivation to learn. While we don't expect a perfect match, many of the following qualifications will help you succeed in the role:

• Strong software engineering skills: Experience building clean, scalable, tested, and production-ready software. Strong Python skills are essential, as Python is our primary development language.

• MLOps and development practices: Proficiency in Git, code reviews, CI/CD, experiment tracking, model deployment, and monitoring.

• Cloud computing: Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP, ideally including relevant data and machine learning services.

• Problem-solving and communication: The ability to structure complex problems, communicate clearly, and collaborate with colleagues across technical and commercial disciplines. Full professional proficiency in English is required.

• Ownership: The ability to work independently and deliver in a fast-paced environment.

• Interest in energy markets: Curiosity about power markets, trading, and energy systems. Previous experience in energy or trading is an advantage, but not a requirement.

• Education: A degree with a strong technical focus, e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, or other relevant fields. We welcome different educational backgrounds and levels of qualification.

What We Offer

• Growth environment: Become part of a young, ambitious, and expanding tech-driven trading company where talented people are given responsibility and room to grow.

• Exceptional team: Work closely with experienced quantitative researchers, software engineers and power traders.

• Competitive compensation: Receive a competitive salary package and attractive benefits that reflect your skills and contributions.

• Strong culture: Participate in both social and professional events, including team sports, company parties, team-building, and informal gatherings that strengthen our team spirit.

• Central Copenhagen location: Work from our office in Carlsberg Byen, located in beautifully renovated historic Carlsberg buildings.

How to Apply

If this opportunity feels like the right fit for you, we would love to hear from you.

Please apply via LinkedIn and submit your cover letter, CV, and university transcripts as a single PDF. Please note that applications that do not meet these requirements may not be considered.

Application deadline: November 27, 2026

If you have any questions, please contact Carl Frederik Grønvald (Senior Quantitative Analyst) at cfg@copenhagen-energy.com or Anna Schumann (People & Culture Manager) at as@copenhagen-energy.com.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher in Molecular Plant-Microbe Interactions
jobs.description:
The Plant Molecular Biology section at the Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics is seeking a highly motivated and ambitious postdoctoral researcher to join a dynamic and international research team. You will play a central role in advancing our understanding of the molecular dialogue between plants and their associated microorganisms, with the long-term goal of contributing to more sustainable and resilient agricultural systems.

The research team you will join is coordinating an international program that brings together leading scientists from around the world to investigate beneficial plant–microbe associations and harness their potential for sustainable food production.

Our focus is on uncovering the molecular mechanisms by which plants and microbes interact—ranging from early recognition events to colonization strategies. Within this framework, the advertised postdoctoral project is specifically focused on plant engineering for improved symbiotic associations with soil microbes. This knowledge forms the foundation for the development of novel solutions to reduce the need for chemical inputs and improve crop productivity, particularly in smallholder farming systems.

Your contributions will directly support the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), especially those related to food security, sustainability, and climate resilience.

Expected start date and duration of employment
This is a fixed-term position from 15 February 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter, to end on 31 March 2028.

Job description
• Conduct independent and collaborative research into the molecular and genetic basis of plant–microbe interactions, with a particular emphasis on beneficial symbioses.
• Design, execute, and analyze experiments using molecular biology, plant transformation, gene expression, and phenotyping.
• Apply plant genetics and genomics to study mechanisms underlying plant–associated bacteria.
• Collaborate with international partners and contribute to joint research efforts within the program.
• Present your work at group meetings, conferences, and in high-quality scientific publications.
• Contribute to the supervision of MSc and PhD students, fostering an inclusive and supportive research environment.
Your profile
• You hold a PhD in Molecular Biology, Plant Biology, or a related field.
• You have strong expertise in molecular and genetic techniques, with prior experience in plant genetics and molecular biology.
• Experience working with plant–microbe systems will be considered an advantage.
• Expertise in genetic engineering, transcriptomics, or advanced microscopy will also be an asset.
• You are curious, creative, and capable of driving projects independently while thriving in collaborative research settings.
• You have excellent communication skills and are fluent in English, both spoken and written.
• You are motivated to contribute to applied outcomes of fundamental research in support of sustainable agriculture.
Who we are
The postdoctoral researcher will be affiliated with the Plant Molecular Biology section at the Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics, Aarhus University, where the research program is coordinated.

The Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics is part of the Faculty of Natural Sciences and encompasses research within Plant Molecular Biology, Neurobiology, RNA Biology and Innovation, Protein Science, Cellular Health, Intervention and Nutrition. The department currently hosts 158 full-time scientific staff and 83 PhD students. It also delivers two degree programs: Molecular Biology and Molecular Medicine, with an annual intake of ~120 students.

For more information, please visit:

http://mbg.au.dk/ – Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics

https://nat.au.dk/ – Faculty of Natural Sciences

http://www.au.dk/ – Aarhus University

What we offer 
• A full-time position.
• A role in an ambitious, research-intensive environment with strong international collaborations.
• The opportunity to pursue high-impact research in plant–microbe interactions with both fundamental and applied dimensions.
• A collaborative and respectful work culture that values diversity, creativity, and professional growth.
Place of work and area of employment 
The place of work is Universitetsbyen 81, 8000 Aarhus C, Denmark. The area of employment is Aarhus University with affiliated institutions.

Contact information
For further information, please contact: Professor Simona Radutoiu, radutoiu@mbg.au.dk

Deadline
Applications must be received no later than 7 December 2026.

Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self. 

Formalities and salary range
Natural Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

At the Faculty of Natural Science at Aarhus University, we strive to support our scientific staff in their career development. We focus on competency development and career clarification and want to make your opportunities transparent. On our website, you can find information on all types of scientific positions, as well as the entry criteria we use when assessing candidates. You can also read more about how we can assist you in your career planning and development.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

About Aarhus University

Aarhus University is an academically diverse and research-intensive university with a strong commitment to high-quality research and education and the development of society nationally and globally. The university offers an inspiring research and teaching environment for its 37,500 students, including PhD students, and has 9,000 employees (full-time equivalents) and an annual revenue of EUR 1.2 billion. Learn more at international.au.dk

Meet your future team

You turn ambiguous problems into measurable solutions and look for ways to automate, simplify and standardize business results in mind.

As IIoT Platform Technical Lead, you will lead the technical direction of our shared IIoT platform while taking part in engineering. You will enable development teams to build manufacturing applications through reliable connectivity, standardised shop floor data and reusable platform services.

Meet your future team

You will join the Industrial IoT Platform Team, part of IT & Digital Enablement. The team develops and maintains the shared IIoT platform that supports manufacturing applications through connectivity, data and reusable technical capabilities.

As IIoT Platform Technical Lead, you will provide day-to-day technical leadership across the engineering group. Working closely with senior IIoT platform engineers, architects, vendors and manufacturing stakeholders, you will coordinate decisions, coach engineers and help move delivery forward. The role has no formal people-management responsibility.

What We Offer

This role combines contributing to the shared IIoT platform’s technical direction with direct engineering work. You will lead day-to-day technical direction and engineering execution, contributing to design, development, testing, reviews and complex problem-solving. You will turn product priorities into a coherent platform roadmap, engineering practices and clear guardrails.

You will balance a clear technical direction with close collaboration, involving the team in technical decisions and finding practical compromises that support both platform integrity and delivery needs.

The goal in this role means a clear and maintained platform roadmap, faster onboarding and greater reuse, improved visibility of platform health, and well-defined ownership between shared platform capabilities and domain-specific application logic.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Own and maintain the IIoT platform technical roadmap, including runtime, frameworks, connectivity components, data contracts, developer tooling, observability and lifecycle enablers. Provide estimates, sequencing, dependency and risk input and coordinate with dependent product teams.

Act as the first technical escalation point. Guide external engineering contributions so standards, knowledge and lifecycle accountability remain within the team. Escalate material architecture and cross-platform decisions through the appropriate technical governance.

• Establish and evolve engineering guardrails, reference patterns and clear development paths. Maintain the boundary between shared platform mechanisms and domain-specific application logic. Own technical data-quality controls at the platform boundary.

• Contribute hands-on to platform services and reusable components through design, development, testing and improvement. Focus your direct contribution where technical depth, complex problem-solving or delivery needs require it.

• Support platform observability, technical investigations and follow-through on incidents, problems and improvement actions in collaboration with the Operations Manager.

• Manage platform lifecycle health, including security, patching, vulnerability remediation, upgrades, documentation, supportability, and technical debt.

The role can be based in Skjern, Østbirk, Kolding or Hørsholm. Regular on-site presence in Skjern and at manufacturing locations in Denmark is required, along with occasional international travel. When tasks and projects allow, you may work from home up to two days per week.

What You Will Bring Into The Organization

You bring 7+ years of relevant experience in software, platform or integration engineering, including technical leadership in an industrial IT/OT or digital manufacturing environment. You understand both manufacturing-domain needs and Unified Namespace. You use that understanding to make technical choices that work for platform users and the engineering team.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Have direct experience building C#/.NET services and APIs. Your experience also includes event-driven or decoupled architectures, Unified Namespace, containerised deployment and modern DevOps practices.

• Bring practical knowledge across industrial connectivity and edge technologies, including MQTT, edge runtimes and container orchestration. You also understand industrial data contracts, observability or SRE practices, and OT cyber security.

• Can translate product priorities into an actionable platform roadmap, technical guardrails and engineering practices.

• Apply a platform mindset focused on reuse, self-service, consumer enablement, operational excellence and long-term maintainability.

Summary

At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. The Creativity Apps team needs your help shaping the next generation of creative editing tools by working on state-of-the-art technologies to surprise and delight creative pros and enthusiasts alike. You’ll be working with the world-class teams behind Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, iMovie, and GarageBand to create next-generation tools for creators!

Description

We're looking for a Performance Tooling Engineer to own the tooling and automated tests that keep our products fast, efficient, and correct. Your mission is to catch regressions before they ship, across latency, memory, power/thermals and functionality, by building the test harnesses, benchmarks, and CI infrastructure that make regressions visible, reproducible, and actionable.

The systems you build will run continuously across our device fleet and become the safety net our engineering team relies on. If you enjoy turning "it feels slower" into a hard number on a dashboard with a bisected culprit commit, this is for you.

Responsibilities

• Design, write, and maintain automated tests that detect performance regressions (latency, memory footprint, power consumption, etc.) and functional regressions.

• Build and operate CI pipelines and tooling that run these tests reliably across a fleet of hardware devices.

• Create dashboards, alerting, and triage tooling that surface regressions early and help engineers root-cause them quickly, e.g. automated bisection, historical trend tracking.

• Partner with cross-functional teams & leadership to define meaningful performance goals and acceptance criteria.

• Continuously improve test coverage, execution speed, flakiness, and the developer experience of running and interpreting tests.

Minimum Qualifications

• Very strong problem-solving and coding skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Experience building and maintaining CI systems.

• Solid understanding of performance measurement fundamentals: how to benchmark reliably, control for noise, and reason about latency, memory, and power/thermal metrics.

• Experience writing automated tests and the tooling/frameworks around them.

• Proven track record of integrating AI tools to enhance both personal productivity and team workflows.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience developing for Apple platforms (iOS/macOS), with working knowledge of Swift.

• Familiarity with the Apple development toolchain: Xcode, Instruments, and related profiling and testing.

• Experience with GPU programming and image processing systems (Metal, OpenCL, CUDA or similar).

• Experience with regression testing across many hardware devices, e.g., device labs, device farms, or fleet-based test automation.

For more than a century and a half, we’ve shaped the future with our pioneering spirit. We’re proud of our heritage and driven by a commitment to continuously improve the industries we serve. Whatever we do, we aim to make a meaningful impact—and we’ve been doing so since 1866.

Why Join Us?

We are 15,000 experts—and we want you IN. If you’re looking for a workplace that spans cultures, continents, and perspectives, you’ll feel at home here. We value lean processes, innovative thinking, and the freedom to grow—both personally and professionally.

At Innomotics, you’ll join a global player with the agility and spirit of a mid‑sized champion. Innovation and motion drive everything we do, and we’re passionate about creating sustainable, energy‑efficient solutions that shape the industries of tomorrow.

From your first day, you’ll be part of a dynamic, supportive, and forward‑thinking team.

Ready to Join Us?

We hope you like what you’ve learned about us—we can’t wait to meet you. Please send your application and CV as soon as possible, as we review candidates on an ongoing basis.

If you have questions about the position, feel free to contact Logistics Manager Mie Østergaard at +45 61 46 09 32.

We look forward to hearing from you.

**Job Requisition ID #

**26WD102106

**Locations where we are Hiring

**This is not a current open position. Soon, we will be investing in remote Regional Field Sales roles across the EMEA region specific to Europe: Ireland, Denmark, Sweden, United Kingdom, France, Germany, Netherlands, and Spain.

**Our Story

**The world’s innovators, designers, engineers, builders and creators trust Autodesk to help them design and make a better world for all.

Autodesk’s Design and Make Platform empowers customers to transform how they work through cloud-connected technology, automation, AI, data and insights. From the buildings and infrastructure around us to the products we use and the entertainment that inspires us, Autodesk technology helps our customers design and make the world around us.

Our customers are navigating significant change, including sustainability pressures, labor and supply-chain challenges, rapid technological advancement and increasing digital complexity. Global Expansion Sales helps them unlock greater value from Autodesk by uncovering new opportunities, expanding adoption and connecting Autodesk solutions to their most important business priorities.

**Position Overview

****As an Account Executive in Global Expansion Sales, you will lead Autodesk’s growth strategy across a focused portfolio of assigned customers.

**You will operate as a senior business partner to the customer, bringing a hunter mindset to existing relationships: creating new demand, uncovering substantial whitespace, opening new buying centers and expanding Autodesk into strategic workflows, business units and transformation initiatives.

You will be expected to lead complex, high-value enterprise sales cycles, including seven-figure opportunities and multi-year commercial agreements, while orchestrating the broader Autodesk ecosystem around a common customer strategy. Success will be measured through sustained expansion growth, material pipeline creation, increased share of wallet, executive sponsorship, customer outcomes and forecast accuracy.

**Responsibilities

**

• Own and lead the multi-year growth and expansion strategy for assigned customers.

• Develop deep knowledge of each customer’s business model, strategic objectives, operating environment, industry dynamics and transformation agenda.

• Establish a clear point of view on where Autodesk can create differentiated business value for the customer.

• Identify significant whitespace across business units, geographies, workflows, technology estates, user communities and executive priorities.

• Create demand and originate large strategic opportunities, including seven-figure deals and opportunities that may not yet exist in the customer’s formal buying process.

• Build relationships across new buying centers while deepening trusted relationships with existing stakeholders.

• Develop C-suite and senior executive sponsorship across business and technology functions.

• Bring external market, industry and customer insight into executive conversations, with relevant knowledge of Autodesk’s Design and Make industries.

• Translate customer strategy into compelling multi-year value propositions, transformation roadmaps and business cases.

• Lead complex, high-value and potentially multi-year sales cycles involving multiple business, technical, procurement, finance and legal stakeholders.

• Develop and execute competitive strategies to win strategically significant new workloads and displace incumbent technologies.

• Navigate sophisticated commercial arrangements and seven-figure negotiations with strong business and financial acumen.

• Mobilize Autodesk’s executive leadership and broader organization around a unified account strategy.

• Orchestrate Technical Sales, Customer Success, Industry, Partners, Marketing, Professional Services and other specialists at the appropriate stages of the customer journey.

• Develop strategic ecosystem and partner relationships that increase Autodesk’s impact and relevance.

• Maintain executive-level governance around opportunities, risks, dependencies and account priorities.

• Apply account-planning, relationship-mapping, customer intelligence, forecasting and AI-enabled tools responsibly to support multi-year account strategy, executive engagement and opportunity governance.

• Maintain rigorous pipeline quality and deliver accurate, evidence-based forecasts.

• Represent the voice of the customer within Autodesk while bringing relevant Autodesk innovation, capability and thought leadership back to the customer.

**What Success Looks Like

**Sustained strategic revenue growth; creation and conversion of substantial new whitespace; increased Autodesk share of wallet; expansion into strategically important workloads and business initiatives; deep C-suite sponsorship; successful execution of seven-figure opportunities; strong multi-year account strategies; competitive displacement; measurable customer outcomes; and consistently high-quality forecasting.

**Minimum Qualifications

**

• Demonstrated success leading complex enterprise technology, SaaS, cloud or strategic software sales.

• Proven record of creating and closing significant opportunities within large, complex customer organizations, including experience with seven-figure deals or comparable commercial complexity.

• Demonstrated ability to create demand and develop major opportunities rather than simply manage an existing pipeline.[KS1]

• Strong C-suite presence with the ability to engage credibly on business, industry and transformation priorities.

• Exceptional strategic account-planning and whitespace-development capability.

• Strong business and financial acumen and ability to build compelling economic and strategic business cases.

• Experience leading sophisticated multi-stakeholder and multi-year sales processes.

• Strong competitive selling, negotiation and commercial leadership capability.

• Demonstrated ability to lead large virtual teams and influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.

• Exceptional communication, storytelling and executive presentation skills.

• High standards of commercial judgment, accountability, pipeline management and forecasting.

• Demonstrated fluency with CRM, strategic account-planning, relationship-mapping, pipeline and forecasting platforms. Experience with Salesforce, Clari, Altify or comparable platforms is valued.

**Preferred Qualifications

**

• Deep knowledge of a relevant Autodesk Solution Group industry - AEC, Manufacturing or Media & Entertainment - where appropriate to the assigned customer portfolio.

• Experience selling enterprise platforms, cloud technology or large-scale transformation solutions.

• Experience navigating complex multinational customer organizations.

• Demonstrated success developing multi-year executive relationships and transformation programs.

• Track record of strategic competitive displacement and significant share-of-wallet growth.

**How We Work At Autodesk

**At Autodesk, we work as One Autodesk and bring our One ORBIT values to life every day: Optimistic, Relentless, Brave, Ingenious and Trusted.

In this role, you will bring those values to life by leading as One Autodesk, bringing a bold and informed point of view to our customers, making smart decisions in complex environments, creating new possibilities and earning long-term trust at the highest levels of the customer organization.

****Learn More

******About Autodesk

**Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

**Salary transparency

**Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For Germany based roles, we expect a starting base salary between 122,850 EUR and 180,180 EUR Annual. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Belonging

**We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: **https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging

****In-Person Onboarding and Identity Verification

**This role may require in-person onboarding and/or in-person ID verification.

A Snapshot of Your Day

As a Student Assistant in HR Services at Siemens Energy, you will be based at our office in Aalborg while working closely with our HR Services team, which is located across multiple sites in Denmark. The team play a key role in supporting our blue-collar colleagues and managers, as well as coordinating with external HR service providers. Much of their daily work involves control tasks, data checks and follow-ups related to payroll, time management and other HR processes.

Your role will involve finding ways to simplify these tasks, improve efficiency and reduce manual work. You will explore how tasks are currently carried out and develop tools to reduce manual work, including well-structured Excel files, Power BI reports that provide a clear overview, and practical applications of AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot. Expect a hands-on role in a collaborative team where your ideas are valued and put into practice.

We are looking for a bachelor's student who would like to stay with us for several years while continuing with a master's degree. This will give you the opportunity to develop your skills and gradually take on more responsibility as you grow into the role.

How You'll Make an Impact

• 
Map recurring control and follow-up tasks in HR Services and identify opportunities to simplify, standardised or automate them.

• 
Build and maintain Excel tools (formulas, pivot tables and Power Query) to make data checks on payroll, time registration and absence faster and more reliable.

• 
Develop Power BI reports and dashboards that provide HR Services Specialists, HR Business Partners and managers with a clear overview of key data.

• 
Explore opportunities to use AI tools, such as Microsoft Copilot, and work on Power Automate flows to reduce manual work and improve quality.

• 
Document new tools and processes to make them easy for others to use, and support colleagues in adopting them.

• 
Contribute to ad-hoc analyses and HR projects when needed.

What You Bring

• 
Currently enrolled in a bachelor's programme, for example in Business Administration, Economics, Information Management, Data Science, Engineering or a related field, with plans to continue with a master's degree.

• 
Strong Excel skills and a genuine interest in data, structure and smart solutions.

• 
Experience with or a strong motivation to learn Power BI, Power Query, Power Automate and AI tools.

• 
An analytical mindset, attention to detail and the ability to see the bigger picture in a process.

• 
A proactive and curious approach, with the ability to work independently once a task has been agreed.

• 
Good communication skills in English; Danish is an advantage, as many of our colleagues in the factory speak Danish.

• 
Availability for approx. 8–25 hours per week, with flexibility around exam periods.

About the Team

You will be part of HR in Denmark, working closely with the HR Services Specialists at our Wind Power Factory in Aalborg. The factory plays an important role in our operations, and we are committed to creating an environment where every employee can thrive. Our team values innovation, collaboration and diversity, and you will have the opportunity to see how your work and solutions make a difference.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

• 
A student job with real responsibility and learning opportunities in a large international company.

• 
Flexible working hours that fit around your studies and exams.

• 
The opportunity to stay with us through both your bachelor's and master's studies.

• 
A supportive and inclusive work environment and a team that values innovation and collaboration.

Application

Don’t hesitate to apply before the 26th November 2026. Ongoing selection is applied; the role might be filled before the last application date.

Location: 9220 Aalborg, DK.

If you are invited for an interview, you will receive a case assignment to prepare in advance. During the interview, you will present your work, followed by an open discussion. You will also be given a short task during the interview, which we will work through together.

Don't let this put you off! The assignments are intended to encourage dialogue and give us insight into how you approach different tasks – not to test you or expect you to have all the answers 😊

As an Imaging Engineer, you will contribute to the development and integration of imaging solutions for endoscope products. You will work with camera sensors, lenses, illumination and image-quality testing, supported by senior colleagues and cross-functional specialists in the medical device domain. The role combines practical laboratory work, technical problem-solving, supplier collaboration and structured documentation.

**Your Responsibilities

**

• Contribute to the development of imaging technology, including sensor, optics and illumination in technology projects to build solid imaging solution roadmap.

• Participate in endoscope product-development projects, focusing on imaging component integration and imaging system performance, which include:

• Participate in user-related event and identify user need for imaging requirements.

• Support the selection and evaluation of sensors, lenses, illumination components and related imaging solutions.

• Assist with integration of imaging solutions into the product in collaboration with mechanical, electronics, quality and NPI engineers.

• Perform hands-on camera testing, image-quality evaluation, troubleshooting and documentation.

• Participate in user testing in clinical settings and provide imaging-related technical support.

• Prepare reports and technical documentation in line with medical-device development processes.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• A relevant degree in Optoelectronics, Electronics, Physics, Computer vision or a related engineering field.

• 2+ years of relevant professional experience. Strong graduates with practical project, internship or laboratory experience are also encouraged to apply.

• Basic understanding of camera systems and components such as image sensors, lenses, illumination and electronic interfaces.

• Familiarity with key imaging and optical performance concepts, for example SNR, dynamic range, noise, MTF, depth of field, field of view and distortion.

• Interest in hands-on testing, measurement, data analysis and systematic problem-solving.

• Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate across engineering disciplines.

• A proactive approach to work and strong communication skills.

• A curious, structured and user-focused mindset with motivation to learn.

**Nice to have

**

• Exposure to ISP functions, camera calibration or imaging-pipeline tuning.

• Basic knowledge of mechanics, electronics or embedded camera systems.

• Practical use of laboratory equipment or image-quality measurement methods.

• Experience with Python programming and image/video analysis

**What You Will Gain

**

• Hands-on experience across the full imaging chain, from sensor and optics to illumination and image quality.

• Mentoring and technical guidance from experienced camera and product-development engineers.

• Opportunities to work with top-notch suppliers, prototypes, product teams and clinical users.

• A strong foundation for growing into an imaging specialist and imaging system-level engineering.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

BLAST is a global esports media network on a mission to create world-class entertainment experiences for millions of fans around the world. From high-energy arena shows and studio broadcasts to digital content that sets new standards, we bring the biggest moments in esports to life - working with top-tier partners like Valve, Riot Games, Epic Games, Ubisoft, Krafton, and more.

We move fast, think big, and aim high. Our environment blends deep industry experience with bold, tech-driven ideas - whether we're perfecting a broadcast or chasing the next moonshot. BLAST has grown into a leading force in the esports space, but we're just getting started when it comes to pushing boundaries and shaping the future of the industry.

You'll be part of a diverse and dynamic organisation with roots in traditional sports, entertainment, and esports - all working together to deliver unforgettable experiences and keep raising the bar.

**The team

**You'll be joining a high-performing team of industry experts who thrive on delivering results and pushing boundaries. We work hands-on with top-tier broadcast technology and cutting-edge products that power some of the most recognisable names in the industry.

Our culture is built around getting things done - we value initiative, ownership, and practical solutions over endless processes. At the same time, we believe in growing together: there's plenty of room to learn, challenge yourself, and expand your skillset alongside experienced professionals.

Bonus? This job will take you places - literally. From major cities to remote broadcast sites, we travel the world to make things happen. If you're ready to bring energy, adaptability, and a sense of adventure, you'll fit right in.

**Requirements

**

• Curious, quick learner and eager to master new technologies

• Proactive and decisive with a strong sense of ownership

• Ability to work at our Copenhagen office and Brøndby Studio

• Ability to travel to and work at events globally

• Previous experience in working large broadcast shows on flightpack / OB Truck

• Proficient in the english language

• Experience with broadcast switchers equipment, such as Sony / Grass Valley etc

**Responsibilities

**

• Programming and setting up Grass Valley K-Frame, Sony XVS and Blackmagic ATEM switchers for highly complex shows

• Implementing new technologies, allowing greater automation, through both Companion and Cerebrum

• Set up general broadcast equipment, including EVS, Cuepilot, Cameras, Riedel Intercom, Routers etc

• Train directors and engineers on our various switchers, and keep us up to date on the latest technologies

**Benefits

**

• Competitive salary package

• Enhanced parental leave

• Pension and Health Insurance

• Awesome new office in the centre of Copenhagen and 2400m2 studio facility in Brøndby

• Team building and social events

• Lunch, snacks and sodas

• Company trips (2024 we all went to Barcelona and had a BLAST)

Are you a skilled Artificial Intelligence (AI) Engineer with experience across the full AI solution lifecycle, from model development and training to deployment and operation at scale? Do you enjoy combining deep technical expertise with practical, business-focused solutions that drive innovation and improve processes? If so, you could be our next Senior AI Engineer!

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

You’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of AI at JYSK by helping accelerate AI adoption across the organization. As part of a high-performing, agile AI Engineering team, you’ll contribute to our strategic ambition of integrating AI into business processes across the company. If you’re passionate about technical innovation and enjoy solving real-world business challenges with AI, we’d love to hear from you!

Furthermore, we offer you:

• A dynamic workplace in an international company focused on growth, innovation, and continuous development.

• A collaborative, open-minded environment with opportunities to engage across all organisational levels.

• A flexible work-from-home policy that supports a healthy work-life balance.

• Attractive employee benefits, including staff discounts across the Lars Larsen Group and a variety of social events throughout the year.

• Access to internal training, courses, and learning opportunities to support your personal and professional growth.

• A welcoming and supportive culture, complemented by a comprehensive onboarding programme to help you succeed from day one.

• A low-politics, low-ego culture where collaboration, ownership, and high standards are valued.

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As a Senior AI Engineer, you will be instrumental in developing AI solutions that drive innovation, enable data-driven decision-making, improve operations, and enhance customer experiences. You will bridge software engineering and machine learning, focusing on model experimentation, deployment, and integration to create scalable, efficient, and reusable solutions.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Develop and scale end-to-end AI applications and MLOps pipelines using your deep software engineering background.

• Design, develop, and deploy end-to-end AI agent systems, from orchestration and tool integration to production deployment and monitoring.

• Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, embedding workflows, and semantic search solutions where appropriate.

• Research, experiment with, and develop classical and state-of-the-art AI models across NLP, Computer Vision, Deep Generative Models, Graph Neural Networks, and Reinforcement Learning to improve and optimize JYSK’s business processes.

• Collaborate closely with data, AI, and platform engineers on complex projects to integrate cutting-edge models into impactful AI products.

• Managing AI workloads on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to ensure optimal performance and resource efficiency.

• Working with architects to refine AI solution design and contributing to solution planning phases.

• Supporting end-users of AI solutions with a "you build it, you own it" mindset.

You can read more about our department here.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Holds a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field. A PhD is considered an advantage.

• Has 5+ years of industry experience in software engineering, designing and implementing AI solutions at scale using Python.

• Has a strong foundation in machine learning algorithms, with experience spanning both discriminative and generative models applied to structured data, natural language, and vision.

• Has experience developing, deploying, operating, and monitoring AI models in production at scale, preferably on Google Cloud Platform (or equivalent experience with Azure or AWS and a willingness to work with GCP).

• Has hands-on experience in one of the following areas: Building AI agents at scale integrated with advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. Pre-training, fine-tuning, or post-training large language models (LLMs). Developing and deploying state-of-the-art generative AI solutions for computer vision in real-world environments.

• Works independently on complex technical challenges while collaborating effectively with stakeholders to ensure successful outcomes.

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Team Leader AI Engineering, Florencio Paucar at +45 27794325.

Send us a brief application with your CV by clicking “Apply”. We process applications on an ongoing basis and complete the recruitment once we have found the right candidate.

ABOUT US

We believe that our employees are key to our success going from one store in 1979 to more than 3,400 stores worldwide today. That is why we strive to offer development and possibilities of growing within JYSK, and we also take pride in rewarding engagement and a great effort among our employees. Our three fundamental JYSK Values – Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit – express the behaviour and attitude that we can expect from each other. We trust each other, and we believe in delegation and freedom with responsibility.

JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team.

For more information, please visit our career page**.

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professor or Postdoc in Economics and Business Economics
jobs.description:
The Department of Economics and Business Economics at Aarhus BSS, Aarhus University, is seeking ambitious and dedicated scholars to join a dynamic research and teaching environment. The positions offer excellent opportunities to develop an international research profile and contribute to high-quality teaching. We invite applications for one or more positions as assistant professor or postdoc in the field of economics and business economics.

The positions are full-time and different job packages can be offered including fixed-term postdoc and assistant professorships for up to 4 years. The starting date is 1 August 2027 or as soon as possible subject to mutual agreement.

Job description
As an assistant professor or postdoc, you are expected to make a significant contribution to our research and teaching activities and to support the further development of our overall research strategy.

You will teach and supervise students at both Bachelor's and Master's levels and conduct independent as well as collaborative research of the highest international standard. You are also expected to engage actively in the academic life of the department and contribute to the activities of the relevant research section

Your qualifications
You must have been awarded a PhD degree in economics and business economics or have acquired equivalent qualifications.

Who we are
At the Department of Economics and Business Economics, we aim to conduct research and teaching of the highest quality and impact. We believe that a supportive atmosphere and appreciative work environment are fundamental for our work and professional development. The department employs approximately 140 academic staff members and 55 PhD students, and our academic staff is highly international and culturally diverse. We focus on the recruitment of excellent national and international researchers. Our research and degree programmes have a strong international focus. The Department hosts a number of research centers and external funding for research activities has top priority. Read more about the department on our website www.econ.au.dk 

The Department of Economics and Business Economics is one of the six departments at Aarhus BSS, one of the five faculties at Aarhus University. Aarhus BSS unites the business and social science-related research fields and brings them closer together to reflect the close relationship between society and the business community. As part of a Top 100 university, Aarhus BSS has achieved the triple-crown AACSB, AMBA and EQUIS accreditations.

Further information
For further information about the position, please contact Head of Department, Professor Thomas Quistgaard Pedersen, tel.: +45 27467467, e-mail: tqpedersen@econ.au.dk

If you need help uploading your application or have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR supporter Ulla P. Bjørn, e-mail: upb@au.dk.

Place of work
Aarhus University, Universitetsbyen 51, 8000 Aarhus C.

Are you an international applicant?
Aarhus University offers a wide range of services for international academic staff and their accompanying families, including relocation support and career counselling for accompanying partners. Find more information here: Relocation Service at Aarhus University

Learn more about research opportunities at Aarhus University here: Aarhus University research

Aarhus University also offers a career development programme for postdocs and assistant professors. Read more about the programme here: Junior Researchers

Terms of employment
The appointment is made in accordance with the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities as well as the circular on the Collective Agreement for Academics Employed by the State (in Danish). The job content and qualification requirements are described in further detail in the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities. Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the collective agreement for academics in the state sector. You will be employed as assistant professor or postdoc at basic salary level 4–8, with supplements in accordance with the protocol on certain terms of employment for academic staff at universities.

Application procedure
When you apply for this position it is mandatory to attach the following:

• Cover letter. You are encouraged to elaborate on your current and future research plans and on how you match the department’s profile, including potential research centers.
• Curriculum Vitae. You are encouraged to declare any periods of leave or career breaks without research activity, including, for example, parental leave, since your research activities are assessed in relation to your actual research time.
• Education (diploma for master's, PhD and possibly higher doctoral degree).
• List of publications, working papers, and work-in-progress (the enclosed papers must be clearly marked on the list of publications).
• Publications. Up to three papers, including both publications and working papers, may be submitted. In the event of co-authors the included papers must be accompanied by a co-author statement concerning your share of the collaborative work with the consent of the co-authors.This template may be used for the purpose
• Teaching portfolio. The specific requirements regarding the documentation can be found here.
Read more about how to apply for an academic post at Aarhus BSS here.

The evaluation process
After the application deadline, an assessment committee is appointed. Please note that the assessment of applicants is based solely on the material received prior to the application deadline. For further information, see Guidelines for Assessment Committee, Aarhus BSS. 

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website. 

Aarhus University
Aarhus University is an academically diverse and research-intensive university with a strong commitment to high-quality research and education and the development of society nationally and globally. The university offers an inspiring research and teaching environment to its 38,000 students (FTEs) and 8,300 employees, and has an annual revenues of EUR 935 million.
