At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**Genmab’s CMC Writing team is growing, and we are looking for a Senior CMC Writer to support global regulatory submissions across our expanding portfolio.

Your primary focus will be documentation for global Biologics License Applications (BLAs), Marketing Authorisation Applications (MAAs), New Drug Applications (NDAs), and responses to health authority questions during assessment. Working closely with scientific and technical experts, you will transform complex CMC information into clear, accurate, and consistent regulatory submission documents.

You will join a dedicated team of CMC writers collaborating across early and late-stage development, regulatory submission, and lifecycle management. As a senior colleague, you will independently drive writing activities, provide expert review and mentoring, and help improve documentation practices through AI and digital tools.

The position reports to the Director, Head of CMC Writing, and is based in Copenhagen, Denmark.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your responsibilities include:

• Independently authoring and coordinating review of Module 3 CTD sections and supporting source documents covering manufacturing processes and controls, analytical procedures, characterization, specifications, formulation development, stability, and facilities

• Working with CMC Project Managers, subject matter experts, Regulatory Affairs CMC, Quality Assurance, and external partners to resolve review comments and deliver approved documents within agreed timelines

• Serving as a go-to reviewer for scientific accuracy, document quality, consistency, and regulatory alignment, including verification of data against source documentation

• Authoring and coordinating responses to health authority questions and maintaining the resulting updates across submissions and programs

• Supporting late stage initial filings, global roll outs, lifecycle maintenance, including post-approval changes, and contributing to IND/CTA submissions and amendments as needed, while maintaining source document trackers and traceability

• Applying and refining CMC writing and response principles, templates, procedures, and style guides in accordance with Genmab’s quality system and applicable GxP requirements

• Using AI, automation, and digital tools to identify documentation gaps and improve writing quality and efficiency, with critical evaluation of outputs and appropriate handling of confidential information

• Mentoring colleagues in regulatory writing and digital documentation practices, and contributing to process improvements and departmental initiatives

**Requirements

**You hold a master’s degree in science or a related technical discipline. An advanced degree, relevant certification, or equivalent experience is preferred.

You bring at least six years of experience in CMC or a related field within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and/or medical device industry, with relevant experience in biologics and/or chemical development and manufacturing. We welcome candidates with backgrounds in biologics, small molecules, or both.

**In Addition, You Have

**

• Experience in global regulatory submissions and pharmaceutical or biotechnology product development and manufacturing. Direct experience supporting IND, CTA, BLA, MAA, or NDA filings is expected

• Demonstrated expertise in authoring and reviewing complex CMC regulatory sections and/or supporting source documents, with the ability to independently manage writing activities and guide other authors

• A good understanding of CMC regulatory expectations across development stages and strong knowledge of CTD structure, GxP, and relevant documentation requirements

• Excellent written English, sound scientific judgment, and the ability to present complex information clearly, assess supporting data, and identify gaps and inconsistencies

• Practical experience using AI to improve scientific or technical writing quality and efficiency, including effective prompting, critical assessment of outputs, and verification of scientific content

• Strong communication and influencing skills, enabling you to align cross-functional stakeholders, resolve differing perspectives, and mentor colleagues

• A proven record of ownership, effective prioritization, and timely delivery, combined with curiosity, continuous learning, and a collaborative approach that builds trust, welcomes feedback, and supports an inclusive work environment

**Application deadline: 30 November 2026

**The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK624.000,00---936.000,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

__CEO, Steen Brødbæk

_**Your Tasks & Responsibilities

Experience with BI tools is a big plus, and you communicate fluently in English and Danish.

What we offer

Do you want to grow together?

About 2care4

**About The Role

**We're seeking a driven Business Intelligence Analyst to join our FP&A team, reporting to our FP&A Data Lead - someone early in their data career who's eager to help build our new data platform and grow with it, in a high-impact role that offers real visibility and room to grow.

Now a delisted, growth-equity backed business, OrderYOYO is entering an exciting new chapter – a clear testament to our bold growth ambitions and the fast paced, high-impact environment we are building.

We're building a new data platform that brings together data from every restaurant partner, both on our own platform and on the platforms we acquire. Our Data team builds the pipelines, warehouse and core models; this role sits between them and the people who use the data, turning what lands in the warehouse into something the business can actually work with.

In this role, you'll gain broad exposure across the business by collaborating with Management, Finance, Commercial teams, Tech and Product Owners. You'll play a key role in turning data into actionable insights, including translating business questions into something measurable, modelling the right data, building the reporting and presenting findings for key stakeholders. As you grow, you'll have the freedom to shape your path based on your strengths and interests.

**Here's a Taste Of What You'll Be Doing

**

• Get to know our data warehouse in depth - what data we have, where it comes from and what it can be trusted for - and help scope and integrate data from the companies we acquire.

• Model data into analysis-ready datasets, so the rest of the FP&A team can find and use the right data without starting from raw data every time.

• Write SQL to pull and shape data for Management, Finance, Commercial and Data Science.

• Build and maintain reporting in Power BI - dashboards, recurring management reports and KPI scorecards - and keep the metric definitions behind them consistent, so the business has one version of each number.

• Check data quality, reconcile figures that don't match across sources, and explain why a number moved.

• Turn stakeholder questions into measurable analysis, such as why a new market is ramping up slower than expected or which partners are at risk of churning, and turn recurring requests into reusable models or reports.

**What We Are Looking For In You

**

• A degree in a quantitative or data-related field, such as economics, statistics, engineering, computer science or information systems.

• Solid SQL skills you have used in practice - in a job, a project or your studies.

• Some understanding of data modelling (how tables, keys and dimensions fit together), or a clear wish to learn it.

• Experience with, or a strong interest in, a BI tool such as Power BI, Tableau or Looker.

• Strong business sense. Curious about which numbers matter and why the business wants them.

• Structured and careful. You check your own numbers before someone else has to.

• A team player who enjoys helping colleagues get to the data they need, with strong communication in English (Danish is a plus but not a requirement).

**Why Join Us?

**

• Help build a modern data platform early in your career, while it is still taking shape, with data that Management uses to make decisions from day one.

• A clear growth path - from learning the platform and supporting the team, to owning metric definitions and how we report.

• Work in a supportive, team-first culture where we help each other succeed.

• Expect personal development plans and ongoing training tailored to your growth.

• Be part of a high-growth journey in a growth equity-backed company, where ambition meets opportunity - and your impact truly matters.

**Great To Have (But Not Required)

**

• Understanding of database structures and data modelling, such as star schemas and semantic models.

Join Copenhagen Energy Trading as our new Machine Learning Engineer

Machine learning is becoming an increasingly important part of how we understand energy markets, improve forecasts, and make trading decisions. We are therefore looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to move our models from research to production, building robust, scalable pipelines that continuously improve our strategies.

At Copenhagen Energy Trading (CET), we combine deep market expertise with machine learning, quantitative research, data, and engineering to automate and optimise how we trade power. We’re a small, highly ambitious team based in central Copenhagen, specialising in power trading and asset management across Europe and North America. Technology is at the core of how we operate, supported by one of Europe’s most advanced automated and analytical trading environments for power markets.

The Opportunity

Energy markets produce vast amounts of data and are continuously shaped by weather, power production, transmission constraints, and market behaviour. Using that data meaningfully requires accurate models and reliable software and infrastructure that allow those models to run in production.

As our Machine Learning Engineer, you’ll work across machine learning and software development. Alongside quantitative researchers, software engineers and traders, you’ll build the production systems behind our ML pipelines, making our trading more performant, more reliable and more automated.

You’ll own the full lifecycle around the model: from data management to the pipelines and frameworks that deploy and monitor our models, keeping them reliable and adaptive as markets evolve. The opportunity for impact is large, and so is what it asks of you: dedication, real talent and the willingness to grind through hard problems. This is a hands-on engineering role at the centre of how CET uses machine learning to trade.

What You Will Do

• Strengthen our ML framework: Build and improve the framework our researchers use to build models and quantitative strategies.

• Build production-ready software: Design and develop reliable, scalable, and well-tested Python software that integrates machine learning into our internal trading platforms.

• Develop data infrastructure: Build and maintain data pipelines and storage solutions for ingesting, transforming, and serving diverse market and fundamental data.

• Ship and operate models: Take models from experiment to production, including deployment, serving, monitoring and experiment tracking

• Improve our ML and engineering practices: Help strengthen our approach to MLOps, testing, CI/CD, code reviews, and the wider model development lifecycle.

• Shape our technical solutions: Evaluate and introduce tools and technologies that improve how we develop, deploy, and operate machine learning solutions.

• Collaborate across disciplines: Work closely with quantitative researchers, traders, and software engineers to turn business and market needs into practical technical solutions.

• Build energy-market expertise: Develop a deep understanding of power markets and how machine learning, data, and software can improve trading decisions.

What We're Looking For

We value strong technical ability, sound judgement, curiosity, and motivation to learn. While we don't expect a perfect match, many of the following qualifications will help you succeed in the role:

• Strong software engineering skills: Experience building clean, scalable, tested, and production-ready software. Strong Python skills are essential, as Python is our primary development language.

• MLOps and development practices: Proficiency in Git, code reviews, CI/CD, experiment tracking, model deployment, and monitoring.

• Cloud computing: Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP, ideally including relevant data and machine learning services.

• Problem-solving and communication: The ability to structure complex problems, communicate clearly, and collaborate with colleagues across technical and commercial disciplines. Full professional proficiency in English is required.

• Ownership: The ability to work independently and deliver in a fast-paced environment.

• Interest in energy markets: Curiosity about power markets, trading, and energy systems. Previous experience in energy or trading is an advantage, but not a requirement.

• Education: A degree with a strong technical focus, e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, or other relevant fields. We welcome different educational backgrounds and levels of qualification.

What We Offer

• Growth environment: Become part of a young, ambitious, and expanding tech-driven trading company where talented people are given responsibility and room to grow.

• Exceptional team: Work closely with experienced quantitative researchers, software engineers and power traders.

• Competitive compensation: Receive a competitive salary package and attractive benefits that reflect your skills and contributions.

• Strong culture: Participate in both social and professional events, including team sports, company parties, team-building, and informal gatherings that strengthen our team spirit.

• Central Copenhagen location: Work from our office in Carlsberg Byen, located in beautifully renovated historic Carlsberg buildings.

How to Apply

If this opportunity feels like the right fit for you, we would love to hear from you.

Please apply via LinkedIn and submit your cover letter, CV, and university transcripts as a single PDF. Please note that applications that do not meet these requirements may not be considered.

Application deadline: November 27, 2026

If you have any questions, please contact Carl Frederik Grønvald (Senior Quantitative Analyst) at cfg@copenhagen-energy.com or Anna Schumann (People & Culture Manager) at as@copenhagen-energy.com.

**

**

**Product Management at Dalux – Bringing AI into the Construction Industry

**Dalux continues to grow rapidly, and AI is creating entirely new possibilities for how construction professionals find information, understand complex project data, automate repetitive work, and make decisions.

We're looking for an AI Product Manager to help turn those possibilities into products that create real value for our users.

As an AI Product Manager at Dalux, you'll operate at the intersection of customer needs, rapidly evolving AI technology, and business strategy. You'll work closely with Product Design, AI engineers, developers, and other Product Managers to identify where AI can meaningfully improve construction workflows – and equally importantly, where it cannot.

Building AI products is different from traditional software development. Outputs are probabilistic, quality needs continuous evaluation, and product decisions involve trade-offs between accuracy, latency, cost, scalability, and user trust.

You'll help us navigate those trade-offs and establish how we build great AI products at Dalux.

**Your responsibilities will include:

**

• AI Product Discovery: Identify and validate problems where AI can create meaningful value rather than applying AI for its own sake.

• Customer Insights: Work closely with users and internal domain experts to understand construction workflows and identify opportunities for AI-powered improvements.

• Evaluation & Quality: Define what "good" looks like for AI features and establish evals, quality metrics, test cases, and feedback loops.

• AI Safety & Trust: Consider hallucinations, uncertainty, guardrails, failure modes, explainability, and user trust throughout product development.

• Feature Ownership: Lead AI-powered features from early experimentation and prototyping through delivery, evaluation, and continuous improvement.

• Technical Collaboration: Work closely with AI engineers and developers on model capabilities, context, architecture, latency, scalability, and cost.

• AI Product Strategy: Follow developments in models and AI technology and help determine which technological advances create meaningful opportunities for Dalux.

**About You

**We are looking for someone who combines strong product thinking with a solid understanding of modern AI.

You don't need to be an AI engineer, but you need enough technical understanding to make informed product decisions and have meaningful discussions with the engineers building these systems.

We believe you:

• Have experience building or managing customer-facing AI/ML products.

• Understand concepts such as LLMs, RAG, embeddings, context, agents, evals, and guardrails.

• Understand the fundamental difference between building deterministic software and probabilistic AI experiences.

• Can translate rapidly evolving technical capabilities into valuable user experiences.

• Are comfortable defining and measuring quality where traditional acceptance criteria are insufficient.

• Think critically about when AI is – and isn't – the right solution.

• Can balance user value, model quality, latency, scalability, and cost.

• Communicate fluently in English, written and spoken.

Experience with B2B SaaS is an advantage.

Experience with construction technology is welcome but not required. We have deep construction expertise within Dalux – for this role, we are particularly interested in adding strong AI product expertise to our organization.

**What To Expect At Dalux

**At Dalux, you'll join a product-driven company where ideas quickly become reality and where you'll have a direct impact on the products we build.

We offer:

• A collaborative and informal work environment with flat hierarchies

• High ownership, trust, and the freedom to drive initiatives

• Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international team

• A central Copenhagen office, flexible work hours, and no dress code

• Monthly social events and an active community

• Attractive benefits including health insurance, lunch, fitness facilities, and free parking

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

**Ready for the next step?

**We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your resume and application as soon as possible.

**About Dalux

**Founded in 2005, Dalux is a Danish Contech company revolutionizing the construction industry with innovative software built on geometric processing and 3D computer graphics.

Over the past years, we’ve grown by 40% annually and now have over 900 employees across 50+ offices in more than 25 countries. All product development takes place in our Østerbro, Copenhagen office, where we focus on building the future of construction technology. We place great value on our strong social community and close collaboration with colleagues, which is why we primarily work from our Copenhagen location.

**Application deadline:

**As soon as possible

_**About The Role

**OrderYOYO builds the ordering apps and websites that thousands of restaurants across seven European markets use to take orders directly from their own customers. Our Growth team has one number to move: average orders per day per restaurant partner.

We're looking for a Growth Data Analyst to find where those orders are being lost, design the experiments that win them back, and prove it with data — across the end-user apps (iOS and Android), the restaurant partner websites, and the marketing stack.

This is a hands-on role. You'll write the SQL, build the test, read the result, and present it to the people who decide what ships next — working alongside a developer, a marketing manager, a paid media manager, and a data engineer.

**Role Mission

**Grow average orders per day per restaurant partner by finding where orders are lost across apps, websites and marketing channels, running the experiments that win them back, and making the Growth numbers trustworthy enough to decide on.

**Core Responsibilities

**

• Own the end-user funnel view — from visit to order to repeat order — across apps and RP websites, by country and by restaurant partner.

• Run cohort, funnel, and retention analyses to find the biggest leaks in traffic, conversion, and repeat ordering, and size what fixing each one is worth in orders per day.

• Turn findings into a ranked backlog of hypotheses with expected impact and effort, and defend the ranking with the Growth team and Product.

• Design A/B tests end to end — hypothesis, success metric, guardrails, sample size and runtime, randomisation unit, and a pre-registered analysis plan — and set them up yourself on the apps and RP websites, working with the developer on feature flags or variant logic where code changes are needed.

• Check tests while they run (sample ratio, instrumentation, novelty effects) and read them out honestly, including when the result is flat or negative.

• Bring the same discipline to the marketing stack — paid media (Google Ads, Meta), email and push, SMS, landing pages, and restaurant partners' Google Business Profiles — using geo or restaurant-level splits and holdouts where a user-level test isn't possible, and judging traffic quality and incrementality on orders, not clicks.

• Own the definitions of the Growth metrics (AOD, conversion rate, new vs returning, retention), keep them consistent between GA4, the apps, and the warehouse, and chase tracking gaps with the data engineer and developer until fixes are verified with data.

• Partner with Algirdas on the Growth dashboards in Fabric and Power BI so reporting is automated rather than produced by hand.

• Build and own the experimentation playbook, and use AI as a daily tool — for SQL, analysis plans, and readouts — helping the team build small, repeatable AI workflows such as pre-test power calculations or weekly funnel checks. Experimentation is too important to be guesswork.

**Must-Have Requirements

**

• 3 to 5 years in product, growth, or marketing analytics, ideally in a consumer app, marketplace, e-commerce, or food ordering business.

• Strong SQL — able to write and debug multi-step queries over event and transaction data without help.

• A track record of designing, running, and reading A/B tests, with the statistics to do it properly: power and sample size, significance, guardrail metrics, and the common ways a test lies (peeking, sample ratio mismatch, novelty).

• Technical enough to set up a test yourself: comfortable with feature flags or an experimentation tool, basic JavaScript or app event instrumentation, and reading a tracking plan.

• Hands-on with a product or web analytics stack (GA4 or similar) and a BI tool (Power BI, Looker, Tableau, or similar).

• Comfortable testing in marketing channels as well as in product: campaign experiments in Google Ads or Meta, email or push tests, and geo or holdout designs for measuring incrementality.

• Uses AI tools daily for analysis work and can show how it changed the way you work.

• Clear, confident communication — able to take a messy result and explain to a non-technical audience what it means and what to do next, in writing and in person.

• Owns outcomes, not tasks, and is comfortable setting the plan in a small team rather than waiting for one.

• Fluent English. Danish is not required.

**Strong-to-Have Experience

**

• Python or R for statistical analysis and automating recurring checks.

• Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, or another lakehouse and BI setup.

• Mobile app experimentation (Firebase, Optimizely, GrowthBook, Statsig, or similar) and web experimentation on multi-tenant or white-label sites.

• Sequential or Bayesian test methods, or quasi-experiments where a true A/B test isn't possible (for example, market-level or restaurant-level rollouts).

• Paid media data (Google Ads, Meta) and attribution, to judge traffic quality as well as conversion.

• A customer data platform and B2C engagement tooling (Segment, Braze, Firebase messaging, or similar), including running lifecycle tests in them.

• Building AI-assisted workflows or agents for analysis, not only using chat tools.

**Who We Are

**At OrderYOYO, company culture comes first. We create a positive, inclusive environment where people are trusted to do their best work and take ownership of what they build. Personal development is central to how we work — engineers are encouraged to grow technically, take responsibility, and help shape how our products and platforms evolve.

We help restaurants succeed online by providing branded websites, mobile apps, and tailored marketing solutions, giving them full control of their business. By removing high commission fees charged by third-party platforms, we empower restaurants to grow sustainably.

Through our partnership with AppSmart, the market leader in POS and in-store systems, we've become the largest restaurant-focused platform in Europe.

**What We Offer

**

• A salary of DKK59,000/ month

• A hybrid role based in Copenhagen.

• High ownership and autonomy over the analysis and experiments you run.

• The opportunity to directly move a revenue-critical metric: orders per day.

• A strong focus on data quality, honest experimentation, and analytics best practices.

• A collaborative, international Growth team.

• Real emphasis on learning, mentoring, and personal development.

**Bring your engineering expertise to processes that help protect lives every day

At Bavarian Nordic, we are looking for a Engineering Specialist to strengthen our Drug Substance manufacturing processes and support the introduction of new equipment and technologies.

You will join Material & Sterile Operation, reporting to the Senior Manager, and combine hands-on problem-solving with technical leadership. Your work will help ensure that our processes deliver reliable performance, consistent quality, and GMP compliance.

**Your impact

Working across Manufacturing, Engineering, Automation, and Quality, you will also share your expertise and strengthen process understanding across teams.

**What You Bring

**Why join Bavarian Nordic?

**At Bavarian Nordic, we work to protect lives through vaccines. Your engineering expertise will contribute directly to the manufacturing processes that make this possible.

**AI Academy Intake - Copenhagen (on-site, full-time)

**At Light, we're redefining how software is built, how it's delivered, and how it works.

We're building organic software. Software that heals itself. Software that adapts to the user and the business. Software that learns and gets better as it's used.

Our starting point is finance. Companies including Legora, Lovable, and Fuse Energy run on Light. We're building towards a platform that understands how each business operates and evolves with it.

The AI Academy

The AI Academy is where Light builds its future leaders for an ever-changing world. It's a small cohort of exceptional early-career people who take an operating process in marketing, sales, finance, partnerships, customer success, product or any other team, and rebuild it so AI agents do the work and humans handle the exceptions. Then they move on to the next one.

We believe roles will increasingly merge, and that cross-functional collaboration and broad knowledge of the business will define high-performing teams. The Academy is built around that:

• Training. You start with a period of training on how to use AI to drive business outcomes: tools, agents, automations, and how to judge their output.

• Several functions at once. You then apply it across several functions, splitting your time between teams such as marketing, sales, finance, partnerships, customer success and product.

• Focus. Over time you move into fewer functions, where you've had the most impact and want to go deepest.

In this role you're a member of Light's AI Academy. You'll undergo specialised AI training and be pushed to use AI in every aspect of your job and to re-think the status quo from first principles.

This training will enable you to effectively build operations and companies at scale. If you aspire to be a future single-person unicorn founder, this is the ideal training ground.

**Who This Is For

**You must meet this requirement: an exceptional level of achievement in a highly competitive endeavour. Work experience in itself is irrelevant, past hires have been 17 years and older. For example:

• A gold medal at the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) or International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI)

• Experience at McKinsey QuantumBlack, the Goldman Sachs Special Situations Group or TMT group (regular IBD do not apply), Optiver, Jane Street or similar.

• Having built or sold a company

• Competed in elite-level sport (e.g. a sub-8-hour Ironman, the Olympic Games, or a European or World Championship, football or basketball at highest level)

• A FIDE chess rating of 2,400 or higher (IM level)

• An equivalent level of achievement in another highly competitive endeavour

• Top of class in high-school year

If you're applying with an equivalent achievement, explain the competition or field, your result, and the standard required to achieve it. If you don't have an equivalent level of achievement we encourage you to not apply.

Our bar at Light is high, and this is more than just a job. You will need the curiosity to explore unfamiliar areas, the willingness to go the extra mile to get things right, the discipline to test your assumptions, and the persistence to keep going when your first approach does not work.

We hold two bars: outperforming your metrics, and being kind and supportive of each other. Exceptional ability without kindness is not a fit.

What you'll work on

You'll be in charge of building agentic factories that re-think what is possible across product, marketing, implementation, customer service.

• Rethink work from first principles. Take a process in marketing, sales, finance, partnerships, customer success, or product. Ask what outcome it exists to deliver, and redesign it around what AI now makes possible. Making the old process faster is the easy part.

• Own operations end to end. Take full ownership of processes across finance operations, people operations, and legal and compliance, working directly with the Chief of Staff to CEO. Run them, then rebuild them so agents do the work and nothing falls through the cracks.

• Build the agents and workflows yourself. Identify where manual work can be automated or standardised, and build the solution rather than waiting for someone else to do so.

• Move fast. Ship a first version in hours and iterate several times a day.

• Participate in the AI Academy. Complete the specialised AI training, apply what you learn in every function you work in, and share what worked and what didn't so the rest of the cohort and the teams can adopt it.

• Own projects through delivery. Scope the problem, build the solution, debug regressions, and follow through until the team can rely on what you've shipped.

You'll work alongside exceptional colleagues.

What else we're looking for

• Clear thinking and the ability to explain your decisions, including what you tried and why it didn't work.

• Kindness. You make the people around you better.

How we'll measure success

Your work should produce measurable improvements: 10 to 1,000x output capacity.

What you'll get

• Full-time compensation above the standard market rate.

• Every tool available. We give everyone in the Academy access to all the AI tools on the market, and put you in the environment that will make you a success.

• A role based in our Copenhagen office, working alongside the teams and the AI Academy cohort.

• Ownership from your first day, with a path to owning a function.

How to apply

Send your CV.

Include a link to, or a description of, something you've built. Tell us what it does, which parts you built yourself, where it failed, and how you fixed it. Then explain why you want to join the AI Academy at Light.

We want to understand how you think, what you can build, and what you're ready to take on next.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

Are You Our Next Rescue Zookeeper at Odsherred Zoo Rescue?

We are looking for two qualified zookeepers with a passion for exotic animals and animal rescue!Fonden Odsherred Zoo Rescue is Denmark's first and only approved rescue centre for exotic animals in need. We provide a permanent home for animals that have experienced difficult circumstances and need specialised care.

We are currently looking for two dedicated, qualified zookeepers to join our team.

About the PositionsThe positions primarily involve caring for our larger animals and a variety of other species, including small wild cats, camels, meerkats, llamas, deer, birds and more.

Our rescue centre is home to approximately 600 animals, representing a wide range of exotic species.

You will work closely with our existing team of six zookeepers and a maintenance colleague. Teamwork is an essential part of our daily operations, and we expect everyone to contribute to a supportive and responsible working environment.

Both positions are full-time and include weekend duties approximately twice a month.

We are looking to fill:

• 
One longer-term position, potentially permanent or lasting 1–2 years.

• 
One shorter-term position, lasting approximately 6–12 months.

We would like the successful candidates to start as soon as possible.

What We Expect From You

We are looking for colleagues who are genuinely passionate about animal welfare and understand the responsibility that comes with working at a rescue centre.

You should be:

• 
A qualified zookeeper with experience or a strong interest in exotic animals.

• 
Reliable, punctual, honest and hardworking.

• 
Positive, adaptable and willing to take responsibility.

• 
A team player who actively supports and communicates with colleagues.

• 
Observant and attentive to the animals in your care, recognising changes in their health, behaviour and general well-being.

• 
Willing to learn and adapt to the different challenges of working with rescued animals.

• 
Comfortable with the practical and sometimes physically demanding nature of animal care.

Teamwork is particularly important to us. We have a working culture in which colleagues help one another complete the day's responsibilities. We expect everyone to contribute, communicate openly and take their responsibilities seriously.

Working at a rescue centre is more than a traditional zookeeping job. It requires dedication, flexibility and an understanding that the needs of rescued animals can be very different from those of animals in conventional zoological collections.

Visitor Presentations and Social Media For approximately half the year, our rescue centre is open to the public.

During this period, all zookeepers participate in educational presentations for visitors, introducing the animals they care for and explaining their stories, behaviour and needs.

Public speaking is a mandatory part of the position, but previous presentation experience is not required as long as you are willing to learn.

We also regularly produce content for our social media platforms to raise awareness of our rescue work and the animals in our care.

This includes livestreams, photographs and recorded videos. Our zookeepers participate in this work by helping communicate the stories of the animals and the daily life of our rescue centre.

Understanding Our Mission, Odsherred Zoo Rescue is built around three main areas of work:

1. Rescue and Rehabilitation — Our Primary Mission

First and foremost, we are a rescue centre for exotic animals in need.

Our animals come from a variety of backgrounds, including the pharmaceutical and cosmetics industries, confiscations, former private ownership and other zoological institutions across Denmark and Europe.

Many of these animals have experienced difficult circumstances and require specialised care, patience and understanding.

Providing them with a safe and permanent home is our highest priority.

2. Conservation and Breeding Programmes

When resources and funding allow, we participate in conservation breeding programmes for rare and endangered species, including tamarins from South America.

Although this is an important part of our work, it remains secondary to our primary rescue mission.

3. Providing Homes for Surplus Zoo Animals

When we have the necessary space and resources, we also welcome surplus animals from other zoological institutions, providing them with a home when they might otherwise face euthanasia.

A Different Approach to Zookeeping, We want to emphasise that working at Odsherred Zoo Rescue is not the same as working at a traditional zoo.

We welcome applicants with experience from conventional zoological institutions, but it is essential that you are open-minded and willing to understand the different principles and challenges involved in operating a rescue centre.

Our focus is not simply on maintaining a zoological collection. It is on providing individual animals with the care, security and permanent home they deserve.

We are looking for colleagues who genuinely share these values and are willing to learn, adapt and contribute to our mission.

How to Apply, If you are passionate about exotic animals, dedicated to animal welfare and would like to become part of our rescue team, we would love to hear from you.

Please send your written application and CV to: post@odsherreds-zoo.dk only written inquiries.

Yours sincerely

Joan Thygesen

Director and founder of

Found Odsherred Zoo Rescue

• Contribute to testing, deployment, and operational excellence

• Work closely with other engineering teams across Flatpay to build integrated solutions

• Help improve engineering practices, tooling, and development workflows

**Who You Are

**

• 3-6 years of professional software engineering experience

• Experience building and operating production systems

• Comfortable working across modern backend and cloud technologies

• Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals

• Curious, pragmatic, and eager to learn

• Enjoy taking ownership and solving real customer problems

• Experience with payments, e-commerce, SaaS platforms, or fintech is a plus

You'll be working with technologies such as the following.

We don't expect experience with every technology listed below. We're looking for engineers who can learn quickly and help us build great products.

**Backend

**

• Java, Spring Boot

• REST APIs & Event-Driven Architecture

**Frontend

**

• TypeScript

• React

• Jest

• Playwright

• i18n, feature flags

**Platform & Delivery

**

• GitHub Actions

• CI/CD

• AWS ECS

• Observability & Monitoring

**Why Flatpay?

**As part of our team, you'll join 2,000+ passionate Flatpayers dedicated to shaping the future of payments. You'll help build a strategic new business area from the ground up, working on products that directly connect merchants and consumers while shaping the future of online payments at Flatpay. We offer an inclusive environment where engineers are trusted with ownership and encouraged to make an impact.

Our engineering teams work together from our Copenhagen office. We believe that close collaboration, quick feedback loops, and solving problems side-by-side help us build better products, move faster, and create a stronger engineering culture.

We also provide plenty of perks including free slush ice, an on-site gym, a fully equipped gamer room, and much more.

If you're ready to help build and scale the future of payments, we'd love to hear from you.

Established in 2022 in Copenhagen with a commitment to transparency, we've streamlined card payments to small and medium-sized businesses. Our innovative pricing model eliminates hidden costs and fees, offering a simple flat rate for all cards with no monthly subscription for our point-of-sale and payment solutions.

Operating in Denmark, Finland, Germany, Italy, France, the United Kingdom, and the Netherlands, we're more than just a service provider; we are your trusted business partner.

We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our clients' evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary?

**Location: Copenhagen

**We are seeking a strategic and solutions-oriented Director, Creative Operations to lead the operational backbone of our in-house creative team. As a key leader within the organization, you will be responsible for driving efficiency, optimizing workflows, and enabling the seamless delivery of creative work for a global audience.

This role will lead project management, creative operations systems, technology enablement, and external agency partnerships to ensure our teams deliver best-in-class creative work at scale. You will collaborate closely with Digital & Technology, Brand, Marketing, and Production teams to shape and evolve the creative operating model, lead technology initiatives, and identify opportunities to improve speed, quality, and efficiency through automation and emerging technologies.

The ideal candidate is a highly organized and collaborative leader with deep expertise in creative operations, workflow transformation, technology implementation, and change management. You are equally comfortable developing long-term operational strategies and ensuring day-to-day execution excellence.

**Creative Operations & Project Management

**

• Lead the Creative Studio operating model, including intake, prioritization, capacity planning, resource allocation, and project delivery.

• Drive continuous improvement of creative workflows, systems, and governance across project management, DAM, and MRM platforms.

• Partner with Creative, Brand, Marketing Operations, Production, and Technology teams to align priorities, optimize resources, and ensure successful delivery.

• Establish operational KPIs and reporting to measure workflow effectiveness, resource utilization, delivery performance, and business impact.
