Job description

A Tech & Business Lead inspired by innovation… just as curious about business as about code.

Can you take a digital product all the way from the first business need to a launched platform, website or eCommerce setup, and describe, plan, document and facilitate the process along the way? Then we'd love to hear from you!!!

We are looking for someone who thrives in the technical process with our developers and loves diving into the architecture and business decisions that shape today’s digital products. BUT also a person who loves working closely with designers, strategists and creatives, to create the best possible outcome for users out there. So what does that mean?

Things that matter: Strong technical skills, real curiosity about business and innovation, a nose for the smart solution and a love for building products that matter to real people.

About Signifly

Signifly is one of the fastest growing innovation agencies in Denmark. Our team has won several awards for our innovative approach to digital products and user experiences. We are an ambitious team that is constantly pushing the limits of our work and our own capabilities. We collaborate with a broad range of clients from all industries to create new and innovative digital products and business models. We are a team of developers, designers, film makers and digital strategists, and we believe that creativity, entrepreneurship and a diverse mix of top-notch skills can drive the innovation and change that will help shape a better tomorrow.

Agentic engineering – with craft at the core

We're operating in a time of agentic engineering. AI agents are changing how software gets built, and we embrace that: we use agentic tools to ship faster and build AI-powered features into client products.

At the same time, we know that great solutions still start with the fundamentals. Agents amplify good engineering, they don't replace it. As our Tech & Business Lead, you help decide where AI makes a solution better, and where good old craft is still the way to go.

Key tasks

• 
Turn business needs into clear technical solutions, from the first idea to the launched product

• 
Describe, plan and facilitate the development process together with designers, strategists and developers

• 
Be hands-on and run the process end-to-end on smaller projects

• 
Own the technical deliverable on larger projects and align with the innovation lead on business and project goals

• 
Validate solutions early, so we build the right thing in the right way

• 
Bring AI and agentic tools into our projects where they create real value

Job requirements

What we expect of you

• 
A fair understanding of relational databases and common data structures

• 
An intuitive understanding of business workflows and strategy

• 
Eager to work in a highly ambitious team and keep developing your skills and knowledge

• 
Structured with an eye for detail, especially the technical details of implementation

• 
A commercial mindset to spot digital business potential

• 
A relevant educational background in business or technology (or similar experience)

It is a plus if you:

• 
Have deep knowledge of a major JavaScript framework (we use Next.js, but Vue or React is cool too)

• 
Have experience building APIs in a major web framework (Hono or another TS framework)

• 
Have experience as a project lead of multidisciplinary teams or as a product owner

• 
Are a true motivator who gets all stakeholders working towards a common goal

• 
Have experience from strategic business consulting, creative agencies or web agencies

Please expect no less from us

The most important thing that we offer is an inspiring and ambitious work environment, with an emphasis on learning and developing, both personally and as a team. We have an informal organization with minimal hierarchy, where there is plenty of room for being ambitious within your own area of expertise, as well as taking part in shaping our team, culture, and product offering.

But, of course, we can also tempt you with:

• 
Yearly one-week team trip with both social and professional focuses (paid) - in 2023 we went to Portugal.

• 
Fresh catered lunch of mostly organic produce and with vegetarian options

• 
Coffee, tea, soft drinks, snacks, etc. day and night - and wine, beer and drinks on Fridays

• 
Beautiful office space with emphasis noise reduction, centrally located in Vesterbro

• 
Paid equipment of high quality - you choose what you prefer

• 
In-office massage service

• 
Inspiration-trips to events, meet-ups, and conferences

• 
Company paid pension and health insurance

• 
Competitive salary based on qualifications and performance

• 
Career progress based on merits rather than seniority

• 
Opportunity to work-exchange with our office in Montreal, London and Toronto

And if you think something is missing, just let us know. We can probably work together to add it. After all, we are trying to create the best possible place to work!

Practical information

• 
Position: Full-time, 40 hours per week

• 
Location: Signifly, Vesterbrogade 46, 1st floor, Copenhagen V

• 
Language: Danish

• 
Tech stack: TypeScript, Next.js, React, and Tailwind

Please submit your CV or online profile (LinkedIn or GitHub) – and feel free to include links to projects you’re proud of. Then we will be in touch!

Master Data and Payroll Specialist

Permanent

Lyngby

Do you thrive in a role that combines payroll, people data, and process improvement? Can you turn complexity into efficient, compliant, and scalable solutions? Are you ready to contribute to digitalization, automation, and continuous improvement across a global organization? If you're ready to create meaningful changes, this opportunity is for you!

About the Team

COWI's Global Payroll and People Master Data team is responsible for payroll operations for Denmark, COWI's largest entity, while supporting payroll governance, compliance, master data management, and process excellence across the Group.

Over the past several years, the team has been on a significant transformation journey, continuously professionalizing, standardizing, digitalizing, and optimizing payroll and people data processes. We are known for delivering stable, high-quality operations while simultaneously driving improvements, system enhancements, compliance initiatives, and global projects.

Join our Master Data & Payroll Team in Lyngby

We are looking for a colleague who is motivated to contribute to both operational excellence and continuous improvement. This specialist role combines payroll and people master data operations with process optimization, compliance, system support, digitalization, and project work.

Approximately 50% of the role focuses on payroll, people master data, and related controls, while the remainder is dedicated to process improvements, automation, compliance, system support, and implementation initiatives.

You will collaborate across countries and functions to ensure efficient day-to-day delivery and streamline payroll and people data processes across the organization. To perform effectively, you should understand current processes and find the best supporting IT solutions. You should be curious to learn the basics.

On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for:

• Managing payroll and people data, and related processes while ensuring compliance with local legislation, governance requirements, and audit standards.

• Maintaining accurate and high-quality people master data to support effective workforce management and reporting.

• Managing process optimization, standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives across payroll and people operations.

• Supporting digitalization, automation, and system-related projects, including payroll, compliance, and HR data initiatives.

• Contributing to global time registration programs and other cross-functional people operations projects and rollouts.

• Delivering analysis and operational support to HR, Finance, leaders, and employees while collaborating with stakeholders across multiple countries to implement best practices.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future

Your skills are the key to your growth. Working across borders and disciplines, we share knowledge and build positive relationships with colleagues and customers. You bring your knowledge and get to learn from the best. To thrive in this position, we believe that you have good analytical skills, a structured work approach and can develop practical solutions.

Furthermore, you should have:

• A degree within Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a similar discipline with minimum 1 years of relevant professional experience.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and process improvement capabilities, with experience working with data to drive operational excellence.

• Solid understanding of accounting principles, financial processes, governance, and compliance requirements, with the ability to interpret legislation, regulations, and business needs.

• Strong system skills and affinity for technology including experience with HR, payroll, finance, or reporting systems; Good to have a knowledge of SAP HCM, Maconomy, Power BI, ServiceNow, or similar tools.

• Effective communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions, departments, and international teams.

• A curious and collaborative mindset, with a willingness to learn and fluency in both English and Danish.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Got more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to VP, Head of Payroll, People Master Data Pernille Lading Hedberg at [plhe@cowi.com](

**💰 Salary, Based On Experience Level

**🇫🇷 Paris — up to €95,000 gross/year + 10% bonus

🇬🇧 London — up to £88,000 gross/year + 10% bonus

🇩🇰 Copenhagen — up to 70,500 DKK gross/month + 10% bonus

🇩🇪 Berlin — up to €99,000 gross/year + 10% bonus

**About Monta

**Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you’ll do well with us.

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully — and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people — sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You’ll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

We’re looking for a Solution Architect who’s ready to roll up their sleeves, take ownership, and build with us — through the grind and the wins.

**Solution Architect

**The Solution Architect is responsible for designing and delivering technical solutions that enable customers to successfully adopt and integrate Monta into their existing technology environments. The role spans pre-sales and post-sales, with a primary focus on solution architecture, hands-on enterprise integrations, and the design and execution of customer migration projects.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Lead technical discovery to understand customer requirements, existing systems, integration needs and migration complexity.

• Design, develop, test and implement integrations between Monta and enterprise systems such as ERP, CRM, finance and data platforms.

• Design and execute customer migration projects, including technical assessments, migration planning, cutover strategies, testing and validation.

• Define scalable solution architectures, integration approaches, data flows and technical specifications.

• Support Solution Engineers and Sales during pre-sales with architecture design, integration feasibility, migration scoping and technical risk assessments.

• Collaborate with customer IT teams, Product and Engineering to troubleshoot technical issues, resolve implementation challenges and ensure successful customer onboarding.

**Core Skills And Experience

**

• Proven experience in a Solution Architect, Integration Architect or similar customer-facing technical role.

• Hands-on experience building and implementing enterprise SaaS integrations, not solely designing or overseeing them.

• Experience planning and executing complex customer migrations, including technical discovery, cutover planning, testing and issue resolution.

• Experience integrating enterprise business systems such as ERP, CRM, finance or data and analytics platforms.

• Strong customer communication, technical problem-solving and solution design skills, with professional English.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have Experience

**

• Experience with platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, Business Central, Databricks, Salesforce, SAP or similar.

• Experience migrating customers between enterprise SaaS platforms, including data migration, system configuration and service continuity.

• Experience supporting both pre-sales solution design and post-sales implementation.

• Experience in EV charging, energy, mobility, IoT or similarly complex technology ecosystems.

• With experience supporting customers across Western Europe.

**_If the mission excites you but your experience isn’t a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway — we care about potential, not perfection.

_**Primary Outcome

_Design and deliver reliable enterprise integrations and successful customer migrations that accelerate onboarding, minimise disruption and enable revenue activation.

_**AI Competency

**You’ll be expected to work with AI-powered tools. Some we use:

• GitHub Copilot / Claude Code

• ChatGPT / Gemini / Claude

• Notion AI (docs, knowledge, meeting notes)

• Analytics & ML: Langfuse, PyTorch, Mastra

• AI-enhanced testing & monitoring (e.g., generative QA, Grafana ML)

We don’t expect mastery of all — but we expect comfort learning, experimenting, and adopting _AI responsibly.

_Why Monta

• Impact, not easy mode — your work matters, and you’ll feel it every day.

• Ownership from day one — we don’t micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• The grind is real — priorities shift, and flexibility is sometimes needed to get things across the finish line. But so are the rewards: impact, growth, and a team that has your back.

• The people are extraordinary — talented, driven, and fun to work with. You’ll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure

**What We Offer

**

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life’s big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you’re at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

**Please send us your application in English.

**To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you’ll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don’t accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won’t agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

Monta is building the platform that powers the future of EV charging. We connect hardware, software, businesses, and drivers into one seamless ecosystem. Our mission is to make charging simple, reliable, and scalable for everyone.

Do you genuinely want to make an impact on people’s lives and their health? Do you have a business-oriented and analytical mindset with proven IT skills and the ability to process data and conceptualize it into interactive and visually appealing dashboards and reports? Then you might be our new colleague.

The team you will be part of

At our global HQ, located in Ballerup, Denmark, you will join a innovative and hybrid work environment. You will be part of the Agile Transformation & delivery team and work closely with the other teams within the SW & Electronics organization as well as stakeholders across the organization.

This role is an exciting opportunity to contribute to strategic initiatives and support business development through analytics and data utilization, while developing your skills in a real-world setting.

Your Contribution Is Appreciated, And You Will

• Support the organization's data needs by assisting with data management and analytics from the agile release train delivery process

• Develop, optimize and maintain data-driven analytical performance tracking dashboards and reports in Power BI / Sharepoint, as well as building the underlying data models

• Aid in ensuring high data quality, by assisting in reinforcing relevant supporting processes

• Generate and provide ad hoc reports and analyses to support the business delivery being transparent

• Actively seek out new opportunities in data and analytics with business requirements

• Automate the forecast tool embedded into our planning tools and processes

To Succeed In The Role, We Imagine That You

• Are currently enrolled as a student at a Business School or University, within the field of Data Science, Engineering, Business Analytics, Business Intelligence, Statistics or similar

• Have a genuine interest for data and analytics

• Can approach new problems with an analytical and data-driven mindset

• Have great communication and presentation skills

• Have practical experience with Power BI, MS Office, Jira, Python and SQL and/or are keen to further enhance those skills

• Are curious towards new technologies, and to learn new systems

• Are fluent in English, written and spoken

• Can work appr. 15-20 hours a week (flexible hours to fit your academic schedule)

At a personal level, you enjoy working in a team to create new solutions. You are capable of adjusting and feel comfortable working in a highly varied environment. Furthermore, you have a natural understanding of how to make things simplistic, including complex technical concepts, when interacting with stakeholders cross functionally.

We encourage you to apply

Even if you don’t match all the above-mentioned skills, we will gladly receive your application if you think you have transferrable skills**. We highly value a mindset, motivation, and energy, that align with our core values, to not only ensure growth for you, but for your team and the wider AMBU organization as well.

Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

We're now looking for a Chief Product & Technology Officer to lead our next chapter.

One accountable leader for what we build, why we build it and how we release it.

The Role:

The role translates the company’s growth ambition into an AI-first portfolio built on a scalable, secure and coherent platform, and ensures that it reaches customers predictably and at a high quality bar. The CPTO is both the architect of the portfolio and its foremost ambassador, internally and externally.

You'll own product strategy, technology, architecture and release cadence across our full product portfolio, leading an international product and R&D organization globally.

Reports to Chief Executive Officer; member of the Executive Management Team.

Direct reporst - VP of Technology Engineering; VP Product Management.

📍 Copenhagen HQ preferred

• international role, approx. 40–50 travel days a year.

What You'll Drive:

• Scale Retail platform solution for global enterprise customers and lead our entry into the US market.

• Set the direction for our next-generation hospital platform.

• Take AI from roadmap to recurring revenue, built into the core platform and delivered responsibly.

• Bring several legacy systems together into one coherent, secure cloud platform.

• Build a predictable release rhythm and a data-driven, AI-first engineering culture.

• Shape build, partner or buy decisions and lead product and technical due diligence.

Strategic Priorities:

Three agendas connect directly to growth along two vectors: winning more clinics and customers (points of sale) and expanding what each customer uses and pays for (product depth and ASP). Platform consolidation underpins all three.

• Manage: Global Scaling to Enterprise & US Market Evolve Manage for enterprise scalability, security, integrations and governance, with standardised workflows across clinics and regions. Sequence market entry deliberately rather than opportunistically.

• Next-Generation Hospital Software: Set direction for and deliver a modern, future-proof hospital platform. Define the product configuration needed for broader global expansion without compromising the depth hospital customers require.

• AI: From Roadmap to Recurring Revenue Move planned AI categories from build to commercial launch on time and to a high quality bar. Drive attachment until AI is a differentiator in every deal and a recurring contributor to ARR.

• One Coherent Platform: Reduce the number of legacy systems and build the shared foundation that makes the three agendas above deliverable.

Success Criteria:

First 6–12 Months:

• A clear, prioritised and communicated product and technology roadmap addressing 2 main Goals; Enterprise Expansion & US Market Entry, understood and supported by the Executive Management Team and the Board.

• A decided and initiated plan for next-generation hospital software, built on one coherent foundation.

• A defined target architecture and a legacy consolidation plan with milestones.

• A defined AI approach across the portfolio, with concrete initiatives linked to customer value and ARR potential.

• Clear build-versus-buy principles and a product-led view on M&A opportunities.

• A product and technology organisation with clear roles, one planning rhythm and agreed delivery metrics to increase velocity and throughput.

What You Bring:

• Senior leadership of both product management and engineering (CPTO, CPO, CTO or SVP level) in B2B SaaS or vertical software.

• A record of turning market insight into a portfolio strategy that grows ARR, including pricing and packaging.

• Experience building and leading multinational, distributed teams and developing strong leaders.

• Platform modernisation, legacy consolidation and M&A integration experience.

• Hands-on understanding of where AI creates real customer and business value.

• Credibility with engineers and in C-level customer conversations.

• PE-backed or high-growth experience is a clear advantage; healthtech or regulated industries a plus.

Personal Qualities:

• Strategic: Think in wholes, long horizons and business value, and turn this into concrete, prioritised choices.

• Technology fluent: Credible with architects and engineers, and able to explain technical trade-offs in business terms.

• Commercial: Understand the link between product, sales and earnings, and drive growth through the product.

• Execution-strong: Balance ambition with pragmatic delivery and measurable results.

• Clear communicator: Explain product and technology choices simply and convincingly, and builds buy-in from the Board to the team.

• Empowering leader: Build strong teams and develop people, in line with our values: Cutting-edge, Attentive, Resourceful, Ethical/Transparent.

• Purpose-driven: Motivated by improving access to hearing healthcare.

• Robust: Collaborative, and able to make clear choices when priorities compete.

How We Work:

Agile, direct and non-political. We say it like it is, make the tough calls and like to see people grow and deliver results. Our values are all about C. A. R. E. - Cutting-edge, Attentive, Resourceful, Ethical/Transparent.

What We Offer:

A central value-creation role in an Insight Partners-backed software company with an ambitious growth plan and a clear purpose. The CPTO owns the full product and technology agenda, takes a defining role in the growth journey, and has access to Auditdata’s Management Incentive Programme.

Your journey with us:

We want you to get to know us as well as we get to know you.

• Introductory call (online) with our Talent Partner;

• Value fit meeting (online) with our Chief People Officer, followed by a behavioural profile (such as DISC);

• Executive interview (online) with our Chief Executive Officer;

• Copenhagen visit (in-person): meet the team at our HQ and present a case on a real challenge we’re tackling;

• Final interview (online) with the Board.

Throughout, you’ll get timely feedback and plenty of room to ask your own questions.

We look forward to your application! (please submit your CV in English and why this role interests you)

Auditdata is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to create diverse work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills.

jobs.occupation: Senior Project Manager, Strategic Procurement Initiatives
jobs.description:
Job Description: Are you passionate about project management, and think strategy execution in a Nordic role sounds exciting? Are you motivated by driving complex initiatives across functions and countries, turning strategic ambitions into tangible business results?

If so, you could be our new Senior Project Manager in Project Management & Strategy Execution, Group Procurement.

At Tryg, Procurement plays a central role in shaping and developing our Nordic partner and supplier ecosystem. Through strategic sourcing initiatives, partnerships, and transformation projects, we help create business value, improve customer experiences, and support the delivery of Tryg’s strategic priorities across the Nordics.

About the role | Turning strategy into results

As a Project Manager, you will play a key role in executing Procurement’s strategic agenda. Through strategic sourcing projects and transformation initiatives, you will help translate ambitions into tangible results that strengthen our business, improve customer outcomes, and create measurable value across Tryg.

You will take on a Nordic role with responsibility for driving projects from initial analysis and scoping through implementation and benefit realization. Many of the projects span countries, business areas, and stakeholder groups, with Claims being one of our key partners.

Working closely with leaders, specialists, and key stakeholders across the organization, you will be responsible for creating alignment, driving progress, and ensuring successful execution across diverse perspectives, priorities, and dependencies.

Projects vary in scope and focus and may include:

• Strategic partnerships and supplier development

• Process optimization and operational excellence

• Digitalization and automation initiatives

• Cost and value creation programs

• Customer and partner experience improvements

Common to all projects is their focus on turning strategic priorities into meaningful change in how we work with partners and how customers experience Tryg.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Leading strategic projects and transformation initiatives from analysis and planning through implementation and benefit realization.

• Establishing clear project goals, plans, governance structures, and success criteria.

• Ensuring progress, quality, risk management, and dependency tracking throughout project lifecycles.

• Creating alignment and engagement among stakeholders across Procurement and the wider organization.

• Challenging existing ways of working and transforming opportunities into concrete improvements.

• Driving implementation and ensuring sustainable organizational adoption of new solutions and processes.

• Contributing to the continued development of our project management methodologies, tools, and ways of working.

We are looking for project managers with different profiles and levels of experience.

Depending on your experience and background, you will take responsibility for projects of varying size and complexity. As a Senior Project Manager, you will lead larger cross-functional initiatives and programs while also contributing to the further development of our project management capabilities.

For one of the positions, we are particularly interested in candidates with experience from the automotive industry, as several upcoming initiatives will focus on developing our workshop partnerships, spare parts ecosystem, and other key areas of the automotive value chain.

About you | Analytical, proactive, and collaborative

You are motivated by creating results through collaboration and thrive at the intersection of business, strategy, and execution. You are able to create structure in complex situations, challenge existing approaches, and turn ideas and analyses into practical solutions.

You likely hold a relevant university degree and have experience within project management, transformation, or strategic development, either from a similar role or from management consulting.

We place particular emphasis on candidates who:

• Have a proven track record of leading complex projects or transformation initiatives from analysis to implementation.

• Possess strong analytical capabilities and can translate complex challenges into clear recommendations and decision-making material.

• Work in a structured manner and take ownership of progress, quality, and outcomes.

• Have strong stakeholder management skills and can create commitment across functions, teams, and organizational levels.

• Are curious, challenge the status quo constructively, and actively seek opportunities for improvement.

• Are fluent in one of the Scandinavian languages (Danish, Norwegian, Swedish).

Experience within Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Supplier Management, or the insurance industry is considered an advantage. However, what matters most is your ability to lead complex initiatives, understand business priorities, and create measurable results.

About us | Project Management & Strategy Execution

You will join the Project Management & Strategy Execution team within Group Procurement.

Our mission is to ensure successful execution of Procurement’s strategic priorities in close collaboration with our sister team, Strategy & Innovation Hub. While Strategy & Innovation Hub focuses on opportunity identification, analysis, business cases, and benefit definition, our team is responsible for driving execution, implementation, and organizational anchoring.

Together, we ensure that strategy becomes reality.

We bring an analytical, structured, and results-oriented approach to our work, while believing that outstanding results and a healthy work environment go hand in hand. We therefore prioritize an environment characterized by high ambitions, strong collaboration, and continuous professional and personal development.

With us, you will gain:

• A highly visible Nordic role with broad stakeholder exposure.

• The opportunity to work on strategically important projects with meaningful business impact.

• Close collaboration with leaders, specialists, and decision-makers across Tryg.

• The chance to influence both the projects you lead and the future development of project management within Procurement.

We value trust, accountability, and teamwork, and we believe the best results are created together.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Please submit your application and CV no later than 22nd of November.

We encourage applicants not to include a photo in their CV.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and invite selected candidates for interviews continuously, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The recruitment process will close once the right candidate has been identified.

If you have any questions regarding the position, please feel free to contact Jonas Klestrup, Head of Project Management & Strategy Execution, at jonas.klestrup@tryg.dk.

We encourage everyone regardless of gender identity, age, background, disability or origin to apply for the position. We are proud to have high employee satisfaction, strong professionalism and equal opportunities to develop your career in the Tryg Group. Tryg is the largest non-life insurance company in Scandinavia with activities in Denmark, Norway and Sweden. Every day we strive – each in our own way – to create peace of mind and affect the lives of most Scandinavians. Read more at www.tryg.com

jobs.occupation: Student Assistant for Analytical Method Development
jobs.description:
Would you like to work for a CDMO producing Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API) for different companies worldwide? **Do you want laboratory experience in a biopharmaceutical company? Then join AGC Biologics in a Student Assistant role and become part of an international and dynamic organization where everyone is responsible for delivering right on time as one team!

****About The Department

**We are a highly collaborative team that provides analytical support to both early-stage and late-stage development projects, as well as to external customers. Our work environment is dynamic and requires strong coordination across the team.

We are therefore looking for a Student Assistant who is communicative, flexible, positive, and service minded, and who enjoys contributing to a team-oriented environment.

**Your Responsibilities

**As a Student Assistant in the Analytical Method Development team, your primary responsibilities will include:

• Preparation of buffers and eluents

• Preparation of analytical samples (e.g. desalting and concentration)

• Ensuring reagents and buffers are prepared and available for analytical work

• Supporting the team with laboratory-related tasks

You will work closely with other team members to ensure that the laboratory operates smoothly and that materials are prepared in time for analysis.

**About You

**We are looking for a candidate who:

• Is enrolled in a relevant higher education program (e.g. Chemistry, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Sciences or similar)

• Has strong attention to detail

• Has good written and spoken English skills

• Works in a structured, accurate, and methodical manner

• Is proactive, flexible, and solution oriented

• Is comfortable working independently as well as in a team

• Has some familiarity with laboratory equipment such as analytical balances and pH meters

The role requires a consistent weekly presence of 8 hours per week, typically as one full working day. We aim to provide flexibility during exam periods and vacations where possible.

**How To Apply

**We will process the applications as they arrive and will close the job posting once we have the right candidate. Therefore, please submit your application and CV as soon as possible.

**When applying, please also attach your university enrolment letter as proof of your current student status.

**If you need further information about the position please contact Team Lead Phillip Sommer (Phillip.sommer@agcbio.com.)

**Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

The Business Analyst – Investment Governance & Performance plays a pivotal role in shaping our global retail footprint. In this role you will be responsible for optimizing and controlling all Pandora’s investments in store leases, acquisitions and other network actions. By owning and driving best practices in investment evaluation, you will help support the strategic growth and profitability through data-driven decision-making on our global store network.

You will work closely with the Franchise & Network Management Team as well as local property and network teams, delivering high-quality analysis and recommendations to drive strategic initiatives such as store openings, closures, relocations, Forward Integrations and lease renewals.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• 
Evaluate and Review Investment Proposals.

• 
Ensure the accuracy and completeness of all submitted investment proposals (IPs).

• 
Validate compliance with accounting standards, including IFRS16 regulations.

•

jobs.description:
We are looking for a student assistant who will be a member of the GRANDER research team and support key research tasks related to data management, analysis, and giving practical support to the research team.

GRANDER is a research program at the Department of Organization, Copenhagen Business School, studying the impact of large-scale philanthropic funding on organizations and their outcomes. The program is led by Associate Professor Jane Bjørn Vedel and runs until 2032.

We do ambitious research in an inspiring setup on an important societal topic, based on large qualitative data sets collected over many years.

The position offers first-hand insight into qualitative research at the highest level – a strong foundation for your further studies and your master’s thesis.

Tasks in the position

• Organizing our data and preparing raw data for analysis – e.g., receiving interviews and documents, transcribing, logging and archiving data

• Collecting archival data and background information

• Analyzing data – e.g., coding data in NVivo and Excel; creating evidence tables; developing timelines and models based on data

• Supporting literature reviews – e.g., performing Scopus searches, downloading and filing articles, and coding articles

• Supporting events and meetings, and other practical tasks

The position is 12 hours per week, mainly at CBS Kilen, and some flexibility in scheduling is required.

Requirements for experience/qualifications and personal skills

We value the following qualifications – you are:

• thorough, systematic and detail-oriented

• analytically strong, interested in both data and theory, and open to learning new methods

• team-oriented, helpful and flexible when needed

• able to handle confidential material with great care

• highly proficient in English, written and spoken

• enrolled in a relevant degree program in the social sciences

We offer a position in an inspiring research environment characterized by high ambition, passion for research and a willingness to go far to do excellent and impactful work. You will work closely with the project leader and the team, gain insight into how a large qualitative research project is run – from data collection to publication – and learn a lot along the way.

Salary and terms of employment

Employment takes place in accordance with the HK organisational agreement and the Collective Agreement between the Ministry of Finance and Publicly Employed Organisations (OAO-S Collective Agreement).

The salary currently ranges between DKK 145.73 and DKK 152.88 per hour and is dependent on previous employment in the office profession and level of education. The pension contribution amounts to 16% of the pensionable salary components.

It is a prerequisite for employment that you are an active student at a higher educational institution.

The employment is time-limited for the period from January 15, 2027, to June 30, 2028.

The recruitment process

Copenhagen Business School invites all qualified candidates to apply for the position. A recruitment committee will assess applications and call a selection of qualified candidates for an interview.

One of CBS' strategic goals is to promote diversity and inclusion in our organisation. Therefore, we strive for a hiring process that reduces potential bias. Consequently, we encourage applicants not to include photos or unnecessary information about personal circumstances in the application.

Additional information

If you want to know more about the job content, please contact Associate Professor Jane Bjørn Vedel, email: jbv.ioa@cbs.dk.

Your application

You apply for the position online, where you fill in the application form and attach your application with information about previous employment, exam papers and CV.

Interviews are expected to be held in the first half of December.

**Your impact begins here

**As Safety Surveillance Principal Specialist, you will be the safety lead for several products in Novo’s early pipeline, working where non-clinical and clinical development meet. You will turn emerging data into a clear early safety profile and shape decisions for first-in-human and early clinical studies. Your scientific judgement will help protect the people taking part in these studies and give development teams the clarity to move at pace.

**What You’ll Bring

**You are a scientist first. You are confident, outgoing and driven, and you want to be in the room where early safety decisions are made.

• A PhD, MD, DVM, MSc Pharm or equivalent in Medicine or Natural Sciences, with extensive experience in pharmacovigilance or early-phase pharmaceutical development.

• A solid understanding of drug development processes, global regulatory requirements and GxP standards.

• A strong grasp of medical concepts, disease mechanisms and scientific methodology. You use data to build scientific understanding, rather than letting the data lead you.

• The ability to identify challenges, shape strategies and turn them into clear, actionable steps.

• Confidence to take informed scientific risks and make a call, while never compromising on patient safety.

• Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to guide and influence others through mentorship and informal leadership.

• A self-driven, ethical and adaptable approach. You work independently, address issues proactively and stay flexible when priorities change.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Own the early safety profile of products, evaluating emerging pre-clinical and clinical safety data to guide patient surveillance and business decisions.

• Lead the resolution of complex safety challenges and provide strong scientific and medical input across development activities.

• Shape study designs, clinical protocols and benefit-risk assessments, working to ambitious development timelines.

• Chair a cross-functional drug safety committee and represent Safety Surveillance in key cross-functional teams.

• Drive initiatives that strengthen scientific, strategic and operational excellence within Safety Surveillance.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join Safety Surveillance Early Development, part of Global Patient Safety in Research & Development. It is a team of 8 colleagues in Denmark, and it handles all First Human Dose (FHD) studies across all indications at Novo. The team provides scientific safety expertise to early-stage projects, contributes to safety strategy and supports protocol review, risk assessments, early signal detection and cross-functional safety forums.

Your closest partners will be the non-clinical project manager, the medical specialist and the clinical pharmacologist. Together you will design studies that are scientifically strong and move quickly. You will also work with skilled colleagues across Non-clinical and Clinical Development, and across several therapeutic areas.

The environment is dynamic, collaborative and highly engaged. Colleagues share scientific insights, speak openly and support one another when evaluating complex safety data. Everyone is focused on doing what is best for the people we serve.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will have real ownership. As safety lead, you will be trusted to work independently, make your voice heard and influence decisions that guide early development. You will keep learning from colleagues across Non-clinical and Clinical Development, and you will help strengthen a culture of knowledge sharing and openness in the team.

• have deep expertise in European power markets and significant experience forming an independent view of how fundamental developments affect power prices and market dynamics

• bring strong commercial judgement and can move confidently from fundamental analysis to clear recommendations on trading, hedging, portfolio, and PPA decisions

• understand the interaction between physical power market fundamentals, forward markets, options, and curve dynamics, and can connect changes in the physical market with their commercial and trading implications

• are comfortable owning a market view, challenging established assumptions, and acting as an equal sparring partner to experienced traders and senior decision-makers

At Novicell, we help companies unlock their full digital potential. **We imagine you bring:

**

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

• The ability to build strong relationships and inspire trust with clients and colleagues alike.

**What We Offer

**At Novicell, you will step into an ambitious and professional environment where you can make a real impact. As Senior Management Consultant, you will report directly to our Consulting Director and play a central role in advising some of the most exciting brands in Denmark and abroad.

**We offer:

**

• Excellent opportunities for professional and personal growth.

• Inspiring colleagues who bring expertise and ambition to every collaboration.

• A collaborative culture built on our motto “Flink & Flittig” – professionalism, helpfulness, and dedication in everything we do.

**Life at Novicell

**At Novicell, we believe job satisfaction and dedication go hand in hand. Our motto “Flink & Flittig” reflects our core values of professionalism and collaboration. We value openness, trust, and shared responsibility over rigid rules. We believe that joy at work is the key to motivation, creativity, and strong teamwork.

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager, Global Clinical Drug Supply
jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

Genmab is seeking an experienced (Senior) Clinical Drug Supply Manager to join Global Clinical Drug Supply (GCDS) Manufacturing in Copenhagen.

The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality clinical trial supplies for both early and late-stage trials. In addition, this position offers significant influence over the refinement of Genmab’s processes, both within the GCDS Manufacturing function and cross-functionally to ensure scalability.

The (Senior) Clinical Drug Supply Manager will resolve complex operational challenges, lead strategic initiatives and mentor colleagues. A key focus of this role will be supporting team members through troubleshooting, problem-solving, and developing mitigation plans for complex issues related to packaging and labelling activities. This role requires balancing urgency and importance in a dynamic environment while serving as a positive role model for the team, by bringing a strong can-do attitude to drive solutions and inspire others.

The position reports to the Associate Director, Team Lead, Global Clinical Drug Supply Manufacturing based in Princeton.

**Responsibilities

**Responsibilities will be adjusted based on level of experience, and may include the following:

• Manage operational trial and project objectives related to packaging and labelling, providing proactive oversight to meet goals.

• Oversee inspection readiness and ensure compliance with relevant GMP, GDP and GCP regulations.

• Engage with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment and successful collaboration.

• Supervise and monitor vendor performance, ensuring delivery aligns with timelines and SOW.

• Provide direct support to team members in troubleshooting and problem resolution, ensuring effective development of mitigation plans for operational challenges.

• Mentor and coach team members, fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment.

• Lead complex GCDS Manufacturing projects within the area of clinical drug supply management.

• Develop, maintain and implement SOPs for drug supply processes and manage cross-functional collaborations.

**Qualifications

**

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant area (e.g., pharma, science, engineering, or supply chain management).

• Minimum 3 years of experience at manager level, and minimum 6+ years’ experience for Senior Manager. Ideally demonstrated skills with global CMO vendor collaboration and oversight of clinical packaging and labelling activities.

• Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects with an innovative and entrepreneurial mindset.

• Collaborative, proactive, and goal-oriented team player who inspires colleagues while fostering strong relationships.

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

• Extensive knowledge of GMP, GDP, and GCP regulations.

• Excellent communication skills in English, both oral and written.

**The Team

**You will join a highly competent team focused on packaging and labelling clinical trial supplies, collaborating closely with the Global Clinical Drug Supply Execution team. Together with the Global Clinical Drug Supply Systems team and Global Clinical Drug Supply Strategy team, these four functions form the Global Clinical Drug Supply department. We foster a supportive, international, and fast-paced work environment centered on collaboration, excellence, and a can-do attitude to achieve results.

**Application

**If this opportunity excites you, we encourage you to upload your CV and cover letter outlining your motivation for the position. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and interviews will be scheduled accordingly. Please note, fully remote applicants will not be considered; candidates must be within commuting distance of Copenhagen.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK687.888,00---1.031.832,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

**In this Director of Legal role, you’ll be…

**

• Serving as the legal partner to Sales by driving commercial SaaS contracting, handling T&Cs, MSAs, and DPAs, negotiating deviations, and maintaining fallback negotiation playbooks.

• Managing corporate legal matters, including entity management across international markets, governance, board support, and selective coordination with external counsel.

• Supporting the company's compliance framework in close partnership with our existing Compliance function, with a path toward taking over internal compliance ownership in the near future.

• Owning vendor and supplier contracting by reviewing and negotiating key terms on liability, security, privacy, and SLAs alongside Finance and Operations.

• Building and scaling a lean legal operating model by proactively driving processes, internal guidance, and review triggers to keep legal operations efficient.

• Supporting fundraising rounds, corporate structuring, and M&A initiatives in close collaboration with the CFO and leadership team.

**Who is the Legal Team?

**Sitting within Finance & Operations, the Legal function drives our overall legal direction while remaining hands-on in building a scalable framework that supports our rapid growth across European markets. We safeguard the company across commercial SaaS contracting, corporate law, international scaling, and vendor management, while supporting future fundraising and M&A activities.

We act as a close partner to executive stakeholders, Sales, Finance, and Security, balancing fast risk-reward decisions with robust corporate governance. You will work directly with the Chief Financial Officer and lead our Corporate Lawyer in an environment that values extreme ownership, pragmatic decision-making, and strong cross-functional collaboration to enable business velocity.

Essentially, we contribute to our vision by protecting the business and providing the legal backbone needed to scale our platform across international markets safely and efficiently.

**What you’ll bring:

**

• Ideally, +5-10 years of relevant legal experience in a similar role, with proven exposure to a fast-growing SaaS environment that has scaled internationally.

• A hands-on, autonomous mindset with the drive to take full ownership of the legal function and scale it from the current setup.

• Strong expertise in commercial SaaS contracting and negotiating client-facing terms.

• GDPR and data privacy expertise, with experience maintaining compliance frameworks.

• Experience with corporate law and governance (board and shareholder matters, entity management), plus exposure to fundraising and M&A processes alongside external counsel.

• A pragmatic, business-oriented mindset with a strong grasp of risk-reward balance to keep sales velocity high while protecting the business.

• Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with fluency in English (Danish is not a requirement).

**What do we offer you?

**

• A starting salary of 115,000 DKK per month. As you grow within this role, your compensation can grow with you up to 130,000 DKK per month.

• Continuous development through a clear and transparent framework, so you always know what the next step looks like through bi-annual growth talks and regular check-ins.

• Thorough pre- and onboarding to set you up for success.

• An office-first culture in a centrally located office near Kødbyen, along with visa and relocation support if needed.

• A culture of ownership, trust, and independence with the support you need.

• A strong team spirit where we celebrate wins and enjoy time together across offices.

• Our annual Global Summit, where the whole company meets and connects.

**Our recruitment process

**

• 30-minute online interview with our Talent Acquisition Partner

• 30-minute online interview with our CFO

• Completion of Personality Assessment & Case Presentation

• 60-minute in-person final case interview with our CFO & other relevant stakeholders

• Cultural interview with relevant stakeholders across the organisation

**About Formalize

**Formalize is a tech company founded in 2021 with offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Milan, Madrid, Munich & Paris. Currently, we are a team of +200 people from +30 nationalities operating in multiple European markets and are one of the fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups. We thrive on ambition, deliver impact through pragmatism, and embrace passion and honesty. We celebrate our wins, learn from our mistakes, and grow together as a team.

Our journey began within the whistleblowing compliance sector, highlighted by the award-winning Whistleblower Software by Formalize, laying the foundation for our success story. Now, we have extended our expertise to a larger compliance universe, including data compliance, risk, and privacy. Our Formalize product helps companies to effortlessly navigate and stay ahead in the ever-changing landscape of compliance. Our platform adapts to regulatory changes, continuously adapting to meet and foresee the evolving needs of our users, ensuring businesses remain compliant and confident in their operations.

Still curious? Read more about us here: About Formalize.

****Ready to apply?

****We will hold interviews and hire on an ongoing basis. For more information or questions, please contact the responsible recruiter in the Talent Acquisition team. Apply now with your resume and other relevant information through our Career Page. We look forward to seeing your application!

Do you want to be a valued part of the critical infrastructure that serves communities across Europe and beyond? Are you looking for an opportunity where you can make an impact, shape decisions, and accelerate your career?

If so, we are looking for dedicated, curious, and highly motivated graduates to join the DFDS Graduate Programme starting in September 2027.

Be part of the movement - and play your part.  **About The Finance Graduate Programme

**The DFDS Graduate Programme is a two-year fast-track programme for recent graduates with an interest in and passion for the maritime industry. With several acquisitions and continued growth across Europe, our Finance Division plays a key role in supporting business performance, driving strategic decision-making, and enabling sustainable growth across DFDS.

During the programme, you will complete three rotations across different areas of our Finance Division. You will begin at our headquarters in Copenhagen, followed by a mandatory international rotation at one of our European hubs. Your final rotation at our headquarters (HQ) will be tailored to your skills, interests, and our business needs.

Throughout the programme, you will gain broad exposure to both the business partnering and HQ functions of our Finance Division while building valuable industry knowledge and professional experience.

**Finance at DFDS

**Finance is at the heart of supporting our business and helping DFDS make informed decisions across our shipping and logistics operations.

**Examples Of Interesting Tasks Could Be

**

• Support business performance analysis and partner with stakeholders across functions and markets.

• Contribute to forecasting and planning processes, helping identify opportunities and areas requiring further analysis.

• Work with financial reporting, consolidation, accounting, and performance management.

• Develop KPI reporting and management insights to support business decisions.

• Deliver analyses and recommendations to management, highlighting performance trends, risks, and opportunities.

• Gain exposure to strategic projects, investments, and initiatives supporting the continued growth of DFDS.

Across all rotations, you will work closely with highly skilled colleagues and collaborate with teams across our business units, group functions, and senior leadership. To support your development, each rotation will include both a dedicated manager and a mentor who will help you successfully navigate your learning journey.

**About You

**At DFDS, we believe the strongest teams are built on diversity, inclusion, and different perspectives. We are looking for candidates who:

• Have graduated from a relevant master’s degree by the start of the Graduate Programme in September 2027.

• Have gained relevant experience through a student job, internship, exchange programme, or other extracurricular activities.

• Have no more than two years of full-time professional experience after completing your master's degree.

• Demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Are collaborative team players who enjoy working with others and creating impact.

• Are curious, proactive, and eager to learn and develop professionally.

• Have an international mindset and are excited about working across cultures and locations.

Working at DFDS **Join the movement and grow with us.

**As part of the DFDS Graduate Programme, you will become part of a strong graduate network across the company and build valuable connections across our international business. We offer a steep learning curve, meaningful responsibility from day one, and three interesting rotations designed to accelerate your professional development.

Are we a match? Apply now.  If your skills, experience, aspirations, and personality match this opportunity, we would love to hear from you.

Please Apply By Uploading Your CV No Later Than 30 November 2026. When Applying, You’re Also Asked To Answer The Following Questions

• Why are you interested in joining the DFDS Graduate Programme?

• How will the programme help kickstart your career?

• How do you expect to contribute to the programme and DFDS?

• What do you believe will be your biggest challenge(s) during the programme?

**We look forward to hearing from you.

**Visit our Graduate site here to learn more and meet some of our people.

jobs.occupation: Manager - Business Advisory and Project Management
jobs.description:
Drive meaningful impact across the life sciences industry.

As our next Manager - Business Advisory and Project Management, you will contribute to solving meaningful challenges across the life sciences industry. We offer specialised management consulting services, working with top-tier life sciences companies as well as biotech startups -locally and globally. From strategy development to hands-on implementation, we support our clients were impact matters most.

About the role

As a Manager - Business Advisory and Project Management, you will work closely with clients and colleagues to address complex challenges across the life sciences value chain. You will take ownership of your work and contribute to delivering solutions that create real, lasting impact. This is a Senior role designed to provide project and program leadership to deliver strategic technical solutions that address complex client issues in the Life Sciences industry. You will be handling implementation/migration projects and programs to achieve desired outcomes and ensure successful business growth. You will also seek new business opportunities to help BASE life science grow its presence within existing and new customers.

Additionally, you will contribute to internal initiatives and training to further strengthen BASE life science’s project and program management methodologies, approach, and tools.

You will lead teams consisting of multiple workstreams, which could include BASE/Infosys, external third party, or client stakeholders. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in, project/program management and the ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications.

Your responsibilities include:

• Developing responses to Requests for Proposals (RfPs), ensuring adequate planning for scope, timelines and budget

• Monitoring project/program status including milestones, risks, issues, budgets, etc.

• Acting as a delivery escalation point and proactively ensuring escalations are handled promptly with a clear action and communication plan.

• Creating and delivering tailored communication based on audience, i.e., executive level summaries for client stakeholders, or senior executives in BASE life science, status reports at a project or program-level at a suitable cadence for team members

• Intervening, when necessary, to ensure costs, timelines and quality are on track.

• Lead a cross-functional team to deliver projects/programs to the required scope, on time, within budget, and to the satisfaction of our life science industry stakeholders.

• Collaborate with business stakeholders in the life science industry to understand their needs and translate them into executable plans for the project team.

• Develop plans, timelines, and budgets for projects/programs for which you are responsible.

• Track and report on project/program progress, identifying and mitigating risks as needed.

• Facilitate communication and collaboration between the project team, life science industry stakeholders, and other teams within BASE life science.

You bring:

• 5+ years of experience as a technical project/program manager within Regulatory, Clinical, Quality or other GxP areas in the life science industry.

• Successful track record of managing technically complex projects/programs such as software development, implementation of IT systems, data migrations, etc.

• Experience leading technical teams and delivering data driven projects/programs.

• Experience with project management tools such as JIRA, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project etc.

• Experience with Agile project management methodologies such as SAFe.

• Strong communication skills, both in writing, meetings and in presentations.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

Additionally, the ideal candidate has the following skills/certifications:

• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification

• Experience selling either projects or products to clients.

• Experience working with Veeva Vault, SalesForce or similar technologies.

• Experience working with AI professionally

This position is offered in Denmark and Spain.

Who is BASE life science?

Founded in 2015, BASE life science is a business and technology consulting company working exclusively in life sciences, built on a simple purpose: grow our people, and deliver real impact for our customers.

We don't think AI is a feature you bolt onto existing systems — we think it's the layer through which a life sciences company's strategy actually gets executed, end to end. Most of the industry is still proving AI can do one task at a time, function by function, pilot by pilot. We're building toward something bigger: AI that runs across clinical, regulatory, quality, and commercial work instead of stopping at the edges of a single application.

With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Spain, Switzerland, the UK, Germany, France, Italy, and the US, we work with top-10 pharma and ambitious biotechs alike, and with technology partners including Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Google, AWS, Microsoft, and Amass — turning that belief into deployed, compliant, sellable solutions, not slideware.

Why join BASE Life Science?

At BASE, you work on meaningful, complex challenges at the intersection of technology, science, and business. We trust our people with real responsibility and support them in turning ambition into impact — grounded in five core values: team spirit, trust, openness, ambition, and execution.

• Ambition, encouraged through ownership and continuous learning.

• Execution — we focus on delivering solutions that work in practice.

• Openness — your ideas are heard, challenged constructively, and supported as you grow.

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance.

• The opportunity to shape a practice, not just staff one.

Alongside this, we offer:

• Support for health and wellbeing, covering physical, mental, and social needs

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance

• Ongoing learning and professional development throughout your career

• A modern work setup, with the tools and equipment needed to do great work

• Recognition of performance and impact, linked to contribution and results

• The opportunity to work on challenges that make a meaningful difference for patients and healthcare systems worldwide

Explore our work, values, and people at www.baselifescience.com

Interested?

If you find this position intriguing, don't delay—submit your application in English at your earliest convenience. We are continuously reviewing and assessing all incoming candidates and eagerly await your application.

At BASE Life Science, we value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Employment decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs

**Your new position

**As Associate QA Manager in Quality Systems, you will take over day-to-day ownership of core QA processes during a 12-month maternity cover. You will keep the processes running, improve them where it makes a difference, and represent them in audits and inspections. You will work closely with colleagues across the company, and the position reports to the Head of Quality Systems.

**We Offer Exciting Responsibilities

**

• Own and continuously improve core QA processes, e.g. Change Control, Deviation and CAPA

• Ensure that our regulatory intelligence process is running

• Train colleagues in QA processes, locally and globally

• Assist in continued implementation of the Zealand Pharma process landscape

• Represent QA processes in audits and inspections

• Define and communicate requirements to IT for our electronic QMS

• Review and approve new and updated SOPs and contribute to the Quality Management Review process

**Your profile

**You are structured and pragmatic, and you turn requirements into solutions that are easy to follow in practice. You work independently while being a motivated team player who drives results with a quality-first mindset.

• MSc or equivalent in a relevant field

• QA experience, preferably within pharmaceutical quality systems

• Experience presenting and defending quality processes to stakeholders, auditors or inspectors

• Ability to translate regulatory and GxP requirements into practical process solutions

• Familiarity with Veeva Vault (our EDMS/QMS) is a plus

**Your new team

**You will join the Quality Systems team, a group of 9 specialists focused on maintaining and improving the Zealand Pharma QMS across all GxP areas. We are part of the QA organization, and we hold process ownership of key QA functions, including Change Control, Deviation, CAPA, Document & Records Management, Training and Inspection Handling.

**Let’s bond and be bold

**We have a unique culture, characterized by excellent teamwork and strong engagement across the organization. And we want you to help us strengthen this culture.

Making bonds is at the core of everything we do. From discovering and developing the best new peptide drugs for patients, to engaging with our partners or connecting with each other. We bond through curiosity and playfulness as a team, allowing ourselves to challenge common thinking and drive future innovation. Join us and let’s bond and be bold.

Interested in bonding with us? Then please apply no later than 22 November, 2026, or as soon as possible. The applications will be reviewed as they come in. While a cover letter is not required, please include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

For further information, please contact Head of Quality Systems, Kamilla Vagtborg: KVagtborg@zealandpharma.com.

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and welcome applications from all job applicants.

**About Zealand Pharma A/S

**Zealand Pharma A/S (Nasdaq: ZEAL) is a biotechnology company focused on advancing medicines for obesity and metabolic health. Combining more than 25 years of peptide R&D expertise with a proprietary data platform that leverages advanced data-driven and AI/ML approaches, Zealand Pharma aims to lead a new era in obesity and metabolic health. To date, more than ten Zealand Pharma-invented drug candidates have entered clinical development, of which two products have reached the market and three candidates are in late-stage development. Founded in 1998, Zealand Pharma is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, with a U.S. presence in Boston, Massachusetts. Learn more at www.zealandpharma.com.
