Stibo DX is the company behind Cue, our multimedia enterprise platform used by media organizations around the world to create, manage, and deliver content across digital and print channels.

As Cue evolves from self-hosted and hybrid deployments towards a standardized, cloud-native SaaS platform, the way our platform connects, exchanges data, and governs information is becoming increasingly important. Creating greater consistency across APIs, integrations, events, schemas, and data ownership is therefore one of our key architectural priorities.

As our Senior Integration & Data Architect, you will take ownership of shaping a more unified, governed, and decoupled integration and data architecture across Cue. You will help us tackle fragmentation and inconsistency across the platform and establish clear architectural patterns that enable our product and engineering teams to build and evolve solutions with greater speed and confidence.

This is very much a hands-on architecture role. You will not simply define principles and governance from a distance. You will work directly with teams on real designs, APIs, event contracts, integrations, schemas, and data domains, helping translate architectural direction into solutions that work in practice. You will work with modern architectural approaches and technologies such as API-first design, GraphQL/REST, Kafka, CDC, schema evolution, and multi-tenant SaaS.

You will become part of a small, but senior architecture team with significant autonomy, visibility, and responsibility. Working closely with our Platform Architect, who focuses on runtime, multi-tenancy, and observability, and our Senior Software Architect, who focuses on domain boundaries and solution design, you will have the opportunity to influence how the entire Cue platform develops as we continue our SaaS transformation.

You will report to the Director of Solution Architecture, and you will work within an architecture governance model keeping decisions close to the teams, while applying the right level of architectural guidance based on risk. The role can be based at any of our offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Oslo, Málaga, or Hamburg, depending on where you are located.

Key responsibilities

• Define and govern the unified API strategy for CUE (REST and GraphQL), design standards, versioning, deprecation, breaking-change discipline, and consistency across teams.

• Design integration patterns for a modular, microservices-based platform, sync vs async, anti-corruption layers, adapters, and migration from bespoke customer integrations to standardized platform interfaces; guide teams on when to use events vs APIs and how to avoid tight coupling.

• Own event-driven architecture on Kafka, topic design, event contracts, schema evolution, CDC/streaming, and consistency models (ordering, idempotency, replay).

• Establish data domains and governance, ownership models, schema definition and evolution, metadata, lineage, quality, classification, retention, and compliance readiness.

• Align contracts with domain boundaries, connect bounded contexts, domain events, and service ownership to API, event, and data design, in close collaboration with the Software Architect.

• Enable teams through architecture leadership, produce reference architectures and integration blueprints, shepherd ADRs, review high-risk designs, and coach teams on better patterns without blocking delivery.

• Reduce fragmentation and drive consolidation, identify one-off approaches early and steer teams toward reusable platform standards.

• Partner across architecture and delivery, work with platform, product, and engineering teams to ensure standards are usable, adopted, and durable.

What you will bring

You are someone who naturally takes ownership and looks beyond individual solutions to understand what is best for the platform as a whole. You notice fragmentation, inconsistencies, and emerging risks, and you are proactive in bringing people together to find practical ways forward.

You are comfortable working across engineering, architecture, and product, and you know how to turn complex integration and data topics into clear, pragmatic decisions that teams can actually work with. You build credibility through your expertise, but also through collaboration, listening, and an understanding that strong architecture needs to support delivery rather than slow it down.

You believe in strong standards where they matter, while taking a pragmatic, risk-based approach to governance. You are curious and adaptable, care about quality and maintainability, and are motivated by creating clarity around contracts, data ownership, and architectural boundaries. Ultimately, you enjoy bringing coherence to complex platforms and leaving them in a better architectural state than you found them.

Experience

• 10+ years in software engineering, integration engineering, data engineering, or architecture, with 5+ years in a senior role focused on integration, APIs, events, and/or data architecture.

• Proven experience designing and governing APIs in large, distributed, multi-team environments.

• Strong experience with REST and GraphQL API design, versioning, and contract-first approaches.

• Hands-on experience with event-driven architecture in production, preferably Kafka.

• Experience with integration patterns: messaging, pub/sub, request/reply, outbox, saga/process manager, and CDC.

• Strong understanding of schema modeling and schema evolution for APIs and events.

• Experience defining data domains, ownership models, and data governance in a product or platform context.

• Ability to connect Domain-Driven Design (DDD) concepts (bounded contexts, domain events, aggregates) to integration and data design.

• Understanding of AWS, Kubernetes-based platforms, and multi-tenant SaaS implications for data isolation and integration boundaries.

• Security-aware design across APIs and events, authentication, authorization, zero-trust principles.

Interested?

Please apply here on LinkedIn. You are encouraged to apply at your earliest convenience. Short-listed candidates will be invited for an interview. Applications are processed as they are received until the right candidate is found.

Should you have questions about the position, you are also welcome to contact Director, Safdar Aqeel via mail safs@stibodx.com. We look forward to hearing from you.

Company Description

Do you enjoy turning financial insight into commercial impact? Join Deloitte’s Nordic Sales Excellence Team to develop compelling pricing strategies and commercial solutions that deliver value for clients and strengthen profitability. This is an exciting opportunity to help increase the win rate and shape commercial decisions for Deloitte’s largest and most important deals.

About us

With more than 8,000 employees, Deloitte is one of the largest professional services firms across the Nordics. We help clients navigate complex business and technology transformations by combining deep industry expertise with leading capabilities in Audit, Tax, Advisory, and Consulting.

Join our diverse Nordic Technology & Transformation Sales Excellence team and help shape Deloitte’s most strategic pursuits. The team helps win deals and improve profitability through compelling pricing and commercial propositions for our clients. We provide expert advice on all commercial aspects of client proposals, focusing primarily on higher-value, more complex deals and Deloitte’s most important Nordic clients.

This role can be placed either in Copenhagen, Denmark or in Oslo, Norway.

Job Description

What will be your role?

We aim to become the largest professional services firm in the Nordics by continuously innovating, evolving and adapting to meet clients’ needs. To achieve this, we need to strengthen our commercial expertise to support our most complex deals, to our most important clients. You will play a key role in our Nordic Sales Excellence team, and your worksite is therefore flexible within the Nordics.

As our Commercial and Pricing Specialist, your role will be to structure and shape commercial solutions to respond to our client’s requirements and challenges and to help win business and improve profitability. You will work closely with the rest of the Nordic Sales Excellence Team and the stakeholders for our major Nordic accounts to shape commercial arrangements.

The core responsibilities of your role include:

• Shape commercial solutions for complex opportunities, bringing together clients’ needs, pricing options and commercial considerations into compelling proposals

• Develop pricing strategies and structures that demonstrate value to clients and improve our ability to win work

• Build and challenge deal economics through financial modelling, testing margins, assumptions, pricing scenarios and commercial risks

• Partner with proposal teams to design and implement commercial strategies that grow revenue and strengthen profitability

• Advance value-based pricing by helping pursuit teams identify and quantify expected clients’ outcomes, then translate them into appropriate pricing models

• Support proposals and negotiations by clearly articulating the pricing structure and commercial assumptions, and advising on terms and trade-offs

• Build commercial capability across the Nordics through practical guidance, training, knowledge sharing and improvements to the various tools and ways of working

Qualifications

Who are we looking for?

You are a commercially minded professional with strong analytical and modelling skills, together with good business acumen. We are looking for a team player with a collegiate style who enjoys working, collaborating and having fun with team-mates.

We imagine that you have:

• A minimum of 5 years’ experience in pricing, commercial finance, deal shaping or a related commercial role; professional-services experience is an advantage

• A strong financial modelling and Excel skills, with the ability to turn analysis into clear recommendations

• Experience with leveraging AI applications in commercial work, with the judgement to evaluate outputs

• Confidence working with senior stakeholders and collaborating across functions and countries

• Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain pricing choices and commercial terms

• It would be desirable, but not essential, to have professional services experience and insights, ideally having worked within a consulting or professional service organisation

• Flexibility to meet peaks of work inherent in the cycle of a deal

• Proficient in written and spoken English. Knowledge of another Scandinavian language is a benefit

Work permit: We are only able to consider applicants with a valid work permit in Denmark/Norway.

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

What impact will your role make?

Every day, your work will make an impact that matters, while you thrive in a dynamic culture of inclusion, collaboration and high performance. We do not just aspire to make solutions. We wish to create an impact that makes a positive and crucial difference for the people around us, our clients and our society. Deloitte is where you’ll find unlimited opportunities to succeed and realize your full potential.

jobs.occupation: Senior Data Engineer – Build the Data Foundation for Greener Rail
jobs.description:
Cubris · A Hitachi Rail company · Ballerup, Denmark · On-site with flexibility

Would you like to use your expertise in Python, geospatial data and data platforms to make rail operations smarter and more energy-efficient? At Cubris, you will play a central role in developing the data foundation behind solutions that help train operators reduce energy consumption and improve punctuality.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer who enjoys shaping technical direction, building solutions and working closely with colleagues across engineering, architecture and product.

Your role

You will help shape the data platform and geospatial model supporting our GreenSpeed® platform and Infrastructure Management System. You will turn complex railway data into a consistent, reliable foundation for our software – covering everything from tracks, signals and stations to gradients, speed limits and temporary restrictions.

Your main responsibilities will be to:

• 
Develop our data platform and geospatial model: Define schemas, feature classes, linear referencing using track and chainage, topology rules and railway asset attributes.

• 
Build robust Python data pipelines: Ingest, transform and integrate data, and automate workflows using Airflow or similar orchestration tools.

• 
Develop spatial storage and cloud solutions: Work with PostgreSQL/PostGIS or equivalent technologies, preferably on Microsoft Azure, and apply graph-based structures where they add value.

• 
Ensure data quality and traceability: Validate geometries, topology and attributes, and document data models and workflows with appropriate versioning and change control.

• 
Translate requirements into practical solutions: Collaborate with architects, software engineers, product managers and DevOps to deliver solutions that meet today’s needs and evolve with our products.

What you bring

You have substantial hands-on experience in data platform development and architecture, and you enjoy both making technical decisions and implementing them.

We are particularly interested in your:

• 
Strong Python skills and experience with scalable data pipelines, data integration and orchestration tools such as Airflow.

• 
Experience with GeoPandas, Shapely, GDAL/OGR, PyProj or equivalent geospatial technologies, including LineString and MultiLineString geometries.

• 
Knowledge of PostgreSQL/PostGIS or other spatial databases.

• 
Experience developing cloud-native data solutions, preferably on Microsoft Azure.

• 
Ability to work independently when requirements are evolving and documentation is still taking shape.

We also welcome a strong engineering grounding in industrial systems. You may have developed this through your education or through experience in transport, manufacturing, energy or automation. You understand how software, data and physical infrastructure interact, and how to translate real-world assets and operating conditions into accurate data models. You also appreciate the demands for quality, reliability and traceability in systems used in daily operations.

Experience with QGIS or ArcGIS, graph-based data structures and algorithms, safety-critical systems, railway technology or EBuLa integration would be an advantage.

As a colleague, you share your knowledge, contribute ideas and enjoy solving problems with others. You can balance long-term technical quality with practical delivery.

Why join Cubris?

You will have a real say in technical decisions and product development in a company where ideas can quickly become action. Our flat, agile organisation encourages open dialogue and gives you room to take ownership.

You will join a small, autonomous team backed by Hitachi Rail’s international expertise and resources. Your work will serve a clear purpose: smarter rail operations with lower energy consumption and CO₂ emissions.

The role is based in Ballerup, Denmark. We value close collaboration in the office while offering flexibility.

About Cubris

Cubris is a Danish software company and has been part of Hitachi Rail since 2024. Our award-winning GreenSpeed® platform helps train operators optimise driving, reduce energy consumption and improve punctuality. We develop technology for Driver Advisory Systems (DAS), Automatic Train Operation (ATO) and advanced data analytics.

Interested in joining us?

We would love to hear about your experience, your ideas and what motivates you. Send us your application and CV, or get in touch if you would like to learn more about the role and life at Cubris.

jobs.occupation: Optical Design Engineers for our High Power Beam Combining team
jobs.description:
Optical Design Engineers for our High Power Beam Combining team

Location: Farum, Denmark | Level: PhD / Postdoc / Experienced Engineer

The Mission: Build the Next Generation of SBC Systems

At Ibsen Photonics, we are developing Spectral Beam Combining (SBC) modules for high-power laser architectures. We are looking for creative, hands-on Optical Design Engineers to take full ownership of designing, building, and optimising our SBC platform.

This role bridges the gap between theoretical physics and industrial reality. You won’t just design on a screen; you will spend significant time in the lab, iterating rapidly from proof-of-concept to robust, production-ready, scalable systems.

Key responsibilities:

• Design & Assemble: Develop compact, efficient SBC modules using Ibsen’s world-class transmission gratings, while considering optical beam paths, thermal effects and mechanical constraints.

• System Optimisation: Drive performance by refining optical alignment, mechanical stability, and complex thermal management for high-power loads in a reiterative process: design – experiment – optimise.

• Characterisation: Use advanced diagnostics to maintain beam quality (low M²) during power scaling, including wavefront sensing and spectral analysis.

• Full Lifecycle Ownership: Source optical/mechanical components and manage the transition from experimental prototypes to scalable, volume-ready designs.

• Global Collaboration: Work closely with an internal team and international partners, including potential overseas visits for joint prototyping and testing.

What you bring

You are a proactive problem-solver who thrives in a “build-test-learn” environment. Ideally, you possess:

• Education: A PhD or Postdoc in Optics, Photonics, Laser Physics, or a related field.

• Expertise:

• Hands on experience with (high-power) fibre and free-space optical systems, precise alignment, and experimental troubleshooting.

• Understanding of (and ideally experience with) SBC and CBC beam combining techniques.

• Beam quality measurement and analysis.

• Mechanical design of low-tolerance devices

• Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Gaussian optics, beam propagation, and high-power laser effects (thermal lensing, runaway-effects, mitigation strategies).

• Software Skills: Proficiency in optical simulation tools (e.g., Zemax) and familiarity with mechanical CAD.

• Mindset: Independent enough to drive a project and work on your own, but collaborative enough to thrive in a flat-hierarchy, cross-functional team, sharing insights and discussing projects/next steps. The role is highly experimental and hands-on, requiring independence and a strong drive to make systems work in practice, not just on paper.

• Security Clearance: You are a European citizen with no family ties to Russia or Russian allied territories, and you have a clean criminal record.

Why join Ibsen Photonics?

• High Impact: Your designs will directly shape the future of high-brightness laser systems for manufacturing, defence, telecommunications, and science.

• Freedom to Innovate: We value experimental drive—if you have a better way to align or stabilise a system, we want to see it.

• Danish Engineering Culture: Enjoy a supportive environment with fast decision-making, real ownership, and a healthy work-life balance.

We are looking to recruit as soon as possible but will keep the positions open until we have found the right candidates. • Working closely with 3 other members of the MCS team and with the customer. You will be at our customer’s site in Hillerød 2-3 days per week and in our Virum office the rest of the time.

• Delivering software according to internal and customer procedures. We will train you in our Quality Management System, GxP and compliance.

• Using AI tools for software development.

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Motivated by working with colleagues and customers towards shared goals

• Responsible for progressing your assignments and following through to completion

• A quick learner and a good problem-solver

• Organised in your work and committed to following established processes

• Communicating openly and proactively with colleagues and customers

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• Master's or bachelor's degree in software engineering or similar degree

• 5+ years of experience in software development

• 5+ years of experience with Oracle Database, Oracle SQL and PL/SQL, Oracle Forms/Reports

• Experience with AI-assisted software development

• You speak and write English fluently

• Experience in some of the following is an advantage: Agile software development, XML, Linux, SAP, interface technologies

• Experience in the pharmaceutical industry, including GxP, is an advantage but not a requirement

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 30th November 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Peter Møller at +45 3075 5186.

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

jobs.occupation: Senior Product Development Manager (Maternity Leave Cover, 6-12 months)
jobs.description:
**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the teams by creating or helping create great guest experiences, and use every day as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer or staff member; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of people who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You'll learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path—our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

****Full-time

****Maternity leave cover: January - June 2027

**As Senior Product Development Manager, you'll be the senior product voice in the Menu & Innovation team, owning our highest priority global NPD projects and the systems, standards and ways of working that sit behind every product we launch. Based at our Global HQ in Copenhagen, you'll work closely with Brand, Marketing, Operations, Technical, Franchise partners, Supply Chain and our supplier partners to make sure JOE products are consistently great in every market. This is a lead role in the menu & product team: you'll set the direction for how we develop, test and approve products worldwide, coach the wider team, and help shape how the team grows and operates globally. You'll have real scope to define the future of our global menu, always keeping juicer ease at the heart.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Drive end-to-end ownership of high priority global NPD projects, including new categories, new occasions and growth platforms, from brief through to in-store launch.

• Lead on all global NPD systems and processes, defining and continuously optimising them as JOE scales.

• Define and own the JOE global product testing framework and approach for all products, from scale-up kitchen trials to product operational testing to global scale commercial consumer testing.

• Lead on future NPD team growth strategies and the expansion of our global operating model.

• Own all core EPD quality workstreams across defined products and categories.

• Own all product and ingredient standards, making sure the JOE quality bar is upheld globally.

• Lead high functioning cross-functional project teams; with all global teams and local markets, from Operations and Marketing to Franchise and Supply Chain.

• Champion best-in-class trend diagnosis, coaching the wider team on how to diagnosis, read & interpret trends, in a Joe way, and run sharp competitor reviews to keep a finger on the pulse.

• Partner with all key suppliers, owning strong relationship management and engagement across current and new suppliers for current and future projects.

• Maintain and nurture a tightly connected global product network across equity and franchise; now and as it scales, so opportunities are identified, shared and recognised and everyone stays aligned.

• Key point of contact for our franchise team (current and new) on all product activity beyond equity stores; ensuring global brand consistency whilst driving local relevancy

**WHO YOU ARE

**

• A defining ability to translate concepts into scalable, operationally sound recipes without losing sight of brand and quality standards.

• Excellent project management skills and experience

• Senior stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across functions, markets and franchise partners.

• Experience coaching and developing others

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• Min. 8 years' experience in corporate product development, ideally within QSR (Quick Service Restaurant), with a track record of owning global or multi-market launches.

• Proven experience building or improving NPD systems, processes and testing frameworks, including scale-up, operational and consumer testing.

• Deep familiarity with stage-gate or gate approval governance.

• Strong supplier management skills, with experience owning relationships across a global supply base.

• Fluent in English - other languages are a bonus!

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 130 friendly faces come together!

• Enjoy our fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Join us for our lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars-there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

• Stay fit and healthy with our well-equipped fitness facilities, complete with showers and a relaxing steam room to refresh after your workouts.

Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

**ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

jobs.occupation: Associate Consumer Finance & Online Partnerships Director
jobs.description:
**Your impact begins here

**As Associate Consumer Finance & Online Partnerships Director, you will build the financial foundation for how Novo grows online partnerships in Obesity across Europe and Canada (EUCAN). This is a newly created role: you will set up a European customer profit and loss view and a clear business case approach, so teams know where to invest and can track the return. You will turn complex analysis into decisions that help more people reach treatment.

**What You’ll Bring

**You thrive where commercial business development, consumer behaviour and financial decision making meet. You can build something new, influence without formal authority and turn complexity into action.

• A master’s degree in economics, business administration, finance or an equivalent field.

• Significant experience in commercial finance, business development, M&A finance, financial system change projects or customer profitability, including cross-country, regional or global exposure.

• Strong financial modelling and data interpretation skills.

• Practical experience in pricing, negotiation, customer profitability and stakeholder management in a large organisation.

• Experience bringing structure to new business areas, setting clear priorities and steering the business through influence and relationships.

• The ability to turn complex analysis into clear recommendations and to build new capabilities, standards and frameworks from the ground up.

• Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, AI modelling, SAP and systematic data consolidation.

• Fluency in English.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Experience from consumer health companies, including private healthcare organisations.

• Additional languages.

**What You’ll Do

**You will be the finance partner who helps Region Europe and Canada decide where to invest in online partnerships and consumer initiatives, and who shows what those investments deliver.

• Create the framework and shape commercial partnership priorities through sound financial modelling, working with business partners to assess partnership opportunities and consumer investment initiatives.

• Develop and deliver a business case methodology across European markets, so investment decisions are prudent, comparable and grounded in facts as part of the business rhythm.

• Establish an end-to-end view of customer and partner profit and loss, including system tracking and performance updates that follow return on investment.

• Deliver complex cross-functional change projects with Business Development, Finance, Legal, Supply Chain and Commercial Strategy to enable online sales in new European markets.

• Act as Commercial Finance Partner to the commercial unit for business development and to the UK affiliate.

• Improve data definitions, ownership, quality and comparability of online sales channels across markets.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Business Finance team in Region Europe and Canada (EUCAN), part of International Operations, reporting to the Director of Business Finance. The team is a key business partner to the Regional Leadership Team and the European sales affiliates.

Day to day, you will collaborate with European sales affiliate offices, local finance and business development teams, and with colleagues in Marketing, Business Development and Commercial Excellence, Data, Insights & Analytics, Pricing and Access, and Supply Chain. You will build bridges between these functions, so every investment decision rests on evidence and aims to maximise patient reach. Working across markets, you will help drive both the online sales agenda and the consumer finance agenda in Obesity.

The role is based in Ørestad, Copenhagen, Denmark.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will shape a new area from the start, with the trust to set direction and the visibility to influence decisions across European markets. Working with colleagues from finance, commercial, legal and supply chain, you will broaden your perspective across the value chain and build new skills through practical, cross-functional experience.

You will be supported to perform at your best, with clear expectations and a culture that values honest input and follows through on decisions.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 847,010.00 to 1,245,110.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to build the financial foundation for online partnerships across Europe, apply for the Associate Director, Consumer Finance & Online Partnerships role by 22 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

At DESMI Ro-Clean, we develop and deliver equipment and solutions for oil spill response, as well as the collection of seaweed and marine debris. Our customers are located worldwide, and our deliveries range from individual products to large-scale, technical system solutions.

Sustainability is highly appreciated while developing high-performance and long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

**Ready to apply?

Would you like to work with infrastructure and operations for complex IT solutions that make a real difference for both public sector organizations and private businesses? If so, you could be Netcompany’s next Operations Engineer.

_**Responsibilities And Technologies

**Netcompany Operations consists of specialized and cross-functional teams working across a wide range of technologies, including Linux, Oracle, Windows, Cloud, and Infrastructure, covering networking, servers, backup, and storage.

Based on your technical interests and expertise, you will join one of our operations teams, where you will take ownership of your own responsibilities while working closely with colleagues to deliver large-scale operational projects for our customers. **

**At Netcompany Operations, technical expertise and a passion for IT operations are at the core of what we do. As our new colleague, we hope you share that same enthusiasm.

**

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

**Send us your application

_All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

_We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

Job Description

Are you motivated by creating measurable improvements through data, technology, and customer insights? Do you want to influence how millions of customers experience JYSK across multiple markets?

At JYSK, we are expanding our team to strengthen our digital foundation and unlock new opportunities within marketing technology. We are looking for an Email Marketing Automation & Conversion Specialist who can help optimise customer journeys, improve conversion rates, and ensure our email communication performs at its best.

Based at our Head Office in Aarhus, you will join an informal, social, and collaborative team where knowledge sharing and teamwork are key to success. In this specialist role, you will work at the intersection of technology, data, and customer experience, helping JYSK take the next step in optimisation, personalisation, and marketing automation across digital channels.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

This is an opportunity to join a large international retailer where your work will have a visible impact across multiple markets. You will play a key role in strengthening JYSK's capabilities within conversion rate optimisation, email marketing automation, customer journey optimisation, and email deliverability.

You will become part of a team that values initiative, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We believe in giving our employees responsibility and freedom with accountability, allowing you to influence both your own development and how we work. At JYSK, your dedication creates opportunities to grow professionally while contributing to business results across our international organisation.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• A key role in shaping and improving customer journeys across multiple international markets

• The opportunity to establish new ways of working within landing page optimisation and conversion rate optimisation

• Responsibility and freedom to drive projects and improvements within your area of expertise

• An informal and supportive working environment characterised by trust, teamwork and straightforward communication

Combining analytical insight, technical understanding, and stakeholder management, you will transform data into tangible results.

One of your first achievements in the role will be helping establish stronger ways of working around landing pages and conversion optimisation while driving initiatives that strengthen inbox presence, sender reputation, and email performance across JYSK markets.

This role will suit someone who enjoys solving complex challenges, improving performance through testing and optimisation, and creating measurable impact. Based on the preferred behavioural profile, you are likely to balance independence with collaboration, demonstrate strong attention to detail, and take a methodical approach to problem-solving.

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Takes ownership and drives optimisation initiatives independently from analysis through implementation

• Combines analytical thinking with a structured and detail-oriented approach

• Has experience working with conversion optimisation, customer journeys, testing methodologies and data analysis

• Understands email deliverability, audience segmentation, personalisation and marketing automation principles

• Builds strong relationships and collaborates effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders

Experience with Bloomreach, Drupal, Dynamic Yield, Google Postmaster Tools, HTML, CSS and Jinja will be considered an advantage.

Additional Information

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Team Leader, Email Marketing, Martin Ry Mathiasen at +45 31 23 90 10.

jobs.occupation: DCS Automation Specialist – ABB 800xA for Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
DCS Automation Specialist – ABB 800xA for Novo Nordisk Engineering

Do you want to be a part of NNE’s all-time largest Process Automation team? We are looking for a colleague to join our fantastic company, where we have the aspiration of becoming best in class within Automation Solutions for Pharmaceutical Engineering.

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

Imagine seeing your automation solutions come to life in pharma facilities that are essential for millions of patients. In our DCS Automation team, deep DCS expertise meets real process understanding – and you'll be at the centre of it.

Why you'll enjoy working here:

• Greenfield projects at scale: An exciting pipeline of large, data-driven greenfield plants with modular, scalable designs.

• The full automation lifecycle: Consultancy, design and development, implementation and validation of automation solutions for the pharma and biotech industries.

• Real process depth: Work across API production areas such as fermentation, recovery and purification, utility and cleaning systems.

• Room to innovate: Our solutions are built on a deep understanding of our customers' production processes – and when standard components can't do the job, we develop our own.

• A strong professional community: 80+ DCS Automation colleagues in Denmark and 200+ globally, from graduate engineers to senior specialists and leads.

How you might spend your days

As a DCS Application Specialist, you'll join a diverse, collaborative team where no two days look the same. You will:

• Shape the control systems. Design, develop, implement, qualify and support Process Control Systems, using your deep PCS/DCS expertise and your hands-on feel for how client plants really run.

• Stand side by side with the client. Work closely with the client's Operational Responsible and operators, from the first design discussions through to commissioning.

• Solve problems where code meets equipment. Track down and resolve whatever shows up when the software meets the physical plant.

• Fine-tune to the finish line. Optimise the processes until they are ready for final handover.

• Connect with experts across disciplines. Exchange ideas with process experts and colleagues who specialise in MES, historian systems, instruments, production equipment and more.

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Respectful of your colleagues’ individual and cultural differences

• Aware of your surroundings and able to flag any concerns

• Agile and able to prioritize urgent tasks

• Team-oriented and able to collaborate on team projects

• Reliable, curious and eager to learn

• Appreciative of feedback, because it contributes to your growth

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• Engineering foundation: A degree in electrical, automation, process or marine engineering – or equivalent experience

• Hands-on DCS skills: Proven experience designing and coding PCS/DCS applications, ideally in ABB 800xA or ABB SattLine

• Batch know-how: Understanding of batch production and ISA-88 – or a strong drive to build it quickly

• Regulated or project experience: Experience from GMP/GAMP environments or from executing automation projects – and you find the complexity of GMP/GAMP meaningful

• Cross-disciplinary mindset: You collaborate easily with process experts and colleagues working on MES, Historian, instrumentation and production equipment

• Digital and AI-savvy: You use AI tools, scripting (e.g. Python) and smart engineering tools to work faster, standardise and reuse solutions

• Future-oriented: You are motivated by modular, data-driven and scalable automation design

Why choose NNE?

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 14th December 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Please contact Manager Ditte Høiberg Møller on +45 3075 5028 or Manager Volker J. Jentzsch on +45 3191 1540.

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the teams by creating or helping create great guest experiences, and use every day as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer or staff member; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of people who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You'll learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path—our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**The Global Leadership Training Lead is responsible for owning the company's leadership and talent training standard, ensuring that people at every career step are equipped with the skills and mind-set for their role. The role owns the leadership curriculum, including the JOE’s leadership development program(s), coaching and feedback modules and team development tools, facilitates Train-the trainer programs, and partners with Operations, Culture and regional T&LD to embed leadership training across operational and office-based career paths. As part of the Talent & Leadership Development team within People & Development, this position shapes how the company builds leaders at scale, supporting the company's purpose and growth ambitions.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Own the leadership training curriculum and set the standard for how leadership is trained at every career step, for operational and office-based roles.

• Develop and own the company's leadership development program(s), scaling them from pilot to company-wide availability at speed.

• Shape the leadership training content standard within the operational training journey together with Operations, ensuring leadership training is consistent from store to office.

• Develop and own coaching and feedback modules and a team development toolbox that become the common leadership toolkit across the organization.

• Ensure training is anchored in the talent development process, leadership standards and the competency framework, applying an approach of growth assignments, coaching by leaders and formal training.

• Facilitate selected leadership programs, especially pilots and new launches, and own and facilitate the train-the-trainer certification for People Business Partners and regional T&LD, ensuring consistent delivery quality across regions.

• Develop content and facilitator materials, aligned with Operations training and Culture on the shared learning platform.

• Define how training impact is measured, linking participation and feedback to talent and performance outcomes, and use insight to guide decisions on the learning portfolio.

**WHO YOU ARE

**

• Passionate about leadership. A standard-setter who works with high autonomy, setting the bar for how we build leaders

• A builder who creates a pilot and take it to company-wide availability at speed

• A facilitator who energises a room, from a bar back room to the office meeting room

• Operationally credible: you know what a busy shift and running a store demands of a leader and design training that fits it

• A partner who cooperates and influences across Operations, Culture, People Business Partners and regional T&LD without needing authority

• Curious and data-led: you want proof that training changes behaviour and results

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• 7+ years in leadership development, L&D or talent roles, ideally in global multi-site quick service restaurant, retail or similar front line heavy industry

• Proven track record designing and delivering content and facilitator materials, incl. blended or digital learning for leadership programmes, including coaching and feedback modules

• Hands-on facilitation experience, ideally with train-the-trainer or certification programmes

• Experience measuring training impact and linking it to performance outcomes

• Leadership experience and/or relevant education

• Fluent in English - other languages are a bonus

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

**Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

****ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

Connected Cars is on an ambitious mission to connect millions of vehicles through real-time data, enabling safer and more sustainable mobility. Our team of ~70 people is driven by a shared belief in community, team effort, and quality solutions.

The Position

As we rapidly scale across international markets, we are looking for a Head of Support & Training. Exceptional support and structured customer training are core drivers of our product adoption. Sitting within the Commercial team, you will lead a dedicated technical product support team of 5, act as a proactive operational bridge for our Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to help them translate technical solutions into tangible customer value, and drive the onboarding strategy for 15–20 international Customer Interaction Centre (CIC) stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

• Team Empowerment & Leadership: Mentor and develop a team of 5 Product Support Specialists (including one fully remote). After our in depth onboarding, you will step back from daily ticket execution to empower the team, delegating ownership of strategic projects and functional areas so they can grow as independent, proactive professionals.

• Proactive Commercial Enablement: Partner closely with Sales & CS, moving beyond reactive troubleshooting to actively equip CSMs with the technical insights and operational backing needed to unlock customer value and drive account expansion.

• Technical Escalations: Serve as the senior escalation point for complex enterprise issues across our hardware, telematics, and app ecosystem, ensuring prompt root-cause resolution.

• Enterprise Partner Governance: Lead the onboarding and training of 15 -20 international CIC and market support leads, ensuring local operations can support our product at scale.

• Zendesk Architecture: Own and optimize our Zendesk setup - designing efficient ticket routing, automation, SLAs, and performance metrics.

• Training Frameworks: Collaborate with Product & Brand Marketing to create scalable training templates and academy materials for internal teams, external CICs, and end-users.

What You Bring

• Support Leadership: A proven track record of leading B2B technical support in a high-growth SaaS, IoT, or tech environment, with a strong focus on fostering team autonomy and delegating project leadership.

• Technical & Commercial Acumen: Comfortable with software integrations, app/hardware diagnostics, and APIs, paired with a strong understanding of how proactive support drives product adoption, customer value, and long-term retention.

• Global Stakeholder Management: Experience working with multinational enterprise accounts and multi-market partner teams.

• Zendesk Expertise: Hands-on experience configuring and administering Zendesk for automated, scalable workflows.

• Communication: Excellent written and verbal English, with the ability to translate complex technical realities into clear guidance for both technical and commercial stakeholders.

Why Connected Cars?

• The opportunity to shape a vital support function during a critical phase of international growth.

• A collaborative culture valuing technical rigor and commercial ambition.

• Competitive salary, attractive pension, Friday bars, monthly social events, affordable lunch scheme, and unlimited office snacks.

Connected Cars is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

How to Apply

Please apply via LinkedIn with an up-to-date CV. A cover letter is optional, but feel free to add one if there is extra context you’d like to share.

**Role Description

We are seeking applicants with extensive experience taking the lead in complex ERP transformation projects across ERP strategy, ERP sourcing, project and programme management, architecture, and business consulting.

Lead Designer for the world’s most impactful CPR training programs

We are looking for a hands-on Lead Designer who loves great Interaction Design, UX & UI craft, and can also set direction and bring an organisation with them.

At Laerdal, we develop CPR training solutions used by healthcare professionals and organisations around the world, with a mission to help save one million more lives each year by 2030.

We are seeking an exceptional Lead Designer to join our cross-functional product team in Copenhagen, working on the psycho-motor skills experience of RQI Provider and HeartCode Complete. These are cornerstone programs in the collaboration between Laerdal Medical and the American Heart Association, reaching millions of healthcare professionals across the globe.

This is an opportunity to shape experiences that ultimately help people become better prepared to save a life.

The design challenge goes well beyond screens. Learners move between digital instruction, software-guided practice, physical interaction with manikins and training stations, assessment, and certification. Your role is to make that entire experience coherent, intuitive, and effective.

About us

In Laerdal Copenhagen we are around 150 people developing best-in-class digital learning products. We hire people with grit and mission-driven hearts, and by joining us, you will become part of a unique and dynamic workplace that appreciates diversity, authenticity, ambition, and long-term, sustainable solutions.

We are a unique mix of talents, from medical doctors and learning specialists to designers, software engineers and 3D engineers, working with international partners to deliver effective learning solutions.

Some of what we offer

• A collaborative and diverse environment with lots of passion and energy. Our workplace is friendly and casual, located in an old warehouse at Islands Brygge.

• An outstanding teamwork culture driven by the mission of helping save lives.

• Fair compensation.

• Great opportunities for growth and personal development in a global organization

About you

You are an exceptional hands-on product designer who cares deeply about craft. You are equally comfortable defining an end-to-end learner experience, working through a complex interaction, and crafting the final UI that gets built.

You enjoy getting close to users, turning insight into ideas, and making those ideas tangible through flows, prototypes and high-quality screen designs. You have a strong eye for visual and interaction design, and you care about the details that make a product feel intuitive, coherent and polished.

At Lead level, we also expect you to look beyond the individual screen or feature. You can articulate a compelling design direction, bring Product, Engineering and other stakeholders with you, and use prototypes and customer evidence to move the team from discussion to experimentation and implementation faster.

This is a hands-on design role. You will be the designer creating the UX and UI for these products, not someone handing the work over to another designer.

About the role

On this cross-functional team, you will:

• Own the UX and UI design craft for RQI Provider and HeartCode Complete.

• Design the learner experience across digital interfaces, software-guided training and physical interaction with manikins and training stations.

• Create user flows, interaction models, wireframes, prototypes and polished, implementation-ready UI designs using Laerdal’s Life Design System.

• Work closely with Engineering throughout implementation, reviewing the built experience and ensuring that design quality and intent survive through release.

• Prototype early and often, putting tangible ideas in front of learners and customers rather than relying on presentations and specifications.

• Lead discovery and collaborate with a Design Researcher on research and usability testing to understand learner needs and validate solutions.

• Build a deep understanding of healthcare professionals and their CPR learning and certification journeys through direct engagement with learners, instructors and customers.

• Shape and communicate a strong design vision for the products, creating alignment across Product, Engineering, Educational Specialists and other stakeholders.

• Help the team shorten the cycle from idea to prototype, customer test, learning and release.

• Use AI-enabled workflows to accelerate exploration, prototyping and iteration.

• Travel to the US and other markets to observe training, test solutions and work directly with customers and partners.

Qualifications

• A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent hands-on UX, interaction and UI design craft in shipped products.

• Strong visual design skills and attention to detail, with the ability to take work all the way from rough concept to production-ready interface.

• Excellent prototyping skills, from quick experiments to realistic prototypes suitable for customer testing.

• Deep understanding of user-centered design, with demonstrated experience involving users throughout the design process.

• Experience designing complex digital products where software is part of a broader physical experience is a strong advantage.

• Ability to establish a product or experience design vision and translate it into concrete design work.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence Product, Engineering and senior stakeholders through customer evidence and tangible design proposals.

• An AI-first mindset toward your own design toolchain and cross-functional workflows in the team.

• Experience with healthcare, medical technology, learning products or connected devices is an advantage.

• Willingness to travel internationally, particularly to the US.

If you're passionate about design and want to make a meaningful impact, we invite you to join our team at Laerdal Medical in Copenhagen. We’re looking forward to receiving your:

• Letter of motivation,

• CV, and

• Portfolio (can be a link to an online resource)

Only applications with all three will be reviewed. Beware that LinkedIn only allows one document upload, so merge them into one, before you hit the APPLY button.

Business Consultant, Corporate Credit, Netcompany Banking Services

• Full-time

Job Description

Are you interested in the intersection of IT, business and finance? As a Business Consultant, you will work with IT solutions supporting banks' corporate credit processes. You will analyze system issues, understand client needs and translate business requirements into technical solutions while building specialized knowledge within banking and corporate credit.

Netcompany Banking Services

We deliver various IT solutions and services to banks and savings institutions across Denmark and other Nordic countries. We provide a modern, cloud-based core banking platform serving more than 50 Nordic banks with over 2 million end customers. Our solutions encompass daily banking operations, mobile and internet banking, payments, investment management, risk management, compliance, and open banking.

Responsibilities

We are looking for a Business Consultant to join our team, working with IT solutions that support banks' corporate credit processes. You will be involved in the daily operation, maintenance and further development of these solutions, acting as a link between clients, developers and other stakeholders. Your work will involve investigating issues, understanding business needs and ensuring reliable system operations.

You will join an experienced team that will support your onboarding and help you build expertise within corporate credit and IT solutions. Initially, your focus will be on learning the existing solution and its daily operations, with opportunities to take on more responsibility for further development over time.

Your responsibilities will typically include:

• Handling and analyzing client-reported issues and tickets, investigating problems and identifying their root causes to ensure reliable system operations.

• Maintaining and supporting existing IT solutions while contributing to their continuous improvement and further development.

• Engaging in dialogue with clients to understand their needs and challenges, translating business requirements into clear and actionable tasks.

• Collaborating closely with developers and testers to investigate technical issues, clarify requirements and coordinate solutions.

• Supporting the development and implementation of new functionality through requirements analysis, testing and refinement.

About you

You are curious, analytical and motivated by understanding how IT solutions work and how they support business processes. You enjoy investigating problems, asking questions and finding solutions in collaboration with others. You are comfortable communicating with different stakeholders and can translate complex issues into clear and actionable tasks.

We imagine that you have a relevant educational background and some experience working at the intersection of IT and business. Most importantly, you are eager to learn, take ownership and build specialized knowledge within banking and corporate credit.

We imagine that you have:

• A relevant master's degree, such as Cand.merc. IT, Cand.it. or a similar degree combining IT, business, finance or accounting.

• Some experience from IT consulting, business analysis, application management, system support or a similar field. Recent graduates with a strong interest in IT and financial services are also welcome.

• Good analytical skills and an interest in investigating issues, understanding complex problems and identifying solutions.

• Technical understanding and an interest in IT systems, combined with an interest in banking, financial services or digitalisation. Experience with corporate credit, credit processes or financial statement analysis is an advantage, but not a requirement. Programming skills are not required.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English, spoken and written, is mandatory.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritize an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparing.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

Job Description

Do you enjoy coordinating campaigns, creating structure around recurring activities, and working closely with stakeholders across markets? Then this could be your opportunity to join JYSK's Email Marketing team at our Head Office in Aarhus.

We are expanding our team to strengthen our operational setup and explore new opportunities within gamification and permission marketing. As our new Gamification Coordinator, you will play an important role in ensuring that gamification activities run smoothly across multiple markets while contributing to subscriber growth and customer engagement. You will join an informal, social, and collaborative team where knowledge sharing, teamwork, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

At JYSK, you become part of a large international retail organisation where your development matters. You will have the opportunity to deepen your expertise within gamification, email marketing, and digital customer engagement while working alongside experienced colleagues in a business that values initiative, responsibility, and cooperation. We believe that the best results are created together, and we support your professional and personal growth through close collaboration and learning opportunities.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• A central role in a growing area with visibility across multiple markets

• The opportunity to work with gamification, email marketing, and subscriber growth initiatives

• A strong team culture built on collaboration, knowledge sharing, and mutual support

• Responsibility from day one combined with sparring from experienced specialists and colleagues

• Professional development opportunities in a large international company where growth is part of our DNA

• Close cooperation with stakeholders across Marketing, Sales & Expansion, and local market teams

• An informal working environment where ideas and improvements are welcomed

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As Gamification Coordinator, you will be responsible for coordinating day-to-day gamification activities and supporting the onboarding of new subscribers to JYSK's email marketing channels. Working closely with the Gamification Specialist and stakeholders across the business, you will help ensure high-quality execution, structured processes, and continuous optimisation of our gamification initiatives.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Planning and coordinating gamification campaigns and activities across JYSK markets

• Maintaining and updating campaign plans and yearly activity schedules

• Supporting the daily collaboration with our gamification platform provider

• Setting up campaigns and ensuring they follow agreed processes and timelines

• Supporting integration and testing activities between sign-up sources and marketing automation platforms

• Monitoring performance, preparing KPI reporting, and identifying opportunities for optimisation

• Supporting colleagues across markets with onboarding, training material, and operational guidance

You can read more about our department here.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for someone who enjoys creating structure, coordinating multiple tasks, and working with stakeholders across different functions and markets. You are detail-oriented, comfortable with recurring operational tasks, and motivated by delivering consistent quality. At the same time, you are curious and eager to learn new technologies and ways of working.

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Has a degree within E-commerce, Digital Marketing, IT, or a similar relevant field

• Has an interest in gamification, customer engagement, and digital marketing

• Works in a structured and accurate manner, even when handling repetitive tasks

• Communicates clearly and collaborates effectively with stakeholders across different functions

• Is comfortable working with digital platforms, integrations, and testing processes

• Is eager to learn and continuously develop new knowledge within the field

• Experience with Playable, Bloomreach or similar platforms is an advantage but not a requirement

Additional Information

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Team Leader, Email Marketing, Martin Ry Mathiasen at +45 31 23 90 10.

We kindly ask you to only attach your CV. With us, there is no need to write a traditional cover letter when applying for a job.

Instead, when you click “I’m interested/Apply”, you will have the option to write a brief message to the hiring team. If you wish, you can use this space to share your motivation for applying or highlight anything else you feel is relevant.

ABOUT US

We believe our employees are key to our success. That is why we strive to offer development and possibilities of growing and finding new challenges within JYSK. Since our founder, Lars Larsen, opened his first store in Denmark in 1979, JYSK has expanded our global presence with stores and web shops in countries around the world.

Our three fundamental JYSK Values – Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit – express the behaviour and attitude that we can expect from each other.
