jobs.description:
Are you an actuary with a couple of years of experience looking to broaden your career beyond a traditional actuarial role? Would you like to work across insurance, audit and advisory, helping some of the largest financial institutions solve complex actuarial and business challenges?

Then you might be our new colleague in KPMG’s Financial Services Advisory team in Copenhagen.

The opportunity

We are looking for an ambitious actuary with approximately 2 years of relevant professional experience to strengthen our actuarial capabilities within Financial Services Advisory.

You will join a multidisciplinary team working with insurance companies and other financial institutions. Your assignments will vary from supporting our audit teams on actuarial matters to advising clients directly on actuarial, risk, regulatory and transformation topics.

The role provides a strong opportunity to combine your actuarial expertise with broader business and advisory experience and to develop your career in an environment where you will work closely with experienced colleagues, clients and specialists across KPMG.

What you will be doing

Depending on your experience and interests, your work may include:

• Performing actuarial analyses of insurance liabilities and technical provisions.

• Supporting the audit of insurance companies, including review and challenge of actuarial assumptions, methodologies, models and calculations.

• Working with Solvency II, financial reporting and other regulatory requirements relevant to insurers.

• Reviewing and challenging reserving methodologies, models, assumptions and data.

• Supporting actuarial modelling, validation and quantitative analyses.

• Advising insurance clients on improvements to their actuarial processes, governance, controls and documentation.

• Contributing to projects at the intersection of actuarial science, risk management, regulation, data and technology.

• Working directly with clients and gradually taking responsibility for your own workstreams and deliverables.

• Collaborating with colleagues across KPMG in Denmark and our international network.

The aim is not only for you to apply your actuarial skills, but also to develop into a trusted adviser who understands both the numbers and the business behind them.

Who we are looking for

We expect that you:

• Hold a relevant quantitative degree, ideally within actuarial mathematics, insurance mathematics or a closely related field.

• Have approximately 2 years of relevant experience, for example from an insurance company, consultancy or audit firm.

• Have practical experience with actuarial calculations, models or insurance liabilities.

• Have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy working with complex quantitative topics.

• Are interested in understanding the commercial, regulatory and strategic context surrounding actuarial work.

• Communicate clearly and are comfortable discussing your analyses with both specialists and non-specialists.

• Enjoy working collaboratively and taking responsibility.

• Are fluent in English. Danish or another Nordic language is an advantage.

Experience within life insurance, non-life insurance, pensions, reserving, Solvency II or actuarial audit would be particularly relevant, but we do not expect you to be an expert in all areas.

What we offer

At KPMG, you will have the opportunity to build a career that extends beyond a traditional actuarial role.

You will become part of Financial Services Advisory, where we bring together expertise across insurance, banking, risk, regulation, data, technology and transformation. You will work alongside experienced specialists while being given responsibility early in your career.

We offer:

• A steep learning curve and exposure to different insurance companies and business models.

• The opportunity to combine actuarial expertise with advisory and business skills.

• Direct interaction with clients and senior colleagues.

• Access to KPMG's Danish and international actuarial and financial-services network.

• Opportunities to work on projects beyond traditional actuarial assignments.

• A collaborative and informal environment with strong focus on professional and personal development.

Most importantly, we offer the opportunity to help shape and grow our actuarial capability in Financial Services Advisory.

Why KPMG?

You’ll thrive in a professional environment that emphasizes close team collaboration and cross-functional, international partnerships. You won’t just be a part of a team; You will become integral to a motivated and skilled team of over 60 international professionals driven by progression and professional development.

Our culture is not just a buzzword – It is social, informal, and open, with a flat organizational structure. We value diversity, social well-being, collaboration, and innovative thinking.

Interested?

If you find yourself aligned with this opportunity, then we are excited to get to know you better. Feel free to contact Senior Manager, Teis Dengsøe, tdengsoee@kpmg.com, or Partner Hans Jørgen Andresen, hansjandresen@kpmg.com. We accept applications and interview candidates continuously and will close the position once we have found the right match.

At KPMG, we are committed to developing diverse talents at all levels. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

Please note that we do not accept applications by e-mail to ensure GDPR compliance.

We look forward to welcoming you to KPMG

jobs.occupation: Senior Cell Bank Scientist, CMC Drug Development
jobs.description:
Your impact begins here

Ready to bring together microbial science, GMP manufacturing and project responsibility in a senior role where your work directly supports the development of future medicines? Join our Microbial Cell Bank team, where every drug substance begins - we manufacture and maintain the cell banks that are the starting point for drug substance production all over the world. Working cross-functionally across projects, you will combine your scientific expertise with GMP responsibility and help drive continuous improvement of our Cell Bank operation. Ready to take the lead where every medicine begins? Apply today!

**What you’ll do

**As a Senior Scientist in the Microbial Cell Bank, you will take a leading professional role in activities related to the production and lifecycle management of our cell banks. You will take ownership of complex tasks and projects, working closely with scientists, laboratory technicians, QA, QC and project teams. With your experience, you will help navigate cross-functional processes, identify solutions and contribute to developing both our processes and ways of working. Depending on your experience and interests, the role provides an opportunity to build deeper expertise and potentially develop towards a specialist position.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Planning and supporting GMP manufacture of microbial Master Cell Banks (MCBs) and Working Cell Banks (WCBs).

• Taking project responsibility for cell bank projects from incoming Initial Cell Clone (ICC) through production, characterisation, release and lifecycle activities.

• Preparing and maintaining specifications, production documentation and other GMP documentation.

• Coordinating activities and solving issues across QA, QC, project teams and other key stakeholders.

• Handling deviations and change requests and driving systematic problem solving.

• Supporting regulatory activities, audits, inspections and responses to Health Authority questions.

• Driving continuous improvements to cell bank processes and ways of working.

• Contributing to the continued digitalisation of our Cell Bank operation and exploring how new technologies, including AI, can support smarter and more efficient ways of working.

What you’ll bring

To succeed in this role, we imagine that you hold a relevant master’s degree within biotechnology, microbiology, biochemistry or a related scientific field. You also have:

• a solid background from the pharmaceutical industry and a strong understanding of GMP.

• hands-on skills in microbial cultivation and knowledge of microbiology, molecular biology, cellular biology and analytical science.

• a proven ability to navigate a complex organisation and work across functions.

• a strong quality mindset combined with an analytical and pragmatic approach to problem solving.

• an interest in digitalisation and new technology. Experience with AI is an advantage, but curiosity and motivation to explore how AI can improve our work are equally important.

On a personal level, you are collaborative, curious and motivated by taking professional and independent ownership of activities and projects involving multiple stakeholders. You enjoy sharing your knowledge and contributing to the development of others while continuously strengthening your own expertise. You communicate effectively across functions and organisational levels and are comfortable challenging existing ways of working when you see opportunities to improve.

Who you’ll work with

CMC Development turns promising molecules into approved products in close collaboration with colleagues across Research & Development and Global Manufacturing & Supply.

Cell Banks are at the starting point of drug substance production and play an important role in bringing new medicines through CMC Drug Development. We are a team of approximately 16 scientists and laboratory technicians working with microbial cell banks in Bagsværd and mammalian cell banks in Hillerød, with an ambition to collaborate closely and share knowledge across the two locations.

We have a strong focus on quality, collaboration and delivering for our projects. At the same time, we are ambitious about developing the Cell Bank area and continuously improving our processes, facilities and digital ways of working. We value an open and collaborative environment where we help each other, share knowledge and believe that having fun at work is an important part of being a strong team.

What you can expect here

You will work in an international environment where your expertise is valued, and your contribution can shape decisions across markets. You will be supported to perform at your best and trusted to take ownership. You will be encouraged to make your voice heard, learn from colleagues and contribute to work that helps create progress for people living with serious chronic diseases. We foster a collaborative culture where we care for one another, value initiative, and empower you to drive projects forward while growing professionally.

**What we offer

**Salary: The annual base salary for this role ranges from DKK 651,000 to DKK 956,900, depending on the level of the position. Placement within the range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives and other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Please apply by 22 November 2026.

**

Due to the short deadline, please apply as soon as possible. We review CVs and invite candidates to interview on an ongoing basis.**

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Associate Director Jesper Roland Jørgensen at +45 30797885.

While not mandatory, we strongly encourage you to submit a cover letter explaining why you are the ideal candidate to join us in the Cell Bank team. Please do not include a photo in your CV, as this supports a fair and efficient recruitment process.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.description:
Are you motivated by the opportunity to deepen your leadership, commercial and advisory impact while contributing to sustainable growth in the operational transformation area? As Associate Partner and Competence Team Lead for Valcon’s Operational Transformation team, you will play a key role in developing our people, strengthening client partnerships and evolving our capabilities. And you will be instrumental in growing the area considerably in the future matching Valcon’s growth ambitions.

Role and profile

The job is located at the intersection between client delivery, team leadership, commercial work and service offering development.

You will lead a team of approximately 12 consultants and help shape the continued development of our Operational Transformation offerings, focused on Process Redesign and Process Automation, including agentic automation. You are expected to support the further integration of AI, data and technological capabilities into the services based on a clear understanding of our clients’ business needs and strategic ambitions. The ideal candidate brings deep experience and insight from both operations’ excellence and business process redesign as well as technology-driven business change and automation.

You will also act as a trusted advisor to clients, and contribute to Valcon’s growth by being commercial active, building trusted client relationships and lead projects that deliver sustainable results.

To thrive in this role, you have demonstrated experience in these four competence areas:

• Team leadership: Guide, inspire and develop a talented team of consultants, fostering an inclusive environment where people can thrive, collaborate effectively and deliver meaningful results together

• Commercial growth: Strengthen Valcon’s position as a trusted advisor by building long-term client partnerships and creating sustainable growth opportunities together with clients

• Client engagement: Manage and deliver complex projects with high-quality standards from initial mobilization to final delivery and further expansions

• Service development leadership: Develop internal capabilities and strengthen methodologies with AI, data, and technology as key enablers of business transformation

The role offers a high degree of autonomy and responsibility. The ability to balance time between all four areas is key, as they are equally important for success in this role.

In addition, you should embody these skills:

• People skills: Build and nurture existing relationships and teams through empathy, engagement and effective communication with clear direction

• Business and digital acumen: Think analytically and strategically with a pragmatic approach to execution. View AI, data and digital technology as integral elements of modern business development

• Subject-matter-expertise: Business process redesign, improvement and automation

• Education: Speak and write English fluently and professionally, with Danish being a plus. Completed relevant higher education or equivalent professional experience. Further education is a plus

Organisation and reporting

You will be the direct people manager of the Operational Transformation team of consultants (excluding Associate Partners and Partners) or managing their people managers. The role reports to a Partner from either one of our Commercial Sectors or our Head of Consulting.

Location and travel

The role is based at Valcon’s offices in central Copenhagen or Århus, Denmark. You can expect travel in connection with client meetings and project work, primarily within the Nordic region.

About Valcon

We are a European powerhouse in AI and data-driven business transformation, bringing this to life by integrating management consulting with data and digital technology capabilities.

We ensure companies are in their best possible shape – fit for the future. We spot opportunities and help bring them to life. We are thorough, fast and collaborative in everything we do. From the boardroom to the shop floor. From strategy to operations.

We are a no-nonsense consultancy with curious individuals who are driven by creating value together with clients. We have an informal culture and a flat hierarchy with offices in Denmark, Sweden, the Netherlands, the UK, Germany, Croatia and Serbia.

Career opportunities

Valcon is in a significant growth phase supported by acquisitions and capital investment from Rivean Capital and Waterland Private Equity. This supports our ambitious expansion plans – both geographically and in terms of capabilities – with a particular focus on the Nordics and the DACH (German-speaking) region. Therefore, you will have a unique opportunity to help shape the company’s development and gain strategic influence over its future direction.

The role provides internal career development opportunities toward broader leadership roles within the capability or across the broader organisation. With Valcon’s international footprint and focus on complex transformation projects in the business and technological space, you will gain access to:

• A broad network of colleagues and clients across Europe

• Strategically significant and high-complexity projects

• Opportunities to work with cutting-edge technology, including AI, data and digital technologies

Application

If this role sounds like a good match, we warmly encourage you to apply and share how your experience, strengths and perspective could contribute to the team. Deadline for applications is Monday December 7, but we do review applications on an ongoing basis.

Turn financial data into insights and support for decisions that help build future manufacturing capacity for patients worldwide. As Finance Partner in Drug Product Manufacturing (DPM) Expansions, you will be part of strengthening cost transparency and financial reporting, combined with improving forecasts and helping secure right resource planning across a multi-billion DKK investment portfolio. Your insights will support across the Global Project Management Office (GPMO) and selected expansion sites. You will combine independent ownership with close collaboration in an experienced finance team. Key is that you are ready for a step learning curve and take ownership in your work and bring high energy and motivation to make a difference within delivering sound financial management.

What you'll bring

You can translate complex financial information into clear business insights and recommendations and build trusted relationships with stakeholders from expansion sites to the finance community. For this role, the essentials are:

• A master’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, business administration or a related discipline.

• Relevant experience in financial planning and analysis, business finance, controlling or business partnering, including independent delivery of reporting and analysis.

• Strong understanding of financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting, with close attention to data quality.

• Clear communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain findings simply and build a compelling financial story.

• Fluency in written and spoken English, together with a structured approach to deadlines and commitments.

• Useful, but not essential: experience with financial planning systems and improving reporting through digital tools.

What you'll do

• Lead and coordinate the month-end closing process across capital expenditure, operating expenditure and workforce planning, bringing inputs together into a high-quality monthly management report.

• Consolidate and analyse operating expenditure (OPEX) and manning data for monthly reporting, budgets and forecasts, explaining deviations and identifying risks early.

• Partner with GPMO budget owners to assess cost and manning, as well as support resource prioritisation within agreed budgets.

• Work with selected site project finance teams to improve collaboration and insights even further to secure sharpen OPEX financial execution and forecast, as well as strong financial follow-through and follow up on assumptions, deviations and agreed actions.

• Challenge assumptions and resolve complex financial issues within your scope, while seeking input from senior colleagues when it adds value.

• Simplify reporting and finance processes through common standards, efficient workflows and effective use of digital tools and AI adoption.

Who you'll work with

You will join the Finance & Procurement team within the GPMO for DPM Expansions. The team brings together finance management, financial compliance, procurement, contract management and digital solutions. Your closest partners will include experienced finance colleagues and corporate finance functions, GPMO budget owners, site project finance teams and digital colleagues across the expansion portfolio.

DPM Expansions delivers major capital investment projects that establish manufacturing capacity for current and future demand, working with standardised equipment and processes, advanced technology and flexible facility designs, with a strong focus on safety, cost, time and good manufacturing practice compliance. You will contribute financial clarity that helps these teams make timely, well-informed choices.

You will have independent ownership of defined processes and stakeholder relationships, while having close internal collaborations and sparring with finance and investment colleagues. The role offers broad exposure to a global major investment portfolio and the opportunity to strengthen your business partnering, financial reporting and process-improvement skills. You can expect a collaborative environment where asking questions, constructively challenging assumptions and sharing knowledge are valued.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 570,200 to 838,100 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

AIR ALSIE A/S is a Danish aviation company headquartered in Sønderborg, Denmark. Our core business activities include flight operations, business aviation charter services and aircraft maintenance.

AIR ALSIE A/S is Scandinavia’s largest regional airline within the business aviation segment, and we are experiencing rapid growth and continuous development. As our organisation continues to expand, we are looking to strengthen our Technical Engineering team with a dedicated and skilled professional.

The Position

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Engineer or Aircraft Technician with a strong administrative mindset and an interest in aviation regulations and compliance.

The ideal candidate combines technical knowledge of aircraft maintenance with strong administrative skills and an understanding of regulatory requirements. You will play an important role in supporting and developing our technical organisation, ensuring that documentation, procedures and processes meet applicable aviation standards and regulatory requirements.

This position offers an exciting opportunity to work across technical and administrative functions, collaborate with colleagues throughout the organisation and contribute to the continued development of AIR ALSIE A/S.

Are you passionate about aviation and motivated by being part of a dedicated team working towards shared goals? Do you want to take responsibility, make a difference and contribute to the future development of AIR ALSIE A/S? Then we would like to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

• 
Manage, maintain and update technical documentation and records in accordance with applicable aviation regulations and authority requirements.

• 
Maintain and update the Maintenance Organisation Exposition (MOE), ensuring continued compliance with relevant regulatory requirements.

• 
Establish and maintain effective communication and cooperation with aviation authorities.

• 
Coordinate and collaborate with internal departments on matters relating to flight operations and aircraft maintenance.

• 
Support the development and implementation of improvements to aircraft maintenance processes, procedures and working methods.

• 
Assist in the planning and coordination of aircraft maintenance programmes and resource allocation.

• 
Support the development and maintenance of employee training, competency and qualification programmes.

• 
Contribute to ensuring a high standard of regulatory compliance and operational efficiency across the organisation.

Your Profile and Qualifications

We are looking for a structured and proactive individual who enjoys working with both technical matters and administrative tasks.

Ideally, you bring:

• 
An educational background in aircraft engineering, aircraft maintenance or a related technical field, combined with administrative experience.

• 
Experience with aircraft maintenance procedures, processes and practices.

• 
Knowledge of aviation regulations, compliance requirements and industry standards.

• 
Strong organisational skills and a structured approach to documentation and administrative tasks.

• 
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments.

• 
Proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

• 
The ability to work independently, prioritise tasks and maintain an overview in a dynamic working environment.

• 
A solution-oriented mindset and the ability to handle challenges efficiently.

• 
An aircraft maintenance licence, certification or other relevant professional qualifications will be considered an advantage.

What We Offer

At AIR ALSIE A/S, you will become part of an ambitious and growing aviation company where your contribution matters.

We offer:

• 
An exciting position in a dynamic and developing aviation industry.

• 
A varied role with a combination of technical, administrative and regulatory responsibilities.

• 
Opportunities for professional development, further training and relevant certifications.

• 
A collaborative and supportive working environment with highly skilled and dedicated colleagues.

• 
The opportunity to influence processes and contribute to the continued development of our technical organisation.

• 
Competitive salary and employment conditions in accordance with your qualifications.

A Great Place to Work

At AIR ALSIE A/S, we believe that our employees are our greatest asset. We offer an informal working environment characterised by mutual respect, strong teamwork and a high level of professional expertise.

We strive to create an inspiring workplace where employees are encouraged to take responsibility, share their knowledge and continuously develop their skills and talents.

Our continued growth and success are driven by the commitment, expertise and dedication of our employees. We believe in working together, supporting one another and creating an environment where everyone has the opportunity to make a difference.

Would you like to be part of our journey?

We look forward to welcoming a new colleague to the AIR ALSIE team!

Visit our website www.alsie.com to read more about our company.

Questions

If any questions, feel free to contact Maintenance Manager Torsten Plank Lorentzen TPL@alsie.com or by phone +45 74429888.

Does This Sound Like the Right Opportunity for You?

If you recognise yourself in the profile described above and are motivated to take on the role of Engineer or Aircraft Technician at AIR ALSIE A/S, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Please submit your motivated application, CV and relevant educational certificates through our website at www.alsie.com.

East Denmark: Hillerød, Bagsværd and Måløv

Your impact begins here

As Site Compliance Lead, you will help create fair, responsible and legally compliant working conditions across Novo Nordisk construction sites in East Denmark. You will bring clarity to complex compliance matters, strengthen consistent practices and help project teams manage risk effectively. By guiding operational activities and addressing irregularities with sound judgement, you will support compliant, efficient and sustainable project execution at our sites in Hillerød, Bagsværd and Måløv.

What you’ll bring

You combine strong Site Compliance expertise with the confidence to coordinate activities across teams, contractors and other stakeholders. You can assess complex information, make timely decisions and communicate requirements clearly, including when conversations are challenging.

• A relevant technical background, for example as a construction engineer, marine engineer or in a comparable field.

• Several years of relevant compliance experience, preferably from construction, large-scale projects, a regulated industry or a similar operational environment.

• Knowledge of labour relations, employment legislation, working environment requirements and the legal and regulatory context for construction activities.

• Experience with compliance monitoring, investigations, risk assessments and the management of non-compliance cases.

• Experience coordinating or leading employees, teams or operational activities.

• Professional working proficiency in Danish and English.

You will also need integrity, discretion and strong professional judgement. You are comfortable working independently, balancing changing priorities and escalating significant issues when required.

What you’ll do

• Ensure right staffing of Site Compliance Consultants and Safety Induction Consultants at our 3 construction locations in East Denmark, currently Hillerød, Bagsværd and Måløv.

• Coordinate onboarding and training of consultants, helping colleagues apply requirements consistently in their daily work.

• Monitor contractor performance, identify patterns and emerging risks, prepare timely reports.

• Help ensure that contractors, suppliers and their employees comply with applicable Danish labour legislation and Novo Nordisk Site Compliance requirements.

• Manage compliance breaches and irregularities, applying professional judgement to assess risk and determine appropriate next steps.

jobs.occupation: Tech Lead, Video Conferencing & Screen Sharing
jobs.description:
Most companies that do conferencing hand you one slice of it. The desktop app, or the media pipeline, or, maybe, the join flow. Everything else you pass over a wall to another team. Not in this case. One team owns the whole path across the Airtame platform: Airtame 3, Airtame Go, Virtual Airtame, and browser, desktop, and mobile apps that go with them. The bar remains at an effortless experience. Someone walks into a room, and starts sharing. No app to hunt for, no login to chase.

The team is four engineers, and we're hiring their technical and people lead: someone who spends about 60% of time hands-on with the hardest problems, and the rest growing the engineers around them.

**About Airtame

**We're around 55 people, headquartered in Copenhagen, and you'd work from there or remotely from within the EU. We make the hardware and the software that runs on it, so a call you make about the streaming stack ends up in a product bolted to a wall in meeting rooms around the world. The team is small, works across disciplines, and reaches a global market from a small base.

Year one outcomes

Make joining a call one step that works. Today, getting an authenticated meeting started from a room takes too many turns: personal logins, manual entry, a different quirk on every platform. A year from now, starting a scheduled call on Teams, Zoom, Google Meet, or Webex should be something a room just does. Judge it by how often it works on the first try, and how rarely it reaches support.

Take the friction out of screen sharing. The browser path loses first-time users: too many clicks, not enough signposting. You'll own getting a newcomer from a short code to their screen on the wall without a stumble, and getting Miracast and AirPlay stable enough to turn on by default.

Make it behave the same everywhere. The experience varies between Airtame 3, Virtual Airtame, browser, desktop, and mobile today. By year-end, sharing and calling should feel like one product no matter which surface you're on, with real-time quality that holds up on whatever network the room happens to have.

Lead the team. You'll run the 1:1s, set the technical bar, and support team members' growth. The measure is simple: a year in, the team runs on your leadership day to day.

Push AI-assisted development further. The team already builds with AI daily. You'll lead the next step: sharper workflows, better tooling choices, new patterns that make the whole group faster. By year-end, the team's AI practices should be visibly ahead of where they started.

Who you are

• The player-coach. You've owned a team's technical direction: the architecture calls, the reviews where the hard problems get caught. And you want the people side too. Growing engineers, running 1:1s, hiring. You're not looking to trade one for the other. Maybe you've been a staff engineer or tech lead ready to own a team, or a manager who never stopped building. Either way, 60/40 sounds about right to you.

• Comfortable across the stack. Real-time media is second nature to you: WebRTC, streaming, the way audio and video behave over a network you don't control. You've gone deep somewhere, whether a media pipeline, native protocols, or a cross-platform client, and you can hold your own everywhere else, on browser, desktop, and mobile.

• You've made stubborn systems cooperate. Half this job is getting software to play nicely with platforms you don't own: Teams, Zoom, Meet, Webex, the operating system's own media APIs, each with its own idea of how things should go. You've done that kind of integration, and you keep your head when every platform behaves differently.

• You measure yourself by the room. Your bar is the person standing at the "share" button. Someone who's never seen an Airtame, getting their screen up first try with no help. That's what you optimize for, and it steers the calls you make when something has to give.

• You use AI as a daily tool. You write code with it, debug with it, prototype with it. You've formed your own view on where it speeds things up and where it gets in the way, and you help the people around you do the same.

**Logistics

**Location: Remote in Europe, or hybrid from our Copenhagen office.

Employment type: Full-time preferred. We're also open to a project-based contract scoped to delivering the native protocol implementations.

****Why Airtame:

• The defining calls are still ahead. Airtame's collaboration software keeps spreading across more devices and form factors, so the shape of the next phase is still open, and you'd be the one setting it.

• At our size, a major call you make shows up in front of customers within weeks, so the feedback comes back fast.

• A healthy work-life balance.

• Significant responsibility and ownership over projects and your field of expertise.

• Five weeks paid vacation and 5 days of extra paid AirtameFlex days.

• Flexible work environment, with a hybrid mindset.

• Pension and private health insurance (on FTE Copenhagen contract).

Airtame is an equal opportunity employer. We have colleagues across the globe, with both in-office and full-time remote workers. This feeds into our international hybrid mindset, with people from 25+ nationalities that make up the Airtame team.

Our work-life cultural balance is key to our success. Our team encompasses our values of trust and open communication to support each other and to collaborate in a fun and collective way.

****What Our Employment Decisions Are NOT Based On

****Race, colour, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, ethnicity, national origin, marital status, family or parental status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected classification or status. And we will not tolerate discrimination or harassment.

****What Our Employment Decisions ARE Based On

****Business needs, job requirements, individual qualifications, and candidates potential for growing with Airtame.

****How We Handle Your Application Data

****Airtame ApS (CVR 35478973, Copenhagen), together with Airtame US Inc. for US roles, processes the information you submit to assess your application. We do this under the EU General Data Protection Regulation, wherever you are based. Your data is stored in Greenhouse, our recruiting system, which may store it outside the EU under standard EU safeguards. Only the people involved in hiring can see it. For roles with privileged access to our systems, we’ll contact one professional reference or previous employer that you name, to confirm your role and dates. We’ll tell you before we do. We keep your data for 6 months after the recruitment process ends, or longer where US law requires it or where you consent to us keeping it for future roles. To get a copy of your data, correct or delete it, or object to how we use it, write to data@airtame.com. You can also complain to the Danish Data Protection Agency (Datatilsynet).

****Business needs, job requirements, individual qualifications, and candidates potential for growing with Airtame.

Job title / Headline

Marketing Automation Manager

Introduction

Are you a hands-on Marketing Automation Manager who enjoys turning customer data into personalised experiences and measurable business results?

At Scandlines, you will take ownership of developing our marketing automation capabilities across B2C and B2B, combining technical expertise with a commercial mindset to improve customer engagement, retention, and growth.

Job description

As part of our E-commerce & Digital Transformation team, you will drive the development and optimisation of our marketing automation activities.

You will work hands-on in Bloomreach (CDP & Marketing Automation) and HubSpot (CRM), designing and optimising automated customer journeys, activating customer data, and identifying new opportunities to improve customer experiences and commercial performance. Email content and production are handled by colleagues, allowing you to focus on marketing automation, segmentation, and personalisation.

You will also take ownership of our marketing automation roadmap, prioritising initiatives based on customer needs, business impact, and available resources.

The role involves close collaboration with colleagues across E-commerce, Marketing, IT, and external partners.

Area of responsiblities

• Own and develop the marketing automation roadmap, prioritising customer journeys and commercial impact across B2C and B2B.

• Design and optimise personalised, automated customer journeys in Bloomreach and HubSpot to drive engagement, retention, and repeat bookings.

• Activate customer data through segmentation and behavioural triggers to improve customer journeys across email, app, sms, website, and MyScandlines.

• Analyse customer behaviour and journey performance, using reporting and A/B testing to improve results.

• Maintain customer data quality, support integrations, and collaborate with internal stakeholders and external agencies to develop and implement automated customer journeys.

Competencies

You are an experienced marketing automation professional who combines strong technical skills with an analytical and commercial mindset.

You enjoy working directly in the platforms, but you also see the bigger picture and take responsibility for driving initiatives forward.

We expect that you:

• Have 4+ years of hands-on experience with marketing automation or CRM, either in-house or at an agency.

• Have solid experience with Bloomreach or similar platforms, such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, or Iterable.

• Ideally have experience with HubSpot, although this is not a requirement.

• Have strong experience with automated customer journeys, advanced segmentation, personalisation, and lifecycle marketing.

• Are comfortable working with customer data, reporting, performance metrics, and A/B testing.

• Understand CRM structures, workflows, lead management, and customer data integration.

• Have technical knowledge of HTML/CSS, email deliverability, and privacy regulations such as GDPR.

• Have a commercial mindset and can translate customer insights into initiatives that improve conversion, retention, and customer value.

• Experience from travel, e-commerce, or subscription-based businesses is an advantage.

Personal skills

You are proactive, structured, and solution-oriented, with a natural ability to take ownership and drive initiatives forward.

You enjoy collaborating across teams, challenging existing ways of working, and identifying opportunities for improvement.

Most importantly, you combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach and are motivated by turning ideas into meaningful results.

Additional information

Additional information

What we offer

We offer an exciting and challenging role in a dynamic, international organisation with high ambitions. You will join a digital and commercial team of dedicated colleagues in an informal working environment.

The role is based at our Copenhagen office (Havneholmen).

We offer a competitive salary based on your qualifications, along with a range of attractive employee benefits, including a pension scheme, health insurance, a staff canteen, additional days off, and various discount schemes.

**Job Requisition ID #

**26WD101877

**Principal Embedded Engineer, AI Solutions

****Position Overview

**Autodesk Technical Advisory is seeking a highly technical and customer-focused Embedded Engineer, AI Solutions to join our new Embedded Engineering (forward-deployed engineering) team.

You will work directly alongside strategic Autodesk customers to discover high-value workflows, model the data those workflows depend on, and build the AI systems for their Design & Make workflows to enable customer’s measurable business outcomes.

You will move fluidly from understanding a customer's workflow and architecture to writing code. You will spend your weeks writing production code to build agents and orchestration, retrieval and graph services, connectors and APIs - inside customer environments, alongside customer engineers. What you ship is concrete: AI agents, MCP servers and tools, domain and semantic models, knowledge-graph extensions, retrieval and context-resolution pipelines, integrations into ERP, PLM, BIM, enterprise data platforms, and eval harnesses to move new capabilities into production.

Unlike traditional project delivery, Embedded Engineering works deeply inside customer environments, connecting Autodesk technology and data with the rest of the enterprise. Insights developed through customer work will be translated into reusable agents, connectors, reference architectures, engineering patterns, and direct product feedback that shapes Autodesk's platform roadmap.

The successful candidate combines strong software and AI engineering skills with curiosity, customer empathy, business judgment, and the ability to operate independently when the problem is not yet well defined. This role is engagement-driven with travel up to 75% during active engagements, including extended periods working onsite with customers.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.

**Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed below.

**Responsibilities

****Discover Workflows and Own the Outcome

**

• Partner with customer executives, business leaders, and technical teams to translate transformation objectives, operational KPIs, sustainability commitments, and digital initiatives into measurable, AI-enabled workflow outcomes.

• Lead co-innovation with customers to find high-value workflows, decision bottlenecks, data requirements, and integration opportunities, turning ambiguous business challenges into clear technical directions.

• Analyze end-to-end workflows across Autodesk and non-Autodesk systems to pinpoint friction, process inefficiency, data gaps, and the places where AI and agents genuinely change the economics.

• Own technical execution end-to-end - rapid prototype through architecture, build, integration, testing, governance, production deployment guidance, and adoption - with accountability for customer impact.

• Sequence the work and decide what not to build. Make explicit trade-offs between scope, speed, and durability, and defend them to both customer and Autodesk stakeholder

**Make Data and Context AI-Ready

**

• Assess customer data readiness - fragmented sources, ownership, quality, lineage, metadata, governance, permissioning, and integration constraints - required to support trusted AI and agentic workflows.

• Structure and connect design intent, project, product, and asset data, along with requirements, supporting evidence, approvals, decisions, and dependencies, into trusted AI-ready data and context models that enable reasoning, retrieval, and agentic action.

• Design ontologies, semantic layers, and knowledge graphs that business users recognize and agents can act on, including entity resolution across source systems, schema mapping, and permission models that survive contact with enterprise reality.

**Build and Ship Production AI

**

• Design and build production-grade AI-enabled workflows, agents, applications, and integrations that connect Autodesk products and platform capabilities with customers' broader enterprise technology environments.

• Build the retrieval and context layer these systems depend on - hybrid search, graph-grounded retrieval, tool interfaces, and MCP servers that expose governed enterprise context to agents safely.

• Make quality measurable. Build evaluation harnesses, golden datasets, guardrails, tracing, and observability so that agent behavior is testable before launch and monitored after it, and so that quality regressions and drift are caught in production rather than reported by users.

• Apply strong engineering practices across architecture, code quality, security, permissions, reliability, observability, testing, performance, and maintainability, adapting quickly to complex and constrained customer environments.

• Define the operating model for what you build - runbooks, ownership, escalation, and cost - and hand it over cleanly to customer teams or Autodesk services so value persists after the engagement ends.

**Feed the Product and Build Reusable IP

**

• Act as a frontline product discovery mechanism, translating customer learning into prioritized product requirements, platform capability gaps, roadmap recommendations, and opportunities for feature or API acceleration.

• Convert customer-specific learning into reusable Autodesk value - reference architectures, agent and MCP patterns, connectors, ontology templates, graph models, reusable code, evals, and technical playbooks - that reduces the cost of every engagement that follows.

**Build an AI-Native Practice

**

• Design, build, and operationalize the agents, workflows, and automations that make the Embedded Engineering organization itself faster and more effective, measuring success by both customer impact and scalable internal leverage. Continuously look for manual work to replace with agentic systems and reusable internal tooling.

• Stay at the frontier. Maintain working knowledge of new model capabilities, agent implementation patterns, and AI product development stacks, and bring what's genuinely useful into practice.

• Serve as a trusted technical advisor across the boundary - partnering with customer engineers, architects, and business leaders, and with Autodesk Sales, Customer Success, Technical Advisory, Product, and Platform teams - to unblock delivery and help teams navigate ambiguity, trade-offs, risk, and changing requirements.

**Minimum Qualifications

**

• 6+ years building and operating production software, including 2+ in a customer-facing or embedded role (forward-deployed or founding engineer). CS/Engineering degree or equivalent hands-on experience.

• Full-stack range. Expert Python plus one of TypeScript, Java, or C# - comfortable across backend, data pipelines, integrations, and a lightweight React surface when a workflow needs one.

• Cloud fluency in Azure or AWS: containers, serverless, managed data stores, and identity and networking inside customer-governed environments (e.g., infrastructure as code with Terraform, Bicep, or CloudFormation), with strong API, distributed-systems, CI/CD, and observability fundamentals.

• Agentic systems in production. You've built and run single- and multi-agent systems - tool schemas, memory, human-in-the-loop checkpoints - on a modern orchestration framework (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain, Bedrock AgentCore, etc), MCP making practical cost and latency trade-offs (e.g., model selection, caching).

• Evaluation as engineering. You build golden datasets and eval harnesses from real customer data, and you measure groundedness, task success, and retrieval quality using standard tooling (e.g., RAGAS, LangSmith, Langfuse).

• Retrieval and data readiness. You've built retrieval systems end-to-end (chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking) over a vector store and can assess and fix messy enterprise data - lineage, permissions, entity resolution, schema mapping.

• Knowledge architecture for AI. You model domain semantics into AI-ready context - ontologies, semantic layers, knowledge graphs - and ground agents in it via GraphRAG or equivalent, using at least one graph technology (e.g., Azure Cosmos DB Gremlin, Amazon Neptune, Neo4j, or equivalent) and its query language (e.g. Gremlin, Cypher, SPARQL).

• Ownership under ambiguity. You take greenfield customer problems from framing to production and measured outcomes and can explain a non-deterministic system with equal credibility to an engineer and an executive.

**Work arrangement

**

• You'll work with one customer at a time on focused engagements, for specified duration, on-site at customer locations that may be outside your home country, with travel of up to 75%, subject to any immigration or other requirements (averages likely to be lower across the whole year). You remain an Autodesk employee throughout, and the intention is that Autodesk's policies, benefits, and time off apply on every assignment. Some customers may have their own onboarding, safety, security or other requirements, which will be discussed with you at the time.

**Preferred Qualifications

**

• Domain fluency in AECO, with the ability to ramp quickly on design-to-construction-to-operations processes.

• Autodesk platform fluency: Autodesk Platform Services (APS), AEC Data Model API, Autodesk Construction Cloud and Common Data Environment (CDE) concepts, Forma, Fusion, Flow, and Autodesk data models.

• Enterprise systems of record integration: ERP, PDM, PLM, BIM, project controls, cost, scheduling, and asset management, plus enterprise data platforms (data lakes, warehouses, Lakehouse, analytics platforms).

• Constrained enterprise deployment: customer VPCs, private, on-prem, or air-gapped environments, data residency and sovereignty requirements, SSO/SCIM, and formal security review processes.

• AI-native builder practice: routine use of AI coding agents, harnesses, and automation to multiply individual and team throughput, including spec-driven development: writing clear specs and executable acceptance criteria for coding agents, keeping changes small and reviewable, and verifying AI-generated code through automated tests and review.

• Production trust and safety: prompt-injection defense, permission-aware retrieval, provenance and audit trails, versioning, staged rollout, monitoring, and incident response.

**Ideal Candidate

**

• Ships. Has put things into production and can name the metric that moved.

• Treats evaluation as part of the product. Assumes agents will fail and builds evaluation, observability, and guardrails before scaling.

• Is fluent in both worlds. Understands the customer’s business process and the failure modes of non-deterministic systems.

• Thinks in reusable patterns. Instinctively asks, “How does this become an asset for the next ten customers?”

• Moves fast without leaving a mess. Knows when speed matters, when engineering rigor matters, and how to make that trade-off deliberately.

• Applying and maintaining the test process, define test strategies, write and review test cases and define test plans across projects

• Executing functional, integration, hardware-related and regression tests

• Contributing to the validation of hardware integrations such as sensors, radio interfaces and external systems

• Sharing knowledge through mentoring, workshops and coaching on test design and techniques

Joining the team

You will join the Bespoke Applications team: 18 developers, architects and a main tester, spread across Denmark and Poland. Together, we deliver software and hardware integrations – from sensor interfaces and radio drivers to interoperability with external systems – so that our customers get exactly the functionality they need, built to last.

You will work closely with fellow developers, architects, testers and project management, and with hardware partners and external system providers. We value open collaboration, sharing what we learn and speaking up with ideas for how we can improve our code, tooling and processes.

We already use AI in our daily work and want to explore it even further. Working in defence comes with limitations, but we do everything we are allowed to – and we need colleagues who are curious to join us on that journey.

Your qualifications

• Minimum a bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Software Technology or similar

• Two to five years of experience in software and/or systems testing, working in a structured environment with multiple team members, including test management and test design methods

• Experience driving test frameworks and test tools

• Familiarity with integrations, APIs, protocols and hardware validation setups

• Experience with tools such as JUnit, Playwright, Jira, Xray, Karma and TeamCity or similar

• ISTQB foundation certificate is preferred

• Fluent English skills

On a personal level, you:

• Have strong analytical abilities and think in terms of risk

• Work proactively and independently, and thrive in a team

• Build good relationships and collaborate effectively with stakeholders

• Are passionate about customer needs and how our systems are used

• Share information proactively and help others learn through mentoring and workshops

• Are curious about AI and eager to explore how it can help us work smarter within the boundaries of defence

The role includes occasional travel of approximately 2–10 days per year, mostly within Europe.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Anna Bacher, Manager Bespoke Development.

jobs.occupation: Senior Offshore Wind Turbine Loads & Structural Dynamics Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

Are you passionate about understanding how offshore wind turbines respond to the forces of nature? Do you want to use your engineering expertise to influence the design, performance and long-term reliability of offshore wind farms?

At Vattenfall, we believe there is a way to build a more sustainable energy future. We're looking for a Senior Offshore Wind Turbine Loads & Structural Dynamics Engineer to join our Structural Loads team within Offshore Engineering.

In this specialist role, you'll work at the heart of offshore wind turbine engineering, using engineering analysis, aeroelastic modelling and measurement data to investigate complex turbine behaviour and turn the results into sound engineering decisions.

From early development and turbine selection through to operational optimisation and lifetime extension, your expertise will help shape important technical decisions across our offshore wind portfolio.

You'll join an international team of engineering specialists who value collaboration, technical excellence and finding practical solutions to complex challenges.

Your Role

As a Senior Offshore Wind Turbine Loads & Structural Dynamics Engineer, you'll combine hands-on technical expertise with responsibility for delivering complex engineering work across offshore wind projects and operating assets.

Working closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, turbine manufacturers and external partners, you'll help ensure our offshore wind turbines are designed and operated safely, efficiently and reliably.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Advanced engineering analysis: Independently define, perform and technically own aeroelastic load analyses, including modelling strategy, execution, validation and interpretation, turning complex results into sound engineering conclusions and decisions.

• Structural integrity: Assess wind turbine and support-structure loading and independently investigate and resolve complex engineering questions relating to fatigue, structural performance and lifetime extension.

• Project delivery: Technically lead load-related engineering activities, ensuring technical deliverables meet project requirements, quality standards and deadlines, and act as the Structural Loads technical point of contact for assigned projects.

• Technical collaboration: Work closely with specialists across Wind Turbine Engineering, Primary Structures, Geotechnical Engineering and Metocean to solve multidisciplinary engineering problems where turbine loads, structural response and environmental conditions interact.

• Stakeholder engagement: Act as a trusted technical partner to internal stakeholders, understanding their needs and translating complex loads-related questions, risks and results into clear engineering recommendations that support project decisions.

• Innovation and improvement: Develop and refine simulation models, engineering tools and analysis methods to improve turbine performance, reduce technical risks and support continuous improvement.

Your Profile

We're looking for an experienced engineering specialist who can independently investigate and solve complex engineering problems, translating detailed analysis into well-founded engineering conclusions and practical solutions.

You'll bring a strong understanding of wind turbine aeroelasticity and structural dynamics, alongside the ability to take technical ownership, exercise sound engineering judgement and communicate complex technical matters clearly and effectively across different disciplines.

Qualifications

• A master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Wind Energy or a closely related discipline.

• At least 7 years of relevant industry experience in wind turbine aeroelasticity, load simulation or structural dynamics.

• Extensive hands-on experience defining and performing aeroelastic load analyses, including model development, simulation, validation, post-processing and interpretation of results.

• Strong knowledge of wind turbine aerodynamics, structural dynamics, control systems and load-generation mechanisms.

• Experience interpreting simulation results, validating engineering models and working with measurement data.

• Experience working within multidisciplinary engineering environments, ideally within offshore wind, turbine manufacturing or renewable energy development.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical findings and collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.

• Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

It would also be beneficial if you have experience in:

• Offshore wind turbine foundation design, hydrodynamics or coupled turbine-foundation analysis.

• Relevant IEC and DNV standards and certification processes.

• Engineering programming tools such as Python or MATLAB.

• Operational load assessments, turbine power upgrades or lifetime extension projects.

Above all, you'll bring curiosity, a careful and structured approach to engineering challenges, and a genuine interest in sharing knowledge and developing solutions together.

Additional Information

Our offer

Good remuneration, a challenging and international work environment, and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field. You will be working in interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues. We offer attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development.

More Information

We welcome your application in English, no later than 02/12/2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website as we cannot guarantee that we will be able to process applications that are not made via our website.

For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our recruiter Adam Hammond via adam.hammond@vattenfall.com

Commitment to Diversity

Vattenfall is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive community - a place where we can all be ourselves and succeed on merit. We offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, staff engagement forums and services to support all our employees.

We are convinced that diversity contributes to build a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Do you want to help turn operational data into reliable insights that support the safe and efficient operation of our wind assets? We’re looking for an OT O&M Manager for Information & Data to lead the services that make critical operational information available, reliable and ready to support better decisions across Business Area Wind.

Reliable operational information and data are essential for running and managing Business Area Wind’s assets. They enable operational decision-making, performance monitoring, reporting, engineering and the exchange of information with internal and external stakeholders.

We are looking for an OT O&M (Operation and Maintenance) Manager for Information & Data within the OT team in Business Area Wind. This is an operational management role with end-to-end accountability for the performance, availability, reliability and continuous improvement of this business-critical service area.

You do not need to be the technical expert in every information and data domain. You do, however, need a strong understanding of OT environments and data-driven services and the ability to lead technical teams, challenge and support specialists, set priorities, make decisions and ensure that issues are driven through to resolution.

For this role, leadership, Accountability and Proactivity are as important as technical understanding. You will create the structure and momentum needed to deliver reliable information and data services.

The OT Information & Data service area is responsible for making operational data and digital asset information available, reliable and usable across Business Area Wind. The service area connects local assets, fleet operations and enterprise consumers while supporting controlled information exchange with external authorities and joint-venture partners.

The scope includes operational data provisioning and integration, data quality management, enterprise engineering services, operational reporting, advanced data-driven solutions and lifecycle management of OT information and data.

Be in your element with BA Wind

As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets.

You won’t only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships.

Qualifications

Your role

You will take end-to-end ownership of the OT Information & Data service area and ensure that operational data and digital asset information remain available, reliable and usable for teams across Business Area Wind. You will set clear priorities for the service area, lead and develop service managers, engineers and domain experts, and create the governance needed to manage performance, risks, costs and dependencies. A key part of the role is to shape the service strategy and roadmap, balancing stable day-to-day delivery with lifecycle needs and the operationalisation of new data-driven solutions. Working across OT, Operations, IT, Cybersecurity, Engineering, projects and suppliers, you will bring the right expertise together, resolve issues and ensure improvements are followed through to completion.

Your tasks and responsibilities:

• Take end-to-end accountability for the OT Information & Data service area, including its performance, availability, reliability, cost and continuous improvement.

• Lead and develop the service area team, setting clear priorities and expectations while empowering service managers, engineers and domain experts to deliver within their areas of expertise.

• Drive operational performance, ensuring service risks, data-quality issues, dependencies and improvement needs are proactively identified, prioritised and followed through to resolution.

• Own the service strategy and roadmap, including priorities, budget, resources, lifecycle needs and the development of information and data services in line with Business Area Wind’s operational requirements.

• Manage the OT Information & Data service portfolio, ensuring reliable standard services while enabling new and advanced data-driven solutions to be operationalised and scaled.

• Provide effective operational governance, using service performance, risks, KPIs and expert input to make decisions, manage priorities and ensure clear accountability.

• Manage stakeholders and interfaces across Business Area Wind, bringing together data and analytics, OT, Operations, IT, Cybersecurity, Engineering, projects, suppliers and business stakeholders to resolve issues and deliver results.

• Drive continuous improvement in services, processes, data quality and ways of working, ensuring OT Information & Data remains reliable and fit for future business needs.

Your profile / who are you?

You combine a solid understanding of OT information and data environments with leadership experience from complex operational settings. You are comfortable taking Accountability for a broad service area without needing to be the technical expert in every domain. Instead, you create clarity, set priorities and empower specialists to deliver within their areas of expertise. With Proactivity, Collaboration, Composure and a Solution-Oriented approach, you use performance information, risks and expert input to make informed decisions and keep topics moving. You build strong relationships across technical teams, business functions and suppliers, and you are motivated by improving service reliability, data quality and ways of working over time.

Next to this you bring:

• Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in operational management, O&M, IT/OT service management, information and data management, engineering management or asset management, preferably within energy or another asset-intensive industry.

• Experience leading technical teams or services in a complex operational environment, with a track record of improving performance and driving issues through to resolution.

• A good understanding of OT information and data environments, sufficient to lead specialists, understand risks and dependencies, challenge recommendations and make informed decisions.

• Strong service-management capabilities, including operational performance, governance, risk management, lifecycle planning and continuous improvement.

• Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical teams, business functions, suppliers and management.

• A relevant degree in engineering, technology, information or data management, business or a similar discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Company Description

Vattenfall is a leading European energy company driving the transition to a sustainable energy system. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years. We employ around 21 000 people mostly in our core markets in Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK.

Head of Group FP&A

At Salling Group, we are on an ambitious growth journey. As we continue to grow across markets, formats and businesses, the ability to connect performance, investments and strategic priorities becomes increasingly important.

We are looking for a Head of Group FP&A to lead and further develop our Group-wide financial planning and performance management agenda. This is one of the most impactful leadership roles in Finance, offering a unique opportunity to shape how financial insights support decisions, prioritization and long-term value creation across the Group.

The role

As Head of Group FP&A, you will lead a strong team and play a key role in strengthening how we understand, plan and improve business performance across Salling Group. You will help create a more connected view of performance, ensuring that financial and operational insights are translated into actions that make a difference.

Reporting directly to the CFO, you will be part of the Finance Leadership Team and our Global Finance Board. In close collaboration with business leaders and finance teams across our organization, you will help shape decisions related to performance, investments, growth opportunities and resource allocation.

This role is about much more than reporting and budgeting. It is about challenging assumptions, identifying opportunities, developing future finance talent and helping the business navigate an increasingly dynamic environment.

**

What you will be responsible for**

You will play a central role in:

• Driving Group-wide performance management, ensuring transparent and relevant insights that support better business decisions across markets and formats.

• Further developing our planning, budgeting and forecasting approach to create greater alignment between financial targets, business priorities and investments.

• Leading the Group's capital allocation and investment governance processes, helping prioritize opportunities and create transparency around value creation.

• Strengthening the focus on working capital and cash performance through clear governance, follow-up and business engagement.

• Supporting strategic initiatives, business cases, acquisitions and integration activities through robust financial analysis and performance insights.

• Developing a high-performing FP&A team while helping build the next generation of finance leaders across Salling Group, including ownership of our Finance Graduate Programme.

**

Your profile**

You are an experienced finance leader who combines analytical strength with commercial understanding and the ability to create followership across a complex organization. Experience from retail, FMCG or similarly operational businesses is an advantage, but not a requirement.

We imagine that you:

• Have a strong track record of driving performance management and planning processes in a complex organization.

• Understand how financial results are created through commercial and operational decisions.

• Are comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders and challenging established thinking when needed.

• Have experience leading and developing high-performing teams.

• Enjoy building talent and creating opportunities for others to grow.

• Combine curiosity, pragmatism and business judgement with a strong drive to create impact.

**

What we offer**

• A key leadership role at the center of one of the Nordic region's largest retail groups.

• The opportunity to work closely with executive management on some of the most important decisions across the business.

• Significant influence on how performance management, planning and investment decisions evolve across the Group.

• The chance to lead a strong team and help develop future finance leaders.

• A collaborative and ambitious culture where people support each other and enjoy working together.

**

Are you curious?**

If you have any questions about the position you can contact Group CFO, Thomas Børglum Jensen +4521210166 or Senior People & Culture Business Partner, Louise Lærke on +45 28296362.

Please send us your CV and application as soon as possible as we reserve the right to remove the job advert when we have found the right candidate.

This position is based in Aarhus, Denmark. Travelling will be expected.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About Salling Group

Salling Group is one of the largest retailers in the Nordics, with approximately 70,000 employees and more than 2,100 stores across six European countries. Through our Aspire '28 strategy, we have set an ambitious direction for continued growth and development. Owned by the Salling Foundations, our profits are either reinvested in the business or donated to charitable causes. We are driven by a simple ambition: making everyday life better for our customers.

We are looking for an engineer who wants to build the foundation of our new Integrations effort: the connectors that bring our customers' data from third-party systems into the Trackunit platform. The connectors you build directly support our new partnership business, one of our key goals for next year. You will be among the first developers on this project, designing a reusable architecture and working directly with the engineers behind the systems we connect to, as well as seeing customer feedback shape what you build next. You might have a couple of years or be an experienced senior engineer, either way, we would be interested in seeing your application for this role.

**What's in it for you?

**

• Shape how the work gets done. Join a new, small team set up next to an established platform team, and help define how integrations get built here.

• Hear directly from the people using what you build. Customer feedback feeds straight back into the roadmap, and we act on it quickly.

• Collaborate beyond your own codebase. You’ll have regular, technically focused conversations with developers from the systems we connect to.

• Learn from experts who share. You’ll work with experienced domain experts who are open to sharing what they know, so you learn quickly.

• See your work ship. We favour small, frequent releases over long project cycles, so progress is visible fast.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a backend developer with strong Java skills, just as comfortable at the edges where systems meet as inside your own codebase.

• Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and REST APIs, in particular consuming data from other systems, in a microservice architecture.

• Experience designing new, reliable, reusable architecture for integrating with multiple systems. System-to-system integration experience is what we value most.

• You are comfortable discussing technical feasibility and approaches with third-party technical teams.

• You care what happens when data moves between systems, so you build with quality, observability and reliability in mind and you know quickly when something breaks.

• You are motivated by incremental delivery, enjoy getting close to the data, and like building new foundations from scratch.

You embrace AI as part of how you engineer. From prototyping through to production, you use AI tools as an integrated part of your workflow, not as a shortcut but as a force multiplier. That said, this isn't the main thing we're hiring for: curiosity and a willingness to use it well matter more than deep prior experience.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Design a reusable architecture for integrating with multiple third-party systems, not one-off solutions.

Your role
