Experience building and operating production platforms at scale? Help shape the data platform behind energy trading through technical leadership, architectural influence and mentoring fellow engineers

Here’s what the job entails

In the role, your primary function will be to design, build and run critical parts of our internal data platform. Alongside hands-on delivery, you will influence the team's design decisions, challenge existing approaches, set the bar for engineering quality and mentor colleagues. As the platform is being modernized now, your work will have broad influence on its development and direct impact on our trading activities.

More specifically, your responsibilities include:

• designing and building core platform capabilities across cloud data infrastructure, .NET and streaming platforms that enable data to move through the business, or across our machine-learning platform and feature store

• making the platform reliable and observable on performance, capacity, cost, monitoring and incident follow-up

• reviewing and challenging architecture and design decisions, bringing in practices from outside Danske Commodities

• mentoring engineers in the team and helping newer colleagues get productive quickly

• building self-service 'golden paths' so other teams can build on the platform without waiting for us

You join a team building the data platform every data engineer and quant at Danske Commodities works on - early enough to shape its architecture, with a mandate to challenge how we do things today. (Erik Hjælm Skole, Head of Data Platform Engineering)

Meet your team

You will join our Data Platform Infrastructure team, where we build and run the shared platform capabilities that Danske Commodities builds on. Our primary responsibilities include compute platforms, streaming infrastructure, the data ingestion framework, machine learning infrastructure and hosted data tooling. We make it fast and safe for other teams to build with data by providing the platform capabilities they rely on.

We are a newly formed team of four experienced engineers, growing to nine team members. Our backgrounds are currently within software engineering, cloud infrastructure and data-science platforms. We work with Python, C#/.NET and Rust, test-driven and with a strong focus on automation. We always seek to build things our users want to use, not just things they have to use.

But enough about us… over to you!

As you will be influencing the direction of our data platform and the way we build software, we imagine that you are solution-oriented and see opportunities where others see problems. You enjoy taking ownership, driving improvement and constructively challenging existing approaches when needed. At the same time, you are motivated by helping others succeed and sharing your knowledge with fellow engineers.

Furthermore, we imagine that you:

• hold a relevant educational background within computer science, software engineering or similar – or equivalent practical experience

• have a minimum of 8 years’ experience as a software engineer building and operation production systems

• are proficient in C#/.NET and Python

• have deep hands-on experience with cloud, containers, infrastructure as code and CI/CD (e.g. Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions)

• are proficient in English - both written and spoken

Please note that prior knowledge of the energy sector is not required for this role.

We’ll take good care of you

Do you love designing clean game architecture, building multiplayer systems that run smoothly, and helping a team of programmers make the right technical decisions? Great! Let’s talk.

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

We're building something unannounced, exciting, thoroughly goofy, and built to be played together online. We're now looking for a Lead Game Programmer to help building the underlying systems that make it all work, from the core architecture to the multiplayer tech that connects our players. You'll stay hands-on in the code and the Unity editor while helping the programming team make good technical decisions, stay aligned, and build systems that support creative experimentation. And just to be very clear: this is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.

Here’s what that looks like day to day

• In collaboration with game designers, artists, and other programmers, you’ll build new features and systems and continuously iterate on improvements. We all work in Unity with C#, with every team member hands-on in the editor

• You’ll set and communicate the project’s technical direction, turning creative goals and production needs into clear technical priorities

• You’ll help the programming team make architectural decisions, align around shared patterns, and navigate trade-offs between long-term code health and short-term needs

• You’ll review and improve technical solutions, share best practices, and support other programmers without becoming a gatekeeper or bottleneck

• You’ll proactively identify technical risks, messy systems, and missing foundations, and take responsibility for addressing them at the right time

• Overall, you’ll make sure the project is technically healthy and maintain the codebase in a way that makes it easy for others to build on

This includes things like...

• Designing an architecture that allows for easy gameplay implementation and flexibility

• Implementing and maintaining online features such as matchmaking, invites and friends

• Profiling and improving network performance, bandwidth and latency, and making sure the game holds up on real-world connections

• Breaking down complex technical challenges, helping decide what to prioritise, and ensuring important decisions are understood by the people they affect

• Staying close to the actual game: writing production code, debugging difficult problems, and improving systems as the project evolves

You’re a great match if

• You have at least ten years of professional game development experience across multiple shipped games and different stages of development, including significant technical ownership or leadership on a project

• You have experience setting technical direction and helping a programming team make and implement architectural decisions, with strong judgment in balancing flexibility, maintainability, performance and the needs of a creative production

• You're highly proficient in C# and have deep knowledge of the Unity engine and editor

• You've shipped at least one online multiplayer game, had real ownership of its networking/online systems, and have hands-on experience with a Unity multiplayer framework (e.g., Coherence)

• You communicate clearly and can explain technical decisions and trade-offs to programmers and non-programmers alike

Nice to haves

• You have experience shipping iOS and macOS apps, including hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and the Game Controller framework using Xcode and Swift

• Experience with backend services, dedicated servers or cloud hosting for online games

• Interest in multiplayer game design and social features

• Experience working with automated build pipelines such as Jenkins

• Experience building systemic or open-world games

What always matters to us at Triband

• You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

• You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness and creativity while actively contributing to sustaining that culture

• You believe games are made by teams, not rockstars and that great ideas can come from anyone

• You bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test them

• You love exploration and experimentation but don’t get too precious when the evidence tells you you’re wrong

• You value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place to be

Practicalities

• We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

• For this role we also consider people located outside of Denmark and provide financial (and moral!) support with visa application and relocation.

• We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

• Our working language is English.

We offer

• Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.

• A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.

• Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.

• A professional development budget to invest in your growth.

• Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.

• Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

• Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).

• Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.

• Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.

• Pension plan and private health insurance.

• Endless amounts of Faxe Kondi.

WHAT THE TRIBAND?

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn't always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games, and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

For more info about Triband, check out: triband.net/about

jobs.occupation: Medical Scientific Advisor Gyn GU GI (GGG) Denmark – Nordic Marketing Company
jobs.description:
Are you driven to transform cancer care by turning science into real-world change? In this role, you will connect cutting-edge evidence with clinical practice, helping physicians make well informed and confident decisions that improve outcomes for people living with cancer and those who care for them. Your work will accelerate the adoption of appropriate therapies by removing diagnostic and pathway bottlenecks through credible, balanced scientific engagement.

Our AstraZeneca Nordic Marketing Company employs around 550 people and has offices located in Copenhagen, Stockholm, Oslo, and Espoo. AstraZeneca Nordic is a recognized leader in its core therapy areas and aims to improve the lives of millions of people. This is an area where you are free to be more – you are encouraged to challenge traditional ways and test your curiosity. We drive innovative science, deliver key launches, build close collaboration and partnerships within health care.

As the therapy-area medical expert for your country, you will lead in-country scientific engagement and execute medical strategy with precision. You will collaborate closely with the Therapeutic Area Lead and country medical leadership, leveraging Nordic alignment to amplify impact. Using digital and AI-enabled tools to strengthen preparation, literature synthesis and insight capture—while upholding scientific integrity and compliance, you will turn external learning into action. Can you see yourself building trusted partnerships that shape launches and elevate standards of care?

This role is field based.

Accountabilities:

• Scientific Engagement: Develop and execute the country scientific engagement plan, building trusted relationships with experts, societies, investigators and healthcare stakeholders.

• Scientific Exchange: Lead balanced, non-promotional scientific dialogue, respond compliantly to unsolicited requests and manage advisory boards in line with procedures.

• Insight Generation: Identify pathway bottlenecks, diagnostic gaps and adoption barriers; translate insights into recommendations for strategy, evidence generation, launches and access.

• Launch & Transforming Care: Support launch readiness, medical education, scientific narrative development, objection handling and initiatives that address healthcare-system needs.

• Evidence & Clinical Trials: Identify local evidence gaps, support RWE and externally sponsored research, and contribute to clinical-trial feasibility, site engagement and delivery.

• Market Access Support: Provide scientific input to HTA, formulary and protocol submissions, guidelines and appropriate-use initiatives.

• Governance & Internal Enablement: Ensure compliance with local codes, SOPs and ethical standards; support medical review, pharmacovigilance and inspection readiness.

• Medical Expertise & Collaboration: Act as a therapy-area subject-matter expert, deliver scientific training and collaborate effectively with cross-functional and Nordic teams.

Essential Skills and Experience

• Advanced life-sciences degree, such as MSc, PharmD, MD or PhD.

• Proven deliverables for the experience in the relevant therapy area and scientific stakeholder engagement.

• Strong ability to generate insights, synthesize evidence and translate findings into action.

• Understanding of clinical trials, evidence generation and medical support for market access.

• Excellent scientific communication, influencing and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• Ability to use digital and AI-enabled tools with scientific rigor, compliance and sound judgment.

• Valid driver’s license as this is a field-based position.

• Fluency in the local language and English.

Desirable Skills and Experience

• PhD, MD, MBA or other relevant advanced qualifications.

• Proven successful pharmaceutical Medical Affairs experience, particularly in pre-launch or launch environments.

• Proven impactful collaborations in clinical trials, RWE or externally sponsored research.

• Experience supporting HTA, formulary or protocol submissions.

• Eligibility for local material certification.

• Proficiency with analytics, insight platforms and relevant management systems.

Inclusion & Diversity

We are proud to have a unique workplace culture that inspires innovation and collaboration! Here, employees are empowered to express diverse perspectives - and are made to feel valued, energized and rewarded for their ideas and creativity.

Why AstraZeneca

Join a team where science and strategy come together to change how cancer is treated. You will collaborate closely with clinicians, biostatisticians, data scientists, market access experts and more—often in the same room—turning evidence into practice that improves every step of the patient journey. We empower bold ideas, learn fast from what works, and back ambition with support, valuing kindness alongside high standards. With a strong and diverse oncology pipeline, opportunities to shape real-world evidence, and a culture of openness and learning, your expertise will directly influence clinical decisions and accelerate meaningful progress for patients, science and society.

So, what is next:

If you’re ready to use your scientific voice to shape oncology care and see your insights turn into better outcomes, send your application and take the next step today!

Welcome with your application, in English, latest by the 22nd of November 2026

Where can I find out more?

Follow AstraZeneca on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/1603/

Inclusion & Diversity: Inclusion and diversity

Career site: https://careers.astrazeneca.com/

Websites for Nordic Marketing Company:

Sweden: https://www.astrazeneca.se

Denmark: AstraZeneca Denmark

Norway: AstraZeneca Norway

Finland: AstraZeneca Finland

AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity.  We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills.  We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be.  We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics.  We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

Our Philosophy

AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused pharmaceutical company committed to excellence in the research, development and commercialisation of prescription medicines. With approximately 90,000 people in 85 countries, our aim is simple: to unlock the power of what science can do, for people, society and the planet. From Clinical Development, Regulatory and Medical Affairs to Finance, IT, Digital, Manufacturing and Supply, the opportunities to make an impact are limitless. Our workforce reflects the diversity of the patients we serve – it is embedded in everything we do. We're at our best and most creative when we seek out different perspectives, experiences and strengths. At AstraZeneca, you'll have the chance to grow your abilities, skills and knowledge constantly in a place that never stands still. Discover why we're a great place to work and see what science — and you — can do.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**Why this role is important

**The Principal SaaS Solution Advisor plays a critical role in supporting the growth of SimCorp's SaaS and SimCorp One offerings across new and existing client opportunities. Working closely with Sales, Account Management, and internal product and delivery teams, you act as a trusted advisor to prospects — guiding them through the strategic, commercial, and operational considerations of adopting a cloud-hosted, managed investment management platform.

Your focus is to shape and progress opportunities across the full presales lifecycle, from initial discovery and solution scoping through to RFP responses, tailored demonstrations, and competitive positioning. You bring both deep product fluency across SimCorp's evolving portfolio and genuine industry expertise, enabling you to engage credibly at the senior level and position SimCorp's SaaS and SimCorp One offering as a compelling answer to the challenges reshaping the investment management industry.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

****Discovery & Scoping

**

• Engage prospects in structured discovery to understand their operating model, technology estate, regulatory environment, and strategic priorities.

• Translate functional and non-functional requirements into an indicative SaaS or SimCorp One solution scope, covering platform configuration, data services, connectivity, and managed service boundaries.

• Identify and document client-specific pain points and map them to SimCorp differentiators — including the SimCorp One open platform model, continuous delivery, and the reduced total cost of ownership relative to on-premise alternatives.

• Surface potential fit gaps early and provide structured feedback to Product and SaaS Operations.

**RFPs & Commercial Responses

**

• Lead or contribute to RFP responses for SaaS and SimCorp One opportunities, with focus on deployment model, service levels, data residency, security posture, and total cost of ownership.

• Articulate the SaaS and SimCorp One commercial model clearly — subscription structure, included services, upgrade inclusion, and open ecosystem positioning — in a way that resonates with procurement, finance, and technology stakeholders.

• Build and maintain a knowledge base of SaaS and SimCorp One RFP responses, keeping content current and aligned with contractual and operational commitments.

**Workshops, Scoping & Solution Validation

**

• Plan and deliver tailored workshops, scoping sessions, and architecture design discussions that help prospects understand the SimCorp One SaaS operating model, deployment approach, and managed service boundaries.

• Prepare and present compelling service descriptions, solution presentations, and platform overviews — adapting content and depth to the audience, from operational teams to C-level stakeholders.

• Design and facilitate workshops covering topics such as the shared responsibility model, release management, environment strategy, and the SimCorp One partner and data ecosystem.

• Where appropriate, support Solution Validation engagements, defining scope and success criteria aligned to the prospect's decision framework.

**SimCorp One & SaaS Proposition

**

• Develop and maintain deep knowledge of SimCorp One — its open platform architecture, API-first design, partner integrations, and the strategic direction of moving clients from on-premise deployments toward a composable, cloud-native operating model.

• Articulate clearly how SimCorp One differs from traditional SaaS delivery: the ability to connect third-party solutions, consume data services, and operate within a broader fintech ecosystem while retaining SimCorp Dimension as the investment book of record.

• Engage confidently with CTO, COO, and CIO-level stakeholders on cloud strategy, platform extensibility, vendor dependency, and the long-term operating model implications of the SimCorp One platform.

• Understand and articulate the value of SimCorp One Neo — SimCorp's embedded AI layer — including its agentic workflows, prompt library, and human-in-the-loop design, and position these capabilities as part of the broader SaaS and SimCorp One value proposition in client conversations.

**How You Contribute To The Team

**

• Partner closely with Sales Specialists and Account Management to ensure consistent and compelling messaging to prospects and business partners.

• Provide feedback on competitive positioning and product gaps based on prospect and market insights.

• Coordinate with broader presales and delivery colleagues to ensure continuity and quality across the opportunity lifecycle.

• Contribute to the ongoing improvement of SaaS and SimCorp One Solution Advisory tooling, decks and material.

**What We Value

**Most importantly, you see yourself thriving in the role described above. How you acquired the relevant skills matters less than your ability and willingness to apply them and continue learning.

Ideally, you bring experience in several of the following areas:

• A minimum of 7 years’ experience in investment management technology, in a presales, solution advisory, or senior implementation capacity.

• Deep understanding of buy-side operating models across asset managers, asset owners, insurance companies, or wealth managers — including front-to-back investment workflows, data management, and the pressures driving technology transformation.

• Fluency in industry trends such as fee compression, the shift to alternatives, T+1 settlement, cloud adoption, and evolving regulatory frameworks (e.g. DORA, AIFMD, MiFID).

• Strong knowledge of SimCorp Dimension, SimCorp One, or competing front-to-back investment management platforms.

• Solid grounding in enterprise and solution architecture — able to engage credibly with client architects, CTOs, and IT leadership on integration patterns, data design, and platform decisions, and to translate technical complexity into clear business value narratives.

• Familiarity with cloud platforms and deployment models, including public cloud providers (Azure, AWS, or GCP), hybrid and private cloud strategies, and the considerations financial services firms face around cloud adoption, data residency, and operational resilience.

• Understanding of the broader investment technology stack — including APIs and event-driven integration, data and analytics platforms, reference and market data management, and how these components interact within a modern front-to-back architecture.

• Experience operating in complex, consultative, multi-stakeholder sales environments.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt messaging from operational to C-level audiences.

• Proficiency in PowerPoint and standard sales tooling.

• Comfort working with AI tools and a demonstrated ability to adopt and apply emerging technologies and methods — translating new capabilities into practical value in a client-facing context.

• Language skills: English required; additional European languages are advantageous.

**Benefits

**SimCorp provides a range of benefits that may influence decisions regarding job offers. With operations in more than 30 offices globally, the benefits package can differ depending on the country. SimCorp implements a global hybrid work policy, requiring employees to be in the office two days per week and permitting remote work on other days. Additional information about location-specific benefits is available from the recruiter.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually.

Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.

At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

jobs.occupation: Product Owner - Shape the Future of Industrial Ice Cream Filling
jobs.description:
At Gram Equipment, we develop the technology behind ice cream products enjoyed by people around the world.

As a global provider of equipment and complete production solutions for the ice cream industry, we combine more than a century of experience with innovation, technical expertise and close customer collaboration. Our filling solutions help customers produce cups, cones, tubs and other filled products efficiently, reliably and at high quality.

We are now looking for a Product Owner to help develop and strengthen our filling product portfolio with emphasis on the Flexline product.
Your Role
As Product Owner – Flexline, you will take technical ownership of our filling product portfolio and play a central role in its continued development.

You will connect customer requirements, market opportunities and operational experience with engineering and product development. Working closely with Product Management, Engineering, Automation, Sales, Projects, Production and Service, you will ensure that our filling solutions remain competitive, reliable and aligned with customer needs.

You will maintain the product roadmap, prioritize improvements and support projects throughout the value chain—from quotation and technical clarification to production, commissioning and lifecycle support.

The role does not include direct personnel responsibility. Your influence comes through your product expertise, judgment and ability to create alignment across functions.
Key ResponsibilitiesProduct Ownership and Roadmap
• Maintain and develop the roadmap for Gram Equipment’s filling product portfolio.
• Identify and prioritize product improvements based on customer needs, field experience, market developments and business priorities.
• Define product requirements and help translate strategic priorities into concrete development activities.
• Monitor competitor technologies and identify relevant performance or technology gaps.
• Maintain product standards and ensure that approved improvements are implemented and sustained.Technical and Cross-Functional Execution
• Support project reviews, design approvals, technical clarifications and decisions concerning product interfaces.
• Ensure that project-specific solutions remain aligned with product standards, technical feasibility, safety, cost and delivery requirements.
• Coordinate closely with mechanical engineering, automation, production, assembly and project management.
• Support testing, validation and commissioning and use the resulting learning to improve the product portfolio.
• Contribute to the resolution of complex technical and field-performance issues.Commercial and Customer Support
• Support Sales and Internal Sales with quotations, equipment selection, configurations and technical customer dialogue.
• Participate in customer meetings and communicate product capabilities, options and technical limitations clearly.
• Balance filling performance, customer value, reliability, standardization and commercial competitiveness.
• Develop an understanding of customer applications and production requirements and use this insight to strengthen future solutions.Product Lifecycle Management
• Maintain relevant product specifications, documentation, equipment structures and product data.
• Coordinate product changes and ensure that decisions are properly documented, released and communicated.
• Support standardization and lifecycle management across existing and future filling platforms.
• Ensure that products comply with relevant food-safety, hygienic-design, machine-safety and regulatory requirements.Your Profile
We are looking for someone who combines strong technical understanding with product ownership, commercial awareness and an interest in working across the organization.

You bring:

• A relevant technical education, preferably within mechanical engineering, process technology, production engineering or a comparable field.
• Experience with product ownership, product development, mechanical engineering or technical project execution within industrial machinery or a related industry.
• A good understanding of mechanical equipment, machine interfaces and the interaction between mechanics and automation.
• Experience with hygienic equipment, food production or filling and dosing technology is an advantage.
• The ability to understand customer applications and translate technical and commercial needs into product requirements and practical solutions.
• A structured approach to product roadmaps, technical decisions, documentation and follow-up.
• Commercial awareness and an understanding of how product decisions influence customer value, project performance and lifecycle cost.
• Strong collaboration and communication skills and the ability to influence decisions without formal authority.
• Good written and spoken English.
Experience with Inventor, Vault, AutoCAD, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or comparable engineering and ERP systems would be an advantage.

Above all, you are curious about how products perform in real customer environments. You enjoy developing technical knowledge, asking questions and bringing people together around solutions that work across the full value chain.
What We Offer
• A central role with genuine influence on the future direction of Gram Equipment’s filling portfolio with emphasis on the Flexline product.
• The opportunity to combine technology, customer insight, commercial understanding and product development.
• Close cooperation with experienced specialists across Engineering, Automation, Sales, Production, Projects and Service.
• An international working environment with customers and colleagues across global markets.
• Opportunities for professional development and increasing product responsibility.
• An informal and collaborative workplace where knowledge sharing and practical improvement are valued.
• Competitive employment conditions aligned with your experience and qualifications.
The position is based at our headquarters in Kolding, Denmark. You should expect approximately 0–30 travel days per year, primarily for customer meetings, technical clarification, commissioning support and product validation.
Apply Now
Would you like to take ownership of filling technology and help turn customer needs, market insight and engineering expertise into competitive product solutions?

Join Gram Equipment and help shape the next generation of industrial ice cream filling equipment.

**Job Description

**In Credit Risk Model Validation (CRMV), we are reimagining model risk management across Danske Bank, moving from manual data wrangling, ad hoc scripts, and copied notebooks towards an industrialised, reproducible, AI-accelerated quantitative engineering ecosystem.

To realise this vision, we are looking for a Senior Model Validation Quant who bridges quantitative model validation and software and infrastructure engineering. You will combine strong quantitative skills with sound engineering practices to validate models, build our core validation software, and configure modern cloud workflows.

Enabling the team to perform high-quality, repeatable validations is as important as running them yourself. Your initial focus will be roughly 70% direct model validation and 30% tooling and infrastructure engineering, adapting as our platform and automation mature.

You will join a skilled, collaborative, forward-thinking team of risk professionals migrating to GitHub Enterprise Cloud and Databricks, building modular internal Python packages, configuring Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs) and GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows, and using GitHub Copilot as a daily engineering partner.

**What you will be doing:

**

• Perform and lead model validations: independently validate credit risk models (e.g. PD, LGD, CF, and IFRS 9), assessing conceptual soundness, statistical performance, and model limitations.

• Build and evolve validation software: design, implement, and maintain core Python packages and shared libraries that translate quantitative methodologies into clean, parameter-driven, testable tools.

• Enable the department: create tools and automated templates that help fellow validators run analyses, generate standard evidence bundles, and produce publication-ready PDF reports with minimal manual effort.

• Design modern workflows and infrastructure: set up and manage GitHub Actions workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs) for automated, audit-ready execution across environments.

• Integrate AI-assisted engineering: use GitHub Copilot extensively each day to accelerate code delivery, write comprehensive test suites, and modernise legacy codebases.

• Promote engineering excellence: promote sound version control practices, structured code reviews, and reproducible analyses across the team.

• Engage key stakeholders: clearly and persuasively present technical architectures, quantitative findings, and validation conclusions to model developers, risk leaders, and regulatory counterparts.

**About you:

**

• Quantitative grounding: you have an MSc or PhD, or equivalent practical experience, in a quantitative discipline (e.g. mathematics, statistics, computer science, physics, quantitative finance, data science, or engineering).

• Strong coding practices: you have solid practical experience writing clean, modular Python and SQL code.

• Collaborative version control (Git is essential): you are confident with Git branching strategies, pull requests, automated checks, and collaborative code reviews.

• Infrastructure and automation mindset: you have practical experience with, or a strong interest in learning, platforms such as Databricks (including DABs) and GitHub Actions.

• Enthusiasm for AI tooling: you are keen to use GitHub Copilot daily to enhance your workflow. Prior experience is a plus, but curiosity and openness to AI-assisted coding matter most.

• Bridge-builder mindset: you enjoy combining quantitative modelling with software engineering and switching between building infrastructure and exploring model mechanics.

• Clear communicator: you communicate clearly and warmly in English, translating technical and mathematical nuances into accessible insights for colleagues with varied backgrounds.

**What we offer you:

**This position can be located both in Denmark and Lithuania. If the position is located in Lithuania, the salary range will be from 3280 EUR to 4920 EUR gross (based on your competencies relevant for the job) and your contractual job title will be Risk Methodology & Model Validation.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**Does this sound like the opportunity you have been looking for? We would like to hear from you.

If you have any questions, please contact Morten Gadegaard Jørgensen mojrg@danskebank.dk

Are you a hands-on, security focused engineer ready to help build a technical security foundation? If you thrive on turning compliance frameworks into real-world technical control while staying closely connected to daily operations, this job is for you.

Working closely with our Head of IT and Security, you will turn our ISMS (ISO/IEC 27001, NIS2, and the EU AI Act) into operating technical reality by designing, implementing, and operating the controls, tooling, and secure configurations that protect Space Inventor across our Corporate, Missions, and SatOPS zones. This is a role focused on establishing new capabilities rather than maintaining an existing setup. Alongside hands-on security engineering, you will co-own and deliver day-to-day IT support, keeping you grounded in user needs and the operational reality of our environment.

Given Space Inventors work you must be eligible for a Danish Personnel Security Clearance.

The job is located in Aalborg, Denmark.

Your Responsibilities

• Core Security & Tooling: Design, implement, and operate core security controls and tooling (EDR, logging/SIEM, vulnerability management, email, and endpoint security).

• Identity & Access Management: Build and harden the identity foundation (Entra ID security, MFA, Conditional Access, PAM, Windows LAPS, and access governance).

• Hardening & Infrastructure: Establish endpoint and server hardening baselines (CIS benchmarks) enforced via Intune; support secure design for infrastructure rebuilds and Entra ID/M365 migrations.

• Network & Zone Security: Implement network security and segmentation across our three zones (Corporate, Missions, SatOPS), including the overlay for OT and the SatOPS ground segment.

• Vulnerability Management & Incident Response: Scan, prioritize, remediate, and verify vulnerabilities; build detection, alerting, playbooks, and hands-on investigation/recovery.

• Automation & Architecture: Automate security operations via PowerShell/scripting; contribute to technical roadmaps, document controls, and serve as a technical security resource.

• Compliance & Governance: Implement technical controls behind the Statement of Applicability and produce evidence for ISO 27001 certification and NIS2 compliance.

• IT Operations & Support: Co-own and deliver day-to-day service desk support, troubleshooting endpoint/user issues, Microsoft 365, onboarding/offboarding, and hardware/AV lifecycles.

Qualifications

Experience: 3 to 6 years of hands-on experience in IT security engineering or SecOps specifically building or maturing controls from scratch combined with solid IT support experience. Experience from regulated, manufacturing, critical-infrastructure, or OT environments is an advantage (space experience is not required).

Technical Proficiencies:

• Hands-on security engineering across endpoints, identity, cloud, and networks.

• Microsoft security stack: Entra ID, Conditional Access, Intune, M365 security, Defender (EDR), and ideally Sentinel or a comparable SIEM.

• Hardening baselines (CIS), patch management, and vulnerability scanning.

• Network security: Firewalls, segmentation, VPNs, and traffic monitoring.

• Scripting and automation with PowerShell.

• Incident response, triage, and log analysis.

Standards & Compliance: Solid working knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001 and NIS2 requirements; awareness of OT / IEC 62443 is a strong plus.

Education & Certifications: Degree in IT/cybersecurity or equivalent proven experience. Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft SC-200/AZ-500/SC-100, CompTIA Security+/CySA+, or GIAC GSEC/GCIH) are an advantage.

Personal Attributes: A builder mindset with strong initiative; pragmatic and risk-oriented; structured with audit-ready documentation; and a clear, discreet communicator who collaborates well across technical and non-technical teams.

What We Offer

• A full-time role with exposure to a variety of disciplines within space technology.

• A position in an exciting, rapidly growing industry with significant international reach.

• A chance to shape your role and responsibilities within a growing company.

• Great colleagues and several social events each year.

• Health insurance and additional employee benefits.

• Competitive salary and good working conditions.

How to Apply

If you’re ready to take your career to the next level, apply by submitting your CV and application. If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact us via jobs@space-inventor.com, and we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

Interviews are held continuously until the right candidate is found.

Start date to be agreed, but preferably with start-up as soon as possible.

We look forward to receiving your application.

About Space Inventor

Space Inventor is a leading Satellite company with a passion for exploring space and delivering innovative solutions in satellite technology. Our mission is to revolutionize the space industry with creativity, technical expertise, and reliability. With our 250+ years of combined experience in the space industry, we are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what satellites can achieve.

jobs.occupation: Experimental Technician Wanted for Permanent Position at the AU-Auning Field Research Station, Gl. Estrup
jobs.description:
The Department of Food Science at Aarhus University is seeking an Experimental Technician for a permanent position, starting on 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The position will focus on field-grown vegetables and pulses.

Start date and duration
1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. This is a permanent position on 32 hours per week. 

Job description

• 
Day-to-day care and maintenance of field trials involving vegetable crops and other annual crops

• 
Soil cultivation and weed control using a range of machinery and weeding methods

• 
Prevention and control of pests and other harmful organisms

• 
Harvesting, grading, storage and recording of field-grown crops

• 
Planning and carrying out field trials

• 
General horticultural tasks across the department involving vegetables and fruit

• 
Tasks are planned and carried out as part of a team of experienced horticulturalists and agricultural technicians, together with seasonal staff.

Your profile

• 
Day-to-day maintenance of areas used for agricultural crops outside experimental trials, as well as trials involving annual crops and fruit and berry species

• 
Soil cultivation and weed control using a range of machinery and weeding methods

• 
Prevention and control of pests and other harmful organisms

• 
Harvesting, grading, handling and storage of field-grown crops

• 
Handling soil samples

• 
Necessary certificates for operating the machinery available at AU-Auning for relevant field tasks

• 
General horticultural tasks across the department involving vegetables

Tasks are planned and carried out as part of a team of experienced horticulturalists and agricultural technicians, together with seasonal staff.

Who we are
The Department of Food Science is part of the Faculty of Technical Sciences at Aarhus University. Its research covers a wide range of areas, including horticulture, fruit and vegetables, food quality and biochemistry, as well as sensory science and consumer science.

About MITS Industries

MITS Industries is establishing an R&D and design site in Copenhagen focused on advanced RF systems, signal intelligence, aerospace technologies, and mission-critical product development.

The site will build core engineering capabilities in RF and microwave hardware, antenna systems, RF testing and characterization, rugged mechanical integration, and the industrialization of complex radio-electronic systems.

The Copenhagen team will work closely with strategic partners and engineering teams across Europe, playing a leading role in the development, validation, and industrialization of advanced technologies for defense, aerospace, and other demanding applications.

One of the initial focus areas will be the development of an advanced aerospace signal intelligence product platform. The work will cover RF and system architecture, antenna system design, signal acquisition, embedded control, laboratory validation, mechanical integration, integration with the satellite platform, and preparation for production and field deployment.

The ambition is to build a strong technical design site capable of taking complex RF products, modules, and platforms from architecture and detailed design through prototyping, testing, validation, industrialization, and deployment.

About the role

MITS Industries is looking for a Senior Systems Engineer, RF Systems to join the core Copenhagen R&D team and help build the site’s systems engineering capability for advanced RF, aerospace, and signal-intelligence products. You will translate product, mission, and stakeholder needs into clear functional, performance, and parametric requirements, system architectures, subsystem allocation, interface definitions, integration strategies, and verification plans. The work covers requirements decomposition and traceability, system performance budgeting, interface management, technical risk analysis, design reviews, integration planning, and system level verification and validation. You will work closely with RF and microwave hardware engineers, antenna systems engineers, embedded and control engineers, signal-processing engineers, RF test and characterization engineers, mechanical design engineers, project managers, and partner engineering teams. You will ensure that requirements, design decisions, implementation, integration, testing, and validation remain connected throughout the development lifecycle. The role requires strong RF system understanding, structured systems-engineering expertise, technical ownership, and a hands-on integration mindset. Working with technical leadership, you will turn product and architectural intent into an executable, traceable, and verifiable engineering baseline and help carry the product through integration, qualification, and deployment.

Key responsibilities

• Translate product, mission, and stakeholder needs into clear functional, performance, parametric, interface, environmental, and verification requirements.

• Develop and maintain the functional and physical system architecture, allocate requirements to subsystems, and define key technical trade-offs.

• Establish and maintain system performance budgets and constraints covering RF performance, timing and synchronization, data flow, power, thermal performance, mass, and platform interfaces.

• Define and maintain system requirements, subsystem requirements, interface control documentation, acceptance criteria, and verification logic.

• Align RF subsystem requirements, including frequency coverage, sensitivity, selectivity, dynamic range, noise figure, linearity, phase noise, spurious responses, channel isolation, and interference resilience.

• Define antenna-system requirements covering frequency coverage, antenna gain, polarization, radiation-pattern characteristics, isolation between antenna channels, placement, and platform integration.

• Define embedded control, data acquisition, timing, synchronization, diagnostics, logging, networking, and system-monitoring requirements.

• Coordinate mechanical and platform requirements covering dimensions, mass, thermal management, connectors, cabling, grounding, shielding, mounting, environmental constraints, and serviceability.

• Work with RF test and characterization engineers to define measurable acceptance criteria, calibration needs, verification methods, test coverage, and required evidence.

• Prepare and maintain system requirements specifications, interface-control documents, system budgets, integration plans, verification plans, compliance matrices, and technical decision records.

• Lead system integration planning and support prototype bring-up, laboratory validation, qualification, and field-test preparation.

• Identify system-level risks, interface conflicts, missing requirements, invalid assumptions, and integration blockers, and drive their resolution.

• Facilitate cross-functional technical alignment between engineering disciplines, technical leadership, manufacturing partners, and partner engineering teams.

• Support requirements reviews, system design reviews, integration reviews, test readiness reviews, and milestone decisions.

• Maintain traceability between stakeholder needs, requirements, design decisions, implementation, verification results, and acceptance evidence.

• Help establish systems-engineering methods, documentation practices, requirements-management workflows, and technical-review processes for future MITS Industries development programs.

Required qualifications and experience

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in electrical or electronic engineering, telecommunications, systems engineering, aerospace engineering, applied physics, or a related field.

• 6+ years of professional experience in systems engineering for complex RF, electronic, aerospace, or other mission-critical systems.

• Strong understanding of RF systems, including receiver architectures, RF signal paths, antenna interfaces, signal acquisition, data conversion, embedded control, timing and synchronization, calibration, and system validation.

• Proven experience translating product, mission, and stakeholder needs into functional, performance, parametric, interface, environmental, and verification requirements.

• Experience developing functional and physical system architectures, decomposing systems into subsystems, allocating requirements, and defining interfaces and technical trade-offs.

• Experience establishing and maintaining system performance budgets and constraints covering RF performance, timing and synchronization, data flow, power, thermal performance, mass, and platform interfaces.

• Strong understanding of requirements decomposition, traceability, acceptance criteria, and verification methods, including analysis, inspection, demonstration, and testing.

• Experience preparing and maintaining system requirements specifications, interface-control documents, integration plans, verification plans, compliance matrices, and technical decision records.

• Practical experience with requirements-management and traceability tools such as IBM Engineering DOORS, Jama Connect, Polarion, or equivalent.

• Experience working with cross-functional engineering teams covering RF and microwave hardware, antennas, embedded systems, signal processing, mechanical design, test, manufacturing, and system integration.

• Ability to evaluate technical trade-offs across RF performance, embedded implementation, mechanical and thermal constraints, testability, manufacturability, reliability, and operational use.

• Hands-on experience with prototype integration, laboratory validation, system-level debugging, and troubleshooting of complex multidisciplinary systems.

• Experience identifying and managing system-level risks, interface conflicts, assumptions, technical dependencies, and integration blockers. Strong technical communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to align senior engineers and drive decisions across engineering disciplines.

Nice to have

• Experience with signal-intelligence, direction-finding, spectrum-monitoring, or radio-surveillance systems.

• Experience with SDR-based systems and high-throughput RF data acquisition.

• Experience with broadband, multiband, coherent, or multichannel receiver systems.

• Experience with Model-Based Systems Engineering, SysML, and tools such as Cameo Systems Modeler, Enterprise Architect, or equivalent.

• Experience establishing and maintaining controlled system baselines, including requirements, interfaces, verification status, configuration, and engineering changes.

• Experience with engineering analysis, data processing, or system modelling using MATLAB, Python, or equivalent.

• Experience with field integration, testing, calibration, and deployment of complex RF or aerospace systems.

• Experience working on aerospace, mission-critical, ruggedized, or internationally distributed engineering programs.

Success in the first 6 months

• Establish the initial system requirements baseline, subsystem allocation, interface definitions, and performance budgets for the assigned product scope.

• Create a clear technical decomposition across RF and microwave hardware, antenna systems, embedded control, signal processing, mechanical design, test, and system integration.

• Define the integration, verification, and validation approach for the initial prototype or subsystem, including acceptance criteria, traceability, and required evidence.

• Identify unclear interfaces, missing requirements, technical assumptions, and system-level risks early, and drive practical resolution actions. Support prototype integration, bring-up, and laboratory validation with structured system-level analysis, troubleshooting, and verification evidence.

• Establish repeatable systems-engineering practices, documentation templates, requirements-management workflows, and technical-review processes for future development programs.

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**Portfolio Analysis is where investment professionals turn data into insight on portfolios, performance and risk. Our products are business critical and widely used, so they need to keep evolving in a responsible way. Right now that means strong maintainability, high system performance, mature CI/CD, and reshaping parts of SimCorp Dimension for the cloud.

As a Senior Software Engineer in our Product Division, you will join an agile team of 5–7 people in the Portfolio Analysis Product Area. You will mainly work on backend components, APIs and services, using C#, .NET, Dyalog APL and Oracle.

AI is part of how we work every day. We see it as a natural part of modern software engineering, alongside source control, testing, CI/CD and code reviews. AI does not replace engineering judgment. It helps good engineers learn faster, reduce repetitive work and build better software.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Contribute to cloud modernization and scalable service design where it adds real value

• Building high-performance, scalable and maintainable applications

• Continuous integration and delivery, automated testing and practical quality engineering

• Relational databases, preferably Oracle or similar

• Cloud technologies, distributed systems or Azure-based services

• Willingness to learn additional technologies, including Dyalog APL

• Experience with financial instruments or investment systems is an advantage but not a requirement. We will bring you up to speed through training and a comprehensive onboarding program.

We also value people who take ownership and deliver results. We look for engineers who try new approaches, work with others to leverage everyone’s strengths, and balance technical quality with business value. We want you to help build an inclusive, trust-based engineering culture.

**Benefits

**

• Global hybrid work policy – We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. You can work remotely the other days if you choose.

• Growth and innovation – Every sixth sprint is reserved for planning, innovation, learning and improvements.

• Self-direction – Teams and developers have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.

• Work-life balance – We believe balance between professional and private life makes us better colleagues and better engineers.

• Empowerment – All voices are valuable, and you will be involved in shaping our work processes.

jobs.occupation: Data manager for Center for Landscape Research in Sustainable Agricultural Futures, Land-CRAFT, Department of Agroecology, Aarhus University
jobs.description:
Department of Agroecology at Aarhus University, Denmark, is looking for a full-time Data manager to work at the Center for Landscape Research in Sustainable Agricultural Futures (Land-CRAFT).

Land-CRAFT addresses three of our major societal challenges - food security, climate change, and loss of biodiversity. With Center partners from University of Copenhagen, Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (Germany), and Colorado State University (USA), we bring together expertise in climate impact research, landscape analyses, biogeochemistry, agronomy, biology, and geography to develop solution – oriented research that extends across multiple spatial and temporal scales. Established in June 2022, Land-CRAFT has built a dynamic team to undertake both fundamental and applied research aimed to reduce the environmental impact of agricultural systems, specifically regarding greenhouse gas emissions. To reach our goals, we are using a combination of empirical, field-based approaches, digital technologies, including modelling and remote sensing, while closely interacting with stakeholders. The position we advertise here is aimed at supporting these activities with respect to data management. The new employee will become part of a support team with complementary skills and work collaboratively in an active and international research environment with diverse projects and people across Department of Agroecology.

The position is available from 1st March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The duration of the position is 3 years.

Responsibilities and tasks
Your main role as part of the support team at Land-CRAFT will be to support research activities of the staff and research students (at BSc, MSc, and PhD levels) in data management, analysis and statistics. This will include maintaining and supplementing relational databases used for process-based modelling and geospatial data analyses. Main responsibilities and tasks include:

• 
Organize, archive, and document data collected by the Land-CRAFT team, including with appropriate metadata protocols

• 
Manage data transfer/sharing among Center partners and external collaborators following FAIR data principles, AU rules and regulations, and GDPR rules

• 
Manage user access and permissions within the AU File system and user data on a computational server

• 
Create and manage a database on research outputs from the Center, including e.g., publications, citations and other reports, to facilitate website updates, annual reports, and other communication platforms, as well as managing the Zenodo community

• 
Support staff and students with statistical and geospatial analyses (e.g. in R and Python)

• 
Support/manage data collection pipeline from instruments in the lab & field (including visualisation of data in e.g. Origin)

• 
Establish, maintain, and refine documentation regarding all data-related protocols (e.g. data policy, data management plans, etc.)

• 
Coordinating data management across the Department of Agroecology (about 20 % of time) in collaboration with the department’s data steward

Your profile
As a member of the Land-Craft support team, we expect you to plan and perform your tasks independently and initiate frequent feedback and communication with Land CRAFT researchers and students. The position requires that you can communicate with and support students and scientists from BSc to Professor levels, including attention to detail and quality (QA/QC) and an affinity for knowledge-sharing, e.g., in working with students as they learn to manage their own data. You have a high proficiency in English, are culturally sensitive, and can work in a large group of diverse colleagues and students. At Land-CRAFT we emphasize good relationships among colleagues and students. It is therefore important that you have a positive and open personality, stay engaged with emerging challenges and opportunities, and are ready to support colleagues when needed.

Qualifications

• 
MSc in data science, agroecology, geoscience, biology, ecology, environmental science, mathematics, geography (or related fields)

• 
Knowledge and understanding of data management plans, metadata systems, archiving practices

• 
Experience in statistical analysis; knowledge of R or Python, as well as visualisation platforms

• 
Good collaboration and communications skills across different groups of employees,

• 
High level of English proficiency and cultural sensitivity

• 
Interest in and willingness to acquire general knowledge about Land-CRAFT’s research areas

• 
Familiarity with the Danish administrative structures or Danish language.

Workplace
The place of work is Aarhus University, Ole Worms Alle 3, DK-8000 Aarhus C. The affiliation will be with the Department of Agroecology.

Who we are
At the Department of Agroecology, our main goal is to contribute to sustainable solutions to some of the world’s biggest problems within the areas of soil, plants, animals, humans, and the environment. We want to make a difference by contributing to both fundamental knowledge generation and the attainment of sustainable production systems via innovative research, contracted policy advice, and education. We offer professional laboratories, greenhouses, semi-field, and field-scale research facilities, advanced computing capacities as well as an extensive national and international researcher network. The department consists of nine research sections with around 350 highly skilled employees, of which approximately 50% are scientific staff. More information can be found here.
We believe in encouraging inclusion, acceptance, and understanding by employing staff who bring unique perspectives to our department.

What we offer

• 
A collaborative, international research environment that combines high academic standards with an informal and supportive atmosphere. We value accountability, curiosity, flexibility, and teamwork in everything we do.

• 
An inclusive and respectful workplace culture, where mutual trust, kindness, and professional dialogue are part of daily life. We encourage open communication and develop a cohesive sense of community across teams and disciplines.

• 
A flexible working environment that supports work-life balance and individual needs.

• 
An active institutional commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion – in recruitment, career development, and everyday interactions.

• 
An innovative and meaningful workplace where your work contributes to solving real-world challenges. No two days are alike, and we welcome creative thinking and new ideas.

• 
Support for international researchers and their families, including Relocation Service and an Expat Partner Programme

Contact information
More information can be obtained from Klaus Butterbach-Bahl (klaus.butterbach bahl@agro.au.dk).

Formalities and salary range
Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions..You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

About Aarhus University

Aarhus University is an academically diverse and research-intensive university with a strong commitment to high-quality research and education and the development of society nationally and globally. The university offers an inspiring research and teaching environment for its 37,500 students, including PhD students, and has 9,000 employees (full-time equivalents) and an annual revenue of EUR 1.2 billion. Learn more at international.au.dk

Do you enjoy diving into data and are curious about how market risk is measured and managed? Join us to turn data into insights that feed directly into daily decision-making in energy trading.

Here’s what the job entails

As a Junior Risk Analyst, your primary role will be to support the team with daily reporting and help ensure that our data is accurate and up to date. You will also analyse PnL to investigate and explain changes in results and contribute to improving the way we work, for example by automating reporting and monitoring processes. Along the way, you will gain hands-on experience with risk management and insights into our business.

More specifically, your responsibilities include:

• managing monthly reporting processes and execution for key stakeholders, including executive level

• supporting reporting activities across multiple business units and building an understanding of the business

• helping automate processes and data flows, including exploring how AI solutions can create value for the team

• developing monitoring and reporting tools together with colleagues to provide better insights into business activities and support decision-making across Risk Management and beyond

You’ll work closely with skilled colleagues who are eager to share their knowledge, while taking responsibility for tasks that give you hands-on experience with risk management. (Tor Bonde, Head of Product Analysis)

Meet your team

You will join our Risk Control team, where we monitor and report on Danske Commodities’ market risk exposure and PnL. By providing transparency into risks and results, we help the business manage exposures while partnering with our trading teams to support informed decision-making and active risk management.

We are a team of committed and skilled risk analysts who help and motivate each other to continuously improve. Collaboration is an important part of our work, and will interact with colleagues across Risk, other supporting functions and our trading teams.

But enough about us… over to you!

As you will be working with data and reporting, we imagine that you have a structured and detail-oriented approach to working with data and are excited to apply this in daily problem-solving. You will collaborate with stakeholders across the organisation, so we are looking for someone who is curious, proactive and motivated by turning data into precise and useful insights.

Furthermore, we imagine that you:

• are currently studying a relevant education within finance, physics, mathematics, economics, business intelligence or similar

• enjoy working with data and are curious to learn more about finance and risk management

• have some experience with Python and data analysis – and are motivated to develop your skills further

• are proficient in English – both written and spoken

Please note that prior knowledge of the energy sector is not required for this role.

We’ll take good care of you

At Danske Commodities, we take great care of our people. Joining us means you’ll get a lot of great perks – including social events, cultural experiences, tasty food and benefits to better your health, your life and your future.

Here are some of the benefits we offer our employees:

Shape your development tailored growth plans, 100+ DC University courses & Harvard Learning access

100+ yearly events from office parties to DC Sports events, CS:GO team, student network & more

Global career paths as part of our parent company, Equinor’s 20,000-strong international network

Flexible work life to fit with your studies

Unlimited paid child’s sick days because family comes first

Free tickets & discounts culture, family fun, hotels, restaurants & more

Organic meals light breakfast, lunch, snacks, dinner & take-away

Barista café high-quality coffee, always on us

On-site wellness state-of-the-art gym, physio, chiro and massage therapy

HQ in the heart of Aarhus with stunning views, inspiring architecture and close to public transport

…. and much more

We're an energy trading and optimisation company that works at the intersection of technology and energy economics. Our disciplined and scalable trading strategies are designed to be competitive in volatile markets and create value for our partners.

**Your impact begins here

**As Sr Lead Corporate Investigator in Global Investigations, you will design and lead internal investigations into alleged misconduct, including fraud, bribery and corruption, conflicts of interest, potential misconduct in external engagements, and misappropriation of company assets or information. You will turn evidence into clear findings and practical recommendations, working across Novo’s global organisation as a trusted partner with the highest standards of integrity. You will create impact by safeguarding Novo and protect the trust of patients and society, to ensure Novo can pursue its purpose of driving change for lasting health.

**What You’ll Bring

**

• A Master’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Audit, Law, Finance or equivalent. A Bachelor’s degree combined with extensive relevant investigative experience (for example in law enforcement) also qualifies.

• Experience conducting investigations, including interviews, evidence review, root-cause analysis, reporting and remediation recommendations.

• Experience in compliance, internal investigations, legal, audit or similar in a global organisation, and in building trusting relationships across hierarchies and cultures.

• Experience leading sensitive investigations with discretion, independence and professionalism.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate complex information and data into practical insights and recommendations.

• High ethical standards, sound judgement and the ability to build trust and rapport with all parties during an investigation.

• Excellent communication skills, with stakeholders across a global organisation and at all leadership levels.

• A curious and independent mindset, a proactive approach and the ability to work closely with a team of experienced professionals.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Experience in compliance, internal investigations, legal or audit in the pharmaceutical industry.

• Experience in data analytics, data visualisation, AI/ML, automation and continuous improvement.

• A Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) or similar certification.

**What You’ll Do

**You will own investigations from the first allegation to the conclusion and recommendation and support the continuous development of the Global Investigations function.

• Review and assess allegations, scope actionable investigation plans and identify key witnesses, documents and systems for evidence collection.

• Collect and review data and documentation, conduct witness and subject interviews, and develop clear, well-documented findings and recommendations.

• Keep case documentation and investigation reports timely, complete and in line with department standards.

• Identify systemic issues and root causes, and recommend corrective and preventive actions where applicable.

• Provide oversight, guidance and informal leadership to junior investigators, as well as regional and local investigators.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of Global Investigations, including its procedures, tools and processes, to ensure alignment with industry best practice.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will be part of Global Investigations within Business Assurance & Compliance, where colleagues safeguard the business and ensure Novo can deliver on its purpose. You will work as a peer with fellow investigators in a trusting and supportive team.

Your close partners include the wider Legal & Compliance organisation (LECX) both at headquarters and across all EVP areas, including regional and local levels, as well as a range of other key stakeholders, including HR, Global Security and Global IT Security. You will also work with external legal counsel and external investigation support when cases require it.

The role has global reach. You will work with colleagues at every level, including senior leadership, bringing clarity and professionalism to investigations across Novo. Occasional travel should be expected, sometimes at short notice.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will have real ownership. We trust you to work independently, make tactical decisions and use your judgement within our standard investigation framework.

You will be part of a department that seeks to continuously improve itself, and where your experience and insight can bring real change. You will grow through the complexity of the work and through collaboration with colleagues across Novo, in a culture where honest feedback and high standards go together with respect and support.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000.00 to 956,900.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to lead investigations and bring impact across Novo, apply for the Sr Lead Corporate Investigator role by 24 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For further information, please contact Mads Pazyj at ymdp@novonordisk.com

Together with developers, product managers and designers, you'll help shape new features from the product discussion through implementation, testing and release.

Our app is built using C# and .NET MAUI , allowing us to share the majority of our codebase while integrating with native iOS and Android capabilities whenever it makes sense.

• Designing intuitive user experiences for professionals working in demanding environments

• C#

• .NET MAUI

• Kotlin

• Swift

• Flutter

• React Native

Why Dalux?

All software development happens from our headquarters in Copenhagen, where you'll work alongside a growing community of software engineers in an environment that values knowledge sharing, technical discussions and continuous learning. You'll find a flat organization with a high degree of trust, opportunities to influence the product, and colleagues who care deeply about building great software.

Ready to join us?

If you'd like to help build the mobile platform used by tens of thousands of construction professionals every day, we'd love to hear from you.

Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005. Today, our solutions are used on construction projects in more than 140 countries worldwide.
