jobs.occupation: Laboratory Engineer for Underwater Robotic Systems
jobs.description:
Aalborg University Energy in Esbjerg seeks a Laboratory Engineer for a permanent, full-time position from 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. You will provide practical and technical support for research and teaching in underwater technology and help ensure that researchers and students have reliable, well-documented equipment for laboratory and field activities.

Your work tasks
You will become part of the underwater technology research environment at Aalborg University Energy in Esbjerg, where research projects combine the development, testing and application of advanced underwater robotic systems. The position provides shared technical support across several projects and contributes to coherent mechanical and electronic design practices. In this way, you will help researchers reduce duplicated technical work, strengthen knowledge sharing and reuse proven solutions across research activities.

You will work closely with researchers, students and external collaborators in a role that combines independent technical responsibility with day-to-day collaboration. Your work will take place in laboratories, workshops and field settings, depending on the activities and testing needs of the research projects. A central part of the role is to make equipment ready for use, keep it operational and support colleagues in using it safely and effectively.

You will develop laboratory and field-testing setups for underwater robotic systems, including selecting, integrating and maintaining relevant instrumentation, data acquisition equipment and data-logging systems. You will conduct laboratory and field tests involving underwater vehicles and associated sensors, support the standardisation and maintenance of electrical and mechanical hardware, and contribute to the design, development and fabrication of new components. You will also prepare user manuals and technical documentation, assist students in the operation of equipment, and help ensure that technical solutions remain accessible and reusable across projects.

Your competencies
You have a bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, electronics or a related technical field. You bring practical experience with the design, development and fabrication of mechanical and electronic hardware, preferably for underwater robotic systems or comparable complex technical equipment. You are familiar with control electronics, instrumentation, data acquisition and data-logging systems, and you can use computer-aided design tools to develop and document mechanical solutions.

You have experience with robotic testing equipment and understand the importance of reliable instrumentation, systematic test procedures and clear technical documentation. Experience with the Robot Operating System or a comparable robotics framework, as well as MATLAB for data processing and analysis, is required. You communicate confidently in spoken and written English, as this is the working language in the research environment.

You work systematically and pay close attention to safety, technical quality and the practical usability of equipment. You approach technical challenges in a structured and solution-oriented way and are comfortable taking responsibility for tasks independently. At the same time, you provide constructive support to students and researchers, explain technical procedures clearly and contribute to a collaborative approach to maintaining and developing shared research infrastructure.

Who we are
Aalborg University Energy in Esbjerg has approximately 40 scientific employees, including around 15 colleagues in the underwater technology research group. The group works with research and development activities that connect engineering research with practical technological solutions, and the Laboratory Engineer will have an important role in supporting the technical foundation for this work.

You will join an informal working environment where colleagues work closely across projects and professional disciplines. The role offers flexible working hours and occasional opportunities to work from home when the tasks allow it. Because the position supports a broad range of research and teaching activities, you will have the opportunity to deepen your technical expertise in underwater technologies, robotic systems, instrumentation and testing while contributing directly to research projects with practical relevance.

How to apply  
Your application must contain the following: 

• A brief motivated application describing your professional and personal competences and the experience qualifying you particularly for the position 
• Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
• Examination certificate 
• Any other relevant appendices 
You can read more about the requirements for your application here.  

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 
 
Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 
 
Do you have any questions?    
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us.

Further information 
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment
Your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the Collective Agreement for Academic Staff Employed in the State Sector. Qualification-based supplements may be granted, subject to negotiation. 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Technical and administrative positions Academic (AC-TAP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Academic staff”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Q-PLANET is an EU funded project aimed to establish a European pilot line for quantum applications and creation of the state-of-the-art quantum devices. These quantum devices would specifically be implemented and integrated in neutral atoms quantum applications. The project is a consortium with around 30 partners from both academia and industry. DTU Nanolab is one major partner, mainly focused on Photonic Integrated Circuits (PIC) fabrication and packaging. 

If you are passionate about science communication and outreach events coordination, this job is for you. Within Q-PLANET, DTU Nanolab is one of the main drivers of dissemination and communication activities. These activities include organization of workshops and webinars for stakeholders as well as education and training modules. 

The job
You will be heavily involved in planning and coordinating the outreach activities mentioned above. This requires high levels of coordination and communication on EU level. This means, you will coordinate workshops and training activities across Q-PLANET partners and stakeholders. Furthermore, events advertisements through networking and digital channels, including websites, newsletters, social media. Additionally, you can also release the inner artist in you by creating outreach material like videos, posts posters, and the like. 

Our expectations of you
We are looking for an enthusiastic candidate that enjoy collaborative work with the following skills:

• proven experience in planning, coordinating, and delivering events, webinars, workshops, conferences, or stakeholder engagement activities.
• Has excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
• Can contribute content for newsletters, websites, social media, and other channels to support event promotion and project visibility.
• Is proficient in digital collaboration and communication tools.
• Has experience working with multiple partners across organisations, sectors, or international projects.
• Is willing to travel occasionally within Europe.
What we offer in return
We offer an interesting and challenging job in a very international environment. A highly dynamic job and collaborative work environment. The Technical University of Denmark is a leading university in Northen Europe, and our facility is among the largest and most advanced fair access facilities in Europe.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC) or in accordance with the OAO-S Joint Agreement and the organization agreement for Office Clerks, Laboratory Technicians and IT staff (HK/stat). In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP) or DTU’s salary structure for clerical employees: https://www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures

The position can be a full-time position or on reduced time for between 32–37 hours per week. Starting date is 1st January 2027 (or as soon as possible). The workplace is DTU Lyngby Campus.

Application and contact
Please submit your online application no later than Tuesday, 29 November 2026. 

Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates. 

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Thomas Pedersen on 4525 5833 or thope@dtu.dk or Rawa Tanta rawta@dtu.dk

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.occupation: PhD in Electrolyte Solvation and Interphase Engineering for Rechargeable Calcium Batteries
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a position as PhD stipend is available within the general study program. The stipend is open for appointment from 1st of March 2027 or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

Your work tasks
You will develop and investigate non-aqueous liquid electrolytes for rechargeable calcium batteries, focusing on how Ca2+ solvation, ion pairing and interphase formation govern electrochemical reversibility. Your work will contribute to a complementary research programme on calcium-battery electrode materials and cell development at AAU Energy.

You will systematically vary salt chemistry, solvent composition and concentration within selected electrolyte families. Physicochemical measurements and spectroscopic analysis will be used to examine electrolyte coordination environments and ion association. These investigations will guide the selection of formulations for detailed electrochemical and interfacial studies.

A central part of the work will be the design and evaluation of calcium plating and stripping experiments, including measurements of coulombic efficiency, polarization and cycling stability under defined conditions. You will use appropriate controls and complementary analyses to verify metallic calcium deposition and distinguish it from electrolyte decomposition or other electrochemical reactions. You will investigate electrode interphase composition and evolution using XPS, supported by electron microscopy and, where appropriate, ToF-SIMS for morphology and species distribution. Raman spectroscopy, complemented by NMR where relevant, will probe electrolyte coordination and ion association. Targeted MD simulations may clarify Ca²⁺ solvation and ion pairing. Correlating these findings with electrochemical performance will establish mechanism-based guidelines for electrolyte formulation and selection.

Working closely with the PhD researcher developing cathode and calcium-alloying anode materials, you will assess selected electrode–electrolyte combinations and contribute to reproducible coin-cell evaluation. You will also contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations, teaching, supervision of student projects and departmental dissemination activities.

The position is offered in relation to the Batteries research group, and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Power Electronics Systems Integration and Materials”.

Your competencies 
Applicants are expected to hold an M.Sc. degree in chemistry, materials science, physics, chemical engineering, or a closely related discipline. Candidates should have a solid scientific background and preferably hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas: electrochemistry, electrolyte formulation and preparation, battery testing and characterization, or the handling of air- and moisture-sensitive materials under controlled environments. A strong interest in electrochemical energy storage, interfacial chemistry, spectroscopic characterization techniques, and quantitative experimental data analysis is highly desirable.

Experience with advanced characterization techniques, particularly spectroscopy and surface analysis, will be considered an advantage. Familiarity with molecular dynamics (MD) simulations or other computational approaches for investigating electrolyte properties is beneficial but not essential, as the position is primarily focused on experimental research.

Excellent written and spoken English communication skills, together with the ability to collaborate effectively in a multidisciplinary and international research environment, are essential.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are
AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners, utilities and other academic environments to address real world energy challenges.

Aalborg University has been ranked as the best university in Europe within energy research and is among the very best universities worldwide in this field. At AAU Energy you will be part of a top international environment where research, innovation and collaboration are used to develop solutions to global challenges such as the green transition and future energy systems.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and with diverse national and disciplinary backgrounds, which creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as working language in both research and teaching, which supports the integration of international colleagues.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
• Curriculum Vitae (CV)
• Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
• Project description (2-5 pages), that describes the applicant’s initial thoughts and ideas related to the specific project applied for. This includes a brief state-of-the-art (including short list of references), a time schedule and how the applicant intends to shed light on the project objectives.
• Other relevant documents
The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions?     
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost. 

Further information  
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employment
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.occupation: Lead Learning and Development Specialist, Leadership
jobs.description:
At KMD, we build digital solutions used by millions of people around the world. These solutions are the digital foundations of our most important institutions, from governments and public services to financial industries and private companies. Our mission is to ensure that they are reliable, accessible, and efficient.

We believe that the future is what you make it. So a career at KMD is a career with purpose and freedom. One where you’ll have a direct hand in improving the lives of people, while being empowered with the resources and autonomy to shape the course of your own professional journey.

Shape leadership at a company that shapes societies!

About us

For more than 50 years, KMD has built and operated digital infrastructure that citizens, governments, and businesses rely on from welfare and public administration to critical digital services.

As societies face demographic change, digital sovereignty, climate resilience, and technological disruption, we combine technology expertise with an understanding of society’s needs.

Our 2030 strategy and new cross-functional organization bring us closer to customers, combining domain expertise and technologies such as AI to create value for customers and society. We’re looking for an experienced Lead Learning & Development specialist to translate strategy into people initiatives and strengthen the employee experience across the People agenda.

About the Capability Management team

You will join our Capability Management team within the People (HR) department. We are accountable for onboarding, leadership and specialist development, strategic workforce planning, diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI), employee engagement, and performance management. We work closely with our lines of business and colleagues across People to translate business priorities into practical initiatives that build the capabilities KMD needs today and in the future.

About the job

Working closely with business leaders and People teams, you will ensure our learning programs and offerings align with organizational goals, reinforce key competencies, and foster a thriving leadership culture. Your primary focus will be designing leadership development frameworks and taking end-to-end ownership of program implementation and delivery. Facilitation is a supporting part of the role, rather than its main focus.

Accountability and Key Responsibilities

Leadership development & frameworks

• Lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of KMD’s leadership framework and principles, translating them into impactful learning offerings – from comprehensive development programs and focused learning sessions to bite-sized digital learning.

• Translate business strategy and cultural priorities into scalable leadership development programs and learning events for different leadership levels.

Program design & delivery

• Own the end-to-end design, implementation, and delivery of leadership development programs, translating frameworks into practical learning journeys and coordinating internal experts and external providers.

• Act as subject matter expert and advisor to leaders on leadership capability building.

Succession planning

• Own the succession planning framework and annual process in collaboration with HRBPs and business leaders.

• Ensure robust identification, assessment, and development of critical leadership talent and successors.

Assessment tools & development

• Lead the use and continuous improvement of Deeper Signals and Hogan to support individual and team development.

• Facilitate individual feedback sessions and team workshops, translating assessment insights into clear development actions.

Data, governance & impact

• Define success metrics for leadership development and succession planning.

• Use data and insights to continuously improve programs and ensure measurable impact.

You will work from our Ballerup office in reference to Head of Capability Management.

About you

Qualifications & Requirements

This role requires experience with end-to-end responsibility for designing, rolling out, and following up on leadership learning events and programs. Your core strength is designing leadership development frameworks and translating them into effective programs. You are experienced in defining clear learning objectives aligned with strategic goals and bring proven expertise in applying learning taxonomies to program design. We are looking for a framework architect and program owner, rather than primarily a facilitator.

• Over 5 years of experience in Learning & Development, with a strong emphasis on leadership development.

• Strong framework and learning design skills, combined with the ability to manage program delivery; facilitation, coaching, and communication skills support this work.

• Ability to manage multiple initiatives and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to influence and build relationships across all levels of the cross-functional organization.

• Demonstrates empathy and emotional intelligence in interactions with learners and leaders.

• Relevant Master’s degree in HR, Organizational Development, Psychology, or a related field.

What we offer?

Join a collaborative, inclusive environment that values innovation and continuous learning, with opportunities to develop your expertise and help others grow.

Shape leadership development in a growing international company, turning frameworks into programs that strengthen our leadership culture and support business ambitions.

Enjoy a flexible hybrid work model that combines time with colleagues and working from home.

Recruitment Process

Our recruitment process includes two to three interviews with the hiring team, two tests (a cognitive and a personality test), and a case presentation on leadership development. This gives us the opportunity to get to know each other and explore how your experience and approach match the role.

Interested?

If you’re ready to bring your full expertise to a role where the business wants People at the table, we’d love to hear from you.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To learn more about the position, you’re welcome to contact Head of Capability Management, José Leonardo email: JRO@kmd.dk.

jobs.occupation: Channel Account Manager (DACH) | Copenhagen or London
jobs.description:
We are Heimdal® and cybersecurity is our passion. Join us in an internationally expanding business, leading the fight against cybercrime!

When joining Heimdal®, you will embark on a thrilling ride in a fast-growing cybersecurity business, where we believe the team is the cornerstone of what we do tomorrow. We are leading the fight against cybercrime, developing new technologies and providing intelligence to protect over 15,000 companies worldwide against cybercriminal attacks and data security breaches.

Our award-winning line-up of 10+ fully integrated cybersecurity solutions span the entire IT estate, allowing organizations to be proactive, whether remote or onsite. From endpoints, networks, and cloud to emails, and beyond, Heimdal® offers advance detection and response capabilities, ensuring complete security coverage.

The role

We are looking for a results-driven Channel Account Manager, based in Copenhagen or London, to grow our partner network across the DACH region. In this role, you will develop strong relationships with MSP and VAR partners, identify new business opportunities, and drive sustainable revenue growth through the entire Heimdal® product portfolio.

You will report to the Global Head of Channel (London).

Key objectives

• Responsible for managing and growing relationships with new and existing partners (MSP & VAR) to drive net new revenue.

• Finding new business opportunities for the company, recommending solutions to prospects and converting generating leads into new customers.

• Drive long-term growth within your assigned territory.

• Establish strong partner relationships at all levels, representing the entire Heimdal platform to our prospects.

Main responsibilities

• Manage and grow existing relationships within the DACH cybersecurity channel community

• Identify, recruit and onboard new partnerships to drive long-term growth within the channel

• Co-develop and execute strategic plans for your territory to achieve sales targets

• Manage all partner onboarding, training sessions, quarterly business reviews

• Coordinate access to online and onsite training on new products, solution sets, Heimdal® corporate direction, value proposition

• Responsible for handling initial product demos, roadmap updates and basic product queries from the field

• Drive joint opportunity development activities with channel partners through account mapping and marketing initiatives, etc.

• Manage all aspects of MSP & VAR channel forecasting and pipeline with your manager and your partners; provide reporting and analytical data to track and measure your performance against your monthly and annual targets

• Provide reporting and analytical data to your partners in order to support and drive achievement within the Heimdal® Nexus Partner Program

• Work closely with the global sales, channel and marketing team to ensure alignment and collaboration

• Establish strong partner relationships at all levels, demonstrate advanced solution selling capabilities, conduct sales presentations and leverage all available resources to grow the channel community in your territory

Key skills and Attributes

• Fluent in German and English, oral and written

• Previous experience in technology or security sales as a Channel Manager is essential, ideally selling SaaS solutions with a network of existing partner relationships

• Comfortable in engaging senior partner sales executives

• Strong interpersonal skills with a flair for building trusting relationships

• Solid presentation skills and being a good verbal communicator

• Strong technical, sales and business acumen and the ability to become the trusted advisor

• A self-starter with a competitive attitude with a strong work ethic

• Proven track record of consistently meeting and exceeding sales targets

• Willing to grow and help other team members grow by offering and accepting feedback and help when needed

• Strong organization skills and an independent worker

Education and Experience

• At least 5 years’ of experience in a channel management role, selling SaaS solutions

• At least 3 years’ of experience in IT/Cyber security and a good understanding of the security and threat vendor landscape

• Experience selling to MSP’s and VAR’s is essential

• Career history of consistent success in meeting and exceeding sales quotas

• Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM

Benefits

DK / Copenhagen

• Monthly phone allowance: DKK 400

• Company pension scheme

• 25 annual holidays + up to 5 additional company-paid days off

UK / London

• Monthly phone allowance: £50

• Workplace pension

• Healthcare cash plan

• 25 annual holidays + up to 5 additional company-paid days off

Our Mission

We are leading the fight against cybercrime and protecting the operational integrity of all midmarket and lower enterprise companies.

Our Culture

We believe in hiring the best and the brightest while cultivating a culture of collaboration and execution.

We are Dedicated, Innovative, and Humble. As in devoted and passionate about our work and what we do. We seek to optimize, improve, and challenge status quo. We are open-minded to new ideas and to feedback, and we know success comes from hard work.

We are committed to constantly creating an environment where each individual has the opportunity to grow, personally and professionally. We have a strong sense of unity and togetherness, and having fun together is a key element at Heimdal®.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to gender, race, color, disability, religion, marital status, family or parental status.

jobs.occupation: Student Software Tester for Digital Asset-Integrity Solutions, Brøndby
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy understanding how complex software and hardware works and spotting opportunities for improvement?

We are looking for a Software Tester to support end-user testing of our ultrasonic inspection software, P-Scan.

In this role, you will work closely with our software development team and play an important part in ensuring that new features and improvements meet quality and usability expectations before being delivered to customers.

About the role and key responsibilities

You will join DAIS, a dynamic business unit with approximately 50 employees, delivering innovative digital products and services - primarily to the wind industry, but also to nuclear, oil & gas, and space sectors. Our solutions help ensure product quality and operational excellence for our customers.

Your primary responsibility will be to perform structured end‑user tests based on real‑life usage scenarios. You will report findings, bugs, and improvement suggestions to the development team and assist in validating fixes. During your onboarding period, you will receive guidance and training from experienced colleagues.

Over time, you will become familiar with the software workflows and contribute actively to improving the overall user experience and reliability of the product.

The position is based at our headquarters in Brøndby and you will report to Søren K. Hansen, Senior Team Leader, Digital Asset-Integrity Solutions.

We are looking for a student who is interested in developing their skills with us over a longer period. In return, we offer a student position with the opportunity to stay and grow in the role throughout your studies.

Later in your time with us, there may also be an opportunity to develop the position into an engineering internship project that we define together.

We welcome applications from both Danish- and English-speaking candidates.

Additional information

You likely have:

• A solid ability to understand and work with technical solutions and software systems

• The willingness and ability to work on your own after an onboarding period

• Good analytical skills and attention to detail

• The ability to communicate findings clearly to developers and other stakeholders, both verbally and in writing

• Proficiency in English, as bug reports are submitted in English

It would be an advantage if you have

• Basic knowledge of C# programming

• Experience with software testing, quality assurance or technical products

However, these qualifications are not required, and we welcome applicants from a variety of technical backgrounds.

At Force Technology, you work alongside specialists who are deeply committed to their fields and proud of the value their expertise creates. Many choose to build their careers here because they enjoy exploring their field in depth and pushing the boundaries of their expertise.

The opportunity to specialise does not mean doing the same thing every day. Customer challenges, new technologies and cross-disciplinary collaboration create opportunities for continuous learning.

Despite the high level of expertise, the culture is informal and approachable. Colleagues take an interest in each other, share their knowledge generously and are always willing to help.

Does this sound like something for you?

If you think this job is for you, send us your application today. We process applications on an ongoing basis and invite candidates for interview along the way. Please note that we only accept electronic applications via our recruitment system.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Søren K. Hansen on skh@forcetechnology.com.

We look forward to receiving your application, CV and other relevant attachments.

At Force Technology, we are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment, and we are actively looking for qualified people candidates regardless of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, disability or age.

Force Technology

At Force Technology, we help businesses and society navigate technological opportunities and challenges safely.

As one of Denmark's largest GTS institutes, we play a unique role in strengthening innovation, competitiveness and technological resilience. As an independent expert authority and technology advisor, we help ensure that technology creates value for people, businesses and society.

When you join us, you become part of an expert environment with more than 1,000 specialists across 18 offices in 4 countries working together to turn knowledge into sustainable solutions.

Build intelligent financial products. Solve real problems. Shape a company.

For our client Verifi Finance in central Copenhagen, we’re looking for an entrepreneurial Senior Software Engineer who combines exceptional engineering skills with a strong sense of ownership and a drive to solve meaningful customer problems.

At Verifi Finance, they believe great software starts with understanding the problem, not writing the code. They are building an AI-native platform that transforms complex, manual accounting workflows into reliable, intelligent automation — helping finance teams spend less time validating data and more time creating value.

This isn’t a role where you’ll simply pick up tickets and implement predefined solutions. You’ll work closely with their founders and customers to uncover problems worth solving, challenge assumptions, shape the product, and take ideas from concept to production.

You’ll have the opportunity to influence technical decisions, build across the stack, experiment with emerging AI capabilities, and help define how they build and scale the company

Verifi Finance has solid funding and excisting customers in Denmark and Sweden with plans to expand across Europe soon.

See more here: verifi.finance

The Challenge (What you will build)

You will dive deep into the day-to-day chaos of accounting workflows, extract the logic, and write software that automates, validates, and quality-controls financial data.

• The “Hardcore” Logic:

You will translate messy, human-centric accounting processes into strict, “hardcore” business logic. This requires understanding the why behind a transaction, not just the how.

• Data Ingestion (Intelligent Document Processing):

You will build pipelines that ingest raw financial documents, cleaning and structuring that data for their system.

• LLM & Predictive Integration:

You will build AI agents that don’t just “chat”, but take real-world actions and amaze users to their core.

• Workflow Automation:

You will identify bottlenecks in Verifi Finance’s customers’ daily lives and code them out of existence.

• UI:

You will not shy away from contributing to UX and state management (client side) of the product.

The Verifi Finance Tech Stack

• Core: TypeScript (Must be god-level). They value type safety and strict standards.

• Data: Deep understanding of Databases. You know how to model financial ledgers and ensure data integrity.

• AI-Assisted Workflow: At Verifi, they move fast. They expect you to be proficient with Cursor, Claude, and Gemini to accelerate boilerplate and refactoring. They’d love to see how you do it your way.

• The “Plus” List: Experience with Python, Go, Rust, or Java is highly valued for backend performance and data processing_.

Who You Are

• Direct & Energetic: You cut through the noise. You communicate clearly, you push back when the design is wrong, and you bring energy to the team.

• Customer-Obsessed: You are willing to understand the “boring” parts of accounting to build the exciting parts of the software. You empathize with the user’s pain.

• A “Finisher”: You don’t just start cool experiments; you ship production-ready, test-covered features.

• Adaptable: Verifi Finance is well funded and ready to roll. The environment changes, the vision evolves, and you need to be quick to absorb new knowledge.

• Startup Mindset: Previous experience working in a startup environment is a strong plus.

Verifi Finance Offers You

• A unique opportunity to contribute to building a breakthrough financial software system

• Close collaboration with the founders and a team of dedicated colleagues

• Hybrid workplace with expected 2-3 workdays per week at the office

• A dynamic work environment with short decision-making paths

• Strong opportunities for personal development and expanded responsibilities

• Competitive salary and benefits package. They have an ESOP in place and this role is planned to be a part of it with standard cliff periods.

You will work at the company HQ in central Copenhagen, offering lunch facilities and access to a vibrant startup ecosystem.

Interested in joining Verifi Finance?

At Bloom, we are actively reviewing applications and look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible.

If you have any questions, please feel free to contact Director Sara Juhl at Bloom via sj@bloom.dk or +45 2086 0865.

The Tech Collective, Data & AI

Kalkværksvej 5, 8000 Aarhus · Full-time

We’re looking for a senior builder who turns AI and data into products people actually use. You’ve shipped real systems end to end, you know AI or data well enough to make it work in production, not just in a demo, and AI is as much a part of how you build as what you build.

What you'll do

In this role, you’ll take client ideas from a rough hypothesis to a working prototype, and then to a production system that runs reliably. You'll design the architecture, write the code across frontend, backend, and data, and decide what to build and what to leave out. It's a hands-on role. Most of your time goes into building, and the rest goes into working with clients to make sure you’re building the right thing.

The work covers generative AI applications and agents, including the harnesses that make them reliable (tools, context, memory, orchestration, and guardrails), along with retrieval pipelines and the data flows they depend on. You’ll connect these to client systems, deploy them in the cloud, and set up the evals and observability you need to see whether they work and how to improve them. You’ll work closely with our data platform and AI specialists, review code, and help less experienced engineers grow.

What you'll bring

You're a builder at heart. You have a master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, (preferably) 5+ years of hands-on software experience, and a track record of shipping production-ready software systems. Ideally, you also have experience with the whole software development lifecycle: starting with an idea (whether your own or a stakeholder’s), designing the solution architecture, developing and testing the solution, and putting it into the hands of actual users. Good engineering matters to you, but you’re not a purist, you care more about shipping something that works and solves the problem.

What sets you apart is depth beyond the code. You know AI (LLMs, agents, RAG, evals) and data (data modelling, pipelines, event-driven, and real-time systems) well enough that others come to you for it. Ideally, you know a bit of both.

You're equally at home building AI products and building with AI. Coding agents and AI-assisted tools are part of how you work every day, and you use them critically. You know where they make you faster and where the output needs a careful human eye.

To be a great fit, it helps if you have:

• 
Solid full-stack skills in Python and/or TypeScript (e.g., React, Next.js, FastAPI), with production systems to show for it

• 
Hands-on experience building agents and the harnesses around them (tool use, MCP, context and memory management, orchestration, guardrails), and designing the data models and pipelines that real products run on

• 
An AI-native way of working, using coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex in your own development workflow, with a clear view of where they help and where they don’t

• 
Experience deploying and running solutions on AWS, Azure, or GCP, including containers, CI/CD, and enough observability to know what's going on

• 
System-level judgement: you can reason about architecture, trade-offs, and failure modes, and you can spot the weak points in an existing stack

• 
Curiosity about the client’s problem, and the ability to explain technical choices clearly to people who don’t write code

• 
A habit of helping others get better through sparring, pairing, and code reviews

English is our corporate language. Proficiency in one or more additional languages is a plus.

What we offer

At The Tech Collective, you’ll join a team of 30 consultants that feels closer to a nerdy startup than a large consultancy, while being firmly backed by Implement Consulting Group. You’ll own what you build, and you’ll have the freedom to shape your role in the direction that motivates you.

You’ll work on data and AI problems across industries, alongside experienced peers in AI, data, and software. Our culture is built on trust, curiosity, humility, and impact, with high autonomy, co-creation, and active knowledge-sharing.

Ready to build with us? We review applications on an ongoing basis, so apply as soon as you can.

The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement Consulting Group. We help organisations unlock the potential of data, AI, and analytics so they’re fit for the digital future. In our collective, you’ll find people who combine nerdiness with infectious energy. We’re passionate about technology, and we have a sincere interest in people

Shape leadership at a company that shapes societies!

As societies face demographic change, digital sovereignty, climate resilience, and technological disruption, we combine technology expertise with an understanding of society’s needs.

We work closely with our lines of business and colleagues across People to translate business priorities into practical initiatives that build the capabilities KMD needs today and in the future.

ABOUT THE JOB

Working closely with business leaders and People teams, you will ensure our learning programs and offerings align with organizational goals, reinforce key competencies, and foster a thriving leadership culture. Your primary focus will be designing leadership development frameworks and taking end-to-end ownership of program implementation and delivery. Facilitation is a supporting part of the role, rather than its main focus.

• 
Lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of KMD’s leadership framework and principles, translating them into impactful learning offerings – from comprehensive development programs and focused learning sessions to bite-sized digital learning.

• 
Translate business strategy and cultural priorities into scalable leadership development programs and learning events for different leadership levels.

Program design & delivery

• 
Own the end-to-end design, implementation, and delivery of leadership development programs, translating frameworks into practical learning journeys and coordinating internal experts and external providers.

• 
Act as subject matter expert and advisor to leaders on leadership capability building.

Succession planning

• 
Own the succession planning framework and annual process in collaboration with HRBPs and business leaders.

• 
Ensure robust identification, assessment, and development of critical leadership talent and successors.

Assessment tools & development

• 
Lead the use and continuous improvement of Deeper Signals and Hogan to support individual and team development.

• 
Facilitate individual feedback sessions and team workshops, translating assessment insights into clear development actions.

Data, governance & impact

• 
Define success metrics for leadership development and succession planning.

• 
Use data and insights to continuously improve programs and ensure measurable impact.

You will work from our Ballerup office in reference to Head of Capability Management.

ABOUT YOU

Qualifications & Requirements

This role requires experience with end-to-end responsibility for designing, rolling out, and following up on leadership learning events and programs. Your core strength is designing leadership development frameworks and translating them into effective programs. We are looking for a framework architect and program owner, rather than primarily a facilitator.

• 
Over 5 years of experience in Learning & Development, with a strong emphasis on leadership development.

• 
Strong framework and learning design skills, combined with the ability to manage program delivery; facilitation, coaching, and communication skills support this work.

• 
Ability to manage multiple initiatives and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

• 
Ability to influence and build relationships across all levels of the cross-functional organization.

• 
Demonstrates empathy and emotional intelligence in interactions with learners and leaders.

• 
Relevant Master’s degree in HR, Organizational Development, Psychology, or a related field.

What we offer?

Join a collaborative, inclusive environment that values innovation and continuous learning, with opportunities to develop your expertise and help others grow.

Shape leadership development in a growing international company, turning frameworks into programs that strengthen our leadership culture and support business ambitions.

Enjoy a flexible hybrid work model that combines time with colleagues and working from home.

Our recruitment process includes two to three interviews with the hiring team, two tests (a cognitive and a personality test), and a case presentation on leadership development. This gives us the opportunity to get to know each other and explore how your experience and approach match the role.

You will never face challenges alone, but always have experienced teammates by your side.

• Cross-Border Collaboration: Working alongside interdisciplinary, international teams characterized by open knowledge sharing and daily mutual support.

• Thrives in an inclusive, interdisciplinary environment where people listen to each other's ideas and learn together.

The recruitment process is managed by Academic Work, and it is our client's wish that all inquiries regarding the position are directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is ongoing, and the job posting may close before the recruitment process is completed if we advance to the next phase. The process includes two tests: a personality assessment and a cognitive test. These tests serve as tools to find the right talent for the right role and ensure equal opportunity, diversity, and a fair evaluation process.

Do You Feel a Match?

Even if you don't feel you check every single technical box, we still encourage you to apply! Both we at Academic Work and the team at Vattenfall value your potential, your curiosity, and your drive to learn just as much as your specific experience.

jobs.occupation: Full-time PhD position(s) on conspiracy theories in political communication at the Digital Democracy Centre  (5+3 or 4+4 scheme)
jobs.description:
Full-time PhD position(s) on conspiracy theories in political communication at the Digital Democracy Centre (5+3 or 4+4 scheme)

The Digital Democracy Centre (DDC) at the University of Southern Denmark, Odense, invites applications for one or more full-time PhD positions studying conspiracy theories in political communication as part of the German Research Foundation-funded research unit Beyond Crazy: Integrating Benefits into the Analysis of Conspiracy Beliefs.

The project examines how conspiracy theories are shared in political communication, how the media and the public respond to such content, and how politicians perceive conspiracy theories. The project combines qualitative and quantitative social science methods, including content analysis, interviews, and social scientific experiments.

We are looking for motivated candidates from communication, psychology, journalism, political science, sociology, or related disciplines who are interested in conducting high-quality research with societal relevance.

The position can be applied for under either the 5+3 or 4+4 PhD scheme. Employment is expected to start in April 2027 or soon thereafter, and the place of employment is Odense.

For full details about the position, eligibility requirements, PhD schemes and application process, please read the full job advertisement and apply via SDU's website.

Application deadline: 11th of December 2026, 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

jobs.occupation: Senior Data Engineer – Build the Data Foundation for Greener Rail
jobs.description:
Cubris · A Hitachi Rail company · Ballerup, Denmark · On-site with flexibility

Would you like to use your expertise in Python, geospatial data and data platforms to make rail operations smarter and more energy-efficient? At Cubris, you will play a central role in developing the data foundation behind solutions that help train operators reduce energy consumption and improve punctuality.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer who enjoys shaping technical direction, building solutions and working closely with colleagues across engineering, architecture and product.

Your role

You will help shape the data platform and geospatial model supporting our GreenSpeed® platform and Infrastructure Management System. You will turn complex railway data into a consistent, reliable foundation for our software – covering everything from tracks, signals and stations to gradients, speed limits and temporary restrictions.

Your main responsibilities will be to:

• 
Develop our data platform and geospatial model: Define schemas, feature classes, linear referencing using track and chainage, topology rules and railway asset attributes.

• 
Build robust Python data pipelines: Ingest, transform and integrate data, and automate workflows using Airflow or similar orchestration tools.

• 
Develop spatial storage and cloud solutions: Work with PostgreSQL/PostGIS or equivalent technologies, preferably on Microsoft Azure, and apply graph-based structures where they add value.

• 
Ensure data quality and traceability: Validate geometries, topology and attributes, and document data models and workflows with appropriate versioning and change control.

• 
Translate requirements into practical solutions: Collaborate with architects, software engineers, product managers and DevOps to deliver solutions that meet today’s needs and evolve with our products.

What you bring

You have substantial hands-on experience in data platform development and architecture, and you enjoy both making technical decisions and implementing them.

We are particularly interested in your:

• 
Strong Python skills and experience with scalable data pipelines, data integration and orchestration tools such as Airflow.

• 
Experience with GeoPandas, Shapely, GDAL/OGR, PyProj or equivalent geospatial technologies, including LineString and MultiLineString geometries.

• 
Knowledge of PostgreSQL/PostGIS or other spatial databases.

• 
Experience developing cloud-native data solutions, preferably on Microsoft Azure.

• 
Ability to work independently when requirements are evolving and documentation is still taking shape.

We also welcome a strong engineering grounding in industrial systems. You may have developed this through your education or through experience in transport, manufacturing, energy or automation. You understand how software, data and physical infrastructure interact, and how to translate real-world assets and operating conditions into accurate data models. You also appreciate the demands for quality, reliability and traceability in systems used in daily operations.

Experience with QGIS or ArcGIS, graph-based data structures and algorithms, safety-critical systems, railway technology or EBuLa integration would be an advantage.

As a colleague, you share your knowledge, contribute ideas and enjoy solving problems with others. You can balance long-term technical quality with practical delivery.

Why join Cubris?

You will have a real say in technical decisions and product development in a company where ideas can quickly become action. Our flat, agile organisation encourages open dialogue and gives you room to take ownership.

You will join a small, autonomous team backed by Hitachi Rail’s international expertise and resources. Your work will serve a clear purpose: smarter rail operations with lower energy consumption and CO₂ emissions.

The role is based in Ballerup, Denmark. We value close collaboration in the office while offering flexibility.

About Cubris

Cubris is a Danish software company and has been part of Hitachi Rail since 2024. Our award-winning GreenSpeed® platform helps train operators optimise driving, reduce energy consumption and improve punctuality. We develop technology for Driver Advisory Systems (DAS), Automatic Train Operation (ATO) and advanced data analytics.

Interested in joining us?

We would love to hear about your experience, your ideas and what motivates you. Send us your application and CV, or get in touch if you would like to learn more about the role and life at Cubris.

**Student Analyst in Strategy & Transformation

**

**Who We Are

**

NNIT is a niche specialist in IT for life sciences and highly regulated industries. We help pharma, biotech and medtech companies across Europe, the US and Asia, as well as public sector and regulated customers in Denmark, solve their most complex challenges where technology, regulation and business critical processes meet.

We are in the middle of a fundamental transformation. Our strategy, OneNNIT 2030, sets out how we will sharpen our position as a niche specialist, reshape our portfolio into a focused set of value pathways that take customers from advisory through implementation to managed services, bring our US and European organisations together as one, and become a genuinely AI-driven company.

The Strategy & Transformation Office leads that journey. It reports directly to our CEO, owns NNIT's strategy cycle, runs the transformation programme and builds the capabilities that will carry the momentum through to 2030. We are now building the team, and we are looking for a Student Analyst who wants to work at the heart of it.

**What You Will Do

**

This is not a back-office student job. You will work on the same questions as our CEO and Executive Management, and you will see first-hand how strategy is set, decided and turned into action in a listed company.

You do not need to be a technical AI specialist. You should, however, care deeply about how AI reshapes organisations, ways of working and business models, because that question runs through everything we do.

**Typical tasks include

**

• Supporting the programme management of OneNNIT 2030, from planning and milestone tracking to following up on decisions across the organisation

• Preparing sharp decision material, presentations and updates for the CEO, Executive Management and the Board

• Analysing our offerings, markets and competitors as we shape the value pathways NNIT will take to market

• Supporting the annual strategy cycle and strategic projects, including the screening and assessment of partnerships and acquisitions

• Helping drive NNIT's journey to becoming an AI-driven company, across our offerings, our delivery model and our internal ways of working

• Contributing to the change management and internal communication that help colleagues understand and own the transformation

• Preparing and facilitating workshops and leadership meetings

**What You Will Bring

**

We imagine that you

• Are preferably in the third year of your Bachelor's degree, or in the first year of your Master’s degree, for example in Strategy, Organisation and Leadership at Copenhagen Business School

• Have a strong interest in strategy, transformation, change management and AI

• Are analytical and structured, and able to turn complex input into clear, well-argued recommendations

• Write well and build presentations that make their point quickly

• Have strong Excel and PowerPoint skills and are comfortable with the rest of Microsoft Office and everyday AI tools

• Communicate clearly and professionally in English, both written and spoken

• Take initiative, challenge your own thinking, handle confidential information with discretion and enjoy working with senior stakeholders

**What We Offer

**

You will join the Strategy & Transformation Office, which reports directly to the CEO, and work closely with the Head of Strategy & Transformation. You will have a front-row seat as NNIT redefines its strategy, organisation and portfolio, and you will work alongside Executive Management, senior leaders across Europe, the US and Asia, and our external advisors.

You will get real responsibility from day one, high exposure to senior leadership and the flexibility to balance work with your studies. Few student jobs offer a closer view of how strategy and transformation are done in practice.

**Practical Information

**

The role is 15 to 20 hours per week, with flexibility around exams.

Please upload your CV and cover letter in English. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply soon.

About NNIT

NNIT is a publicly listed company that specializes in IT solutions to life sciences internationally, and to the public and enterprise sectors in Denmark. We focus on high complexity industries and thrive in environments where regulatory demands and complexity are high. We advise on and build sustainable digital solutions that work for the patients, citizens, employees, end users or customers.

NNIT consists of group company NNIT A/S and subsidiaries SCALES, Excellis Health Solutions and SL Controls. Together, these companies employ more than 1,600 people in Europe, Asia, and USA.

We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees. We actively work to eliminate bias and ensure an inclusive workplace where everyone has the right to be seen and heard as they are. We invite interested candidates to apply, no matter their background.

In the interest of fostering a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request candidates to refrain from including their pictures in their applications.

Senior Engineer – AI & Data Products (Aarhus)

The Tech Collective, Data & AI

Kalkværksvej 5, 8000 Aarhus · Full-time

We’re looking for a senior builder who turns AI and data into products people actually use. You’ve shipped real systems end to end, you know AI or data well enough to make it work in production, not just in a demo, and AI is as much a part of how you build as what you build.

What you'll do

In this role, you’ll take client ideas from a rough hypothesis to a working prototype, and then to a production system that runs reliably. You'll design the architecture, write the code across frontend, backend, and data, and decide what to build and what to leave out. It's a hands-on role. Most of your time goes into building, and the rest goes into working with clients to make sure you’re building the right thing.

The work covers generative AI applications and agents, including the harnesses that make them reliable (tools, context, memory, orchestration, and guardrails), along with retrieval pipelines and the data flows they depend on. You’ll connect these to client systems, deploy them in the cloud, and set up the evals and observability you need to see whether they work and how to improve them. You’ll work closely with our data platform and AI specialists, review code, and help less experienced engineers grow.

What you'll bring

You're a builder at heart. You have a master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, (preferably) 5+ years of hands-on software experience, and a track record of shipping production-ready software systems. Ideally, you also have experience with the whole software development lifecycle: starting with an idea (whether your own or a stakeholder’s), designing the solution architecture, developing and testing the solution, and putting it into the hands of actual users. Good engineering matters to you, but you’re not a purist, you care more about shipping something that works and solves the problem.

What sets you apart is depth beyond the code. You know AI (LLMs, agents, RAG, evals) and data (data modelling, pipelines, event-driven, and real-time systems) well enough that others come to you for it. Ideally, you know a bit of both.

You're equally at home building AI products and building with AI. Coding agents and AI-assisted tools are part of how you work every day, and you use them critically. You know where they make you faster and where the output needs a careful human eye.

To be a great fit, it helps if you have:

• 
Solid full-stack skills in Python and/or TypeScript (e.g., React, Next.js, FastAPI), with production systems to show for it

• 
Hands-on experience building agents and the harnesses around them (tool use, MCP, context and memory management, orchestration, guardrails), and designing the data models and pipelines that real products run on

• 
An AI-native way of working, using coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex in your own development workflow, with a clear view of where they help and where they don’t

• 
Experience deploying and running solutions on AWS, Azure, or GCP, including containers, CI/CD, and enough observability to know what's going on

• 
System-level judgement: you can reason about architecture, trade-offs, and failure modes, and you can spot the weak points in an existing stack

• 
Curiosity about the client’s problem, and the ability to explain technical choices clearly to people who don’t write code

• 
A habit of helping others get better through sparring, pairing, and code reviews

English is our corporate language. Proficiency in one or more additional languages is a plus.

What we offer

At The Tech Collective, you’ll join a team of 30 consultants that feels closer to a nerdy startup than a large consultancy, while being firmly backed by Implement Consulting Group. You’ll own what you build, and you’ll have the freedom to shape your role in the direction that motivates you.

You’ll work on data and AI problems across industries, alongside experienced peers in AI, data, and software. Our culture is built on trust, curiosity, humility, and impact, with high autonomy, co-creation, and active knowledge-sharing.

Ready to build with us? We review applications on an ongoing basis, so apply as soon as you can.
