jobs.occupation: Technical Instructor - Offshore Operations - Maersk Training
jobs.description:
Experienced Offshore Professional from Oil & Gas, Wind, or Energy Operations? Share your operational expertise as an Instructor at Maersk Training in Svendborg. Help shape the next generation of energy professionals and contribute to safer operations worldwide.

**Recruitment managed by MARPRO Group on behalf of Maersk Training.

Maersk Training, a global leading learning provider to the maritime, oil & gas and wind industry, is expanding our offerings and growing our business within the maritime and energy industry. We are looking for a professional with frontline operational experience from the oil & gas, offshore, or wider energy industry, combined with the potential, ability, and passion to share knowledge, experience, and best practices with others.

**We Offer

**An exciting and challenging position, where you will use both your technical competence and experience, as well as your interpersonal skills. As our new Technical Instructor, you will be part of an innovative company, dedicated to developing crew competence in the maritime – and energy industry, to improve safety and operational performance.

**Key Responsibilities

**The scope will be to deliver (both classroom and virtual) and develop training within the maritime and energy industry.

You will:

• Conduct high-quality courses within the maritime-, wind- and energy industry

• Take part in maintaining our advanced simulators and developing new scenarios and exercises

• Ensure timely update and upgrade of the courses you are assigned responsibility for

• Develop new courses and services to customers

• Keep an eye on technology development and industry trends within marine engineering, and share your knowledge with the instructor team and commercial

• Support our sales organisation with expert advice and technical knowledge

**Professional Competencies Required For This Role

**We are looking for a person that has:

• You have a technical background as Marine Engineer, Offshore Engineer, Technical Supervisor, Control Room Operator or similar within offshore wind, oil & gas, drilling, or other energy-related industries.

• Strong technical competence with demonstrated experience from a supervisory, operational, or training position within the offshore wind, oil & gas, drilling, or energy industries.

• Hands-on experience from offshore operations, oil & gas production facilities, drilling rigs, control room operations, or similar technical environments.

• Experience delivering training, mentoring colleagues, or developing the skills of others is considered an advantage.

• Fluent in English both verbally and in writing

Other backgrounds than above could also be relevant, so we encourage anyone with interest in the position to apply.

**Personal characteristics we are looking for

**

• Passionate about sharing knowledge and helping others develop their competence and skills

• Highly self-driven and result oriented

• Service minded and open to new tasks

• Strong desire to contribute to the team success

• Structured way of working, showing attention to detail and following procedures

• Motivated to acquire new knowledge, and use this to develop and deliver high-quality training

• Be able to work both alone managing own projects and form part of a team

**What Maersk Training Offers

**Joining Maersk Training means becoming part of a globally respected organisation dedicated to developing competence, safety, and operational excellence across the maritime and energy industries.

**As Technical Instructor, you can expect:

**

• A full-time, permanent position with long-term career opportunities

• An attractive compensation package reflecting your experience and expertise

• A daily lunch arrangement

• Access to fitness facilities and wellness benefits

• The opportunity to work in a truly international environment with colleagues, clients, and participants from across the globe

• A collaborative culture where you become part of a highly skilled and dedicated team of instructors

• The chance to work for a well-respected and reputable global brand with a strong market position and solid financial foundation

• A meaningful role where you help develop the next generation of maritime and energy professionals while contributing to safer and more efficient operations worldwide

**Application

**The application process is handled by MARPRO Group. If you have any questions to this position, please contact Chief Operations Manager Nanna Lyck Cerelius, MARPRO Group at +45 5370 0995.

If you are interested in the position, please upload a motivated application and an updated CV via the application button. You will receive a confirmation email from us. Please check your spam folder, if you have not received the confirmation within 10 minutes after applying, to ensure future communication.

**About Maersk Training

**_Maersk Training is a global training and consulting organisation and part of the A.P. Moller - Maersk Group. For more than 40 years, the company has helped develop skilled, confident, and safety-focused professionals across the maritime, wind, energy, and offshore industries.

__With world-class training facilities, advanced simulators, and a strong focus on practical learning, Maersk Training partners with organisations worldwide to improve safety, operational performance, and technical competence.

__Driven by excellence, innovation, and a passion for workforce development, Maersk Training plays a vital role in preparing people and businesses for the challenges of today's and tomorrow's industries. As a Maritime Instructor, you will become part of a respected international organisation where your expertise will help shape the next generation of maritime professionals.

_We strongly encourage you to connect with MARPRO Group, to be considered for job openings that are not publicly listed. It is 100% free and confidential to join our talent pool and you can create your personal profile in few minutes.

We are your gateway to Maritime & Shipping talent. Whether you’re a maritime or logistics company seeking exceptional professionals or a skilled individual searching for the next career opportunity, we connect the right talent with the right employers. Our extensive network and industry-specific expertise ensure a seamless recruitment process, making us the preferred choice for Maritime & Shipping staffing solutions.

We have the full and exclusive mandate to all positions listed and all applications have to go via MARPRO Group.

**Warehouse & Inventory Controller

**Take full responsibility for warehouse operations, inventory management and stock accuracy in an international project organisation.

Copenhagen Global A/S is part of Copenhagen Group, a Danish project-driven organisation with a strong international profile. We tender for and manage complex projects for international organisations and national authorities, operating across different markets and in close cooperation with specialised partners.

Our activities place high demands on structured warehouse operations, accurate inventory management and reliable stock control. To support this, we are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Warehouse & Inventory Controller to take full responsibility for Copenhagen Global's warehouse, working closely with colleagues to ensure that all goods, equipment and materials are properly registered, stored and managed.

Your Responsibilities

You will have overall responsibility for the day-to-day operations of Copenhagen Global's warehouse, ensuring accurate stock records and effective inventory control.

Your responsibilities will include registering incoming and outgoing goods, maintaining accurate inventory records and ensuring that all materials and equipment are correctly identified, stored and accounted for. You will be responsible for maintaining and updating the warehouse management system, ensuring that physical stock levels match recorded inventory.

You will also plan and conduct regular stocktakes, identify and resolve discrepancies, and maintain clear procedures for stock handling, storage and inventory control, ensuring that all inventory records are continuously updated and accurately maintained in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.

In addition, you will coordinate the receipt and dispatch of goods, support logistical requirements across Copenhagen Global's projects and work closely with colleagues in procurement, project management and other relevant functions.

You will take ownership of maintaining a well-organised, safe and efficient warehouse, ensuring that materials and equipment are accessible, traceable and handled in accordance with established procedures.

The role requires a high degree of independence, accountability and attention to detail.

Your Background

We are looking for someone with previous experience in warehouse management, including direct responsibility for inventory control and goods registration.

You have practical experience with warehouse management or inventory systems and understand the importance of accurate registration, stock reconciliation and traceability. You are confident working with digital systems and maintaining structured, reliable inventory records.

You are highly detail-oriented, systematic and reliable, with a strong sense of responsibility and the ability to maintain an overview of a wide range of materials, equipment and ongoing activities.

You are proactive in identifying discrepancies and improving procedures, and you take pride in maintaining an organised warehouse where stock levels and the location of goods can be accounted for at all times.

You are comfortable working independently, prioritising tasks and coordinating with colleagues across different functions. You communicate effectively in Danish and English.

Relevant experience in logistics or project-driven warehouse operations, preferably involving the use of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, will be considered an advantage.

Practical Information

The position is based at our warehouse facilities in Copenhagen.

Salary will reflect qualifications and experience.

Employment is conditional upon obtaining the required security clearance.

About the role

Would you like to be part of an ambitious Compliance team where you play a key role in ensuring that Saxo meets its regulatory obligations within financial and non-financial risk areas? If so, this may be the right opportunity for you at Saxo. You will join the Prudential Oversight team within Group Compliance, Saxo's second line of defence function, based at our headquarters in Hellerup. Our team oversees compliance risks across a broad range of areas, including the financial risk areas of capital, market risk, liquidity and credit risk, as well as non-financial risk areas such as ICT, operational risk, model risk, data governance and strategy, supporting the business in meeting regulatory requirements, market standards and internal policies. Your primary responsibility will be to conduct compliance oversight and monitoring across the financial risk areas of capital, market risk, liquidity and credit risk in relation to policies, procedures, segregation of duties, limits, calculations, samples, controls, etc. As a team, we balance professionalism with a sense of humour and maintain an informal atmosphere where people enjoy coming to work.

Responsibilities

• Perform compliance risk assessments

• Provide advice and compliance opinions to the business on managing compliance risks and regulatory requirements

• Conduct compliance monitoring activities

• Contribute to regular compliance reporting to senior management of the bank

• Participate in developing the bank’s compliance framework

• Interact with the business across organisational levels and seniority

Your profile

We are looking for a colleague with experience from working with one or more prudential risk areas, who is motivated to develop deeper expertise in these areas. Further we expect you to have:

• At least 2 years of relevant experience from the financial sector, preferably within compliance, risk management, audit, finance, credit or another relevant first-line function

• A relevant educational background within economics, finance, accounting, audit or similar

• Interest in prudential risk areas such as capital, liquidity, market risk, credit risk, model risk, strategic risk, operational risk areas, governance, and internal controls

• Familiarity with regulatory requirements such as CRR/CRD, Basel guidelines, EBA/ESMA guidelines, the Executive Order on Management and Control of Banks and other relevant Danish financial regulation is an advantage

Moreover, we are looking for someone who is detail-oriented, can work independently while taking an active role in teamwork and enjoys collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders across the entire organisation. It is an advantage if you thrive in an environment with constant change, bring a positive and curious mindset to work, and do not buy into the word ‘cannot’. You must possess strong stakeholder management skills and use your communication skills to ensure positive collaboration and progress in joint tasks. We are looking for a colleague who always brings a positive attitude when liaising with the business.

Please note! International applicants are encouraged to apply. To help us understand your circumstances, we kindly ask candidates currently based outside Denmark to include a brief summary of their relocation plans and expected timeframe for relocating to Denmark.

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on. You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success. We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations. When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense. At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

How to apply

: Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

About Saxo Bank

Support our purpose

We believe access to global capital markets is not only for the privileged few. Our vision is to enable people to fulfill their financial aspirations to make an impact. That’s why we use the power of technology to deliver clients what they need, when they need it in a user-friendly and personalised experience. We aim to deliver the world’s most user-friendly and personalized trading and investment platform experience, which gives our clients exactly what they need to make more informed investment decisions.

Be part of a unique journey

Do you want to work for an extremely ambitious organisation at the cutting edge of banking and technology? You’ll be joining a company that:

. Continuously strives to improve the Saxo Experience and exceed our clients’ expectations.

. Always invests in the future

. Builds unrivalled platforms for seasoned and experienced investors and wholesale clients that provide real-time access to global capital markets.

. Consistently wins the highest accolades for our platforms, products and services.

Own your future

So, if you’re up for the challenge of breaking down barriers in global financial markets, we’re always looking for ambitious and enthusiastic people who share our passion for clients, technology and innovation and can bring new perspectives to our diverse team. For more on our story, culture and identity, please read the Saxo Bank Foundation, written by our CEO and founder Kim Fournais.

Are you experienced with Application Lifecycle Management system and GxP automation? Do you thrive in a global environment and want to advance your career withing life sciences? If so, we invite you to keep reading.

**Your Role As GxP System Specialist

**You will join the ALK Global Business IT Business Application Systems (BAS) department as process owner for Application Lifecycle Management system and GxP automation. In ALK, we use OpenText ALM for Application Lifecycle Management and OpenText UFT for GxP automation.

**Responsibilities

**In this role, you will combine strong process ownership with hands-on system and tooling expertise to drive improvement and innovation in a GxP enviroment, your Key Responsibilities include:

• Own and continuously improve ALK's Application Lifecycle Management system (OpenText ALM), ensuring it remains compliant, efficient, and fit for purpose as regulatory and business needs evolve.

• Support computer system validation (CSV) activities for ALK’s automation and test-automation solutions (OpenText UFT) that fall within GxP scope, applying a risk-based approach throughout.

• Drive the creation and maintenance of QMS-related SOPs and Work Instructions for OpenText ALM and OpenText UFT, keeping documentation current with regulatory expectations.

• Proactively identify and manage improvement opportunities across Global IT systems, including expanding automated and computer-aided testing to increase coverage and efficiency.

**It is preferred that the candidate has solid knowledge of compliance, so the candidate can also take further responsibilities include:

**

• Lead the GxP compliance framework for projects and releases across ALK's Veeva Vault portfolio, coordinating impact assessments and validation activities.

• Support the handling of Deviations, CAPAs, and Change Controls for systems owned by our department, ensuring timely and well-documented resolution.

• Assist in representing Business Application Systems during internal and external inspections and audits, preparing and presenting validation and automation evidence.

**Your qualifications to enable you to succeed in this role:

****IT Qualifications

**

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.

• 3+ years of professional experience within pharmaceutical or other GxP-regulated industries.

• 3+ years of hands-on experience with Computer System Validation (CSV) and GxP compliance requirements.

• Solid, hands-on experience with ALM (Application Lifecycle Management) is required.

• Experience with Veeva Vault QualityDocs and Veeva Vault RIM is an advantage.

**General Qualifications

**

• Quick learner with a genuine interest in new applications and technologies.

• Innovative mindsets paired with a pragmatic, can-do attitude.

• A structured, quality-first mindset is essential, with the ability to follow and document processes in line with ALK's quality standards.

• Proficiency in both written and spoken English.

• Proven ability to collaborate effectively and thrive in an international environment, with colleagues located in Hørsholm, Madrid, and Krakow.

• Flexibility to travel up to 10 days per year, primarily within Europe.

**World Leader In Allergy

**ALK’s goal is to become the global leader in allergy care by helping many people live better lives through prevention, diagnosis, and treatment options. In Global IT, we play a key role in this mission by supporting the organization with cutting-edge IT tools and technologies, and by providing world-class support to our colleagues around the world.

**Global IT At ALK

**Global IT at ALK is a diverse, international team of approximately 140 employees, with key hubs in Hørsholm, Madrid, and Krakow, along with IT staff at production sites and regional sales hubs in Germany, France, and North America. ALK predominantly manages its IT expertise in-house, offering you the chance to collaborate with talented colleagues from around the world.

We believe that achieving outstanding results and delivering exceptional IT services go hand in hand fostering development and learning opportunities. Our employees are encouraged to connect and support each other daily. You will join an IT organization that values competence and substance over style and presentation, and that thrives on collaborative, iterative teamwork.

**We look forward to hearing from you!

**Are you experienced with Application Lifecycle Management system and GxP automation? Do you thrive in a global environment and want to advance your career withing life sciences? If so, we invite you to keep reading.

Allergy impacts and challenges the lives of millions of adults and children every day. At ALK, our purpose is to improve the lives of people living with allergies. Building on our strong heritage, we are guided by our strategy, Allergy+, that shows us a clear path towards this goal through focus, innovation, cultivation and optimisation.

Read more about our corporate strategy and our ambitions for growth

**Fair and unbiased recruitment at ALK

**At ALK, we believe that every candidate deserves to be evaluated fairly and respectfully. Our recruitment process is designed to give each applicant an equal opportunity, regardless of their background. Read more about fair and unbiased recruitment at ALK.

If you are applying from North America, please know that we are committed to fair, unbiased and non-discriminatory recruitment practices and to complying with all applicable federal, state and local employment laws. Employment decisions are made based on qualifications, skills and experience, without discrimination on the basis of legally protected characteristics. For more information, please visit the official websites of the relevant authorities: U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) and Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP).

jobs.occupation: Key Account Manager – Industrial Energy Clients
jobs.description:
Company Description

Vattenfall is a leading European energy company driving the transition to a sustainable energy system. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years. We employ around 21 000 people mostly in our core markets in Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK.

Job Description

Do you want to make a difference and help industrial companies navigate the energy transition?

Vattenfall’s Business Sales Department offers a wide range of products in the energy field. We operate in a highly competitive and dynamic market, serving large corporate customers, partners, and resellers. Our ambition is to be number one for the customer.

We are looking for a Key Account Manager to join our Industrial Production Clients team within Business Area Customers & Solutions. This is an opportunity to strengthen Vattenfall’s position as the preferred energy partner for industrial customers in Denmark and across the Nordic region.

Our customers operate in an increasingly complex environment where competitiveness, energy supply, commercial risk, and sustainability ambitions are closely connected. In this role, you will help customers navigate these challenges while building long-term partnerships that create value for both the customer and Vattenfall.

Vattenfall has established a strong position within the Industrial Production client segment in Sweden, Finland, and Denmark. As we continue to build an even stronger customer platform in Denmark, you will become an important part of our Nordic sales organization and contribute directly to its future growth.

You will join a Nordic sales team of thirteen Key Account Managers across Sweden, Finland, and Denmark and report to the Sales Manager and Head of Industrial Production Clients Nordic. Based in Copenhagen, you will work closely with colleagues across the region. The team has a collaborative, knowledge-sharing culture, supported by flexible working conditions that combine office collaboration with remote work when appropriate.

Qualifications

Your role

As Key Account Manager, you will be responsible for developing long-term, profitable business and strategic customer partnerships within the Nordic Industrial Production client segment. You will work with prospects and customers to understand their operations, energy needs, market exposure, decision-making structures, and long-term priorities.

From this insight, you will identify opportunities, offer relevant solutions, and negotiate contracts. You will act as a trusted advisor, helping prospects and customers navigate the energy transition, manage market risks, and achieve their sustainability ambitions, including reducing their environmental footprint.

You will coordinate cross-functional expertise across Vattenfall to develop and deliver customer solutions. This includes close cross-functional collaboration to ensure alignment, a seamless customer experience, and long-term value creation.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Develop and manage long-term strategic relationships with industrial prospects & customers in Denmark and across the Nordic market.

• Identify customer needs and translate them into tailored, value-creating energy solutions.

• Take commercial ownership of customer opportunities from early development through internal alignment, negotiation, and contracting.

• Lead commercial discussions and contract negotiations in close collaboration with relevant specialists.

• Coordinate cross-functional bid and solution-development activities, ensuring clear ownership, alignment, and progress.

• Act as a trusted advisor by translating energy-market and industry developments into relevant customer insights.

Manage and develop a profitable customer portfolio while contributing to Vattenfall’s customer offering and commercial platform in Denmark.

Your profile

You are a commercially minded professional with experience in B2B sales, key account management, business development, or another field involving complex customer solutions. Experience from the energy commodity business is highly relevant, while experience from sectors with complex instruments, such as insurance or finance, may also provide a strong foundation.

You combine strategic and commercial focus with operational capability. You are genuinely interested in customers and their industry challenges, and you are motivated to create the best possible value through collaboration. Structured, proactive, and self-driven, you enjoy working independently as well as in a cross-border team.

Your credibility is built through business insight, sound judgement, and clear communication. You are trustworthy, solution-oriented, and comfortable involving the right colleagues to move customer opportunities forward. You bring creative thinking and a drive to continuously develop and improve.

To succeed in this role, you bring:

• A relevant degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Science, or a comparable field.

• Fluency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

• Strong and demonstrated business acumen.

• Experience in B2B sales, key account management, business development, or other complex commercial environments.

• Knowledge of energy commodities, electricity markets, energy procurement, risk management, or comparable complex solutions.

• Strong communication, influencing, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.

• A genuine interest in customers, their operations, and their industry challenges.

• A proactive, collaborative, and solution-oriented way of working.

• Experience with electricity supply agreements, commodity contracts, hedging solutions, power purchase agreements, Nordic electricity markets, or decarbonisation strategies is an advantage.

• An established network within Danish industry or the energy sector would also be beneficial.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Location  Copenhagen

Additional Information

Our offer

Looking for a career with growth?

Looking for a role where your superpowers can be leveraged to the maximum and with limitless opportunities for growth?

The scale and ambition of our wind, battery and solar business means you can really find your element with us. We’ll also provide you with all the learning and development you need to expand your horizons.

We strive to be the best place to work in the industry with highly competitive pay and conditions and an open, supportive culture. A commitment to a healthy work-life balance aims to ensure everyone plays to their strengths, whatever their background and experiences.

You will be part of a growing team of 1,700+ colleagues from 50+ nationalities where our positive approach to diversity is reflected in the fact that more than a quarter of staff are women.

More Information

For more information about the position you are welcome to contact hiring manager Annelie Gerborn, annelie.gerborn@vattenfall.com.  For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our recruiter Christian Pathuel, christian.pathuel@vattenfall.com

We welcome your application in English no later than 22-11-2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website.

At Vattenfall we are convinced that diversity contributes to building a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be a good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation. Click here for further information.

The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfill within Vattenfall and will be performed by a third party, DISA Global Solutions AB.

Since Vattenfall is a part of the Swedish critical infrastructure, many of our services are security classed. If this position is security classified the final candidates might be subject to a security vetting process, according to Swedish legislation.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Are you ready to lead Deloitte’s most strategic pursuits across the Nordics? Join our Nordic Technology & Transformation Sales Excellence team as an experienced Pursuit Lead and head some of our largest and most complex pursuits from early positioning through proposal and client presentation_._

About us

With more than 8,000 employees, Deloitte is one of the largest professional services firms across the Nordics. We help clients navigate complex business and technology transformations by combining deep industry expertise with leading capabilities in Audit, Tax, Advisory, and Consulting.

Join our diverse Nordic Technology & Transformation Sales Excellence team and help shape Deloitte’s most strategic pursuits. We combine pursuit expertise, insight and creativity to develop compelling propositions that stand out with clients. Our open, supportive culture encourages knowledge-sharing, fresh thinking and innovative tools to improve how we work. You will have opportunities to grow professionally and personally, build relationships across Deloitte and help shape the team’s approach to strategic pursuits.

This role could be placed in either Copenhagen, Denmark or in Oslo, Norway.

What will be your role?

We are looking for an experienced Pursuit Lead to join our team. You will project manage some of Deloitte’s most strategic pursuits across the Nordics, leading the end-to-end pursuit process from pre-RFP planning through proposal development, client presentations and follow-up. Using strong project management skills, you will create structure, momentum and quality across complex pursuits, while working closely with pursuit leadership and multidisciplinary teams.

Beyond managing the process, you will, together with rest of the Sales Excellence team, bring a strategic mindset, helping teams develop compelling and differentiated propositions.

In this role, you will make an impact by:

• Leading the pursuit process: Drive the plan with the client service pursuit lead, set milestones and deliverables, track assignments, manage meetings and logistics, and mitigate risks to deliver high-quality submissions that meet client requirements.

• Developing the winning strategy: Work with the Pursuit team to shape compelling value propositions, winning messages and a differentiated strategy for each opportunity.

• Coordinating proposal and presentation development: Oversee documents, design and quality and risk reviews, ensuring consistent strategic messaging across all deliverables.

• Engaging stakeholders and governance: Align senior leaders, subject-matter experts, client service teams and other internal stakeholders; facilitate leadership and quality reviews; and coordinate quality and solutions reviews.

• Managing risks proactively: Identify content and knowledge gaps, identify risks and escalate issues when appropriate.

• Driving innovation and continuous improvement: Apply best practices and lessons from past pursuits and the wider network. Use AI and innovative tools to improve research, collaboration, content and quality, and support learning initiatives that strengthen Deloitte’s sales excellence capabilities.

Who are we looking for?

You are a structured and proactive pursuit professional who can work independently while enabling effective collaboration and momentum across diverse teams. You combine sound judgement and analytical thinking with strong interpersonal skills. You maintain composure, flexibility and attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.

What you bring to the team:

• Strong project management skills: Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage complex workstreams and maintain excellent quality control over milestones and deliverables.

• Pursuit and proposal experience: At least three years of experience in pursuit and proposal development, preferably in B2B / Professional services sales. A former consulting client-service background combined with pursuit experience is an advantage.

• Stakeholder leadership: Experience collaborating with and building consensus among executive, management and delivery stakeholders, including the ability to navigate differing opinions constructively.

• Proactive and analytical mindset: A self-starting approach, strong analytical skills and the ability to identify gaps, challenges and risks before they affect delivery.

• Resilience and flexibility: Ability to work well under pressure, maintain composure and adapt to shifting priorities and deadlines.

• Team orientation and interpersonal skills: A collaborative working style and strong relationship-building skills that foster trust, alignment and effective teamwork across diverse stakeholders.

• Language skills: Proficient in written and spoken English. Knowledge of another Scandinavian language is a benefit.

• Work permit: We are only able to consider applicants with a valid work permit in Denmark/Norway

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

What impact will your role make?

Every day, your work will make an impact that matters, while you thrive in a dynamic culture of inclusion, collaboration and high performance. We do not just aspire to make solutions. We wish to create an impact that makes a positive and crucial difference for the people around us, our clients and our society. About The Job

Do you want to work with data engineering, platform development, and data-based automated processes within Saxo's Financial Crime Prevention (FCP)? Saxo is an investment bank with high speed, global colleagues, and a strong focus on using technology and data to prevent financial crime. We are looking for a Senior Software/Data Engineer to join the FCP Modelling & Development team. FCP Modelling & Development is part of the 1st Line of Defence in Group Operations and is located in Saxo's headquarters in Hellerup. The team works with models and data-based automated processes used across FCP. The goal is to ensure that these data assets and processes are sound, fit for purpose, adequately documented, secure, and regularly reviewed.

Responsibilities

Build, operate, and continuously improve reusable AML data products, data-modelling components, and user-facing interfaces, with clear ownership, lineage, documentation, quality controls, and production reliability. Design robust ETL pipelines and integration interfaces for operational, analytical, model-development, and external-platform use cases, enabling secure and efficient data exchange across internal and external systems. Translate FCP and AML requirements into durable, adaptable production systems, contributing to solution architecture decisions on design patterns, system scalability, regulatory compliance, and flexibility across AML processes. Partner with FCP and AML subject-matter experts on transaction monitoring, customer segmentation, scenario development, client risk rating, surveillance support, and AML-related development initiatives that strengthen financial crime prevention capabilities. Define automated checks for completeness, consistency, validity, reconciliation, source-to-target integrity, architectural integrity, security, performance, and governance standards. Own observability, alerting, incident response, backfills, runbooks, performance tuning, production support, and operational resilience for critical data assets. Raise engineering standards through design and code reviews, mentoring, reusable patterns, clean and well-documented code, test-driven development, secure coding practices, CI/CD pipeline optimization, automated testing, and continuous improvement.

Your profile

5+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, data-platform engineering, or a related production data role. Strong Python, SQL, and Spark skills, with experience building and maintaining production data pipelines and data models. Practical experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Kafka, Snowflake, Airflow, Azure, or similar technologies. Experience supporting ML workflows, including feature engineering, feature data preparation, dataset versioning, reproducible training and validation datasets, model-validation support, and production-ready model inputs. Deployment skills for production workloads, including CI/CD, containerized services, and Kubernetes or similar orchestration platforms. Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, data access controls, encryption, secure handling of sensitive data, and practical data-security patterns using Azure services such as Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Key Vault, Azure RBAC, and Managed Identities. Hands-on experience maintaining production data pipelines, including data quality testing, reconciliation, lineage, metadata management, documentation, monitoring, and operational controls. Experience with financial crime prevention in regulated financial services, including AML, KYC/CDD/ODD, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, client risk rating, and market-abuse surveillance support. Experience with GDPR-sensitive data, audit evidence, regulator-facing reporting, or data governance in control-heavy environments Nice to have: Experience with data quality validation tools e.g. Great Expectations (GX), dbt‑expectations, Soda, Deequ, or Microsoft Fabric. Clear communication in English with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

The conference floor is where deals start. The dinner is where trust is built. The clip is what 10,000 people see the next morning. Own all three.

**About The Job

**GetWhy is the end-to-end AI-powered human insights platform trusted by the world’s most influential brands, including eBay, Arla, Warner Brothers and The Coca Cola company, to understand their customers at scale. We’re backed by $40M in Series A funding and scaling aggressively into the enterprise market.

In our category, events aren’t a nice-to-have. They are a strategic weapon. Industry conferences, hosted experiences, executive dinners and brand activations are where relationships form, pipeline is built, and GetWhy cements its position as the category leader in AI-powered qualitative research.

We’re hiring our first Lead, Global Events & Community to own how GetWhy shows up in the world. This is a high-ownership role for someone with taste, commercial instinct and relentless execution. You’ll design experiences enterprise buyers actually want to attend, turn every event into content that travels far beyond the room, and build the playbook that lets GetWhy show up brilliantly on every continent.

What you’ll do

Own the global event strategy

• Set GetWhy’s global events strategy with the marketing leadership, from tentpole industry conferences (IIEX, ESOMAR, Quirk’s) to hosted events, executive roundtables and product showcases.

• Plan, produce and execute 15–20+ events per year across Europe, the US and beyond, each tied to clear pipeline, brand and customer goals.

• Own the global events budget, sponsorship negotiations, and relationships with agencies, venues and production partners.

Make GetWhy unmissable at every conference

• Have a strong point of view on world-class conference presence, from booth concept and spatial design to merch and the small details people remember.

• Replace badge-scanning booths with live experiences: let attendees run a real GetWhy study, see AI-moderated interviews in action, and leave with an insight.

• Secure speaking slots and sponsorships that put GetWhy at the centre of the industry conversation.

Put customers on stage

• Build a flagship GetWhy-hosted event where customers present the work they’ve done with GetWhy and show other brands how to do the same.

• Recruit and prepare customer and executive speakers, and make sure every GetWhy representative on stage or on the floor is briefed and on message.

Own the side events and intimate moments

• Design VIP dinners, executive roundtables and side events around major conferences, where the real relationships are built.

• Partner with Sales and Customer Success on account-based events that move specific deals and expansions forward.

Run the content machine

• Capture on-site content at every event, including video, photos and short clips that show GetWhy’s presence on the ground.

• Turn events into social media content, such as live posts, recaps, reels and LinkedIn stories, working with the wider marketing team.

• Conduct on-site interviews with customers, speakers and industry leaders, creating content for social, the website and sales enablement.

• Make sure every event keeps working for weeks afterwards through recaps, clips and follow-up campaigns.

Turn events into revenue

• Build the pre- and post-event engine: invitations, promotion, lead capture, qualification and a seamless handoff to Sales.

• Track and report on pipeline, ROI, reach and brand impact for every event, and double down on what works.

Build the playbook

• Create scalable playbooks and “event in a box” toolkits so local teams and partners can host on-brand GetWhy events anywhere.

• Grow the events function over time, including freelancers, agencies and future hires.

• Stay ahead of new event formats and technologies, and bring the best of them to GetWhy first.

Who you are

You’re not looking for an event coordination role. You’re a builder who sees events as the highest-leverage channel in a B2B enterprise sale, and you want to prove it on a global stage.

• 3–6+ years in event marketing, field marketing or experiential marketing for B2B SaaS, enterprise tech or a high-growth scale-up.

• A portfolio of standout events, with a track record that ties them directly to pipeline and revenue.

• Real taste. You know what makes a booth, a dinner or a keynote memorable, and you can explain why.

• Commercially minded. You think about pipeline and impact, not just logistics.

• A poster, not a scroller. Social media is second nature, and you know what makes an event clip worth watching.

• Comfortable behind a camera and in front of people. You can film, run an interview and do basic editing on the fly.

• A strong operator who can run several events in parallel across time zones without dropping quality.

• An excellent communicator who can brief a designer, negotiate with a venue and pitch an executive audience.

• Comfortable with CRM and marketing automation tools such as HubSpot or Salesforce.

• A willing traveler. You go where the events are and you bring the energy.

Bonus points

• Experience from the insights, market research or MarTech industry. You know the conferences, the audience and the culture.

• Experience at an AI-native research company or a frontier AI or tech company known for its events.

• You’ve built an events function from scratch, including playbooks, processes and measurement.

• You’ve produced a flagship owned event or customer conference.

• A network of event organisers, venues and production partners across Europe and the US.

What we offer

• A fast-scaling, ambitious company where events are a core growth engine, not an afterthought.

• The chance to build GetWhy’s global events function from the ground up and define how a category leader shows up in the world.

• Real ownership, a seat close to leadership, and the budget and trust to try bold ideas.

• Work with some of the world’s most influential brands as customers, speakers and partners.

• Annual company retreats and Friday bar events. We work hard, and we celebrate hard.

How to apply

Click apply and upload your CV, LinkedIn profile, and a link to a portfolio of events you’ve produced. Event photos, clips or social posts you’ve made are a big plus.

If we see a match, we’ll invite you to a conversation online or at our office. The process includes a short creative assignment, where you’ll pitch how GetWhy should show up at one of our key industry conferences.

This isn’t the easiest events job out there. It’s the one that will define how a category leader shows up in the world. Let’s build GetWhy together.

Join us in this role where you’ll be responsible for sourcing the right suppliers to secure the operation and fulfil the servicing needs of our offshore windfarms. You’ll be working with our procurement process and governance from developing the sourcing strategies to contract handover. In this role, you'll be coordinating with our category managers, business stakeholders and colleagues in supporting functions. You can look forward to a dynamic, fast-paced, and international environment, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop your career while making your mark on the transition to renewable energy.

**Welcome to Offshore Generation Procurement

**You’ll be part of the Offshore Services Procurement team where you, together with your colleagues, will support our offshore windfarms to produce power, by ensuring contracting of timely, compliant and competitive O&M services capacity. You’ll be working in a global team of highly skilled procurement professionals. An important aspect of your role is to proactively consolidate input from internal stakeholders to negotiate and sign fit to scope contracts ready for the end users’ purposes. In this role you’ll be working closely with colleagues organized in projects at our operational hubs.

As a team, we ‘re driven by an open working environment where everyone is encouraged to speak up, seek, and provide feedback. We actively take initiative, work on improvements, and seek learning opportunities.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• being responsible for the end to end tendering process, qualifying suppliers, clarifying and evaluating bids, preparing and negotiating terms and conditions, and recommending and awarding suppliers

• ensuring compliance with internal and external tendering rules, policies, and governance by actively engaging and seeking input from key support functions

• preparing and presenting clear and thought-through gate documents to aim management and budget owners’ decision on recommended strategies

• leading communication with suppliers throughout the sourcing activities

• contributing to the quality assurance processes by reviewing peers’ documentation, sharing tendering and contract lessons learned, and providing feedback to category strategies

• handing over complete signed contract package with complete metadata ready for execution .

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have significant experience with managing sourcing processes from drafting of sourcing strategies to contract signing. Experience running tenders according to EU-tender law is a plus

• have a passion for negotiating and possess considerable experience taking responsibility for planning and executing negotiation process

• possess good verbal and written English communication skills enabling you to effectively collaborate with the team and communicate professionally with key stakeholders

• have the bandwidth to spot commercial opportunities focusing on bottom-line impact and personnel safety, while achieving the right technical, operational contract solution

• act with high integrity, take ownership, handles pressure well, proactively asks questions, and seeks input beyond your network to drive results

• are organized, well-structured, and possess good attention to detail, especially when preparing documentation.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. At Intempus, our goal is simple: make time tracking as easy, intelligent and automated as it can possibly be. We're building the future of time tracking and our ambitions are high. This means that our system needs to deliver a stable and great user experience at all times — especially since our user base keeps growing fast.

That’s why we're looking for you: an experienced DevOps Engineer ready for the challenge.

What we offer

• 
A role where you can grow, learn and make a real impact

• 
A helpful, social and diverse workplace with a flat hierarchy and open communication

• 
A healthy work/life balance

• 
55 friendly, driven and skilled colleagues

• 
Flexibility, including two days of remote work per week

• 
A centrally located, modern office at Visma House in Carlsberg Byen, Copenhagen

• 
… and much more!

Your role

As part of our four people DevOps team, your main responsibility will be keeping our systems running smoothly around the clock. More specifically, you will:

• 
Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines that ensure fast, reliable and secure delivery of changes to our applications

• 
Automate infrastructure and server configuration using tools like Ansible, Terraform or whatever fits best — we're moving from a fully manual setup to infrastructure and configuration that's fully documented and managed as code

• 
Monitor and troubleshoot day-to-day issues across our servers and applications

• 
Design and implement improvements using the best tools the DevOps ecosystem has to offer — anything from a new secrets management solution to better container deployment workflows

• 
Collaborate with developers to improve tooling around development and test environments

• 
Keep our infrastructure and applications updated and secure

• 
Automate wherever possible, to cut down on manual effort and maintenance overhead

Who are you?

You're proactive and take ownership of your work. You thrive in a team with plenty of freedom, where ideas are shared openly and people genuinely listen to and support each other.

You communicate clearly, both in writing and in person, and you actively help foster a good team environment.

You hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent, and you bring at least 7 years of experience in a DevOps role or similar (e.g. System Administrator).

On the technical side, you have experience with:

• 
Managing Linux systems for at least two years (we run Debian-based Linux across all our servers)

• 
Bash scripting — you're comfortable working in a bash shell

• 
Docker — building, testing, deploying and maintaining containerized applications in production

• 
A programming language (our CI/CD pipeline and much of our automation is written in Python)

• 
git

• 
A CI/CD tool (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.)

• 
An infrastructure-as-code tool, ideally Terraform

• 
A configuration management tool, ideally Ansible

• 
Container orchestration (e.g. Kubernetes, HashiCorp Nomad)

Nice to have, but not required:

• 
Managing PostgreSQL databases

• 
Cloud services with any provider

Who are we?

Intempus is a Danish software company with offices in Copenhagen and Aarhus. Since 2012, we've built, refined and optimized our own time-tracking system, and we continue to hold high ambitions for our product.

Our team of 55 includes a development team of 35 driven engineers. We are part of the Visma Group but operate day-to-day as an independent company.

Take a look at our team in the Copenhagen office here!

Ready to join us?

Apply now if you can see yourself as our new DevOps Engineer. Job start is January 1st, 2027, but we are flexible for the right candidate. The role is on-site at our office at Visma House in Carlsberg Byen, Copenhagen.

Please submit your application in English, as we are an international team, and include your resumé, educational diploma and references.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.description:
**What’s the role?

**Hilti Denmark is looking for a Digital & Strategy Marketing Manager to lead and develop our digital marketing, branding, communications, and strategic marketing initiatives. In this role, you will be responsible for driving an integrated marketing strategy that strengthens our brand, engages customers and employees, supports commercial growth, and delivers measurable business impact.

As part of the Danish Marketing Leadership Team, you will lead a team of five employees and collaborate closely with stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Finance, and regional and global teams. This is a unique opportunity for an experienced marketing professional who enjoys combining strategic leadership with hands-on execution.

**What You'll Do

**As our Digital & Strategy Marketing Manager, you will be responsible for translating business priorities into impactful marketing initiatives while ensuring strong execution across digital channels, communications, campaigns, pricing, and strategic business projects.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Lead and develop a high-performing marketing team, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability.

• Shape and execute Hilti Denmark's brand, communications, and digital marketing strategy to strengthen market position and customer engagement.

• Own the digital customer journey across content, social media, Hilti Online, and demand generation, driving traffic, conversion, and growth.

• Translate strategic business priorities into impactful go-to-market initiatives and integrated marketing campaigns.

• Use data, customer insights, and market intelligence to optimize performance and influence key business decisions.

• Partner across sales, finance, product, and trade functions to enhance commercial effectiveness, pricing excellence, and sustainable growth.

**What You’ll Bring

**We're looking for an ambitious marketing leader who combines strategic thinking with strong commercial understanding and the ability to turn ideas into action.

**We Imagine That You Have

**

• A university degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field, combined with solid experience in digital marketing, campaign management, strategic marketing, or similar disciplines.

• At least 5 years of experience operating successfully in cross-functional, matrix organizations, with a proven ability to influence stakeholders across functions and organizational levels.

• Strong leadership capabilities with experience developing people, fostering collaboration, and driving high-performing teams.

• A data-driven and analytical mindset, with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to translate insights into business actions and growth opportunities.

• Hands-on experience with digital marketing channels, customer engagement, content strategies, and performance measurement, coupled with strong communication and storytelling skills.

• Fluency in English. Danish and experience within B2B and/or the construction industry are considered strong advantages.

**What’s In It for You

**This is an opportunity to take ownership of a broad and highly visible marketing leadership role with significant business impact. You will combine people leadership, strategic responsibility, and operational execution while helping shape the future direction of Hilti Denmark's marketing organization.

• A leadership role with responsibility for key marketing activities and strategic business initiatives.

• The opportunity to lead and develop a talented team in a collaborative and high-performing environment.

• Close collaboration with senior leaders and international stakeholders across the Hilti organization.

• A dynamic role combining brand management, digital marketing, demand generation, analytics, and business strategy.

• Continuous development opportunities, supported by coaching, feedback, and extensive learning resources.

• Long-term career opportunities within a global organization known for developing its people.

**Why Hilti

**Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.

**Commitment to Inclusion

**At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

**Legal Notice

**Does this sound like you? We look forward to your application!

You can apply for this position by clicking “Apply now” and uploading your CV. You do not need to submit a cover letter, but we encourage you to include a few sentences in your CV about what motivates you to apply for the role.

If your profile matches the position, you will first be invited to a short video interview. After that, selected candidates will be invited for an in-person interview. If you have any questions about the position, you are very welcome to contact our recruitment team at DKTeamRecruiting@hilti.com

jobs.occupation: GRC Specialist, Netcompany Group CISO Office
jobs.description:
Job Description

Do you want to help shape how a large IT company measures, manages and documents its information security? Are you motivated by turning data, risk and regulation into practical decisions? If so, you may be our next colleague in the newly established GRC team in Netcompany's Group CISO Office.

Responsibilities and technologies

As a member of the GRC team, you will help ensure that Netcompany has an accurate, data-driven view of the effectiveness of its security controls and its level of compliance. The team takes a pragmatic and technically grounded approach to governance, risk and compliance, and works closely with the Application Security team, the Operations organisation, Internal IT and other business functions across the group.

The GRC team is a small team of colleagues with complementary profiles. We do not expect any one candidate to cover every area described below. Instead, we are looking for broad profiles with solid experience across several of these areas and the motivation to develop within the rest.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Developing and maintaining risk scenarios, assessing the effectiveness of mitigating controls against the scenarios, and conducting risk assessments to support business decisions

• Establishing automated measurements and KPIs that provide insight into the implementation and effectiveness of security controls across the business

• Interpreting regulatory and contractual security requirements and translating these into Netcompany's security baselines and standard methodologies

• Planning and executing security awareness activities, including phishing simulations, targeted micro-learning, and onboarding/yearly awareness training

• Driving smaller security improvement projects from planning to implementation, combining coordination with hands-on execution

• Developing, maintaining and testing internal security processes, such as major incident response, crisis management and business continuityDeveloping, maintaining and testing internal security processes, such as major incident response, crisis management and business continuity

About you

You have broad experience within information security and a solid understanding of its technical aspects alongside a general understanding of the software development life cycle. You combine this with the ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical solutions. Furthermore, you are pragmatic, take ownership of your work and prefer a hands-on approach.

To succeed in this role you:

• Hold a relevant degree or equivalent experience; within IT, engineering, computer science or a similar field.

• Strong analytic skills, with the ability to interpret data and draw meaningful conclusions independently.

• Experience within several of the areas listed in the overview of responsibilities in the role.

• Solid communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage effectively with technical teams, business functions, management and, on occasion, customers.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken).

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Partaking alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

Send us an application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

**Do you want to help ensure quality in energy infrastructure projects? Can you turn quality requirements into practical activities and support projects through to handover? And do you have experience with quality management, audits and inspections? Then join COWI as our new Quality Consultant.

****Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

**We are looking for a Quality Consultant to join COWI and support our customers’ construction and operational projects on assignments of both shorter and longer duration. You will help ensure that projects follow the customer’s governance framework and can be handed over to the operations organisation at the required quality level, with all supporting documentation. Your work may span electricity transmission projects, including cables, overhead lines and substations; gas distribution and transmission networks, including natural gas and biogas facilities and stations; oil pipelines; and gas storage facilities.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Support projects in applying internal processes and tools and provide guidance and support on quality-related matters.

• Consistently promote and embed quality management in projects so that documentation, products and deliverables meet the specified requirements

• Plan, carry out and document the necessary quality activities in collaboration with the project team, including internal and external audits and inspections of project partners.

• Ensure that quality-related experience and lessons learned are shared within the customer’s organisation.

• Prepare project quality plans.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways, but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

You work in a structured and systematic way and take a proactive approach to building relationships. You collaborate and communicate on an equal footing with internal and external stakeholders involved in construction projects. You bring professional credibility in your field and can work independently.

On top of that, you will have:

• An understanding of the structure and application of quality management systems.

• Experience with project- and process-related work.

• Experience with quality management activities in infrastructure and construction projects, including quality assurance (QA) and providing input to quality control (QC) activities.

• Experience carrying out quality activities, including audits and inspections of internal and external parties involved in projects.

• Experience using the Microsoft Office suite.

• The ability to communicate in Danish and English, both orally and in writing, at negotiation level.

Your official COWI office location will be either Lyngby, Vejle or Aarhus. However, your primary workplace will be at Energinet in Erritsø, but Ballerup could also be an option, with some travel to Erritsø. You will report to Head of Discipline, Ioana Nicoleta Tuglui, who is based at COWI's headquarters in Lyngby.

**A place to work and so much more

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

**Before you apply

**All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

**We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

Looking for a workplace where you can make real change? A meaningful job where you have the freedom, trust and responsibilities to play an important role and not just be a small fish in a big shoal? Does being a part of a social, passionate, and international team sound right to you? Join us!

Your position

In your new position as a Telecom & Network Engineer in the Telecom Engineering Department, you will join a multicultural, diverse team of skilled, enthusiastic telecommunication specialists from all over the world. As a telecom engineer with a strong network background, you will create, design and develop integrated critical communication systems for the offshore energy industry. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be either at our Global HQ located in Esbjerg, or in Gdynia or Norfolk. The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel from 10-30 days per year depending on which office you will be working at.

“This is an exciting chance to become part of an expanding energy industry, where you can benefit from outstanding career development opportunities. You’ll collaborate with highly skilled and dedicated professionals who are committed to excelling in their field. The role involves working on diverse projects of various scales worldwide, within a collaborative team environment where success is shared” says Head of Engineering, Technology Solutions, Kurt Thorøe.

Your tasks & responsibilities

As a Telecom & Network Engineer, you will design integrated telecom solutions with a strong focus on industrial network technologies. You will take technical responsibility for assigned systems throughout the project lifecycle, from requirements and design through configuration, integration, testing and final documentation Each project is tailored to meet the unique requirements of our clients, providing you with the opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge, customized solutions.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

• Designing and engineering different telecommunication solutions for our clients, which could include network design, CCTV, Line-of-Sight radios and other integrated telecom systems, with a strong focus on network technologies.

• Designing network architecture in accordance with applicable OT security requirements and principles.

• Prepare detail design specification for network to be used for actual implementation.

• Ensuring integration and interface coordination between telecom systems

• Verify configurations and equipment in preparation for Factory Acceptance Tests.

• Performing system configuration, integration and testing as required by the project.

• Following up on subcontractors’ designs, securing technical requirements and interface management.

• Supporting and interacting with subcontractors, customers and other teams across the organisation, such as Telecom Service and the Tender team.

Your profile & qualifications

You are a detail-oriented and structured engineer with a curious and analytical mindset. In addition, you have a proactive and organised approach to your work and thrive in a workday with lots of variation and teamwork.

We imagine that you hold:

• Minimum 5 years of experience within telecom engineering, preferably with strong experience in designing and configuring industrial network systems and a solid understanding of both physical and logical network technologies.

• Knowledge of OT security standards and practices, such as the Purdue Model, IEC 62443, or similar frameworks.

• A relevant degree in Electronics, Telecommunications, Network Engineering, or a related field.

• Experience from the maritime or offshore energy industry; broader telecommunications experience is considered an advantage.

• Strong technical ownership and project mindset, with the ability to drive assigned systems forward and foster positive collaboration within project teams.

• Strong analytical and technical writing skills, combined with professional fluency in written and spoken English.

Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.

Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.

Apply

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.
