The position
The Centre for Quantum Mathematics (QM) at the Department of Mathematics and Computer Science, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), seeks outstanding candidates to fill a number of 3-year assistant professor positions in Quantum Mathematics with emphasis on pure mathematics with relations to quantum theory.
The targeted starting date of the position is 01.08.2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

About the Centre for Quantum Mathematics (QM)
Over the past seven years, QM has built a highly international and interdisciplinary research environment spanning a broad spectrum of pure mathematics, mathematical physics and quantum computer science. The Centre has attracted leading international researchers to Odense and developed a unique research environment spanning both fundamental and applied research.

The University of Southern Denmark has recently invested DKK 50 million in the Centre for Quantum Mathematics, on top of its continuous substantial basic funding of the centre, which will enable the Centre to further expand its scientific capacity, attract and retain leading international researchers, increase the acquisition of competitive external research funding and establish strategic collaborations with industry, public authorities and international partners.

As part of this continued development and expansion, QM will move into a new dedicated building from next year. The new building will be located on the SDU campus in Odense and will provide a dedicated research environment for the Centre and its growing international research community.

Research activities and funding
The QM centre is located at the Faculty of Science on the international campus in Odense, Denmark and it is hosting several large European, Danish and American grants including “New Structures in Low-Dimensional Topology” (Simons Collaboration) & “Topological Photonic Quantum Computing and its Applications” (Innovation Fund Denmark) both led by PI and Centre Director Jørgen Ellegaard Andersen; “Mathematics of the open topological string” (VILLUM Investigator) led by Professor Vivek Shende; “The Quantum Geometry of Dynamical Systems” (VILLUM Ascending Investigator) and “The Emergent Geometry of Categories” (DFF Sapere Aude) both led by Associate Professor Fabian Haiden; “New invariants in low-dimensional topology via quantum field theory” (VILLUM Young Investigator) led by Associate Professor Du Pei, “Global Categorical Symmetries and Phases of Quantum Matter” (VILLUM Young Investigator) led by Assistant Professor Apoorv Tiwari, “From Pertubative to Non-pertubative Quantum Field Theory by cutting and gluing” (DFF Sapere Aude) led by Assistant Professor Konstantin Wernli and finally “Leveraging Algebraic Geometry for High-Precision Fundamental Physics“ (DFF Sapere Aude) led by Associate Professor Matthias Wilhelm.

Job description
A successful candidate will drive internationally competitive research, collaborate with the world community in the field, and attract competitive external research funding. The candidates are expected to contribute significantly to QM’s excellent research and teaching environment and to provide outstanding education. The candidates will get the opportunity to shape this development together with the team and implement research project ideas with national and international impact. 

Topics of interest: Algebra, algebraic geometry, differential geometry, algebraic topology, complex geometry, quantum topology, geometric analysis, operator algebra, number theory statistics, probability theory and mathematical physics.

We offer
Our new colleagues will become part of an inspirational international research environment with excellent facilities and strong collaborations with a vast international network, research organizations and regulatory stakeholders. We offer a number of positions from which to further develop the mathematical foundations for quantum theory and to combine this pure mathematical initiative with an ambitious build up in the theoretical foundations of quantum field theory and string theory and further in the theoretical foundations of quantum engineering. Given that current development of mathematical foundations of quantum theory draws from and needs a diverse deep understanding of all branches of pure mathematics, we offer a number of positions in all branches of pure mathematics and quantum computer science at QM. We also offer the opportunity to shape our educational programme to benefit from new developments in pedagogical approaches and content.

We expect
The candidates must have a PhD degree in algebra, algebraic geometry, differential geometry, algebraic topology, complex geometry, quantum topology, geometric analysis, operator algebra, number theory, statistic, probability theory, mathematical physics or quantum algorithms, quantum software architecture. 

The candidates must further have an emerging research track in the field and evidence of excellent teaching at minimum undergraduate level (e.g. teaching evaluations). We are seeking highly motivated candidates, who work and communicate well in an international team. The candidates must be able to carry out independent and rigorous work at top international level.

Fluency in English is required. Knowledge of Danish is not a prerequisite for application. The hired candidate will be offered Danish courses by the university.

Living and working in Odense
Odense is a fast-growing international community with an open Scandinavian culture, affordable housing and living costs.

jobs.occupation: Green Biorefinery Pathways for Carbon Capture and Fiber Valorisation into Biobased Materials
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Biological and Chemical Engineering programme. The position is available from 1 February 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title:
Green Biorefinery Pathways for Carbon Capture and Fiber Valorisation into Biobased Materials

Research area and project description:
The transition towards a circular bioeconomy requires new technologies that enable the efficient conversion of biomass into high-value products and long-lived carbon-storing materials. This PhD project will investigate how green biorefinery processing and subsequent pretreatment affect the molecular structure and properties of lignocellulosic fibres from grassland biomass.

The PhD is part of the interdisciplinary research project GrassCO2mposites, which aims to develop novel biobased building materials from grass fibres, linking agricultural biomass production, green biorefining and carbon storage in the built environment.

The research will focus on the processing and detailed characterisation of fibre-rich side streams generated during protein extraction in green biorefineries. Different mechanical, chemical and potentially biological pretreatment methods will be investigated to understand and control changes in the composition, molecular organisation and interactions of key structural biopolymers, including cellulose, hemicellulose and lignin.

Advanced analytical methods will be applied to investigate biopolymer composition, molecular structure, crystallinity, fibre morphology and physicochemical properties. The aim is to establish structure–property relationships that can guide the development of processing methods for producing fibres with tailored characteristics suitable for biobased composite materials.

Experimental work will combine laboratory investigations with pilot- and demonstration-scale processing at Aarhus University's green biorefinery facilities. The PhD will collaborate closely with project partners at the University of Copenhagen and the Royal Danish Academy on fibre functionalisation, composite development and material performance.

An additional focus will be to strengthen interdisciplinary collaboration with the Department of Civil and Architectural Engineering at Aarhus University, connecting fundamental biomass processing and biopolymer research with the development and evaluation of biobased construction materials.

The project will contribute new scientific knowledge and scalable processing strategies for the valorisation of agricultural biomass into functional, carbon-storing materials.

Qualifications and specific competences:
Applicants must hold a relevant Master's degree (120 ECTS) in chemical engineering, biotechnology, materials science, polymer science or a closely related discipline.

We seek candidates with a strong academic background in lignocellulosic biomass processing, biorefining, polymer chemistry or biobased materials. Experience with experimental processing and characterisation of biomass-derived fibres and biopolymers is particularly relevant.

Knowledge of analytical techniques such as FTIR, NMR, HPLC, GPC/SEC, DSC, TGA, microscopy, rheology or mechanical testing will be considered an advantage. Experience with cellulose extraction, fibre pretreatment, polymer dissolution or other chemical and physicochemical processing methods is also desirable.

Applicants should have strong experimental and analytical skills, an interest in understanding molecular structure–property relationships, and the ability to plan and conduct independent research.

The project requires an interest in interdisciplinary collaboration across chemical engineering, biotechnology and materials science, including collaboration with researchers working on biobased construction materials.

Good written and spoken English communication skills are required. Experience from relevant research projects or industrial R&D will be considered an advantage.

Place of employment and place of work:
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Hangøvej 2, 8200 Aarhus N, Denmark.

jobs.occupation: Tenure-track Assistant and Associate Professorships in Algorithms at SDU Vejle
jobs.description:
We seek candidates to join the Algorithms Section at the Department of Mathematics and Computer Science and contribute to the development of the new SDU Centre for Computer Science and AI in Vejle.
The starting time is negotiable with a preference for Summer 2027. 

The academic environment
Hired candidates will join the Algorithms Section, which spans SDU’s campuses in Odense and Vejle, and become part of the new SDU Centre for Computer Science and AI. Based at the new campus in Vejle, in the heart of Denmark’s Triangle Region and its strong and developing IT ecosystem, the centre offers an inclusive, international and collaborative environment for research and education in Computer Science and AI. It connects research, teaching and innovation through collaboration across research groups and with companies, public organizations and international partners.
The Centre for Computer Science and AI at SDU Vejle connects fundamental computer science with AI, data and advanced digital systems. Its shared focus is how architectures, AI, data and advanced algorithms can transform the specification, design, development, validation, deployment and operation of digital systems. The research environment is also home to SustainAI, an international research group advancing the design, development, evolution, testing and operation of sustainable, high-quality and AI-enabled software systems.
We encourage applications from researchers who can complement or strengthen the Algorithms Section while building links to the centre’s wider scientific environment in areas such as data analytics, data science and machine learning; optimization and computational efficiency; programming languages; software engineering and DevOps; AI-driven development and software evolution; and software architectures, cloud-edge computing, and autonomous and agentic systems.

At SDU Vejle, the department is responsible for international BSc and MSc programmes in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence. The programmes provide a strong setting for research-based teaching, supervision, and student collaboration with researchers and external partners.

Research profile
We seek candidates with a strong research record in efficient algorithms, broadly understood as spanning algorithm design, analysis and implementation as well as complexity theory. Relevant areas include, but are not limited to, approximation algorithms, combinatorial optimization, cryptology, data structures, fine-grained complexity, experimental algorithmics, and algorithmic research bridging to machine learning and AI.
Scientific excellence is the primary requirement. We particularly welcome candidates in algorithms engineering, optimization, or computational efficiency, whose work combines strong algorithmic foundations with the design, implementation and rigorous evaluation of algorithms for real-world problems.
Each appointment should help create a clear and distinctive identity for the Vejle environment by building critical mass, adding a missing capability, or creating a strong bridge between research areas. Candidates must strengthen at least one core area and connect meaningfully with other parts of the centre through research, education or external collaboration.

Industrial collaboration
Industrial collaboration is a defining theme of the centre. Successful candidates are expected to demonstrate an interest in engaging with companies and public organizations and the potential to contribute to the digital transformation of industry at local, national and international levels. Relevant activities may include collaborative research, industrial PhDs, student collaborations, and experimentation with industrial data and systems.

Qualifications
Successful candidates for a tenure-track assistant professorship must demonstrate a promising research record within the area of the call and some experience with teaching and supervision at BSc or MSc level. They are expected to contribute to research-based teaching, student projects and thesis supervision, including activities that connect students, researchers and external partners.
The Danish tenure-track system provides a focused pathway toward a permanent academic position. Before the end of the sixth year of employment, and contingent upon a positive academic assessment, the Assistant Professor will transition to a tenured Associate Professor position. Read more about SDU’s tenure-track program here.

The evaluation is based on an overall assessment of the candidate's academic achievements and potential. Emphasis will be placed on the ability to develop an independent and internationally recognized research profile, deliver high-quality teaching and supervision, contribute actively to the academic community, and demonstrate the potential to secure competitive external research funding and build an ambitious research programme. 
As part of the tenure-track programme, the Assistant Professor is expected to complete SDU's Lecturer Training Programme before the tenure evaluation, unless an equivalent university-level programme has already been completed at another institution. 
The evaluation will also consider the candidate's contributions to the strategic and organizational development of the department, including a willingness to engage in academic leadership and administrative responsibilities. 
Successful candidates for an associate professorship must have an international profile, a distinguished research record within the area of the call, and a proven ability to attract third-party funding. Demonstrated success in building and leading research teams, and a strong record of developing and leading research, innovation or industry-engaged activities, will be an advantage. Extensive teaching and supervision experience across BSc and MSc levels is expected.

Application
In addition to the documentation required under SDU’s appointment procedures, applicants should describe:

• 
Possible existing collaboration with industry or public organizations and plans for developing future external partnerships.

• 
How they would collaborate with existing groups in Vejle, supported by concrete examples of potential research, educational or practical collaboration.

Conditions of employment
Appointment as a Tenure Track Assistant Professor is temporary and for an initial up to 6 years period. 
During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

The Danish tenure track employment
The Danish tenure-track employment is a focused assistant professorship with a guaranteed assessment for a permanent position as an associate professor within the tenure-track assistant professor’s field of study.
The head of department will host annual performance- and development reviews, to ensure the progress of the assistant professor’s development towards meeting the qualifications of an associate professorship. A formal midterm evaluation will be conducted by a committee, consisting of the head of the department and two external researchers with relevant qualifications, with the purpose of ensuring the focus of the assistant professor’s activities, as well as to create the basis for the planning of the remaining period.

jobs.occupation: PhD Position in Organic and Supramolecular Chemistry: Electrically Controlled Cargo Release in [2]Rotaxanes via Mechanochemical Retro Diels-Alder Reactions at SDU in Odense
jobs.description:
A 3-year (5+3) or 4-year (4+4) PhD position in organic and supramolecular chemistry is available for a highly motivated candidate at the Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy (FKF) at the University of Southern Denmark. The position is funded by a DFF-Research Project 1 grant from the Independent Research Fund Denmark – Natural Sciences and is available from January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.
The project focuses on the design and synthesis of electroactive molecular machines capable of converting electrically controlled molecular motion into mechanical force. In particular, the project will investigate whether redox-induced shuttling in mechanically interlocked molecules can be used to trigger the cleavage of covalent bonds and thereby enable controlled cargo release.

Project Background
The aim of this project is to develop electrically responsive molecular machines capable of converting redox-induced molecular motion into covalent cargo release.
Specifically, the project will focus on the design and synthesis of [2]rotaxanes incorporating a redox-active monopyrrolotetrathiafulvalene (MPTTF) unit, a cyclobis(paraquat-p-phenylene) (CBPQT4+) macrocycle, and a furan-based unit linked to a cargo molecule through a Diels–Alder adduct.
Upon electrochemical oxidation of the MPTTF unit, the CBPQT4+ macrocycle is expected to undergo shuttling along the molecular axle. The central hypothesis is that this redox-induced motion can generate sufficient mechanical force to promote a retro-Diels–Alder reaction, resulting in the release of the covalently attached cargo molecule. A key objective is to establish a direct mechanistic relationship between redox-induced macrocycle movement, the generation of mechanical force, and the cleavage of a covalent bond.
The project will involve extensive synthetic organic chemistry, the preparation and characterization of mechanically interlocked molecules, and investigations of their electrochemical and mechanical properties using techniques such as NMR spectroscopy, mass spectrometry, UV–vis spectroscopy, and cyclic voltammetry.

By combining synthetic, spectroscopic, and electrochemical studies, the project aims to establish whether electrically driven molecular motion can be harnessed to induce covalent bond cleavage. The results are expected to contribute to the fundamental understanding of force transduction in artificial molecular machines and may provide a foundation for future applications in controlled molecular release.

Qualifications
The ideal candidate holds a Master's degree (5+3 programme) or a Bachelor's degree (4+4 programme) in chemistry or a closely related field, preferably with a strong background in synthetic organic chemistry.

The successful candidate should have:

• 
Extensive practical experience in synthetic organic chemistry.

• 
A strong interest in supramolecular chemistry and molecular machines.

• 
Experience with standard analytical and spectroscopic characterization techniques.

• 
The ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a research environment.

• 
Good communication skills and proficiency in written and spoken English.

Previous experience in supramolecular chemistry, mechanically interlocked molecules, or tetrathiafulvalene chemistry would be an advantage but is not a prerequisite.
The successful candidate will also be expected to contribute to the supervision of Bachelor's and Master's students working on research projects within the group.

To learn more about the PhD programme at the Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy, read more here. 

Natural Science Research – Interdisciplinary Strength
The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy is one of four departments at the Faculty of Science, SDU and is located in Odense. At the Department, we contribute to solving some of society’s greatest challenges within energy, environment, health, and sustainability. We succeed because we build bridges between disciplines and transcend traditional boundaries. Our interdisciplinary mindset is not only a fundamental condition, but also our strength. And it is a strength that ensures our research and education are recognized both nationally and internationally.

Our vision is to create and apply knowledge across the natural sciences. We are unique in housing research within physics, chemistry, and pharmacy under one department, which provides excellent opportunities to explore the intersections between these disciplines. Read more about our vision here.

jobs.occupation: New model for activated sludge flocculation integrating cellular biochemical reaction potential with the microbial ecology
jobs.employer_name: Technical Sciences - Institit for Bio- og Kemitekn
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Biological and Chemical Engineering programme. The position is based on a collaboration between Novonesis and Aarhus University and is available from 15 January 2027 or later. The PhD project is funded through the Helix Lab Renewal grant from the Novo Nordisk foundation. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title:
New model for activated sludge flocculation integrating cellular biochemical reaction potential with the microbial ecology

Research area and project description:
While bacterial and activated sludge flocculation is the most important component of wastewater treatment processes, mechanisms governing flocculation are poorly understood. It is difficult to control and optimize activated sludge flocculation, and so downstream clarifiers for removing activated sludge from treated water are overdesigned or overloaded.

Effective flocculation is currently explained in terms of achieving the right balance between good and bad flocculating bacteria. Industrial wastewater treatment plants commonly experience poor flocculating sludges with impaired flocculation, which is attributed to too many bad flocculating bacteria.

However, there is in fact a poor correlation between the microbial ecology of industrial wastewater treatment activated sludges and flocculation.
In this project the candidate will build on ongoing research in the host lab demonstrating that biochemical reactions occur within activation sludge that also likely promote flocculation The candidate will establish abiotic and biotic activated sludge models, assess the effect of flocculation stressors characteristic of industrial wastewaters, as well as biological, chemical and mechanical strategies for overcoming these. The research will inform strategies for the industrial to consider to increase the hydraulic of their wastewater treatment plant.

Qualifications and specific competences:
Applicants to the PhD position must have a relevant master's degree in biology, biotechnology, biochemistry, biological or chemical engineering or a closely related field.

Place of employment and place of work:
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work will be divided approximately evenly between Department of Biological and Chemical Engineering, Ole Worms Alle 3, 8000 Aarhus C., Denmark, and Novonesis, Hallas Alle 1, 4400 Kalundborg, Denmark or Helix Lab, Campus Kalundborg 3, 4400 Kalundborg, Denmark.

About Helix Lab
Helix Lab is a research and education center in Kalundborg, Denmark, facilitating collaborative MSc and PhD projects between Danish universities and local industry partners. As part of the PhD project, some experimental activities are expected to take place at Helix Lab, providing access to its laboratory facilities and research environment. The PhD student will also be invited to join the Helix Lab scientific community, consisting of PhD students, researchers, and specialists working on industry-related research projects in Kalundborg.

**

ValueOne is recruiting a Procurement Category Manager Logistics & Transport for Haugen-Gruppen Nordic AS. In this newly established role, you will be responsible for driving and developing the Group's strategic procurement activities within the logistics and transportation category. The position is physically based at the Danish subsidiary's office south of Copenhagen and reports to Head of Supply Chain Operations & Development. We welcome applications from candidates residing in both Sweden and Denmark.

About Haugen-Gruppen Nordic AS

Haugen-Gruppen Nordic AS is one of the Nordic region's leading distributors and brand partners within food, beverages, snacks, and confectionery. With more than 100 years of experience, the Group helps both international and proprietary brands grow across the Nordic markets through strong capabilities in marketing, sales, logistics, and category development. Supply Chain is regarded as a key competitive advantage, with a strong focus on customer and brand value while ensuring the right balance between service and cost. The company currently generates annual revenues of MNOK 4500 and employs approximately 400 people across the Nordic countries. Following an acquisition in 2026, Haugen-Gruppen has also established a presence in Poland and intends to continue expanding beyond the Nordic region.

About the Role

The Procurement Category Manager Logistics & Transport is part of the Nordic Supply Chain team and responsible for strategic sourcing and category management at Group level within transportation, third-party logistics (3PL), warehouse equipment, packaging materials and load carriers, and, where relevant, selected third-party manufacturing. The role works closely with stakeholders across the various markets to develop competitive and sustainable supplier solutions that strengthen Haugen-Gruppen's supply chain while ensuring the right service levels and total cost position.

Key Responsibilities

• Own and develop the Group-wide Logistics & Transport category strategy.

• Lead strategic sourcing and procurement initiatives across transportation, 3PL, warehousing, and related logistics services.

• Drive the Source-to-Contract process, including sourcing strategy, tendering, negotiations, contracting, and implementation.

• Develop and optimize Route-to-Market solutions in collaboration with Supply Chain and Commercial stakeholders.

• Manage supplier relationships, commercial agreements, and performance to ensure competitiveness, service excellence, and sustainability.

• Identify cost optimization opportunities through spend analysis, market intelligence, and supplier development.

• Mitigate supplier risk and ensure compliance with Group policies, standards, and sustainability requirements.

• Support strategic sourcing initiatives across adjacent supply chain categories when required.

Experience and Qualifications

To succeed in this role, you should have:

• A Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business Administration, or a related field, alternatively equivalent relevant experience.

• Proven experience in strategic sourcing and category management managing suppliers and commercial agreements within indirect material and services.

• Strong commercial and analytical capabilities within spend analysis, tendering, negotiation, and total cost of ownership (TCO) assessment.

• Knowledge of sustainability requirements and compliance standards within logistics and procurement.

• Fluency in English and proficiency in at least one Scandinavian language, both written and spoken.

• Experience within logistics, transportation, supply chain, or FMCG environments is considered highly advantageous.

Personal Attributes

We are looking for a proactive, accountable, analytical, and solution-oriented professional who enjoys working in an international environment. You have excellent communication and organizational skills and thrive when collaborating across functions, countries, and cultures.

A service-minded, flexible approach combined with a continuous improvement mindset will be essential for success in this role.

Application

We welcome your application for the position of Procurement Category Manager Logistics & Transport. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. For further information, please contact Talent Acquisition Specialist James Li at James.Li@valueone.se.

About ValueOne

ValueOne specializes in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, and Logistics. We support our clients through three business areas:

• Interim Procurement and Supply Chain Consultants

• Recruitment of Procurement and Logistics Professionals

• Management Consulting

Through our consulting services, we help organizations develop and improve their procurement, logistics, and supply chain capabilities covering strategy, operating models, processes, organization, governance, and competence development.

Vattenfall is a leading European energy company driving the transition to a sustainable energy system. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years. We employ around 21 000 people mostly in our core markets in Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK.

Are you an experienced OT SCADA professional who wants to help secure the reliable operation of business-critical systems? Would you like to apply your technical expertise in an operational technology environment supporting the future of renewable energy?

As our new OT SCADA Engineer (Integration & Operations), you will be responsible for engineering, integrating, maintaining, operating, and continuously improving SCADA systems, ensuring data flows between power plants, market-facing control applications used by BA Markets, the Operational Control Centre’s monitoring and control systems, and other data consumers underpinning Vattenfall’s business-critical renewable-energy Operational Technology applications.

You will participate in the team’s on-call rotation to support business-critical services that operate around the clock. You will help restore service during incidents and implement corrective and preventive improvements.

A key part of your role will be applying structured engineering, security and lifecycle-management principles to keep the platforms reliable, supportable and compliant with Vattenfall standards and operational requirements. You will work closely with internal colleagues, external stakeholders and suppliers.

Be in your element with BA Wind

As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets.

You won’t only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships.

Your role

As an OT SCADA Engineer, you will take ownership of SCADA systems and related data flows throughout their lifecycle, from initial analysis and engineering through implementation, operation, improvement and eventual replacement or decommissioning.

You will combine hands-on technical work with structured planning, documentation, and collaboration. Your focus will be on maintaining secure, reliable, and scalable SCADA systems and proactively identifying opportunities to strengthen performance, availability, and operational resilience.

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Engineering, configuring, commissioning, maintaining, and improving OT SCADA solutions and interfaces for assets in operation and development.

• 
Delivering and supporting reliable data flows from plant-level systems through approved OT integration layers to monitoring, control, analytics, reporting, and data-platform consumers.

• 
Assessing site and interface readiness, identifying integration prerequisites, technical constraints, dependencies, risks and ownership boundaries, and defining requirements and integration approaches.

• 
Configuring, deploying, and supporting resilient SCADA integration components, including industrial edge devices or gateways, connectors, and data pipelines, with appropriate monitoring, troubleshooting, deployment documentation, and operational handover.

• 
Planning, estimating, and tracking assigned work, making dependencies, risks, and progress visible, and documenting and maintaining technical records and operational knowledge.

• 
Providing operational support, including incident diagnosis, service restoration, root-cause and problem analysis, defining and implementing preventive and proactive improvement actions.

• 
Participating in the team's on-call rotation, providing specialist OT SCADA support for business-critical services outside normal working hours.

• 
Improving observability and data quality through health monitoring, completeness checks, alerting, backfilling support, performance analysis, and clear operational ownership.

• 
Planning and executing lifecycle upgrades, migrations, patches, configuration changes, and component replacements using approved change and DTAP practices.

• 
Producing requirements, designs, implementation guides, configuration records, test cases, support documentation, and operational handover packages including operational runbooks, support responsibilities and escalation arrangements

• 
Supporting technical purchasing and supplier coordination through technical evaluations, solution validation, and design reviews.

• 
Preparing and executing tests and commissioning checks for assigned solutions, recording test evidence, tracking defects to resolution, and supporting factory and site acceptance testing (FAT/SAT), acceptance decisions, and operational-readiness assessments.

• 
Standardizing repeatable integration services and work packages for asset projects, while supporting refinement and estimation of less standardized initiatives.

• 
Supporting internal and external audit activities.

Your profile

You hold a relevant bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, automation or control engineering, computer engineering, technical computer science, industrial IT, or a related discipline. Alternatively, you have developed equivalent professional competence through a relevant technical qualification and substantial experience in OT SCADA engineering.

You have several years of hands-on experience engineering, integrating, and supporting SCADA systems or comparable industrial OT solutions, including responsibility for systems in operation. You thrive when taking ownership of solutions from analysis and design through to implementation, operation, and continuous improvement. You are equally comfortable working independently and collaborating with colleagues, suppliers, and stakeholders across the organisation. To succeed in this role, you must have excellent written and spoken English skills. The role may also be subject to security clearance, and candidates must be able to meet the applicable screening requirements.

You bring knowledge and experience in:

• SCADA systems and interfaces: configuring, integrating, commissioning, managing, maintaining, operating, and supporting SCADA applications, gateways, and interfaces connecting operational assets with central systems and data consumers.

• Industrial communications: working with relevant industrial protocols such as OPC UA, IEC 60870-5-104, Modbus TCP or MQTT, as well as APIs and vendor-specific interfaces where applicable, and diagnosing communication and integration issues.

• Operational resilience: practical understanding of high availability, service monitoring and logging, SCADA application and configuration backup and recovery, and configuration management, including dependencies on hosting and network services.

• Operational data flows: understanding signal mapping, timestamps, data quality, buffering, and the recovery of missing historical data.

• Incident and problem management: diagnosing faults across SCADA applications, interfaces, source and target systems, including dependencies on server services, networks, certificates and service accounts; restoring services; investigating root causes; and implementing preventive and proactive improvements.

• Controlled technical changes: planning and delivering upgrades, migrations and configuration changes with appropriate testing, deployment documentation, rollback arrangements and operational handover.

• Secure OT operation: applying OT security requirements, including access controls, certificate handling, system hardening and vulnerability management, within approved architectures and change procedures and in collaboration with cybersecurity and infrastructure teams.

• Engineering documentation: producing and maintaining clear technical documentation of SCADA system architectures, configurations and procedures.

• Supplier collaboration: supporting technical purchasing, assessing and validating solutions, supporting acceptance testing and coordinating technical work with colleagues and external suppliers.

Additional experience that would be valuable:

• Renewable energy, utilities or comparable industrial environments.

• OEM SCADA interfaces.

• Industrial edge platforms or gateways.

• SCADA historians, SQL databases, scripting and automation.

Personal traits

To succeed in this role, we believe that you:

• Bring strong analytical skills, approach technical challenges with proactive, structured problem-solving, and remain composed when resolving operational incidents.

• Communicate clearly and can connect technical, operational and supplier-related perspectives.

• Are comfortable taking end-to-end responsibility, from analysis and planning through implementation and delivery.

• Work independently while contributing actively and collaborating effectively across disciplines with internal and external stakeholders.

• Are organised, reliable and committed to high-quality documentation.

• Take a proactive approach to continuous improvement.

• Use sound judgment to balance immediate service restoration, long-term reliability, maintainability and agreed delivery priorities.

• Are willing to participate in the team’s on-call rotation.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Location: Kolding

Our offer

Looking for a career with growth?

Looking for a role where your superpowers can be leveraged to the maximum and with limitless opportunities for growth?

The scale and ambition of our wind, battery and solar business means you can really find your element with us. We’ll also provide you with all the learning and development you need to expand your horizons.

We strive to be the best place to work in the industry with highly competitive pay and conditions and an open, supportive culture. A commitment to a healthy work-life balance aims to ensure everyone plays to their strengths, whatever their background and experiences.

You will be part of a growing team of 1,700+ colleagues from 50+ nationalities where our positive approach to diversity is reflected in the fact that more than a quarter of staff are women.

More Information

For more information about the position you are welcome to contact hiring manager Steffen Hellmich, steffen.hellmich@vattenfall.de. For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our recruiter Christian Pathuel, christian.pathuel@vattenfall.com

We welcome your application in English no later than 22-11-2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website.

Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation. jobs.description:
With more than 8,000 employees, Deloitte is one of the largest professional services firms across the Nordics. We help clients navigate complex business and technology transformations by combining deep industry expertise with leading capabilities in Audit, Tax, Advisory, and Consulting.

About the team

Join our Transfer Pricing team of more than 45 colleagues in Copenhagen and Aarhus. We help international and Danish businesses turn complex tax, finance and operating-model questions into practical solutions. As a Manager, you will bring your experience to a collaborative team, take a leading role in client engagements and contribute to developing our people and practice.

You will lead a broad range of projects for clients across sectors. Working with colleagues across Deloitte, you will turn complex analyses into practical advice and take responsibility for engagements from planning through to delivery. You will also help develop less experienced colleagues and continue building your own technical and leadership skills through training in Denmark and at Deloitte University in Paris.

Ready to take the next step in your career? In this role, you will:

• Manage transfer pricing engagements across advisory, compliance and disputes, overseeing teams, timelines and quality.

• Build client relationships and deliver practical advice with colleagues across Deloitte’s international network.

• Develop less experienced colleagues through feedback, work review and knowledge sharing.

• Help grow our practice by spotting new opportunities and shaping solutions for existing and new clients.

We work in a dynamic, international environment with an informal tone, where quality, collaboration and different perspectives are central to how we create value for clients and for each other.

AI-enabled and digital tools are a natural part of how we work. You will help identify where they can add value to research, analysis and delivery, while applying sound judgement and maintaining responsibility for the quality of the work. No specialist AI expertise is required, but curiosity and a willingness to improve how we work matter most.

We value the community that extends beyond client work. Our employee association brings people together throughout the year - from social events to shared experiences that cut across teams and business units. We celebrate the wins, big and small, and make a point of recognising individual and shared milestones.

The role is full-time, and we are looking for professionals for our offices in both Copenhagen and Aarhus, Denmark.

We are looking for experienced transfer pricing professionals who are ready to take responsibility for client engagements and contribute to the development of our team. You may already be working as a Manager ready for the next step.

You combine technical expertise with a practical understanding of client needs. You take ownership, collaborate openly and are comfortable coordinating the work of others while remaining hands-on with analysis and delivery.

What you bring to the team:

• A relevant academic background, such as law, economics, finance, accounting or business.

• Solid experience in transfer pricing, gained in an advisory firm, an in-house role or a comparable environment (minimum 5 years).

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex technical and financial information into clear recommendations.

All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

**Join an inclusive community

**At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

**Send us your application

**Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

jobs.occupation: Take the next step in your Transfer Pricing career
jobs.description:
With more than 8,000 employees, Deloitte is one of the largest professional services firms across the Nordics. We help clients navigate complex business and technology transformations by combining deep industry expertise with leading capabilities in Audit, Tax, Advisory, and Consulting.

About the team

Join our Transfer Pricing team of more than 45 colleagues in Copenhagen and Aarhus. We help international and Danish businesses turn complex tax, finance and operating-model questions into practical solutions. As a Manager, you will bring your experience to a collaborative team, take a leading role in client engagements and contribute to developing our people and practice.

You will lead a broad range of projects for clients across sectors. Working with colleagues across Deloitte, you will turn complex analyses into practical advice and take responsibility for engagements from planning through to delivery. You will also help develop less experienced colleagues and continue building your own technical and leadership skills through training in Denmark and at Deloitte University in Paris.

Ready to take the next step in your career? In this role, you will:

• Manage transfer pricing engagements across advisory, compliance and disputes, overseeing teams, timelines and quality.

• Build client relationships and deliver practical advice with colleagues across Deloitte’s international network.

• Develop less experienced colleagues through feedback, work review and knowledge sharing.

• Help grow our practice by spotting new opportunities and shaping solutions for existing and new clients.

We work in a dynamic, international environment with an informal tone, where quality, collaboration and different perspectives are central to how we create value for clients and for each other.

AI-enabled and digital tools are a natural part of how we work. You will help identify where they can add value to research, analysis and delivery, while applying sound judgement and maintaining responsibility for the quality of the work. No specialist AI expertise is required, but curiosity and a willingness to improve how we work matter most.

We value the community that extends beyond client work. Our employee association brings people together throughout the year - from social events to shared experiences that cut across teams and business units. We celebrate the wins, big and small, and make a point of recognising individual and shared milestones.

The role is full-time, and we are looking for professionals for our offices in both Copenhagen and Aarhus, Denmark.

We are looking for experienced transfer pricing professionals who are ready to take responsibility for client engagements and contribute to the development of our team. You may already be working as a Manager ready for the next step.

You combine technical expertise with a practical understanding of client needs. You take ownership, collaborate openly and are comfortable coordinating the work of others while remaining hands-on with analysis and delivery.

What you bring to the team:

• A relevant academic background, such as law, economics, finance, accounting or business.

• Solid experience in transfer pricing, gained in an advisory firm, an in-house role or a comparable environment (minimum 5 years).

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex technical and financial information into clear recommendations.

• Curiosity about technology and judgement when using AI-enabled tools.

• Clear written and verbal communication, and confidence discussing technical matters with clients and colleagues.

• An interest in developing others through guidance, feedback and knowledge sharing.

• A strong client-service mindset and an interest in building relationships and contributing to new opportunities.

• Work permit in Denmark

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

Do you want to be part of our team?

Click the "I am interested" button above if you are ready to join our team.

Send your CV, grade transcript and an application outlining your motivation for joining our Transfer Pricing team and highlighting relevant experience by 4 December 2026. We regularly call for interviews, so send your application already today.

Please do not hesitate to contact Partner Cecilie Emilie Rendtorff at crendtorff@deloitte.dk or Aske Haahr Lauridsen at aslauridsen@deloitte.dk if you have any questions about the position.

At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team´s success.

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

**Account Executive - Denmark

**Aarhus | Copenhagen

About Puzzel 🔍

We're the AI-native customer experience platform built in Norway, trusted across Europe, and growing fast. For 25 years we've helped contact centres deliver faster, more human service — without the clutter or complexity. Today we're #1 in the Nordics, scaling rapidly in the UK and the Netherlands, with one ambition: become Europe's clear CX market leader.

Puzzel Values 🎯

• 
Built on Trust - our Nordic foundation. Customers, partners, and each other.

• 
Stronger Together - one team, one purpose, shared wins.

• 
Stay Hungry - we raise our game every day.

Why we’re proud_🏆_

• 
Frost Radar Innovation & Growth Leader in EMEA Customer Experience Platforms (2025)

• 
CX Awards 'Best Mid-Market Contact Center Platform' (2024)

• 
Flexa Top 10 most inclusive companies and Top 25 for work-life balance, diversity and inclusion, pet-friendly companies and professional services (2026)

• 
Consistently high Glassdoor rating

• 
Mercer-benchmarked pay for equity and market fairness

• 
Puzzel doesn't just build AI for our customers — we’ve embraced it internally, adopting it across the business to work smarter and faster

Read more about us here.

What you'll do 🏡💻

This is a 100% net-new business role. You’ll drive your own prospecting, while working closely with our SDR, our partners and our marketing team to create and convert opportunities. Our SDR focuses on our top 100 accounts every day, marketing supports you with lead generation and events, and partners are an important source of new ARR in Denmark.

You’re proactive, solution-oriented and not afraid to shake things up. You communicate excellently, manage your own time and processes well, and know how to close deals.

You should have good time management skills, be comfortable running your own processes and excel at the following:

• 
Building and nurturing relationships with customers and partners or creating business opportunities from scratch - it's important to highlight that you'll be managing the full sales cycle from initial prospecting to close.

• 
Generate your own pipeline through outbound activity, spending a meaningful part of each week on direct and partner-led prospecting

• 
Collaborate with the SDR and marketing to turn target accounts, leads and events into qualified opportunities

• 
Recruit, enable and co-sell with partners and channel organisations to generate and close pipeline

• 
Run discovery calls, demos and presentations, building a thorough understanding of each customer’s needs, business and processes

• 
Take performance and budget responsibility for your own portfolio, driving growth and profitability

• 
Use our systems and automated sequences (Salesforce and Outreach in particular) to minimise manual work and follow RevOps best practice

The must haves 💪

• 
Danish native level speaker + strong English

• 
Technological understanding and interest in the field of cloud-based services

• 
At least 3 years’ experience managing full sales cycle, from prospect to close

• 
Proven outbound experience, and a track record of generating your own pipeline (ideally you still do your own outreach today)

• 
CX or complex B2B SaaS sales experience

• 
Experience working with structured sales methodologies (MEDDPICC and/or Challenger preferable) & sales pipelining

• 
Proactive, entrepreneurial mentality and willingness to self-generate pipeline are a must

• 
Autonomy and confidence to sell into a growing market

• 
The nice to haves ➕➕➕

• 
Experience of selling through partners or channels

• 
Exposure to an international environment

• 
Additional language skills

• 
CCaaS / competitor industry experience

The location

This role is based in our Aarhus or Copenhagen offices, with a hybrid set up of 2-3 days per week in the office.

What to expect from the interview process ❔

• 
Screening call with Talent Acquisition

• 
1st interview with the Sales Director & local Account Executive

• 
Final panel presentation

Diversity & Inclusion 🌍

We want everyone at Puzzel to feel able to be their true, authentic self at work – regardless of nationality, race, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, physical ability, age or economic background.

We're proud of our diverse, global workforce, but there's more to do. Our current gender split is 25% female to 75% male – in line with the SaaS average, but not where we want to be. Here's how we're improving it:

• 
Our C-suite has moved from 100% male in 2023 to a 5:3 male-to-female split today.

• 
Female hires grew from 23.6% in 2021 to 41% in 2024, dipping to 34% in 2025 — a trend we watch closely, but never treating as a tick-box exercise.

• 
We partner with Flexa, to compound our aspiration to attract a diverse talent pool.

• 
We work with state employment initiatives in Norway and Sweden on internship and apprenticeship routes, to help early-years talent into the workforce.

One Last Thing ☝🏻

Even if you're only a 75% match for this role, we still want to hear from you — this list is indicative, and skills can always be learnt.

We're unable to offer sponsorship for this role, so you'll need existing eligibility to work in the country you're applying to.

By applying you accept the terms of our Data & Privacy notice.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**The Manager, Corporate Supply Chain Planning is responsible for coordinating end-to-end supply planning and execution for assigned products across Genmab’s global commercial supply chains, ensuring reliable and compliant product supply to markets.

Working closely with CMOs and internal cross-functional stakeholders, the Manager maintains up-to-date supply plans and coordinates operational planning and execution processes. The role ensures transparency of batch status, supply priorities, responsibilities, and risks, with timely follow-up and escalation to support supply continuity in a global, GxP-regulated environment. The role also collaborates with Clinical Supply to support alignment across commercial and clinical supply needs.

You will be joining the Corporate Supply Chain Planning team, reporting to the Senior Director. The team is responsible for Genmab’s global supply chain planning activities and supports Genmab’s mission to transform patient lives through innovative antibody medicines.

**Key Responsibilities

**As Manager, Corporate Supply Chain Planning you will be responsible for planning and executing supply chain activities across commercial programs, for an assigned product/product group or supply chain, ensuring alignment between demand, manufacturing, and distribution.

• Oversee daily supply chain operations, including order management, replenishment, inventory planning, and supply planning across international markets

• Coordinate operational planning and execution processes across Supply Chain, Quality Assurance, Manufacturing Life Cycle Management, Logistics, and CMOs for assigned products, ensuring supply plans remain up to date and that batch status, priorities, responsibilities, and risks are transparent across functions

• Facilitate daily operational meetings to coordinate activities, track agreed actions, and escalate issues impacting supply through established governance

• Act as key interface with CMOs to align on production schedules, execution, and supply priorities

• Serve as key user of ERP systems (e.g., SAP S/4HANA), supporting planning, execution, and data integrity

• Ensure GxP compliance across the supply chain in collaboration with Quality Assurance, including deviation handling, root cause analysis, and CAPA implementation

• Identify, assess, and mitigate supply and capacity risks, developing contingency plans that strengthen business resilience and protect patient supply

• Support audits, inspections, and regulatory compliance activities through proper documentation and process adherence

• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, new product introductions, CMC project activities, and process standardization efforts that improve planning maturity, execution reliability, and scalability

• Contribute to the S&OP process for assigned products through supply planning inputs, risk assessments, and scenario evaluations

**Requirements

**

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, Life Sciences, or a related field

• +6 years of experience in supply chain planning, logistics, or a related function

• Experience within biotech, pharmaceutical, or other GxP-regulated industries is preferred

• Hands-on experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP S/4HANA) and supply planning tools

• Strong analytical skills with experience in data analysis and forecasting (e.g., Excel, Power BI, or similar tools)

• Familiarity with global supply chain operations and Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) is an advantage

**Moreover, You Meet The Following Personal Requirements

**

• Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills

• Solid written and verbal communication skills

• Strong organizational and multitasking abilities

• Ability to operate effectively in high-pressure, deadline-driven environments

• Advanced user of Microsoft Office Suite

• Understanding of GMP/GDP requirements within regulated supply chains

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK584.000,00---876.000,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Combine hands-on software development with team leadership and make a real impact on cybersecurity and global security

Are you an experienced software engineer who thrives on solving complex technical challenges and helping other developers succeed? Do you want to combine hands-on development with team leadership and have a direct influence on the architecture and evolution of mission-critical products?

This is your opportunity to make a difference.

Our client, Arbit Cyber Defence Systems, is growing rapidly and is looking for a dedicated Software Development Team Lead to join its R&D department in Hvidovre, just outside Copenhagen.

In this key role, you will lead a team of software engineers while remaining close to the code, the architecture and the technology. You will take ownership of software releases, Linux systems and development processes, helping ensure that your team delivers robust, high-quality software that meets the highest standards of security and performance.

If you are ready to combine technical depth with people leadership and contribute to protecting critical networks and sensitive information across borders, this could be your next career move.

About Arbit Cyber Defence Systems

Arbit develops high-end network protection solutions for an international customer base, including intelligence agencies, armed forces and national governments. Its certified Cross Domain Solutions, including Data Diodes and TRUST Gateways, enable secure data transfer between networks operating at different security classification levels. With customers operating in some of the world’s most demanding security environments, Arbit plays an important role in protecting sensitive information and securing critical digital infrastructure across national borders.

Arbit’s R&D department brings together two development teams—Release and Project—alongside project management, hardware engineering and quality assurance specialists. You will join a highly skilled, collaborative environment where technical excellence, innovation and reliability are essential.

The role: Technical leadership with real influence

Reporting directly to the CTO, you will lead the Release development team, taking responsibility for its technical direction, delivery and people development. You will work closely with the CTO on technical decisions and development planning, helping translate product ambitions into robust, well-engineered solutions.

You will balance hands-on engineering with leadership, ensuring that your team has the direction, structure and support it needs to succeed.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership & Software Development

• Combine hands-on software development with responsibility for the architecture, design and continuous improvement of Arbit’s core products.

• Develop high-performance software components for unidirectional data transfer, with a strong focus on security, reliability and maintainability.

Release Management & Linux Systems

• Own software releases, ensuring efficient development processes, reliable CI/CD pipelines and delivery of high-quality software on time.

• Oversee Linux systems, make sure that a good infrastructure and hardware/software integration is built.

Team Leadership & Development

• Lead, motivate and develop your team, creating a positive environment where people thrive, grow their skills and deliver their best work.

• Set priorities, drive progress and represent the team within the organisation.

Collaboration & Innovation

• Work closely with the CTO on technical decisions, architecture and development planning.

• Collaborate with Project Development, Quality Assurance, Service Delivery and Product Management to ensure thorough testing, smooth delivery and continued product innovation.

Your background

We are looking for an experienced software engineer with a strong systems mindset and a genuine interest in leading people.

You understand that a single line of code can affect the security, reliability and performance of an entire hardware/software system. You enjoy diving into technical details, but you also know how to create clarity, set direction and bring out the best in a team.

You may already be an experienced Team Lead looking for a role with substantial technical depth—or a senior engineer who is ready to take the next step into formal leadership.

What you bring

• Extensive software engineering experience: At least 10 years of professional software development experience, ideally including the development of a software product from the ground up through to production. Experience with Java and C++ is highly relevant.

• Leadership potential: Experience in team leadership and people management is an advantage. Alternatively, you may have mentored less experienced developers and be ready to take on your first formal leadership role.

• Strong systems understanding: A solid foundation in computer science, software architecture and system design, ideally complemented by knowledge of relevant standards and compliance requirements.

• Linux expertise: Practical experience with Linux system management and a good understanding of system integration, build environments and release infrastructure.

• A structured, proactive approach: You create momentum, establish clear priorities and take ownership of progress and results.

• A collaborative mindset: You communicate clearly, build strong working relationships and enjoy working across disciplines.

• Relevant education: A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or a related field.

• Language skills: Fluency in English is essential. If you are not fluent in Danish, you should have a good understanding of the language.

Security clearance: Due to the nature of Arbit’s customers and products, you must be eligible to obtain and maintain a SECRET (HEMMELIGT) security clearance.

Why join Arbit?

• Make a difference: Develop advanced cybersecurity solutions for international clients and help protect critical networks and sensitive information.

• Shape technology and people: Influence core product development while leading a skilled team of engineers in a collaborative R&D environment.

• Flexibility and benefits: Enjoy flexible working hours, the option to work from home, a pension scheme, healthcare, fitness facilities and team-building activities.

• A close-knit team: Join a growing company with more than 25 employees, an informal culture and a strong team spirit.

More about Arbit Cyber Defence Systems

Founded in 2006, Arbit has established itself as a specialist in advanced cybersecurity solutions for highly sensitive environments. As the need to protect critical networks and information continues to grow, Arbit’s technology plays an increasingly important role.

Arbit is among a small number of companies worldwide whose products have achieved NATO COSMIC TOP SECRET and EU TOP SECRET accreditation.

Learn more at arbitcds.com.

Are you interested in joining Arbit?

Please do not hesitate to apply for the position by sending your CV and a short application. If you have questions, you are most welcome to contact Director Sara Juhl at Bloom via sj@bloom.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Company Description

Join Oterra in making natural food and beverages easy, for a sustainable and healthy world.

Headquartered in Denmark, with production sites in Europe, Latin America, and the US, we’re a passionate team of over 1200 team members of 48 nationalities in 27 countries worldwide, serving 120 markets globally. As the leading worldwide provider of natural colors, we offer food and beverage manufacturers an alternative to artificial colors. Food and health are at the heart of everything we do and every day over 400 million people eat a product with our colors in it. We believe that nature got it right the first time.

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Group Financial Controller with interest and experience in driving continued improvements to our financial reporting process to join us at our global headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark.

As Group Financial Controller, you will be part of the team responsible for ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant preparation of the Oterra Group's financial reporting. The group financial reporting is prepared in accordance with IFRS and the accounting principles applied under Oterra’s senior financing agreements.

You will report to the Head of Group Controlling & Reporting, but close collaboration with finance teams across the Group Finance, Group Tax, Group Treasury, Business Finance, and senior management is expected to ensure high-quality financial information is delivered to stakeholders.

In addition to supporting and controlling selected global sales and production subsidiaries, you will be part of developing and improving our group consolidation system, SAP Group Reporting, and related processes including data collection, intercompany eliminations, currency translation, ownership management and validation rules.

Qualifications

We imagine that you have a relevant master’s degree or alternatively, a diploma degree and bring at least eight years of relevant experience from similar roles within a global finance organization maybe combined with experience from consulting or auditing.

You have strong knowledge of IFRS and experience with consolidation systems (e.g., SAP Group Reporting, BPC, OneStream, HFM).

Just as importantly, you are able to communicate complex financial matters in a clear and pragmatic way. You combine strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and enjoy working both independently and collaboratively across functions, cultures, and geographies.

We are looking to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible. Applications will therefore be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews will be conducted continuously until we have found the right match.

Additional Information

At Oterra, we take care of our people – because when you’re supported, you can do your best work. Our

benefits are designed to support your health, your future and your life outside of work.

We are looking to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible. Applications will therefore be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews will be conducted continuously until we have found the right match.
