_As our new Test Manager, you will play a key role in delivering our SitaWare and Iris suites, an integrated, ultra-modern command-and-control toolset that helps Defence customers make critical decisions wherever they need it. You will apply your broad test and engineering skills in an agile environment with highly skilled colleagues, as part of our growing Defence Services team in Copenhagen.

**The job

**Our SitaWare and Iris suites give armed forces an integrated, ultra-modern command-and-control toolset spanning radio, mobile, vehicle, web and application-based solutions, with real-time reporting back to command HQ. As our new Test Manager, you will be involved in everything from the start of a feature, writing test cases and managing the process, through to verifying the final testing before we deliver the solution to our Defence customers.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Planning and conducting acceptance tests (FAT and SAT) with customers, both at our own facilities and at customer sites

• Conducting integration tests with third-party software and hardware

• Challenging solution design against risks, based on system context, customer requirements and security

• Taking part in military exercises to support the use of our solutions and find new ways of testing that reflect real-life use

• Establishing and maintaining test environments, and contributing to tender and proposal work on test and test management approach

You should expect travel within the Nordics, and potentially elsewhere in Europe, several times a year.

**Joining the team

**You will join a small but growing team in a brand-new office in the heart of Copenhagen, working closely with your Nordic colleagues while also collaborating with other teams across our global constellations. Testing is an integral part of our development process, and you will be part of a wider community of testers and test managers, with knowledge-network events to exchange ideas, hear lectures, share best practice and get to know your colleagues. It is an agile, fast-moving environment with flexible, trust-based working hours and plenty of room for personal responsibility.

**Your Qualifications

**To succeed in this role, you bring:

• A technical degree, Bachelor's or Master's

• Solid experience as a Test Manager or in a similar role, with strong technical skills

• Experience with test management tools such as TestRail and Jira, including the Xray and R4J plugins

• Hands-on experience with test execution in close cooperation with stakeholders, and the ability to analyse and communicate technically complex solutions

• Solid knowledge of Windows and Linux environments, SQL/MS SQL Server, Active Directory, and networking fundamentals (IP, TCP, UDP, multicast, routing, firewalls), along with scripting skills in PowerShell or Bash

• Fluent Danish and English

• The ability to understand product requirements and translate these into effective tests

Alongside this, we value:

• Enjoys working in a changing environment, eager to step outside your comfort zone to make a difference

• Highly motivated to develop and apply your technical skills in a broad, technical role

• Enjoys customer-facing activities such as presentations, technical support, training and testing, building the trust that drives customer satisfaction

• Self-motivated and committed, with a hands-on approach

ISTQB or TMAP certification, automated testing experience, or experience with testing standards such as ISO/IEEE 29119, ISO 25010 or ISO 9001 are an advantage.

Experience with radio networking (e.g. VHF, HF) or tactical communications systems is a strong plus.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

jobs.description:
**Minimum qualifications:

**

• Associate's degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of electrical experience (e.g., electrical testing equipment or electrical distribution) in industrial or commercial environment.

• Ability to participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying or moving up to 50 lbs (23 kg) of equipment, the required use of safety equipment such as limited weight bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools and personal protective equipment (PPE) like safety harnesses in accordance with safety and ergonomic guidelines and assessments.

• Ability to work non-standard hours and work rotations/shifts.

**Preferred qualifications:

**

• Experience in data centers, hospitals, or power plants.

• Experience in electrical maintenance in critical large scale facilities (Data Center, Pharma, Medical or Electrical) including UPS, generators, LV/MV switchgear Strong electrical safety awareness and ability to develop switching procedures and RAMS.

• Knowledge of electrical systems used in a data center environment (e.g., Feeders, Transformers, Generators, Switchgear, UPS systems, ATS/STS units, PDU/PMM units).

• Knowledge of meters, devices, sensors, and troubleshooting utilizing standard hand tools, digital metering, or calibration/diagnostic equipment.

• Ability to communicate with contractors who perform maintenance or upgrade work on the data center systems.

**About The Job

**The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facilities Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some of these duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems. You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components). You provide daily assistance to senior technicians as you read blueprints/schematics, conduct tours of systems and assess their working order.

As an advocate for best practices, you develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly. In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures.

As a Facilities Technician, you will operate, monitor, and support physical facilities conditions for our data centers.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Denmark: kr.600000 - kr.615000 (DKK) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

**Responsibilities

**Learn more about benefits at Google .

• Inspect, maintain, and repair various data center systems.

• Provide daily assistance to technicians as you read blueprints/schematics/sequence of operations, conduct tours of systems, and assess their working order.

• Manage the uptime and maintenance of UPS, generators, electrical distribution, and control and monitoring systems.

• Operate, monitor, maintain, and respond to abnormal conditions in the data center facilities systems and equipment.

• Support startup, commissioning, and integration of new electrical equipment and systems into facilities infrastructure.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

**ARE YOU READY TO DRIVE GANNI’S WHOLESALE GROWTH ACROSS SCANDINAVIA WITH PURPOSE AND PASSION?

**GANNI is looking for a Wholesale Area Manager to join our global Wholesale team!

In this role, you will play a key part — together with your fellow Area Managers — in elevating GANNI’s brand presence across the Nordics market by nurturing strategic wholesale relationships and ensuring strong commercial performance.

The area manager will take over the whole Scandinavian market to contribute to regional growth and brand elevation in close collaboration with the broader EMEA Wholesale team.

This is a dynamic mid-level role that blends commercial execution, market insight, and operational excellence — and we’re looking for someone ready to contribute and grow within an ambitious team environment.

**Your Mission & Responsibilities Ahead Of You

**As Wholesale Area Manager, you will support and manage wholesale partnerships across the Nordics region, working closely with other Area Managers, the Head of WS EMEA and the Executive Wholesale & Franchises Director.

Your role will focus on driving sales performance, strengthening category growth, and ensuring seamless alignment between GANNI and our wholesale partners — all in line with our global wholesale strategy.

**Responsibilities ahead of you:

**

• Develop and execute a comprehensive business plan aligned with the brand strategy to drive growth and strengthen GANNI’s presence across the Nordics.

• Participate in prospecting and onboarding of new wholesale partners across the Nordics.

• Strategically collaborate with wholesale partners to meet weekly, monthly, and annual trade expectations.

• Monitor sell-in and sell-out performance, taking proactive measures to maximize sell-through, reorder rates, and profitability.

• Ensure all partners and activations are aligned with GANNI brand guidelines and deliver a consistent brand experience.

• Collaborate with marketing, VM, and merchandising teams to deliver local marketing initiatives, activations, and sales-driving campaigns.

• Provide exemplary day-to-day support to our wholesale partners as their main point of contact with GANNI HQ.

• Support showroom operations in Paris, including OTB discussions/negotiations and collection feedback.

• Stay up to date on the Nordics market trends, competitors, and opportunities and actively share insights internally.

• Coordinate with logistics and internal teams to ensure timely delivery and payment follow-up.

**Must Have Requirements

**We are looking for a commercially driven and collaborative professional who thrives in a fast-paced and international environment.

• 5-7 years of experience in international wholesale within fashion/apparel.

• Strong understanding of the Nordics market dynamics, consumer behavior, and wholesale operations.

• Solid understanding of retail math, including sell-through, mark-up, and OTB planning.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into clear actions.

• Experience building and maintaining client relationships.

• Experience supporting seasonal sales campaigns and showroom environments.

• Proficiency in Excel; experience with wholesale systems such as JOOR is a plus.

• Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally.

• Comfortable working across different markets and cultures within the Nordics.

• Flexibility to travel within the region as required.

• Fluent in Danish and English; additional Scandinavian languages are an advantage.

**THE GANNI WAY

We are looking for a true GANNI ambassador - someone who shares our values of Openness (ready to evolve, honest not perfect), Optimism** (you never stand still, just dance!), Authenticity (you march at your own beat!), Accountability (no excuses, you make an impact) & Responsibility (make small changes, see big differences).

The GANNI culture is based on a learning and results-driven mentality, where everyone is united by a common purpose of (hack)the fashion system!

GANNI is a state of mind - more than a way of dressing and we love to change the usual practice in everything we do. We are confident and capable of anything! So prepare yourself to be comfortable with the uncomfortable and hacking the system together with our amazing Wholesale team!

**WHAT ELSE?

**You will be based at our Copenhagen HQ, while maintaining close and continuous contact with the Paris office and ensuring strong collaboration and alignment with the Denmark team.

We welcome applications from all people regardless of gender identities, sexual orientations, ethnicities, racial identities, religious beliefs, disability statuses and personal expressions. We only want to know why you’re great for this role, so please avoid including your picture, age, and marital status in your CV.

**BE BOLD AND JOIN OUR GANNI COMMUNITY!

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel motivated to join our team and become a part of the GANNI community.

We will be interviewing candidates continuously and kindly ask you to send your application and CV as soon as possible. Please use the “Apply for position” button.

**About Kanpla

**Kanpla helps contract caterers create better dining experiences while cutting food waste. What started as a school project now serves more than 800,000 users across 5,000+ locations in 14 countries.

We're a team of 70+ and are growing aggressively across both Europe, UK & the US.

Our revenue comes from three places: software subscriptions, card payments on our platform, and the hardware and services we sell alongside our software. All of that runs through three legal entities (Denmark, the UK and the US) and three accounting systems. That's a lot of moving parts. So far, our VP of Finance has built and run the accounting setup, with support from our external partner ScaleUp Finance. As we grow, we want a dedicated person to take full ownership of the accounting & monthly close. That's where you come in.

**About The Role

**This is an ownership role. You'll be responsible and accountable for Kanpla's accounting function: the close, the numbers and the processes behind them.

The setup is up and running today, so you won't be starting from scratch. Our VP of Finance will onboard you and hand over the accounting, so you can take full ownership as quickly as possible. From there, the function is yours to run. ScaleUp handles day-to-day bookkeeping, payroll and VAT for our Danish parent company, and Karl, our part-time Finance Associate, supports you on the daily tasks.

Your job is to make sure everything going into the books is complete and correct, and that everything coming out of them is accurate and on time. Over time, we want to bring more of the work in-house and use external partners where it actually makes sense. You'll drive that, together with our VP of Finance.

You'll own finance operations end to end: what we invoice, what we collect, what we pay, what we pay our people, how we close the books and what we owe in VAT. That covers Denmark (e-conomic), the UK (Xero) and the US (QuickBooks).

We're also tidying up our structure across countries and investing heavily in automation, AI and data across the company, including a move to a new group-wide accounting / ERP system down the line. So there's plenty to build, not just to maintain.

This is a hands-on role, not a pure reporting job. You'll be accountable for making sure our numbers can be trusted, and you'll keep improving the processes behind them.

What you'll do

• Run the group close (monthly, quarterly and year-end) and lock the numbers on time, reviewing ScaleUp Finance's work along the way.

• Own AR and AP end to end: invoicing, collections, bank reconciliation and supplier payments.

• Make sure revenue matches across CRM, billing and accounting.

• Own VAT reporting across our markets, working with our external advisers.

• Manage payroll in Denmark, the UK and the US, including Employer of Record setups.

• Keep hardware margins on budget and sales in line with Incoterms and VAT, together with our Head of Hardware.

• Prepare financial statements and support budgeting and variance analysis.

• Be the main point of contact for our auditors.

• Keep improving controls and processes, and cut manual work.

What you'll bring

There's more than one route into this role. Strong candidates will probably bring most of the following:

• 4+ years in accounting or finance operations, in a growing international company or an audit or accounting firm.

• Solid knowledge of Danish accounting rules, as our parent company operates under Danish law.

• Hands-on experience owning a month-end close, ideally with an external accounting partner.

• Solid AR, AP and European VAT experience.

• Experience with e-conomic, Xero or QuickBooks, and the confidence to learn the others fast.

• Precision with reconciliations, and the habit of finding the root cause.

• The judgement to push back, and the pragmatism to find a way that works.

• Clear written English.

**Nice to have

**

• Experience from an international scale-up.

• Payroll experience, ideally across countries.

• UK or US accounting (or you'll pick it up on the job).

• ERP implementation or migration experience.

• Experience with hardware or Incoterms.

• Danish language skills.

What we offer

• Real ownership, with a direct line to the VP of Finance.

• A broad role across three countries, software, hardware, payments and payroll.

• The chance to shape our finance function, and grow with it.

• A competitive salary and real support for your development.

• Remote-first working and two off-sites or workcations a year.

Practical details

This is a full-time, permanent role, ideally based in Copenhagen, where our VP of Finance and the rest of the finance team sit. It covers our entities in Denmark, the UK and the US.

You'll report to Felix, our VP of Finance, and be part of a small finance team that also includes Karl, our part-time Finance Associate, who helps with accounts receivable, accounts payable, VAT and billing. Day to day, you'll work with Customer Success, Sales and Operations on invoicing and collections, and with our Head of Hardware on hardware. Externally, you'll work with ScaleUp, our auditors, tax advisers, payroll and Employer of Record providers, and payment partners.

We review applications on a rolling basis and aim to fill the role as soon as possible.

Technician, QA Manufacturing Support

AGC Biologics København

2 uger siden 143 ansøgere

Se, hvem AGC Biologics har ansat til denne rolle

• Rapportér dette job

**QA Manufacturing Support Technician

****Be close to production and make a difference in quality every day

**At AGC Biologics in Søborg, Quality and Manufacturing go hand in hand. As our new QA Manufacturing Support Technician, you will play an important role in supporting manufacturing activities during solution preparation and ensuring that production documentation meets GMP requirements.

This position offers an exciting combination of working close to the production line and handling batch record reviews and buffer and media documentation. You will be an important link between QA and Manufacturing, helping to connect the two functions and support a smooth and compliant manufacturing process.

**Where Quality meets Manufacturing

**In this role, you will support the Manufacturing Batch Release process by ensuring that solution (media and buffers) batch documentation are reviewed in accordance with established procedures and GMP requirements.

**Your Daily Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Performing QA Oversight in the Solution Preparation production suite in VAT83B.

• Supporting manufacturing during review of batch documentation, including questions related to Good Documentation Practice.

• Reviewing and approving Buffer and Media Batch Production Records.

• Printing Batch Process Records and managing manufacturing labels.

• Providing real-time review of manufacturing records and logbooks.

You may also support scanning, archiving and other related activities when needed.

What makes this position particularly interesting is the opportunity to combine documentation review with direct interaction with production. You will be close to daily manufacturing activities while contributing to the Quality processes that support batch release.

**A dynamic team with strong connections to production

**You will become part of a dynamic and proactive QA team consisting of 7 Scientists and 4 Student Assistants.

The team works closely with Manufacturing, and collaboration is an important part of everyday work. Together with your manager and colleagues, you will help build strong connections between QA and Manufacturing, acting as a bridge between the teams.

This is a role for someone who enjoys being involved in daily operations, working with different colleagues and combining structured documentation tasks with close collaboration on the production floor.

**Bring your attention to detail and collaborative mindset

**We imagine that you hold a Bachelor's degree (BSc) or a qualification as a Technician in production. Ideally, you have experience from a GMP or GLP production environment or a QA department within the biopharmaceutical industry.

You bring an interest in, or previous experience with, reviewing Batch Production Records and Solution Preparation Sheets.

Strong communication and collaboration skills are important, as you will work with colleagues and stakeholders across functions. You are fluent in written and spoken English and communicate clearly with both internal and external stakeholders.

As a person, you have a positive mindset, are flexible and enjoy taking on new tasks and responsibilities. You thrive in a dynamic environment and are comfortable navigating uncertainties.

**Interested in joining our team?

**We will review applications as they arrive, so please submit your application and CV as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you.

**Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

PanTarg is a Danish biotechnology company developing novel anti-cancer therapies in the form of antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) for the treatment of aggressive cancers with high unmet medical need.

Our work is based on more than 30 years of research conducted at Rigshospitalet and University of Copenhagen, and our vision is to enable novel treatment options for cancer patients via a novel first-in-class approach to targeted therapy.

We are currently incubated at the BioInnovation Institute (BII), a Copenhagen-based incubation hub for biotech startups in Europe. Here, we are currently progressing through preclinical development, aiming to reach a stage of clinical testing within a few years.

The position

We are looking for a Staff Scientist to join our team on site at BII. We are looking for a candidate with robust experimental experience with both in vivo xenograft studies as well as in vitro methods such as assay development, ELISA, flow cytometry and dose-response studies of drug candidates in cell culture. The selected candidate will generate data that supports our early translational activities, our non-clinical safety studies, and business decisions.

Qualifications

In vivo experience – Xenograft models

• Robust (5+ years) of hands-on experience with xenograft models of cancer, including CDX, PDX and orthotopic models.

• Strong practical experience with standard in vivo procedures, including I.V. injection via tail vein (must-have), blood collection, tissue collection, necropsy and general animal monitoring. Experience in preparing drug formulations and dosing solutions for administration, including appropriate handling and preparation of injectable drug candidates, is also required.

• Experience in the context of pharmacokinetic (PK) studies will be considered an advantage.

• Experience in planning, conducting and monitoring in vivo studies, as well as managing external CROs conducting such studies.

In vitro experience – Laboratory assays and protein characterization

• 5+ years of hands-on laboratory experience, with a strong focus on assay development, optimization and protocol troubleshooting.

• Experience with relevant assays and techniques, including ELISA, flow cytometry (multicolor panels) and dose-response studies of drug candidates in standard cell culture models.

• Good understanding of antibody biology and properties, as well as protein characterization, antibody concentration determination and purity assessment using techniques such as UV-Vis spectrophotometry, SDS-PAGE and Western blotting.

• Experience with additional laboratory methods and assay platforms is also relevant.

Data analysis and reporting

• Experience in analyzing, interpreting and presenting experimental data from both in vivo and in vitro studies.

• Ability to perform relevant statistical analyses, generate graphs and visualize experimental results.

• Experience in preparing clear and structured experimental reports and presenting study results and conclusions.

Other qualifications

• The optimal candidate will have obtained a PhD degree and have at least 4-5 years of experience from either pharma or biotech, or as a post doc.

• Good scientific project management and communications skills, and the ability to clearly and precisely present data to a professional audience.

• Good interpersonal skills, and the ability to thrive in a startup environment where flexibility and a can-do attitude is part of everyday work life.

• Fluent in the English language, written as well as spoken.

• On-site presence at the BioInnovation Institute in Copenhagen will be required.

General information and how to apply

• 
You will be reporting to the Chief Scientific Officer.

• 
The position is full time.

• 
Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, and the selected candidate will start as soon as possible.

• 
Application takes place via the application system here at LinkedIn.

• 
Please provide and combine, in a single file (PDF), a one-page CV, as well as a short, motivated application letter (also one page), summarizing your relevant experience, key responsibilities in previous roles, and motivation for applying for the position. Note that the application system only allows uploading of a single document.

• 
Questions about the open position should be addressed to the e-mail address jobs@pantarg.com

jobs.occupation: Critical Facilities Manager, Data Center Operations
jobs.description:
**Minimum qualifications:

**

• Associate's degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 9 years of experience in critical facilities management, including facility, technical and team management.

• Experience as a Facilities Manager or Chief Engineer within a critical facility.

• Experience managing mission critical facilities portfolio.

**Preferred qualifications:

**

• Master's degree in Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Experience collaborating with other business units to meet company goals and standards.

• Knowledge of electrical and mechanical systems in a data center environment.

• Excellent people management and leadership skills, with the ability to influence at all levels.

**About The Job

**The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facility Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems. You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components). You'll provide daily assistance to senior technicians as you read blueprints/schematics, conduct tours of systems and assess their working order.

You will develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Denmark: kr.940000 - kr.965000 (DKK) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

**Responsibilities

**Learn more about benefits at Google .

• Plan and execute campus operational budgets and expense forecasting, and manage established budgets.

• Set strategy and plan deployments across multiple sites.

• Lead efforts to integrate Google-wide strategy and execution with internal and external business partners.

• Create strategy for cost-effective operations, focused on total cost of ownership.

• Demonstrate critical thinking and innovation in approaching traditional data center and emergent issues.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

Are you a skilled Refrigeration Technician passionate about securing high-quality technical support?

Advansor is looking for an Aftersales Engineer to join an international team driven by climate action and delivering the best customer support.

We strive to design and produce the world’s best sustainable CO2 climate solutions. We know CO2 by heart, having gained rock-solid experience from designing and producing more than 20,000 racks.

We proudly share our expertise, best practices, and training with our customers through webinars, online training, and 2-day courses at our state-of-the-art training centre.

Your role

Working from our facilities in Brabrand, you will become part of our Aftersales Team. We handle support, warranty, training, and commissioning support of our sustainable CO2 refrigeration and heating systems. Technical Support is one of our core businesses, and your main responsibility will be securing high-quality support for our customers.

We support customers across Europe and LATAM, and the team is represented both at our HQ in Brabrand and locally in these regions.

Your key responsibilities will include

• Providing technical support via phone and email, guiding customers through optimization, fault diagnosis, and daily operations.

• Participating in our 24/7 support setup to ensure our customers always have a technical lifeline.

• Handling warranty claims efficiently and professionally.

• Collaborating across the organization to solve complex issues and deliver the best possible customer experience.

• Traveling approximately 25 days per year as part of our international support setup.

Your background

• You have a background as a Refrigeration Technician or hold similar experience.

• Knowledge about CO2 as a refrigerant is an advantage, but we will make sure you receive the proper training.

• You are quality-conscious, solution-oriented, and driven by a desire to share your knowledge with other technicians.

• You communicate clearly and professionally in English (our corporate language), both verbally and in writing. Additional language skills are an advantage.

We offer

As part of Team Advansor, you will get to work with more than 300 competent colleagues of more than 20 different nationalities and join us in our mission: to design and produce the world’s best sustainable climate solutions. You will become part of a highly ambitious company that values a good working environment, diversity, and teamwork.

Salary is decided based on your qualifications.

Please contact Martin Toft, Technical Support Manager, Aftersales at mto@advansor.com or by phone: +45 51 27 54 96 if you have any questions about the position or Advansor as a workplace.

Advansor is a part of Dover Corporation – please apply on Dover’s website:

Sustainable CO2 climate solutions

As a market-leading manufacturer, we have designed and produced more than 20,000 CO2 systems for sustainable commercial and industrial cooling and heating around the world since 2006.

Many people associate CO2 with global warming. We’re cool with that. Literally. Because CO2 is the most climate-friendly refrigerant: It is non-toxic, non-flammable and does not affect the ozone layer or harm our drinking water. That is why we are ’cool with CO2’.

_Are you passionate about financial planning and analytics? Do you want to shape financial performance insights and facilitate strategic decision‑making for the world’s largest jewellery brand? … If so, then we have an exciting opportunity for you!

_**Help shape the financial future of one of the world’s most iconic brands!

**The Group FP&A function has ownership of managing and steering the financial performance of Pandora. The function plays a vital role in defining and enforcing the global performance management framework and policies across Global Finance and within the business – including being the driver of planning, budgeting and forecasting, defining KPIs and management reporting towards CFO and CEO. The function is therefore key to Pandora’s ability to provide the right guidance on expected future performance to the capital markets.

As our new Senior FP&A Manager, you will lead Pandora’s long‑term planning process and provide the analysis our executive team relies on to make informed decisions. You will translate strategic priorities into clear financial insights, build a strong understanding of our value drivers, and help ensure that the company is set up for long‑term success. To succeed, you must bring a strong financial background, excellent analytical capabilities and the ability to collaborate effectively across a wide, global stakeholder landscape.

This role requires deep expertise in financial planning, reporting, and modelling, along with solid knowledge of cash flow and balance sheet mechanics. You should be able to manage multiple priorities independently and perform effectively in a fast‑paced, constantly evolving environment.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Lead the long‑term financial planning process across the PANDORA Group, ensuring alignment with corporate strategy and supporting the translation of strategic priorities into financial outcomes

• Conduct and interpret detailed financial analyses to help the organization understand deviations from long‑term plan.

• Develop robust financial models to simulate business scenarios, assess risks and opportunities, and support strategic decision-making

• Act as a strategic finance partner, helping shape financial targets and performance expectations across a wide range of stakeholder groups

• Prepare and deliver high-impact presentations and reports for executive leadership meetings, distilling complex financial information into clear, actionable insights

• Drive long‑term cash flow and balance sheet forecasting, ensuring alignment with overall financial plans and supporting capital allocation decisions

• Independently manage ad hoc strategic and financial analyses for senior stakeholders up to the CFO level, ensuring timely and accurate responses to critical business questions

**Required Skills

**

• Strong ability to understand complex ideas and simplify them

• Ability to manage multiple tasks and work under tight deadlines

• Ability to build high‑level financial models and scenarios

• Advanced Excel and solid financial modelling skills

• Experience with planning/reporting systems

• Strong written and verbal communication in English

**Required Experience

**

• 5-8+ years of experience in FP&A, commercial finance or finance transformation

• Experience working in a global or regional role

• Strong background in financial modelling, reporting, and scenario analysis

• Experience driving cross‑functional projects and process improvements

**Did we get your attention?

**If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible.

You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

At Pandora, we believe that creating an inclusive and diverse workplace and reflecting societal diversity in our customer engagement is essential to delivering on our company purpose: to give a voice to people’s loves. We dedicate ourselves to fostering, cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion and diversity where everyone feels respected and valued

We are looking for a Software Engineer who wants to build and ship new features that quickly reach customers, on top of an engine that already runs at scale. You join our platform team, which owns several live domains that our customers depend on every day. The foundations are solid and well maintained, so your time goes into new use cases and features rather than firefighting. Whether you have a couple of years of experience or a few more, we would like to see your application.

**What's in it for you?

**

• Hear directly from the people using what you build. Customer feedback feeds straight back into the roadmap, and you work on features and product decisions that matter to end users.

• Build on a system with real scale behind it. The event system spans 8 domains, exposes 20+ event types as webhooks, and powers 10 configurable alert types for our end users - currently ~20k active configurations triggering ~200k events every weekday. The team owns 8+ public APIs end to end, crucial for customers' day-to-day business.

• Learn from experts who share. You’ll join a talkative team of experienced domain experts who love discussing technical topics.

• Grow with support. Scoped, well-defined assignments to start, senior colleagues pairing and reviewing your work, and shared ownership of keeping things running.

• See your work ship. We favour small, frequent releases over long project cycles, so what you build lands in production fast.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a backend developer with strong Java skills who is at home on live production systems.

• Hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and REST APIs, in particular building and running your own services in a modern cloud-based microservice and event-driven architecture.

• You are comfortable working on live production systems with high data volumes and migration paths, keeping quality, observability, reliability, and performance in mind.

• You enjoy talking tech: you like discussing technical topics widely, learning, and listening in on topics not always directly related to your own tasks.

• You are motivated by incremental, high-quality delivery on products that are already live, bringing a fresh perspective that helps rework existing infrastructure where it is holding us back, and you treat the tools already in our platform as solid building blocks.

• Nice to have: Flink and stateful processing (or the willingness to learn it, since it is widely used here), relational databases, and Grafana and Prometheus, our “bread and butter”.

You embrace AI as part of how you engineer. From prototyping through to production, you use AI tools as an integrated part of your workflow, not as a shortcut but as a force multiplier. That said, this isn't the main thing we're hiring for: curiosity and a willingness to use it well matter more than deep prior experience.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Improve, extend and run the live domains our team owns, including telemetry storage and APIs, the event system, and the alerting engine, without disrupting production.

• Build and run your own services, with migration paths when architecture or data formats need to change.

• Work closely with the internal teams building products on top of the platform you help shape.

• Keep the platform reliable and observable at high data volumes.

****Our hiring process

****Don’t waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that’s not in the cover letter.

• Initial phone conversation with a colleague from our P&T team.

• Virtual meet and greet with your potential new leader and someone from the team, so you’ll get to know the role and team better.

• Assignment-specific interview with the hiring manager and a lead engineer from the team. We want to give you a real insight into the work. You’ll receive a case to prepare ahead of the interview and present to relevant colleagues - people you’ll also work closely with in the role.

• If needed, we will obtain references from former employers and conduct background checks at relevant levels.

• Offer presentation and walk-through.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products - it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues come together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

Over one million Danes use Skatteguiden to understand and optimise their taxes. We automate tax tracking, surface deductions people didn't know they had, and give users the insight they need to make better financial decisions. All connected directly to the Danish tax authority. We're an independent company of around 50 people based in Copenhagen, with a 4.7-star rating and a simple mission: make financial insight accessible to everyone, not just those who can afford an accountant.

Our platform has grown with us. The infrastructure that keeps Skatteguiden running has reached a scale and complexity that deserves full-time, specialist ownership, and the work ahead makes this an unusually good time to join.

About the role

You'll be joining the Platform team as a Platform Application Engineer, the counterpart to our Operational Platform team, which owns the infrastructure. Where they own the systems that keep Skatteguiden running, you'll own the shared application-layer services that the rest of engineering depends on.

The team treats these services as a product, with engineers distributed across several product teams as their users. Every product team touches payments, identity, and integrations. Your job is to make those services reliable, well-designed, and genuinely easy to build on, across a microservices architecture that favours low coupling and event-driven communication over direct dependencies.

We operate on a simple principle: you build it, you own it. That means end-to-end accountability, from design and implementation through to what happens when something goes wrong. Incidents aren't escalated to someone else's queue; they're yours to understand, resolve, and learn from.

What you'll do

Own the shared application platform. Design and build the core backend services underpinning payments, identity, authorisation, and third-party integrations — the shared foundation that product teams rely on every day.

Build and maintain payment services. Design payment flows that are reliable, observable, and compliant. Work with product teams to support new features and providers without coupling concerns or creating fragility in the critical path.

Own identity and authorisation. Design the systems that manage who our users are and what they can do — from OAuth flows and token management to fine-grained permission models and audit trails.

Integrate security and privacy into the application layer. Work with our Head of Security & Privacy to translate requirements into technical controls — particularly in identity, authorisation, and data handling — with GDPR and ISO 27001 in mind.

Integrate third-party systems. Own the integration layer connecting messaging, payment providers, and others. Ensure resilience, observability, and clear contracts.

Improve the developer experience. Build shared libraries, abstractions, and internal tooling that make it easier for product engineers to build on top of platform services correctly and confidently. Reduce the cognitive load on teams that shouldn't need to think about auth or payment internals.

Who we're looking for

You're likely a senior backend or platform engineer who's built and operated shared application services at scale, and who sees that role not just as backend development but as a product discipline — with the engineers who depend on your services as your primary users.

You take end-to-end ownership seriously. You don't consider something done when the code is merged, you care about how it behaves in production, you're on the hook when it doesn't, and you treat incidents as feedback worth acting on.

You're genuinely collaborative, someone who makes the people around them better, shares context freely, and doesn't work in isolation. And you're curious: you like trying new things, you're not attached to the way things have always been done, and you get energy from learning.

Must-have

A senior backend or platform engineer who's built and operated shared application services at scale, writes clean, maintainable services, takes API design seriously, and cares about the boundaries between components.

Hands-on experience deploying and debugging services on Kubernetes in production; you know how to get code running reliably in a Kubernetes environment without needing to own the cluster.

Experience designing MySQL schemas for production, migrations, indexing, query performance, and keeping data models clean as requirements evolve.

Working knowledge of message brokers such as RabbitMQ, event-driven patterns, consumer reliability, and how to design async communication that is easy to reason about across a distributed codebase.

Understanding of identity and authorisation (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, RBAC), and how to implement them securely and maintainably at scale.

Security, privacy, and compliance awareness. You design with GDPR, auditability, and least-privilege access in mind from the start, not as an afterthought.

A platform-as-a-product mindset. Experience thinking about developer experience as a product discipline, not just an engineering concern.

Genuine enthusiasm for AI. You use it daily, and you're always looking for new ways to apply it.

Nice-to-have

Experience building or operating payment integrations — familiarity with PSPs, webhook reliability, idempotency, and reconciliation.

Familiarity with React and TypeScript — enough to read, understand, and occasionally contribute to frontend code when the work calls for it.

Familiarity with Azure. You know your way around the platform — how services connect, how access and permissions work, and how to build in a cloud-native context.

Familiarity with our observability stack: Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry.

Familiarity with our GitOps tooling: ArgoCD and GitHub Actions.

Why join us

A substantial project from day one. The hosting migration means designing a production system from scratch, rare at any company.

Real influence. The architectural decisions made in this team will shape how Skatteguiden is built and operated for years. It's a small team with a high degree of autonomy, and the work is genuinely consequential.

Strong engineering culture. We take the technical foundations seriously. Security, architecture, and technical debt get real attention, not just lip service.

The product matters. Over one million Danes use Skatteguiden. Your work keeps it running and makes it possible to grow.

Solid company. We're independent, profitable, and growing. No VC pressure, no bloated roadmap. Just a clear mission and a team that cares.

A company that's serious about AI. We use AI across the business and we're only going deeper. Being a small, focused team means we can move fast on this, no lengthy approval chains, no slow rollouts. If you're always looking for ways to work smarter with AI, you'll fit right in.

Good people. We take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. The culture is professional, informal, and genuinely collaborative.

Practical details

Location: Copenhagen. We're an office-first company, and it's a deliberate choice. We're moving fast, we have big ambitions, and we genuinely believe that being physically together is one of the things that makes that possible. Things move quicker when you can turn your chair and talk to someone. We want to be upfront about this so you know what to expect.

And if we're asking people to be in the office, we want it to be worth their while. We're a five-minute walk from Rådhuspladsen, stocked with everything from fruit to fizzy drinks to afternoon snacks, and lunch is at Claus Meyer's canteen just across the street, proper food, not an afterthought. If you're putting in a long day, dinner is covered too.

Start: As soon as possible

Salary: Competitive and based on your experience.

Reporting to: CTO

Our lean hiring process

Screening call with our recruiter (30 min) ONLINE

Technical interview with the manager and an engineer (120 min) ONSITE

Meeting with our CEO (15 min) ONSITE

**World leader in allergy

**ALK is a global specialty pharmaceutical company based in Denmark, dedicated to allergy treatment and innovation for over a century. Present in 46 markets with production sites in the USA, Spain, France, and Denmark, we reach 3.1 million patients annually and aim to help 5 million people living with allergies by 2030.

Our 2,800 employees support this mission, with Global IT enabling modern technologies and world-class support across the organization.

We are looking for an IT Supporter to provide reliable, friendly technical assistance to colleagues and help keep workplace technology running smoothly. You will respond to support requests, troubleshoot hardware and software issues, and contribute to the effective day-to-day operation of IT services.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Resolve incidents and requests from colleagues by phone, email, ServiceNow and in person

• Set up and maintain laptops, mobile devices, printers, accounts and software

• Prepare equipment and access for onboarding and offboarding

• Document your work in ServiceNow and escalate complex or recurring issues to the right team

• Support IT asset management and routine maintenance

• Maintain GxP documentation for your area and support production-site IT when needed

**What You Bring

**

• At least 3 years’ hands-on experience in IT support or service desk in a Microsoft environment

• Solid working knowledge of Windows, Microsoft 365 and [Entra ID / Intune]

• Experience working independently and prioritising your own queue

• Experience with an ITSM tool (ServiceNow is a plus)

• Fluent Danish and English

Nice to have: ITIL Foundation, experience in a regulated (GxP) environment, basic networking

**What We Offer

**

• A close local team of three colleagues, plus a European support network

• Reporting to the Senior Manager, IT Support Europe

• Varied work across office IT and a regulated pharmaceutical environment

• Opportunities to grow within Global IT

**Become a part of ALK

**ALK provides a dynamic and accommodating work environment, complete with inspiring and challenging assignments. You are able to actively influence and challenge the status quo. Our flat structures attract independent individuals who like to feel the progress of the business and enjoy being close to the decision-making process. We consider our pioneering spirit, coupled with our trustworthiness, our winning formula.

Join us at ALK and be a part of an organization that values integrity, innovation, and making a difference in the lives of those we serve.

Allergy impacts and challenges the lives of millions of adults and children every day. At ALK, our purpose is to improve the lives of people living with allergies. Building on our strong heritage, we are guided by our strategy, Allergy+, that shows us a clear path towards this goal through focus, innovation, cultivation and optimisation.

Read more about our corporate strategy and our ambitions for growth

**Fair and unbiased recruitment at ALK

**At ALK, we believe that every candidate deserves to be evaluated fairly and respectfully. Our recruitment process is designed to give each applicant an equal opportunity, regardless of their background. Read more about fair and unbiased recruitment at ALK.

If you are applying from North America, please know that we are committed to fair, unbiased and non-discriminatory recruitment practices and to complying with all applicable federal, state and local employment laws. Employment decisions are made based on qualifications, skills and experience, without discrimination on the basis of legally protected characteristics.
