We're looking for a Customer Success Manager to lead complex enterprise implementations in a fast-moving company on a mission to help businesses fight financial crime and simplify compliance.

This role combines project leadership, technical problem-solving, and hands-on work with customer data. You'll get a front-row seat to how large organizations run KYC and compliance - and you'll be the one who makes it painless for them. Customer pain is our pain, and your goal is to turn their messy real-world problems into a smooth, structured onboarding experience.

You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable acting as an owner of the data workstream in onboarding and collaborating closely on integration-dependent deliveries.

You'll own implementations end-to-end for a portfolio of customers: project plans, stakeholder alignment, data mapping, validation, troubleshooting, and clear communication throughout delivery.

You'll work closely with peers in Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and Support, especially when delivery depends on integrations, APIs, or data workflows.

We're open to strong mid-level and senior candidates.

After go-live, you'll stay close enough to support adoption and a smooth handover into the broader customer lifecycle.

**Example projects you might run

**

• Enterprise onboarding: Managing multiple stakeholders (Compliance, IT, business owners) against a fixed go-live date.

• Data intake and migration: Mapping customer data into Avallone templates, validating outcomes, and troubleshooting edge cases.

• Integration-dependent delivery: Aligning requirements, timelines, and technical dependencies across teams.

• Most weeks you'll have multiple onboardings or delivery workstreams running in parallel, so executing with urgency, communicating clearly, and keeping momentum is key.

**Roles + Responsibilities

**

• Act as an owner for onboarding and implementation for your customer portfolio: build project plans, coordinate stakeholders, and drive execution against timelines.

• Lead the technical workstream: handle data intake, mapping, validation, troubleshooting, and iterative improvement of datasets.

• Turn customer processes into concrete steps: capture requirements, map processes, and build clear action plans.

• Run customer-facing communication: provide status updates, manage risk, and set expectations with everyone from compliance specialists to executives.

• Drive cross-functional success: work with Product and Engineering when delivery involves integrations/APIs; surface issues early, help drive them to closure, and feed insights back into the product roadmap.

• Support post-go-live motions: conduct adoption check-ins and health checks, and contribute to QBR preparation.

• Notice early when a customer is drifting, put a plan on the table, and drive it.

• Flag when a customer is ready for more (more users, workflows, or products) and bring the context to Sales.

• Share what you learn so the team gets faster over time (checklists, templates, SOPs, playbook improvements).

**What Success Looks Like (first 6 Months)

**

• You've delivered multiple onboardings to a predictable go-live without surprises in the final stretch.

• Customers trust the output: uploads are validated, issues are documented clearly, and fixes happen fast.

• You've helped customers reach meaningful early value (Activation) and built momentum towards steady, everyday use.

• You've improved at least one repeatable artifact (template/checklist/SOP) based on patterns you've seen in real implementations.

**Requirements

**We'll hire at the level that matches your experience.

**Core Requirements

**

• Experience in Customer Success, onboarding/implementation, project management, or a similar customer-facing role in a SaaS environment.

• Strong project management skills: you can create structure, align people, and keep delivery moving.

• Technical aptitude and comfort working hands-on with customer data (not just coordinating): CSVs/templates, mapping, validation checks, troubleshooting, and attention to detail.

• Professional proficiency in both written and verbal communication in English.

• Strong ownership and follow-through.

**What tends to make people successful in this role

**

• You like turning messy, real-world problems into a clear plan and getting it done.

• You communicate early when something is off track.

• You know when "good enough to ship" is the right call, and you document what you did.

**Leveling guidance

**

• Mid-level: you can run well-scoped onboardings, execute established workflows, and escalate early when needed.

• Senior: you lead the toughest implementations, handle ambiguity, coach others through tricky technical/data cases, and drive cross-functional execution.

**Bonus points

**

• Strong proficiency in Danish is a big plus.

• API-enabled implementations and/or data integrations.

• Experience in compliance-heavy domains (KYC/AML, sanctions, risk, or similar).

• Comfortable using simple tooling to validate/troubleshoot data (e.g., basic SQL, Excel/Sheets checks, BI).

**Why Avallone?

**At Avallone, implementations matter commercially, operationally, and for customer trust. You'll work on real delivery problems with smart colleagues across Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and Support.

You'll help shape how we run onboardings as we scale, and you'll join a company that values a true people-first culture. We care about our customers, our values, and each other.

We focus on your passion and desire to grow, and we believe that when we win big, we celebrate big. You'll collaborate, learn, and grow with some of the smartest people in the industry - and you will have a lot of fun doing it!

**Location

**Copenhagen, Denmark – hybrid (primarily office-based)

**How To Apply

**We hire on a rolling basis and will close the process once we've found the right person. If this sounds like you, don't wait, send us your application.

_Pandora is currently looking for a Student Assistant to join our Investment Governance & Performance team within Global Network Development & Insights. In this role, you will support the governance and performance tracking of investments across Pandora's global store network. You will work closely with the Franchise & Network Management team as well as local property teams, helping ensure that investment decisions are financially sound, strategically aligned, and supported by data-driven insights.

This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience with investment analysis, retail network strategy, and business performance management in one of the world's leading jewellery brands. Working closely with stakeholders across Pandora's global organization, you will gain exposure to how strategic decisions regarding store openings, relocations, lease renewals, and closures are evaluated, approved, and measured.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Contribute to optimization and automation of investment governance processes.

• Provide analysis and insights to support and improve future network investment decisions.

• Maintain and update the global investment overview and support ongoing investment governance activities.

• Upload and track Investment Proposals (IPs) and support hindsight reporting to evaluate business case performance against actual results.

• Support ongoing store classification processes and ad hoc business requests.

**Your Team

**The Global Network Development & Insights function partners with the Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) organization to provide strategic insights that shape Pandora's global retail and franchise network. The team collaborates closely with Cluster Property Directors and commercial stakeholders worldwide to drive performance, support investment decisions, and execute global growth priorities.

You will report to the Network Expansion & Investments Senior Manager and become part of a collaborative, international team focused on data-driven decision-making and strategic investment optimization.

**Qualifications

**

• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree within Business Administration, Finance, Data Analytics, IT, or a related field.

• Ideally have around two years remaining of your studies.

• Proficient in Microsoft Excel and comfortable working with large datasets.

• Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken.

• Experience with Power BI, Power Query, Power Automate, AI, or other data and automation tools is considered an advantage.

• Interest in using data and technology to solve business challenges.

**Personal Competencies

**

• Analytical, curious, and motivated by solving complex business challenges.

• Structured, detail-oriented, and highly organized in your way of working.

• Proactive and able to take ownership of tasks while working independently.

• Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

• Collaborative and confident working with stakeholders across different functions and markets.

• Strong communication skills and a continuous improvement mindset.

• Eager to learn and develop both technical and commercial capabilities.

**What We Offer

**A position as a Student Assistant at Pandora offers you an opportunity for both personal and professional development in a global organization. This is your chance to join the world's largest jewellery brand and gain valuable experience within investment governance, business performance, and retail network strategy while working alongside talented and passionate colleagues.

**You Will Get

**

• Hands-on experience with investment analysis and decision-making in a global retail business.

• Exposure to senior stakeholders across Commercial, Finance, and Network Development.

• Insight into how data and business cases drive store investment and network decisions.

• Support and coaching from your manager and experienced team members.

• The opportunity to build analytical, commercial, and stakeholder management skills that will benefit your future career.

**Additional Information

**

• You are expected to work approximately 15-20 hours per week on average (less during exam periods and more when possible).

• The role is based at Pandora's Global Office in Copenhagen and requires physical presence.

• You must be a current student to apply.

• Start date: As soon as possible.

**Did We Get Your Attention?

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you would like to become part of Pandora's future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site at Pandora Group.

**Icing on the Cake

**You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world’s largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores. Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Do you enjoy turning business requirements and market insights into sourcing opportunities that create value for the organization? Join Ambu’s Global Indirect Procurement & Capex team and play an important role in supporting procurement across an international, fast-growing organization.

As Associate Category Manager, you will support sourcing and category management activities across indirect Procurement. Working closely with experienced Global Category Managers, you will lead or contribute to sourcing projects, supplier management activities, market analyses and stakeholder engagement while developing your sourcing & category management capabilities. You will gradually take ownership of defined sourcing activities and projects while building experience across the source-to-contract process.

You will join an ambitious global procurement organization where your work will have visible business impact. The role offers broad exposure to international stakeholders, varied indirect categories and end-to-end sourcing activities, providing a unique opportunity to build experience across a global procurement environment.

The position is based at Ambu’s headquarters in Ballerup and reports to the Director of Global Indirect Procurement & Capex.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your main responsibilities will include:

• Support the translation of business requirements and market insights into sourcing strategies and recommendations.

• Contribute to or lead RFI, RFQ and RFP processes, including supplier identification, market analysis, preparation of sourcing documentation, proposal evaluation and stakeholder coordination.

• Independently manage defined sourcing activities and less complex sourcing events using established procurement processes and tools.

• Support supplier negotiations, contract preparation and contract handover activities.

• Analyze spend, suppliers, markets and cost drivers to identify savings opportunities, value creation initiatives and risk considerations.

• Prepare sourcing analyses, recommendations and business case inputs for stakeholder decision-making.

• Build productive relationships with stakeholders, suppliers and cross-functional partners, collaborating closely with Global Category Managers and function including Legal, Quality Assurance, Finance and IT.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives, digital procurement activities and the adoption of new procurement tools and processes.

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you:

• Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree within Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Economics, Finance or a related field.

• Bring 2-3 years of experience within procurement, sourcing, category management or a related procurement function.

• Have experience supporting sourcing initiatives, supplier management activities or procurement projects.

• Understand source-to-contract processes and are comfortable working with stakeholders across different functions.

• Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn data and market insights into recommendations.

• Are a structured and proactive team player with strong communication and project coordination skills, including solid Excel and Microsoft Office capabilities.

• Communicate fluently in English and are motivated to learn and grow within a global procurement organization. Experience with sourcing platforms (e.g. Keelvar, Coupa, Ariba, GEP or similar) as well as an interest in digital procurement, AI or process automation is considered an advantage.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

Are you passionate about developing people and helping leaders succeed? PEAK Wind is seeking a Lead People & Development Specialist to strengthen leadership development, lead larger people initiatives, and provide trusted guidance on complex people matters. This is a senior generalist role for someone who combines hands-on experience with the confidence to turn business needs into practical solutions.

Introducing the People & Development Team

You will become part of our People & Development team, where we work collaboratively to attract, develop, and retain talented colleagues and support the business across the employee lifecycle. We share knowledge, support one another, and bring different perspectives to finding solutions that work for both our people and our business.

You will report to Head of People & Development and work closely with our Senior Management, leaders and colleagues across the business. As an experienced individual contributor, you will take ownership of your areas of responsibility while contributing to the wider team’s priorities.

How You Will Make an Impact

As a Lead People & Development Specialist, you will combine broad generalist responsibilities with a strong focus on leadership development and project delivery. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Support the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of leadership development initiatives, translating leaders’ needs into practical workshops, tools, and follow-up activities.

• Act as a trusted sparring partner to Senior Management and  leaders on team development, performance, collaboration, and day-to-day people decisions.

• Lead larger, cross-functional People & Development projects from scoping and planning through implementation and follow-up, managing stakeholders, dependencies, and communication.

• Handle complex and sensitive employee relations cases with sound judgement, discretion, and a structured approach, involving relevant colleagues or external advisers when needed.

• Contribute across the employee lifecycle, providing pragmatic guidance and supporting consistent people practices, policies, and processes.

• Support annual people processes, including Performance & Development Dialogues and Talent Reviews, helping leaders turn discussions into meaningful development actions.

• Identify opportunities to improve how we work and share your experience with the People & Development team to strengthen our collective delivery.

What Will Make You Successful in This Role

You are an experienced People & Development generalist who enjoys both developing people and navigating the complexity of everyday people matters. You can work independently, build trust with leaders, and balance longer-term development initiatives with hands-on delivery. You will bring:

• A relevant educational background in human resources, organisational development, psychology, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Substantial experience in a broad HR or People & Development role, with the judgement and independence to operate as a senior generalist.

• Hands-on experience supporting leadership development, including facilitating learning activities and helping leaders apply new approaches in practice.

• A track record of leading larger people projects with multiple stakeholders, from defining the need to embedding the outcome.

• Experience handling complex employee relations cases with empathy, confidentiality, and sound judgement, recognising when specialist or legal advice is needed.

• Strong relationship-building and facilitation skills, with the confidence to support and constructively challenge leaders.

• A structured, pragmatic approach and the ability to prioritise competing needs and follow through on commitments.

• Clear and effective communication skills in English, both spoken and written, and a collaborative mindset.

• Experience working with Insights profiles in individual or team development is a clear advantage; relevant accreditation is welcome but not required.

Why Join PEAK Wind

• An international, inclusive, and diverse workplace where differences are valued

• The opportunity to strengthen leadership and people practices in a business supporting the renewable energy transition

• Flexible working arrangements that support both your career and personal life

• A flat organisational structure where your ideas are welcomed and your contributions matter

• A strong focus on your learning, development, and professional growth.

• A culture that values commitment, meaningful contributions, and having fun

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Fair Hiring

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace drives innovation, creativity, and stronger results. At PEAK Wind, we are committed to fair and transparent hiring processes, welcoming candidates from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our hiring decisions focus on what each person brings to the role and our team, and we are committed to ensuring transparent salary structures, with pay decisions based on clear, objective, and gender‑neutral criteria. Salary information, including the relevant salary band, will be shared with candidates when they are invited to a first interview.

How to Apply

We look forward to receiving your application. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been found. Please apply directly through our website. If you have any questions or would like to know more about the position, please contact People & Development at recruitment@peak-wind.com.

About PEAK Wind

PEAK Wind is an independent renewable energy specialist in commercial, financial, and technical operations, delivering advisory, intelligence, and asset management services to investors and developers around the world. From onshore and offshore wind generation to Power-to-X, we work across the entire energy lifecycle to optimise operations and maintenance, enhance asset performance, and provide a holistic view of renewable infrastructure portfolios.

Our values - Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity - are reflected in everything we do, from how we support our clients to how we collaborate as a team. At PEAK Wind, you will be able to apply your professional skills in a dynamic environment and experience a meaningful responsibility and involvement.

jobs.occupation: QA Specialist, QA Commercial Drug Substance
jobs.description:
Are you experienced in managing CMO collaborations and building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders? Do you thrive in a broad QA role where you combine your GMP expertise with a pragmatic and hands-on approach across different quality areas?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new QA Specialist in QA Commercial Operations.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a passionate QA specialist to join our team. You will be a part of the well-functioning QA Drug Substance/QA for QC team in the QA Commercial Operations department, with responsibility for quality oversight of starting materials, intermediates, and Drug Substances for commercial products. We have a close collaboration with our Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) and process- and QC SMEs internally at Ascendis Pharma.

Your key responsibilities will be:

As part of the role, you will work broadly across quality oversight activities and take ownership of a wide range of tasks and responsibilities, including:

• Take primary responsibility for oversight of one or more CMOs in our supply chains with respect to review and approval of documentation from these CMOs, including upscale activities, PPQ documentation, CPVs, batch documentation, deviations, changes, CAPAs, stability studies, QMRs, quality agreements etc

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key CMO stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and effective collaboration through meetings, teleconferences, and audits. Participate in CMO evaluations and product quality reviews

• Keep up to date with changes in relevant product guidelines and regulatory requirements and ensure cGMP at Ascendis and CMOs

• Drive and assume responsibility for agreed tasks and matters

• Continuously optimize our work processes and the way we execute quality oversight

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a relevant academic degree - preferably a master's degree in pharmacy or equivalent - and 5-10 years of experience within chemical and/or biological GMP production

Furthermore, you have:

• Solid QA experience, preferably including QA for QC, and experience working with CMOs

• Strong analytical skills, a collaborative mindset, and a can-do attitude

• Cultural understanding

• Experience with audits/inspections

• A critical and pragmatic mindset and yet with attention to the necessary details

• Clear and persistent communication skills, particular regarding expectations and requirements to quality

• Cooperative and striving for smooth cooperation with many stakeholders

• Ambitious and able to see the benefits in going the extra mile

The position as QA specialist requires experience with and knowledge of US and EU GMP regulations and requirements. Furthermore, you should be proficient in English at a professional level, both written and spoken, and you master MS Office.

At Ascendis Pharma, you will be part of a stimulating, informal, and innovative working environment, where you will interact with very skilled colleagues and partners to deliver on Ascendis' ambitious corporate goals. You will be part of an expanding QA-organization overseeing development, clinical, and commercial activities.

Travel: 5-20 days/year.

Place of work: Tuborg Boulevard 12, Hellerup

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the job or the company, please contact QA Senior Director, Jan Jakobsgaard, M +45 25 66 29 42 leave a message if call is not answered. All applications must be submitted in English and are treated confidentially.

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com

A note to recruiters:

We do not allow external search party solicitation. Presentation of candidates without written permission from the Ascendis Pharma HR team (specifically from: Talent Acquisition Partner or Human Resources Director) is not allowed. If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged.

_Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure? If so, CIP Fund Solutions (CIP FS) is looking for an AI Business Manager to join our Digital Development team.

**Team

**The AI team is a cross-functional team dedicated to embedding AI directly into CIP's business lifecycles and day-to-day operations across the platform and sits within the wider Digital Development team.

**Role

**The AI Business Manager is responsible for ensuring AI creates measurable business value across CIP's business lifecycles and works directly with lifecycle owners, product teams, delivery teams, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, drive adoption, and embed AI capabilities into day-to-day processes and ways of working.

The AI Business Manager serves as the bridge between business priorities and AI capabilities, ensuring that AI is integrated directly into the Investor, Investment, Fund & Investment Management, and Project lifecycles rather than delivered as standalone technology initiatives. The role is accountable for helping lifecycle teams identify where AI can accelerate outcomes, improve decision-making, increase productivity, and enhance user experiences while ensuring appropriate governance and value realization.

**Responsibilities will consist of, but are not limited to:

**Lifecycle Partnership and Business Engagement

• Partner with lifecycle owners and business stakeholders to understand priorities and strategic objectives, identifying where AI can improve outcomes, efficiency, and decision quality.

• Participate in lifecycle planning and roadmap discussions to embed AI initiatives into business plans from the outset, acting as the primary AI partner for assigned lifecycle domains.

AI Opportunity and Use Case Management

• Facilitate identification, assessment, and prioritization of AI use cases, maintaining the opportunity pipeline based on business value, feasibility, and strategic alignment.

• Develop business cases, value hypotheses, and success metrics, supporting initiatives from ideation and validation through deployment and value realization.

Embedding AI into Business Lifecycles

• Work with business and technology teams to integrate AI into core processes, products, and workflows, redesigning ways of working where relevant and driving adoption of AI-powered tools.

• Support the evolution of lifecycle operating models to treat AI as a native capability, scaling effective patterns across domains.

Governance and Responsible AI

• Ensure AI initiatives comply with governance, security, risk, privacy, and regulatory requirements, coordinating with legal, risk, compliance, and information security stakeholders as needed.

• Support lifecycle teams in navigating AI policies and approval processes, promoting responsible AI practices and appropriate human oversight.

Value Realization and Performance Management

• Track KPIs for AI adoption, utilization, and business value, measuring realized benefits such as productivity gains, cost savings, and risk reduction.

• Provide regular updates to leadership on AI portfolio performance and lifecycle impact.

Change, Communication, and Enablement

• Manage efforts for stakeholder engagement, communications, and change management for AI initiatives, supporting training and capability-building across lifecycle teams.

• Build and maintain networks of AI champions and subject matter experts, promoting a culture of experimentation and responsible AI usage.

**You

We look for the following in a candidate:

RESOLVA is assisting INVISIO with the recruitment of a Corporate Legal Counsel.

ROLE DESCRIPTION

INVISIO is looking for a commercially minded and pragmatic Corporate Legal Counsel to support its global business. This is a broad legal generalist role with a strong commercial focus, where you will work closely with the business and provide legal support across a wide range of matters, with particular emphasis on international contracts, tenders, customer projects and other commercial legal matters.

As Corporate Legal Counsel, you will become part of a small legal team together with Signe Karstoft, Legal Director, to whom you will report. The role is based at INVISIO’s headquarters in Hvidovre, and the legal function is organisationally anchored within INVISIO’s Sales & Program function, which consists of approximately 50 employees globally, including around 25-30 in Denmark. You will primarily support the global sales organisation and work closely with colleagues across the business. Much of your work will involve large and complex customer contracts, tenders and projects.

You will provide legal support across INVISIO’s international business, including in relation to US contracts, such as contracts within the defence sector, and support sales teams across Europe and other markets. You will also support INVISIO in connection with major public tenders, including tenders involving ministries and defence organisations, providing legal support on contractual and other legal questions arising throughout the tender process.

As a technology company, intellectual property is an important part of INVISIO’s business. While dedicated specialists handle areas such as patents, you may also advise on IP-related matters as part of the broader commercial legal support. Experience with IP or from a technology or other IP-intensive business would therefore be an advantage.

In addition to the day-to-day legal support, you will contribute to developing and improving the way Legal supports the business. This includes driving legal improvement initiatives, maintaining and developing contract templates and legal guidelines, and conducting workshops and awareness activities for the business.

The role is highly international and outward-facing, with significant interaction with customers and stakeholders at all levels. You will have opportunities to join customer visits and negotiate contracts abroad, as well as participate in trade fairs in Denmark, Europe and the US.

The role is expected to involve approximately 25 travel days per year.

As INVISIO continues to grow rapidly, you will work in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly, and no two days are the same.

AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY

INVISIO is looking for an independent and commercially minded lawyer who takes ownership and enjoys working closely with customers and colleagues across the organisation. Your key responsibilities will include:

Commercial contracts and negotiations:

• 
Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of commercial contracts, including large international sales contracts, non-disclosure agreements, letters of intent, consulting agreements, tender-related contracts and distribution agreements.

• 
Take an active role in customer dialogue and contract negotiations and provide commercially focused legal advice, working closely with relevant stakeholders to balance legal considerations with commercial objectives.

• 
Provide pragmatic legal advice on contractual and other commercial matters arising in the day-to-day business.

Tenders and customer projects:

• 
Provide legal support in connection with major public tenders, including reviewing tender documentation and advising on contractual and other legal questions arising throughout the tender process.

• 
Advise on legal and contractual aspects of tender structures, including which INVISIO entity should participate and any related intercompany arrangements.

• 
Support and, where relevant, take a coordinating role in customer projects and other commercial initiatives, including advising on contractual set-ups, priorities and how existing solutions can be applied in different markets etc.

IP and export control:

• Ad hoc Advise on IP and export control matters, including IP considerations in commercial agreements and questions relating to export restrictions and requirements in connection with international sales and customer projects.

Legal development and business support:

• 
Develop, maintain and improve contract templates, legal guidelines and other tools.

• 
Drive legal improvement initiatives and conduct workshops and legal awareness activities for the business, for example in relation to NDA’s.

• 
Provide ad hoc legal advice and support across INVISIO as required.

REPORTING AND TITLE

Reporting to: Signe Karstoft, Legal Director.

Title: Corporate Legal Counsel.

IDEAL EXPERIENCE

Education: You hold a master’s degree in law (cand.jur. or cand.merc.jur).

Work experience: You have approximately 3-6 years of relevant legal experience from an in-house role, for example in a technology or software company or another larger international industrial company.

Legal areas of specialisation: You have strong experience in drafting, reviewing and negotiating commercial agreements and are comfortable handling contractual matters independently. You also have experience supporting tender processes and advising on the legal and contractual matters that arise in this context.

In addition, you have a broad legal profile and are able to navigate a varied range of legal matters. Experience with IP-related matters, particularly from a technology or other IP-intensive business, would be an advantage. Knowledge of export control would also be beneficial.

Commercial: You have a strong commercial mindset and understand how legal advice fits into the broader business context.

You have experience working directly with customers and are comfortable collaborating with colleagues at all levels of the organisation. You are able to balance legal considerations with commercial objectives and provide pragmatic, solution-oriented advice.

Language skills: You are fluent in Danish and English, both written and verbal.

PERSONAL CAPABILITIES

Independent & proactive: You work independently, take ownership of your responsibilities and proactively drive matters forward.

Outgoing & interpersonal: You are outgoing and enjoy interacting with people with different backgrounds and at all levels, both internally and externally. You have strong interpersonal skills and are comfortable engaging with customers, colleagues and senior management.

Analytical & pragmatic: You have strong analytical skills and are able to understand complex legal and commercial matters while maintaining a pragmatic and solution-oriented approach.

Structured & able to prioritise: You work in a structured manner, maintain a good overview of your responsibilities and are able to prioritise effectively in a fast-paced environment where new and urgent matters frequently arise. You remain calm and focused when priorities change or deadlines are tight.

Stakeholder management & collaboration: You build strong relationships and collaborate effectively across functions and organisational levels. You are a team-oriented colleague who contributes to a strong sense of teamwork across the organisation and is able to influence stakeholders in a constructive manner.

Positive & constructive: You have a professional approach to your work and interact with others with maturity and integrity. You bring positive energy, are resilient when challenges arise and remain constructive in a busy environment.

INVISIO’S VALUE PROPOSITION TO YOU

INVISIO is a rapidly growing company with ambitious growth targets. The company achieves these ambitions through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts will be important to INVISIO’s continued success, and by joining the company, you will become part of an international headquarter with an informal working environment.

INVISIO offers a wide range of professional and social employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

ABOUT INVISIO

INVISIO is a global leader in communications technology for professionals working in mission-critical environments. Established in Denmark in 1999, the company develops and markets advanced, integrated communication systems for defence and public safety professionals, helping users communicate clearly and safely in demanding environments.

INVISIO’s modular and scalable portfolio includes headsets, control units, intercom systems, hubs and software designed to work together across dismounted, vehicle-based and command operations. The solutions are marketed under the INVISIO and Racal Acoustics brands.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, INVISIO has an international presence across Europe, North America and Asia. The company has approximately 330 employees globally, including around 215 in Denmark, and is growing rapidly. INVISIO is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm (Large Cap).

INVISIO is characterised by a strong focus on innovation, close customer collaboration and an international working environment. Its core values are Passion, Innovation, Teamwork and Customer First.

You can learn more about INVISIO here: www.invisio.com.

If you believe this position is a good fit for you, we look forward to receiving your application. Please attach your CV and any relevant documentation. Should you have any questions regarding the position, please don’t hesitate to contact Camilla Krogh at (+45 51261264) or Mikkel Falkenberg at (+45 29993065) from the team at RESOLVA.

**GetWhy is the end-to-end AI-powered human insights platform trusted by the world’s most influential brands, including eBay, Arla, Warner Brothers and The Coca Cola company, to understand their customers at scale. We’re backed by $40M in Series A funding and scaling aggressively into the enterprise market.

In our category, events aren’t a nice-to-have. They are a strategic weapon. Industry conferences, hosted experiences, executive dinners and brand activations are where relationships form, pipeline is built, and GetWhy cements its position as the category leader in AI-powered qualitative research.

We’re hiring our first Lead, Global Events & Community to own how GetWhy shows up in the world. This is a high-ownership role for someone with taste, commercial instinct and relentless execution. You’ll design experiences enterprise buyers actually want to attend, turn every event into content that travels far beyond the room, and build the playbook that lets GetWhy show up brilliantly on every continent.

What you’ll do

Own the global event strategy

• Set GetWhy’s global events strategy with the marketing leadership, from tentpole industry conferences (IIEX, ESOMAR, Quirk’s) to hosted events, executive roundtables and product showcases.

• Plan, produce and execute 15–20+ events per year across Europe, the US and beyond, each tied to clear pipeline, brand and customer goals.

• Own the global events budget, sponsorship negotiations, and relationships with agencies, venues and production partners.

Make GetWhy unmissable at every conference

• Have a strong point of view on world-class conference presence, from booth concept and spatial design to merch and the small details people remember.

• Replace badge-scanning booths with live experiences: let attendees run a real GetWhy study, see AI-moderated interviews in action, and leave with an insight.

• Secure speaking slots and sponsorships that put GetWhy at the centre of the industry conversation.

Put customers on stage

• Build a flagship GetWhy-hosted event where customers present the work they’ve done with GetWhy and show other brands how to do the same.

• Recruit and prepare customer and executive speakers, and make sure every GetWhy representative on stage or on the floor is briefed and on message.

Own the side events and intimate moments

• Design VIP dinners, executive roundtables and side events around major conferences, where the real relationships are built.

• Partner with Sales and Customer Success on account-based events that move specific deals and expansions forward.

Run the content machine

• Capture on-site content at every event, including video, photos and short clips that show GetWhy’s presence on the ground.

• Turn events into social media content, such as live posts, recaps, reels and LinkedIn stories, working with the wider marketing team.

• Conduct on-site interviews with customers, speakers and industry leaders, creating content for social, the website and sales enablement.

• Make sure every event keeps working for weeks afterwards through recaps, clips and follow-up campaigns.

Turn events into revenue

• Build the pre- and post-event engine: invitations, promotion, lead capture, qualification and a seamless handoff to Sales.

• Track and report on pipeline, ROI, reach and brand impact for every event, and double down on what works.

Build the playbook

• Create scalable playbooks and “event in a box” toolkits so local teams and partners can host on-brand GetWhy events anywhere.

• Grow the events function over time, including freelancers, agencies and future hires.

• Stay ahead of new event formats and technologies, and bring the best of them to GetWhy first.

Who you are

You’re not looking for an event coordination role. You’re a builder who sees events as the highest-leverage channel in a B2B enterprise sale, and you want to prove it on a global stage.

• 3–6+ years in event marketing, field marketing or experiential marketing for B2B SaaS, enterprise tech or a high-growth scale-up.

• A portfolio of standout events, with a track record that ties them directly to pipeline and revenue.

• Real taste. You know what makes a booth, a dinner or a keynote memorable, and you can explain why.

• Commercially minded. You think about pipeline and impact, not just logistics.

• A poster, not a scroller. Social media is second nature, and you know what makes an event clip worth watching.

• Comfortable behind a camera and in front of people. You can film, run an interview and do basic editing on the fly.

• A strong operator who can run several events in parallel across time zones without dropping quality.

• An excellent communicator who can brief a designer, negotiate with a venue and pitch an executive audience.

• Comfortable with CRM and marketing automation tools such as HubSpot or Salesforce.

• A willing traveler. You go where the events are and you bring the energy.

Bonus points

• Experience from the insights, market research or MarTech industry. You know the conferences, the audience and the culture.

• Experience at an AI-native research company or a frontier AI or tech company known for its events.

• You’ve built an events function from scratch, including playbooks, processes and measurement.

• You’ve produced a flagship owned event or customer conference.

• A network of event organisers, venues and production partners across Europe and the US.

What we offer

• A fast-scaling, ambitious company where events are a core growth engine, not an afterthought.

• The chance to build GetWhy’s global events function from the ground up and define how a category leader shows up in the world.

• Real ownership, a seat close to leadership, and the budget and trust to try bold ideas.

• Work with some of the world’s most influential brands as customers, speakers and partners.

• Annual company retreats and Friday bar events. We work hard, and we celebrate hard.

How to apply

Click apply and upload your CV, LinkedIn profile, and a link to a portfolio of events you’ve produced. Event photos, clips or social posts you’ve made are a big plus.

If we see a match, we’ll invite you to a conversation online or at our office. The process includes a short creative assignment, where you’ll pitch how GetWhy should show up at one of our key industry conferences.

This isn’t the easiest events job out there. It’s the one that will define how a category leader shows up in the world. Let’s build GetWhy together.

jobs.occupation: Specialist/Senior Specialist Pharmacometrician - Translational and Clin Dev
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about pharmacometrics and model-informed drug development? Do you have experience with translational and clinical population PK/PD modeling and support of regulatory submissions?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Specialist/Senior Specialist Pharmacometrician.

We are looking for a hands-on pharmacometrician who combines scientific excellence with strategic thinking and wants broad ownership across programs.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

Our Pharmacometrics Department supports every asset in the Ascendis portfolio and acts as a strategic partner throughout development, from innovation and early research through translational and clinical development, regulatory submissions, and life cycle management. Each pharmacometrician contributes directly to development strategy and portfolio decisions.

We are seeking an experienced hands-on Specialist/Senior Specialist Pharmacometrician who can address complex development questions and translate quantitative insights into actionable recommendations. You will apply model-informed drug development in rare diseases, where quantitative methods can directly inform trial design, dose selection, and evidence generation in small patient populations. You will gain exposure across translational and development stages and contribute to projects throughout the portfolio, providing broad visibility and influence within the company.

This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results. You will work both independently and in close collaboration with colleagues in Pharmacometrics, global project teams, external partners, and consultants. You will be joining the growing Pharmacometrics Department and report directly to Kristin Carlsson Petri, Senior Director and Head of Pharmacometrics, who is based in Hellerup. You will also be based in Hellerup. The team includes in-house pharmacometricians, a pharmacometrics programmer, and external consultants working remotely.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

• Develop model-informed drug development strategies for translational and clinical-stage projects and ensure optimal use of pharmacometric methods to inform trial and program design

• Shape regulatory strategy and represent pharmacometrics in global health authority interactions

• Inform dose selection, trial design, regulatory strategy, and lifecycle decisions through population PK/PD modeling, simulation, exposure-response analysis, and quantitative benefit-risk assessment

• Translate quantitative results into clear recommendations to project teams, senior management, health authorities, external partners or organizations

• Plan, document and report pharmacometric analyses in accordance with internal quality standards and global regulatory submission requirements

• Strengthen departmental methods, standards and capabilities through peer reviews, knowledge sharing, and continued development of the department's modeling and reporting environment

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a PhD, MSc, or equivalent qualification in pharmacometrics, pharmaceutical sciences, pharmacokinetics, mathematics, engineering, or another relevant quantitative discipline. You have relevant experience with PK/PD modeling and model-informed drug development.

Furthermore, you have:

• Hands-on experience with NONMEM and R applied to population PK/PD model development, simulation, and model-informed drug development

• Strong programming skills and technical expertise to organize, perform, document, and report pharmacometric analyses to submission standard

• Experience with translational and clinical-stage analyses, including population PK, PK/PD, exposure-response, dose selection, and trial-design questions

Additional experience that would be an advantage:

• Industrial experience supporting regulatory interactions or submissions, including knowledge of relevant FDA, EMA, and ICH expectations for pharmacometric analyses

• Familiarity with LaTeX, Git and reproducible reporting workflows, or experience applying machine learning, artificial intelligence, or automation to pharmacometric workflows

Key competencies:

• You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude

• You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key

• You communicate complex quantitative findings clearly, work effectively across disciplines, and balance analytical detail with broader development objectives

• You combine a strong quantitative background with biological and clinical understanding and collaborate effectively with scientists, clinicians, regulatory colleagues, and external partners. Your ability to share knowledge and contribute to common goals will be valued among colleagues

Travel: 5-10 days per year.

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, Hellerup, Denmark.

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform-applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For further information about the position, please contact Kristin Carlsson Petri, Senior Director and Head of Pharmacometrics at kcp@ascendispharma.com.

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com.

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

A note to recruiters:

We do not allow external search party solicitation. Presentation of candidates without written permission from the Ascendis Pharma HR team—specifically a Talent Acquisition Partner or Human Resources Director—is not allowed. If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged.

jobs.description:
**Market Director Health and Public Institutions – Buildings & Industry

**__**Lyngby or Aarhus, Odense or Vejle

**_

_**Do you want to help shape some of Denmark's and the Nordic region's most important healthcare, education and public building projects? Can you build trusted relationships with key clients, grow business opportunities, and lead complex pursuits in a market with significant societal impact? And do you combine solid commercial acumen with deep insight into the health and public institutions sector? Then join COWI as our new Market Director for Health & Public Institutions within Buildings & Industry and apply your knowledge and curiosity to enable a better tomorrow.

**_

_**Shape the future of healthcare and public buildings

**_To strengthen COWI’s customer-centric approach, we are looking for a Market Director to drive business development and coordinate sales efforts within Health & Public Institutions in our Buildings & Industry sector.

This is a key role in one of COWI’s strategic growth markets, covering healthcare, education, research, cultural facilities and public development projects across Denmark and the Nordics. You will help position COWI on major hospital developments, universities, public institutions, refurbishment programmes and other complex projects that contribute to the development of society.

What makes this role unique is its pure focus on market leadership, where success is defined by customer value, business growth, and a strong market presence. Working closely with specialists, project managers and technical experts, you will build relationships, identify opportunities and grow COWI’s presence in the market. You will also become part of an experienced business development community that shares best practices and drives commercial excellence across COWI.

As part of a team of 25 experienced market professionals across COWI and Arkitema, you will work at the forefront of our business development efforts. Reporting to the Senior Market Director, you will collaborate closely with colleagues across the organization to deepen client relationships, unlock strategic opportunities, and lead pursuits from early engagement through to project win, contributing directly to the continued growth of our business.

With increasing investments in healthcare, public buildings and sustainable transformation, the market offers significant growth potential. Your sector insight, commercial mindset and customer understanding will help position COWI as a preferred partner for public clients and healthcare organisations across the Nordic region.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Grow business development and growth across the Health & Public Institutions market segment by identifying, prioritizing, and converting strategic opportunities.

• Build and maintain close relationships with key customers, partners, and decisionmakers, acting as a trusted advisor and Key Account Manager for selected clients.

• Develop and manage a healthy sales pipeline, manage Go/No-Go decisions, and drive capture planning for major pursuits and tenders.

Lead and support complex proposal processes, ensuring compelling value propositions and effective collaboration across disciplines and business units.

• Provide direction and coordination for the Business Development team supporting the market segment, ensuring effective collaboration and delivery of market priorities.

• Monitor market trends, upcoming investments, and customer needs to help shape market strategies and long-term growth initiatives.

• Represent COWI externally through customer meetings, industry networks, conferences, and strategic partnerships.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**Like us, you believe that successful business development is built on trust, collaboration and long-term relationships. You are motivated by creating opportunities, understanding customer needs and bringing together the best teams to deliver value for clients and society. You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working closely with fellow Market Directors and multidisciplinary teams to achieve shared goals.

To perform well in this role, it is essential that you bring solid market insight and a well-established network within healthcare, public institutions or the built environment sector. Equally important is your ability to build internal alliances and leverage the collective expertise of the organisation rather than acting alone.

On top of that, you will have:

• A relevant educational background such as engineering, architecture, business or a related discipline.

• Extensive experience in business development, client management, or market leadership within healthcare, public institutions, architecture, construction, or engineering consultancy.

• Deep knowledge of public-sector customers, procurement processes, and market dynamics, combined with a well-established professional network.

• Demonstrated skill in building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and converting opportunities into long-term partnerships.

• Experience contributing to large and complex tenders, proposals, and commercial negotiations.

• Demonstrated ability to provide leadership, direction, and coordination across Business Development teams, account managers, and framework agreement holders, ensuring a shared focus on market growth and client development without formal personnel responsibility.

• Solid communication and stakeholder management skills, with professional proficiency in both Danish and English.

**A place to work and so much more

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability and strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices. We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and collaboration – because that is what brings out the best in you, both at work and at home. With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people bringing expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

**Got more questions?

**If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Senior Market Director Mikael Voldborg, Buildings & Industry, at mivo@cowi.com, or Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist, Janne Nielsen, at jane@cowi.com.

Get to know us better on our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we aim to achieve, and what it is like to be part of COWI.

**Before you apply

**All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or cover letter required. Please add a short motivation for the role (4–5 lines) at the top of your CV. When it comes to photos, we prefer to form our first impression face to face rather than from a picture. If relevant, please also attach your portfolio.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI – inclusion is key

**We are committed to creating a respectful and fair working environment where all employees feel a sense of belonging and have equal opportunities to thrive and develop. Our leaders act as role models for inclusive leadership and contribute to a culture where diverse perspectives and professional approaches are seen as a strength. We integrate diversity and inclusion into relevant decisions and processes, and when forming teams across architecture and engineering disciplines. We do this because it is part of our values – and simply because it is the right thing to do.

JOIN US IN COPENHAGEN TO HUMANISE BRANDS, SPARK HAPPINESS AND ORCHESTRATE INTERNATIONAL CLIENT PARTNERSHIPS

The Role: Driving World-Class Brand Development

Everland is looking for a full-time, on-site International Client Director to join our Copenhagen office

and drive the Client Service role for some of our key international client collaborations.

Being part of our Clients Services team, you will have a key role in our client collaborations, working

alongside Strategy, Creative, and Realisation to ensure our partnerships are as operationally

seamless as they are ambitious and impactful.

Your Mission: To Be "On It"

Your success is measured by the health of the relationship and the excellence of the delivery. You are

a high-level orchestrator of complex work streams, with responsibilities including:

• Service Excellence & Responsiveness: Providing the responsiveness that our clients crave. You are the primary point of contact for the ongoing collaboration, soaking up everyday tasks and solving tactical challenges with pragmatic, "can-do" energy.

• Master of Project Management: You take absolute ownership of the project management fundamentals. You lead the full brand and design development lifecycle, from defining initial scopes and meticulous budgeting to resource planning and timeline precision. You are the guardian of the brief and process, ensuring nothing is left out or to chance.

• Driving & Shaping Partnerships: You manage the full spectrum of client needs. This ranges from leading extensive, long-term brand development programmes to flawlessly coordinating the day-to-day tasks that keep a global brand moving.

• Team Integration: Acting as the operational glue within our teams. You bridge the gap between the strategic intent, the creative vision, and the client’s operational reality, ensuring that every project is delivered on time, on budget, and beyond expectation.

• "Beyond the Brief": Acting as the operational "eyes and ears" with your clients. Because you are so close to the daily work, you identify opportunities to create value beyond the initial scope, proactively proposing ways we can help clients solve their next challenge.

Your Profile: ‘Pro’ with International Outlook and Scandinavian Heart

We are looking for a team player who balances a professional "Director-level" weight with a

flat-hierarchy, sleeves-up mindset.

• The Experience: 10+ years of relevant professional experience. This must include at least 5 years of agency-side experience managing international clients within the consumer goods / FMCG industry.

• The Operational Specialist: You are a project manager by trade and a problem-solver by nature. You have the seniority to sit at the table with senior client stakeholders, but you have never lost your love for the "basics" of a perfectly managed workflow.

• The Commercial Driver: Commercially astute and growth-oriented. You possess a deep curiosity about your clients' business realities, allowing you to shape strategic solutions that truly address their needs while proactively identifying and driving organic growth opportunities for Everland.

• The Mindset: Resilient, energetic, and proactive. You don’t just flag problems; you take ownership. You take pride in "owning the machine" and making complex projects feel effortless for the client.

• The Collaborator: You thrive in a flat organisation. You are an empathic and natural team player who values the collective win over individual ego and understands the "One Team" philosophy across our functions and offices.

• The International: Some client-related travel activity (mainly Europe) must be expected, and your professional English must be flawless as this will be the main language in your client communications. As you will be based in Copenhagen, mastering a Scandinavian language is a nice bonus, but by no means a necessity.

Why Everland?

You will have a central role in an agency where we value freedom, responsibility, and the "One Team"

mindset. You will join a culture that plays to win but never forgets to spark happiness and keep it

human. Here, you will have the space to leave your mark on some of the world’s most famous

consumer brands while helping shape the future of our international Client Service approach.

Practical Information

• How to apply: Apply via LinkedIn or email your application and CV to our Head of Client Services, Emilie Aagreen emaa@everlandagency.com

• Deadline: ASAP – we will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis.

• Start date: By agreement.

About Everland

We help Humanise Brands to shape culture and drive sustainable value. Based on our human-centric

approach, we help brands grow with Character and Charisma. In everything they do, and everywhere

they are. Our Scandinavian DNA defines our way of working: an inclusive, direct, and ego-free approach to collaboration — with each other, our clients, and other agency partners alike.

Everland is an international brand and design partner specialised in FMCG brand worlds. We deliver

end-to-end expertise across brand strategy, visual and verbal identity, design realisation, and brand

guardianship.

We are proudly independent, entrepreneurs at heart, and consider ourselves challengers on the

international agency scene. This allows us to stay nimble, focused, and deeply committed to the

brands we nurture.

********Job Description Summary

********The International Clinical Education & Strategy CVUS manager is responsible for defining and executing the clinical education and alignment strategy across regions in close collaboration with internal stakeholders and external partners. The role ensures strong clinical differentiation of the product portfolio through effective education programs, third‑party partnerships, and close alignment with Marketing on competitive positioning to maximize sales effectiveness and win rate. the clinical education manager reports to the CVUS GM International.

**

Le/La Responsable International(e) de la Formation Clinique et de la Stratégie CVUS est chargé(e) de définir et de déployer la stratégie internationale de formation clinique et d’alignement, en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes internes et les partenaires externes.

Ce rôle garantit une forte différenciation clinique du portefeuille produits grâce à des programmes de formation efficaces, des partenariats avec des tiers et un alignement étroit avec le Marketing sur le positionnement concurrentiel, afin de maximiser l’efficacité commerciale et le taux de concrétisation des ventes.

Le/La Responsable de la formation clinique reporte au Directeur Général CVUS International.

****Job Description

******Key Responsibilities

****Clinical Education & International Clinical Management

**

• Define and lead the international clinical education strategy across regions, ensuring consistency, quality, and alignment with business priorities.

• Develop, deploy, and continuously optimize clinical education programs addressing customer needs, care pathways, and evolving clinical practices.

• Coordinate and align regional clinical leaders to ensure consistent execution of clinical education initiatives at international level.

• Monitor clinical education outcomes and leverage insights to improve adoption, customer engagement, and clinical confidence.

**Third‑Party & Industry Partnerships

**

• Establish and manage strategic partnerships with third‑party organizations, including medical device companies, education providers, and clinical institutions.

• Co‑develop joint educational initiatives, clinical programs, and content to enhance clinical credibility and market impact.

• Ensure all partnerships comply with regulatory, ethical, and company standards while delivering measurable value.

**Clinical Alignment with Marketing & Competitive Strategy

**

• Act as the clinical partner to the Marketing Director and Marketing teams to ensure strong clinical alignment in go‑to‑market strategies.

• Lead clinical input into competitive analysis, translating market and competitor insights into clear clinical value propositions.

• Adapt and validate battle cards and competitive tools by integrating clinical arguments aligned to competitive products and customer decision drivers.

• Support the optimization of win rate by ensuring sales teams are equipped with clinically relevant, differentiated, and credible competitive messaging.

**Cross‑Functional Collaboration & Strategy Execution

**

• Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product Management, and R&D to ensure clinical insights are integrated into product positioning, roadmap discussions, and launch strategies.

• Communicate and monitor the execution and alignment of clinical strategies across international regions and zones.

• Provide regular feedback to senior leadership on clinical priorities, competitive landscape, and education performance.

****Qualifications

• Senior profile with an experience in the medical industry

• Experience in ultrasound & Cardiology

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Excellent organizational skills

• Willingness and ability to travel 50% of time

• Valid motor vehicle license

• Experience with interfacing with both internal team members, external customers and industrial group

• Working level English

• Ability to develop and execute multiple priorities and approaches to meet objectives

• Direct customer relationship experience

• Proven ability to effectively communicate across a distributed workforce

**Responsabilités clés

****Formation clinique et management clinique international

**

• Définir et piloter la stratégie internationale de formation clinique à travers les régions, en garantissant la cohérence, la qualité et l’alignement avec les priorités business.

• Développer, déployer et optimiser en continu des programmes de formation clinique répondant aux besoins des clients, aux parcours de soins et à l’évolution des pratiques cliniques.

• Coordonner et aligner les responsables cliniques régionaux afin d’assurer une exécution cohérente des initiatives de formation clinique au niveau international.

• Suivre les résultats des actions de formation clinique et exploiter les retours pour améliorer l’adoption, l’engagement des clients et la confiance clinique.

**Partenariats tiers et partenariats industriels

**

• Établir et gérer des partenariats stratégiques avec des organisations tierces, notamment des fabricants de dispositifs médicaux, des organismes de formation et des institutions cliniques.

• Co‑développer des initiatives éducatives conjointes, des programmes cliniques et des contenus visant à renforcer la crédibilité clinique et l’impact marché.

• S’assurer que tous les partenariats respectent les exigences réglementaires, éthiques et les standards de l’entreprise, tout en générant une valeur mesurable.

**Alignement clinique avec le marketing et la stratégie concurrentielle

**

• Agir en tant que partenaire clinique du/de la Directeur(trice) Marketing et des équipes marketing afin d’assurer un fort alignement clinique des stratégies de mise sur le marché.

• Piloter l’apport clinique aux analyses concurrentielles et traduire les informations marché et concurrentielles en propositions de valeur clinique claires.

• Adapter et valider les battle cards et outils concurrentiels en intégrant des arguments cliniques alignés sur les produits concurrents et les critères de décision des clients.

• Contribuer à l’optimisation du taux de gain en dotant les équipes commerciales de messages concurrentiels cliniquement pertinents, différenciants et crédibles.

**Collaboration transverse et exécution de la stratégie

**

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Ventes, Marketing, Gestion de Produits et R&D afin d’intégrer les retours cliniques dans le positionnement produit, les discussions de roadmap et les stratégies de lancement.

• Communiquer et suivre l’exécution et l’alignement des stratégies cliniques à travers les régions et zones internationales.

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.
