We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

• 
For this role we also consider people located outside of Denmark and provide financial (and moral!) support with visa application and relocation.

• 
We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

• 
Our working language is English.

We offer

• 
Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.

• 
A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.

• 
Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.

• 
A professional development budget to invest in your growth.

• 
Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.

• 
Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

• 
Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).

• 
Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.

• 
Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.

• 
Pension plan and private health insurance.

• 
Endless amounts of Faxe Kondi.

WHAT THE TRIBAND?
Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn't always work out, but we always learn something.
We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games, and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

For more info about Triband, check out: triband.net/about

CHEMICAL ENGINEER

Help us develop cleaner, high-performance braking solutions

Would you like to join the world’s leading supplier of industrial braking solutions? Svendborg Brakes is looking for a skilled and motivated Chemical Engineer to join our Application Department. You will help develop organic brake pads and contribute to cleaner, safer and more reliable braking solutions. You do not need to be a brake-pad expert today, but you should be eager to develop your knowledge in this field.

Key responsibilities 

• Develop new friction materials for a wide range of applications.
• Lead technical discussions with suppliers and customers.
• Evaluate new raw materials and manufacturing processes against friction-performance requirements.
• Identify brake-pad components with a focus on environmental impact and regulatory compliance.
• Document components in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
• Develop test methods for new friction materials in cooperation with Test Center personnel.
• Prepare work instructions and production recipes for brake-pad manufacturing.
• Take a hands-on role in pilot production and support the transfer to full-scale production.
• Prepare reports and statistical analyses of particles and fumes generated during braking-system use.

 Qualifications 

• A degree in chemical engineering, chemistry, materials science or a related field.
• Experience with material formulation is an advantage.
• Knowledge of rubber technology, plastics and inorganic materials.
• Knowledge of hazardous and restricted chemicals, including REACH requirements.
• Experience with product and environmental documentation, such as safety data sheets, is an advantage.
• Knowledge of good laboratory practice.
• Experience working within an ISO- or TS-based quality management system.
• Fluent spoken and written English. Danish or another language is an advantage.

 Personal qualities 

• Positive, persistent and open-minded.
• Proactive and able to turn ideas into action.
• Professional and comfortable working with colleagues at all levels of the organization.
• Practical, curious and motivated by technical problem-solving.

 What we offer 

• An exciting and independent role with varied responsibilities and testing activities in our expanded Test Center.
• An informal and collaborative working environment with strong opportunities for knowledge sharing.
• Good opportunities for personal and professional development.
• A competitive salary based on qualifications, pension, health insurance and an attractive canteen scheme.

 Interested? 

For further information, please contact Head of Test Center, Esben Rasmussen by telephone on +45 63 25 54 93.

If this position interests you, please submit your application and detailed CV through the application link as soon as possible.

Learn more at www.svendborg-brakes.com.

 Svendborg Brakes creates high growth for both customers and us by innovating, testing and delivering world-class braking solutions. We are value driven and customer focused, and we continuously strive for superior and unmatched quality in design, products, testing, certification and services. This makes us Global Leading Experts and the preferred and trusted provider in the field of intelligent braking solutions. Part of the Regal Rexnord Group www.regalrexnord.com.

Would you like to use data and technology to solve real challenges in logistics? Are you curious about Power BI, Power Apps, automation, simulation, or coding and motivated to see your work used in daily operations? Join our Digital Development team and gain practical experience creating solutions that support Arla’s warehouses, distribution activities, and dairies.

How will you make an impact

As a Student Assistant in Digital Development, you will help turn operational needs into practical, user-friendly digital solutions. Working closely with colleagues in warehouses, distribution, and dairies, you will contribute throughout the development journey; from understanding a challenge and creating a prototype to testing, implementation, documentation, and further improvement.

You will:

• Develop and improve Power BI reports, dashboards, and decision-support tools.

• Help build Power Apps and Power Automate solutions that simplify processes and reduce repetitive manual work.

• Support simulations, digital models, and prototypes that allow the team to test ideas before wider implementation.

• Use data, coding, and scripting to transform information, connect systems, and add useful functionality.

• Gather input from users, translate operational challenges into clear requirements, and test solutions with the people who will use them.

• Assist with maintaining, documenting, and continuously improving existing digital solutions.

• Be part of a small, dedicated team where your contributions truly make an impact.

This role is ideal for a student who enjoys experimenting with technology, solving practical problems, and developing ideas into tools that colleagues can use in their daily work. You are not expected to know every technology from day one; technical curiosity, initiative, and willingness to learn are equally important.

What will make you successful

You are someone who is passionate about turning data and technology into practical tools that make a real difference for our operations. You think beyond reporting -  you focus on what decisions colleagues need to take, and how digital products can help them act earlier, faster, and smarter.

You thrive in the space between business and technology, where you translate operational challenges into intuitive, proactive, decision‑support solutions. You enjoy working with data, but you get most energy from seeing your tools in the hands of users and watching them improve the day‑to‑day execution.

To succeed in this role, you:

• Are currently enrolled in a relevant bachelor’s or master’s programme within areas such as IT, software development, data science, engineering, business intelligence, supply chain, logistics, or a comparable field.

• Expect to have at least one year remaining of your studies.

• Have some exposure to (or the motivation to learn):  o Power BI, data modelling, and visualising operational information. o Power Apps, Power Automate, or similar low-code technologies. o SQL, databases, APIs, and data integration. o Programming, scripting, automation, or simulation.

• Designing intuitive digital tools for technical and non-technical users.

• Have an interest in, or willingness to learn about, improvement methodologies such as Lean, Agile, or other continuous-improvement frameworks.

• Are curious, structured, and able to break down problems into clear digital requirements.

• Communicate clearly with both technical and non‑technical teams and enjoy gathering user input

• Are comfortable asking questions and constructively challenging assumptions while learning from experienced colleagues.

• Communicate clearly in Danish and English and can work approximately 15 hours per week, with flexibility around exams and your studies.

And personally, you:

• Bring a proactive, learning‑oriented mindset.

• Ask the right questions and aren’t afraid to challenge “how we’ve always done it”.

• Enjoy iterating, testing, and improving digital tools with users.

• Want to see your work used in real operations, not just sitting in a report.

What do we offer?

You will gain hands-on experience developing digital solutions with visible impact on daily operations.  We offer close collaboration with operational users, opportunities to follow ideas from early concept through implementation, room to contribute your own perspectives, and professional development. The role is planned flexibly around your studies and gives you access to Arla’s student community.

We have a purpose for Good

At Arla, we strive to unlock the highest potential in each other while working together to create a sustainable future of dairy. We call it Stronger People Stronger Planet and it is deeply anchored in our organization and founded on our commitment to respecting human rights, increasing access to healthy dairy nutrition, inspiring good food habits, and improving the environment for future generations. In order to succeed, we need to hire people with a sustainable mindset. Could this be you?

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

jobs.occupation: Technical Solution Designer - Clinical Trial Mgmt & Clinical Trial Supply in IT
jobs.description:
Are you a Technical Solution Designer with deep understanding of Clinical Trial Management and Clinical Trial Supply? Do you think holistically, act with ambition, and find technical solutions to accelerate clinical trial oversight?

Can you design and implement configurations for SaaS applications to support trials?

If so, you may be our new T_echnical Solution Designer._

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference for patients. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we apply our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Denmark, research facilities in Germany, and offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in rare endocrine diseases, including hypoparathyroidism and growth disorders. We also collaborate with strategic partners to develop TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

Our context

This position is based in our Global IT organization. In Global IT, we have spent the past five years building and maturing a product-driven organization. We operate with a strong focus on product management and lifecycle thinking, where long-lived teams take full ownership- from problem discovery to solution delivery and continuous improvement - ensuring we address real business needs.

Our structure combines clear leadership intent with empowered teams: each team member is supported by both a People Leader focused on development and a Functional Leader guiding strategy and delivery. We foster autonomy and self-organization to enable fast flow, clear accountability, and minimal dependencies.

The Clinical domain currently consists of three product teams and a data team, supporting our Clinical Operations, Clinical Development, Biometrics, Clinical Data Management and Clinical Trial Supply functions.

We are seeking a passionate Technical Solution Designer who will be responsible for designing and implementing technical solutions to support CTM and CTS. Practically speaking, you will be the technical expert in how our CTMS, eTMF, and IRT are configured. All of these are SaaS solutions. When our SaaS solutions fall short, you will find ways to deliver functionality in collaboration with our Automation, Integration, AI and Analytics teams.

Together with the IT product team, you will ensure that the solutions, including the documentation packages we deliver, are GxP compliant and sustainable.

You will report to Simon Rønne Kümmel, Clinical Domain Lead, and Jakob Thrane, People Leader. You will be based in Hellerup, Denmark.

Your key responsibilities will be to

• Design and implement technical configuration and solutions to support CTM and CTS.

• Engage with stakeholders to understand business needs.

• Either implement the configurations yourself, or work with the managed services provider or vendor to implement the configuration.

• Oversee system support and act as escalation point for tickets.

• Assist with documentation and validation of solutions.

• Be visionary in improving our CTM and CTS supply technical capabilities and suggest and implement improvements for automation, integration and seamless data flows.

• Ensure systems are in a validated state and are inspection-ready.

• Maintain operational oversight over vendors.

Qualifications and experience

You hold a relevant academic degree – preferably a Master’s degree, with a background as an Engineer, Technical Business Analyst, Configuration Manager or an equivalent technical role.

You have solid experience with eTMF and CTMS in a GxP context, minimum +3 years of relevant experience across complex organizations.

Furthermore, you have:

• Strong understanding of Clinical Trial Management and Clinical Trial Supply and related systems.

• Experience working with SaaS vendors.

• Ability to connect people and create shared understanding and direction.

• Is good at collaborating with business in complex and ambiguous settings, handling conflicts constructively and helps groups move forward.

Key competencies:

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

To succeed in this role, we also expect you to be good at collaborating with business in complex and ambiguous settings, handling conflicts constructively, and helping groups move forward.

What we offer

We offer an exciting and challenging position in an entrepreneurial and international company with short decision paths. You will work with highly skilled colleagues and play a key role in shaping how Global IT delivers sustainable value to Ascendis Pharma and, ultimately, to patients.

Travel: 10-15 days per year

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, 2900 Hellerup

Flexibility: Some of the Clinicial organization is located in the US, and meetings in the afternoon and evening will occur.

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the position or the company, please contact Jakob Monajemzadeh Thrane, People Leader, jmt@ascendispharma.com.

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website,

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

As the summer holiday period approaches, you may experience a longer response time than usual. We truly appreciate your patience and thank you for your understanding. We look forward to reviewing your application as soon as possible.

A note to recruiters:

We do not allow external search party solicitation. Presentation of candidates without written permission from the Ascendis Pharma HR team (specifically from: Talent Acquisition Partner or Human Resources Director) is not allowed. If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged.

Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure investments? If so, CIP Fund Solutions is looking for an Associate to join our skilled and dedicated Valuation team in Copenhagen.

The team

The Valuation team is responsible for financial modelling, valuation framework, applied valuations, and supporting investment decisions through business case reviews with reporting to senior management.

The role

You will be responsible for handling and developing the valuation methodologies applied across CIP funds, working with corporate and regional teams to enhance your financial and valuation skills in a varied portfolio of renewable investments.

As part of the final investment decision process, you will be responsible for engaging with the investment teams, providing detailed financial model assumption reviews to ensure consistent and well-documented business cases, and being accountable for delivering key inputs such as discount rate assumptions to become a trusted business partner, supporting our global investment strategy for the investments and funds managed by CIP.

Furthermore, you will participate in ad hoc analyses on, e.g., power markets, hedging strategy, currency swaps, and other financial products.

Responsibilities will consist of, but are not limited to:

• Develop internal valuation methodologies for new types of investments

• Advising the business on valuation issues and methodologies and maintaining CIP’s valuation framework in collaboration with senior stakeholders

• Participating in various ad hoc financial analyses related to, e.g., financial hedging, benchmarking, factor analysis, mean-variance analysis, risk mitigation, etc.

• Developing and reviewing financial models to ensure consistent implementation of best practices

• Participating in the FID process for new assets by conducting assumption review of underlying business cases

• Preparing and coordinating analysis and communication material for decision-makers at the senior management level

You

The ideal candidate holds a university degree in economics, finance, or a similar field and approximately one year of experience in financial analysis and valuation, with solid skills from private equity firms, top consulting firms, or multinationals, ideally within renewables.

You have a very strong theoretical understanding of complex valuation methodologies and can present complex financial and valuation methods simply and clearly to CIP's senior management.

We look for the following in a candidate:

• The ability to navigate and thrive in a high-intensity environment

• Well-developed interpersonal and communication skills

• Hands-on experience using AI tools to enhance analysis and modelling, with the judgment to verify outputs and protect confidential information

• Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills

• Used to working in an international setting

• Fluent in English

The process

Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

---

CIP Fund Solutions’ commitment to diversity and inclusion

CIP Fund Solutions is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.

A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.

CIP Fund Solutions

CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy-period - supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M&A.

For more information, please visit CIP Fund Solutions.

Transaction Banking is changing fast, and the way customers connect with their bank is becoming more sophisticated. Danske Bank is bringing its Customer Implementation and Integration areas together under one unit, and we are looking for a leader who can create a shared direction, build a strong leadership team, and make complex customer journeys simpler and more consistent across five markets.

What you will be doing

You will lead a newly unified organisation spanning Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland and Lithuania, bringing together experienced leaders, specialist teams and distinct capabilities. Reporting directly to the Head of TxB Sales Enablement, you will work closely with colleagues across Sales, Product, Technology, IT and Tribe organisations to shape end-to-end customer experiences. Your role sits at the intersection of business, operations and technology, and the decisions you make will shape how corporate customers and financial institutions connect with Danske Bank.

More specifically, you will:

• Set the strategic direction and priorities across all five markets

• Build and develop a leadership team grounded in clarity, empowerment and accountability

• Connect Customer Implementation and Integration to create more seamless customer journeys

• Partner with IT and Tribe teams to shape customer-facing solutions and internal tooling

• Use client insights to inform implementation journeys, integration solutions and commercial priorities

• Encourage the responsible adoption of AI to simplify processes and build employee capabilities

About you

• Solid experience leading organisations through other leaders

• Genuine commitment to developing people, teams and leadership cultures

• Ability to create direction across countries or complex organisational structures

• Skilled at translating strategy into clear priorities and tangible outcomes

• Strong customer and commercial orientation

• Comfortable at the intersection of business, operations and technology

• Able to bring structure and clarity to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder situations

You do not need to come from a traditional banking background. Experience from financial services, consulting, technology, transformation, customer implementation, integrations, APIs, cash management or similar environments is equally relevant and welcome.

What we offer you

This is a rare opportunity to shape a newly formed organisation and leave a lasting mark on how Danske Bank delivers for its customers. You will work in a hybrid model, typically three to four days per week in the office, alongside talented colleagues across multiple markets. We invest in our leaders and offer genuine scope to grow, both in the role and across the wider organisation.

Are you ready for the next step?

If this sounds like the right move for you, we encourage you to apply. You are also welcome to reach out to Natasha Rajovic, Head of TxB Sales Enablement, at nkuz@danskebank.dk with any questions before applying.

Location: Aarhus or Copenhagen.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Are you eager to influence the future direction of Arla Foods? Do you envision yourself as a future leader?

How will you make an impact?

The Arla F15 Graduate Programme is a two-year, international development programme designed for graduates who want to learn quickly, explore different areas of a global business and grow into future leadership opportunities.`

Through three eight-month rotations, you will work on meaningful business projects, build an international network and develop the confidence, skills and experience to make an impact at Arla. Business areas for projects may include Marketing, Sales, HR, Strategy, Sustainability, Business Development, and Supply Chain. We will match you with a suitable department based on business needs and your profile, offering you the chance to learn and make a difference. Your F15 Graduate journey begins on 1st September 2027.

• First rotation (8 months - Aarhus, Denmark) Based at one of our offices in Aarhus you will be assigned a strategically important project somewhere in the business.

• Second rotation (8 months - Outside Denmark) You will have more influence over your second project assignment, which will give you the opportunity to continue growing in a meaningful way whilst adding real value to Arla.

• Third rotation (8 months - Any Arla market) You will collaborate with the business to source potential high impact projects for your third rotation. You will have the most influence over projects during your final rotation.

What will make you a successful F15 Graduate?

To apply for the F15 Graduate Programme, please ensure that you meet the following criteria

• You should either be in the process of completing, or have completed, a bachelor’s or master’s degree between September 2025 and September 2027. We welcome diverse educational backgrounds but seek candidates with a strong drive towards a business-focused career.

• International experience gained from working, studying or volunteering abroad is an advantage.

• Preferably at least one year of relevant work experience from student jobs or a minimum of six months of internship experience.

• You are globally mobile and willing to go on one or two rotations abroad during the two-year programme. As your first rotation is based in Aarhus, Denmark you will need to relocate unless you already reside in the local area. Arla Foods will support you with this relocation.

This programme will suit graduates who have leadership aspirations and an ambitious mindset, which combines strategic thinking with a passion for results. A global mindset is essential, as is the ability to build positive relationships and strong influencing skills. The ideal candidate should be curious, competitive, and open to change, demonstrating resilience, while also being humble, self-aware, and open to feedback.

Throughout the rotations you will receive a variety of development opportunities every step of the way. To ensure your professional and personal development, you will benefit from

• Responsibilities from day one, enabling on-the-job learning in three different areas

• Graduate development camps, taking place in different markets with your graduate colleagues

• One-to-one mentoring and sparring from senior leaders

• Be part of a supportive graduate community across all Arla Futures programmes

Important information before applying

The application period for the F15 Graduate Programme runs from 2nd November 2026 until 23.59 CET on 3rd January 2027. Before applying, please ensure you have prepared your CV and cover letter in English. You will be asked a series of questions on the application page, so we recommend that you start the application process from a computer instead of a mobile phone.

For additional information, read more about the F15 Graduate Programme on our website. Here, you can get inspiration from some of our previous and current F15s and learn more about the programme. You can also read more about what to expect from the recruitment process.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

Are you interested in shaping your career in Finance within a global company? Join Arla Foods as a Finance Graduate in Denmark, Sweden, or Germany, where you will develop your skills, gain international experience, and drive business impact. As part of a dynamic Finance organisation, you'll contribute to sustainability efforts and help shape the future of Finance using cutting-edge digital technologies and data.

About our Finance Graduate Programme

The Finance Graduate Programme is a 2-year programme consisting of three rotations across our global Finance organisation. You'll enhance your core finance skills and develop essential competencies in Business & Performance, Data & Digital, and Strategy & Execution. Throughout the programme, you will be exposed to key finance disciplines while developing your strategic, personal, and professional skills to ensure you have the capabilities needed to succeed in the future of Finance.

We are looking for graduates to join in Denmark, Sweden, and Germany, and as part of the programme, you will have a 6-month rotation abroad in one of our European offices. Your Finance Graduate journey begins on 1st September 2027, where you will be hired on a permanent employment contract from day one and will continue your career within Finance in Arla Foods after finishing the 2-year graduate programme.

How will you make an impact as a Finance Graduate?

As a Finance Graduate, you will be a part of a highly competent Finance organisation contributing to both daily operations and cross-functional projects to drive the business forward. You will get your own areas of responsibility, enabling on-the-job learning, and you will get to explore the following areas within Finance:

• Business & Performance (12 months – home country): You will apply analytical skills to provide guidance for decision-makers and develop a strong understanding of financial performance through analysis and modeling, while enhancing your ability to influence others

• Data & Digital (6 months – home country or abroad): You will leverage data to generate insights, grow advanced analytics and visualization skills, and apply digital technology to automate and optimize tasks for efficiency

• Strategy & Execution (6 months – home country or abroad): You will build and communicate business cases for investments, engage in problem solving and stakeholder management, and use finance to drive business growth and create value

What will make you a successful Finance Graduate?

To apply for the Finance Graduate Programme, please ensure that you can tick off the following boxes:

• Hold a bachelor's or master's degree from a university by September 2027 or have graduated within the last 2 years. We are open to various educational backgrounds, so what truly matters is your interest in Finance and curious mindset

• Minimum 1 year of relevant experience from work and/or extracurricular activities

• Being professionally fluent in English

• Currently residing in, or willing to relocate to, either Denmark, Sweden or Germany, and being internationally mobile for at least 6 months as part of the programme

In addition, we are looking for graduates who:

• Lead with confidence, make independent decisions, are results-oriented while valuing the journey to achieve those outcomes

• Build positive relationships with a collaborative mindset and are open to feedback

• Communicate complex information clearly and effectively

• Demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to learn and explore

• Use an analytical and structured approach to problem-solving with a proactive attitude

Why join Arla’s Finance Graduate Programme?

As part of our Finance Graduate Programme, you will receive a variety of development opportunities every step of the way. To ensure your professional and personal development, you will benefit from:

• Responsibilities from day one enabling on-the-job learning in three different areas

• Graduate development camps, taking place in different markets with your graduate colleagues

• One-to-one mentoring and sparring from senior leaders

• Supportive graduate community across our graduate programmes

Important information before application

The application period for the Finance Graduate Programme runs from November 2nd 2026 to January 3rd 2027. Before applying, please make sure that you have already prepared your CV and cover letter in English. You will be asked different questions on the application page, thus we recommend that you start the application process from a computer instead of a mobile phone or tablet.

For additional information, read more about the Finance Graduate Programme on our website. Here, you can get inspiration from some of our previous and current graduates and learn more about the programme. You can also read more about what to expect from the recruitment process.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

jobs.occupation: Manager – Bespoke Software Development & Adjacent Markets team
jobs.description:
Manager – Bespoke Software Development & Adjacent Markets team

Bring your software development expertise and leadership together in a role where people, technology and delivery meet. Lead a team across Aarhus and Warsaw, turn customer needs into customer-tailored Bespoke software solutions and connect Defence expertise with opportunities across Systematic. Along the way, help your team grow and shape AI adoption in developing software.

Your role: Drive software delivery and develop your team

As Manager in the SitaWare Extensions program, you will report to the Senior Director and lead one of the Defence Bespoke Development teams alongside the Adjacent Markets service function.

Your main focus will be delivering customer-tailored Bespoke software solutions that extends SitaWare Headquarters, Frontline and Edge – from software add-ons to system, tactical radio and military equipment integrations. You will take ownership of delivery on schedule, within budget and to the agreed quality. Alongside this, you will act as Project Manager for non-Defence business units in Systematic connecting them with Defence expertise, coordinating and delivering the services they need.

You can look forward to:

• Managing and driving software projects forward by setting priorities, aligning capacity and schedules, tracking progress and budgets, and managing stakeholders, risks and issues

• Developing your team across Aarhus and Warsaw through 1:1s, development talks, creating opportunities for professional and personal growth and recruitment

• Contributing your team's expertise to Defence bids for Bespoke software and representing Defence services in bids across other business units

• Building strong internal partnerships and coordinating communication on SitaWare releases, change requests, defect handling and hotfixes

• Shaping better ways of working, from processes and guides to the use of AI and agentic AI throughout the software development life cycle

You should expect 5–15 travel days a year.

Your team: Bringing SitaWare expertise together

You will lead 8–10 software architects, software engineers and test engineers across Aarhus and Warsaw, including interns and student workers, with a team lead already in place in Warsaw.

You will be part of a wider international network of colleagues across Defence Services, Product Development and other Systematic business units. The Adjacent Markets function draws on specialist expertise from other teams as needed, giving you a broad technical network and connections across the organisation.

You bring: Technical depth, people leadership and the drive to deliver

You combine a solid foundation in software development and architecture with experience guiding projects and leading people. Over several years as a project manager or software engineering manager, you have delivered medium to complex software projects or commercial off-the-shelf software products. You also bring some years of people management experience, an understanding of commercial customer contracts and experience providing services to other business units.

We are also looking for:

• A master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, software design and architecture, data science or cybersecurity, or equivalent

• Experience with system integration software, preferably within Defence, Maritime, Energy/Utilities, Transportation/Logistics or Healthcare, and with AI and agentic AI in the software development life cycle

• Confidence using Jira, D365 Project Management, Confluence and the Microsoft Office suite, including SharePoint, to support planning, collaboration and reporting

• Hands-on experience with technologies such as Java, C#, Angular, Docker, Git, deployment pipelines or cloud platforms is an advantage, along with any Defence domain knowledge from industry or the military

• Fluent English and the ability to bring clarity to technical discussions and collaboration across teams

• A proactive, decisive approach with strong ownership and follow-through, combined with the ability to motivate and involve people, put customers first, embrace change and communicate clearly with stakeholders at every level

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables and even our own padel court. jobs.occupation: 171819 Clinical Associate Professor (Research) of Paediatrics (Fixed-term, 5 years)
jobs.description:
Clinical Associate Professor (Research) of Paediatrics (Fixed-term, 5 years)

  Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
 University of Copenhagen

   

  The University seeks to appoint a clinical associate professor (research) of Paediatrics to the Department of Clinical Medicine to commence as soon as possible.

  The clinical research professorship (research) is combined with a clinical position at Zealand University Hospital, Department of Paediatric and Adolescent Medicine.

  It is a requirement for appointment that the applicant is accepted for both the clinical associate professorship (research) and the clinical position. In order to be considered the applicant must send an application to both the Faculty (the clinical associate professorship (research)) and to the hospital (the clinical position) cf. the simultaneously advertised clinical position. This also applies to applicants who are already employed at the Hospital. Applicants should only apply for a clinical position at one of the hospitals. The advertisement for the clinical position is available from 

  Sundhedsjobs.dk - Clinical position as staff specialist combined with a clinical associate professorship (research) in Paediatrics- Børn og Unge, Sjællands Universitetshospital

  Information on the Department of Clinical Medicine, University of Copenhagen can be found at: Institut for Klinisk Medicin – Københavns Universitet

  Job description

  The clinical associate professors’ (research) duties will primarily consist of:

   	
• Research - Conduct and lead research on the development, treatment, and outcomes of diabetes in children and adolescents. The research is anchored in the Clinical Research Unit, Department of Paediatric and Adolescent Medicine, and carried out in collaboration with departments at Zealand University Hospital, other hospitals, and regional and national research partners. Responsibilities include dissemination of research findings through peer-reviewed publications, presentations, and other academic activities. 	
• Research-based teaching – Deliver pregraduate teaching and examinations as part of the Clinical Course in Paediatrics for medical students, including lectures and student-centred learning activities such as tutorials. Supervise bachelor’s, master’s, and PhD students, and contribute to teaching within the mandatory Research Training Programme for Doctors in Specialist Training. 	
• Research leadership - Co-leadership of the Clinical Research Unit in the Department of Paediatric and Adolescent Medicine. Conduct independent research and development activities, and provide academic leadership, mentorship, and supervision for early-career researchers. 	
• Obligation to share knowledge with the rest of society – Contribute to the dissemination of scientific knowledge to healthcare professionals, patients, policymakers, and the wider public. 	
• Academic assessments – Participation in academic assessment and evaluation activities as a member of the assessor group within the Department of Clinical Medicine.   The division between the different tasks may vary over the 5-year period of employment. Teaching obligations are equivalent to a previous external clinical associate professorship rate B.

  Any current employment as clinical associate professor (rate A, B or rate C) will expire if the applicant is employed as a clinical associate professor (research).

  Required qualifications 

  The qualification requirement for the clinical associate professor (research) is a master’s degree in medicine, specialist status as well as further teaching and research qualifications, for example PhD or doctorate and subsequently documented scientific production on an international level. In addition, there will be an emphasis on experience with scientific guidance, research administration and international research collaboration.

  The clinical associate professors (research) are also required to possess good interpersonal and communicative skills.

  Terms of employment

  A clinical associate professor (research) is paid in accordance with Aftale om kliniske lektorer af 11. februar 2024 mellem Uddannelses- og Forskningsministeriet, Foreningen af Speciallæger og Yngre Læger, Cirkulære om aftale om kliniske lektorer ved universiteter under Uddannelses- og Forskningsministeriet

  Salary and other terms and conditions of appointment are set in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and Akademikerne (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant professional organisations. The position is covered by the current Ministerial Order on the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

  Questions

  For further information please contact Deputy Head of Department of Clinical Medicine, Professor Lone Baandrup, lone.baandrup@regionh.dk 

  Foreign applicants may find this link useful: For international researchers at the University of Copenhagen – University of Copenhagen

  Application

  The application must be submitted in English and must include the following:

   	
• Application (Including motivations for applying for this position (Maximum 2 pages)) 	
• Curriculum vitae (Including information about external funding) 	
• A complete list of publications 	
• List of 5 publications to be considered in the assessment (Please note that we do not you to upload a copy of the 5 publications) 	
• Diplomas (Master’s and PhD and other relevant certificates) 	
• Self-declaration form (https://ikm.ku.dk/ansat/ansaettelser/dokumenter/self-declaration-form-klf.docx) 	
• Teaching portfolio (https://ikm.ku.dk/ansat/ansaettelser/dokumenter/template-teaching-portfolio.docx (English) or https://ikm.ku.dk/ansat/ansaettelser/dokumenter/skabelon-undervisningsportfolio.doc (Danish)) 	
• Research plan (3‐5 pages) 	
• Teaching plan   Application procedure 

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Appointments Committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment. The head of department  appoints an expert assessment committee in order to make an assessment of the selected applicants for the specific post. Selected applicants are notified of the composition of the committee and each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at jobportal.ku.dk.

  Please note that the applicant will be contacted if the assessment committee requires further documentation.

  The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

  The University of Copenhagen encourages all interested applicants to apply for this position.

  Please submit the application with the required attachments. Only online applications will be accepted. The closing date for applications is 23.59pm, Monday 30 November 2026.

  Interviews for this position will most likely be held in the month of March 2027.

The product and the direction

Today we sell chat. Email is rolling out now, and phone and social follow. On top of that we are building the brain: a system that brings together every signal about a webshop and its customers, understands why people buy, and why they do not, and acts on it while the buyer is still on the page. The effect is measured against a control group, so the shop can see what it means for revenue.

That moves the sale from a customer service tool to a conversation about growth, and revenue per customer can become several times what it is today.

The role

Ownership of the entire go-to-market in one place: lead generation, new business, partners and existing customers. You run the process from first contact to signature, find out what works and write the sales process the rest of the company will follow.

The partner channel has to be built. Agencies and platform partners need to be found, judged realistically and sold alongside until they can do it on their own.

Growth in the existing customer base is part of it, especially as email, phone and the brain roll out, measured against clear monthly and quarterly targets.

Price, pitch, customer profile and process are yours. They change when they do not work, and the team is built as the numbers allow. Denmark is home turf, but we already have customers and partners in DACH and the Netherlands, and those markets grow from here.

Senior Gameplay Programmer on WHAT THE CAR?

Do you love working in small, creative teams turning wild ideas into a reality? What about having creative and technical ownership from ideation through to release? Read on!

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

WHAT THE CAR? is our absurdly silly racing adventure game which addresses fundamental questions such as… What if a car had legs? Or a jetpack? Or secretly identified as a sailboat? First launched in 2023 on Apple Arcade and now also on Steam, it has gained a steady following of dedicated fans who have contributed hundreds of thousands of community-built levels.

We’re looking for a Senior Gameplay Programmer to help us continue to build upon CAR’s success by expanding upon its absurdly silly universe! We believe the best people to come up with ideas are the ones implementing them, so we expect a high degree of creativity and game design knowledge from our Gameplay Programmers, in addition to their crazy tech skills. This role involves around 60% programming and 40% game design.

Here’s what that looks like day to day

• 
Build and ship gameplay code. You’ll implement features end-to-end in an existing Unity/C# codebase and ship regularly in a live environment.

• 
Generate design ideas. You’ll take part in shaping features, articulate intent, evaluate tradeoffs, and iterate through discussion with the team.

• 
Keep the game healthy. Fix bugs, improve systems, review test videos, and document findings so issues don’t come back to haunt us.

• 
Extend and refine what’s there. You’ll build on existing mechanics, making them more robust and enjoyable for players.

• 
Support and collaborate. You’re part of a small, closely knit, cross discipline team where people help each other reach their goals.

• 
Prototype and let go. Not everything ships, and that’s fine. Comfort with iteration and refactoring is part of the job.

You’re a great match if

• 
You have 8+ years of commercial game development experience, having shipped at least two games as part of a team

• 
You have strong Unity and C# skills. You’re comfortable navigating a shared codebase and writing maintainable code you’d be proud to hand off

• 
You care about stability, performance, and long-term maintainability, and you leave systems better than you found them

• 
You genuinely value collaboration and working very closely with every member of the team

• 
You approach other people’s ideas with openness and try to understand the intention before giving feedback or pushing back

Nice to have

• Experience working on live games

Requirements for any job at Triband

• 
You thrive in taking ownership - you spot problems, design and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

• 
You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness, and creativity, and you actively contribute to sustaining that culture

• 
You value a positive work environment

• 
You contribute to making the studio a fun and supportive place

Practicalities

• 
Primarily work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen

• 
Only open to candidates who are already eligible to work in Denmark as we don’t offer relocation support or visa sponsorship for this role

• 
37-hour work week, with flexible work hours

• 
No crunch, we put people before deadlines

• 
Our working language is English

We offer

• 
Silly but ambitious projects

• 
The chance to contribute to great games that reach millions of players

• 
A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged

• 
Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games

• 
A professional development budget to invest in your growth

• 
Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights and team events

• 
Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

• 
Six weeks of paid vacation

• 
Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement

• 
Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked

• 
Pension plan and private health insurance

• 
Endless amounts of coffee

WHAT THE TRIBAND?

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 50 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn’t always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games - and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

For more info about Triband, check out: triband.net/about

**Business Consultant - AECO Technical Advisory

**Position Overview

**Autodesk Consulting is looking for a Business Consultant to join our Northern Europe team. This remote role supports strategic customers across the region.

This is a senior individual contributor role combining business consulting, AECO industry expertise and executive advisory. You’ll work with some of Autodesk’s largest customers to shape transformation strategies, define target operating models, and develop business cases and roadmaps that deliver measurable business outcomes.

You’ll advise senior leaders, structure complex business challenges and lead strategic advisory engagements from discovery through executive decision-making. While you won’t configure or implement solutions, you’ll understand how Autodesk and complementary technologies fit within customers’ broader business and technology ecosystems, partnering with technical specialists to turn strategy into actionable delivery plans.

**Main Responsibilities

**

• Build trusted relationships with customer executives, business leaders and transformation teams, acting as a strategic advisor throughout the engagement

• Understand customer objectives, challenges and operating context to define outcome-driven transformation strategies

• Assess operating models, business processes, organizational capabilities, data and digital workflows to identify opportunities for improvement

• Define target-state operating models, transformation roadmaps, business cases, success measures and benefits realization plans

• Lead executive workshops, facilitate decision-making and align stakeholders across complex organizations

• Advise customers on how Autodesk and complementary AECO technologies support business outcomes through effective workflows, data management and interoperability

• Identify and prioritize opportunities for data, automation and AI based on business value, organizational readiness, governance and adoption

• Partner with Solution Architects, technical consultants and customer-facing teams to shape advisory engagements, validate strategic recommendations and develop credible delivery roadmaps

**Minimum Qualifications

**

• Substantial experience in AECO, management consulting or business transformation, with a proven track record of independently leading complex strategy and transformation engagements

• Deep expertise in at least one of the following: construction, infrastructure, engineering consultancy, utilities, or a closely related project-based, asset-intensive industry

• Strong working knowledge of Autodesk technologies or comparable AECO tool ecosystems, with the ability to discuss capabilities, workflow fit, data, interoperability and business value. Hands-on implementation expertise is not required

• Strong understanding of operating models, organizational change, governance, business cases and benefits realization

• Practical understanding of data-centric workflows, enterprise systems, automation, responsible AI and technology adoption

• Ability to lead through influence across cross-functional and international teams, with excellent communication and executive presentation skills

• Fluent English is required. Dutch and other European languages are highly valued

• Willingness to travel to customer meetings and Autodesk events across Northern Europe (up to 50%)

• Proven experience advising executives, structuring complex problems, facilitating high-stakes workshops and driving decisions

Salesforce Solution Architect

Hybrid (minimum of 2-3 days a week from the office)

**Shape the Future of Privacy

**Usercentrics is a global leader in data privacy and privacy-led marketing solutions. We believe there is no need for a trade-off between growth and privacy compliance. Our vision is to unlock the potential of data privacy to empower a thriving digital ecosystem. We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise. Our customers build trust with their users through improved transparency and control to drastically improve marketing and monetization, while achieving full privacy compliance.

About the Role

Our GTM organization is at an inflection point after reaching more than €100M ARR in 2025. As we scale, our Salesforce ecosystem needs to evolve from a system of record into a true platform for growth – flexible, well-governed and built to support increasingly complex go-to-market motions. You'll be responsible for the technical architecture and long-term health of our Salesforce instance, translating ambitious business requirements into scalable, maintainable solutions.

You'll own the architecture and design standards across our Salesforce ecosystem. This is a hands-on technical role at the intersection of CRM architecture, systems integration and revenue operations. You'll collaborate closely with the GTM leadership team, RevOps, Data and Analytics team to ensure our Salesforce platform scales cleanly alongside the business. Your core accountability is simple: design and steward a Salesforce architecture that is scalable, secure and built to last.

Responsibilities

• Own the end-to-end solution architecture of our Salesforce ecosystem, including data model, security model, sharing rules and integration architecture to support a global, multi-function GTM organisation spanning Self Serve, Partner-Led and High Touch motions.Translate complex business requirements from Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and Finance into scalable, well-governed technical designs.

• Define and enforce architectural standards, coding conventions and release management best practices across the Salesforce platform.

• Design and oversee integrations between Salesforce and the broader GTM tech stack (marketing automation, data enrichment tools, billing, data warehouse) using APIs, middleware and event-driven architecture.

• Partner with RevOps and the GTM org to evaluate buy vs. build decisions and guide platform-native solutions over custom code wherever possible.

• Lead technical design reviews, identify risks or technical debt early and ensure solutions are secure, performant and compliant with data governance requirements.

• Stay at the frontier of the Salesforce ecosystem – continuously evaluate new platform capabilities (Data Cloud, Agentforce, Flow) and bring the right innovations into our architecture roadmap.

Requirements

Experience

• 5+ years of experience in Salesforce architecture, solution engineering or senior Salesforce development roles.

• Proven track record designing and scaling Salesforce architecture in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

Technical Skills

• Deep fluency in Salesforce architecture fundamentals: data modeling, security/sharing model, Flow, Apex, LWC, and integration patterns.

• Strong practical experience designing integrations via REST/SOAP APIs, middleware (MuleSoft, Workato or similar) and event-driven architecture.

• Salesforce Application Architect and/or System Architect certification (or equivalent depth of experience) strongly preferred.

**

Operating Skills**

• Good understanding of core GTM processes (lead-to-cash, renewals, forecasting) to design architecture that reflects how the business actually operates.

• Strong bias to pragmatic, well-documented design decisions that balance speed with long-term maintainability.

• Excellent stakeholder management across technical and non-technical teams, including the ability to clearly explain architectural trade-offs to business stakeholders.

Benefits

Why join Usercentrics?

• 
Joining Usercentrics means becoming part of a fast-growing, diverse and international team of tech enthusiasts and entrepreneurially-minded who build our success story together

• 
Company culture is important to us - we strive to continuously develop a positive, vibrant and inspiring environment that enables everyone to thrive both personally and professionally

• 
Get involved! We have plenty of initiatives and love to see people from all department enthusiastically participating and shaping our future together in different cross-department projects

• 
Your work-life balance is important to us too - we offer flexible working hours, hybrid working and the possibility of workcations (in accordance with our company policy)

• 
We always remember to have fun along the way, both in our day-to-day work and at our regular team events on site in our offices in Munich, Copenhagen, Odense, Lisbon, New York and Buenos Aires or online

• 
You are the most valuable asset to our company which is why we’re happy to offer awesome benefits like our personal development budget, job-related language courses and a lot more (depending on your location) to focus on your well being

Usercentrics is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

**The Role

**As Genmab continues its transformation into a fully integrated global biotech company, the Head of Total Rewards will architect a future-ready, technology-enabled global rewards strategy that aligns with our purpose, growth ambitions, and values.

This leader will combine expertise in executive compensation, global scalability, and digital enablement to create a next-generation total rewards model—anchored in data, automation, and human experience. The role will also build the structures, systems, and shared-service capabilities needed to scale efficiently while maintaining governance, equity, and agility.

The location is flexible across Genmab’s global hubs (Princeton, Copenhagen, Utrecht). We have a hybrid model that requires being onsite 60% of the time.

**Responsibilities

****Strategic Design & Operating Model

**

• Define and lead the evolution of Genmab’s total rewards philosophy and structure to support a global, end-to-end biotech organization.

• Design a modern total rewards operating model that integrates regional teams, shared services, and centers of excellence for consistent global delivery.

• Drive process standardization and automation to improve quality, transparency, and efficiency.

• Lead a strategic compensation team responsible for developing forward-looking frameworks, tools, and analytics that enable proactive support to HR Business Partners, Talent, and other COE stakeholders.

• Ensure the Total Rewards function continuously evolves its offerings to meet the changing needs of a high-growth, science-driven organization.

**Executive Compensation & Governance

**

• Serve as lead advisor to the Board’s Remuneration Committee on executive and equity compensation.

• Design performance-based and ESG-linked long-term incentive plans aligned with Genmab’s business strategy and culture.

• Ensure strong governance, compliance, and transparency in all executive pay matters.

• Bring external perspective and best-in-class practices to inform committee discussions and program evolution, ensuring Genmab remains competitive within the biotech and broader life sciences markets.

**Global Rewards Strategy & Wellbeing

**

• Oversee global compensation, benefits, recognition, and mobility programs that balance competitiveness, scalability, and inclusivity.

• Integrate skills-based pay, internal mobility, and evolving career architectures into the total rewards framework.

• Evolve wellbeing and flexibility offerings through technology and personalized employee experiences.

• Champion employee understanding and appreciation of Total Rewards by partnering with Communications and HR to create clear, engaging messaging that connects programs to our purpose, values, and “EVP”.

• Regularly assess market trends, benchmark data, and emerging innovations to identify opportunities for differentiation and continuous improvement.

**Technology, Automation & Data

**

• Lead implementation of digital total rewards platforms and process automation across compensation, benefits, and equity administration.

• Establish robust analytics capabilities for pay equity, retention risk, and predictive modeling.

• Drive continuous improvement through data insights, benchmarking, and feedback loops.

• Leverage advanced analytics to generate actionable insights for business leaders, enabling data-driven decisions around talent retention, productivity, and performance outcomes.

**Governance & Continuous Improvement

**

• Strengthen global governance structures and ensure alignment with regulatory, financial, and ethical standards.

• Create transparency and consistency through standardized processes, policies, and data.

• Build and mentor a global total rewards team with strong analytical and design skills.

**Requirements

**

• 15+ years of experience in total rewards, with significant leadership in global, complex organizations.

• Deep expertise in executive compensation design, governance, and disclosure.

• Proven success implementing technology, analytics, and automation within HR or total rewards functions.

• Experience designing shared-service or center of excellence models across geographies.

• Strong understanding of compensation and benefits regulations across multiple markets.

• Exceptional ability to influence and communicate at the executive and Board level.

• Demonstrated success leading and developing global teams, fostering capability growth and functional excellence.

• Proven ability to translate external best practices and market intelligence into actionable strategies tailored to the biotech industry.

**Attributes

**

• Visionary leader who designs systems for long-term scalability.

• Digital innovator who applies automation and analytics to improve the employee experience.

• Trusted advisor who balances strategic foresight with operational excellence.

• Inclusive, globally minded leader who champions fairness and sustainability in rewards.

**The Role

**The Senior Manager, Biostatistics acts as a biostatistician supporting the clinical development of compounds as compound lead, primarily up until proof of concept, and/or as trial responsible statistician.

**Responsibilities

**Compound/Indication Level

• Act as lead and main point of contact related to Statistics for designated compound/indication

• Follow scientific and technical progress within the field of biostatistics in drug development and advise of new methodologies that may support innovation and improve efficiencies

• Engage with regulatory authorities on compound/indication level discussions

• Acts as a role model

• Ensures consistency of statistical methods and data handling across trials

• Ensures all compound/indication related work and information is shared between biostatisticians involved in the compound and with the vendor

• Supports compound responsible programmer in developing an integrated database specification

**CDT Member

**

• Responsible for giving statistical input to overall strategy and the synopsis development in the CDT

• Provide scientific advice to the CDT including design of trials, analyses and analyses requiring advanced statistical methodologies/techniques

• Represent the CDT/the company at regulatory meetings, during Key Opinion Leaders meetings, network and/or Partner meetings, as applicable

• Drive design and synopsis development together with relevant stakeholders

• Ensure transparent communication to relevant stakeholders from the CDT

• Ensure availability of integrated database(s), as needed, and planning and conduct of integrated analysis to support development decisions, submissions, and marketing needs

• Support development and communication in relation to communication strategy and/or scientific input to presentations, posters, and articles

Trial Level

• Represent Genmab during meetings/congresses and courses and perform professional networking

• Engage with regulatory authorities on trial level discussions

• Arranges/attends lessons learned to share learnings

• Represents Genmab during Key Opinion Leaders meetings

• Ensure biostatistician review of partner synopsis, protocols, statistical analysis plans, results meetings presentations and clinical trial reports

• Coordinate data transfers from/to business partners in collaboration with the programmer and the data manager, as applicable

**CTT Member

**

• Participate and represent Biostatistics

• Review and provide input to protocol and amendment development

• Perform vendor oversight according to applicable SOPs

• Give input to eCRF setup, edit checks, validation plan, protocol deviations classifications, DSUR, IB updates, tables, figures, and listings etc.

• Review assay validation reports, as applicable

• Perform exploratory analysis, ad hoc analyses, and modelling of data

• Review and approve randomization and stratification plans

• Perform UAT of Randomization part of the IRT system as applicable

• Ensure procedures for blinding are in place as applicable

• Support timely delivery of statistical deliverables

• Responsible for planning and conducting trial result meetings

• Review and approve the CSR

• Attend operational and steering committee meetings, as applicable

• Support regulatory submission/filing activities

**Requirements

**

• MS / PhD or equivalent in a statistical discipline

• 5+ years of experience in relevant area preferred or demonstrated capability

• Experience in statistical analysis, modelling and simulation and adaptive trial designs

• Experience in working with clinical trials

• Preferred experience with oncology clinical trials

• Proficient programming skills in statistical software’s, such as SAS

• Excellent oral and written communication skills

• Ability to work independently as well as in teams

• Confident, self-reliant, and a quick learner

• Proactive and open-minded

• Ability to prioritize and work in a fast-paced and changing environment

• Result and goal-oriented and committed to contributing to the overall success of Genmab

**Strengthen cybersecurity across our medical devices, cloud platforms and digital solutions

**_At UNEEG Medical, we are on a clear mission: improve epilepsy care and enhance patients' quality of life through objective, real-world EEG data. UNEEG EpiSight Solution, our sub-cutaneous EEG monitoring solution enables remote monitoring of brain activity in people with uncontrolled epilepsy and is already making an impact across Europe and the US. We combine the agility of a small company with the high standards of the medical device industry.

_**Your role and team:

**We are looking for a Cyber Security Engineer who will strengthen cybersecurity and information security across UNEEG Medical's products, cloud platforms and supporting infrastructure. You will help ensure that our solutions are developed, deployed and operated securely as we grow in the US healthcare market and continue to support customers across Europe.

You will be part of Technology (R&D) and act as UNEEG Medical's cybersecurity subject-matter expert. Working closely with Product Management, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Operations, Clinical Operations and Commercial, you will embed security throughout the product lifecycle, manage cyber risks and support customer and regulatory security requirements.

**Your main responsibilities will be:

**

• Identify, assess and manage cybersecurity risks across products, cloud platforms and corporate systems

• Define and maintain cybersecurity controls, policies, standards and procedures

• Support secure-by-design practices, security reviews and threat modelling throughout product development

• Assist the software team in vulnerability management, security monitoring and incident response, including root-cause investigations and remediations.

• Translate standards as ISO 27001, NIS2, IEC 81001-5-1, HIPAA, GDPR into a set of pragmatic standard operating procedures for UNEEG Medical to follow in order to be cyber security compliant.

• Maintain security documentation, risk assessments and evidence for audits and regulatory submissions

• Support cybersecurity requirements for medical devices and US healthcare market access

• Advise internal teams and support customer security questionnaires, risk assessments and cybersecurity discussions

• Promote cybersecurity awareness and collaborate with external security partners and auditors

**You will thrive in this role if you:

**

• Combine solid technical expertise with a practical, hands-on and collaborative mindset

• See security as an enabler and help teams create secure solutions rather than acting as a gatekeeper

• Take ownership of risks and remediation activities and follow issues through to completion

• Are structured and document decisions, actions and evidence systematically

• Can communicate complex security topics clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Enjoy working across disciplines and continuously improving security practices

**Your background:

**

• A bachelor's or master's degree in cybersecurity, computer science, software engineering, IT infrastructure or a related field; equivalent practical experience may substitute formal education

• At least 3-5 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, information security, infrastructure security or cloud security

• Experience with FDA cybersecurity requirements for medical devices

• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure security services and cloud security architecture

• Experience with vulnerability management, security monitoring and incident response

• Knowledge of identity and access management, network security, endpoint security and secure system architecture

• Familiarity with cybersecurity risk management frameworks and standards

• Fluent professional English, both written and spoken

**It will be an advantage if you have experience with:

**

• MedTech, healthcare IT, SaaS or other regulated environments

• ISO 27001, NIS2, IEC 81001-5-1, HIPAA, GDPR or similar frameworks

• DevSecOps and secure software development lifecycle practices

• Penetration testing management and security assessments

• Kubernetes, container security or cloud-native architecture

• Relevant certifications, such as CISSP, CISM, AZ-500, Security+, SC-100 or equivalent

Applicants must be eligible to work in Denmark and possess a valid work and residence permit if applicable. At this time, we are unable to support work permit applications or sponsorships.

**What we offer:

**

Do you have experience working with children with special needs, and do you enjoy an active one-to-one role? Then you could become an important source of support for a 9-year-old boy who loves movement, play and safe, predictable routines.

About the role

You will provide regular one-to-one support for a 9-year-old boy with autism and an intellectual disability. He needs close support, clear structure and a calm approach that helps create predictability.

The boy is energetic, enjoys being active and particularly likes outdoor play, trips to the playground and running in the woods. He also enjoys activities such as puzzles, music, bubbles, balloons and sensory toys. Your role is to plan and take part in activities that match his pace and needs. As he has limited awareness of danger, it is important that you stay close to him and remain attentive to his surroundings.

The role includes assistance with personal care, including bathing, changing diapers and toilet training. You will also provide support at mealtimes, with a focus on motivating and guiding him towards gradually becoming more independent.

The boy does not communicate verbally and uses only a few English words. It is therefore important that you are able to communicate in English, including with his parents, who do not speak Danish.

The boy has food allergies and has an EpiPen, which must be used in the event of an allergic reaction. The family will provide thorough instructions on its use. He also has asthma, and his parents are responsible for all medication management.

You may be a qualified pedagogue/social educator or have relevant experience working with children with special needs. You approach the child with calmness, patience and clarity, and you enjoy an active working environment where you take part in play and physical activities.
