jobs.occupation: Agroecological approaches to reduce nitrogen losses in vegetable production
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Food Science programme. The position is available from 15 January 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
Agroecological approaches to reduce nitrogen losses in vegetable production

Research area and project description
This PhD project will investigate how to reduce nitrogen losses from vegetable production systems. The aim is to successfully introduce and optimize mitigation measures such as catch crops, biomass removal, precision fertilization and irrigation in open field vegetable crop rotations to reduce residual soil N. The focus will be on losses by nitrate leaching as well as vegetable growth and nitrogen use efficiency. The aim is to optimize resource use and reduce environmental and climate impact of both organic and conventional vegetable systems using agroecological approaches. Relationships will be studied by experimental and modelling methodologies between soil nitrogen availability, crop nitrogen uptake and nitrate leaching losses based on soil water, soil and plant sampling from field trials at research and commercial fields. Investigations of losses of nitrous oxide may be included.

Research questions to be addressed include:
 
• How do crop traits influence the effectiveness of various mitigation measures in efficiently reducing nitrogen losses in organic and conventional vegetable production?
• How to optimize fertilization and irrigation practices for adequate root zone availability of nitrogen for high yielding and low nitrogen leaching vegetable production? 
Statistically designed field experiments will be available for studying mitigation measures on nitrate leaching in vegetable crop rotations at the research station AU-Auning. Fields at vegetable producers are equipped and available. The Department provides access to the state-of-the-art field and laboratory facilities. The PhD student will join the Science Team of Plant, Food and Sustainability, which includes PhD students and other scientific and technical staff. We foster a friendly and respectful working environment in an international atmosphere. We aim to collaborate and enjoy while contributing to the sustainability of food production.

The study will be conducted as part of Danish (Nvirkværk, GUDP) and European (Gound2Live, Agroecology Partnership, HEU) projects, which aim to: Integrate cover crops and other measures in sustainable vegetable cropping; Reduce losses of nitrate and nitrous oxide from intensive vegetable production; A Living Lab methodology is used in an agroecological framework, including European stakeholders from horticultural industries and universities.

Qualifications and specific competences
Applicants are expected to have a relevant master’s degree in Plant, Horticultural, Agricultural, Biological, Environmental or Soil Science (120 ECTS)
 
• Write and speak English fluently
• Knowledge of handling and analysing experimental data
• Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team
• Experience in field experiments
It is an advantage to have:
 
• Experience in conducting plant and soil experiments
• A proven record in scientific writing
 Place of employment and place of work
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is FOOD, Agro Food Park 48, 8200 Aarhus N., Denmark.

Contacts
Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:
• Hanne Lakkenborg Kristensen, e-mail: hanne.kristensen@food.au.dk (main supervisor)
• Mesfin T. Gebremikael, e-mail: mesfin.gebremikael@food.au.dk (co-supervisor)
For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:
• admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk
How to apply
Please follow this link to submit your application.

Application deadline is 01 December 2026 at 23:59 CET.

Preferred starting date is 15 January 2027.

For technical reasons, you must upload a project description. Please copy the project description above and upload it as a PDF in the application.

Please note:
• Only documents received prior to the application deadline will be evaluated. Thus, documents sent after deadline will not be considered.
• The programme committee may request further information or invite the applicant to attend an interview.
• Shortlisting will be used, which means that the evaluation committee only will evaluate the most relevant applications.
Formalities and salary range
Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which everyone has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via the online recruitment system, which can be accessed under ‘How to apply’.

Copenhagen Business School invites applications for a vacant Associate Professorship in Management Accounting at the Department of Accounting.

Core research areas of the Department are (1) financial accounting, (2) management accounting, (3) auditing, and (4) corporate governance, all applicable to both the private and public sectors. The objective of the Department is to maintain and expand its leadership position in research related to these areas in the Nordic countries and to preserve its strong international reputation for high-quality research and teaching.

The department's researchers collaborate on specific research projects using a variety of quantitative as well as qualitative methods. 

Teaching responsibilities of the Department comprise undergraduate and graduate teaching in the above-mentioned research fields.

The Department’s research efforts within management accounting focus on: 

• Accounting and digitalization
• Accounting for sustainable green transition
• Accounting history
• Accounting information systems
• Budgeting
• Cost and management accounting
• Data driven decision making & control
• Implementation of accounting systems
• Management control
• Performance measurement
• Profitability measurement and management on segments
• Profit center organization and transfer pricing
The Associate Professorship is a permanent position with research and teaching obligations. 

To fulfill the research requirements of the position, the applicant chosen is expected to be physically present on a regular basis and actively participate in the teaching and research activities of the Department. 

Responsibilities 

• Teaching and associated examination in existing CBS programs, including Executive Education 
• Individual and group-based research meeting high international standards 
• Promoting CBS’s academic reputation 
• Initiating, fund raising and coordinating research projects 
• Promoting the teaching and research capabilities of Copenhagen Business School and other relevant assignments at Copenhagen Business School 
• Contributing to the administrative responsibilities of the Department and to CBS-wide tasks 
• Communicating findings to the public in general and to CBS’s stakeholders in particular, including participating in the public debate. 
• Research meeting high international standards, including responsibility for the academic development of the relevant discipline
• Responsibility for publishing, scientific communication and research-based teaching 
• Active participation in the regular research activities, such as research seminars, workshops and conferences.
The associate professor is expected to contribute to the development and application of the research of the department’s research areas and to maintain and strengthen CBS’s international research position. 

Qualifications 

• Advanced degree in an appropriate field 
• Documented teaching qualifications or other material for the evaluation of his/her pedagogical level. Please see guidelines for teaching portfolios. 
• Documented research production at an international level, including publications in the field’s internationally recognized journals 
• Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) 
Copenhagen Business School has a broad commitment to the excellence, distinctiveness and relevance of its teaching and research programmes. Candidates who wish to join us should demonstrate enthusiasm for working in an organisation of this type (highlighting, for example, relevant business, educational and dissemination activities). 

For further information please contact: Head of Department Carsten Rohde, email cr.acc@cbs.dk. Information about the department may be found at www.cbs.dk/en.

Appointment and salary will be in accordance with the Ministry of Finance’s agreement with the Central Academic Organisation. 

Application 
Application must be sent via the electronic recruitment system, using the link below. 

Application must include: 

• A statement of application. 
• Proof of qualifications and a full CV. 
• Documentation of relevant, significant, original research at an international level, including publications in the field’s internationally recognized journals and citations in the Social Science Citation Index and/or Google Scholar. 
• Documentation of teaching qualifications or other material for the evaluation of his/her pedagogical level. 
• Information indicating experience in research management, industry co-operation and international co-operation. 
• A complete, numbered list of publications (indicating titles, co-authors, page numbers and year) with an * marking of the academic productions to be considered during the review. A maximum of 10 publications for review are allowed. Applicants are requested to prioritise their publications in relation to the field of this job advertisement. 
• Copies of the publications marked with an *. Only publications written in English (or another specified principal language, according to research tradition) or one of the Scandinavian languages will be taken into consideration). 
Recruitment procedure
The Recruitment Committee will shortlist minimum two applicants; when possible five or more applicants will be shortlisted. The shortlisted applicants will be assessed by the Assessment Committee. All applicants will be notified of their status in the recruitment process shortly after the application deadline. 

The applicants selected for assessment will be notified about the composition of the Assessment Committee and later in the process about the result of the assessment. 

Once the recruitment process is completed each applicant will be notified of the outcome of their application 

Copenhagen Business School must receive all application material, including all appendices (see items above), by the application deadline. 

Details about Copenhagen Business School and the department are available at www.cbs.dk. 

Application due 11/25/2026

Do you have experience configuring, testing and commissioning control systems for high-voltage substations? Would you like to apply your expertise to projects supporting Denmark’s electricity transmission grid? Join COWI as a Substation Control and Automation Specialist.

Develop and commission substation control systems

We are looking for an experienced specialist to work on control and automation systems for Energinet’s 132–400 kV substations. Projects range from new substations to extensions, refurbishment and replacement of systems at existing sites.

You will design, configure, test and commission substation control systems, including remote terminal units (RTUs), bay control units (BCUs) and human–machine interfaces (HMIs). Working closely with other specialists, you will ensure that these systems operate correctly and integrate with the substation’s primary equipment, protection systems and communication infrastructure.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Design and configure substation control and monitoring functions in accordance with functional requirements and customer specifications.

• Configure, test and commission RTUs, bay control units and HMIs.

• Configure and verify communication interfaces between control devices, protection equipment and remote control systems.

• Plan and perform functional and integration testing to verify control functions, signal exchange and correct operation of system interfaces.

• Troubleshoot configuration, communication and interface issues in collaboration with other technical specialists.

• Prepare and maintain configuration documentation, test procedures and test records.

• Coordinate technical interfaces with colleagues responsible for protection, communication systems, electrical design and primary equipment

• Undertake the designated on-site role of “holdleder” when required and subject to the relevant qualifications and authorisation.

Your expertise

You take a systematic approach to configuration, testing and troubleshooting. You work independently, pay close attention to technical detail and collaborate effectively with colleagues, customers and suppliers. You understand how individual devices and interfaces contribute to the operation of the complete substation control system.

You will also bring:

• A relevant qualification in electrical engineering or an equivalent technical background, combined with at least five years of relevant experience with control systems for high-voltage substations.

• Demonstrated experience configuring and testing substation control equipment from multiple manufacturers.

• Practical experience with IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 60870-5-103 and IEC 61850 communication protocols and standards.

• A sound understanding of the interfaces between substation control systems, protection equipment and high-voltage primary equipment.

• Experience with functional testing, system integration and commissioning of substation control systems.

• Professional proficiency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

• The ability to obtain the required security clearance and meet the qualification and authorisation requirements for acting as “holdleder” at high-voltage substations.

Your place of work

Depending on project requirements, you may work from one of COWI’s offices in Denmark, at Energinet project locations or partly from home. Testing and commissioning activities will require attendance at the relevant project sites. Travel within Denmark is expected.

A place to work and so much more

At COW, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Got more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Head of Discipline Carsten Sass Husum at CSHU@COWI.COM.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

Equal opportunity employer

COWI provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, COWI complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

What if developers could spend less time navigating complexity and more time building great technology?

Join Pandora as our Lead Engineer, Developer Experience and help shape how engineering teams build, deliver and operate software at scale.

You will lead the implementation and evolution of our Developer Experience platform and Developer Portal strategy, using Port.io as the foundation for a simpler, more connected and increasingly self-service engineering environment.

This is an opportunity to influence Developer Experience across a global technology organisation. You will help reduce friction throughout the software development lifecycle, improve visibility and ownership of software assets, and create practical standards and capabilities that enable engineering teams to move faster and with greater confidence.

Help Write Our Next Chapter

As a technical leader within our DevOps & Operational Excellence team, you will:

• Lead the implementation, configuration and continued development of Pandora’s Developer Portal, built on Port.io.

• Own the architecture of our software catalogue, including metadata, service ownership and portal governance.

• Design engineering scorecards covering operational readiness, security, reliability, documentation and architecture standards.

• Establish and maintain Golden Paths that simplify and standardise software delivery.

• Drive adoption of self-service capabilities across development, deployment, observability and operational excellence.

• Integrate Port.io with platforms including GitHub, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Datadog, Splunk, Azure and Kubernetes.

• Build greater visibility into engineering health, service quality and operational readiness.

• Use DORA metrics, flow metrics and Developer Experience frameworks to support measurable improvements.

• Identify friction across the software development lifecycle and turn this into focused improvement initiatives.

• Influence engineering leaders and teams to adopt shared platform standards and self-service ways of working.

• Facilitate communities of practice and knowledge sharing across engineering teams.

• Evaluate emerging developments across Developer Experience, Internal Developer Platforms and Platform Engineering.

What Makes You Shine:

You are passionate about improving the day-to-day experience of engineers and understand that great Developer Experience is about more than tooling. It brings together thoughtful platform design, automation, clear ownership, effective governance and a deep understanding of how developers work.

We would love to hear from you if you bring:

• 8+ years of relevant experience across Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Internal Developer Platforms or a closely related engineering discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience will also be considered.

• Experience implementing or evolving a developer portal, software catalogue or comparable self-service engineering platform.

• Knowledge of software catalogue architecture, service ownership and engineering governance.

• Experience designing Golden Paths, engineering scorecards or reusable self-service capabilities.

• A strong understanding of CI/CD, cloud platforms, Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code.

• Experience integrating engineering tools and platforms such as GitHub, Azure DevOps, Azure, ServiceNow or observability solutions.

• Familiarity with DORA metrics, flow metrics or other approaches to measuring engineering effectiveness.

• Professional fluency in English.

• Experience with Port.io would be particularly valuable. However, we are also interested in people who have built relevant experience through comparable developer portals, Internal Developer Platforms or service catalogue technologies.

We know that great talent comes from different backgrounds and experiences. If this opportunity excites you and you can see yourself bringing many of these skills to the team, we would love to hear your story.

Crafting What’s Next, Together

You will join Pandora’s DevOps & Operational Excellence team within Digital & Technology and report to the Director of DevOps & Operational Excellence.

Your work will connect you with colleagues across Platform Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, Software Engineering, Product Engineering, Service Management and Cloud Platforms. You will have the opportunity to shape solutions across organisational boundaries and help create a more consistent, productive and developer-centred engineering environment.

This role is a Lead Engineer, individual contributor role.

The Impact You Will Make

Your impact will be visible through the adoption of the Developer Portal and Golden Paths, increased use of self-service platform capabilities, broader coverage of the software catalogue and clearer service ownership.

The role will also contribute to reducing developer onboarding time, strengthening engineering standards, improving developer satisfaction and reducing manual governance activities.

The Additional Sparkle

You’ll be based at our Digital & Technology building at Havneholmen in Copenhagen, working alongside talented colleagues in an international and collaborative environment.

Our LEED Gold-certified building is designed to bring people together and provides a modern workplace where you can connect, collaborate and share ideas. It’s a great base from which to help shape Pandora’s Developer Experience and influence how our engineering teams work globally.

Ready to Craft Your Next Career Chapter?

If you can see yourself improving how engineers build, deliver and operate technology, while helping Pandora advance its Platform Engineering and Operational Excellence journey, we would love to hear from you.

Please submit your application in English. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Let’s Craft the Incredible

Pandora is the world’s largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, helping people share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Pandora brings together craftsmanship, innovation and responsible business practices. Join us and bring your expertise, ideas and unique contribution as we continue to craft what comes next

jobs.occupation: Two-year postdoc in developing inventory of agricultural nitrous oxide emissions
jobs.description:
The Department of Environmental Science and the Department of Agroecology at Aarhus University, Denmark, welcomes applications for a postdoctoral researcher position in developing a Tier 3 model-based national inventory of N₂O emissions modelling from cultivation of soils. The position is part of the SmartField project, which is a cross-organizational research project aimed at obtaining knowledge about N₂O emissions from agricultural fields and solutions for mitigation strategies. Additionally, SmartField will develop and deliver an improved methodology for accounting N₂O emissions at farm and national scale.

Expected start date and duration of employment

The position is to be filled by February 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter and is a two-year fixed-term position.

Job description

You will be part of a research environment addressing greenhouse gas emissions and sustainability transition of agricultural systems, with a particular focus on nitrous oxide emissions from agricultural soil aiming to scale emission estimates from the field to the national scale. Your role will primarily involve supporting the development and implementation of a model-based approach for the national of N₂O emissions from diverse agricultural soils, as well as developing the data pipeline. This will include creating and updating spatio-temporal datasets on soils, cropping systems, and field management, and calculating and assessing and comparing the resulting inventories to other approaches. Scenarios will be used to explore how mitigation technologies and management measures could reduce N₂O emissions and to assess the suitability of the proposed Tier 3 modelling framework for Denmark's national N₂O emission inventory. Your work will support a Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MRV) system, enabling transparent, robust and science-based reporting of mitigation progress regarding agricultural field N₂O emission. You will work in close collaboration with colleagues developing and testing process-oriented models, as well as with those responsible for the national greenhouse gas inventory.

Your profile

We are searching for a highly motivated candidate who has:

• A PhD in agronomy, soil science, data science, environmental sciences, engineering, agroecology, biology, or a related field.

• Experience working with models, managing and analyzing large datasets.

• Experience working with models related to nitrogen/carbon turnover in soil is considered an advantage but is not required.

• Documented experience in scientific writing and publishing in peer-reviewed scientific journals.

• The ability to communicate effectively in English (both written and oral).

• Good collaboration skills and ability to take responsibility to work independently and proactively on the project

Who we are

The position is shared between the Department of Environmental Science and the Department of Agroecology under the Faculty of Technical Sciences at Aarhus University, and it will be hosted by the Land-CRAFT Center at the AU campus in Aarhus.

The Department of Environmental Science is an interdisciplinary department with expertise ranging from physics, chemistry, microbiology, engineering, social science, geography, economics, to policy analysis. Basic as well as applied research are conducted on some of the major challenges facing society, such as pollution and pollution control mechanisms, management of land, soil, water, air and biodiversity, protection of ecosystem services, and climate change. Advisory services within these areas are offered to governmental organizations, non-governmental organizations and companies. The department consists of five sections and currently about 160 staff (including postdocs and Ph.D. students).

The Department of Agroecology contributes to sustainable solutions to some of the world’s biggest problems within the areas of soil, plants, animals, humans, and the environment. We want to make a difference by contributing to both fundamental knowledge generation and the attainment of sustainable production systems via innovative research, contracted policy advice, and education. We offer professional laboratories, greenhouses, semi-field, and field-scale research facilities, advanced computing capacities as well as an extensive national and international researcher network.  The department consists of nine research sections with around 400 highly skilled employees.

This position is hosted by Land-CRAFT - the Center for Landscape Research in Sustainable Agricultural Future, which aims to bring transformational solutions to agricultural systems. Land-CRAFT is a section within the Department of Agroecology. Therefore, there is a strong focus on climate change mitigation and adaptation strategies.

Both departments believe in equality, diversity, inclusion, and creating an attractive work/life balance.

What we offer

• A collaborative, international research environment that combines high academic standards with an informal and supportive atmosphere. We value accountability, curiosity, flexibility, and teamwork in everything we do.

• An inclusive and respectful workplace culture, where mutual trust, kindness, and professional dialogue are part of daily life. We encourage open communication and develop a cohesive sense of community across teams and disciplines.

• A flexible working environment that supports work-life balance and individual needs.

• An active institutional commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion – in recruitment, career development, and everyday interactions.

• An innovative and meaningful workplace where your work contributes to solving real-world challenges. No two days are alike, and we welcome creative thinking and new ideas.

• Support for international researchers and their families, including Relocation Service and an Expat Partner Programme.

Place of work and area of employment

The place of work is Aarhus University (LandCRAFT Center), Ole Worms Allé 3, 8000 Aarhus C. The affiliation will be with the Department of Environmental Science. However, it should also be expected that there will be work-related and meeting activities at the Department of Environmental Science which is located at Risø in Roskilde.

Contact information

Further information may be obtained by contacting Head of Section Emissions and Atmospheric Modelling, Professor Peter L. Langen (plangen@envs.au.dk +4520618369), Professor Jørgen E. Olesen (jeo@agro.au.dk +4540821659), or Special consultant related to the national emission inventory Mette Hjorth Mikkelsen (mhm@envs.au.dk +4587158579).

Deadline

All applications must be received no later than November 27, 2026.

Application procedure

Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self.

Formalities and salary range

Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

Our story goes back more than 150 years, to the chilly southern coast of Scandinavia. From our early success in Sweden and Denmark, we’ve grown into the world’s leading specialist producer of plant-based oils, employing more than 4,000 people across the globe.

We work with our customers to make the products you love even better. The oils we produce go into making your chocolate extra-creamy or putting the crunch into your croissant. And it’s not just food. We work across industries to make products that are higher quality, healthier and better for the planet.

Everything we do is about Making Better Happen™.

AAK Locations

This position is based at our site in Aarhus, Denmark. We offer a hybrid way of working.

About the role

As our Talent Acquisition Specialist in Denmark, you will have a unique opportunity to help shape and establish how Talent Acquisition is delivered locally, while being part of AAK’s growing European Talent Acquisition team.

You will take ownership of end-to-end recruitment across a broad range of functions and levels, combining hands-on recruitment with a strategic and consultative approach. Working closely with hiring managers and HR colleagues, you will bring market insights, recruitment expertise and constructive challenge to hiring decisions.

While Denmark will be your primary area of responsibility, you will also collaborate on recruitment projects and initiatives across other regions, giving you exposure to a broad range of stakeholders, functions and markets.

You will play an important role in attracting talent, strengthening AAK’s employer brand, delivering an excellent candidate experience, and continuously improving our recruitment processes and ways of working.

Responsibilities

- Manage end-to-end recruitment processes across professional and operational roles in Denmark.

- Partner closely with hiring managers and HR colleagues to understand talent needs and define effective recruitment strategies.

- Build proactive talent pipelines through sourcing, talent mapping, networking, and candidate engagement.

- Conduct interviews and assessments and support hiring managers in making high-quality, structured recruitment decisions.

- Provide talent market insights and constructively challenge stakeholders when needed to support inclusive, data-informed, and long-term hiring outcomes.

- Develop attractive job advertisements, contribute to employer branding activities, and ensure a professional and engaging candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.

- Maintain recruitment data and systems and contribute to continuous improvement of recruitment processes and ways of working.

- Support recruitment across both professional and operational populations, including blue-collar recruitment.

jobs.occupation: Senior SDET – Booking and Payments Services
jobs.description:
Help build reliable technology that powers sports experiences around the world.

At Trackman, we develop innovative technology used by athletes, coaches, and sports facilities worldwide. Behind these experiences are business-critical platforms that make it easy for customers to book, pay, and access our services.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to help strengthen the quality, reliability, and scalability of our booking, payments, and commerce solutions. You will work closely with developers, product owners, and quality engineers to ensure that our solutions deliver a seamless experience to customers around the world.

This role is ideal for an experienced automation engineer who enjoys building robust test frameworks, improving engineering practices, and working on business-critical payment solutions.

What You'll Do

• 
Design, develop, and maintain automated test solutions using Playwright and TypeScript.

• 
Build UI, API, integration, and end-to-end automated tests for booking and payment services.

• 
Drive risk-based testing and quality engineering practices across the product lifecycle.

• 
Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, and help define and maintain quality gates

• 
Collaborate closely with developers, product owners, and quality engineers to improve testability and overall product quality.

• 
Identify quality risks early through requirement reviews and technical discussions.

• 
Mentor and support team members in test automation and quality engineering best practices.

• 
Continuously improve automation coverage, reliability, and execution efficiency.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with a proactive and collaborative approach to quality engineering.

• 
5+ years of experience as an SDET, Test Automation Engineer, or Quality Engineer.

• 
Experience with payment, e-commerce, subscription, billing, POS, or financial transaction platforms.

• 
Strong hands-on experience with Playwright and TypeScript.

• 
Experience testing REST and GraphQL APIs and backend services.

• 
Experience integrating and maintaining automated tests within CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.

• 
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

AI & Emerging Technologies

• Experience with AI and machine learning concepts and an understanding of how they can be applied within a quality engineering context.

Nice to Have

• 
Experience testing integrations with payment gateways such as Adyen, Stripe, PayPal, or Nets.

• 
Experience with AWS or other cloud platforms.

• 
Experience with performance, load, or security testing.

• 
Experience working in Agile product teams.

• 
Interest in sports technology or SaaS products.

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

**_Ready to build the AI engine behind the world's largest jewellery brand?

_**As Lead AI Platform Engineer, you will be the technical force behind Pandora's AI platform, shaping how AI systems are built, scaled, and secured across the business. Combining deep hands-on engineering expertise with strong technical leadership, you will drive architectural excellence, elevate engineering standards, and deliver reliable, production-ready AI solutions at scale.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Be To

****Technical Leadership

**

• Serve as the technical lead for the AI platform engineering team — setting the implementation direction, defining coding standards, and making key technical decisions that govern how the platform is built and evolved.

• Lead code reviews and drive architecture discussions, ensuring engineering decisions are well-reasoned, documented, and aligned with the broader platform strategy — championing engineering standards across code quality, testing practices, documentation, observability, and security hardening.

• Act as a technical mentor and go-to resource for all engineers — sharing knowledge, unblocking complex problems, and actively investing in the technical growth of both senior and junior team members.

**Platform Engineering & AI Infrastructure

**

• Design, build, and operate scalable, high-performance services and platform components that expose AI/ML capabilities across Pandora's digital ecosystem.

• Own and define the standards and governance for Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code (IaC) — ensuring all Azure infrastructure is reproducible, auditable, and securely configured.

• Apply strong network architecture knowledge to design and govern secure connectivity between platform services, AI gateways, and external integrations, including VNet, private endpoints, NSGs, and ingress/egress controls, while collaborating with security stakeholders to uphold the platform's overall security posture.

• Leverage Databricks for big data processing, feature engineering, and ML pipeline support.

**AI Services & Agentic Development

**

• Integrate and operationalise AI services including LLM APIs, vector search, RAG pipelines, embeddings, and multi-layer caching into platform-level services.

• Lead the agentic code development practice: architecting autonomous execution loops that enable tools like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot to safely write, test, and self-correct software within isolated sandboxes.

• Own MLflow governance standards for experiment tracking, model versioning, and ML lifecycle management across the team.

• Configure and manage AI gateways to ensure secure, scalable, and governed access to AI capabilities at production scale.

**CI/CD & Reliability

**

• Define and govern the CI/CD standards for the AI platform team — establishing quality gates, testing frameworks, deployment patterns, and pipeline architecture that all engineers build to.

• Ensure performance, availability, and maintainability of platform services in production; handle incidents in a timely manner to minimise Mean Time to Contain (MTTC).

**Job Requirements

****Education & Experience

**

• Relevant background from Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field with experience in backend or platform engineering, with at least 2 years operating in a technical leadership capacity within AI or cloud-native platform teams.

• Proven experience building and operating AI/ML platform services or LLM-based integrations in a production environment.

**Technical Skills

**

• Strong backend engineering fundamentals: service architecture, REST API design, performance optimisation, and production reliability by design and monitoring, with hands-on proficiency in Python.

• Deep Kubernetes expertise — workload configuration, networking, security policy design, and production debugging; hands-on Docker and Azure App Services.

• Expert-level Terraform and IaC ownership — defining standards, patterns, and governance for cloud infrastructure on Azure.

• Strong network architecture and configuration skills, including Azure networking concepts (VNet, NSG, private endpoints, DNS, ingress/egress).

• MLflow governance, Databricks for ML pipeline integration, and experience with ML serving infrastructure, LLM APIs, prompt integration, and multi-layer caching.

• Proficiency in PostgreSQL and experience in configuring AI gateways for centralized AI governance

• Experience in agentic code development practice, harness engineering and spec-driven development is a plus.

**Soft Skills

**Ideally you are a trusted technical leader who combines strong engineering expertise with clear thinking and a collaborative approach to drive sound decisions, communicate complex platform, security, and architecture topics in a business-friendly way, and foster team growth. Brings a proactive and curious mindset, with a passion for emerging AI technologies balanced by a pragmatic focus on execution and delivery.

**About The Team

**You will be part of Pandora's AI Platform team within AI CoE at Digital & Analytics & AI — a passionate, forward-thinking group dedicated to building the infrastructure and services that bring AI to life across the business. The team works at the intersection of data science, machine learning, cloud engineering, and product development, collaborating closely with ML Engineers, Data Scientists, AI Architects, and Product stakeholders.

You will report to the AI Platform Manager and serve as the senior technical voice that shapes how the platform is designed, secured, and evolved — influencing both what gets built and how it gets built.

**Did we get your attention?

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you see yourself in the role and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply! We are an international team, so please make sure to send us your application in English to be considered. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

**Icing on the cake

**You will be working out of our beautiful Digital & Technology Hub in Copenhagen, in a rapidly growing environment of highly skilled and experienced colleagues, which is a key initiative that goes along with Pandora’s experience & ambitions.Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Our ambition with this change is to strengthen end-to-end product accountability, introduce more fit-for-purpose practices, improve cross-team transparency, and create common guidance and capability-building activities across IT & Digital,” says Head of Product IT, Kasper Duus.

**

How will you make an impact**

As Experienced IT Specialist in the IT Excellence team, you will take ownership of key transformation and continuous-improvement initiatives, moving between strategic thinking, practical design, stakeholder alignment and hands-on execution. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Shape and improve our IT operating model and product-led ways of working, translating ambitions into our product lifecycle model, roadmaps, roles, and processes.

• Drive adoption and anchoring of change, ensuring new ways of working become part of everyday behaviors and continue to evolve after implementation.

• Lead cross-functional transformation initiatives, creating alignment across stakeholders, clarifying ownership, and turning complex challenges into actionable solutions.

• Use data, insights, and feedback to identify improvement opportunities, challenge existing practices, and help demonstrate progress and value.

• Enable leaders and teams to succeed with change through facilitation, capability building, clear guidance, and practical tools.

You are comfortable translating ambition into action and have experience driving change from design through implementation and adoption. You combine a structured and analytical mindset with strong stakeholder-management and facilitation skills. We expect the ideal candidate brings:

• 5+ years of experience with large-scale transformation initiatives

• Experience with or understanding of product-led IT organizations

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• Experience with organizational design, capability building, performance insights or agile/continuous-improvement practices is an advantage

Most importantly, you are pragmatic and hands-on. You are comfortable challenging existing thinking, navigating ambiguity, and creating momentum without relying on formal authority.

What do we offer?

You get the chance to shape how a large, Global IT organization works, at a time when the new operating model is being anchored. You will work with leaders and teams across Arla IT & Digital, see the direct impact of your work on everyday practice, and build experience that is valuable for your further career, in a team that cares about connecting strategy with execution.

Would you like to join us?

If you want to turn transformation ambitions into lasting change, then seize this exciting opportunity. Please apply as soon as possible, as we process applications on a continuous basis and will close the recruitment once the right candidate is found.

For additional information, please contact Kasper Duus on kasper.duus@arlafoods.com

jobs.occupation: Drive Technical Excellence, Lead with Confidence, and Make an Impact as Team Lead for our Hardware Automation team
jobs.description:
Are you a technically strong and decisive leader who sets high standards, takes ownership, and drives results?
At Gram Equipment, we are looking for a Team Lead – Hardware, Automation who combines solid electrical engineering expertise with a strong leadership presence and the determination to make things happen.

We are looking for someone who is confident in their technical decisions, comfortable taking responsibility, and motivated by delivering high-quality results. Someone who brings structure, challenges the status quo when needed, and has the courage to set clear expectations and follow through.

In this role, you will lead our Hardware Team within the Automation department, ensuring that we deliver safe, reliable, and production-ready electrical hardware solutions.

This is a hands-on leadership position where you will combine technical expertise with team leadership. Approximately 80% of your time will be dedicated to technical and operational activities, while 20% will focus on leadership, planning, and employee development.
Your role – technical excellence meets strong leadership
As our new Team Lead, you will take responsibility for the daily coordination, technical quality, and performance of a team of six skilled employees in Denmark and one in Turkey.

You will be expected to provide clear direction, establish priorities, and ensure that decisions are translated into action. At the same time, you will remain actively involved in engineering activities, contributing your own technical expertise to complex challenges and important projects.

An important part of your role will be to drive standardization, increase automation of engineering processes, and identify opportunities for cost optimization, helping us create more efficient, scalable, and competitive hardware solutions.

You will work closely with colleagues across Automation, Engineering, Project Management, Procurement, and Production, where your ability to communicate clearly, challenge constructively, and stand firm on technical quality and safety will be essential.

You will report to the Global Head of Automation and play an important role in strengthening the performance and capabilities of our Global Engineering & Automation organization.
Your key responsibilities
• Lead with clarity and accountability: Set clear expectations, establish priorities, make decisions, and ensure that commitments are followed through.
• Drive technical execution: Take an active role in electrical design, panel engineering, component selection, BOM development, and technical problem-solving.
• Ensure high technical standards: Review and challenge electrical solutions, maintain compliance with safety requirements, and ensure consistent engineering quality and documentation.
• Drive standardization and engineering automation: Develop and implement standardized electrical designs, components, and documentation practices. Promote automated generation of electrical drawings to reduce manual engineering effort, improve consistency, and increase efficiency.
• Focus on cost optimization: Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities through smarter design solutions, component standardization, efficient engineering processes, and close collaboration with Procurement and Production, without compromising safety, quality, or reliability.
• Take ownership of planning and delivery: Allocate resources, monitor capacity and progress, address obstacles, and proactively manage delivery risks.
• Make sound technical decisions: Evaluate complex engineering challenges, balance quality, cost, safety, and delivery requirements, and make well-founded decisions, even under pressure.
• Develop and challenge your team: Provide constructive feedback, coach employees, encourage accountability, and support the development of technical competencies.
• Strengthen cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and panel builders to resolve issues and ensure effective project execution.
• Drive continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to improve standards, processes, tools, and working methods, and take the initiative to turn improvements into measurable results.What we are looking for
We are looking for an experienced electrical engineering professional with a strong technical foundation and a natural ability to take the lead.

Our operations team is looking for a Finance Manager who is tired of the status quo. You will work closely with our software engineers and operations team to help shape the future of finance in property management.

To be quite frank: if you currently work with bookkeeping in property management, you probably know the pain. Too much manual work, outdated systems, endless reconciliations, and processes built around software from another decade.

We want to change that. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to rethink and shape how bookkeeping and accounting workflows should work for our customers' property portfolio.

Right now is the best time to join because you’ll help define both the role and the systems behind it as we scale across the Nordics.

****What we do

****Property management is fundamentally broken. It’s held back by legacy software and linear scaling: more tenants equals more manual work.

We automate high-volume, low-value tasks like bank reconciliation, debt collection, and financial administration to remove unnecessary friction and human error from the rental experience.

Rumli is a seal of quality and trust in a messy market. After years of scaling our software to thousands of users, we are now rebuilding our entire stack from the ground up with AI as the foundation. We are moving from being a software provider to a full-service property manager.

We’re not just building the platform; we’re running it.

****You will

• Be a core part of the team: Work closely with operations and product to improve financial workflows and internal systems.

• Handle day-to-day bookkeeping: ensure our automations work as intended across reconciliation, vendor invoice management, payroll and financial administration for the properties we manage.

• Ensure financial accuracy: Manage balance sheet reconciliations, payments, VAT handling, and monthly, quarterly and yearly accounts.

• Help improve the system: Identify repetitive or inefficient workflows and help the product team decide what to automate next.

• Operate at scale: Use modern tools and automation to manage a portfolio size that would be difficult in a traditional setup.

• Support the business: Assist with designing the reporting, budgeting, on- and offboarding of new properties, and ad hoc finance tasks as we continue to grow.

****You may be a fit if you are

• From the field: You have experience with bookkeeping, accounting, or financial administration – ideally within property management or a related industry.

• Done with manual work and outdated processes: You’ve worked with legacy bookkeeping and already have opinions on how finance workflows could be smarter.

• Detail-oriented: You care about accuracy and structure without losing sight of the bigger picture.

• A systems thinker: You enjoy improving processes, not just following them.

• Comfortable with IT systems: You have worked with different software, like e-conomic, before and are quick at adopting new ones.

• Bilingual: You are fluent in Danish and comfortable working in English.

• Equipped with an entrepreneurial mindset: You’re comfortable taking ownership and working in a fast-paced startup environment.

****What you’ll get

****Almost everyone lives or works in a building someone else looks after, and how that is done has barely changed in decades. Rumli is rethinking it – and you'll be part of the team making it happen, backed by some of Denmark's leading investors. The distance from idea to action here is short, and impact gets noticed fast.

• Ownership of the company through our warrant program.

• An office in the heart of Copenhagen.

• Daily lunch, drinks and snacks at the office.

• Private health insurance.

• 30 days of paid holiday.

**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the teams by creating or helping create great guest experiences, and use every day as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer or staff member; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of people who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You'll learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path—our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**The Senior Associate Accounts Payable is responsible for ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely processing of supplier invoices and payments globally, safeguarding financial integrity and operational efficiency. The role delivers high-quality Accounts Payable execution, supports month-end and audit processes, and acts as a reliable point of contact for suppliers and internal stakeholders. As part of the Finance team, this position contributes to strong financial governance, VAT compliance, and continuous process improvement, supporting the company's scalability and commercial performance. The role is a full-time position and reports to the AP Manager.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Process and validate supplier invoices, ensuring accurate coding, proper approvals, VAT compliance, and high-quality data integrity.

• Manage supplier communication and vendor onboarding, resolving invoice and payment-related queries in a timely, structured, and service-oriented manner while coordinating effectively with internal stakeholders.

• Perform monthly reconciliations, including vendor statement reconciliations, vendor subledger reviews, and balance sheet reconciliations to ensure financial accuracy and completeness.

• Support month-end closing activities by ensuring Accounts Payable accuracy and timely reporting in line with internal controls and accounting standards.

• Contribute to audit processes by providing documentation, analysis, and reconciliation support to ensure compliance and transparency.

• Drive continuous improvement within Accounts Payable processes by identifying inefficiencies, enhancing controls, and supporting automation or standardization initiatives.

• Ensure adherence to company policies, financial controls, and regulatory requirements, maintaining strong governance within the AP function.

**KEY EXPECTATIONS

**In this role, you take ownership of your workload, manage moderately complex tasks, and help improve processes. You work independently, propose solutions, and adapt quickly when priorities shift. Your solid knowledge makes you a dependable contributor who helps drive team performance.

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

• Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

**ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

Lead and develop the Nordic service organisation

The position offers significant influence on how Ramcon delivers service to customers and organises its Nordic resources. The Service Director Nordic will lead an experienced organisation consisting of service engineers, service leadership and service coordination in Denmark and Sweden and will contribute directly to the company’s continued growth and operational development.

Your profile

Experience from Life Science, Diagnostics, Laboratory Solutions, Medical Technology or another specialised technical service environment would be considered very beneficial.

jobs.occupation: PhD positions in Algebraic Hardness and Applications (AHA) at IT University of Copenhagen
jobs.description:
The IT University of Copenhagen invites highly motivated individuals to apply for a PhD position starting in September 1, 2027, or soon thereafter. 

We invite applicants who want to contribute to the IT University's vision of creating and sharing knowledge that is profound and leads to ground-breaking information technology and services for the benefit of humanity. 

Job description
To be eligible to apply for these positions, the applicants are expected to have a good background and passionate interest in mathematics and computer science, demonstrated by having credited relevant courses such as Complexity Theory, Advanced Algorithms, Probability Theory, Real and Complex Analysis, Calculus, and Combinatorics. Or they may be demonstrated by results at the Olympiads of Mathematics or Informatics, or by publication in relevant internationally recognised conferences or journals.

Applicants need to be motivated for doctoral studies; should possess the ability to work independently and perform critical analysis; and additionally, have good levels of communicative abilities and English language skills. The working language of the group is English, and knowledge of English is also fully sufficient to navigate every-day research life in general.

General information
The IT University of Copenhagen (ITU) is a teaching and research-based university specializing in information technology (IT) and the opportunities it offers. The IT University has more than 160 full-time Faculty members. Research and teaching in information technology span all academic activities which involve computers including computer science, information and media sciences, humanities and social sciences, business impact and the commercialization of IT.

Research at the IT University of Copenhagen
Our research is organized through dynamic research groups, centers, hubs, and labs that promote collaboration across disciplines. These units explore complex challenges at the intersection of people, technology, and society, contributing both to fundamental insights and practical solutions. At ITU, we see research as a shared endeavor – open, critically engaged, and rooted in dialogue with academic communities, industry, and the public sector. We actively pursue international partnerships and networks, and our interdisciplinary approach ensures that our research not only advances knowledge but also generates impact beyond academia.

Teaching at the IT University of Copenhagen
ITU currently offers four BSc degrees, six MSc degrees and one professional master’s degree, spanning across these disciplines. ITU's educations are extremely sought after and produces qualified graduates who are in high demand from the job market.

Working at the IT University
Located in modern architecture, a 6-minute metro ride from the center of Copenhagen, the IT University offers an informal working environment, a varied everyday life, and a highly motivated, innovative, skilled, and diverse international faculty, with PhD degrees from more than 20 different countries. The IT University is an equal opportunity employer and prides itself in actively pursuing an improved gender balance among students and among faculty.

Working in Copenhagen
Copenhagen has a solid educational system, a rich cultural life, universal healthcare, good childcare, and well-functioning infrastructure. Copenhagen is consistently ranked among the world’s most livable cities according to the Economist Global Liveability Index. Living and working in Copenhagen will typically be a great experience for you and your family.

Salary and terms of employment
Appointment and salary will be in accordance with the Ministry of Taxation’s agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC) and job structure for academic staff at universities.

Qualification Requirements
The following qualifications are required:

• 
3-year programme: candidates should have an MSc (or equivalent)

• 
4-year programme: candidates should have a BSc and one year of university studies on Master level

 The applicants will be employed and enrolled at the ITU University for a period of 3 or 4 years depending on the university degree level of the applicant. 

Application
The application and all other documents ought to be in English and must include:

• 
A motivated application (cover letter), including a detailed description of your qualifications

• 
A full CV, including name, address, phone number, e-mail, previous and present employment and academic background

• 
Documentation of academic degrees (copy of degree certificates etc.)

• 
A statement of purpose, which provides evidence of independent thinking, novelty and originality, of the targeted research field matching the project description

• 
Documentation of English proficiency (see link below to the PhD Admission Requirements)

• 
Relevant scientific publications or/and master thesis written by the applicant (Not required but optional)

 Applications without the above-mentioned required documents will not be assessed.

Please read the guidelines for applicants carefully before filling in the application form. You can see the guidelines through this link. 

The applicant will be assessed according to the Appointment Order from the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation of 13 March 2012.

The IT University may use shortlisting in connection to the recruitment process. In case of shortlisting, the Chair of the hiring committee selects applicants for assessment in consultation with the hiring committee after the application deadline. All applicants are notified whether their application has been passed for assessment. The shortlisting of candidates for assessment is based on the criteria in the job posting. 

Further information
Questions about the positions can be directed to Professor Nutan Limaye, IT University of Copenhagen, nuli@itu.dk. Early contact with our faculty staff is encouraged.
Questions related to the application procedure may be directed to HR, hr@itu.dk.

Application procedure

You can only apply for this position through our e-recruitment system. Apply by pressing the button "Apply for position" in the job announcement on our website.

The IT University might upon request in the interview process contact 1-2 references.

Application deadline: December 1, 2026, at 23:59 CET.

Applications/enclosures received at ITU after the application deadline will not be taken into consideration. If you submit an application, it is your responsibility to ensure that it arrives before the deadline so please allow sufficient time for the upload of publications and other documents.

At The IT University of Copenhagen, we have an international environment and view diversity as a valuable resource. We are committed to ensuring an inclusive working environment for all our employees and encourage all qualified applicants, regardless of age, gender, religious affiliation, or ethnic background to apply for the position.

As ITU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

Are you passionate about creating structure, driving improvements, and turning ideas into scalable HR processes? Do you thrive in a role that combines operational excellence, project leadership, and innovation?

• 
Strong understanding of HR processes, employee lifecycle management, and HR compliance requirements.

• 
Experience identifying and implementing process automation and digital solutions, preferably including AI-enabled tools.

Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate complex issues into practical solutions.

• 
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

• 
A structured and detail-oriented approach with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

Fluency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

Key competencies:

To succeed in this role, we expect you to take ownership, demonstrate sound judgment, and continuously look for opportunities to improve the way we work.

Travel: 5-10 days per year

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, 2900 Hellerup

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

A note to recruiters:

We do not allow external search party solicitation.  Presentation of candidates without written permission from the Ascendis Pharma HR team (specifically from: Talent Acquisition Partner or Human Resources Director) is not allowed.  If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged.

Join us in this role where you’ll carry out specialised inspections, up-tower repairs, troubleshooting and other technical activities across different wind turbine sites and platforms. You’ll combine strong technical capability with a safety-first mindset, sound judgement and the resilience to work effectively while travelling internationally.

Welcome to Special Tasks & Inspections

You’ll be part of the ST&I Travel Technician team, where you and your colleagues will deliver specialist inspections, repairs, technical campaigns and turbine support across Ørsted’s wind turbine sites. As a team, we work in smaller groups across different regions and placing strong emphasis on safety, quality, teamwork and professional development. The role provides exposure to different turbine technologies and complex technical challenges, with opportunities to contribute field experience to improved tools, methods and ways of working.

You’ll play an important role in:

• Conducting turbine condition assessments, end-of-warranty, component and specialist inspections, producing accurate technical reports.

• Perform advanced diagnostic inspections, including endoscopic and stethoscope assessments.

• Carrying out up-tower repairs and support specialised mechanical and electrical activities, troubleshooting complex faults and identifying practical solutions.

• Working within Ørsted's ISO 17020 accredited inspection framework, ensuring compliance, quality and impartiality standards are maintained.

• Leading technical activities as a technical lead, team lead or client representative, collaborating closely with site teams, project teams, OEMs, contractors and technical specialists.

• Contributing to the development and improvement of tools, RAMS, AWPs, work instructions, testing activities and innovative ways of working.

• Championing a strong safety culture, sharing technical expertise, maintaining required competencies and authorisations, and challenging or stopping work where safe execution cannot be assured.

To succeed in the role, you:

• Hold a relevant technical qualification or equivalent hands-on experience, with strong knowledge of wind turbine technology, ideally gained on SGRE or Vestas platforms.

• Apply strong fault-finding and problem-solving skills to unfamiliar and complex technical challenges, developing safe, practical and professional solutions.

• Work independently, prioritising activities and making sound technical decisions when support is not immediately available on site.

• Adapt quickly to different sites, teams and cultures, building effective relationships and representing Ørsted professionally with internal and external stakeholders.

• Communicate clearly in English, producing accurate, structured technical reports and inspection documentation.

• Demonstrate a collaborative, hands-on approach while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality and professional conduct.

• Be resilient and adaptable, with the ability to undertake extensive international travel and secure the work permits, visas and travel authorisations required for offshore work in the UK, EU, US and Taiwan.

It's an advantage if you also have:

• Experience with endoscopic inspections, turbine condition assessments and component inspections.

• Experience supporting up-tower repairs, major component replacements, technical campaigns and testing activities.

• Relevant OEM authorisations, experience working under Wind Turbine Safety Rules, or within accredited inspection and quality frameworks.

• Strong IT skills, including digital inspection and reporting tools, and additional language capabilities such as German.

The position involves extensive international travel as part of a 14/14 rotation with 12-hour shifts. Assignments may involve unfamiliar sites, teams and working environments. There will also be situations where you are expected to work independently while abroad, while remaining connected to the wider ST&I team. Due to the international nature of the role, candidates must be able to obtain and maintain the necessary work permits, visas and travel documentation required for assignments across the UK, EU, US and Taiwan.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.
