**About GoWish, Ønskeskyen ☁️

**At GoWish, we’re building the world’s leading wish-list and social shopping platform - a place where you can make a real impact and have fun doing it.

We’re on a mission to reinvent gifting for millions. We win together, driven by curiosity, ownership, and bold ideas that turn into real products. We experiment cross-functionally, push for excellence, and keep things playful as we grow - together.

**Team & Role Overview

**We are looking for a systems-minded Senior ML Data Engineer to own the offline-to-online feature infrastructure that powers our real-time recommendation and search engines at scale. You will be building the low-latency data syncs and feature-serving layers that bridge our analytical warehouses with operational databases, caches, and Feature Stores. This is a role for a performance-driven engineer who excels at pipeline orchestration (Airflow, dbt), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Docker), and database tuning, ensuring our recommendation systems receive reliable data under strict low-latency SLAs. If you thrive on solving complex data synchronization challenges, scaling operational storage for millions of users, and acting as the operational bridge between Data Science and Backend Engineering - you will play a critical role in powering our product's core ML capabilities.

**What You'll Do

**

• Offline-to-Online Feature Pipelines: Build and operate resilient feature pipelines syncing transformed data from analytical warehouses (e.g., BigQuery) into operational storage layers (e.g., AlloyDB, Redis, Feature Stores) to serve real-time ML recommendation models at scale.

• Pipeline Orchestration and Transformations: Design, test, and maintain robust Apache Airflow DAGs and modular dbt transformations to automate end-to-end data ingestion and feature generation under strict low-latency SLAs.

• Infrastructure as Code and Reliability: Provision, scale, and automate cloud data infrastructure using Terraform, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines, implementing automated data quality testing and monitoring across all feature syncs.

• Cross-Functional System Design: Partner directly with Data Scientists and Backend Engineers to define online/offline feature contracts, optimize database schemas for sub-second queries, and eliminate training-serving skew for millions of active users.

**What we’re looking for 🌟

****We Imagine That You Have

**

• 4+ years of experience

• Operational Data Pipelines: Proven experience moving batch features from analytical warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake) into low-latency online stores (AlloyDB, Redis, Feature Stores) to serve real-time ML recommendation models.

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Deep hands-on experience provisioning, scaling, and managing cloud data infrastructure using Terraform, Docker, and modern CI/CD automation pipelines.

• Pipeline Orchestration & Transformations: Strong track record building, scheduling, and maintaining workflow orchestrations (e.g., Airflow, Dagster) and modular data transformation frameworks (e.g., dbt).

• Database Performance Tuning: Advanced SQL skills across both OLAP and OLTP systems. Ability to optimize schemas, indexing, partitioning, and queries.

It is further seen as an advantage to have experience with:

• Production Feature Management: Experience managing Feature Stores (e.g., Feast, Tecton) or low-latency key-value stores (e.g., Redis) to serve online ML features with zero training-serving skew.

• Real-Time OLA): Experience with ClickHouse, Pinot, Druid or others for ultra-fast aggregations over live event streams.

• Event Streaming: Hands-on experience with streaming tools like GCP Pub/Sub, Kafka, or Flink for real-time feature updates.

Why GoWish should sit at top of your career wish list 💙

At GoWish, we believe great work comes from people who feel energized, supported, and excited to show up every day. That’s why we’ve built a workplace where celebration, growth, and genuine enjoyment are part of the journey - not perks on the side.

Take your birthday off with Happy Birthday Leave, enjoy 30 days of vacation to fully recharge, and join a team that fills the year with events and playful happenings. We invest in your future with pension and insurance, fuel your days with a weekly lunch scheme, and keep you going with unlimited snacks and sodas - because work should feel good.

At GoWish, you don’t just build great products. You build a great work life.

**Practical information

**We collaborate in a flexible hybrid setup, with most of our magic happening at our bright, modern office in Østerbro - perfectly placed between Nordhavn and Østerport Station. We’re ready for you to join us as soon as you are.

👉 Ready to help shape a platform that already empowers 18+ million users (and counting)? Join us at GoWish - and let’s build the future of data-driven innovation together.

We are looking for a Senior Salesforce Developer with expertise in building robust and scalable solutions to join Trustpilot’s Go-to-Market Technology department. This role will be pivotal in executing large strategic projects within our Salesforce platform, collaborating across our commercial, marketing, and customer service teams.

• Automation: Develop and maintain complex Salesforce Flows and automation, ensuring adherence to best practices and optimal performance.

• Integrations: Integrate Salesforce with internal and external systems using APIs and various integration patterns.

• Peer Review: Participate in code reviews and ensure solutions align with the broader Salesforce ecosystem strategy and coding standards.

• Troubleshooting: Support incident management and processes through custom development and technical troubleshooting.

• Requirement Translation: Collaborate with stakeholders and business analysts to translate complex requirements into technical specifications and high-quality solutions.

• DevOps: Utilize and contribute to CI/CD processes and version control workflows to support a high velocity of work.

• Documentation: Develop and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for Salesforce customizations and integrations.

• Mentorship: Provide guidance and technical coaching to Administrators and junior developers to support their skills development.

Who you are:

Technical Skills

• Certifications: Minimum of Platform Developer I certification; Platform Developer II or Architect-track certifications are highly valued.

• Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Developer, demonstrating a proven track record of developing and deploying complex programmatic solutions.

• Modern Tooling: Extensive experience with Salesforce Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Apex. Experience with Agentforce and Data360 is a plus.

• Code Proficiency: Demonstrated proficiency in SOQL/SOSL, platform events, and asynchronous processing.

• Integrations: Strong understanding of Salesforce APIs (REST, SOAP, Bulk) and integration patterns.

• Security: Deep understanding of Salesforce security models (profiles, permission sets, sharing rules) and their programmatic implications.

• Tools: Proficiency in using developer tools like VS Code, Salesforce CLI, and Git for version control.

Collaboration & Mindset

• Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to conduct technical discussions and explain complex solutions to non-technical stakeholders.

• A proactive and flexible mindset, ready to embrace new challenges in a dynamic development environment.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on writing maintainable, scalable code.

What’s in it for you:

• A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you

• Competitive compensation package + bonus

• 25 days holiday per year, increasing to 28 days after 2 years of employment

• Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community

• Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist

• Full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health

• Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, Trustie Community activities, and team socials

jobs.description:
Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,500+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds in general.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated in our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

While striving to deliver client value, we believe it is vital to consider our people and our planet in every business decision we make. Acting responsibly is not optional. It is essential.

Why This Role is Important to Us

We are looking for Software Engineers at middle level to join our engineering team that builds fintech solutions for managing OTC (Over-The-Counter) financial instruments within our asset management platform, SimCorp Dimension and SimCorp One. Our work delivers value in two major areas. First, we implement new features that drive the business forward and shape the future of our platform. Second, we focus on extending and maintaining our established solutions to ensure our clients’ operations remain uninterrupted and always available.

What You Will Be Responsible For

• 
Designing, building, and extending existing solutions and APIs for our OTC asset management product, delivering value to customers incrementally.

• 
Working primarily in C#. Our codebase also includes OCaml and APL therefore prior experience with these languages is a strong plus.

• 
Understanding, refactoring and modernizing our legacy codebase without disrupting the business it supports.

• 
Focusing on the systems as a whole and being able address fundamental changes that improves the quality, performance and user experience.

• 
Collaborating closely with your product owner to refine requirements, clarify business needs, and shape how features get built.

• 
Working as part of a team of skilled engineers — pairing, reviewing code, and sharing ownership of the solution with fellow engineers.

• 
Following good engineering practice: clean code, automated testing, and CI/CD.

• 
Building, extending and consuming REST APIs.

• 
Communicating clearly with both technical and business stakeholders.

• 
Continuously learning — and helping the team and product grow with you.

Required Skills & Experience

• Interest in creating innovative features for a complex platform, working on areas such as API scalability, automation, performance, and operational resilience - having space to explore, design and influence the final solution.

• Good C# skills. This is the core language for the role; your level of seniority will determine how much ownership and architectural input you're expected to bring.

• Experience with, or genuine interest in, functional programming. Familiarity with OCaml, APL, F#, Standard ML, Scala or Haskell is a real advantage but not required — a willingness to learn is what matters most.

• Experience (or strong interest) in refactoring existing code and working with legacy systems.

• Good collaboration and communication skills, with fluency in English (written and spoken).

• A relevant degree (Computer Science or STEM) with demonstrated hands-on experience in software engineering.

Furthermore, We Value That You Are:

• motivated to work within the financial domain,

• comfortable working closely with a cross-functional team,

• willing to learn and pick up new languages and paradigms as needed,

• able to identify tech debt and help drive incremental improvement,

• a collaborative person willing to share knowledge and learn from your team members.

Our Team and Ways of Working

We deliver solution for large scale financial institutions with billions of dollars in managed assets. Therefore, our work impacts everyday of our customers operations. You will work in a small team of highly skilled engineers on whole SDLC process – from understanding customers' needs, through solutioning and design to coding, testing and maintaining our software. Our hybrid model of working includes two days (minimum) in our Copenhagen office and up to three days working remotely. Codebase includes a mix of C#, OCaml and APL which gives broad opportunities to upskill and drive your career with us. We invest a lot in your understanding of both the technical details of the solution and financial knowledge that will allow you to contribute to building the future of asset management.

Our Benefits

Competitive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, at SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide an excellent work-life balance: flexible work hours, a hybrid workplace model. On top of that, we have IP innovation sprints, where you have dedicated time per quarter to spend on mastering your skills as well as contributing to the company development. There is never just one route — we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

Next Steps

Please click below to apply. Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your CV in English as soon as possible. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is the right fit, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process, we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

Every year, European governments spend billions on mobility: subsidies, contracts, licences, public transport. Most of that money is spent with no clear idea of what it buys for society.

We're building the tech layer that changes that.

What we do

Impact Market builds MIMA, the Mobility Impact Market. On our platform, cities and transport authorities incentivise mobility operators (bike share, e-scooters, car-pooling, car sharing, bike leasing) for trips according to their benefit to society: a car trip replaced, emissions avoided, space and congestion saved, health improved, a neighbourhood connected. By estimating the socio-economic impact of each trip, we design smart incentives that get the most social value out of public funds.

The idea is much bigger than mobility: governments paying for the outcomes they want, with the evidence to back it up. Mobility is our first market, and we intend to move into other areas of public spending.

Where we are

• 
Funded with 12+ months runway

• 
Several paying public-sector clients

• 
A production platform (prod + staging), with live trip and rider-survey data from operators flowing in since August 2026

• 
A team of 3. You'd be number 4.

The role

You'll be our first technical hire and will lead product and engineering. For now that means hands fully dirty: you write the code. No agencies, no outsourcing.

• 
Own the platform. Rust, Postgres, cloud, our RiderSurvey API, and the data pipelines from operators. You'll inherit a working MVP and decide what to keep, what to rebuild and what to build next.

• 
Make the big calls, including the language. We chose Rust deliberately: we think a strict compiler and type system are the right guardrails for building fast with AI. If you have a better argument for something else, convince us.

• 
Be AI-native. We expect you to use AI seriously in coding and every other technical task. That's how a team of four does the work of fifteen.

• 
Build agents that run the company with us, for account management, client reporting and forecasting.

• 
Grow into the science. Together with a future R&D lead, you'll work on the statistical significance of measured impacts and on forecasting how markets respond to incentives.

• 
Shape the product with the founders and our clients. You'll be in the room with transport authorities, not behind a ticket queue.

You

• 
Have minimum 4 years of relevant experience shipping production software, ideally backend or data-heavy systems

• 
Senior and still love writing code every day? Even better.

• 
Know Rust, or are genuinely motivated to go deep in it (not just "willing"). (We are not dogmatic about Rust, but we have a working platform built with care, so changing direction would take strong conviction.)

• 
Already build with AI tools daily and have opinions about how to do it well

• 
Are comfortable with data: SQL, pipelines, and an appetite for statistics and forecasting

• 
Take ownership when things are ambiguous, and like it when nobody tells you how

• 
Care about the mission. You don't need to have read our founder's book, The Next Democracy, but its core ideas about how citizens and governments could work together - is fundamental to what we do. If they don’t excite you, this probably isn't the right fit.

Bonus points for experience in mobility or transport, govtech, causal inference or experimentation, or privacy-by-design and GDPR.

What we offer

• 
A real say in everything. Stack, product, architecture, culture and who we hire next.

• 
Title decided together. We're advertising this as CTO / Founding Engineer and will settle the title with you based on your experience and ambitions.

• 
Competitive startup salary plus a meaningful warrant package, designed to make total compensation comparable with bigger-company offers

• 
5 weeks of holiday and flexible hours

• 
Work that matters. Help redirect public money towards what actually improves people's lives.

Location

Copenhagen is our home, and we'd love you here; relocation is very welcome. If you stay elsewhere, you must be based in the EU and work in EU time zones. You'd spend your first 1–2 months with us in Copenhagen, then 2–4 days here every month after that.

Process

• 
Quick online intro call with Erdem (CEO)

• 
In-person meeting

• 
A challenge based on a real problem from our platform

• 
Second meeting with the team

• 
Offer

About Photoncycle

Solar panels make plenty of power in summer and very little in winter, when we need it most. Photoncycle solves that for households. We store energy from the summer sun, so that the it can be used all winter. When there’s excess energy, we sell the surplus to the grid, where it helps balance supply and demand. Households pay a fixed monthly fee; we build, install and operate the system.

Our mission is to accelerate the transition to a more renewable, balanced, and secure energy system. Photoncycle systems enable households to use homegrown energy year-round for electricity, heat, and hot water, while also helping the grid balance production and consumption peaks. This enables the transition away from fossil-based energy.

Our customers are central to that mission. Every home we power is proof that energy independence is possible, and the stories of those homeowners are one of our strongest tools for reaching the next ones.

We are a team of 25 employees across offices in Oslo and Copenhagen. In 2026, we raised a €15 million Series A backed by NordicNinja, Voima Ventures, Lifeline Ventures, Eviny Ventures, Luminar Ventures and Momentum. We're now moving from full-scale pilot to commercial rollout, with the first phase of our production facility coming online in 2027.

The Role

We are looking for a Storyteller to own content creation and community management for our customers. Your main goal is to engage our customers with compelling, on-brand content, and to make Photoncycle something people want to follow, talk about and belong to.

You will shape how Photoncycle shows up on all communications channels, in both Danish and English. That means developing content concepts for social media, writing for our different platforms, and working with external photographers, videographers and agencies to bring ideas to life. You will also be the voice of our brand in our community channels, and you will create moments that bring customers, their neighbours, and future customers together.

Much of this is still unbuilt. Our Danish rollout is in its early phase, so you will spend a considerable amount of time testing formats, trying new ideas, and learning what resonates. We value creativity, curiosity, a structured way of working, and the ability to connect what you create to what the company and the customer actually need, not just the next post in the calendar.

You don't need to be an energy expert from day one. We will support you in learning about the energy markets, and there are experts to help you anytime.

You will join the the small Danish team that is building the market from the ground up, while also contributing to the global storytelling of Photoncycle. You will work closely with operations, product and our marketing colleagues in Oslo to turn a deep-tech product into stories people understand and remember.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Develop and own the content strategy and content calendar across our channels, in Danish and English, tied to clear goals for engagement, awareness and customer loyalty.

• 
Shape the Photoncycle brand story, from our mission to the everyday lives of the homeowners who live with our system.

• 
Develop content concepts and recurring formats for social media that fit how each platform works.

• 
Write copy for our different platforms, including social media, newsletters, website, customer communication, and customer stories.

• 
Brief and manage external partners (photographers, videographers, agencies and freelancers) from concept to final delivery.

• 
Manage our customer community: engage, respond, moderate, spark conversations, and share customer insights with sales, service and product.

• 
Track performance, report on engagement and reach, and use the data to improve what we do.

What We're Looking For

Must-have experience

• 
Experience with concept development, content strategy and creation, brand storytelling or social media, in-house or at an agency.

• 
Excellent written Danish and strong written English.

• 
A solid understanding of the logic of social media platforms: algorithms, formats, and what drives reach and engagement.

• 
Strong project management skills: able to run several projects in parallel and deliver on time.

• 
Ability to explain complex or technical topics in plain, human language.

• 
Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where the right answer isn't known yet.

Nice-to-have

• 
Experience working with external partners to produce content, such as video and images.

• 
Experience with community management or building online and offline communities.

• 
Background in energy, climate tech, home improvement, or other considered consumer purchases.

• 
Hands-on skills in short-form video, photo editing or design tools, for example CapCut, Adobe or Canva.

• 
Experience with social analytics, newsletter tools, CRM, or paid social.

We welcome applicants across experience levels, from motivated early-career storytellers to more senior profiles. If you bring a strong creative sense and genuine curiosity for this domain, we encourage you to apply even if you do not match every item above exactly.

What Success Looks Like for the Team You'll Join

• 
Photoncycle has a recognisable, consistent brand voice that customers and prospects engage with.

• 
Our customers feel part of a community and share their experience with neighbours, friends and online.

• 
Content formats, partners and processes are in place so we can produce high-quality content at a steady pace, and scale it to new markets.

• 
The team makes better marketing and customer decisions by bringing engagement data and customer insight into the discussion, and you'll be part of making that happen.

What We Offer

• 
The opportunity to shape the voice of a high-impact climate technology company in one of its first markets.

• 
A central role in connecting Photoncycle's customers, product and brand.

• 
A collaborative, mission-driven culture with significant ownership.

• 
An office in the heart of Copenhagen at BLOXhub with lunch benefits and unlimited coffee.

Photoncycle is committed to building an inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential.

Digital Operations Manager (Mid, DACH region) Aarhus or Hamburg | Full-time | Hybrid (3+ days a week in the office)

About AutoUncle

Buying a used car is one of the biggest purchases most people make, and one of the hardest to get right. Is the price fair? What will it really cost? AutoUncle was founded to answer those questions. Today, car buyers across Europe use our websites and apps to compare almost every used car for sale and see whether the price is right, for free.

The car dealerships that sell to those buyers are our customers. Over 700 of them use AutoUncle to sell more cars. We send them buyers who are ready to act, and we put tools on their websites that turn visitors into leads.

Now we're going a step further. CoDriver, our newest product, is an AI assistant that answers every lead a dealer gets, on every channel, day or night, and keeps the conversation going until the buyer is ready. We're no longer just sending buyers to dealers; we're helping them close the sale.

Why we’re hiring

AutoUncle is growing fast. More dealers are signing up, and more of them are choosing CoDriver, which connects directly to their CRM, lead providers and website. Every new customer means a new setup to get right and keep running.

The Digital Operations Team

That's where our Digital Operations Team comes in. Sales wins the customer; Digital Operations makes our products work for them. The team gets new dealers live, keeps their integrations healthy and fixes issues quickly when something breaks. A dealer only sees value once leads are flowing, so this team has a direct hand in whether customers stay and grow with us.

The team works across Denmark, Germany and Italy, and we're looking to add someone in the near future to our DACH team to support our growth in the region.

Your mission

Own the technical setup for a portfolio of 60–80 DACH customers, from first call to go-live and beyond. Make sure every product we deliver is properly integrated, measurable from day one, and keeps working.

Day to day, you’ll:

• 
Lead technical onboardings. Connect our products with dealer websites, CRM systems and inventory feeds, and coordinate more complex or tailored integrations.

• 
Join customer meetings alongside Sales, answer technical questions in German and set clear expectations on feasibility and go-live timelines.

• 
Pick up the phone to unblock setups. Reach out to web agencies, CRM providers and dealer IT contacts to solve problems quickly.

• 
Diagnose tracking and data issues. Investigate GA4, Google Tag Manager, consent mode and event tracking when numbers don’t add up, and find out why, not just what.

• 
Customize and improve. Adjust widgets with custom CSS and improve our standard integrations to give customers’ website visitors a better experience.

• 
Keep your portfolio healthy with regular health checks, inventory quality checks and proactive monitoring.

• 
Build repeatable systems. Turn recurring problems into standard workflows, documentation, and AI workflows and automations the whole team uses, and work with product and tech colleagues to drive improvements.

What you bring

• 
Native or near-native German, and fluent English (our company language)

• 
2+ years of experience in technical integrations, implementation, digital operations or a similar role, ideally in B2B SaaS

• 
Hands-on experience with web analytics and tracking (GA4, Google Tag Manager or similar). You understand events, conversions and consent mode well enough to troubleshoot them

• 
A basic understanding of APIs and how systems exchange data

• 
HTML/CSS skills for adjusting and troubleshooting website integrations

• 
Confidence picking up the phone and working with both technical (developers, CRM providers) and non-technical (dealers, sales teams) contacts

• 
A structured way of working: you run several setups at once, prioritize your own pipeline and follow through without being chased

• 
You already use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT or similar) to get real work done, and you can tell us about something you automated or made faster.

Nice to have:

• 
Experience in the automotive industry or at a web agency

• 
Experience with HubSpot or dealer CRM systems

What we offer

• 
€54,600–67,800 gross annual (final salary depending on experience)

• 
Extended social benefits; including 30 holiday days + local holidays, extended parental leave, etc. See more in our Employee Handbook!

• 
Structured training in your first three months, alongside experienced teammates, on our products (Traffic Performance, Website Booster and CoDriver),and how dealerships work

• 
A clear path to Senior Digital Operations Manager, by owning a specialist area such as data quality, website tracking or partner integrations

• 
A growth review every six months and support from your manager to plan your next step

• 
Impact you can see: when a dealer goes live and the leads start coming in, you made that happen

How we work

We're AI-native, and you'll help shape how we use AI in customer operations.

AutoUncle moves fast, and priorities can change from week to week. If you haven't worked somewhere like this before, that's fine. If the idea sounds exciting rather than stressful, you'll fit right in.

We hire for four traits we call "the Ticket": being ambitious, humble and coachable, with a bias for action. We also live by the Five Cs: Clear, Courage, Curiosity, Commitment and Compassion. Our Employee Handbook gives a good feel for how we work.

The process

• 
Intro call with our Talent Acquisition team

• 
Interview with the hiring managers, conducted in English. Then a short conversation in German with a team member

• 
A short personality test (online, in your own time), followed by a case interview where you’ll also meet the team

• 
Reference checks

A once-in-a-company opportunity to lead engineering early as the company scales! 🚀

At proprty.ai, we’re building domain-specific AI for data-driven building maintenance and portfolio planning. Our predictive models estimate the condition and remaining lifespan of building components, and we turn that into prioritised maintenance plans across entire portfolios. Our AI agent, Tily, can take action on users' behalf and help them run strategic analysis of their building portfolio, helping large property owners and managers maintain their buildings efficiently, cost-effectively and sustainably.

The product went live in 2024 and is already solving real problems for real people, with customers across Denmark, Norway, and Germany. There is still so much we can do to make it even better, and you could help shape the future of building maintenance – and how engineering is run at proprty.ai.

What we're looking for

We're looking for a player-coach who loves leading engineers and still wants to write code. You might coach a developer through a tricky problem in the morning and ship a feature yourself in the afternoon.

You've led an engineering team before at a startup or scale-up where the foundations were still being laid, and you know that in a small team, leadership means leading by doing. You care about shipping fast and shipping well.

We're an AI-first company (it's in our name). You've built AI agents and AI features into real products, and you're excited to push that further, both in what we build for customers and in how the team works.

About the team

We're a small but mighty crew of four engineers who love solving tricky problems together, working on-site in our office near Rådhuspladsen. We work closely with our data science team to bring machine learning models trained on millions of m² of building data into the product. We talk a lot (in a good way), pair up when things get tough, and keep the vibe light with plenty of jokes and good energy.

About the role

• 
Lead, coach, and grow the team as a player-coach, while still writing code on core features

• 
Own how we build and ship. Our goal is to release several times a week without letting quality, reliability, or security slip

• 
Guide the platform's technical direction, including architecture and code quality

• 
Design and build AI agents and AI features into the product, and work with Data Science to take models from prototype to production

• 
Help turn input from customers, Sales and Customer Success into features the team can build

• 
Improve the team's AI tools and workflows (we use Cursor and Perplexity) so everyone can build faste

About you

• 
You've led an engineering team before at a startup or scale-up, including coaching and hiring developers

• 
You have strong hands-on full-stack experience with React, TypeScript and SQL

• 
You've built (or have strong interest in) AI agents and AI features in production

• 
You take full ownership from design to implementation, and you lead by doing

• 
You live in the Copenhagen area (we're in the office 4 days a week)

• 
Bonus points if you've worked with Postgres and Next.js, or in real estate or proptech

Even if you don't tick every box, we'd still love to hear from you if you're an experienced engineering leader who learns fast and loves building things!

TL;DR

Want to get in early with a great team? Love leading engineers and still writing code? Apply now to lead our dev team and make building maintenance smarter and more sustainable with AI.

For more information or questions please contact us at ss@proprty.ai

proprty.ai is building a service to help Danish property managers leverage machine learning technology to create better condition assessments and maintenance plans. The cost of maintaining the Danish property mass is growing fast, and property managers are struggling to keep up with maintenance and regulatory responsibilities. This is not only hurting the property managers, but also the people using and living in the buildings. The challenge to live up to the EU Taxonomy for Sustainable Activities, is made harder, by not having the tools nor data to make the right strategic choices when planning and executing maintenance. With our service we aim to create property condition assessment and maintenance plans faster and more accurately than what is possible today. Using machine learning algorithms trained on millions of m2 worth of data, we can provide property managers with data to make the right decisions, when it comes to spending resources on maintenance. That way they can cut costs, improve property conditions and push the property mass towards a sustainable future. We're creating an AI powered web platform, that allows property managers to create condition assessments and maintenance plans in a fraction of the time they're using today, by mixing output from our machine learning models with boots on the ground input. It's not only faster. It provides high quality data instead of subjective information. At proprty.ai we've already signed partnerships with 18% of the Danish residential property market. We have a very real problem to solve, and a strong team to do it.

Mechanical Engineer – FLOWVISION A/S

About FLOWVISION A/S

FLOWVISION A/S is a Danish engineering company founded in 2006, specialized in designing and delivering advanced emission abatement systems for combustion-based power plants worldwide. Since 2021, the company has been part of AXENS GROUP, while continuing to operate as an independent business with its own organization, commercial responsibility, and market-facing role.

The company operates in an international EPC environment and delivers technically advanced solutions to customers within the energy, oil & gas, and industrial sectors across multiple global markets. FLOWVISION collaborates closely with major international players and is recognized for its strong technical know-how, high-quality standards, and ability to solve complex engineering challenges.

Today, FLOWVISION employs around 20 highly skilled specialists, creating a strong concentration of technical competencies and deep industry expertise. This gives the company the agility and close collaboration of a small expert team, combined with the backing and broader industrial context of being part of Axens.

FLOWVISION offers a flat organizational structure, short decision-making processes, and a collaborative culture where openness, knowledge sharing, and teamwork are essential parts of everyday life.

The company is currently experiencing significant growth and a strong order intake, creating attractive opportunities for professionals who want to influence both project execution and the continued development of the business.

The position

As Mechanical Engineer, you will become part of FLOWVISION’s highly specialized engineering environment and play a key role in the execution of technically advanced international EPC projects.

You will work closely with our Lead Mechanical Engineer, Project Managers, workshops, suppliers, and external engineering partners to ensure that mechanical designs, fabrication documentation, and technical solutions are delivered with high quality and according to demanding project timelines.

The role combines hands-on engineering with close interaction across fabrication, welding, procurement, and project execution activities. You will contribute throughout the entire project lifecycle — from bid clarification and design reviews to fabrication support, inspections, and final documentation.

This is a role for someone who enjoys solving practical engineering challenges, working close to production realities, and operating in an environment where technical quality, collaboration, and execution are critical to success.

You will also have the opportunity to influence engineering processes and contribute to the continued professionalization and growth of the business.

Key responsibilities

Mechanical project execution

• Participate in technical reviews of RFQ packages and specifications during bidding and project execution phases.

• Support clarification processes and ensure alignment of technical scope, assumptions, and interfaces.

• Define mechanical design requirements and coordinate engineering inputs towards external engineering and drafting partners.

• Work with mechanical drawings and technical documentation, including general arrangements, structural steel drawings, piping layouts, isometrics, and fabrication documentation.

• Support structured engineering milestone reviews and contribute to design acceptance and design freeze activities.

• Identify and resolve technical issues, deviations, and design changes throughout the project lifecycle.

• Assess manufacturability and propose practical engineering improvements related to fabrication, welding, installation, and assembly.

Fabrication, welding & workshop interface

• Act as a daily technical interface towards workshops and fabrication partners.

• Handle technical clarifications during fabrication and pre-assembly activities.

• Participate in workshop activities such as PIM, pre-FAT, FAT, inspections, and technical follow-up.

• Support resolution of punch items, deviations, and non-conformities together with Project Management and QHSE.

Documentation & engineering coordination

• Prepare and consolidate mechanical engineering documentation for customer deliveries.

• Work actively with engineering data, revisions, BOM structures, and document control processes.

• Support procurement activities through technical review of supplier quotations and deviations.

• Contribute to maintaining technical quality, traceability, and compliance across all project phases.

Qualifications

We expect you to have:

• A technical degree within Mechanical Engineering or a similar engineering discipline.

• Experience from project-based engineering environments, fabrication, workshops, or EPC project execution.

• Practical exposure to welding, piping, valves, structural steel, or process equipment.

• Strong ability to read, review, and assess mechanical and fabrication drawings.

jobs.occupation: Advances in NMR techniques for next generation Foodomics
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Food Science programme. The position is available from 01 February 2026 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
Advances in NMR techniques for next generation Foodomics

Research area and project description
The Department of Food Science at Aarhus University is inviting applications for a Ph.D. student position focused on the development and applications of NMR spectroscopy in the characterization of foods - Foodomics.

Foodomics is a scientific approach that studies food, nutrition and their effects on health using omics technologies. NMR spectroscopy has played a key role in establishing Foodomics and has offered distinctive insights into foods’ health-promoting potential as well as their functional characteristics. However, ¹H NMR spectroscopy, which is the current workhorse of NMR-based Foodomics, has some analytical limitations. Thus, spectral overlap renders substantial parts of the food metabolome unidentified.

This PhD project aims at developing and examining new and alternative NMR-based approaches within Foodomics. This includes elucidating the potential of ¹³C NMR spectroscopy, which so far has been limited applied in Foodomics. For this purpose, sensitivity-enhancement strategies will be explored, including a dissolution dynamic nuclear polarization technique (d-DNP). This will be done in collaboration with a prominent European d-DNP group.

The PhD project will entail studies on new foods of alternative sources and/or derived from innovative biotechnological processing techniques and solutions.

Tasks and responsibilities include:

• 
Conduct research on development and applications of NMR spectroscopy in food science.

• 
Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team including a 4-6-months stay in an international research environment abroad.

• 
Design and implement experiments, collect and analyse data, and interpret results.

• 
Present findings at conferences and publish research in reputable peer-reviewed journals.

• 
Participate in outreach activities to disseminate research outcomes to stakeholders and contribute to teaching in the department

Qualifications and specific competences
Applicants must have a relevant master’s degree (120 ECTS) in chemistry, biotechnology, food technology, or in a related field.

The preferred candidate has substantial hands-on experience in NMR spectroscopy. Relevant expertise in food science, foodomics, multivariate data analysis and good analytical skills is an advantage.

The successful candidate should be motivated to combine laboratory work and experiments, data processing and analysis and ability to work independently and as part of a team in an international research environment.

Place of employment and place of work
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Department of Food Science, Agro Food Park 48, Dk-8200 Aarhus N., Denmark.

Contacts
Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:

• 
Hanne Christine Bertram, e-mail: Hannec.bertram@food.au.dk (main supervisor)

For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:

• 
admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk

How to apply

Application deadline is 26 November 2026 at 23:59 CET.

Preferred starting date is 01 February 2027.

For technical reasons, you must upload a project description. Please copy the project description above and upload it as a PDF in the application.

Please make a project description (½-4 pages). The project description should describe your ideas and research plans for this specific project. If you wish to, you can indicate an URL where further information can be found.

Please note:

• 
Only documents received prior to the application deadline will be evaluated. Thus, documents sent after deadline will not be considered.

• 
The programme committee may request further information or invite the applicant to attend an interview.

• 
Shortlisting will be used, which means that the evaluation committee only will evaluate the most relevant applications.

Formalities and salary range
Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which everyone has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

jobs.occupation: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) wanted for strong, supportive team
jobs.description:
Design solutions that solve whole classes of problems rather than individual tasks. As a Senior SRE at Systematic, you keep the systems running that healthcare staff and patients depend on.

Would you like to shape the future of our infrastructure by designing scalable, elegant solutions that solve classes of problems rather than individual tasks? Join our skilled Site Reliability Engineering team where you’ll have the opportunity to think beyond the immediate fix and architect systems that transform how we operate at scale. Your work will keep healthcare solutions running for the clinicians and care staff who depend on them.

The job

As a Senior SRE with a systems engineering mindset, you’ll work at the intersection of deep technical expertise and strategic thinking. You’ll identify patterns across our diverse infrastructure, from Kubernetes clusters to Azure VMs, and create unified solutions that eliminate entire categories of operational toil. This isn’t about fixing one deployment pipeline; it’s about building a framework that makes all deployments reliable. This isn’t about patching one vulnerability; it’s about architecting a security posture that scales across our organization.

You’ll have access to cutting-edge technologies and the autonomy to innovate, with opportunities to work across multiple environments including our ao-admin Kubernetes cluster, Docker-based deployments, Azure-hosted infrastructure, and healthcare-focused systems. When you are ready, you will join the SRE team’s on-call rotation.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Architect automation systems that eliminate classes of manual work, thinking in terms of platforms and capabilities rather than individual scripts

• Develop infrastructure tooling that empowers development teams to self-service their operational needs while maintaining reliability standards

• Build observability frameworks that provide unified insights across diverse environments, making patterns visible and actionable

• Create abstraction layers that hide complexity while providing powerful capabilities, whether through Terraform modules, Helm charts, or custom operators

• Drive infrastructure evolution by identifying systemic improvements and leading their implementation from concept to production

• Collaborate with development teams to understand their patterns of needs and design operations-ready solutions that scale

• Mentor team members in systems thinking and architectural approaches, sharing your problem-solving methodology

• Apply best practices in site reliability engineering, advocating for solutions that improve reliability, security, and maintainability at scale

• Research and prototype emerging technologies and approaches, evaluating their fit for solving our systemic challenges

Joining the team

You’ll join one of our two skilled SRE teams, each consisting of approximately 10 professionals working from our offices in Aarhus and Bucharest. Our teams operate with a DevOps philosophy and use a mix of Scrum and Kanban methodologies depending on the project needs.

We value engineers who can see the forest and the trees, who understand both the technical details and the broader patterns. You’ll work with colleagues who manage everything from Kubernetes clusters to Windows VMs, from Terraform modules to Prometheus monitoring, and you’ll help us find the common threads that allow us to operate more efficiently and reliably.

This is a role with significant room to manoeuvre and influence. You’ll have the opportunity to work with the newest technologies while solving real operational challenges that impact critical systems across multiple domains. Our healthcare solutions, such as Columna, support the continuum of care across hospitals, communities and private homes, so your work contributes directly to patient safety.

Your qualifications

Our ideal candidate is someone who gets excited about patterns, who sees a specific problem and immediately starts thinking “what other problems does this represent?” You’re the engineer who, when asked to automate a deployment, designs a deployment framework. When asked to fix a monitoring gap, you create an observability strategy.

Our ideal candidate would have:

• Experience as a Senior in site reliability engineering, systems engineering, or platform engineering roles with demonstrated impact on infrastructure scalability

• Solid understanding of abstraction and design patterns in infrastructure, with experience creating reusable frameworks, modules, or platforms

• Experience with observability at scale, including metrics, logging, and tracing systems (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or similar)

• Strong communication skills to articulate architectural decisions, document systems, and mentor others in systems thinking

• Proven ability to architect solutions that solve multiple problems simultaneously, with examples of platforms or systems you’ve built

We value diverse backgrounds and encourage candidates who are passionate about systems thinking, infrastructure architecture, and solving problems at scale to apply, even if they do not meet every requirement perfectly!

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Join us in this role where you’ll develop actionable trading views across European power markets, with a focus on North-West Europe and the UK. Working directly with our Senior Trader on the Revenue Desk, you’ll turn fundamental market analysis into strategic recommendations that shape our hedging and proprietary trading positions on the curve up to 5 years out.

**Welcome to Trading & Revenue

**You’ll be part of Price Forecasting & Analysis, a team of dedicated trading analysts and model developers with diverse backgrounds in commodity market analysis, forecasting, and advanced analytics. We have dedicated model developers, so your focus will be on market research and trading support — not building models from scratch.

We value flexibility, experimentation, and knowledge sharing, working in virtual teams with experienced traders, analysts, meteorologists and other specialists. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we especially encourage women and candidates from underrepresented backgrounds to apply.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• Developing and communicating actionable trading views on European power markets

• Identifying fundamental shifts - supply/demand, policy, weather, interconnector flows - and translating them into trading recommendations

• Collaborating with internal and external analysts to refine market views

• Collaborating directly with the Senior Trader to refine hedging and prop trading strategies

• Performing deep-dive market research on themes that drive power prices across Europe

• Providing fundamental inputs for our price forecasting models and analytics

• Mentoring and educating colleagues on power market dynamics

• Improving our products including price forecasts and trading signal

• Contributing to growing our trading PnL.

**What makes this role stand out:

**

• Direct P&L impact - your recommendations feed straight into trading decisions, not a report that sits on a shelf

• Close to the action - you sit with the trading desk, not in a back-office analytics function

• Green energy trading - your analysis shapes how a global leader in renewable energy trades power

• Ownership - you’ll have the autonomy to drive your own research agenda and trading views

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• Have extensive, hands on experience providing trading driven market research and recommendations within power markets, gained in a trading house, power utility, bank, hedge fund or equivalent trading environment

• Have a proven track record of supporting hedging and proprietary trading decisions, with demonstrated impact on positioning and results

• Have deep understanding of European power market fundamentals and their interaction with forwards, options, and curve dynamics

• Have strong analytical and numerical skills, with the ability to form clear, well reasoned market views under uncertainty

• Have the ability to communicate complex analysis into decisive, trader ready recommendations

• Have a Master’s degree in economics, finance, energy, engineering or a related quantitative field or a Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA®) designation.

**It would be great if you also have:

**

• Experience with North-Western European power markets specifically

• Familiarity with fundamental power market stack modelling concepts

• Experience mentoring or coaching junior analysts

• A passion for continuous improvement, innovation, and knowledge sharing

• Proficiency in Python and experience with statistical analysis and time series analysis.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

**Certain positions may require a background check as part of the hiring process. If applicable, you will be informed during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the teams by creating or helping create great guest experiences, and use every day as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer or staff member; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of people who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You'll learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path—our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**We are looking for an FP&A Specialist to strengthen our Corporate FP&A team and take ownership of cash flow forecasting, balance sheet planning, working capital management, and other key planning activities below Adjusted EBITDA across the Group.

Reporting directly to the Head of FP&A, you will play a key role in advancing our financial planning capabilities and driving transparency across cash flow, liquidity, and balance sheet performance. You will work closely with Accounting, Tax, Controlling, regional Finance teams, and key business stakeholders to ensure robust planning processes and high-quality management reporting.

This is a unique opportunity to:

• Take ownership of the Group's cash flow, balance sheet, and working capital planning agenda, helping to improve cash generation and support management decision-making.

• Shape and develop our Workday Adaptive Planning capabilities, leading key initiatives to establish scalable planning models and reporting structures.

• Work across markets and functions, partnering with regional Finance teams and senior stakeholders to strengthen forecasting, reporting, and business insight throughout the organization.

The successful candidate will help establish best-in-class planning processes that connect P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow forecasting, providing management with greater visibility into liquidity, working capital performance, and long-term value creation. The role is a full-time role and reports to the Head of Group Financial Planning & Analysis.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Own the Group's cash flow planning across forecast, budget, and long-range planning cycles.

• Drive the development of balance sheet forecasting capabilities and ensure alignment between P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow planning.

• Lead the implementation and continuous development of cash flow and balance sheet planning models in Workday Adaptive Planning.

• Define business requirements and partner closely with the BI Team to improve planning processes, reporting capabilities, and system functionality.

• Partner with Accounting, Controlling, Tax, and regional Finance teams to strengthen cash flow and balance sheet reporting, improve forecast accuracy, and establish clear ownership across planning activities.

• Develop and maintain monthly cash flow, balance sheet, and working capital reporting, including variance analysis, key risks and opportunities, and actionable management insights.

• Establish and maintain a clear RACI framework across Finance for balance sheet and cash flow planning, forecasting, and follow-up activities.

• Develop driver-based forecasting methodologies for key working capital metrics, including inventory, receivables, payables, and other material balance sheet accounts.

• Monitor working capital performance and identify opportunities to improve cash conversion and optimize working capital.

• Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, Accounting, and Controlling to strengthen understanding of working capital drivers and improve forecast accuracy.

• Support Executive Management and Board reporting by providing insights on cash generation, liquidity, working capital performance, and financial risks and opportunities.

• Drive continuous improvement of forecasting methodologies, planning processes, and financial transparency across the organization.

• Support the ongoing development of FP&A capabilities by integrating balance sheet and cash flow considerations into strategic and long-range planning processes.

**WHO YOU ARE

**You are a curious and analytical finance professional with a passion for turning data into insights and helping the business make better decisions. You enjoy working across functions, building strong stakeholder relationships, and taking ownership of complex planning processes.

You thrive in a dynamic and growing environment and are comfortable navigating between operational details and the bigger picture. You enjoy driving improvements, challenging assumptions, and creating structure where it is needed.

You are comfortable working across Finance functions and partnering with regional Finance teams to improve forecasting, strengthen financial transparency, and drive continuous improvement. Most importantly, you are proactive, structured, and motivated by creating impact through high-quality financial planning and analysis.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• 5+ years of experience within FP&A, Financial Controlling, Corporate Finance, or a similar role.

• Strong understanding of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning.

• Experience working with cash flow forecasting, working capital, balance sheet analysis, or investment planning.

• Solid financial modelling and analytical skills, including advanced Excel capabilities.

• Experience with Workday Adaptive Planning or other EPM/planning tools is an advantage.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• A proactive mindset and a passion for improving processes, systems, and ways of working.

• Experience from retail, hospitality, food & beverage, consumer goods, or other multi-site businesses is considered a plus.

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

**Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

****ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

A data platform for life science research, where experiments, data and workflows stay structured, traceable and easy to share. Dalea is a data management platform for research in biotech, pharma and academic labs. Scientists keep experiments, structured data, samples and inventory in one place, with full data provenance, in tools that feel familiar to anyone coming from Excel and Word. Today, much of that work is scattered across spreadsheets, personal computers and paper notebooks. Results are hard to find and harder to trust, so teams often re-run experiments rather than track down the ones they’ve already done. In Dalea, everything a lab builds can be packaged and shared: templates, add-ons and whole workflows. Labs can publish, discuss and reuse each other’s work instead of rebuilding it from scratch. Think of it as a GitHub for life science. The same structured, traceable data is what lets AI agents work reliably on real lab data. Dalea is built for regulated research. It has a full audit log, 21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11 compliant infrastructure, and full provenance for everything that happens in the platform. It’s hosted in the EU. We’re a small team at BioInnovation Institute in Copenhagen, working with biotech startups, academic labs, pharma R&D teams and CROs.

Security: access control, encryption, logging and incident response.

• 
Our GxP setup, which is already built: a full audit log, 21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11 compliant infrastructure, W3C PROV provenance for every entity and operation, rollback engines, and export to machine-readable regulatory formats. You'll audit it, maintain it and make it better.

• 
Our ISO 27001 certification and the controls behind it.

• 
Controlled releases, and validation support for customers who run GxP work in Dalea.

• 
Making trust verifiable: clear security and compliance documentation, and joining customer reviews when the questions get technical.

What you bring

Must-haves

• 
You've owned production infrastructure and deployment (containers, CI/CD, cloud) for a system holding sensitive data.

• 
Hands-on security engineering: access control, encryption, logging and incident response.

• 
Hands-on experience with ISO 27001 or SOC 2, or with GxP and regulated software (computer system validation, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11). One of the two is enough.

• 
You've built and maintained production platform software in a small team or early product where you made decisions.

Nice to have (none of them required)

• 
Experience with both compliance areas above

• 
Vendor audits by pharma customers

• 
Part 11 or Annex 11 systems in practice

• 
Provenance or lineage systems (W3C PROV)

• 
Customer security questionnaires

• 
Kubernetes

• 
TypeScript or Python

You don't need deep frontend skills, lab or biology knowledge, a PhD or Danish. If you match the must-haves, apply, even if you have none of the nice-to-haves.

Our stack

TypeScript, Next.js and React. Python for our MCP service. An agent harness built on Mastra. Docker Compose and Kubernetes, hosted on Scaleway.

How we work

Our dev team is the two founders plus up to three new developers, led by our CTO. We discuss progress and priorities closely and continuously, and we expect you to take part: share ideas early, argue for what you think is right, and change course when the evidence says so.

You won't need permission to fix what's broken, and what you build reaches production quickly. We work together at BioInnovation Institute 3–5 days a week. We're building the team and the way we work, and that happens best in person.

About Dalea

Dalea is a data management platform for biology and lab workflows. Experiments, structured data, samples and inventory sit in one place, with full data provenance. Everything a lab builds in Dalea can be packaged and shared, so we're building a GitHub for life science: labs publish and reuse each other's workflows instead of rebuilding them from scratch. We work with biotech startups, academic labs, pharma R&D and CROs.

Timing and our funding round

This position depends on our current funding round closing, which we expect in February/March 2027. We can make a conditional offer before then, and we'll be open with you about the timing throughout the process.

What we offer

• 
Salary: DKK 725,000–900,000 per year, depending on experience

• 
Warrants: under the Danish §7P scheme

• 
Pension: through ASE

• 
Location: BioInnovation Institute, Copenhagen, on-site 3–5 days a week. You'll need to live in the Copenhagen area or be willing to move here. We're happy to hear from people relocating within the EU.

• 
Language: English

• 
Start: when the round closes

How to apply

Apply here with your LinkedIn profile, your CV and short answers to a few questions. No cover letter needed.

We're also hiring a Senior AI Engineer. You're welcome to apply for more than one.

For more information or questions please contact us at recruiting@dalea.tech

**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Head of Medical Affairs International Markets
jobs.description:
Are you knowledgeable within allergy treatment? Do you like working in an international setting facing different cultures? Bring your expertise in allergy, immunology and medical strategy to a global role where your scientific leadership can make a meaningful difference.

The position

The Head of Medical Affairs International Markets will serve as a therapeutic and disease area expert who is responsible for the Medical Affairs strategy development and structured, consistent and strategically aligned medical engagement across International Markets. International Markets in ALK covers all territories outside Europe and North America. The primary focus is Asia, Middle East and Latin America. The International Markets team is small and diverse with people sitting all over the world and currently covering 12 different native languages. You will be reporting directly to SVP International Markets, Morten Essendrop.

Your Primary Tasks Will Be

Medical Strategy Development

• Responsible for the Medical Affairs strategy and plan for International Markets, leveraging learnings and best practices from Region Europe and Region US Medical Affairs.

• Ensure consistency between strategies, communication and messaging within ALK and across partners allowing for local adaption.

• Support partners with medical expertise and education on ALK products.

• Accountable for publication planning (including congress abstracts, poster presentations, manuscripts) working in close collaboration with local teams and Global Medical Affairs.

External Medical Representation

• Define stakeholder engagement strategies and develop professional relationships with thought leaders to ensure education and scientific communication on ALK products and therapeutic areas of interest. Lead scientific and external engagement strategy for International Markets.

• Represent ALK as medical expert and speaker at selected international congresses, advisory boards, partner meetings and scientific events within International Markets.

• Act as a senior medical ambassador for ALK in key International Markets.

Your profile

We expect that you are a medical doctor with the following qualifications:

• Strong knowledge of the immunology field, strong presentation skills and scientific expertise. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with allergy treatment including allergen specific immunotherapy.

• Knowledge of Medical Affairs standards and processes.

• Ability to develop Medical Affairs strategies and tactical plans.

• Build and interact with a network of allergy/immunology experts, partners and represent ALK in scientific and medical matters. Capable of conducting doctoral level discussions with key customers.

• Ability to collaborate with Global Medical Affairs, and Commercial Operations functions locally and globally. Working in a matrix environment.

Become a part of ALK

We provide an attractive working environment for individuals looking for both personal and professional development. ALK is a global pharmaceutical company specialised in allergy immunotherapy. We are driven by a high level of professionalism, integrity, an open-minded approach and contributing to an inspiring and fun working environment together with our colleagues. You will be part of an engaged and informal team who values skill and knowledge creation. The result of your efforts will be significant throughout the organisation, and you will be able to actively influence and challenge the status quo.

The position is international with up to 50-60 days of travelling per year. For the ideal candidate flexibility in the workplace can be arranged.

Apply

Apply by attaching your CV and a short letter of motivation.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all our job applicants. Hence, we prefer that you do not add images to your application documents. We evaluate applications and call for interviews on an ongoing basis, so don't wait to apply! We reserve the right to take down the advert when we have found the right candidate.

Do you want to learn more about our company, we encourage you to visit us at www.alk.net.

We are looking forward to hearing from you!

Allergy impacts and challenges the lives of millions of adults and children every day. At ALK, our purpose is to improve the lives of people living with allergies. Building on our strong heritage, we are guided by our strategy, Allergy+, that shows us a clear path towards this goal through focus, innovation, cultivation and optimisation.

Read more about our corporate strategy and our ambitions for growth

At ALK, we believe that every candidate deserves to be evaluated fairly and respectfully. Our recruitment process is designed to give each applicant an equal opportunity, regardless of their background. Read more about fair and unbiased recruitment at ALK.
