jobs.description:
RØGHUS is looking for an organized and reliable Kitchen Manager to join our growing team in Flyverbyen, Amager.

ABOUT RØGHUS

RØGHUS is a Danish catering and food truck company with a love for food made with smoke and fire.

We are best known for traditional American BBQ and authentic Mexican-inspired food, but most importantly, we believe in making great food from scratch, using quality ingredients and taking pride in the craft behind everything we serve.

For us, RØGHUS is about more than food. It is about hospitality, creating great experiences and treating customers, colleagues and partners with respect. We are an ambitious company, but we also want RØGHUS to be a place where people enjoy coming to work and feel responsible for what we create together.

Currently, our business consists of catering and our food truck, and we are looking for the right person to take responsibility for the day-to-day organization of our kitchen.

ABOUT THE POSITION

As our Kitchen Manager, you will be responsible for keeping the kitchen organized and running smoothly.

• 
Overall organization of the kitchen

• 
Cleaning routines and making sure our hygiene standards are maintained

• 
Staff scheduling

• 
General kitchen maintenance and keeping equipment and work areas in good condition

• 
Purchasing and ordering ingredients, supplies and other necessary goods

• 
Keeping track of stock and helping ensure that we have what we need for upcoming catering jobs and food truck events

• 
Helping create structure and good routines in a growing company

• 
Working closely with the rest of the RØGHUS team

Previous experience from a professional kitchen or a similar position is appreciated, but it is not a requirement.

For us, it is more important that you are organized, reliable and punctual, and that you take responsibility for your work. We are looking for someone who sees what needs to be done and enjoys creating structure around them.

You must be able to speak and write English fluently.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION

Position: Kitchen Manager

Hours: Full-time, 37 hours per week

Location: Flyverbyen, Amager

Salary: Based on qualifications

Application deadline: Monday, October 19, 2026

HOW TO APPLY

Please send your application to christian@roeghus.dk no later than October 19, 2026.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact us at the same email address.

We look forward to hearing from you — and hopefully welcoming you to RØGHUS.

KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is looking for a technically qualified and commercially focused Key Account Manager for its sales of high quality cast iron solutions.

THE POSITION

In order to consolidate and expand our sales activities, we need to strengthen our sales team by recruiting a qualified Key Account Manager.

You will be given responsibility for strategically important customers, all of which are market-leading OEMs or system providers, including those in the truck sector. Your role will be to expand and enhance the sales turnover among existing customers, while at the same time cultivating new customer relationships. A significant part of the role also involves making sustained efforts to secure up-to-date framework agreements and contracts in addition to communicating customer requirements and expectations.

The sales process consists of offering to produce the customers’ cast iron components. Once the items are being produced, the sales work will involve continuously negotiating and adjusting the sales prices of the individual components, as well as negotiating and maintaining other commercial conditions. These conditions include packaging, logistics solutions, framework agreements for quality and delivery, and aftermarket terms.

Your normal working day will vary from administrative tasks at the office in Holstebro, where you will work closely with Production, the Production Engineering Department (PED), Business Controlling and other company stakeholders. You will also be responsible for planning and conducting your external customer visits, primarily in Europe where you can expect up to around 50 days’ travelling per year. You will also help with and prepare data and presentations for sales meetings and trade fair attendance, as well as continuously reporting to Sales Management.

As part of a cross-organisational partnership, you will familiarise yourself with the customers’ projects and thus become the most important link of the contact between the customer and your colleagues across the entire organisation.

When out visiting customers with a view to sales, you will always have a ‘One Stop Shop’ cast iron solution to call upon. By this, we mean that BIRN is able to cast, machine, assemble and surface-treat the products so that they can be delivered directly to the customer’s production line or application without further processing. This is both efficient and sustainable.

Are you looking to combine your technical curiosity and skills with a strategic responsibility for sales and long-term customer relationships in an international industrial group? If so, you may be the person we are looking for as a Key Account Manager.

YOUR DUTIES

You will be given a central role in the sales organisation, with your work including the following:

·       Responsibility for and the continued development of a portfolio of four to six major strategic customers in Europe, primarily in Scandinavia. You will be responsible for a turnover of at least € 25 million

·       Building up long-term relationships with the customers’ stakeholders in the fields of purchasing, development, quality and logistics

·       Technical and commercial advice during the customers’ development and project phases

·       Planning and conducting customer visits, contract and price negotiations and major framework agreements

·       Ongoing budget monitoring, forecasts and sales reports at customer level

·       Searching for, analysing and developing new customer potentials and market segments

·       Close internal collaboration with production engineering, quality, controlling and finance

·       Participation in sales and strategy activities across the organisation

The position involves some travel, primarily in Europe.

QUALIFICATIONS

We expect you to have the following:

·       Extensive advanced technical training/experience, ideally supplemented with commercial skills, e.g. engineer, marine engineer or equivalent. A skilled trade background, supplemented by commercial training or experience, is another option

·       Experience of technical sales, project sales or Key Account Management; alternatively, you will have been recently trained and have the right level of drive. The start date will be adapted to suit the right candidate

·       The ability to thrive in an outward-facing role with extensive customer contact, and to plan your day-to-day work independently

·       The ability to work in a structured manner on CRM, budgets, documentation and monitoring. You will need to be skilled in using digital tools, for processing both text and numbers

·       The ability to communicate without difficulty in English and, preferably, also in Danish – and, ideally, in the other Scandinavian languages

·       The technical flair and ability to get to grips with the customers’ business and applications

·       A passenger car driving licence and a valid passport with no travel restrictions

At a personal level, you will be skilled in relationships, persistent and curious, with the motivation to create value through collaboration based on trust and a high level of professionalism.

WHAT WE OFFER

You will become part of Vald. BIRN A/S, a solid and internationally represented industrial enterprise with strong values and a high degree of professionalism. In addition, you will receive:

·       A central, independent role with a high level of influence on customers, sales and commercial development

·       A strong professional environment with close collaboration across the Group

·       Thorough on-boarding and training in products, markets and the organisation

·       Good opportunities for both professional and personal development

·       Attractive terms and conditions of employment, including a pension scheme and health insurance

·       A good canteen scheme and active staff association

·       An informal work environment that focuses on well-being, responsibility and sustainability

ABOUT THE BIRN GROUP

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is the Group Headquarters of one of Northern Europe’s largest foundry Groups. We supply highly processed cast iron components to the truck industry and others, as well as industrial hydraulics and machine components. Sustainability, the circular economy and responsibility are integral parts of our DNA. The Group employs around 750 staff, of which around 480 are in Holstebro.

APPLICATIONS

If you have any questions about the position or the BIRN Group, please feel free to contact Group CSO Peter Frost Jepsen on tel. +45 3016 0160 or Group HR Manager Morten Madsen on tel. +45 3016 0115.

Please note that we are processing applications on a continuous basis and will close the position once we have found the right candidate. As mentioned above, the start date can be adjusted to suit the right candidate. Please submit your application via our recruitment system, which you will find at [insert link]. Candidates who proceed to a second interview can expect to complete a personality profile as part of the process.

We would encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity or age, to apply for the position.

jobs.occupation: Carbon flux and particle export along the land-ocean continuum in Greenland’s coastal ocean
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Ecoscience programme. The position is available from 01 February 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Research area and project description:

Applications are invited for a PhD fellowship within the Center for Ice-Free Arctic Research (CIFAR) and the Department of Ecoscience at Aarhus University.

Rapid warming is increasing freshwater inputs to the Arctic Ocean from melting glaciers, ice sheets, and altered precipitation patterns. Additionally, sea ice cover is rapidly declining. These changes are transforming the structure and functioning of the Arctic coastal ocean. CIFAR aims to understand how the complex interplay between ice melt, terrestrial runoff, and changing ocean conditions affects Arctic coastal ecosystems and their functioning across spatial and temporal scales.

Fjord systems are a critical interface between the cryosphere, the terrestrial environment and the coastal ocean. They act as important sites of carbon transformation, burial and export, yet we still have a limited understanding of how ongoing freshening will influence these processes. Increasing terrestrial runoff delivers large quantities of particles, minerals and organic carbon to coastal waters, while simultaneously altering water-column structure, particle synamics, and marine primary production.

The overall aim of this PhD project will be to determine how carbon is transformed and transported along the land-ocean continuum in Greenland fjords, and how changes in freshwater inputs influence carbon fluxes and particle export in coastal waters.

The project will investigate interactions between terrestrial organic carbon, marine-produced carbon and mineral particles, with a particular focus on understanding which components of the carbon pool are retained, transformed or exported from the water column. Although much of the terrestrial carbon entering Greenland's coastal systems is transported in particulate form, freshwater runoff also supplies dissolved organic carbon that can be highly bioavailable and rapidly processed within coastal ecosystems. Understanding the fate of these different carbon pools is therefore essential for predicting how Greenland's coastal carbon cycle may respond to continued freshening.

The student will have the opportunity to combine field observations from Greenland with laboratory and analytical approaches to investigate the sources, composition, transformation and export of carbon and particles. The precise scientific focus will be developed together with the student and the wider CIFAR research team.

Qualifications and specific competences:

Applicants to the PhD position must hold a master’s degree and have demonstrated interest and background in biogeochemistry, for example through a bachelor’s or master’s thesis, research project, internship, or other relevant research experience.

• Skills in data analysis and programming, using R, Python, or other relevant programming languages and analytical tools.

• Ability and willingness to work collaboratively within an interdisciplinary and international research environment.

• Good written and oral communication skills in English.

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be an advantage, but is not required:

• Marine or aquatic biogeochemistry

• Organic carbon analyses

• Particle dynamics, sedimentation or particle export

• Geochemical or stable-isotope approaches

• Processing and analysis of environmental or oceanographic datasets

• Fieldwork in marine, coastal or Arctic environments

We particularly encourage applications from candidates who are scientifically curious and interested in developing their own ideas within the broader aims of the project.

Place of employment and place of work:

The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is C.F. Møllers Alle 3, 8000 Aarhus and Frederiksborgvej 399, 4000 Roskilde; Denmark.

Contacts:

Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:

• Christian Lønborg, c.lonborg@ecos.au.dk (main supervisor)

• Johnna Marchiano Holding, johnna@ecos.au.dk (co-supervisor)

For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:

• admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk

How to apply:

Please follow this link to submit your application.

Application deadline is 01 December 2026 at 23:59 CET.

Preferred starting date is 01 February 2027

Please make a project description (½-4 pages). The project description should describe your ideas and research plans for this specific project. If you wish to, you can indicate an URL where further information can be found.

Please note:

• Only documents received prior to the application deadline will be evaluated. Thus, documents sent after deadline will not be considered.

• The programme committee may request further information or invite the applicant to attend an interview.

• Shortlisting will be used, which means that the evaluation committee only will evaluate the most relevant applications.

Formalities and salary range

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.

Are you interested in working in an exciting and challenging consulting role, where you can deploy and develop your skills and competencies within the CFO domain of companies? Who we are

Joining our Finance Consultancy Programme, you will get to collaborate with experienced consultants on a wide variety of assignments and development opportunities. At Deloitte, we work with different project sizes across finance disciplines and industries, but the foundation is always the same: Our genuine passion for the CFO area and creating value together with our clients.

Finance Transformation is part of Deloitte Technology & Transformation (former Consulting) consisting of more than 350 consultants in Denmark who work across all areas of the CFO function. We engage with clients to operate, advise, optimize, and transform their finance functions. Our clients range from domestic to international, from private to public, across various industries, sizes, and time horizons.

You will join a team that emphasizes collaboration, collegiality, coaching, and talent development. At Deloitte, we value diverse skills, experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives, encouraging an inclusive and collaborative environment.

Job Description

Exciting tasks await you

As an Analyst in Deloitte Finance Transformation, you will experience that no workdays are the same. You will face a wide range of tasks, both in the form of interim-based roles and project-based assignments. Projects and tasks will vary across finance disciplines (e.g., operational finance or business finance) and industries (e.g., private or public), and within the first years of your career, you will be assigned to as many different projects and tasks as possible to expand your toolbox and build on your financial craftmanship.

• Finance operations optimization and transformation, e.g., controlling, month-end closing, and reporting

• Transformation and digitalization of finance functions, e.g., process optimization, closing excellence, internal controls advisory, and leveraging technology solutions

• Enterprise performance management, e.g., analytics, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting

• ERP-enabled finance transformations and finance systems implementation, e.g., outlining the ERP-strategy, defining business requirements and ensuring consistent data migration

• Finance strategy and operating model, e.g., designing service delivery models, outlining roles and responsibilities and conducting assessments

• M&A readiness and finance post-merger integration

• Global business services transformations, e.g., assessing, developing and implementing shared service functions and aligning service delivery with corporate strategy

• Internal business development and leadership support, e.g., assisting on client proposals, facilitating events and developing material to strengthen our market offerings.

Onboarding and learning

When joining us, you will participate in our onboarding programme designed with the purpose of giving you the best foundation for kickstarting your career in Deloitte. During your first two weeks, you and your peers will attend our Finance Transformation Nordic Bootcamp and our Consultant Academy, where the content is tailored to match your competencies as recent graduates. The Finance Transformation Bootcamp helps you in building your finance craftmanship and toolbox, while the Consultant Academy prepares you for your consulting role in Deloitte Technology & Transformation. Also heavily focused on social activities and team-building, the onboarding programme provides a smooth transition from university as it offers a unique opportunity to connect and build strong relations with your fellow new joiners from day one.

At Deloitte, we believe in life-long learning, and we are committed to investing in your individual development, both professionally and personally, throughout your career. You will experience this with our Finance Consultancy Programme, which is a highly structured learning programme, aimed at equipping you with the appropriate skillset and the right level of competencies needed to succeed in your role.

Leadership and culture

To support your learning, you will also be assigned a People Leader as your closest leader and go-to sparring partner. Your People Leader will help you set the overall direction of your journey in Deloitte and provide guidance across projects to make sure that your individual aspirations and professional development goals are met. Every career path is unique, and together with your People Leader you get the chance to shape your own.

We believe in leadership at all levels, and we have committed ourselves to creating and maintaining an inclusive and psychologically safe culture, where you are encouraged and empowered to take responsibility while leading both yourself and others. We combine this with a substantial focus on continuously staying relevant and being a meaningful social community to our people. We are a people’s business, and therefore we strongly believe that this is an essential prerequisite for making an impact that truly matters – for ourselves and for our clients**.

Qualifications

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for you, who are passionate about consulting and the CFO-area and who are willing to go the extra mile to deliver sustainable impact that truly matters to our clients. You show an eagerness to make a difference for both clients and colleagues and you are able to see the opportunities and potential in all types of assignments. As our business can be highly changeable, it is important that you are curious by nature, and that you face challenges with an open-minded and solution-oriented approach.

In addition to this, you:

• Have completed a master’s degree within the fields of finance, economics, business, accounting, social sciences, IT, or similar areas in the summer of 2027 or before

• Have achieved academic results from your bachelor’s and master’s degree that you are proud of

• Demonstrate a flair for both oral and written communication and are fluent in English

• Have a legal working permit in Denmark

Although relevant job experience might be an advantage, this is not a requirement.

Additional Information

Want to know more?

Click the "I'm interested"-button above and upload your CV and grade transcripts from your bachelor’s and master’s degree if you are interested and ready to join our team**. Instead of an application letter, we would like you to answer the questions you will be presented with on the next pages** (please only consider the required (*) fields). As we process applications and arrange interviews on an ongoing basis, we recommend that you apply as soon as possible.

Application deadline: Hiring on an ongoing basis.

Please do not hesitate to contact Giulio Marano (gimarano@deloitte.dk / +45 30 93 64 11) or Maria Banke (mbanke@deloitte.dk / +45 20 97 64 15) if you have any questions about the position.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

**The role

**At Good Tape we are ready to level up. We've built up tons of data, a large user base, and a team that's eager to move fast.

We have a world class product, shipping speed and roadmap that warrants our ambition level.

We're looking for someone excited to own Good Tape's acquisition engine: performance marketing, SEO, creative and to fuel our sales motion with a steady flow of qualified demand. You'll report directly to our CCO and work closely with the broader commercial team: Sales, Data, Product Marketing and Customer Success. Your job is to make sure the right people see (and click on) us in the first place, and keep coming back.

It's a rare opportunity; endless data, a real user base and a world class product to market.

**What You'll Do

**Your responsibilities will include:

• Own performance marketing across paid channels, from strategy to execution.

• Drive SEO and organic acquisition, including content and site structure.

• Develop creative strategy and messaging for campaigns and launches.

• Own lifecycle and CRM: nurture flows, retention, and reactivation.

• Own top-of-funnel website content and landing pages; the pages that bring people in.

• Fuel SLG by partnering closely with Sales on positioning, demand gen, and maximizing MQL-to-SQL conversion.

• Feed acquisition learnings into the pricing and positioning conversations led by our CCO.

**What We’re Looking For

**

• A-can-do-mindset who are curious, humble and tech-savvy enough to build manual processes that we can later scale.

• An AI-first approach to problem solving

• Design skills (e.g. static/video ad creative) are a great plus, not a hard requirement

• Proactive, high-ownership mindset with strong cross-functional communication skills.

• Experience in data-driven marketing, growth experimentation, and core SaaS metrics.

• Thrives in a fast-paced startup environment with a proven ability to learn quickly.

**Why join Good Tape?

**

• Work in a small, focused, and highly skilled team where your impact is visible every day.

• Play a key role in shaping our brand, acquisition funnels, and demand gen engine.

• Help define how Good Tape reaches the people who need it.

• Bring passion and proactivity, and see it directly converted into pipeline and growth.

**Apply for the job

**We’re excited to see how you can help us make Good Tape even better for our users.

About Hemab

Hemab is building preventative treatments for serious, underserved bleeding disorders. These are therapies designed to work with the body's own biology and stop bleeds before they start, instead of treating them after they happen. We're patient-first, science-led and clinical-stage - with a pipeline that takes different scientific approaches to different patient needs.

We went public via our 2026 IPO, and we're scaling across two homes: Cambridge, MA, USA, and Copenhagen, Denmark.

The role

As Director, Clinical Sciences, you'll help turn Hemab's science into well-designed clinical studies and clear evidence about how our treatments perform in patients. You'll take scientific ownership across protocol development, study execution and data interpretation, working closely with Medical Directors and colleagues across clinical development, regulatory and other functions.

What you'll do

• Lead the clinical science contribution to study strategy, design and execution, keeping the scientific questions and patient needs at the centre of decisions.

• Drive protocol development with the Medical Director, including amendments as emerging data or study needs require.

• Own the scientific review of clinical study data, identify discrepancies and trends, and turn emerging safety and efficacy data into clear questions and actions for the team.

• Shape study documents and plans, including informed consent forms, eCRFs, medical monitoring plans and data review plans.

• Guide sites and vendors on protocol requirements, eligibility criteria and participant management so studies are executed consistently and to the intended design.

• Partner across clinical development to analyse and interpret study results and build a clear understanding of what the data mean.

• Translate study findings for internal and external audiences alongside the Medical Director.

• Develop clinical content for regulatory documents, including investigator brochures, annual safety reports, clinical study reports and registration submissions.

What you'll bring to Hemab

• Substantial clinical science or clinical research experience in drug development, with direct responsibility for clinical studies.

• Experience developing clinical protocols and interpreting safety and efficacy data from interventional studies.

• A strong working knowledge of ICH-GCP, clinical study design and drug development in a regulated environment.

• The scientific judgement to interpret clinical information, literature and changing treatment approaches and apply it to study and development decisions.

• Experience working effectively with investigators, vendors and cross-functional clinical, medical and regulatory colleagues.

Nice to have

• Experience in haematology, rare disease or bleeding disorders.

• Experience contributing to development programmes through later-stage studies and registration.

• An advanced scientific or clinical degree.

What to expect, honestly

Hemab is still building a lot of its own structure. Systems here tend to get created as we need them, not handed down in advance. Whoever takes this role will likely build some of their own process instead of inheriting a finished one. We work across two hubs and multiple time zones - bridging that well takes real, deliberate effort. And because we're growing quickly, priorities can shift with less notice than they would at a larger, more established company.

This is the actual shape of working somewhere at this stage: It's genuinely energising for the right person and genuinely frustrating for the wrong one. If you want a place where the operating manual is already written, this might not be it – but if you want to help write it, this might be exactly it.

Why Hemab

At Hemab, your work ultimately connects back to something simple. People living with serious bleeding disorders get something they've never had before - the chance to prevent a bleed, instead of reacting to one after it happens. You'll be joining at a stage where individual decisions still carry real weight, and where your work can help turn promising science into a preventative treatment that actually reaches patients.

How we treat our people is meant to be an extension of how we think about patients: with care, honesty, and respect. We're still building the consistency to back that up across every hiring process, every time. We'd say that plainly instead of pretending otherwise. If any part of your experience with us falls short of it, tell us.

Hemab builds balanced candidate slates and assesses everyone against a single standard. If you need a reasonable adjustment at any stage of the hiring process, please tell us.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Hemab Therapeutics is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, sex, marital status, gender expression or identity, genetic information, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

jobs.occupation: Head of Center of Excellence for Project Management
jobs.description:

We excel in R&D innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization, working every day to protect people’s health and quality of life and protect our tomorrow.

In this role, you will not only define how projects are governed and delivered but also drive the adoption of new ways of working across a global organization.

**This is a broad and hands-on role spanning project leadership and organizational capability building within project excellence. A key aspect of the role is driving organizational change by ensuring that project management frameworks, tools, and processes are successfully adopted, understood, and embedded across the business. In this dual role, you will balance being Head of Center of Excellence while managing high-impact cross-functional projects yourself. Just as importantly, you will turn standards into practice by designing and delivering training, facilitating sessions, coaching colleagues, and creating engagement across the organization.

You will work across R&D, manufacturing, supply chain, commercial, and corporate functions. The portfolio may include merger and acquisition activities, development projects, vaccine launches, technology implementations, and other enterprise-wide transformation initiatives. Success requires someone who enjoys moving between strategic planning, practical implementation, and visible facilitation in front of an audience.

The position is based in Hellerup, Denmark. You will join a team of +20 Project Managers, Program Leads, and Student Assistants and report to the VP of Strategy Execution Office.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Own and continuously strengthen project management standards, governance, tools, templates, and ways of working across the organization

• Lead complex, cross-functional strategic projects, including initiatives connected to M&A, product development, vaccine launches, and enterprise transformation

• Drive adoption of project management methodologies and support organizational change through stakeholder engagement, communication, training, and coaching

• Develop project management capability through structured training, facilitation, coaching, and hands-on knowledge sharing across different functions and seniority levels

• Serve as a visible ambassador for project excellence, translating methodology into clear, practical, and engaging learning experiences

• Partner with senior stakeholders to create alignment, transparency, sound decision-making, and clear ownership throughout the project lifecycle

• Drive disciplined planning, risk management, resource coordination, and execution, supported by strong use of project and portfolio management tools

**What You Bring

**You bring extensive experience leading complex projects within pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, vaccines, or another highly regulated healthcare environment. You also bring change management expertise combined with hands-on delivery experience. Besides this, we are looking for someone with the following background;

• A genuine interest in the full scope of project management excellence, from strategic framework design and governance to practical implementation and organizational training

• Strong presentation and facilitation skills, with the confidence and energy to stand in front of an audience, engage participants, and make complex methods practical and relevant

• Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, create buy-in, and lead through complex global and cross-functional environments

• Strong knowledge of PMI-based project management practices. PMI/PMP certification is an advantage - other relevant certifications are also valued

• Experience with merger and acquisition projects

• A relevant master’s degree within life sciences, engineering, supply chain, business, or a related field

• Advanced expertise in Smartsheet combined with experience with Microsoft Project is an advantage

**Why join us?

**This role gives you the opportunity to influence both how strategic projects are delivered and how project management capability is built across Bavarian Nordic. You will combine high-impact project leadership with the chance to shape standards, develop colleagues, and create a lasting project excellence culture in a purpose-driven global vaccine organization.

If you are motivated by strategy and execution, enjoy building practical solutions, and feel energized by training and engaging others, we would love to hear from you.

We do not offer any relocation packages for this role. Please note that employment is contingent on residing and working in Denmark.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

About Memtrace

AI coding agents are fast, but they forget. They lose context between sessions, repeat mistakes, and don't understand the codebase around them. Memtrace builds the memory layer that fixes this: a deterministic knowledge graph of your code, built with AST parsing rather than guesswork, that any coding agent can use. Our products include MemDB, MemFleet, Cortex, and a code review engine. We are backed by Antler and Innovation Fund Denmark, and we work with Google, AWS, and Microsoft for Startups.

The role

You will own revenue end to end: strategy, pipeline, pricing, partnerships, and the first commercial team. We have developer interest and active pilots with enterprise customers. Your job is to turn that into repeatable, paying adoption. At this stage you will do the selling yourself while building the playbook that others will follow.

What you will do

• 
Define and run the go-to-market motion: developers adopt, engineering leaders and budget-holders buy.

• 
Own the revenue number and the pipeline. Run discovery, demos, pilots, and negotiations personally.

• 
Convert pilots into contracts, with clear success criteria, pricing, and procurement paths.

• 
Set pricing and packaging for individual, team, and enterprise tiers.

• 
Build channel and ecosystem partnerships (cloud marketplaces, consultancies, industry bodies, AI-coding-tool vendors).

• 
Feed customer and market insight back to product and research, and help decide what we build next.

• 
Hire and lead the first commercial team (sales, solutions, customer success) when the time is right.

• 
Report on pipeline, conversion, and retention to the founders and investors.

What we are looking for

• 
8+ years in B2B software sales or commercial leadership, with at least one role in developer tools, data/AI infrastructure, or open-source-led products.

• 
A track record of closing enterprise deals yourself, ideally in the Nordics or wider Europe.

• 
Experience selling to both technical champions and executive buyers, and knowing how those conversations differ.

• 
Comfort with ambiguity: you have built a sales motion without an existing playbook, brand, or team.

• 
Enough technical depth to talk credibly with engineers about codebases, CI/CD, and AI agents.

• 
Strong written and spoken English; Danish or another Nordic language is a plus.

Nice to have

• 
Experience with PLG, usage-based pricing, or open-core models.

• 
Existing relationships with engineering leaders at Nordic enterprises.

• 
Experience with EU procurement, security reviews, and data-residency requirements.

What we offer

• 
A founding-team seat with real ownership of the commercial side of the company.

• 
Direct influence on product, positioning, and company direction.

• 
Hybrid work in Copenhagen, with a small and fast-moving team.

Join BEUMER Group Innovation & Development in creating solutions that power the next level of logistic sortation systems worldwide. As a Robotics Software Engineer at BEUMER Group, you’ll design innovative solutions that drive efficiency and reliability in sortation and handling systems for logistic sites around the globe.

Our logistics customers seek innovative solutions to improve the efficiency of their sites. This includes automating manual processes through technologies such as mobile carrier robots, articulated robots, and computer vision software. More broadly, digitalization is a key driver of efficiency improvements.

To meet these needs, we are intensifying our focus on innovation and investing more in bringing new products to the market to address our customers’ evolving needs, making this an exciting time to join BEUMER Group.

Global innovation team

As our new Robotics Software Engineer, you will join a local, cross-functional Innovation & Development team consisting of highly skilled professionals in computer vision, robotics, user experience design, software architecture, and software development. The team operates in a global setup and collaborates closely with colleagues across locations and disciplines. The team's mission is to develop innovative products and systems for the logistics industry.

In your role as Robotics Software Engineer, you will:

• Develop, maintain, and debug software on industrial PCs and robotic platforms, including communication and computer vision applications.

• Configure, program, and integrate industrial robots and motion control systems.

• Work with geometric and spatial calculations related to robot motion, object positioning, and vision-guided applications.

• Participate in the development of new products, from early prototypes to market-ready solutions.

• Collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders across disciplines and locations in a global organization.

Driving business value

You have a strong background in designing and implementing automation solutions across a range of software platforms. You are innovative, proactive, and capable of developing automation systems and software that enhance efficiency and create business value.

You bring the following qualifications to the role:

• A degree in computer science, engineering, physics, or a related field.

• Experience with robotics and automation technologies, preferably from a similar or related industry.

• Experience developing near real-time software and solid knowledge of C#. Experience with Python, Docker, and microservice architecture is an advantage.

• Interest in robotics software and technologies, particularly in combination with computer vision applications.

• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a dynamic environment.

• Strong understanding of geometry and spatial reasoning, including the ability to model and calculate physical dimensions, positions, and movements in real-world systems.

Want to know more?

See our video from PostNord Logistics: Logistic system - BEUMER Group.

Interested?

If you have any questions regarding this position, please do not hesitate to contact Team Manager of Logistic System Product Development Ejnar Nielsen on +45 2721 4733 or Talent Acquisition Lead Søren Elkjær Holm on +45 3176 0448.

BEUMER Group

Conveying, loading, palletizing, packing, sortation and distribution – BEUMER Group is a leader within the development and manufacture of high-technological intralogistics systems for global markets. Our employees stand out from others thanks to their ability to supply innovative solutions to our customers. They can do this because they know the industry and are passionate about continuously developing and expanding their knowledge. We support these high standards through teamwork, mutual respect and a working culture based on trust that fosters stability and security for all of our employees. Our common goal is to implement outstanding and innovative projects worldwide.

Job description

Are you an experienced HR professional who enjoys combining HR operations, employee support and employment compliance in an international environment?

We are looking for a structured, service-minded and proactive HR Generalist to join our Global People Support team. You will take a key role in supporting employees hired from Denmark and become a central point of contact for matters related to Danish employment administration, employee cases and HR processes.

You will work closely with employees, managers, HR colleagues and external stakeholders to ensure that HR processes are handled professionally, efficiently and in line with Danish employment legislation, collective agreements and internal requirements.

As part of our Global People Support team, you will contribute to delivering a high-quality and consistent HR service across the organization. At the same time, you will take particular ownership of Danish employment administration and help strengthen our knowledge, processes and ways of working within this area.

Your Responsibilities

As HR Generalist, you will manage and coordinate a broad range of HR activities across the employee lifecycle, including:

• 
Managing employee cases related to Danish employment legislation and applicable collective agreements

• 
Coordinating sickness absence administration and follow-up

• 
Handling pension-related employee administration

• 
Coordinating work injury and accident reporting

• 
Providing guidance to employees and managers on Danish employment administration and HR processes

• 
Managing correspondence with relevant authorities and supporting statutory reporting requirements

• 
Maintaining accurate employee master data and HR settings in D365 HR and related systems

• 
Preparing and issuing employment-related documentation, including employment contracts and social security documentation

• 
Supporting continuous improvement and standardization of HR administrative processes

• 
Collaborating closely with colleagues across HR to ensure a consistent and professional employee experience

Job requirements

What We Are Looking For

We imagine that you have solid experience from an HR operational environment and enjoy taking ownership while working collaboratively with others.

Ideally, you:

• 
Have experience from an HR Generalist, HR Administrator, HR Coordinator or HR Operations role

• 
Have good working knowledge of Danish employment law, collective agreements and HR administration

• 
Have experience handling employee cases and correspondence with Danish authorities

• 
Are comfortable working with HR systems and maintaining accurate employee data

• 
Work in a structured and detail-oriented way and are comfortable managing several cases and priorities simultaneously

• 
Have a service-minded approach and enjoy supporting both employees and managers

• 
Communicate confidently and professionally in Danish and English, both verbally and in writing

• 
Are collaborative, approachable and comfortable working in an international HR environment

• 
Take ownership of your responsibilities and naturally look for opportunities to improve processes and ways of working

What We Offer

At Global Wind Service, you will join an international organisation operating in the renewable energy sector and become part of a global HR community where collaboration, responsibility and continuous improvement are an important part of how we work.

We offer:

• 
An opportunity to join an international company within the wind industry

• 
A role with real ownership and the opportunity to develop your expertise within Danish HR operations

• 
Close collaboration with colleagues across our global HR organisation

• 
Opportunities for professional and personal development

• 
A competitive compensation package including pension, insurance, laptop and mobile phone

• 
A hybrid working model offering flexibility

• 
Global career development opportunities

• 
A dynamic, inclusive and informal working environment

• 
A workplace where employee well-being and collaboration matter

Joining Global Wind Service means becoming part of a global organization where you can develop your HR expertise while contributing to an industry focused on a more sustainable future.

About Global Wind Service

Global Wind Service was established in Denmark in 2008 with a clear ambition to be a preferred project partner for the installation, service and maintenance of wind turbines worldwide.

Today, Global Wind Service employs approximately 2,000 dedicated professionals and operates internationally with offices across Europe, the United States and Asia.

Global Wind Service is a Fred. Olsen related company with a long-term strategy and ownership.

Our Aspiration and Values

Our aspiration is to be a global tier-one project partner for wind turbine installation, service and blade repair, both offshore and onshore.

At Global Wind Service, our values are:

Be Safe. Act Flexible. Take Responsibility. Focus on People.

These values guide the way we work together, make decisions and support our employees. We therefore hope you can see yourself reflected in them and bring them into your everyday approach to HR.

Same Chance for Everyone

GWS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability or any other status protected by applicable local legislation.

jobs.occupation: Implementation Consultant with expertise in social services – Columna Cura
jobs.description:
Implementation Consultant with expertise in social services – Columna Cura

Do you know municipal case management in social services inside out – VUM, FFB, service catalogues, rates and citizens' co-payments – and would you like to help municipalities get the most out of their IT support for social services? Then seize this unique opportunity to put your professional insight to use in a company with high ambitions, and help our customers get the greatest value from Columna Cura!

Join a collaborative and ambitious team

As our new Implementation Consultant, you'll work with Columna Cura, our IT solution for the health and social care sector, which supports staff, citizens and relatives throughout the citizen's entire care journey. The solution is already live in 38 Danish municipalities, and we're growing in social services, where case management, service provision and collaboration between authority and provider place specific demands on how the system is configured and used.

You'll join the Cura Projects & Services team, made up of dedicated colleagues – consultants, solution architects, service developers and more.

The team's main responsibility is project and service delivery, and your tasks will include implementation projects, training and professional guidance on configuration.

Play a key role and contribute to Systematic's growth

As our new Implementation Consultant on Columna Cura, you'll play a key role in helping municipalities get off to a strong start with Cura in social services – and continue to get optimal value from the Cura product suite afterwards. You'll bridge the gap between the municipality's case management practices, providers' needs and the system's setup, translating assessments, service catalogues, rates and workflows between authority and provider into a well-functioning Cura setup.

Your insights from customer dialogue also feed into our product and service development.

Your key tasks will include:

• advising municipalities on how to configure Cura to support case management in social services, including VUM (the Adult Needs Assessment Method) and the process from assessment and decision to service delivery

• setting up and maintaining service catalogues (FFB – Denmark's Common Professional Concepts framework – and municipal services), rates and rules for citizens' co-payments in collaboration with the customer

• supporting collaboration between case workers and internal and external providers in Cura, including ordering, follow-up and billing of services

• training system administrators and super users to use and configure Cura

• producing and maintaining functional documentation that helps customers configure Cura to their needs

• taking part in tender responses for new customers

• working closely with your colleagues in Cura Projects & Services, Product Management and Domain Advisors, and feeding valuable customer insights from social services into our product development

You should expect around five travel days a month to customers in Denmark and Norway.

Put your social services expertise to use

Our new colleague knows social services inside out – either as a social worker with hands-on experience in case management or with providers, or as a system administrator or super user of Columna Cura or a similar IT solution for social services. You're a strong communicator who's motivated by helping others and committed to laying the groundwork for customer success and satisfaction.

We expect you to have in-depth knowledge of municipal case management in social services – particularly the VUM method, FFB and service catalogues, services, rates, citizens' co-payments, and collaboration with internal and external providers. Experience with Columna Cura or a similar specialist system for social services is a strong advantage, but the right professional insight matters more to us than the exact system you know.

It would be a huge plus if you also know the provider side of social services – for example residential care, supported housing, and activity and employment services – and understand how orders, goals, documentation and follow-up move between authority and provider. That understanding is exactly what enables you to help a municipality set up Cura so that case workers and providers work as one connected process.

We also imagine that you:

• can translate legislation and case management practice into concrete system setup and clear guidance for users

• enjoy coordinating and collaborating with customers and stakeholders – from case workers and providers to system owners and management

are proactive and take the initiative

• speak and write Danish and English fluently - Non Danish Speakers need not apply

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO/EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 social/professional events a year. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, games tables and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

Never stop developing

Systematic is truly international, proudly Danish and uniquely people-centric. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most – this is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. Systematic is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

You can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers almost 100 events of both social and professional character a year, so there is plenty to choose from. Our colleagues also highlight our canteen, which serves a variety of delicious and healthy dishes each day. In addition, we offer several employee benefits such as paid Home Internet, health insurance and a company pension scheme. Finally, we are always up for a friendly game of padel at our new padel court in Aarhus!

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Mette Skylvad, Program Manager.

Are you ready to power the wind industry? Do you want to work in a field where your impact matters?

Then you might be our new High Voltage Technician who is ready to start a new and adventurous journey with us!

The Role

At Global Wind Service, we are currently ramping up our expanding High Voltage Services and we are looking for you!

As a travelling High Voltage Technician, you will work globally in onshore, pre-assembly or the offshore environment. Delivering high quality solutions, with safety as the first priority to our projects.

Become a part of our High Voltage Team

In this position, you will be part of the team of our skilled technicians delivering best in class High Voltage solutions. You will be part of a growing business that continuously develops. This also means that your development is key to Global Wind Service.

Responsibilities

• 
To perform electrical tests such as VLF, MoM, Insulation and Relay Tests.

• 
To be a Team Lead for High Voltage activities.

• 
To connect High Voltage Terminations.

• 
To work according to the safety regulations.

• 
To safely operate High Voltage equipment.

Your profile

Ideally, you:

• 
Have experience with High Voltage works.

• 
Have completed a relevant electrical education.

• 
You have at least 6 months of experience in wind.

• 
Have good English skills

• 
Have ability and willingness to travel and work domestically and internationally as required

• 
Have ability and confidence to work at height (includes physical fitness to climb)

• 
Have valid GWO training and OGUK Medical Fitness certificate

• 
Are EU citizen and have EU passport

• 
Are cooperative, communicative, open-minded, and flexible – with respect for others and other cultures

• 
Can work at remote sites in adverse weather conditions

• 
Are professional with a high emphasis on Quality and Safety

• 
Possess clean drivers’ license and ability to obtain a passport

Following certificates would be beneficial

• 
Siemens Energy 8VM1

• 
EHS-8270

• 
72,5kV Cable Training

• 
Mitsubishi 72,5 SWG Training

• 
Accreditation with SGRE or Vestas

We offer you

• 
An exciting job with excellent opportunities for professional and personal development in an inspiring, dynamic, high performing and international work environment in the renewable energy sector.

• 
An opportunity to work with a leading supplier in wind industry.

• 
An opportunity to further develop your skills and professional development.

• 
Competitive remuneration.

• 
Your happiness and your well-being is a priority.

• 
A great journey with career development within a global organization.

Working at Global Wind Service

Global Wind Service is a leading international provider of turbine installation, service, and maintenance solutions in the wind industry. With a strong focus on safety, quality, and efficiency, we work closely with our clients to deliver exceptional wind energy projects worldwide. As we continue to expand our global presence, we are seeking a self-driven and experienced High Voltage Technician to join our dynamic team.

Focus on People

At GWS our employees play an integral role in our vision for the future and in achieving our goal to be the preferred partner for complete wind turbine services. GWS has a strong team culture, and we are always looking for smart, hard-working people who strive for excellence in their work and appreciate collaboration.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Imagine working with cutting-edge machine learning models, crunching high frequency data sets and sparring with exceptional and fun colleagues, all while taking part in scaling our business even further.

Does this sound highly appealing to you? Then you might be our new Senior Quantitative Researcher in the Equity Statistical Arbitrage wing of Alipes Capital!

At Alipes Capital, we have been a market leader in equity and electricity algorithmic trading since starting in 2008.

This position is focused on

• 
Elevating our predictive modeling standards to the highest levels in the area of statistical arbitrage of traded funds.

• 
Creating a world class modeling workflow, enabling the team to turn massive data sets of financial information into mathematical models that accurately predict movements in the markets.

In doing so, you will get a chance to tackle a variety of software infrastructure challenges, such as:

• 
Development and optimization of calibration and benchmarking frameworks.

• 
Building out and implementing best practices for data preparation and dataset generation pipelines.

• 
Prototyping and releasing novel predictive architectures, especially with respect to time-series models.

You will get instant validation of your work and experience short feedback cycles, where going from inception to deployment can be a matter of hours. There will be no red tape to cut and no salespeople to consult. It is pure play.

About the team

We maintain an informal atmosphere where technical discussions are valued, and you are encouraged to take ownership of, and pride in, your work. You will impact the direction of the team, prioritize your work and choose the tools that get the job done.

The Quant team consists of eighteen passionate quantitative researchers covering 6 nationalities, with thirteen PhD’s and five MSc’s with expertise in statistical analysis, mathematical modeling and machine learning. The stat-arb sub-team is a tight group of 3 researchers.

We enjoy collaboration and are always willing to lend a helping hand. We work alongside a team of software engineers and a team of traders that implement and conceive the mathematical models together with us. All team members across the organization write code and drive change and are equally willing to engage on a nitty-gritty technical level as well as discuss the larger strategic level.

About you

• 
Fluency within mathematics and statistics.

• 
Experience working with the full Machine Learning stack from data generation through model calibration and real-life validation and monitoring.

• 
Programming experience with Python, in particular data-wrangling and numerical programming.

• 
Proficiency in computer science fundamentals.

• 
A scientific and inquisitive mind.

Nice to have

• 
Experience working with financial data, in particular valuation and hedging of fixed-income instruments.

• 
Experience with order book data.

• 
Experience working with tools like PyTorch, Tensorflow, XGBoost and/or Catboost.

• 
Programming experience with languages like C# and C/C++.

• 
PhD or MSc degree in engineering, physics, computer science, mathematics or economics.

What we can offer you

• 
Competitive benefits, including pension, health insurance, and 30 days of vacation.

• 
A modern office in Copenhagen (Nordhavn) with a flexible hybrid work model.

• 
A flat hierarchy with high levels of trust, autonomy, and freedom to make decisions.

• 
A valued role with unique responsibilities and plenty of room for creativity.

• 
Fast feedback and recognition of your contributions in a high-growth company.

• 
Strong team spirit - successes are celebrated with company events and trips.

Practicalities

To apply, please send us your CV and a cover letter telling us why you think this role is a great fit for you. If your profile looks like a good match, we will get in touch to coordinate an online technical test as a first step in the interview process.

Build the platform every engineering team depends on and shape how Performativ scales through reliability, resilience, and world-class developer experience.

As our Hands-On Lead Cloud Engineer, you will lead Mission Control, our Platform Engineering and Reliability team. Mission Control creates secure, self-service platform capabilities that enable product teams to build, deploy, and operate services independently. This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you'll spend the majority of your time building production infrastructure and platform capabilities, leading through technical contribution rather than process.

What you’ll do 📈

• 
Lead Mission Control while remaining deeply hands-on across cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, and reliability.

• 
Build and evolve the default, secure-by-default platform that enables product teams to build, deploy, and operate services independently.

• 
Create reusable AWS CDK constructs, infrastructure standards, and golden paths that reduce complexity and improve the developer experience across engineering.

• 
Set the technical direction for Mission Control, making pragmatic decisions about platform evolution, reliability, and developer experience while helping the team execute.

• 
Strengthen our reliability practices through SLOs, error budgets, runbooks, incident tooling, and post-incident improvements that drive meaningful change.

• 
Treat cloud cost as a first-class engineering concern by improving visibility, eliminating waste, and designing systems that scale efficiently.

• 
Partner closely with our security specialists to build secure-by-default platform capabilities and continuously strengthen our security posture.

• 
Own the evolution of the engineering platform that enables every product team to build, deploy, and operate services independently.

• 
Provide technical leadership, coaching, and feedback to a small team of experienced platform engineers while remaining deeply involved in delivery.

What we’re looking for 🎯

• 
7+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar production-focused environments.

• 
Experience leading or mentoring engineers while remaining hands-on and actively contributing to code and infrastructure.

• 
Strong experience designing and operating production workloads on AWS, including Infrastructure as Code. Experience with AWS CDK and TypeScript is strongly preferred.

• 
Strong understanding of the AWS Well-Architected Framework and practical application of its principles.

• 
A platform engineering mindset focused on building reusable capabilities, self-service, and engineering leverage.

• 
Strong operational judgment with experience in incident response, reliability engineering, SLOs, and continuous improvement.

• 
Comfort owning outcomes, making decisions in ambiguous environments, and improving engineering practices without adding unnecessary process.

• 
Actively leverages AI and agent-assisted engineering workflows to improve productivity while applying sound engineering judgment and maintaining high quality standards.

• 
Experience working within fintech or other regulated industries is a plus.

Technologies you'll work with 💻

You don't need experience with every technology listed below. We care far more about strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and your ability to learn, build, and improve systems.

• 
Infrastructure & Cloud: AWS CDK (TypeScript), Terraform (bonus), and modern AWS infrastructure, networking, security, governance, and observability services.

• 
Engineering Tooling: GitHub Actions, Docker, container pipelines, cloud cost optimization, and observability tooling.

• 
Wider Engineering Stack: You'll collaborate with teams building services primarily in Golang and TypeScript, alongside React, React Native, Python, and PHP.

What we can offer you 🌱

• 
Trust and responsibility to shape the future of Performativ’s success in the European market from day 1.

• 
Join a fast-growing fintech scaleup supported by top-tier VCs.

• 
Work with intelligent, passionate, and driven professionals with experience from leading institutions (such as Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, BCG, Amazon etc).

• 
Accelerate your career with opportunities for professional development and leadership.

Join a Team of Fintech heroes! 🚀

Performativ is making waves in the wealth management ecosystem and is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions do business around the world. Working at Performativ means working at a fast-paced tech scaleup with intelligent people who are passionate about their work. We are on a scaling journey beyond all metrics and expectations and can't wait to have you join us in making a real impact.

We are funded by some of the leading VC funds in the world and expectations are set to be established as a European market leader in a record amount of time.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com

We value passion 🔥

At Performativ, we are builders first. We are passionate with ambitious goals and value the time and effort people put into their work. You will be part of the family from day one, and responsible for making your mark and driving forward your vision. Autonomous work is embedded in our culture, and we are committed to ensure you have all the tools and support you need while acknowledging the importance of flexibility.

Job Description

We're looking for an experienced Microsoft Purview specialist with a proven track record of delivering compliance projects for clients who’s ready to own and develop our Purview capability as the agentic landscape evolves.

What you'll do

You'll work on Microsoft Purview and compliance implementations end-to-end – from architecture and deployment to use case optimisation – with a particular focus on agentic adoption.

You'll be the person who drives the Purview agenda on behalf of an ambitious team, working across industries with organisations that are serious about data security and compliance.

In this role, you'll own:

• 
Design, deployment, and optimisation of Microsoft Purview solutions, including Data Classification, Information Protection, Data Loss Prevention, and Insider Risk Management

• 
Development of data protection policies, automation workflows, and compliance reporting tailored to client requirements

• 
Assessment and reporting on the maturity of client data security and compliance deployments

• 
Definition and creation of operational and executive compliance dashboards and reports

• 
Integration activities across Microsoft Purview and the broader Microsoft 365 compliance ecosystem

You'll also collaborate closely with other engineers on the team, contribute to R&D activities, and support managed service customers in maintaining and maturing their data security practices.

What you'll bring

We're looking for someone with at least three years of hands-on experience enabling security and compliance technologies in a Microsoft environment. Beyond that, you'll bring:

• 
Strong experience with Microsoft Purview across Data Classification, Information Protection, DLP, and Insider Risk Management

• 
Hands-on experience implementing sensitivity labels, retention policies, and DLP rules

• 
Knowledge of data governance principles within the Microsoft ecosystem

• 
Current Microsoft certifications in compliance and security – or a willingness to obtain them within 90 days

• 
Strong communication skills and confidence in client-facing settings

We don't expect you to know everything. Purview and the agentic space are moving fast, and that's part of what makes this role interesting. What matters most is that you want to own it.

To be a great fit for The Tech Collective, it will be a bonus if you bring:

• 
Knowledge of LLMs and agentic workflows, including cybersecurity risk considerations

• 
Understanding of Zero Trust principles as applied to data security

• 
Experience with risk assessment methodologies and compliance reporting

• 
Microsoft Certified: Information Protection Administrator Associate, Security Administrator Associate, or equivalent

What we offer

On top of a competitive salary and bonus package, you'll join a tight team of experts and enthusiasts who take both craft and collaboration seriously. We invest in your development – through training, conferences, and the space to pursue research in areas you're passionate about.

We combine remote work with meaningful co-working at our offices in Copenhagen and will provide you with the tooling and hardware required to reach our goal of building a unique red team platform.

For questions, contact Anders Rømer Skøtt at anrs@thetechcollective.eu or +45 31717487.

As a Senior Front-End Engineer, you will co-own the front-end experience for Performativ's trading and analytics platform, building high-performance interfaces used by wealth managers and financial institutions. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct ownership of architecture, implementation, and production outcomes.

About the team 👥

The engineering team owns the platform that powers portfolio management, trading, analytics, reporting, compliance, and client engagement at Performativ. Front-end engineers work closely with backend engineers, product, and design to turn complex financial workflows into software that advisors can use every day.

The team ships continuously and gives engineers ownership over implementation decisions. On the front end, the current focus is scaling a Next.js and React architecture across increasingly sophisticated workflows while keeping performance, server and client boundaries, theming, and shared components under control.

About the role 🎯

We are looking for a Senior Front-End Engineer to co-own the quality, performance, and architecture of our trading and analytics interfaces. This role is responsible for building production UIs, shaping front-end architecture, and raising the standard of our shared component infrastructure.

You will work closely with backend engineering, product, and design to ship financial workflows from requirements through production. You will co-own the end-to-end front-end scope, including server and client boundaries, hydration strategy, state management, performance, multi-tenant theming, testing, and the component library used across the platform.

This role requires deep React and TypeScript expertise, strong architectural judgment, and the ability to turn complex financial workflows into fast, usable interfaces. You need to be comfortable making implementation decisions independently and shipping production software without management overhead.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together from our city-center office, with working from home possible when there is a good reason. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

What you'll do 📈

• 
Build high-performance trading, analytics, and portfolio management interfaces used by wealth management professionals.

• 
Co-own front-end architecture across Next.js 15, React Server Components, TypeScript, and our shared application infrastructure.

• 
Define server and client boundaries, hydration strategies, and state patterns that keep the platform responsive as complexity grows.

• 
Scale our shared component library and multi-tenant theming across the platform.

• 
Improve runtime performance, bundle size, rendering behavior, and application responsiveness.

• 
Ship production features quickly while making architectural decisions that hold up as the product scales.

• 
Use AI coding agents where they improve engineering throughput while maintaining control over code quality and implementation decisions.

• 
Strengthen front-end testing and delivery across Vitest or Jest, Testing Library, Playwright, and CI/CD workflows.

• 
Co-own implementation decisions from product outcome through production deployment.

What we're looking for 🔍

• 
Have built sophisticated production web applications with React and TypeScript and can structure front-end codebases that continue to work as product complexity grows.

• 
Understand modern React architecture, including React Server Components and the Next.js App Router, or can demonstrate the technical depth to become productive with them quickly.

• 
Have shipped production work using AI coding agents and understand where they improve engineering output and where direct engineering judgment is required.

• 
Have improved front-end performance through decisions around bundle size, hydration, rendering, data fetching, and runtime behavior.

• 
Are comfortable managing server state with TanStack Query and can make deliberate decisions about colocated state and client state libraries.

• 
Have built or extended component systems using tools such as Radix, shadcn/ui, or custom design systems.

• 
Understand usability, accessibility, and interaction design well enough to make sound UX decisions without treating design as somebody else's problem.

• 
Have shipped tested production software using tools such as Vitest or Jest, Testing Library, Playwright, and automated CI/CD pipelines.

Preferred experience ➕

• 
Have worked on trading, investment management, portfolio analytics, or other data-intensive financial applications.

• 
Have worked with AG Grid or comparable data-grid infrastructure for complex datasets and interactions.

• 
Have worked in a pnpm and Turborepo monorepo with generated API types from OpenAPI specifications.

• 
Have designed front-end systems supporting multiple tenants, brands, or configurable themes.

• 
Have mentored engineers or raised engineering standards without moving away from hands-on development.

What we can offer you 🌱

• 
Work that reaches production fast. We ship weekly. Your work will be used by advisors and financial institutions within days, not quarters.

• 
Colleagues who set a high bar. Our team comes from Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, BCG, and Amazon. Standards are high. Politics are absent.

• 
Career compression. People here take on scope in twelve months that takes five years elsewhere. If you can carry it, we will give it to you.

• 
Direct access to founders, customers, and the market. You will sit in the rooms where decisions get made.

• 
Backing from leading venture funds, and a mandate to become the European standard rather than a regional alternative.

About Performativ 🚀

Wealth management runs on software built for a different era. Batch files. Overnight reconciliation. Client reports assembled by hand. Advisors spend more time fighting their systems than advising clients. The industry has accepted this for thirty years.

We are replacing that layer. Performativ is one platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, and client engagement, built from the ground up for how wealth is actually managed today. Banks, family offices, and independent advisors across Europe run on it.

We are a scaleup, not a startup. The product is live, the customers are real, and the growth is ahead of plan. We intend to be the system European wealth management runs on. That is not positioning. It is the plan we are executing against.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com

The bar 🔥

We are builders. We move fast, we say what we think, and we do not manage each other. Autonomy is the default, which only works if you are the kind of person who does not need to be told twice.

This is not a role for someone looking to coast inside a growing company. It is a role for someone who wants scope, wants pressure, and wants to point at something in two years and say they built it. If that is you, apply. If it is not, this will be uncomfortable, and we would rather say so now.
