ABENA is a family owned company built on trust, fairness, and collaboration. With more than 2,200 colleagues worldwide, they serve customers across 90+ markets in healthcare, industry, and retail. Their new strategic focus is on investment in digitalization and standardization, while aligning the organization to support future growth.

At ABENA, you join a global company with a strong purpose: to make a real difference in the everyday lives of people around the world. ABENA combines professionalism with a warm, people-first culture where collaboration, curiosity, and continuous improvement are necessary parts of everyday life. They take pride in delivering high-quality work with integrity, guided by our core values of trust, fairness, and cooperation. These values shape how they lead, support one another, and create meaningful impact for their customers and communities.

Set the direction for global procurement – strengthen ABENA’s competitiveness

With global sourcing units, a significant yearly spend, and more than 29,000 products, procurement is a key commercial driver of the business.

As Global Procurement Director, you will have overall responsibility for the continued development of ABENA’s category-based procurement, with the aim of ensuring that individual categories contribute even more significantly to driving the business forward. Your responsibilities will also include global sourcing and supply chain planning & execution.

The role is positioned at the highest level of management. You will report directly to the CEO, be a member of the ABENA Leadership Team and lead a global organisation of approximately 60 employees. Your direct reports will include two Heads of Procurement, the Head of Supply Chain Planning & Execution, and the Head of Master Data.

This is a key position with significant influence on the Group’s profitability, security of supply, and competitiveness. At the same time, the ambition is to further strengthen procurement’s position in the value chain and in ABENA’s strategic management.

The tasks/your responsibilities

In addition to further developing the category-based procurement organisation, one of your most important responsibilities will be to contribute to the digital transformation across the value chain. You will build and ensure efficient processes across categories, countries and sourcing units. Leading through your managers, you will ensure strong category plans, clear KPIs, and effective execution.

Your responsibility is to:

• develop the global procurement and category strategy in line with ABENA’s overall strategy.

• develop the organisation, managers, and processes to increase efficiency.

• ensure professional framework agreements, qualify major tenders, and follow up on KPIs.

• ensure close collaboration between procurement, supply chain, in-house production, product development, and the international companies responsible for sales.

• contribute to the digitalisation of procurement through ERP, e-sourcing, AI, and automation.

Global procurement from a strategic perspective

This is a senior international leadership role, making substantial management experience within procurement and category development a key requirement. In addition, you should have:

• extensive experience with core procurement disciplines and an understanding of the entire value chain.

• proven experience with managing managers and larger teams.

• experience from a professional, international group.

• experience with transformation and strategic development initiatives.

• a process-oriented approach and an understanding of digitalization and IT.

• the ability to be present in Aabenraa on a daily basis.

The attractive aspects of the job

You will get an exceptionally central procurement role in which procurement is not simply a support function but a significant part of ABENA’s commercial engine. The ambition is clear: the categories should play an even greater role in driving the business.

You report to the CEO and are a member of the senior leadership team while taking over a large international organisation with highly capable managers and employees. The role combines strategic influence, global leadership, and tangible commercial results - within a company of significant scale with a continued appetite for development and change.

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Senior Research Consultant Majbrit Kock Andersen on +45 2628 3821.

Please note, that we only need your cv if you want to apply. Your approach is handled with confidentiality.

Faerch A/S

Faerch is a leading supplier of circular, rigid food packaging with integrated recycling capabilities. With more than 5,000 employees across Europe and the U.S., Faerch serves food manufacturers, food service providers, and retailers globally through a network of state-of-the-art production facilities.

The company is owned by A.P. Moller Holding and is driven by a clear purpose: to accelerate the transition toward a circular economy in food packaging.

With sustainability at the core of its strategy, Faerch develops innovative packaging solutions designed for recyclability and high levels of post-consumer recycled content. The company is currently undergoing a transformation to strengthen integration, customer focus and operational excellence, captured in its strategic ambition, “Ignite our potential”.

Read more at: www.faerch.com

Faerch is looking for a Senior Director, IT & Digital to lead and further develop the global IT & Digital function and support the company’s continued digital transformation.

In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring a scalable, secure, and business-oriented foundation that supports operational efficiency, data security, and customer satisfaction through cutting-edge technology and digital solutions.

A key leadership role in Faerch’s digital transformation

In this role, you will be responsible for the continued professionalization of Faerch’s global IT function, with a strong focus on cybersecurity, infrastructure stability, uptime, data integrity and security, governance, and operational excellence.

You will lead an organization of ~55 employees located across several European markets, including a management team of three direct reports, while also being responsible for the IT budget ownership and spend management across the function. In addition, you will report directly to the Global CFO and be given the mandate to position Global IT & Digital as a strategic business partner to support the execution of the new strategy.

A key priority in this regard will be to accelerate the roll-out of M3 Cloud across Faerch’s factories and ensure that the ERP programme is managed, structured, and implemented as a global transformation. At the same time, you will be responsible for ensuring stable operations, high uptime, strong cyber security, and a simplified application landscape.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Leading the transition of the ERP system from a project-based implementation to a structured global programme in close collaboration with key functional leaders.

• Ensuring high operational reliability across business-critical systems and production environments.

• Strengthening maturity and governance within cyber security across the global IT landscape.

• Defining and maturing Faerch’s AI and digital agenda, including relevant use cases across the organization.

• Maintaining a responsive and efficient service desk that effectively addresses user needs and resolves technical issues promptly.

• Leading and motivating the IT organization, ensuring strong engagement, clear direction, and effective collaboration across disciplines and locations.

• Strengthening Global IT as a trusted business partner through alignment with stakeholders, and digital solutions that support operational and commercial priorities.

Who are you?

We are looking for an experienced IT leader who can strike a balance between strategic transformation and stable day-to-day operations. You bring a solid technical foundation and a proven track record of leading complex digital initiatives in international organizations – ideally from manufacturing companies or other operationally intensive environments with multiple sites and a high reliance on stable systems.

You have experience leading geographically dispersed digital teams across a range of disciplines and thrive in a role that involves setting the direction, creating structure, and ensuring progress. At the same time, you have a strong business acumen that enables you to translate business needs into effective solutions and value-creating initiatives. Furthermore, you are able to translate complex technological agendas into clear priorities that both specialists, managers, and senior stakeholders can understand and act upon.

Personally, you are a visionary and results-oriented individual with a genuine passion for technology, innovation and business impact. You are able to constructively challenge existing working methods with a view to driving improvements. As a leader, you are collaborative, build trust easily, and know how to foster engagement in daily operations.

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Research Consultant Simone Svenningsen on tel. 2616 3704.

Please note that we only need your CV when you apply for the position. Your enquiry will be treated confidentially and will not be passed on without your consent.

Are you a passionate jewellery designer with extensive experience creating iconic products and collections? Do you combine a strong creative vision with exceptional sketching skills and a deep understanding of craftsmanship, materials and the jewellery design process?

We are looking for an experienced Senior Designer to join our Modern Classics & Diamonds team on a 12-month fixed-term contract, bringing creative expertise and immediate impact to one of Pandora's key jewellery categories.

Create the next generation of Modern Classics & Diamonds

As our Senior Designer, Modern Classics & Diamonds, you will work closely with the Design Director and wider design team to develop creative projects from initial concept through design execution and prototype development.

Drawing on your creative vision, technical expertise and understanding of Pandora's brand DNA, you will help develop compelling, commercially relevant collections that combine timeless elegance with modern expression and inspire customers around the world.

Your Role

Design & Collection Development

• Partner with the team to create and develop new collections within the Modern Classics & Diamonds category.

• Translate creative briefs into innovative product concepts, designs and sketches aligned with Pandora's brand identity.

• Lead individual design projects from research and concept development through CAD and prototype stages.

• Propose original and future-thinking product ideas supporting the strategic direction of the category.

• Develop mood boards, concept presentations, creative sketches and technical drawings to support product development.

• Review CADs and provide clear and comprehensive creative feedback within agreed timelines.

• Brief products to Design Operations & Development (DoD) and collaborate closely to ensure successful prototype execution.

• Review early prototypes and contribute to formal prototype reviews and creative evaluations.

• Collaborate with Creative Sourcing to explore new materials, techniques and innovation opportunities.

• Partner with Creative Merchandising to align category and collection structures.

• Maintain accurate design documentation, inspiration references and project records throughout the design process.

• Support and mentor Junior Designers, providing creative and technical guidance.

• Ensure projects are developed and delivered according to agreed timelines and requirements.

Research & Innovation

• Conduct research based on briefs from Creative Leadership and translate insights into strong creative concepts.

• Participate in research activities and trips to identify emerging trends, products, techniques, materials and creative inspiration.

• Contribute ideas for new concepts, innovation opportunities and future category directions.

• Keep design presentations updated with relevant concepts, sketches and final designs throughout project development.

A Creative Visionary with a Passion for Jewellery

You combine exceptional creativity with strong technical expertise and an instinct for commercially relevant product design. You know how to take an idea from inspiration and early sketches through to a beautifully resolved piece of jewellery.

You understand how to balance innovation with the DNA of an established global brand and are comfortable moving between creative exploration and the technical realities of product development.

As this is a 12-month fixed-term opportunity, we are particularly looking for someone who can quickly become part of the team, confidently take ownership of projects and contribute from day one.

What We're Looking For

• Significant experience designing jewellery within a jewellery, luxury, fashion or accessories brand.

• A strong creative portfolio demonstrating concept development, mood boards, sketches and finished products.

• Proven experience taking design projects from concept through CAD and prototype development.

• Strong knowledge of jewellery design, craftsmanship, materials and manufacturing processes.

• Exceptional hand-sketching and visual communication skills.

• Experience working with CAD development and cross-functional product development teams.

• Ability to translate creative direction into distinctive and commercially relevant products.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills within an international environment.

• Experience mentoring or supporting junior designers is an advantage.

• Proficiency in relevant design tools, including Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign.

Important

Please include a portfolio as part of your application, showcasing your design work, creative process, sketching and technical capabilities, and examples of collections or products you have helped take from concept to final execution.

Applications without a portfolio may not be considered.

Your New Team

As a key member of Pandora's Product Design team, you will join an international group of passionate and highly skilled designers dedicated to creating beautiful and innovative jewellery.

You will report to the Design Director and collaborate closely with colleagues across Creative Direction, Design Operations & Development, Creative Merchandising, Creative Sourcing and Product Development.

Additional Information

This is a 12-month fixed-term contract based at Pandora's Global Office in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Did We Get Your Attention?

If you see yourself in this opportunity and would like to contribute to Pandora's future, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Please submit your CV and portfolio through our online application system. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply at your earliest convenience.

Icing on the Cake

You will be working from our beautiful Global Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Alongside our inspiring work environment, we are proud to hold LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design, reflecting our commitment to sustainability and responsible use of resources.

The result is a professional and dynamic workspace that is unique, comfortable and inspirational, delivering a true Pandora experience to everyone who works here and visits our offices.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

jobs.occupation: Senior Product Specialist, Fermented High Protein - Aarhus
jobs.description:
Is your mind set on innovation and developing the next generation of high-protein dairy products?

Are you looking for a role where you can combine deep process expertise, product development excellence and capability building to shape the future of Fermented High Protein products?

This could be your chance to join a leading global dairy company that takes innovation, product superiority and process excellence seriously. The job location is based in our Arla Innovation Centre in Aarhus.

“You will be part of our Fermented High Protein Innovation team, helping to create superior products, strengthen our process capabilities and build the knowledge foundations needed for future growth. So, if you are passionate about working in a fast-paced international environment and want to make a significant impact on the future of Skyr, Quark, Greek yoghurt and other high-protein dairy platforms, this could be your next career move_,” says Associate Director – High Protein Fermented Innovation, Jorden Naseby

Create Product & Process Excellence for Fermented High Protein Innovation

We are looking to strengthen process capability across our Fermented High Protein organisation.

Your main goal is to combine hands-on product development with process leadership, helping the team make robust, data-driven decisions and creating the tools, knowledge and best practices needed to accelerate innovation. You will work closely with Innovation, Science, Operations, Quality, Packaging, Marketing and Supply Chain teams across Europe.

This position places you in a unique role where you will influence both today's products and the future capability of the organisation. You will drive deep process development expertise to support capex investment projects across our network of production sites.

Key responsibilities include:

• Leading complex product and process development projects from concept to launch.

• Acting as a product and process expert across fermented high-protein product platforms including Skyr, Quark, yoghurt and emerging technologies.

• Driving laboratory, pilot and industrial trials and translating technical findings into clear business recommendations.

• Identifying and solving complex product quality, stability and process challenges.

• Leading knowledge in process and product interactions within the team.

• Developing technical playbooks, guidelines, troubleshooting tools and best-practice ways of working.

• Establishing structured approaches for experimentation, data interpretation and root-cause analysis.

• Contributing to future product and technology roadmaps within Fermented High Protein.

• Supporting external manufacturing, supplier collaborations and Contract Manufacturing activities where specialist technical expertise is required.

Inventive, product and processing expert, strong and able to challenge the status quo.

If you hold a degree in Food Science, Dairy Technology, Food Engineering or a related discipline, and have significant experience in product & process development within dairy or food manufacturing, you may have the credentials we are looking for.

You are passionate about applying science to solve real business challenges and have a proven ability to translate technical complexity into practical solutions.

Experience within fermented dairy products, high-protein products, fermentation, process development & large-scale manufacturing is a necessity.

You are comfortable influencing without authority and can work effectively across multiple functions, sites and cultures. You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping others develop technical confidence and capability.

This role requires:

• Technical leadership in process and site capabilities across the network.

• Strong product and process development expertise.

• Analytical and data-driven decision making.

• Curiosity and a continuous improvement mindset.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

• The ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

• Fluency in English, written and spoken.

Finally, you build strong relationships, challenge constructively and thrive in an environment where innovation, learning and collaboration are valued.

Application & Contact

If you want to seize this opportunity to help shape the future of Fermented High Protein Innovation and accelerate your career, then please apply as soon as possible.

We process applications on a continuous basis and close the posting once the right candidate has been found.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

Retire the ERP.

Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our Smart Financial Platform gives modern, global companies superpowers—automated accounting, real-time reporting, and financial flows that move at the speed of the business.

We build with our customers, ship fast, and obsess over craft. In a short time, Light has gone from idea to the operating core for leading companies like Lovable, Legora, and Keyshot. People don't just use Light—they enjoy it.

We're an early team defining a new software category. Think engineers who love debits and credits, designers who care about reconciliation states, and operators who treat finance as a product. If you're excited to modernize how the world runs money—one workflow at a time—you're in the right place.

Backed by world-class investors and advised by industry titans, we're building category-defining products with the freedom to ship ambitiously and own outcomes. Come help us make Light the global default for next-gen finance.

This Integrations Engineer role

Light is only as powerful as the systems it connects to. Money doesn't move because we say so—it moves because we speak the language of the bank, the e-invoicing network, and the planning tool on the other side, correctly, every time, for every customer entity. This role owns that layer: the interaction surface between Light and the rest of the financial world.

You'll build and operate the integrations that let Light plug into multi-tenant banking APIs (J.P. Morgan, HSBC, and peers), global e-invoicing networks, and tax platforms and more. This is backend-heavy, data-integrity-critical work where a dropped message or a silent reconciliation mismatch is not an acceptable outcome. You'll design the abstractions that turn a dozen incompatible partner APIs into one coherent internal model, and you'll keep those abstractions honest as partners change their specs underneath you.

What you'll work on:

• 
Bank connectivity. Build against corporate banking and payments APIs—account information, payment initiation, status reporting, FX—across providers like J.P. Morgan Payments and HSBC. Handle the realities of bank integrations: certificate-based and mTLS auth, OAuth flows, ISO 20022 (pain/pacs/camt) and legacy MT formats, sandbox-to-production parity, and rate limits that assume you're a bank, not a startup.

• 
Multi-tenancy done right. Our customers are many legal entities operating in many countries. You'll design integrations where credentials, configuration, and data are isolated per tenant, where onboarding a new entity is a workflow rather than a code change, and where one customer's failure never leaks into another's.

• 
Global e-invoicing. Connect Light to e-invoicing networks and country-specific mandates (Peppol and the growing set of national clearance and reporting regimes). Map between formats, manage compliance-driven edge cases, and keep delivery auditable.

• 
Tax platforms for statutory filing, US sales tax and much more.

• 
Reliability and reconciliation. Idempotency, retries, webhook and polling strategies, dead-letter handling, and end-to-end reconciliation so that what we think happened and what actually happened always agree.

Your qualifications

4-6 years of experience ideally, plus…

You build things. Not prototypes, not demos. Working software in production, doing something real for real users. This is the non-negotiable.

You've built integrations against unforgiving external systems. APIs you don't control, that fail in ways the docs don't mention, where correctness is contractual. You know how to defend a system against a partner that returns a 200 with an error in the body.

You know banking and payments APIs. Direct, hands-on experience with corporate banking, treasury, or payments APIs is what sets the strongest candidates apart. Experience integrating J.P. Morgan or HSBC specifically—their developer platforms, auth models, and payment and reporting APIs—is highly valuable and a genuine differentiator for this role. Familiarity with ISO 20022, SWIFT, virtual accounts, or open banking is a strong signal.

You are excited about AI. You use AI tooling efficiently to improve your work. At Light, a lot of code is written with AI, which means the hard part is increasingly the thinking: deciding what to build, reviewing what comes back, and catching where the model is confidently wrong. You know when AI speeds you up, when it's likely to mislead you, and how to lean on it while staying fully responsible for what ships.

You're comfortable across the stack. You don't need to be a specialist in everything, but you can't have a lane you refuse to leave. Our stack is Kotlin and React, and this role leans backend. If you're strong on the backend and curious about the rest, that works.

You care about data integrity. You think about the person on the other end and the money moving between them. You notice when a flow is correct but fragile, and you act on it.

You ship early and often. Small batches. Learn. Go again. You'd rather put something real in front of a customer than spend another week perfecting it in isolation.

Bonus points

• 
Experience in fintech or systems where data integrity is non-negotiable

• 
Familiarity with accounting concepts: debits, credits, reconciliation

• 
Experience with e-invoicing standards or country-specific compliance regimes

• 
Background in high-growth startups where everything was still being figured out

Our Tech Stack

We build on AWS, with a Kotlin backend, a React frontend, and infrastructure managed in Terraform. It's a real production system that global finance teams depend on every day. The integration layer you'll own sits squarely in the Kotlin backend, talking to a long list of external partners. You don't need to have used every piece of it. You do need to be comfortable in this kind of environment: real scale, real customers, real stakes.

The good stuff

In addition to being part of a great team and working in a really fun and innovative environment, we offer:

• 
A competitive salary + potential stock options

• 
25 days of annual leave + public holidays in the country where you are based

• 
Regular socials and company off-sites

• 
A huge opportunity for career growth as you'll help shape a market-defining product

The famous last words

Working at Light means you're embarking on an exciting journey to reshape the future of multinational financial operations. Our cheat-code is that we've built something like this before—and are now doing it again, only better. Our goal is to make global finance effortless and empower companies to make informed decisions.

Join the rocket ship while it's taking off.

Working at

Light

Light is the new way to run multinational finances for modern technology companies. Run AR, AP, expenses, bookkeeping, and financial reporting automatically across all your entities — without the chaos of multiple systems. Crafted and built by the designers and engineers behind world-class companies like Spotify, X, AWS, Klarna, Google and Shopify, we empower multinational finances with a joyful user experience like no other.

JOIN Terotech

Ready for a career that's challenging, fun, and ever changing?

Terotech has your back on maintaining your equipment.

Working at Terotech

At Terotech, you do more than maintain equipment - you keep large assets running that support critical infrastructure.

We're 50+ people based in Esbjerg, working in Denmark and internationally. Oil & gas, energy, manufacturing - all industries where downtime isn't an option. You learn fast, solve real problems, and see results immediately.

A Place You'll Want to Stay

We work hard - but the industries we serve demand it. That said, we believe work should be somewhere you want to show up. Where colleagues become friends, and people actually care about how your week went.

We meet by the coffee machine. We solve problems as a team. We celebrate wins and support each other continually. The social side isn't extra, but part of our DNA.

Here's something we're proud of: People who've left for other opportunities often stay in touch. Some come back. A few have said they missed the people and culture as much as the work itself. That's the kind of workplace we want to keep building.

Considering a career in Terotech?

We hire for technical skill and personal fit. You need to be a team player who takes initiative, follows through, and speaks up when something isn't right. Our culture is built on five core values: curiosity, openness, empathy, trust, and integrity. This is what you can expect from us, and what we expect from you.

Curiosity

means we keep learning - from each other, and from the problems we solve. We don't just execute tasks, we're curious about understanding our client's world.

Openness

shows in how we communicate. We say what we mean, admit when we don't know something, and share knowledge freely. No hidden agendas.

Empathy

means we see the person, not just the role. Good maintenance work starts with understanding what actually matters to the people involved.

Trust

is earned through follow-through. We do what we say we'll do. We honor the trust clients place in us when they hand over responsibility for their operations.

Integrity

means we speak up when something isn't right - whether it's a safety issue, an unsound plan, or a colleague who needs support.

our People

Maintenance engineers

who’ve kept industrial facilities running for year, both offshore and onshore.

Mechanics and technicians

with decades of hands-on experience in high-stakes environments.

Electricians

who can troubleshoot complex systems under pressure.

Asset Management specialists

who turn data into decisions.

Programmers and data analysts

who build systems people want use.

Project managers

who keep everything on track.

Considering a career in Terotech?

Check our open positions

We’re always looking for talented colleagues who share our values and want to do meaningful work. If you think you’d be a good fit, send us an unsolicited application to Jannie Schlosser Lund at jsl@tero.tech and tell us what you’re good at and why you want to be part of our team.

Maintenance Engineer

We are looking for an ambitious new colleague to join our young and dynamic team. You are motivated by making a real difference within maintenance and asset management and are eager to help organizations improve the performance and sustainability of their physical assets. In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop into a leading advisor within the field. You will work hands-on with our solutions, taking them from concept to implementation and seeing the results delivered directly at both existing and future client sites.

Location

Esbjerg, Denmark

Position

Full-time

Read more and submit your application

jobs.occupation: Part-Time Warehouse Workers – Container Unloading & Warehouse Tasks
jobs.description:
Are you ready to get stuck in and do you enjoy physical work and an active working day?

We are currently looking for several part-time warehouse workers for our customer in Taulov, near Fredericia.

The work mainly consists of unloading containers and general warehouse duties. The job can be physically demanding, so it is important that you are in good physical condition and comfortable with an active working day where you are ready to get the job done.

Your main tasks

Your primary tasks will include:

• Unloading containers

• Pick and packing

• scanning of goods

• Put labels on the item

• Repacking

• General warehouse duties

Who are you?

We are looking for someone who:

• Is in good physical condition and comfortable with physically demanding work

• Has the motivation and willingness to work

• Is reliable and responsible

• Is not afraid to get stuck in and work hard

• Has a positive attitude

• Can work both independently and as part of a team

• Can communicate in English as a minimum

Working hours

This is a part-time position on the day shift, with working hours within:

07:00 – 15:00

What we offer

• Fast start date

• Part-time work on the day shift

• Warehouse and logistics work

• Salary and employment conditions in accordance with the applicable collective agreement

• Personal support and ongoing communication from VikarCompagniet

• Possibility of additional shifts and longer-term opportunities for the right candidates

Why join VikarCompagniet?

At VikarCompagniet, we are committed to matching the right people with the right companies.

When you work with us, you can expect personal support and ongoing communication throughout your employment. We value fair working conditions, good communication, and a strong working relationship.

Ready to join the team?

If you are motivated, reliable, in good physical condition, and ready to work, we would like to hear from you.

Apply today! We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and are looking for candidates who can start as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you!

• Contribute to system design and architecture

Full-Stack Software Engineer (Mid/Senior)

• You will own features end to end, from the data model through to the screen, on a platform that manufacturers rely on to keep production lines running.

• We're building legitimately useful tools for the industries and companies that make the world go around.... manufacturers. Both AI-tools and just "plain-old-good-software" tools.

About Supplios

Manufacturers live or die by their supply base. Sourcing the wrong supplier, onboarding one slowly, failing to qualify one properly or losing track of a non-conformance can stop a production line and cost millions. Yet most manufacturers still run these relationships across email chains, spreadsheets and shared drives.

We cover the full supplier relationship: sourcing, onboarding, qualification, day-to-day collaboration, compliance and supplier quality, all in a modern cloud based platform that is easy for manufacturers to implement and operate. It is built specifically for the way automotive and industrial manufacturers actually work.

We are headquartered in central Copenhagen and already serve customers globally in our vertical, including some of the most demanding names in automotive. We have grown to this point almost entirely on product strength, domain credibility and word of mouth.

The platform now covers more ground than the team that built it. We are hiring engineers to keep that pace sustainable, and to go deeper on the parts of the product our customers are pushing hardest.

The role

You will join a small engineering team and work across the whole stack: Python on the backend, TypeScript on the frontend and in the AI layers. There is no split between people who design and people who implement. You will take a problem from a customer conversation or a product decision through to something running in production for real manufacturers.

You will work directly with our co-founder and CEO, who is a hands-on product builder himself. That means short conversations instead of tickets thrown over a wall, and it means your questions about why something should work a certain way get answered by the person who decided it.

The domain is genuinely complicated, and that is the interesting part. Supplier relationships in automotive involve deep hierarchies, long-running approval processes, strict audit requirements and a lot of state that has to be exactly right. Modeling that well is most of the job.

Title and level flex with experience. We are open to strong mid-level engineers and to senior engineers who want more scope than their current company gives them.

We work together from our office in central Copenhagen. This is primarily an in-office role: at this stage, and on a codebase with this much implicit context, working through problems with the rest of the team in person is much faster than doing it in writing. Sensible flexibility when you need it is a given; full-time remote is not what we are offering.

Our current stack:

• Backend: Python / Django

• Frontend: Vue (but no specific Vue experience is needed)

• Infrastructure: AWS (mostly)

• Agents: Cloudflare (TypeScript) + Claude & OpenAI platform

What you will do

• Build features end to end, from data model and backend logic through to the TypeScript frontend our customers actually click on.

• Build end-to-end / front-to-back AI features (in-app AI assistants, background worker agents, email-routing agents, customer-configurable agent framework components)

• Design and evolve the relational data model that sits under supplier relationships, approvals and quality records.

• Take vaguely defined customer problems and turn them into something specific enough to build, then build it.

• Work on integrations between Supplios and customer systems (ERP and adjacent tooling), where failures have visible consequences for a production line.

• Improve the parts of the codebase that need it, rather than routing around them.

• Review other people's code and have yours reviewed; we keep the loop tight and unbureaucratic.

• Help keep the platform healthy in production across our regions: errors, performance and the boring things that keep customers trusting us.

• Take part in product decisions. Engineers here are expected to have opinions about what we build, not just how.

What we are looking for

Essential

• Professional experience with Python. This is not negotiable; the backend is Python and you need to be effective in it.

• Solid TypeScript experience and genuine comfort working on the frontend.

• Experience building and running SaaS products, including the part after launch where real users depend on them.

• AI-forward development techniques. (This does not mean you no longer write code.)

• A track record of owning work end to end without waiting to be told what to do next.

• The temperament for a small, senior company: high ownership, low ceremony.

• You want to work primarily from an office in central Copenhagen, with a small team.

Nice to have

Genuinely a plus, not a requirement. Nobody has all of these.

• Experience with B2B enterprise SaaS, especially where customers are large and demanding and implementations are not self-serve. This is a significant plus.

• Experience with complex relational data modeling, and with large, long-lived codebases that you did not write yourself. A big plus.

• Experience building AI-based products, using the latest frameworks/harnesses and infrastructure components (including RAG) is a significant plus.

• Familiarity with any of: domain-driven design, the actor model, finite state machines, CQRS, event-driven architecture. We use these ideas where they earn their place, and it helps if the vocabulary is already yours.

• Startup experience, particularly early stage. A significant plus.

• Knowledge of manufacturing, automotive or supply chain. Useful, but we can teach you the domain; we cannot teach you the craft, so do not rule yourself out on this.

Language

English is the only important language for this position; we work in English, and so do our customers. Danish language skills are not required.

Why this role is worth your time

• The scope is unusually large for the stage. You are one of a small number of engineers on a platform that serves demanding customers globally. What you build ships, and it ships soon.

• No layers between you and the decisions. You work directly with the co-founder and CEO, who runs product. There is no committee to navigate and nobody to translate your work for you.

• Hard problems that are not artificially hard. The complexity comes from the domain (hierarchies, state, audit trails, integrations that must not fail), not from organisational overhead.

• Real customers already, and real gaps. The product has paying customers in automotive and clear places where it needs to get better. Both halves of that are true, and both are why this is a good job.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short note on why this role interests you to team@supplios.com. Work examples will help.

Apply by email

Send an email to team@supplios.com

Please include your CV / resume, and a brief note about why you're interested in the position.

Thanks!

Gubra is a science-enabled biotech company advancing peptide-based drug discovery, development and preclinical research, driven by impact for patients, planet and people. If you are a pragmatic, collaborative lawyer who wants to use your legal expertise to help us succeed in a fast-paced fun environment, you will thrive with us.

The opportunity

As Gubra continues to grow, so does the breadth and complexity of the legal and compliance matters supporting our business. We are therefore looking for a Legal Counsel to join our Legal team and work across Gubra's CRO Services, Biotech, Ventures and group functions.

Gubra operates at the intersection of scientific research, drug discovery and development, and commercial partnerships. Our activities span Biotech, Ventures and Business Development, Gubra Green, CRO Services, enabled by specialist corporate functions, in an entrepreneurial environment of around 330 employees.

Reporting to the Group General Counsel, you will have a broad role spanning commercial contracting, healthcare compliance, corporate governance and general legal advice. You will work closely with colleagues across the organization, translating legal requirements into pragmatic solutions that enable the business to move forward while managing risk appropriately.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys combining sound legal judgement with a practical understanding of how a growing life sciences business operates.

Your role

You will act as a trusted legal partner to the business, with a particular focus on supporting Gubra's CRO Services, and Biotech discovery and development activities.

A significant part of the role will involve contracts. You will help simplify and strengthen the way we contract, including taking a leading role in templates, reviews and legal contracting support for CRO Services. You will also draft, review and negotiate agreements across Biotech and our group functions.

Beyond contracting, you will advise colleagues on a broad range of legal and compliance matters across the product lifecycle and help our functions build legal and compliance by design into their processes from the outset.

You will work across professional disciplines and therefore need to understand both the legal or compliance issue at hand and the commercial, scientific or operational context around it.

How you will create impact

• Lead legal drafting, review and negotiation as primary contracting support for our CRO Services business, including the development and maintenance of practical contract templates, playbooks and review processes and related legal technology opportunities.

• Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of commercial agreements, including vendor, clinical trial, CRO/CDMO, IT, intercompany, confidentiality and consultancy agreements.

• Advise on legal and healthcare compliance matters across the biotech discovery and development lifecycle, including anti-bribery and corruption, advertising and promotion, development and regulatory matters, privacy and data protection, exclusivity and product liability.

• Partner with group functions to support the group leads to embed compliance into their activities and ways of working, including matters related to websites and digital channels, AI, cyber and information security, data protection, labour and employment, health and safety, equity incentive programms, tax and immigration, property, environment and other ESG requirements.

• Support public-company corporate governance and affiliate management, including corporate filings, Board and affiliate activities, whistleblower arrangements, disclosure requirements and insider-trading processes.

• Help develop, implement and continuously improve legal and compliance policies, communications and training programmes.

• Support the implementation and effective use of legal and compliance technology, with a focus on simplifying processes, improving visibility and increasing efficiency.

• Monitor relevant changes in laws and regulations, assess their potential impact on Gubra and help translate new requirements into practical actions across the business.

• Work closely with colleagues across the Gubra functions on matters requiring cross-functional legal input.

Your profile

We are looking for a collaborative and commercially minded risk focused lawyer who combines strong legal fundamentals with curiosity, sound judgement and a pragmatic approach to help the business act responsibly. You are comfortable working independently, and equally comfortable involving colleagues or escalating issues when the circumstances call for it.

We expect that you bring:

• Approximately 3–5 years of post-qualification legal experience, including at least 2 years of in-house experience within the pharmaceutical, medical device or biotech industry.

• Strong experience drafting, reviewing and negotiating contracts across all business areas, including agreements relevant to pharmaceutical development, biotech or CRO activities.

• A passion for helping build solutions to the business deliver in the right way and balanced risk tolerance and assessment.

• A good understanding of the legal and compliance environment applicable to life sciences companies and an ability to apply that knowledge pragmatically.

• Experience advising internal stakeholders and translating complex legal requirements into clear and actionable guidance.

• The ability to manage and deliver competing priorities, a varied workload in a fast paced environment and move comfortably between detailed contract work and broader legal, compliance and governance questions.

• A university degree in Law. Admission to the bar or equivalent qualification to practise law is an advantage.

• Ability to draft in English and Danish. Strong written and spoken Danish and English.

It is an advantage if you also bring:

• Experience advising CRO, drug discovery or drug-development contracting and related activities.

• Exposure to healthcare compliance, clinical development or pharmaceutical regulatory matters.

• Exposure to public-company governance and compliance.

• Experience implementing legal operations, contract-management or compliance technology.

• Experience working across jurisdictions in an international organisation.

Personal qualities:

• Pragmatic and commercially minded. You look for solutions that enable Gubra to embrace opportunity and to protect Gubra, while allowing the business to progress and execute in the right way.

• Curious and comfortable with complexity. You are interested in understanding the science, business and operational context behind a legal and compliance question.

• Collaborative and approachable. You build trusted relationships and enjoy working with colleagues from different professional backgrounds.

• Confident in your judgement. You can challenge constructively, explain your reasoning clearly and know when an issue needs to be escalated.

• Hands-on and accountable. You take ownership, manage priorities effectively and follow matters through to completion.

• Clear and concise communicator. You can see patterns and turn complex issues legislation and legal analysis into practical advice that non-lawyers can understand and act on.

About Gubra

Gubra is a disease-agnostic techbio company specialised in peptide-based drug discovery and development, ventures and business development and preclinical contract research services. Our activities are focused on the early stages of discovery and drug development and organised around highly synergistic business areas: Biotech, Ventures and Business Development, CRO Services, Gubra Green and Group Functions.

Our therapeutic focus includes metabolic and fibrotic diseases, while our capabilities span areas such as in vivo pharmacology, ex vivo assays, drug profiling, histology, imaging and advanced transcriptomics. Gubra's ML/AI-driven peptide drug discovery platform, streaMLine™, supports the rapid development of peptide hits towards nonclinical candidates.

Our team consists of around 330 employees, many located in Hørsholm, Denmark and others in the US, Europe, UK and Switzerland. Our working environment combines different cultures and educational backgrounds with entrepreneurial drive, scientific curiosity and teamwork.

The Aarhus Institute of Advanced Studies (AIAS) is pleased to announce an exclusive fellowship opportunity for a researcher who holds a position at a Swedish research institution. The fellowship is made possible through a collaboration with Riksbankens Jubileumsfond in Sweden.The purpose of the AIAS-RJ fellowship is to strengthen the ties and expand collaborations between the Swedish and Danish research communities.

Why apply for an AIAS-RJ Fellowship

AIAS is a haven for intellectual exploration, hosting excellent researchers eager to develop their work in an interdisciplinary, international and collaborative environment. AIAS nurtures an innovative atmosphere where breakthroughs emerge through transparent, inclusive and reflective discussions, offering a space for engagement and creativity.

The AIAS-RJ fellowship gives the selected fellow the opportunity to concentrate on their own research interests while also being an active member of the AIAS research community and participating in and contributing to seminars and activities beyond their own field of expertise. The fellow must be eager to engage in the interdisciplinary community at AIAS and expand research collaborations with colleagues at Aarhus University.

Who can apply for an AIAS-RJ Fellowship

The call is open to curiosity-driven researchers who:

• are of any nationality who hold a tenured position at a Swedish research institution

• work within the humanities and social sciences

• have a research experience of minimum 4 years after completion of the PhD

A unique interdisciplinary platform at AIAS

AIAS fosters connections, sparks ideas and dissolves boundaries as fellows engage with researchers from different disciplines within the Institute and across departments and research hubs at Aarhus University. Therefore, the call welcomes applications from all research areas and themes.

With a location within the unique campus of Aarhus University, AIAS functions as an interdisciplinary platform that connects researchers across Aarhus University and international scholars. AIAS has fellows who work in thematic groups or in individual fellowships, and hosts events and activities, which AIAS-RJ fellows are welcome to join and contribute to.

AIAS and Aarhus University strive to create a multidisciplinary, inclusive academic environment and to be an inspiring workplace for all by fostering a culture in which the individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The fellowship includes

The AIAS-RJ Fellow is offered:

• a salary based on seniority (employment conditions and wages are regulated through the Danish collective union agreements)

• travel costs to and from Aarhus

• relocation assistance

• a moderate budget for research-related costs

The AIAS-RJ Fellow will have office space at AIAS and can participate in academic training activities, conferences and workshops at AIAS. They will also be affiliated with the relevant research environments at Aarhus University.

How to apply: Application process and deadline

In the ‘Guide for Applicants,’ you can find the detailed application requirements and more information on the structure of the application system, the selection criteria and the selection process.

HOURS FULL TIME

Concept & Prototype Development

• 
You'll select and design acoustic components based on product and market requirements.

• 
You'll define initial enclosure concepts.

• 
You'll build and evaluate proof-of-concept prototypes to validate acoustic concepts.

• 
You'll collaborate with Mechanical Engineering during the early product development phase to mature acoustic concepts.

Simulation & Validation

You'll perform acoustic simulations with a focus on sound pressure level (SPL), sound quality, and system efficiency.

• 
You'll validate simulation results through physical testing.

• 
You'll collaborate with suppliers to refine acoustic components based on simulation and test results.

Driver Specification & Verification

• 
You'll own the technical specification of loudspeaker drivers towards suppliers.

You'll define driver specifications and tolerances.

•

•

Familiarity with crossover design, FEM simulations, or failure analysis is an advantage.

•

• 
You work independently, take ownership of your area, and enjoy collaborating closely with engineers across disciplines.

• 
You're curious, creative, and constantly looking for ways to improve acoustic performance.

• 
You're drawn to what SOUNDBOKS is building and are excited to be a part of the journey!

So, if you’re tired of all of the noise in the job market, we’d love to hear from you. This may be the coolest job you ever have!

At Helion B2B we don't just "run ads" for our clients. We build data-driven growth engines for some of the most ambitious B2B companies in Europe. But an engine is only as good as its sensors. That's where you come in.

You won't just keep the engine running. You'll help build it.

You'll join our tracking team in Aarhus, working day to day with our Tracking Lead. Real ownership early, someone who has done all of it sitting right next to you, and a direct hand in how the practice develops. We have standards, and we like them being challenged. If you think we're doing something the hard way, we'd rather hear it in week two than in year two.

Some of that is building something new. A lot of it is taking a setup that already exists and making it better than you found it, which is where data quality actually comes from. Your scope over the clients you look after grows from there.

Google Tag Manager: Web containers from day one, server-side (sGTM) as you grow into it.

You're a finisher. "Done" means tested and verified, not deployed.

Server-side GTM and Conversions API. Consent Mode in depth. HubSpot data flows. BigQuery. Multi-market container architecture. Reporting and analysis on top of GA4 and BigQuery. B2B lead cycles, and why they make tracking a harder problem than e-commerce.

Do you have experience working with children with special needs, and do you enjoy an active one-to-one role? Then you could become an important source of support for a 9-year-old boy who loves movement, play and safe, predictable routines.

About the role

You will provide regular one-to-one support for a 9-year-old boy with autism and an intellectual disability. He needs close support, clear structure and a calm approach that helps create predictability.

The boy is energetic, enjoys being active and particularly likes outdoor play, trips to the playground and running in the woods. He also enjoys activities such as puzzles, music, bubbles, balloons and sensory toys. Your role is to plan and take part in activities that match his pace and needs. As he has limited awareness of danger, it is important that you stay close to him and remain attentive to his surroundings.

The role includes assistance with personal care, including bathing, changing diapers and toilet training. You will also provide support at mealtimes, with a focus on motivating and guiding him towards gradually becoming more independent.

The boy does not communicate verbally and uses only a few English words. It is therefore important that you are able to communicate in English, including with his parents, who do not speak Danish.

The boy has food allergies and has an EpiPen, which must be used in the event of an allergic reaction. The family will provide thorough instructions on its use. He also has asthma, and his parents are responsible for all medication management.

About you

You may be a qualified pedagogue/social educator or have relevant experience working with children with special needs. You approach the child with calmness, patience and clarity, and you enjoy an active working environment where you take part in play and physical activities.

At the same time, you are able to create structure and a sense of security, be attentive and provide clear boundaries when needed. As communication with the family takes place in English, you must be able to communicate confidently in English.

A driving licence is an advantage. Alternatively, you must be comfortable using the family’s cargo bike, which will be provided.

We offer a wide range of courses, and as a DUOS employee, you will receive relevant induction and ongoing professional development. Working with people at DUOS also gives you the opportunity to develop both personally and professionally.

If you have any further questions, please contact Recruitment Consultant Trine Ankær Johansen on +45 36 34 49 90. You can also find answers to general questions in our FAQ.

We are people helping people

At DUOS, we help people in their everyday lives, support them through challenging situations and contribute to their well-being and quality of life. As one of Denmark’s largest and longest-established welfare service providers, we strive to be there where support is needed.
