**AI Agent Engineer

**Department: AI Delivery

Location: Copenhagen

Working model: Onsite

Reports to: AI Product Lead

Salary: Competitive

**About Autoflows

**Autoflows is an agentic after-sales platform for automotive retail.

We deploy AI agents across dealerships in Europe that handle customer conversations end to end across voice and messaging. Our agents identify the right moment to contact customers about service, MOT, warranty and other after-sales opportunities, then handle the conversation, book the appointment and write the outcome back into the dealership's systems.

Our platform connects with DMS, CRM and OEM data, turning after-sales work that traditionally sits in queues into work that runs itself.

We are now scaling across clients, markets and languages. That requires us to build a delivery capability that does not depend on one person knowing how everything works.

**The Role

**As an AI Agent Engineer, you will build, deploy, debug and continuously improve the conversational agents running across our clients.

**You Will Work Across The Full Lifecycle

****Build → Test → Deploy → Monitor → Debug → Improve

**You will start closely with the AI Product Lead and progressively take independent ownership of production agents and client implementations.

The role is not just about configuring agents. With time you will also help build the tooling and systems that make agents easier to deploy, operate and maintain at scale. Architectural decisions for the core agentic platform stay with the AI Product Lead; your platform involvement is about the tooling layer around agents, not the underlying architecture itself.

**What You'll Do

****Agent development

**

• Build and tune agents across voice, chat, SMS and WhatsApp

• Develop prompts, tools, workflows, guardrails and fallback paths

• Test agents against realistic customer scenarios

• Improve agent behavior using production data and conversation analysis

**Production & implementation

**

• Diagnose and fix live issues such as model failures, mispronunciations, failed tool calls, broken workflows and missing fallback paths

• Own new agent deployments as dealership clients onboard

• Adapt agents to different processes, languages and markets

• Work directly with clients when technical input is required

• Identify root causes rather than applying temporary fixes

**Integrations

**

• Work with DMS, CRM and other dealership systems

• Configure and troubleshoot integrations for customer data and workshop bookings

• Build reusable patterns for recurring integration requirements

**Agentic platform tooling

**

• We are building an agentic platform, not a collection of manually maintained bots. You will be encouraged to identify repetitive work and turn it into systems. This may include:

• Automated testing and evaluation

• Monitoring and regression detection

• Automated diagnosis of recurring failures

• Self-healing or automated recovery for well-understood failure modes

• Automated deployment and configuration

• Reusable agent components and workflows

• Agent-assisted documentation and operational tooling

• Systems that allow agents to improve from production feedback within defined quality and safety boundaries

**| "The principle is simple: if we solve the same problem repeatedly, we should build a system that solves it for us."

****Architecture & delivery

**

• Work with the AI Product Lead on complex architectural decisions

• Help determine when to use prompting, workflow logic, deterministic code, specialised agents or other approaches

• Document recurring solutions and contribute to the team's technical playbook

• Help establish standards that make future deployments faster and more reliable

**What We're Looking For

**This role sits between AI, technology and human behaviour. Technical ability is necessary, but technical ability alone is not enough. Our agents speak to real customers. You need to care about what the interaction feels like, not just whether the system technically works.

**Technical

**

• Hands-on experience building with LLMs and AI APIs

• Strong understanding of prompting and model behaviour

• Experience debugging AI or software systems

• Ability to reason through ambiguous technical problems

• Comfort working without a finished specification

• Ability to learn unfamiliar platforms and systems quickly

**Human & social

**

• Strong social skills and clear communication

• Natural curiosity about how people think, speak and respond

• Ability to look at an interaction from the customer's perspective

• Good judgement about tone, context and conversational nuance

• Comfortable speaking directly with clients and asking the questions needed to understand a problem

• Able to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical people

• Open to feedback and willing to change your approach when evidence shows it is not working

• Interested in how language and culture affect conversational AI

**Builder mindset

**

• You investigate why something failed rather than simply fixing the visible symptom

• You notice repetitive work and look for ways to automate it

• You are comfortable experimenting, testing and iterating

• You think beyond the individual agent and look for ways to improve the underlying platform

**Strong plus

**

• Conversational AI or agent-building experience

• Voice AI, chatbots or workflow automation

• API and systems integration experience

• Experience with tools, function calling or agentic workflows

• Experience operating production AI systems

• Experience working across multiple languages

• Experience with CRM, ERP, DMS or similar business systems

• Automotive experience is not required.

**| "We would rather hire a technically capable builder who understands people than a technically exceptional engineer who does not."

****Success in the Role

**As you become fully productive, you should be able to:

• Independently diagnose and resolve most common agent failures

• Build and deploy agents with limited supervision

• Own production improvements from investigation through deployment

• Handle recurring integration problems

• Turn repeated manual work into reusable systems

• Improve the reliability and scalability of our agent platform

• Reduce the amount of hands-on implementation required from the AI Product Lead

**The Team

****You Will Work In a Small AI Delivery Team

**AI Product Lead - Owns product direction, architecture, priorities, technical standards and complex technical decisions

AI Agent Engineer - Owns agent development, implementation, production debugging and platform improvements

AI/ML Student - Supports testing, evaluation, research, data work, experimentation and implementation

Because the team is small, you will have significant ownership and direct exposure to the systems we are building.

**How To Apply

**Send your CV along with:

Show us something you built, broke or fixed. A link, repository, write-up, video or before/after example. We care more about how you approached the problem than how polished the result is.

Tell us why this problem interests you. Give us a short note explaining what attracts you to conversational AI, agentic systems and the challenge of making them work reliably in the real world.

Contact: Maz Katinas, AI Product Lead

jobs.occupation: Internship in Embedded Software Development and Wireless Technology
jobs.description:
Are you curious about how wireless communication systems power the smart technologies of tomorrow? Do you want to explore embedded software development on a Linux platform? Would you like to join an interdisciplinary R&D team where learning, collaboration, and innovation go hand in hand?

Here is what the job entails

During your internship, you will be part of our concentrator team, where we develop infrastructure products for collecting smart meter data. Your focus will be on embedded development for our Linux platform inside the concentrators, as well as contributing to our solution for automated monitoring the concentrators in operation at our customers.

You will be working with one or more of the following areas during the internship:

• Embedded software development in C++

• Linux platforms

• Statistical data analysis

• Data analysis and visualisation in Python

• Platforms for dashboarding, like Grafana or similar

• Performance analysis of wireless systems

You will gain experience with all phases of a typical development project at Kamstrup – from idea and evaluation to design and prototype implementation. This will give you valuable insight into the diverse and exciting role of a development engineer and help strengthen your future career. The specific content of the internship will be planned together according to your ambitions and competences. It is also possible to work with the topic described above as a semester project or M.Sc. thesis of 6–12 months duration.

Meet your future team

As Intern in our R&D department within wireless communication for smart metering, you will be an integral part of the interdisciplinary team, collaborating with engineers on various development tasks. Together we work to ensure that the data transmissions from smart meters are received and made available to our customers. You will become part of a strong work environment where you will experience a focus on freedom with responsibility and personal development.

Did you know? In addition to Linux experts the team has a homebrewer of beer, a pizza chef and a university lecturer. Moreover, every half year we break out from the development projects and embark on a one-week hackathon, where the entire team collaborates on small proof-of-concept projects.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for a motivated student who can contribute to the R&D department with their updated theoretical knowledge.

In order to succeed we imagine that you:

• Are pursuing a relevant engineering degree (e.g., Electrical Engineering or Information and Communication Technology) with an interest in mathematics, communication theory, and software development.

• Have a curious, thorough, and structured approach to solving complex challenges.

• Work independently with attention to detail and a strong desire to learn.

• Value collaboration and strive for continuous professional and personal growth.

As we are an international organisation it is important that you are fluent in English. Danish will be an asset, but not a requirement.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Besides the best program, we also offer:

• The internship is paid if your place of study allows it

• Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

The applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, but you can expect a response within six weeks. Any details about the internship will be individually agreed upon. However, the internship is expected to run from the beginning of February 2027 until the end of June 2027.

Kamstrup is located in Stilling south of Aarhus, and bus number 200 takes you right to the door.

If you have any questions to the internship position, please contact Manager, Rasmus Krigslund, on phone: +45 89 93 10 00.

Success criteria includes

• Driving contract execution within agreed project timelines

Personal profile

• A confident and pragmatic negotiator with strong attention to detail.

• Structured and proactive, with the ability to manage multiple contracts and deadlines.

• Collaborative, commercially aware and comfortable working independently in an international environment

Are we a perfect cultural fit?

Our commitment to you is encapsulated in our promise to every one of our employees saying ‘Trust in you – in your development and impact´.

This pledge extends uniformly across all entities within Sanos, ensuring that you feel its effects from the very offset of your interaction.

If you are curious about whether you would thrive within Sanos culture and the Sanos Way of Leading, reflect on whether you see yourself working within our principles:

Want to know more? Check out the Voice of Sanos Group people here.

Ready to make a real impact?

Would you like to work with Cyber Security for Industrial Systems in a company that develops and maintains highly complex, mission critical systems for a global market? Then take this opportunity to create something that matters.

Join a software center of excellence

These mission critical systems are installed across international airports and logistics centers as a completely essential part of daily operations 24/7/365. We have the leading products on the market, and the office in Aarhus, Denmark, is an international center of excellence within the BEUMER organization.

Cyber Security for industrial systems

Specifically, you become responsible for monitoring and implementing best practices within Cyber Security for industrial systems. Focus is on Cyber Security for the systems that we deliver to our customers. We comply with internationally recognized standards and have a process-oriented approach as Cyber Security is part of all aspects of what we do.

You will have a close dialogue with both our software product organization and our software project organization and our project IT-Infrastructure team. You will quite naturally be working closely with our Software Process Improvement department, and you will report to the Global Software Director.

Leader of a specialist team

You will be leading a small team of highly professional cyber security specialists while at the same time driving cyber security across BEUMERs global software team in close collaboration with BEUEMRs CISO team. As such you will be in dialog with group companies and product and project departments coordinating cyber security initiatives and communicating Cyber Security strategy, roadmap and best practices.

Skilled in Cyber Security

As responsible for our Cyber Security activities, your task is to enable the organization to deliver Cyber Secure software products, projects and services needed for mission critical systems. To do so, we believe you:

• Have a relevant master’s degree related to software development and/or cyber security

• Experience in analyzing a software organization's cybersecurity priorities and practices

• You have at least 2 years’ of relevant experience in the cybersecurity field.

• Previous work experience with applying or using frameworks such as ISA/IEC 62443, EU CRA, NIS2 and ISO27001/2 in an international environment.

Other than that, we would also like you to:

• Have knowledge about agile software development processes, CMMI and similar methods and standards would be an advantage.

Some travel must be expected as we are an international organisation. Therefore we expect you to communicate fluently in English.

To lead our cyber security activities, you will in addition to the above need drive, energy, and good commutation and stakeholder management skills. You have the experience to facilitate improvement initiatives and implement changes in an organization.

Interested?

If you have any questions regarding this position, please do not hesitate to contact Talent Acquisition Lead Søren Elkjær Holm on +45 3176 0448.

BEUMER Group

jobs.description:
Do you know your way around a balance sheet and a liquidity forecast, and not just the P&L? We are looking for an FP&A Analyst or Senior Analyst to join our Strategic Finance team in Hobro.

Who we are

Eurowind Energy is a global and leading developer, owner and operator of energy parks. Based in Denmark, we operate in 16 countries around Europe and in the USA, and we are continuously growing our project portfolio. We believe in a future of renewable energy, and we have an ambitious plan of becoming the next generation's "Power Major". Based on a full value chain from greenfield project development to energy trading, more than 700 team members are dedicated to creating a greener future fueled with nothing but renewable energy!

We are looking for an experienced FP&A Analyst or Senior Analyst to join our Strategic Finance team in Hobro, Denmark. Based at our headquarters, you will be part of a team of three that provides financial planning, forecasting and analysis across the entire organisation. Strategic Finance is a small function within the CFO area, operating at group level in close collaboration with Group Finance and the business. We do not sit in project or asset controlling.

Your role

You will join a team of three in Strategic Finance. Modelling takes up the largest share of the week, closely followed by understanding how projects, assets and operations flow into the numbers. Collecting, reconciling and reviewing data, and turning it all into analysis, make up the rest.

This is a newly created position, as we are growing the team to match the scope ahead. There is no finished set of models to take over. You will help build them.

With Blackstone Infrastructure set to become a co-owner of Eurowind Energy, Strategic Finance expects to play a growing part in the financial planning and reporting that goes to our owners. Over time, you will work directly with reporting and analysis prepared for one of the world's largest infrastructure investors.

• Budgeting, forecasting and long term financial planning, with an emphasis on balance sheet modelling and liquidity forecasting

• Designing, building and developing integrated financial models (P&L, balance sheet and cash flow) at group, portfolio and project level

• Scenario and sensitivity analysis on liquidity, financing and portfolio development

• Monthly and quarterly management reporting and variance analysis

• Preparing presentations for the board and senior management

• Building and maintaining data pipelines and reconciliations between our ERP and our models

• Developing new reporting tools and dashboards, e.g. in Power BI, and shaping the processes behind them

You will also work with department heads and regional leads when the analysis calls for it, but business partnering is not the main focus. The core of the role is the modelling, the data and the analysis that sit behind the decisions.

What we offer

Strategic Finance sits close to the centre of the organisation, and the models built here are used for real decisions.

• Real influence on how our financial models and processes are built. Not just maintaining what exists, but shaping the structure, logic and methods behind them

• A say in how work is organised, from data flows to reporting cadence, in a team that is still taking shape

• Data from across the entire organisation, from development and construction to operations and offtake

• Room to improve how data flows into planning, reporting and analysis

• Close sparring, clear priorities and colleagues who are involved in the work

• Direct exposure to senior management and, over time, to owner level reporting

Required competencies and skills

We are looking for someone with 1 to 5 years of relevant experience. Whether you join as Analyst or Senior Analyst depends on your experience and how the match feels on both sides. The scope and the team are the same.

• A degree in finance, economics, business or a related field

• Experience in FP&A, controlling, consulting or a similar analytical role

• Solid understanding of balance sheet dynamics and liquidity forecasting

• Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills

• Experience working with data from ERP systems

• Experience with Power BI or similar reporting tools

• Curiosity about how the business works. You want to understand what drives the numbers, not just report them

• Structured and precise, comfortable with deadlines and shifting priorities

• Knowledge of the energy sector is an advantage

Please note that this role requires a clean criminal record.

Renewable energy is our future. And so are our people!

At Eurowind Energy we do our best to create a culture where everyone is valued and feels at home. You will notice this in your everyday work life, where you have the freedom to speak up and where your voice means something to us. We know that when you grow, we grow. Therefore, we strive to support you in what you believe is right and in your personal and professional development. We offer you an exciting job in an energetic and international environment. And we promise you: the wind is never standing still.

Developing, operating and managing wind and solar parks is not just pure business for us. It is a way to view the world. And with this worldview comes a genuine ambition to be one of the leading developers in Europe. Because creating a future run entirely on green energy matters to us.

We manage our own portfolio of projects and at the same time, we perform technical and financial management of projects. We have throughout many years experienced sustained economic growth in the number of developed projects and companies in management. And we continue to expect this. Simply because it is in our nature to keep developing – projects, companies and our people.

Did we capture your attention?

Great! If you see yourself in this role, do not hesitate to apply for the position. Please use the link below. As we continuously review incoming applications, please send us your CV and a brief cover letter as soon as possible. In the letter, tell us who you are and, in a few concrete examples, what you have actually delivered in your career so far, such as models you have built, processes you have improved or analyses that changed a decision.

Should you have any questions before applying, please feel free to contact Jeppe Falk Hansen, Lead Specialist, Strategic Finance & Insights, at jfh@ewe.dk.

We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis

Read more about Eurowind Energy on our website or LinkedIn

Application deadline:

As soon as possible

Vattenfall’s Operational Control Centre is a central part of our Business Unit Wind, Offshore, Generation. We monitor more than 1,500 wind turbines and provide support to all Vattenfall sites Onshore and Offshore within turbine monitoring, high-voltage control, and marine coordination – 24/7, all year round. Our goal is to ensure high availability and safe operations, enabling us to accelerate the transition to a fossil-free society together.

Your Tasks

As a Control Centre Operator, you will be a key person in the operation of our wind assets.

You will be responsible for:

• Monitoring and optimizing wind turbines and transformer stations in real time

• Responding quickly to alarms and unforeseen errors to minimize downtime

• Planning and performing switching operations under Wind Electrical Safety Rules (WESR)

• Handling permits and ensuring proper return to normal operation after maintenance or incidents

• Ensuring open communication with internal teams and external authorities – both in daily operations and during critical incidents

• Preparing precise operational reports and contributing to the coordination of grid balance

• Identifying and sharing opportunities for process improvements across the organization

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

• Has a technical education as an electrician, wind turbine technician, or similar

• Has experience with electrical systems or wind turbine operations – experience from a control room is an advantage

• Thrives with shift work and being able to keep your head cool under pressure

• Has good IT skills and can navigate digital systems confidently

• Speaks and writes fluent Danish and English

• Has a strong safety focus and works systematically and collaboratively

• Can make independent decisions and communicate clearly with colleagues and partners

Additional Information

• Workplace: Esbjerg, Denmark. You must live within daily transport distance.

• All high-voltage tasks must be performed in accordance with applicable legislation.

• Security clearance from the Danish Energy Agency is required for this position.

Our offer

We can offer you the opportunity to make a real world difference whilst shaping your own working environment and career. We provide a competitive salary and benefits package, a progressive, inclusive culture, and the chance to work with some of the best in the industry. You will play a vital role within interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues; our ‘Ask and Share’ concept is embedded in the way we work. We also offer attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development.

Process and timeline

Please submit your application in English or Danish via our website. We do not accept applications in other ways.

We review applications and conduct interviews continuously, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The job posting will be closed once we have found the ideal candidate.

For more information about the position, please contact Martin Jul Tromborg on +45 27875466.

For more information about the recruitment process, please contact Senior Recruiter Jette Ingeberg on +45 22 57 07 51

At Vattenfall we believe that diversity contributes to a more attractive and successful company and we strive to be a role model for diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation.

The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfil within Vattenfall and will be performed by a third party, DISA Global Solutions AB.

Since Vattenfall is a part of the Swedish critical infrastructure, many of our services are security classed. If this position is security classified the final candidates might be subject to a security vetting process, according to Swedish legislation.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Company Description

Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 21 000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission.

Business Area Wind is responsible for Vattenfall’s Onshore and Offshore Wind as well as other non-hydro Renewable activities like solar PV and batteries. Today we develop, construct and operate wind generation in Sweden, Denmark, Germany, the Netherlands and the UK. In addition, we have a clear strategy to develop our solar PV and battery operations further.

Job Description

Would you like to shape Denmark’s pension solutions of tomorrow? As our new Consultant, you’ll use your actuarial expertise to turn complex models and business logic into tangible solutions, creating value for clients and society. Join a major IT project and turn theory into practice.

Responsibilities

As a Consultant within the life and pensions industry, you will become part of a specialised team contributing to the development of a new, unified IT system for pension solutions in Denmark.

You will work at the intersection of deep expertise in actuarial mathematics and technical implementation in a dynamic, and ambitious environment. Your expertise will be at the heart of our work, and you will see your analyses, business insights, and models create direct value for our clients and their businesses. Your work will involve developing and implementing complex calculation models and ensuring that solutions meet both business and regulatory requirements.

In addition, you will gain broad insight into different companies within the pensions industry and develop expertise in delivering large-scale IT projects. You will work closely with actuaries and pension experts at our clients and contribute to building actuarial and pension-specific capabilities at Netcompany.

Your responsibilities will typically include:

• 
Developing and implementing calculation models for life and pension products.

• 
Quality assurance and testing of pension products, as well as bridging the gap between actuarial expertise and technical implementation.

• 
Ensuring that solutions comply with applicable legislation and standards.

• 
Communicating complex analyses and results to colleagues, developers, testers, and clients.

• 
Contributing to the design and customisation of insurance and pension products within our solutions.

About you

• 
You are a recent graduate or have a few years of relevant professional experience within actuarial mathematics.

• 
You hold a Master’s degree in actuarial science (cand.act.) or a similar relevant degree that has given you a strong academic foundation and a logical approach to handling large datasets and advanced models.

• 
You thrive in a dynamic environment focused on collaboration and continuous personal and professional development.

• 
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritize an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

Send us an application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

WHO WE ARE

At Maersk, we are building enterprise-scale data and AI platforms to power intelligent, integrated supply chain solutions. Our ambition is to enable real-time visibility, AI-driven automation, and seamless data access across the business through a unified platform approach. We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to join us in this journey.

As a Senior Engineering Manager for AI & Data Platform, you will lead one or more engineering teams responsible for delivering scalable data platforms and AI-enabled capabilities. You will drive execution across data engineering, platform development, and agentic AI enablement, ensuring solutions are aligned to enterprise strategy and deliver measurable business outcomes. The role is accountable for delivery, engineering quality, team capability, and platform reliability rather than purely strategy definition.

Key Responsibilities:

1. AI & Data Platform Delivery

• Lead delivery of data platforms, data products, and AI-enabled applications supporting enterprise use cases

• Enable agentic AI adoption, ensuring data pipelines and platforms support AI-driven workflows and decisioning

• Drive development of integrated data foundations to support end-to-end visibility across systems

2. Data & Analytics Enablement

• Enable democratised data access through governed, queryable data layers (decoupled from operational systems)

• Drive self-service reporting and dashboards, reducing reliance on central teams

• Ensure high-quality, reliable, and secure data foundations for analytics and AI

3. Platform Engineering & Architecture Alignment

• Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, platform, and cloud strategies

• Drive adoption of reusable platform components and engineering standards

• Support integration across SAP and non-SAP ecosystems

4. Engineering Leadership & Team Delivery

• Lead and develop high-performing engineering teams across data, platform, and AI domains

• Own delivery outcomes, quality standards, and engineering practices within teams

• Drive Agile execution, prioritization, and alignment with product and business stakeholders

5. Operational Excellence & Scalability

• Ensure solutions are designed for scalability, reliability, and performance at global scale

• Drive observability, automation, and DevOps practices across platforms

• Establish governance for platform performance, availability, and cost optimization

6. Cost & Efficiency Focus

• Optimize platform cost through efficient architecture, cloud usage, and tooling decisions

• Drive adoption of shared platforms and reusable services to reduce duplication

• Partner with stakeholders to balance cost, speed, and quality in delivery

7. Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Collaborate across Product, SAP, Infrastructure, and Data teams beyond direct reporting lines

• Influence decisions impacting enterprise data and AI platforms

• Drive alignment across stakeholders with competing priorities

Our Ideal Candidate:

You are a strategic and execution-focused leader who has successfully driven large-scale platform transformations in complex enterprise environments.

• Strong experience leading engineering teams in data platforms, analytics, or AI domains

• Proven track record delivering scalable data and platform solutions in enterprise environments

• Exposure to AI/ML or agentic AI–enabled use cases

• Strong understanding of data engineering, cloud platforms, and distributed systems

• Demonstrated ability to drive delivery across cross-functional teams

• Strong ownership mindset with focus on outcomes, reliability, and cost

Required Skills/Experience:

• MS or BS in a Computer Science or a science/engineering discipline.

• 18+ years of experience in technology leadership roles

• Experience leading teams as Engineering Manager / Senior Engineering Manager / Director

• Strong experience with data platforms, pipelines, and analytics ecosystems

• Experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred) and modern DevOps practices

• Understanding of AI/ML platforms and data requirements for AI use cases

• Strong stakeholder management and execution leadership

The Impact You'll Make

Join a global Infrastructure Operations team that keeps Danfoss connected, secure, and running smoothly across manufacturing plants, offices, and data centers throughout the EMEA region. Your expertise will help ensure reliable network services that support business continuity and operational excellence.

In this role, you will combine hands-on troubleshooting with strategic infrastructure improvements. From resolving complex network challenges to implementing new technologies, your work will directly contribute to a modern, secure, and high-performing IT environment.

If you enjoy working with enterprise networks, collaborating with global teams, and making a visible impact on critical business operations, this is an exciting opportunity to grow your career at Danfoss.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Support and maintain enterprise network infrastructure across EMEA, ensuring stable, secure, and reliable connectivity for manufacturing sites, offices, and data centers.

• Troubleshoot and resolve complex routing, switching, wireless, and network connectivity issues while contributing to major incident and problem management activities.

• Deliver and support network infrastructure projects, including lifecycle upgrades, office relocations, site expansions, and new site deployments.

• Hands-on experience with Aruba switches, Aruba Wireless, Aruba Central, ClearPass, and network monitoring tools.

• Experience installing, upgrading, and supporting network infrastructure in complex business environments.

• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

• Excellent communication in English language (Danish is an asset); stakeholder collaboration skills; multicultural experience.

• Experience with SD-WAN, scripting, automation, ITIL practices, or manufacturing environments is an advantage.

What You'll Get from Us

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

Opportunity

Role Purpose

The Data Engineer is responsible for designing, developing and maintaining data solutions on Microsoft Fabric, ensuring that data is structured, reliable and usable across the organization.

In this role, you will engage closely with business stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into scalable data models, data pipelines and reporting solutions. You will take ownership of ensuring that financial and operational data is correctly modelled and supports consistent, highquality reporting.

The position requires a strong combination of technical data engineering skills and business understanding. You will be responsible for building and maintaining the data foundation that supports reporting, analytics and future automation of business processes.

You will also play a key role in the ongoing development of MCI’s hybrid data platform across Microsoft Fabric and Databricks, ensuring alignment, performance and best practices in data architecture.

This role is critical in reducing dependency on external consultants, improving responsiveness, and building inhouse knowledge and ownership of the data platform - from source system to report

· Strong analytical mindset with the ability to understand complex data structures and relationships

· Solid understanding of data modelling principles (e.g. dimensional modelling, data warehousing concepts)

· Experience with Microsoft Fabric or similar modern data platform (e.g. Azure Data Platform)

· Strong knowledge of data processing, transformation and pipeline design

· Experience working with large and complex datasets, ensuring performance and scalability

· Understanding of financial and operational data structures (e.g. ERP / D365 is a plus)

· Knowledge of Power BI and semantic models is an advantage

· Understanding of data governance, data quality and best practices in data architecture

· Ability to bridge technical data topics with business requirements

· Ability to identify relevant data in source systems - that is needed to facilitate business reporting needs

· Familiarity with integrating multiple data sources across platforms (e.g. Databricks and Fabric)

· Staying curious on business needs, and help business departments formulate what they need to drive their business

Personal competences

· Applies a structured approach to tasks and responsibilities.

· Exhibits excellent presentation and communication skills

· Self-driven and motivated to achieve results.

· Collaborates effectively as a team player.

· Demonstrates a strong service-oriented attitude.

· Adaptable and flexible in handling diverse challenges.

· Thrives in an environment where independence is encouraged.

· Eagerness to learn

Collaborate with architects, engineers, cyber security specialists, operations teams, vendors, and business stakeholders across a global organisation.

Network Architecture & Engineering is responsible for designing, engineering, and evolving Maersk’s global network and perimeter services. As a Network Engineer, you will contribute to the delivery of scalable, secure, reliable, and supportable network solutions across offices, warehouses, terminals, depots, and other operational locations worldwide.

You will play a key role in implementing enterprise LAN, WLAN, WAN, and SD-WAN services while supporting migrations, service improvements, engineering standards, and network automation initiatives. Working alongside senior engineers and architects, you will help deliver consistent connectivity services that enable business operations across a complex global environment.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Contribute to the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of enterprise LAN, WLAN, WAN, and SD-WAN solutions aligned with approved architectures and standards.

• 
Produce and maintain technical documentation including high-level and low-level designs, implementation plans, test plans, rollback procedures, and operational runbooks.

• 
Configure, deploy, troubleshoot, and optimise Cisco SD-WAN, Cisco Meraki SD-WAN, and Fortinet Secure SD-WAN solutions across multiple network underlays.

• 
Support campus networking and wireless deployments, including routing, switching, segmentation, authentication, performance optimisation, and wireless roaming.

• 
Develop reusable configuration templates, validation processes, and deployment standards to improve consistency and reduce implementation risk.

• 
Contribute to automation initiatives using Python, Ansible, APIs, model-driven interfaces, and Git-based workflows.

• 
Investigate incidents and performance issues using telemetry, monitoring platforms, packet captures, logs, and diagnostics while supporting root-cause analysis and operational handover activities.

What We Are Looking For

• 
Continuous improvement mindset: we are looking for someone who brings a thoughtful improvement mindset, curious about how work gets done and motivated to make meaningful, sustainable improvements over time.

• 
4+ years of practical enterprise networking experience within a large enterprise, systems integrator, or service provider environment.

• 
Strong knowledge of enterprise routing and switching technologies including IPv4, IPv6, VLANs, STP, OSPF, BGP, NAT, VPNs, route filtering, and high-availability technologies.

• 
Experience implementing or supporting enterprise SD-WAN platforms with understanding of overlays, underlays, segmentation, application-aware routing, encrypted tunnels, and failover mechanisms.

• 
Hands-on experience with technologies such as Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN, Cisco Meraki, Fortinet Secure SD-WAN, Cisco, HPE Aruba Networking, Juniper Mist, Extreme Networks, or equivalent enterprise networking platforms.

• 
Working knowledge of network security and automation, including firewalls, network segmentation, 802.1X, Zero Trust principles, Python, Ansible, REST APIs, Git-based workflows, and Infrastructure-as-Code concepts.

• 
Strong troubleshooting, communication, documentation, analytical, and stakeholder management skills, supported by relevant professional certifications such as CCNP Enterprise, Cisco DevNet, Fortinet Certified Professional, JNCIP Enterprise, Aruba professional certifications, or equivalent.

Opportunity

We are building an AI-powered operating model for Ocean Operations and a next-generation optimisation capability for global Network Design. This role is not limited to agent orchestration or execution workflows. It is a senior technical leadership role for how AI strengthens optimisation methods, modelling, and decision quality across both planning and execution.

The remit is broader than a standalone AI feature set. It covers how AI, optimisation, and engineering come together to deliver better network decisions at scale, while also shaping agentic decision systems in Control Tower style execution environments.

Role purpose:

The Principal AI Engineer will set the technical direction for AI-augmented optimisation and intelligent operational decisioning. This person will lead through specialists in optimisation, modelling, heuristics, analytics, and experimentation. They will define where AI can materially improve search, structural recommendations, and solver-backed workflows, while also guiding the design of multi-agent systems for reasoning, orchestration, exception handling, and human-in-the-loop execution.

What you will own?

•Technical direction for AI-augmented optimisation and agentic decision systems across Network Design and operational execution

•How planning problems are framed and where AI can improve search, candidate generation, structural recommendations, and decision quality

•The interface between AI systems, heuristics, solver layers, optimisation services, and enterprise workflows

•Patterns for when AI should recommend, act autonomously, or escalate to humans

•The quality bar for experimentation, evaluation, and translation of new methods into measurable value for planners and decision-makers

•Reusable intelligence patterns that can scale across both Control Tower and Network Design use cases

Key responsibilities:

•Lead the optimisation intelligence agenda across network design, routing, vessel deployment, cargo flow, and operational decisioning

•Set direction for how teams define problem structures, formulate optimisation approaches, design heuristics, and identify where AI can improve search, modelling quality, and decision outcomes

•Guide specialists building optimisation models, analytical components, and AI capabilities, ensuring their work fits into a coherent AI plus OR architecture

•Drive structured experimentation to compare alternative methods, validate model behaviour, and improve performance, robustness, and scalability

•Define how AI systems should interact with solver layers, heuristics, and optimisation services rather than treating AI as a separate layer

•Lead the use of agentic AI where it adds value to reasoning, orchestration, exception handling, and human-in-the-loop decision support

•Shape the innovation roadmap by identifying promising new methods and accelerating them into pilots and scaled capabilities

•Raise standards across modelling practice, technical quality, experimentation discipline, and architectural judgment

•Communicate assumptions, trade-offs, and limitations clearly to senior stakeholders and decision-makers

What we are looking for?

We are looking for a senior technical leader with deep credibility across both AI and optimisation, and with the ability to lead through highly skilled specialists rather than doing all modelling work personally.

The strongest profile will combine experience in agentic AI systems and human-in-the-loop workflows with strong grounding in optimisation methods such as heuristics, search, mathematical programming, decomposition, or hybrid AI plus OR approaches. This person should also be comfortable directing teams working on modelling, experimentation, performance improvement, and implementation into production environments.

Required qualifications:

•Advanced degree in engineering, mathematics, computer science, operations research, or another quantitative field

•Significant experience leading applied AI, decision intelligence, optimisation, or analytical platform work in complex operational domains

•Strong understanding of optimisation and modelling principles and how algorithms support real planning problems

•Experience improving planning, routing, scheduling, or network optimisation through heuristics, analytics, or AI-based enhancements

•Strong Python skills and comfort working closely with software and data engineering teams

•Proven ability to lead experimentation, validate model performance, and convert technical ideas into business-relevant capabilities

•Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders

Preferred qualifications:

•Experience in logistics, supply chain, shipping, transportation, or another optimisation-heavy industry

•Exposure to large-scale network design, routing, fleet planning, cargo flow optimisation, or similar decision systems

•Experience using AI or ML to improve optimisation performance, such as learning-augmented algorithms, surrogate models, search guidance, or reinforcement learning

•Experience working across research, prototyping, and productionisation of optimisation methods

Leadership expectations:

This role is expected to lead through others. The Principal AI Engineer should create the technical direction, decision framework, and quality standards for a broader team of optimisation, analytics, and AI specialists. The role should not be framed as a lone architect writing models end to end. It should be framed as the senior leader who sets the optimisation intelligence agenda and ensures that specialist work compounds into a coherent capability.

jobs.description:
Opportunity:

At Maersk, we are transforming global logistics through innovation, operational excellence, and customer-centric solutions. Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) is a critical enabler of that transformation, helping us build trust, strengthen customer partnerships, and support sustainable business growth.

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Customer HSE & Strategic Partnerships to lead strategic HSE engagement with selected Global Key Customers across Logistics & Services (L&S). This role will position HSE as a strategic differentiator by translating Maersk's HSE capabilities, governance, compliance programs, and risk management expertise into tangible customer value.

Working at the intersection of HSE, commercial strategy, customer engagement, and governance, you will build trusted partnerships with senior customer stakeholders, support business growth opportunities, and establish the governance frameworks required to manage strategic customer HSE requirements across a global organization.

What We Offer

This is a unique opportunity to shape how Maersk engages with key customers on HSE, compliance, sustainability, and risk management topics.

You will work across a highly diverse global stakeholder landscape, collaborate closely with commercial, legal, operational, and leadership teams, and play a key role in strengthening long-term customer HSE partnerships while enabling business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Customer Engagement

• 
Lead strategic HSE partnerships with selected Global Key Customers.

• 
Support executive and senior-level customer engagements.

• 
Contribute to strategic commercial opportunities by articulating the value of Maersk's HSE and sustainability capabilities.

• 
Develop customer-facing HSE value propositions, thought leadership materials, and executive presentations.

Customer HSE Governance & Commercial Support

• 
Establish governance, escalation, and decision-making frameworks for managing strategic customer HSE requirements across Logistics & Services.

• 
Coordinate significant customer HSE commitments and ensure alignment across relevant functions.

• 
Develop and maintain customer-facing HSE materials, capability portfolios, and response frameworks.

• 
Drive consistency, quality, and accuracy in external HSE communications and customer engagements.

• 
Leverage data analytics and AI-enabled tools to identify emerging customer needs, trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.

Risk, Compliance & Contractual Support

• 
Continuously develop HSE compliance, and risk management requirements within customer contracts and supplier standards.

• 
Partner with Commercial and Legal teams to evaluate significant HSE commitments.

• 
Monitor evolving customer expectations, regulatory developments, and industry trends.

• 
Translate complex HSE, risk, and compliance requirements into practical business solutions and customer value propositions.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for a strategic and commercially minded leader who combines strong HSE expertise with exceptional stakeholder engagement and business partnering capabilities.

You thrive in complex global organizations, are comfortable engaging at executive level, and understand how governance, compliance, and risk management can create value for customers and the business.

Preferred Qualifications

• 
Relevant Master’s Degree with Occupational Health, Safety, Environment, Compliance or similar.

• 
Significant experience in HSE, Risk Management, Compliance, Sustainability, Operations, or a related discipline.

• 
Strong knowledge of management systems and international standards, including ISO 45001, ISO 14001, and ISO 9001.

• 
Solid experience with Power BI, business intelligence platforms, data mining and advanced reporting tools is an advantage.

• 
Experience utilizing digital, analytical, and AI-enabled tools to improve analysis, decision-making and customer engagement.

• 
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into business insights and recommendations.

• 
Demonstrated experience developing governance frameworks, policies, controls, and escalation processes in large, complex organizations.

• 
Strong commercial acumen and customer engagement experience.

• 
Experience working in global, matrixed environments.

• 
Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, and relationship-building skills.

• 
Strong executive communication, presentation, and storytelling capabilities.

• 
Ability to communicate complex technical requirements in a clear and commercially relevant manner.

Do you want to immerse yourself in testing and quality assurance of large and complex software projects that help digitalise and strengthen Denmark? Are you systematic, with a keen eye for detail? Then you might be the person we are looking for as our new Test Consultant.

Responsibilities and technologies

Testing and quality assurance are a crucial part of the IT solutions we develop together with our clients. As a Test Consultant, you will help test business-critical IT systems that have an impact not only on our public-sector and private-sector clients, but on people across Danish society.

You will always be part of a project team from Netcompany, typically working together on-site with the client. In this role, you will act as the link between the client, their business needs, and our technical solution.

You will continuously develop your testing and technical skills. Throughout your projects, you will gain hands-on experience with a wide range of the latest technologies and tools.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Ensuring the quality of the solution through various types of testing

• Analysing the functional aspects of the solution

• Preparing test plans and designing and writing test cases

• Executing functional and non-functional tests

• Contributing to troubleshooting and test reporting

About you

You can work methodically and connect business and IT-related challenges, explaining business needs to developers and technical aspects to clients. In addition, we imagine that you:

• Can navigate complex error scenarios and understand complex system landscapes

• Are systematic and detail-oriented throughout the analysis, design, development, and testing phases

• Think logically and analytically, and can break down and understand complex concepts and communicate issues and gaps clearly and effectively

• Hold a relevant master’s degree

Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

Senior Software Developer – Full Stack

_

Do you want to shape the software that keeps allied nations connected on the battlefield? As a Senior Systems Engineer on our IRIS team, you'll lead feature development across a rich technology stack — and leave your mark on military messaging software trusted by more than 50 nations worldwide._

The job

You'll take ownership of new features from design through to delivery, working across both modern and legacy code in a fast-moving environment where no two weeks look the same. Alongside hands-on development, you'll help less experienced colleagues grow — acting as a technical guide and keeping quality high across the team.

In short, you can look forward to:

• designing and implementing new features in the IRIS suite, Systematics military messaging and interoperability platform

• maintaining and improving legacy code across the back end

• documenting solutions and describing technical designs for the wider team

• mentoring junior developers and reviewing their code

• contributing to technical assessments as part of the hiring process on an occasional basis.

**Joining the team

**

The IRIS team exists to create interoperability between coalition forces — ensuring that nations can share critical information and carry out successful missions together. You'll be part of a close-knit group of 23 people, including developers based in Denmark, Romania, and the UK, alongside architects, testers, a UX specialist, and a programme manager. It's an environment where the technical scope shifts regularly, keeping the work genuinely varied, and where there's a clear path for those who want to grow into architecture or design. The team values learning from mistakes, honest communication, and getting things done pragmatically.

Your qualifications

• a relevant degree or equivalent professional education

• a minimum of five years' experience in software development

• solid proficiency in at least one object-oriented programming language, preferably java — other than that the team works with JavaScript, C++, and C#

• experience designing software solutions and producing technical documentation

• fluent English, both written and spoken.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or EU country for the past seven years, as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you'll also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1,100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Søren Steen Jensen.

Opportunity

Are you passionate about developing suppliers and driving quality excellence in a global manufacturing setup?

At Maersk Container Industry (MCI) in Tinglev, we are looking for a skilled Supplier Quality Manager to lead our supplier quality and development efforts.

If you have strong experience in supplier quality and enjoy collaborating across functions to drive improvements, we are looking forward to hearing from you.

MCI is located in Tinglev in the Southern part of Denmark, close to Sønderborg, Kolding, and Flensburg. We have strong local roots but act on a truly global stage. At MCI in Tinglev, you will enjoy an informal and supportive atmosphere. We work with the most energy efficient reefer technology and are aware of our contribution to global trade. We always make sure that we have fun and enjoy working with each other.

In your everyday work, you will experience a high degree of independence in a flexible work environment where innovation and quality have very high priority. You will be part of an international company of passionate colleagues who come from different backgrounds and cultures. Furthermore, we have a very good package of employee benefits.

As Supplier Quality Manager, you will lead and develop our supplier quality team, working closely with our Chinese counterparts to ensure alignment and continuous improvement across sites. You will play a key role in managing supplier audits, supporting volume allocation decisions with data-driven insights, and developing supplier performance evaluation tools.

Key responsibilities include:

• Lead and develop the supplier quality organization in MCI Denmark

• Drive global supplier audits and evaluations for both development projects and existing suppliers

• Support supplier volume allocation decisions with data-driven insights

• Develop and maintain supplier performance evaluation tools in collaboration with global teams

• Support the development of key component specifications and mitigation of root causes

• Ensure continuous development of team capabilities and engagement

• Contribute to overall quality strategy and improvement initiatives

You are an experienced quality professional with a background in supplier management, preferably within a technical or manufacturing environment. You thrive in a global role, leading teams across cultures and time zones, and enjoy collaborating with both technical and commercial stakeholders.

To succeed in this role, you most likely:

• have 5+ years of team lead or management experience

• are experienced with ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 quality systems

• have a strong understanding of quality tools and processes

• are fluent in English (spoken and written)

• have strong analytical and communication skills

• preferably hold a Six Sigma Green Belt certification

Joining MCI means becoming part of a global Maersk company that designs and manufactures the world’s most energy-efficient refrigerated containers. You will work with skilled colleagues across Denmark and China, in an open and collaborative culture that values continuous learning, sustainability, and innovation.

MCI is located at its headquarters in Tinglev, where this position is based.

In case you have any questions for this vacant position, please contact our HR department by sending an e-mail to hr@mcicontainers.com.

We review applications on an ongoing basis until the right candidate has been found.

Maersk Container Industry is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace, valuing different perspectives. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applicants of all backgrounds. We consider qualified candidates with criminal histories in accordance with legal requirements. We are committed to accommodating your needs during the application and hiring process. If you require special assistance or accommodations to use our website, apply for a position, or perform a job, please contact us.

Visit our website to learn more: www.mcicontainers.com

jobs.description:
Job Description

Do you want to help ensure a great user experience for our customers? In the System Services team at Netcompany Banking Services, we work to support financial institutions in their use of our system solutions. We are looking for a new colleague who can help ensure stable and efficient system usage, ideally with experience in the banking and financial sector, and who can help make complex systems more usable in practice

You will become part of a highly skilled team where collaboration is key. Working closely with colleagues across NBS and System Services, you will help optimize how customers use our solutions. The role covers areas such as process optimization, IT-related tasks, system configuration, and compliance.

Netcompany Banking Services

We deliver various IT solutions and services to banks and savings institutions across Denmark and other Nordic countries. We provide a modern, cloud-based core banking platform serving more than 50 Nordic banks with over 2 million end customers. Our solutions encompass daily banking operations, mobile and internet banking, payments, investment management, risk management, compliance, and open banking.

Responsibilities and technologies

In this role, you will help ensure that customers achieve maximum value from NBS core and self-service solutions. This includes system configuration and ongoing adjustments to support customer needs and daily operations.

You will work closely with specialists across NBS, where knowledge sharing is an integrated part of how we work. In your daily work, you will interact with both subject matter experts and senior stakeholders at financial institutions. This requires the ability to communicate complex topics clearly and adapt your messaging to different audiences, with an understanding of the impact on both employees and end customers.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Configuring and optimizing system setups (e.g. products, interest rates, and fees), while providing expert guidance to customers.

• Advising customers and increasing awareness of the NBS product portfolio.

• Facilitating workshops and reviews of customer processes and system usage.

• Analysing current customer setups and needs with a focus on improvements and future solutions.

• Creating process documentation and procedures, delivering training on system usage, and contributing to the implementation and automation of workflows.

About you

In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to both experts and senior stakeholders at financial institutions. This requires strong communication skills and the ability to clearly explain complex topics, with an understanding of how decisions impact daily operations and end customers.

You work independently and pragmatically and are motivated by creating value for customers by identifying new opportunities and improvements.

To succeed in this role, you:

• Have an interest in and understanding of banking processes and IT systems.

• Have a few years of experience from a financial institution, preferably in IT support or a similar role.

• Have a good understanding of banking infrastructure.

• Ideally have experience with NBS systems and configuration.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Join an inclusive community

We highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

Turnpikes are a consulting company, supporting their existing and new clients with projects and support for their current OpenText Solutions. they help them grow and expand their solutions to provide the highest value for their investment.

About the role

On behalf of Turnpikes, we are looking for an experienced Enterprise Sales Professional. Turnpikes is a fast-growing, global IT consultancy and software reseller that helps global companies work smarter in finance and information management. In this role, you will play a key part in growing Turnpikes' enterprise business across Denmark and the Nordics. You will work with complex projects and some of the market's largest C25 companies.

We do not expect you to have prior knowledge of our primary software, OpenText. Instead, we value your strong "hunter" mentality, your ability to navigate complex enterprise buying processes, and your courage to engage C-level stakeholders. Forget about being boxed in, transactional software sales, and micromanagement – here you get freedom with responsibility, a seat at the table, and the opportunity to make a real impact on the strategy.

What we offer

• The opportunity to make a visible impact in a recognized specialist consultancy with ambitious growth plans.

• A unique key role with the freedom to shape strategy, work directly with leadership, and influence how we build the business.

• An attractive commission plan where your success and results translate directly into your own earnings.

• A dynamic work environment based on trust, independence, and ownership – for people who see opportunities where others see complexity.

Work tasks

You will be responsible for identifying, shaping, and winning complex consulting engagements across Denmark and the Nordics. You will build a sustainable pipeline of strategic customers and act as the link between customer needs and our technical teams.

Your tasks will be carried out in a fast-paced environment and will include:

• Develop and hunt: Create new enterprise customers, build strategic relationships, and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities.

• Engage and advise: Proactively engage with C-level executives and business stakeholders to understand their challenges and identify digital transformation opportunities.

• Shape solutions: Coordinate closely with solution architects and consultants during presales, as well as draft strong commercial proposals and Statements of Work (SOWs).

• Lead the process: Drive qualification and account strategy from start to finish, including leading commercial negotiations and contract discussions.

• Grow and optimize: Drive growth in existing accounts through cross-selling and upselling, and maintain strict CRM and forecasting discipline.

We are looking for

• Has several years of successful experience in enterprise consulting sales or business development.

• Has a proven track record of selling complex IT consulting, system integration, or digital transformation projects.

• Thrives navigating long end-end enterprise sales cycles with multiple stakeholders.

• Has a strong commercial, analytical, and negotiation-oriented mindset.

• Is a "hunter" with an entrepreneurial spirit, who is also motivated by building and maintaining long-term customer relationships.

• Speaks and writes fluent Danish and masters English at a high level.

It's an advantage if you have

• In-depth understanding of complex enterprise buying processes.

• Experience working closely with technical delivery teams to create winning proposals.

To succeed in the role, your personal competencies are:

• Ambitious

• Relationship-building

• Independent

• Solution-oriented

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Turnpikes ApS

Turnpikes is a fast-moving, global IT consultancy and software reseller. In short: we help companies make their finance and information management work smarter. We work with big-name global companies, complex projects, and clients who expect the best. And we deliver, with a long reference list of current clients who place trust in us. We are proud to have a great variety of C25 companies as long-term reference customers.
