We are looking for a Domain Architect to join our Business Engagement and Platform Solutions team, where you will take domain ownership of the application and platform architecture and drive alignment across our architecture practices.

About the job

The role combines architectural ownership with close business engagement. You will define and maintain the target architecture for applications and platforms, contribute to solution design together with our solution architects and delivery teams, and act as a trusted architectural advisor to the business areas you support.

Your key responsibilities

• Take domain ownership of Orifarm's application and platform architecture, including current state, target state and the roadmap between them

• Engage closely with business stakeholders to understand their processes, priorities and ambitions, and translate these into application and platform solutions

• Drive the architecture forum by setting the agenda, preparing decisions and ensuring alignment across the solution, data, integration and infrastructure architecture practices

• Support solution architects and delivery teams through design reviews, architectural guidance and joint solution design

• Develop and maintain reference architectures, design patterns and architectural standards for the application and platform domain

• Drive simplification of the application portfolio through consolidation, lifecycle management and modernization of key applications

• Support the evaluation, selection and integration of new applications and platforms, ensuring that they can be operated and maintained sustainably

Who are you?

We are looking for a pragmatic and business-oriented architect who is comfortable moving between technical design and stakeholder dialogue. You communicate clearly, and you create alignment through collaboration and professional credibility.

We imagine your profile includes:

• +5 years of experience within solution, application or platform architecture, or a background as a senior developer, lead engineer with relevant architectural experience

• Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into concrete application and platform solutions

• Good understanding of cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure, as well as ERP ecosystems and modern integration patterns

• Experience facilitating architectural decisions across teams and disciplines, for example through design reviews or architecture forums

• Experience from a regulated industry such as pharmaceuticals, life science or medical devices is an advantage

• Knowledge of architecture frameworks is an advantage, with emphasis on practical application rather than formal certification

• Professional proficiency in English. Danish or German is an advantage

Who are we?

You will be part of Business Engagement & Platform Solutions, a function of approximately 40 colleagues across three business-aligned solution teams as well as architecture and integration practices with direct reference to the VP of Corporate IT. Moreover, you will join an organization where IT plays a central role in enabling the business strategy, driving commercial outcomes.

The role offers clear ownership of an architecture domain, close cooperation with senior business stakeholders, and the opportunity to help shape our architecture practice as our organization scales.

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

Are you passionate about finding new drug opportunities? Do you love understanding disease biology to guide the best possible drug design? Are you a seasoned professional and looking for the next step?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Associate Director, Product Innovation.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and expanded portfolio. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

Ascendis Pharma is expanding our Product Innovation department and searching for an Associate Director to help drive the future pipeline and the company’s growth towards 2030 and beyond.

The Product Innovation department’s primary objective is to conduct analysis and propose new potential products for the company pipeline. With Patients in mind, new lead finding is based on thorough analysis which typically includes disease biology, unmet medical need, market assessment, competitive intelligence, FTO and assessment of path to FiH. With “Science” as a fundamental corporate value, analysis is rooted in a deep biological understanding of the disease, available (pre)clinical data, Mode of Action across modalities/lines of treatment and the impact a given molecular design/TPP will achieve. As a critical function to building Ascendis Pharma’s future, the Product Innovation department has high exposure to executive management and works closely with adjacent functions.

The Associate Director Product Innovation will play a critical role in Ascendis' success in Endocrinology Rare Disease as well as novel therapeutic areas. She/He will be the driving force behind providing high-quality analysis and pitch decks which enable value-oriented and informed decision-making by the EMT. By gathering, analyzing, and transforming data into concise, actionable ideas, you will play an important role in shaping the future pipeline.

You will be joining the Product Innovation team and report directly to Steffen Nyegaard, Director, Product Innovation who is based in Hellerup_. You will also be based in Hellerup.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Identification of new drug candidates and indications of interest

• In-depth analysis of diseases, treatment guidelines, competitive environment, how different MoA will affect the disease pathology, market and patents into final reports

• Act as strategic thought partner across different functions and teams, e.g. supporting early research projects or conducting deep-dive analytics to support key business decisions

• Staying current in relevant fields and tracking news widely (e.g., scientific literature, analyst reports, regulatory documents) and share findings with key stakeholders

• Establish processes, structures, and templates when necessary to support Ascendis' growth

Qualifications and Skills:

You have a PhD in life sciences and preferably post doctorial experience from a leading university or group. The ideal candidate has significant experience in lead finding and drug development and knows how to leverage their knowledge into actionable outcomes. The candidate possesses a strong biological profile, which enables them to quickly learn and understand novel biological systems, identify critical issues and unmet needs, and generate analyses with high level take-home and next-step recommendations.

Ideally**, you have:**

• 5 years of industry experience from Pharma or biotech within research or BD

• A strong biological profile with documented track record from the apex of the field

• Significant work experience with the different functions within the pharma value chain

• Experience in the use of public and private databases (e.g. Patsnap, Cortellis, Globaldata, Evaluate or similar)

• The ability to synthesize complex information to both high scientific and layman levels and present it in a clear, actionable manner

jobs.description:
Connectivity, IoT Core, & SIM Lifecycle

On behalf of our customer Circle Gas we are seeking a Mid-level Software Engineer to join their Virtual Device team. This team is the heartbeat of our operation, responsible for the interface between our smart devices and our applications. In this role, you will help build the "nervous system" of their IoT network.

You will work heavily with AWS IoT Core to manage telemetry ingestion and command structures, ensuring their digital twins accurately reflect the physical state of millions of meters. A specific focus of this role will be managing the lifecycle of SIM cards and ensuring robust meter connectivity.

As an Software Engineer, you will be expected to own the delivery of features within your team, write and debug code that affects large parts of our systems, and actively participate in design discussions.

Key Responsibilities

• Core Development: Write, test, and deploy high-quality code (Python & TypeScript) for their virtual device microservices using AWS Serverless technologies (Lambda, DynamoDB, etc.)

• IoT & Connectivity: Implement and maintain telemetry ingestion pipelines and command/control interfaces using AWS IoT Core

• SIM Lifecycle Management: Build and refine the logic for managing SIM card activation, deactivation, and status monitoring to ensure uninterrupted meter connectivity

• System Reliability: Ensure the production readiness of your code; monitor telemetry flows and debug connectivity issues across the fleet

• Collaboration: Work closely with firmware engineers and the data team to understand data payloads and ensure seamless integration

• Team Growth: Actively contribute to the Circle Tech culture, participate in code reviews, and share knowledge with the team

• Infrastructure as Code: Utilize Terraform to manage and deploy infrastructure, ensuring repeatable and secure environments

Qualifications

• Experience: Proven experience in software engineering (typically aligned with L4 expectations: delivering features independently and understanding the broader system)

• Tech Stack: Strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript

• Cloud Native: Hands-on experience with AWS Serverless architectures (Lambda, API Gateway) and EventDriven Design

• IoT Knowledge: Experience with AWS IoT Core or similar MQTT-based telemetry systems is highly desirable

• Mindset: You thrive in a maturing "scale-up" environment—you are comfortable with some ambiguity and eager to help establish better processes

About Circle Gas

Circle Gas is a revolutionary company focused on transforming the lives of people in sub-Saharan Africa and beyond.

We are scaling rapidly to support 2 million households (10 million people), providing clean, safe, and affordable cooking fuel. Data is the lifeblood of our operation—from billing 10 million customers to optimizing logistics in remote areas.

jobs.occupation: Senior Process Automation Engineer in DCS at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
Senior Process Automation Engineer in DCS, Novo Nordisk Engineering

Do you want to be a part of NNE’s all-time largest Process Automation team? We are looking for colleagues to join our fantastic company, where we have the aspiration of becoming best in class within Automation Solutions for Pharmaceutical Engineering.

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

You will be working in an enthusiastic Process Automation team with more than 80 colleagues in Denmark. Globally, the Process Automation team has more than 200 employees.

The Process Automation team works with consultancy, design & development, implementation and validation of Automation solutions for the Pharma and Biotech industries. Our work is project based, and currently we are looking into an exciting pipeline of large data driven, greenfield plants with modular/scalable designs.

We are skilled in a broad range of process areas within API production e.g. fermentation, recovery and purification, utility, and cleaning systems. And the solutions we provide to our customers are always based on a deep understanding of the customers’ production processes – and if standard components can’t do the job, we develop our own.

How you might spend your days

As a DCS Senior Process Automation Engineer, you’ll be:

• Advising customers on their application process solutions

• Design developing, programming, commissioning, qualifying, FAT, SAT, UAT and Handover of applications for Distributed Control Systems (DCS)

• Interacting with process experts and colleagues with expertise in surrounding systems and equipment like MES, Historian systems, instruments, production equipment etc.

• Developing and optimizing automation methods and strategies to meet our customers’ needs and sharing working knowledge with colleagues and partners

• Forming the basis of automation strategies and architectures to support our sister departments internationally and expand NNE’s Process Automation engagement

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you:

• Understand your colleagues’ individual and cultural difference

• Are aware of your surroundings and able to flag any concerns

• Are agile and able to prioritize urgent tasks

• Are team-oriented and able to collaborate on team projects

• Are reliable, curious and eager to learn

• Are appreciative of feedback, because it contributes to your growth

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• You have 6+ years or more of working experience and hold a degree as an engineer, ideally within electrical, automation, process or marine engineering

• You have 4 years or more of working experience with PCS/DCS Application development (for example ABB 800xA or ABB SattLine), working in GMP/GAMP environment or with execution of Automation projects

• Knowledge of batch production is valued

• You find the complexity of the GMP/GAMP environment exciting

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Do you want to use your skills in pioneering technology in a highly dynamic, ambitious environment with broad variety of exciting projects? In Welltec, cutting-edge technology and global development are high on the agenda, and we are looking for colleagues within mechanical engineering to take this journey to the next level.

A world-class company

Welltec® is an international oilfield service company and a leading specialist partner to the energy industry.

Our values are to be Pioneering, Visionary, Dedicated, and Agile.

We develop and manufacture precision-controlled technologies which provide the most unique and advanced Completion and Intervention solutions, which assist our clients in maximizing recovery from their assets.

We always look to the future, utilizing our intelligence, imagination and expertise to create new opportunities. We have won several industry awards for innovative thinking. We are enjoying constant growth worldwide through the wide adoption of our cutting-edge solutions.

Our policy is to hire locally and work globally. We therefore recruit where we are active and train our employees to operate our state-of-the-art technologies to provide services to our high-profile clients in the region.

The global dimension offers a range of opportunities for those who are motivated by a challenging and multicultural environment where employees come with very different backgrounds but with a common wish to collaborate and succeed.

The department

At Welltec, you will join our mechanical department situated in our completions Design & Engineering (D&E) function which currently consists of over 20 colleagues worldwide with various educational backgrounds and nationalities. In D&E we closely together - in order to get a holistic approach to our products and tools and to benefit from each other’s knowledge and expertise. In D&E, the work environment is informal, creative and fun but at times it can be complex, challenging, and fast-paced.

The team that you will join is responsible for the development and maintenance of Welltec’s proprietary metal expandable packer technology and other innovative technologies which we constantly introduce to the market through our global footprint.

The position

As a mechanical engineer within Design and Engineering (D&E) you will have the possibility to be innovative and create technology solutions from the idea phase to the commercial implementation. The main task is to develop new technologies where your focus will be development of mechanical systems. You will, together with the team, be part of conceptualization of products and detailed design development both for prototypes and commercial design. You will work in an environment where you will be able to develop your skills and where innovation is a key focus and you will be part of an agile business where your input will be heard. Travelling for exhibition and conferences related to the energy market can be expected to a smaller extent.

As our new Mechanical Engineer, you will:

• Be part of concept phase as team and have ownership of design and manufacturing package

• Conduct prototype assembly and function testing/troubleshooting

Ensure collaboration with relevant teams and stakeholders within the organisation

• Cooperate with sub-contractors

• Take ownership of schedules and delivery times

• Challenge the business with new ideas and concepts

• Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of the Design and Engineering (D&E) department

Your tasks will include:

• Work on technical projects through all development phases

• Working in teams on development projects with both own and shared tasks

• Conceptualization and feasibility studies

• Design review guided by DFM, FMEA principles and robust design thinking

• 3D mechanical design

• Trouble shooting on both existing solutions as well as new solutions under development

• Provide your guidance and input in your specific expert areas across the whole organization

The candidate

You are proactive in your daily tasks and have an analytical and critical approach to problem solving. You have a quick, creative mind with a natural understanding of complex concepts and systems. The ideal candidate is someone who gets excited by technology and open-ended challenges as described above. In order to perform well in this role, you should also have the following qualifications or similar competencies:

The preferred candidate has the following profile:

• Mechanical Engineer B.Sc, M.Sc. or similar background

• Experience from oilfield, energy sector, hydraulics, precision mechanics, electro mechanical systems, mechatronics or similar is a plus

• Takes ownership of tasks and projects – enjoys broad responsibility

• Agile Project Management skills

• Is an experienced CAD user in Catia Software or similar system

• Is experienced in the use of FEA simulations in ANSYS or similar system

Welltec® is an equal opportunity employer. We offer good career opportunities for the right candidate. Also, Welltec® has a competitive compensation package.

The process

If you are interested in the position submit your resume and cover letter online via the link below.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply soon if you believe you fit the role.

Are you an experienced power trader who enjoys making decisions in fast-moving markets? Would you like to take responsibility for your own trades while working alongside colleagues who share your interest in intraday power trading?

Join our IDE Proprietary Trading team at Norlys Energy Trading in Aalborg. Here, you will use your trading experience to identify opportunities, act on market developments, and contribute to the team's trading activities.

Your team and role

You will join a team of experienced traders working in the intraday power market. The role combines market analysis, trade execution, and risk management with the development of trading strategies.

The desk operates around the clock, and you will be part of our 24/7 shift rotation. You will work independently on trading decisions while exchanging market insights and ideas with colleagues across shifts.

Your key responsibilities

• Analyse market data and price movements to identify trading opportunities.

• Develop and execute intraday trading strategies.

• Monitor positions, manage risk, and respond to changing market conditions.

• Collaborate with traders, analysts and quantitative teams to challenge market views, share insights, and improve trading strategies and decision-making.

• Contribute to improving trading tools, models and processes in collaboration with relevant teams to strengthen analytical capabilities and trading efficiency.

• Coordinate with colleagues across shifts to ensure continuity in trading activities.

• Maintain relationships with relevant market participants and stakeholders.

You'll be joining a desk where different perspectives and trading ideas are part of the conversation. There's room to share your experience, challenge ideas and learn from the people around you.

Jacob Goth

Manager, Proprietary Trading

We are looking for an experienced trader who combines sound market judgement with the ability to act independently and contribute to a team.

You bring:

• Experience in energy trading, preferably within intraday power.

• Strong analytical skills and a solid understanding of trading strategies and risk management.

• The ability to make well-founded decisions under pressure.

• Good communication skills and an interest in sharing knowledge with colleagues.

• A relevant degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering or a related field.

You should be comfortable working in a 24/7 shift rotation and ready to apply your trading experience from an early stage.

You will become part of a specialist trading environment where colleagues share market knowledge, discuss trading ideas, and learn from each other's experience. With responsibility for your own trading activities and opportunities to contribute to strategy development, you will have room to put your expertise to work.

jobs.occupation: Supply Chain Internship Roster 2026 – Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU), Copenhagen, Denmark
jobs.description:
The Position:

The UNFPA Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU) is seeking candidates for its newly established Supply Chain Internship Roster 2026. These internship opportunities are on-site at SCMU’s office in the UN City headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark.

SCMU offers specialized functional streams aligned with its operational needs, including:

• Data & Analytics

• Logistics & Supply Chain

• Procurement & Business

• Humanitarian Supplies

• Supply Chain & Customer Service

• Governance, Risk & Compliance

• Communications

• Human Resources

• Information and Communications Technology (ICT)

• Administration & Business

To ensure effective team integration and maximize the value of the internship, candidates must be logistically and financially prepared to undertake full-time, on-site work in Copenhagen for the duration of the internship.

How you can make a difference:

UNFPA is the lead UN agency for delivering a world where every pregnancy is wanted, every childbirth is safe and every young person's potential is fulfilled.  UNFPA’s strategic plan (2026-2029), reaffirms the relevance of the current strategic direction of UNFPA and focuses on three transformative results: to end preventable maternal deaths; end unmet need for family planning; and end gender-based violence and harmful practices. These results capture our strategic commitments on accelerating progress towards realizing the ICPD and SDGs in the Decade of Action leading up to 2030. Our strategic plan calls upon UN Member States, organizations and individuals to “build forward better”, while addressing the negative impacts of the Covid-19 pandemic on women’s and girls’ access to sexual and reproductive health and reproductive rights, recover lost gains and realize our goals.

The UNFPA Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU) is self-funded and was made operational in January 2022. It is tasked with ensuring that UNFPA is able to effectively and efficiently support the delivery of life-saving reproductive health products and other programme supplies to the end user when and where they are needed. To achieve this, it is important to strengthen the capacity of governments and implementing partners to ensure coordination, end-to-end visibility and accountability on all supply chain and logistics management related activities, in particular for programme supplies, across all UNFPA programmes.

In a world where fundamental human rights are at risk, we need principled and ethical staff, who embody these international norms and standards, and who will defend them courageously and with full conviction.

UNFPA is seeking candidates that transform, inspire and deliver high impact and sustained results; we need staff who are transparent, exceptional in how they manage the resources entrusted to them and who commit to deliver excellence in programme results.

Eligibility:

Educational requirements

a. Be enrolled in a first university degree programme (such as bachelor’s degree or equivalent) and have completed one full academic year;

b. Be enrolled in a postgraduate degree programme (such as master’s programme or higher);

c. Have recently graduated with a university degree as defined above and, if selected, must start the internship within one-year of graduation; or

d. Be enrolled in a postgraduate professional trainee programme and undertake the internship as part of this programme.

Other eligibility requirements

e. Demonstrate interest in the field of development;

f.  Demonstrate written and spoken proficiency in at least one of the working languages of the United Nations (English or French) and fluency in the official language (Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian or Spanish) of the UNFPA office; and

g. Demonstrate ability to adapt to new environments and to establish and maintain good working relations with individuals of different cultural backgrounds.

An individual whose father, mother, son, daughter, brother or sister is a UNFPA staff member is not eligible for an internship with UNFPA.

Required Competencies:

Values:

• Exemplifying integrity,

• Demonstrating commitment to UNFPA and the UN system,

• Embracing cultural diversity,

• Embracing change

Core Competencies:

• Achieving results,

• Being accountable,

• Developing and applying professional expertise/business acumen,

• Thinking analytically and strategically,

• Working in teams/managing ourselves and our relationships,

Financial Support:

Interns who do not receive financial support from an outside party (such as an academic institution, university, government) are eligible to receive a stipend as a contribution towards living expenses. The stipend is based on the intern’s agreed place of work, which may be different from the duty station of the hiring office in cases of remote arrangements. The stipend is normally paid in local currency at the end of each month.

UNFPA Work Environment:

UNFPA provides a work environment that reflects the values of gender equality, diversity, integrity and healthy work-life balance. We are committed to ensuring gender parity in the organization and therefore encourage women to apply. Individuals from the LGBTQIA+ community, minority ethnic groups, indigenous populations, persons with disabilities, and other underrepresented groups are highly encouraged to apply. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to applicants with disabilities upon request, to support their participation in the recruitment process. UNFPA promotes equal opportunities in terms of appointment, training, compensation and selection for all regardless of personal characteristics and dimensions of diversity. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion is at the heart of UNFPA's workforce - click here to learn more.

Disclaimer:

UNFPA does not charge any application, processing, training, interviewing, testing or other fee in connection with the application or recruitment process and does not concern itself with information on applicants' bank accounts.

jobs.occupation: Director Specialist – Key Account Management (Power & Controls)
jobs.description:
Director Specialist – Key Account Management (Power & Controls)

Vacancy description

Director Specialist – Key Account Management (Power & Controls)

Build strategic partnerships that power the future of renewable energy

At KK Group, we are on an ambitious journey to enable a future powered by renewable energy. We are looking for a commercially driven and relationship-oriented leader to take ownership of a key strategic account and help unlock its full potential.

In this role, you will work at the heart of our business—connecting customers, technology, and operations—to drive sustainable growth, strengthen long-term partnerships, and deliver real impact.

Highlights of the offer

• Job offer expiration: 30/11/2026

• Type of work: Hybrid

• Role: Individual Contributor / Specialist

• Location: Europe, Denmark, Ikast

Responsibilities

Key Account Management:

• Obtain detailed knowledge of the account’s organization, their product portfolio, their on-going projects, and secure this is shared across commodities.

• Identify cooperation and sales opportunities

• Process customer RFQ’s and work cross-functionally with colleagues to generate the best technical and commercial offering

• Process ideas targeting increased business right from idea to implementation. Painstakingly drive the idea internally, build the business case and sell the new product or service

• Keep a strong and tight relationship with the Accounts’ technical and commercial organization and their internal stakeholders

• Contribute in development and adjustment of account strategy in order to support the overall business plan and targets for the account

• Support the customer on a day-to-day business

• Secure correct reporting, data and pipeline management in e.g. CRM

• Support all operational activities where sales need to be involved towards the customers to ensure highest level of performance.

• Drive customer negotiations to land new business and/or supporting the Key Account commodities across.

• Secure timely preparation, process and level of RFQ and negotiations across Key Account commodities and divisions.

Our requirements

We are looking for a commercially strong and collaborative professional who thrives in a global, customer-focused environment.

• 6-10 years of proven experience in Key Account Management within large OEM environments, with a proven ability to drive growth and create value for both the customer and the business

• A basic understanding of electromechanical components and industrial environments

• Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience in budgeting, performance management, and delivering on business targets

• Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships and align expectations across internal and external partners

• Proven experience in leading cross-functional teams and managing complex projects in an industrial or technical environment

• A structured, analytical, and data-driven mindset, enabling you to translate insights into impactful decisions

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels in a global setting

• A collaborative and inclusive leadership style, with a commitment to safety, quality, and company values

• Cross-cultural awareness and the ability to operate effectively in an international matrix organisation

• Fluency in Danish and English (written and spoken); additional languages are considered a plus

Location

This role can be based in our offices in Ikast or Hammel, with flexibility for hybrid work.

Ready to make an impact?

If you are excited about shaping strategic partnerships and contributing to the renewable energy transition, we would love to hear from you.

Apply now & send us your resume in English.

Due to the summer vacation period in Denmark, all applications will be processed only in the beginning of August.

We offer

By joining KK Group, you will be part of a culture where diversity is embraced, every nationality is respected, and trust and collaboration across perspectives drives our success. Across our global organisation, we offer a wide range of job opportunities spanning office-based roles, production facilities, and onsite positions worldwide. Our roles cover multiple functions, locations, and disciplines, providing diverse career paths across the business. Whether you’re interested in engineering, manufacturing, operations, or support functions, you’ll find opportunities at KK Group to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and make an impact.

Potential Benefits (Depending on Role)

Further information

If the above matches your field of interest and your qualifications, please send your application and resume as soon as possible. Interviews are held on an ongoing basis.

For further information, please contact:

Karen Lim  +45 4194 6883

About KK Group

KK Group is a global technology partner delivering power, controls, cooling, monitoring and service solutions for renewable energy and energy-intensive industries.

With more than 45 years of experience in the wind industry and technologies installed in over 120,000 turbines worldwide, KK Group provides critical electro-mechanical systems that enable electrification, improve energy efficiency, and optimise the lifetime performance of industrial assets.

The company’s capabilities span the full value chain - from development and manufacturing to service and digital solutions - supporting customers across the entire lifecycle of their platforms. Backed by its long-term owner, A.P. Moller Holding, KK Group is expanding beyond wind into selected energy-intensive industries including hydrogen, mining, rail and defence.

Today, KK Group employs more than 3,700 people across 10+ countries and is building a more diversified, resilient and global business - Powering Change towards a more sustainable tomorrow.

Visit www.kkgroup.com to learn more about our company and career opportunities.

System Manager, Battery Energy Storage System (BESS)

Own the system. Shape the solution. Enable the energy transition.

Are you motivated by bringing complex energy systems together into one seamless, high-performing solution?

Do you enjoy working across technologies, teams, and disciplines to deliver real-world impact?

Highlights of the offer

• Job offer expiration: 30/11/2026

• Type of work: Hybrid

• Role: Individual Contributor / Specialist

• Location: Europe, Denmark

Responsibilities

Act as the overall system‑responsible owner of the entire BESS solution/product.

Define and maintain the system architecture, ensuring seamless integration of:

• PCS (Power Conversion System)

• Battery DC Block

• AC Skid

• EMS & Hybrid Power Plant Controller (HPPC)

• Grid interconnection & compliance

Ensure subsystem interfaces are clearly defined, robust, and fully aligned across electrical, control, mechanical, and communication domains.

Collaborate closely with other System Managers to deliver a high‑quality, reliable, safe, and easy‑to-install BESS platform.

Support customer-facing project phases, including:

• Understanding customer technical and functional requirements

• System sizing and configuration

• Defining or selecting product variants and architectures

• Clarifying integration, performance, and compliance aspects

Ensure the BESS platform meets all relevant standards and certifiable requirements for the targeted European and global markets.

Drive product-level requirement definition, functional specifications, technical governance, and change management.

Contribute to product roadmap development, ensuring alignment with market trends, grid requirements, and future hybrid power plant needs.

Support cost‑optimization, manufacturability, and quality initiatives to ensure a price-competitive product.

Maintain system documentation, design rules, product configuration guidelines, and compliance packages.

Our requirements

Must‑haves:

Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Systems, Controls Engineering, or a related field.

Strong understanding of grid‑scale BESS architecture and system integration.

Experience working with multiple subsystems such as PCS, battery containers, AC Skids, and EMS/plant controllers.

Ability to define system requirements, specify subsystem interfaces, and validate system integration.

Understanding of grid interconnection requirements, certifiable standards, and BESS compliance guidelines.

Experience with customer technical discussions, system sizing, and solution definition.

Nice‑to‑haves:

Experience in hybrid power plant solutions (BESS + PV + WTG).

Familiarity with European grid codes (ENTSO‑E, national TSO/DSO requirements).

Background in product ownership, system engineering, or platform leadership.

Experience with industry certification processes for electrical or power systems.

Knowledge of thermal, mechanical, or communication aspects of BESS solutions.

Location

This role can be based in our offices in Ikast or Hammel, with flexibility for hybrid work.

Ready to take ownership of the system that powers the future?

Apply now! Send us your resume in English and help us design and deliver the next generation of battery energy storage solutions.

Interviews will be scheduled on an ongoing basis.

We offer

By joining KK Group, you will be part of a culture where diversity is embraced, every nationality is respected, and trust and collaboration across perspectives drives our success. Across our global organisation, we offer a wide range of job opportunities spanning office-based roles, production facilities, and onsite positions worldwide. Our roles cover multiple functions, locations, and disciplines, providing diverse career paths across the business. Whether you’re interested in engineering, manufacturing, operations, or support functions, you’ll find opportunities at KK Group to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and make an impact.

Potential Benefits (Depending on Role)

Further information

If the above matches your field of interest and your qualifications, please send your application and resume as soon as possible. Interviews are held on an ongoing basis.

For further information, please contact:

Karen Lim  +45 4194 6883

About KK Group

KK Group is a global technology partner delivering power, controls, cooling, monitoring and service solutions for renewable energy and energy-intensive industries.

With more than 45 years of experience in the wind industry and technologies installed in over 120,000 turbines worldwide, KK Group provides critical electro-mechanical systems that enable electrification, improve energy efficiency, and optimise the lifetime performance of industrial assets.

The company’s capabilities span the full value chain - from development and manufacturing to service and digital solutions - supporting customers across the entire lifecycle of their platforms. Backed by its long-term owner, A.P. Moller Holding, KK Group is expanding beyond wind into selected energy-intensive industries including hydrogen, mining, rail and defence.

Today, KK Group employs more than 3,700 people across 10+ countries and is building a more diversified, resilient and global business - Powering Change towards a more sustainable tomorrow.

Visit www.kkgroup.com to learn more about our company and career opportunities.

Pls note that we do not support relocation or visa sponsorship for this position

Do you enjoy working through complex mechanical problems, questioning assumptions, and understanding why a design behaves the way it does?

At RD8, you will work hands-on with mechanical product development, using analysis and practical design work to solve challenging client problems. You will join an international team of mechanical engineers in a dedicated technical environment where specialist expertise is central to the work as part of a dynamic start-up

This role is for engineers who want to stay close to the engineering work and don’t shy away from the hard and interesting challenges where you have to use all of your toolbox

About RD8

We help companies that cannot afford to get it wrong make better engineering design decisions. Through consulting, software and ventures, we strengthen how mechanical R&D teams think, design and deliver.

Our aim is to make Robust Design an everyday engineering practice.

Our engineering ecosystem brings together specialist knowledge, training, documentation and software.

We work with R&D, operations and manufacturing organizations across industries, including major international companies, to make mechanical products less sensitive to variation.

What you will do

As a Robust Design Consultant, you will work directly on clients’ mechanical design challenges. You will investigate how parts interact, how tolerances affect function, and how designs can be improved.

The role combines engineering work with client dialogue and technical responsibility for project delivery.

• Work with small teams to design, analyse, and improve mechanical products. We work either inside our client’s teams or as more independent teams.

• Develop solutions for new products across several industries.

• Analyse and improve existing products in a range of industries.

• Create data-driven transparency in your solutions to improve decision-making.

• Explain findings and design recommendations to clients, help deliver projects, and coordinate technical work within the team.

You will be working on these tasks with frontrunners within the area of Robust Design - experts on a global level, in a start-up with global ambitions.

We are continuously developing our framework and adopting or creating solutions for our engineering ecosystem.

There’s a short way from decision to action and a high degree of freedom to shape the company and solutions. Great opportunities to take responsibility and for shaping business areas going forward

Your background

We welcome engineers with two or more years of relevant professional experience, ideally in mechanical product development, as well as senior specialists who want to deepen their expertise and remain hands-on.

• A master’s degree in mechanical engineering or a related field.

• Strong analytical skills across mechanical function, tolerance variation, and solid mechanics.

• Knowledge of Robust Design principles.

• Knowledge of production technologies and Design for Manufacturing (DFM).

• Fluent English.

Additional experience we value

• Working knowledge of statistical methods and finite element simulation methods.

• Experience with prototyping tools and methods.

• Strong communication and presentation skills.

• Danish or German language skills.

• Advanced simulation expertise.

Location and travel

This is a hybrid role based at our headquarters at Strandboulevarden 122, 3rd floor, 2100 Copenhagen, Denmark.

Expect 0–20 travel days per year.

Why join RD8

• Work alongside Robust Design specialists on mechanical challenges across products and industries.

• Have a high degree of freedom in how you approach your work and contribute to the methods and tools we develop.

• Flexibility to work from home when project and client commitments allow, with support for a home office setup

• Optional monthly social events, a subsidized lunch scheme and coffee, tea and snacks at the office.

• Take on responsibility and help shape our services and business areas as the company develops.

Apply

If you're a problem-solver who is excited about working on cutting-edge technology to create world-class solutions, then apply now with your CV

For further information about the position, contact Casper Høgh at csh@ing.dk

Please mention in your application that you saw the job on TechJob.

The Deloitte Master's Thesis Hub bridges bright students with unanswered questions Deloitte is curious about.

The program is a great place to meet like-minded students navigating the ups and downs of thesis writing. Best of all, you'll have the invaluable opportunity to get guidance and support during the writing process and tap into the expertise of Deloitte's thought leaders, who will guide you on the path of creating an impactful master thesis!

Our Deloitte experts will be able to provide collaboration and guidance within the following five research topics:

• M&A & Strategy

• Sustainability & ESG

• Financial Performance & Reporting

• Digital Transformation & AI

• Organization & Change Management

Deloitte invests in providing relevant business insight and latest industry trends, challenging your thought process, and giving access to a large network of experts in the specific problem domain. We help develop your problem-solving skills and show you tips and tricks to present research findings concisely. Most importantly, the Master's Thesis Hub offers a room for reflection and shared learning between participants and experts.

By applying to the Master’s Thesis Hub, you will commit to attending four dedicated sessions from January – April 2026 for shared learning and pro-level guidance. To round of the Master Thesis Hub we will have a celebration dinner in June 2026, to congratulate you on your new degree. All sessions will be held in the Deloitte office in Copenhagen (Weidekampsgade 6, 2300 Copenhagen S). Note that it is a requirement to attend all sessions physically at the Copenhagen office to be a part of the program.

Are you ready? We are looking forward to receiving your application!

How to apply?

To apply, click "I'm interested" and upload your CV (along with the CVs of your group members if applicable). You will also be asked to answer a few practical questions.

Final deadline for signing up is the 4th of December. You will receive a response regarding your application shortly thereafter.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

About DonerKing

DonerKing is a growing fast-food restaurant brand operating three locations in Copenhagen, Denmark.

We are seeking a motivated and commercially driven Business Development Manager to support our existing operations and lead our future growth and expansion.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Develop and execute business growth strategies for DonerKing.

• 
Identify and evaluate new restaurant locations across Denmark.

• 
Improve sales, revenue and profitability across existing restaurants.

• 
Research market trends, competitors and customer preferences.

• 
Build partnerships with suppliers, landlords, shopping centres and delivery platforms.

• 
Identify opportunities for corporate catering, B2B sales and new revenue streams.

• 
Work with restaurant managers to improve operational performance.

• 
Develop marketing and promotional strategies to attract new customers.

• 
Prepare financial forecasts, business plans, and expansion proposals.

• 
Report business performance and growth opportunities directly to company ownership.

Requirements

• 
Experience in business development, sales, hospitality, retail or restaurant management.

• 
Strong communication, negotiation and leadership skills.

• 
Good understanding of the Danish business environment.

• 
Ability to develop business plans and deliver measurable results.

• 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• 
Good English communication skills; Danish is an advantage.

• 
Must already be residing in Denmark and have the legal right to work in Denmark.

What We Offer

• 
Full-time management position.

• 
Competitive salary based on experience.

• 
Opportunity to lead DonerKing's expansion.

• 
Direct collaboration with company ownership.

• 
Career development opportunities.

• 
A dynamic and growing business environment.

How to Apply

Send your CV and a short application explaining your relevant experience.

Are you looking for a temporary job with the opportunity to get plenty of hours? Then this could be the right opportunity for you!

 Fredericia – Temporary Position – Evening & Night Shifts

We are currently looking for reliable and flexible temps to support one of our clients in Fredericia. The company expects to become busier over the coming weeks, which means there may be many shifts available.

During busy periods, there may be opportunities to work around 37 hours per week. However, as the number of shifts depends on the company's workload, we cannot guarantee a specific number of hours.

 

Your tasks will include:

• 
Sorting and handling parcels and letters

• 
Handling and placing shipments correctly

• 
Lifting and moving heavier parcels

• 
General warehouse and production tasks

• 
Helping to ensure that the daily work runs smoothly

The job involves physical work and regular heavy lifting, so you should be comfortable with an active working day.

 

Working hours:

There are shifts available on both weekdays and weekends.

jobs.occupation: Hotel Allrounder (Bar, F&B, Reception all in one role)
jobs.description:
Hospitality job in Copenhagen. One role, many hats. No two days alike.  Love good coffee, great drinks and even better conversation? Want a hotel job where no day feels the same? Keep reading.   Most hotel jobs put you in one spot. At Zoku, you’ll be everywhere that matters. 

From welcoming guests and sharing local tips to serving great food, making coffee, and mixing cocktails, you’ll help create the experience people remember long after they’ve checked out. If variety is your thing and making people feel genuinely at home comes naturally to you, you might be exactly who we’re looking for. 

At Zoku, we’re not your typical hotel. We’re a community-driven space where people can live, work, socialize, and connect with the city around them. We believe hospitality should feel personal, human, and effortless and that starts with the people on our team. That’s where you come in! 

WHAT IS A SIDEKICK?  

At Zoku, we call our hospitality all-rounders “Sidekicks”. You can think of this role as a Guest Experience Host: someone who combines reception, restaurant, bar, and guest services into one dynamic hospitality role. You’re the friendly face welcoming guests at check in, the person recommending your favorite local spots, the bartender making someone’s evening, and the host creating a warm atmosphere in our rooftop Living Kitchen restaurant. 

No two days are the same and that’s exactly why people love this role. 

WHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY DO 

Behind the bar. Pull espressos in the morning, pour craft beer in the afternoon, shake cocktails at night. We'll teach you the recipes, you bring the chat. 

In the restaurant. Serve breakfast, lunch, dinner and bites in our Living Kitchen and on our rooftop terraces with great views over the city. Guide guests to the right wine, the right small plate, the right table. 

At the front desk. Welcome arriving guests, handle check-ins & check-outs, and answer the inevitable "where's the best bakery in Copenhagen?" with the kind of tips only a local would know. 

YOUR SCHEDULE 

You’ll work independently across different departments, with both morning and afternoon/evening shifts. A standard shift is 8 hours with a 30 minute meal break. Your responsibilities and hours may vary.

• 
Morning Shift (AM Shift): 07:00 to 15:00 (+/- 1 hour)

• 
Afternoon/Evening Shift (PM Shift): 15:00 to 23:00 (+/- 1 hour)

YOU’LL FIT RIGHT IN IF YOU 

• 
Are genuinely friendly, and open. 

• 
Love creating unforgettable stays where guests feel a true sense of belonging. 

• 
Thrive in social, energetic environments. 

• 
Like variety and can easily switch between different tasks. 

• 
Are proactive, hands on, and team oriented. 

• 
Have a genuine interest in hospitality, food, drinks, travel, or community. 

• 
Love discovering and sharing the best spots in Copenhagen. 

 

A FEW MUST HAVES 

• 
You have worked in hospitality or in a similar customer-facing industry.

• 
You are fluent in English - Danish and any other languages are a big plus!

• 
You are an EU resident or have a valid working and living permit to work in Denmark.

• 
You have a CPR-number / tax number and a Danish bank account.

• 
You are flexible, as there are no fixed working days / hours and enjoy working both week days and weekends.

• 
You are available to work either 32 hours weekly (4 shifts) or 37 hours weekly (Full Time-5 Shifts).

 

Start date: We’re ready to welcome our next Sidekick as soon as possible! We’re reviewing applications on a rolling basis, so don’t snooze, apply today! We’re all about finding the right match for our amazing team.

RECRUITMENT PROCESS

• 
We’ll screen applications as they are submitted.

• 
We’ll give you a call to for a quick get to know each other chat.

• 
We’ll invite you in for either 1 or 2 interviews to get a tour of Zoku and meet the Team.

• 
We’ll finalize the offer and get you started!

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU 

You’ll join an international team filled with people who genuinely care about hospitality, creativity, and community. Plus, exciting training and events to celebrate every step of the journey! 

• 
A market conform salary package including pension and health insurance.

• 
A 40% discount on food & drinks for you and up to 4 friends 

• 
Discounted Employee- and Friends & Family rates across all Zoku locations (Amsterdam, Copenhagen, Vienna and Paris) 

• 
The best staff meals, enjoyed in our rooftop Social Spaces overlooking the city. 

• 
A free night stay for you and a +1 in your first 3 months – plus another free night at any Zoku location for your birthday celebration 

• 
Access to all community events, team celebrations, and after work drinks 

• 
Exciting on-the-job training opportunities and fun events throughout the year to celebrate achievements and milestones.

• 
A personal budget after your first year: spend it on extra days off, learning, or take it as cash  

Check out all benefits here.  

WHAT WE ARE PROUD OF 

Zoku combines the energy of a lifestyle brand with the warmth of a close knit team. We challenge traditional hospitality by creating spaces where people genuinely connect, whether they’re staying for one night or several months. 

Next to our award-winning design and our global press fan club, we’re proud to be a certified B Corp across all our locations, meaning we care deeply about people, community, and doing business with a heart (not just as a marketing line). 

WHAT THE ZOKU?!  We’re Zoku. Designed for the new generation of business travelers, we’re so much more than a long stay hotel. We’re a place you can call your second home, even on your first visit. We’ve created a hive of private Lofts and rooftop Social Spaces, so you can stay connected and well rested as you live and work throughout Europe. Throw yourself into your work and play, and effortlessly discover one of our home cities. It will be your home city next.  READY? Hit apply and tell us why this role has your name on it.

jobs.employer_name: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
As Head of Commercial Products at Impact Fund Denmark, you will turn investment ideas and investor requirements into commercially viable funds and other investment products. You will build the financial models and fund structures that enable Impact Fund Denmark to attract additional private capital for investments in developing and emerging markets.

You will take responsibility for financial structuring and product development, combining hands-on modelling with a visible role in investor discussions. Working closely with the Head of Investor Relations, you will explain product economics, support fundraising and contribute technical expertise to the ongoing investor dialogue for existing funds.

The role is part of Legal, Compliance and Commercial (LCC), led by Frederik Bjørn, General Counsel & Chief Commercial Officer. LCC brings together Legal Corporate, Legal Transactions, Compliance (Non-Financial Risk), and Sales and Investor Relations and consists of around 15 colleagues across Copenhagen and IFDK’s international locations.

You will work in a highly collaborative environment, with close interaction across Investor Relations, Legal, Risk and the wider investment organisation. The team values openness, constructive challenge and strong professional collaboration. You will have considerable ownership of your area while drawing on specialist expertise from colleagues across LCC, Investment, Finance, Risk, Valuation and Strategy & Business Development.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• 
Design and structure investment products, including tranches with different risk and return profiles, risk-sharing arrangements and guarantees.

• 
Build and challenge financial models using cash-flow analysis, scenarios and simulations, including Monte Carlo methods, to assess outcomes for investors and IFDK.

• 
Assess how funds and products work together, including risk allocation and the implications of different investment and guarantee structures.

• 
Develop fee and pricing models that reflect the economics of each product and the resources required to manage it.

• 
Develop investor and sales materials and present products alongside the Head of Investor Relations, explaining structures, risks and returns and answering product-specific questions in investor due diligence.

• 
Contribute financial analysis to information memoranda and ongoing investor reporting, and participate in Limited Partner Advisory Committee (LPAC) meetings and other investor fora for existing funds.

• 
Work with Investment, Finance, Legal, Risk and Valuation colleagues to translate investor and guarantee requirements into clear responsibilities and processes throughout fund and product lifecycles.

YOUR FIRST YEAR

• 
A consistent approach to financial modelling and clear investor materials supports product design, fundraising and ongoing investor dialogue.

• 
Structuring and pricing options for priority products have been assessed, with clear recommendations on risk allocation and economics.

• 
Responsibilities and handovers for key investor and guarantee requirements are agreed with the relevant teams.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

You bring substantial experience in financial structuring and investment products, with the commercial judgement and credibility to take ownership and engage directly with institutional and other private investors. You have:

• 
A relevant master’s degree in finance, economics or a related discipline with a strong quantitative foundation.

• 
Experience personally building financial models and developing or structuring investment products.

• 
A strong understanding of risk, return, cash flows and how financial structures allocate outcomes between different investors.

• 
Experience working with institutional investors, supporting institutional clients or working on the investment side of a pension company.

• 
Experience presenting complex financial topics to investors or institutional clients, with the ability to turn analysis into clear recommendations and respond confidently to technical questions.

• 
Strong written and spoken Danish and English.

You combine technical depth with commercial judgement, take ownership of detailed work and collaborate effectively across specialist functions. Experience with illiquid assets or private-market fund structures would be an advantage.

WHERE THE ROLE SITS

Based in Copenhagen, you will report directly to Frederik Bjørn, General Counsel & Chief Commercial Officer, and work closely with the Head of Investor Relations. You will have analytical support from Strategy & Business Development for product development and investor-related work.

WHY JOIN US

You will shape how IFDK combines institutional investor requirements, financial returns and impact. The role offers ownership of product development, direct exposure to investors and broad collaboration across IFDK, with the opportunity to see your work through from financial design to fundraising and ongoing investor reporting.

PRACTICAL DETAILS

Location: Copenhagen | Position: Full-time | Start date: By agreement

Please apply through IFDK’s recruitment platform with your CV and a short application explaining your interest in the role and relevant experience.

jobs.occupation: Content Creator to DAMM Cellular Systems A/S
jobs.description:
Content Creator

Find the interesting. Make it understandable. Get it seen.

DAMM Cellular Systems builds communication systems for organisations worldwide that depend on them when communication matters most - from offshore installations and mines to airports and emergency response teams.

We're a technical company with deep expertise, customers operating in high-stakes environments, and an industry moving fast. There are plenty of stories and insights worth sharing. We need someone who can recognise what matters, find the right angle and turn it into content that reaches the people we want to reach.

This is not a traditional content writing role.

Writing is at the heart of it. But writing in isolation is no longer enough.

Today, how content gets discovered is just as important as what it says. Search engines, AI and social platforms are changing how people find and consume information. We need someone who understands these shifts and knows how to make our content more visible, relevant and effective - so it works for us, not the other way around.

What you'll do.

Understand our customers and uncover opportunities

Work closely with our sales teams and partners to understand customer needs, challenges and buying motivations. Draw on engineers and technical specialists to understand how our solutions deliver value. Identify stories, insights and opportunities worth communicating.

Bring our key messages to life

Understand DAMM's positioning, communication priorities, industries and target audiences. Find fresh ways to consistently reinforce our key messages, translate technical capabilities into meaningful customer benefits and communicate what makes DAMM different - without simply repeating ourselves.

Create content that matters

Turn customer insights, expertise, stories and proof points into clear, engaging content for our website, LinkedIn, newsletters and campaigns. Create articles, case studies, thought leadership content, short videos and podcast teasers. Support outreach activities.

Design for discovery

Understand how search, AI, social algorithms and emerging platforms influence what gets found, read and shared. Use that knowledge to shape content from the outset - how it's framed, structured, published and distributed.

Improve what works

Use data, feedback and digital tools to refine content and experiment with new approaches. Find smarter ways to research, create, repurpose content and improve workflows.

What we're looking for

You don't need a traditional background or a particular number of years on your CV. What matters is strong writing, editorial judgement, commercial awareness and curiosity about technology and digital communication.

• Experience creating content for professional audiences, ideally within B2B or technical industries.
• Excellent English writing and editing skills, with the ability to make complex subjects clear, relevant and engaging.
• An understanding of how content gets discovered and performs across digital channels - what makes people stop, read, watch or click.
• Confidence using digital tools and an interest in search and emerging technologies.
• The ability to adapt messages and content for different audiences, industries and formats.
• A proactive, curious mindset and the confidence to ask questions and take initiative.
• Experience creating or editing short-form video is an advantage.
 What you'll be part of

You'll join a small marketing team at our headquarters in Sønderborg, working closely with the Head of Marketing and colleagues across the business.

DAMM has around 80 colleagues representing more than 15 cultures, with teams and partners around the world. We’re an international, flat and team-oriented organisation where people take responsibility for their work, bring their own areas of expertise and work together towards a common goal.

What we offer

• The opportunity to shape how an international technology company communicates.
• A varied role combining writing, creativity, technology and digital communication.
• A small team where your work is visible and your ideas can make a difference.
• Health insurance, a lunch scheme, and social and sporting activities.
The position is based at our office in Sønderborg, Denmark.

How to apply

Forget the traditional cover letter.

Send us your CV and a short application answering two questions:

• What caught your attention about this role, and what would you bring to it?
• Share a piece of writing you're particularly proud of. What makes it work, and why?
Please include examples of your work.

We'd also love to see a short video (around 60 seconds) introducing yourself. Your phone is fine, and no editing is needed. It's completely optional, but it's a nice way for us to get a feel for you.

If you have questions about the role, contact: Lone Hansen, Head of Marketing, at +45 2986 7350.

Summary: Overall Job Purpose

As a Bra Innovation Designer, you will lead the creative development of innovative bra products across our lingerie collections, with a particular focus on moulded cup technologies, new constructions, materials and functional design solutions.

You will combine a strong fashion sensibility with specialist knowledge of bra design, translating customer needs, market insights and emerging textile technologies into commercially relevant products that deliver CHANGE's Perfect Fit philosophy.

Working across our two annual fashion collections and ongoing product development initiatives, you will drive new product concepts from initial research and design through prototyping, sample development and production readiness. You will collaborate closely with Technical Design, Production, Planning and our manufacturing partners in China to develop products that balance innovation, aesthetics, comfort, support, quality and commercial viability.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

·         Research emerging trends, bra innovations, competitor products, textile technologies and customer needs to identify new product development opportunities.

·         Lead the design and development of innovative bra concepts, including moulded cup bras, seamless and bonded constructions, wireless solutions and new support technologies.

·         Explore moulding techniques, foam and spacer materials, cup shapes, pad and wire solutions, innovative fabrics, elastics and construction methods in collaboration with Technical Design, Production and suppliers.

·         Develop new silhouettes and design solutions that enhance fit, comfort, support and aesthetics across CHANGE’s extensive size range, including larger cup sizes.

·         Create detailed design sketches, technical drawings, concept presentations and collection overviews using Adobe Creative Suite.

·         Initiate raw material research, sourcing and development with suppliers, including new material technologies and alternative sourcing opportunities.

·         Work closely with Technical Design on prototype fittings, construction development, material performance and product refinement, supporting the achievement of approved fit and quality standards.

·         Collaborate with manufacturing partners in China to develop prototypes, evaluate new manufacturing capabilities and translate innovative concepts into commercially viable products.

·         Assess target costs, manufacturing feasibility and design-to-cost opportunities to achieve category margin objectives.

·         Create and maintain accurate design information in PLM, including sketches, materials, trims, colorways, design BOM components and development updates.

·         Support product commercialization through product descriptions, key product features, innovation storytelling and collaboration with Marketing.

·         Contribute to continuous improvement of bra design standards, product performance and the development of new product categories.

KPIs

·         On-Time Milestone Delivery: Percentage of assigned design and innovation deliverables completed within agreed collection deadlines.

·         Product Innovation: Delivery of approved new bra concepts, moulded cup solutions, materials and construction innovations against agreed development objectives.

·         First-Time Sample Accuracy: Percentage of initial samples meeting approved design specifications without significant aesthetic or construction-related design corrections.

·         Design Cost Compliance: Percentage of developed styles meeting target FOB costs and category margin objectives.

·         PLM Data Accuracy & Completeness

·         Commercial Performance: Performance of launched innovation products against agreed sales, sell-through and category objectives.

Ideal Profile

You are an experienced and technically curious designer with a genuine passion for lingerie, product innovation and the relationship between design, fit and function.

You bring specialist knowledge of bra construction and moulded cup products, together with a strong understanding of textile materials, manufacturing processes and emerging technologies. You enjoy exploring new solutions, challenging existing product constructions and translating complex technical possibilities into desirable, commercially relevant designs.

You are hands-on, proactive and detail-oriented, with the confidence to drive development projects independently while collaborating closely with technical specialists, suppliers and cross-functional teams.

You combine creativity with commercial awareness and understand how innovative product design can strengthen CHANGE’s positioning in fit, inclusivity and product expertise.

Qualifications

·         Relevant higher education in Fashion Design, Textile Design, or Contour Fashion.

·         Minimum 5 years of professional experience in fashion and textiles, with specialized experience in bra design and intimate apparel product development.

·         Demonstrated experience developing moulded cup bras, including knowledge of cup construction, moulding processes, materials and manufacturing requirements.

·         Strong understanding of bra construction, fit, support, sizing, grading considerations and performance requirements.

·         Knowledge of innovative textile materials, foam, spacer fabrics, bonded and seamless technologies and other functional lingerie constructions.

·         Proven experience managing product development from initial concept through prototyping, sample approval and production readiness.

·         Strong design skills with proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite

·         Experience working with PLM systems and maintaining accurate product development information.

·         Understanding of garment costing, manufacturing feasibility and commercial product development.

·         Experience collaborating with international suppliers and production partners, preferably in Asia.

·         Strong communication, presentation and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple development projects and deadlines.

·   Fluent in written and spoken English. Mandarin fluency is a plus
